We modeled fluid and vasopressor dosing on a cohort of 36,872 septic ICU stays drawn from the MIMIC-IV critical-care database, as a discretized Markov decision process with 1,000 states and 25 actions, defined by a five-by-five grid of fluid and vasopressor levels and solved by policy iteration. The clinicians' behavior policy was estimated with a random forest, which mitigated the collapse of the Effective Sample Size (ESS 50.1 against 4.0 with smoothed counts) that otherwise destabilizes the importance-sampling estimate. The learned policy was evaluated with two estimators, weighted importance sampling (WIS) and fitted Q evaluation (FQE), with the ESS and clinician agreement as reliability checks. An empirical variable selection found that the composition of the state matters more than its size. Both estimators place the learned policy above the clinicians' return (WIS 50.8 and FQE 46.8 against 38.2, ESS 50.1), yet it departs only modestly from observed practice (total variation 0.18), favoring less intravenous fluid. These retrospective single-center off-policy results support the learned policy as a clinically plausible refinement of observed practice and motivate its further evaluation as a discordance-based clinical decision-support approach.

</details>


### [181] [Large language models as synthetic clinical experts to inform longitudinal rare-disease modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16507)
*Clemens Schächter,Astrid Pechmann,Janbernd Kirschner,Jan Hasenauer,Harald Binder*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出利用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为合成临床专家，通过监督变分自编码器（VAE）框架学习纵向罕见病数据的低维潜在表示，从而将临床知识引入模型拟合过程，减少重建数据的临床解释失真并改善下游预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向罕见病数据量有限，建模时需要整合临床知识，但临床专家的时间有限，因而难以进行知识引导和形式化。本文旨在克服这一瓶颈，使领域知识在模型拟合过程中可被利用。

Method: 采用LLMs作为合成临床专家，离线查询患者观测的文本描述以获得判断（如临床类别）；训练一个可微分的替代模型来学习这些判断，并将其作为额外损失项加入VAE的损失函数，鼓励重建结果保留原始输入的临床标签分布；在后续应用中将就诊层面的临床画像映射到低维表示，再通过多元混合效应模型进行关联建模。

Result: 在脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA）儿童纵向运动功能数据上，合成专家损失显著减少了原始与重建SMA类型标签的不一致率（从约11%降至7%）；且相比无监督潜在表示和数据层面基线，合成专家引导的潜在表示在运动功能里程碑预测上表现更好。

Conclusion: 将LLMs纳入模型拟合可使临床知识对表示学习可用，提高纵向罕见病数据建模的临床忠实度，展示了LLMs作为合成专家在医学数据分析中的潜力。

Abstract: Due to the limited amount of information, modeling longitudinal rare-disease data can benefit from integrating clinical knowledge. Yet, elicitation of expert knowledge and formalization for model fitting is challenging, in particular due to limited time of clinical experts. To nevertheless make domain knowledge accessible during model fitting, we use large language models (LLMs) as synthetic clinical experts to supervise a variational-autoencoder-based approach that learns low-dimensional latent summaries of visit-level observations. Specifically, LLMs are queried offline on textual descriptions of patient observations to obtain judgments, e.g., the suspected clinical category. To improve the variational autoencoder fit, we train a differentiable surrogate model on these judgments and augment the loss function to encourage reconstructions that preserve the clinical-label distribution of their corresponding input profile. In an application to longitudinal motor-function assessments from children with spinal muscular atrophy, we map visit-level clinical profiles to low-dimensional representations that are linked by a multivariate mixed-effects model. The synthetic expert loss discourages reconstructions that remain numerically close in data space but alter the clinical interpretation of the reconstructed motor function profile, such as by crossing a disease-type boundary. We thus reduced disagreement between original and reconstructed SMA type labels from about 11 to 7 percent. Furthermore, informing the latent representation by the synthetic expert improved prediction of motor function milestones compared with unsupervised latent representations and a data-level baseline. These results suggest that incorporating LLMs into model fitting can make clinical knowledge available to representation learning and improve clinical faithfulness for longitudinal rare-disease data.

</details>


### [182] [DeepInsight II: One Trace from Benchmark to Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16556)
*Siyi Li,Yuchen Kang,Wuliang Wang,Zhengjie Zhang,Jiangpin Liu,Jianhao Yao,Jie Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeepInsight II 延续 DeepInsight v1 的统一评估框架（task、resource、result 三大抽象），将实证范围从基础模型层扩展到完整 Physical AI 栈的"具身一半"——包含导航与操控（System 1）和全身控制（System 0），并通过原生协议复现、统一基准、以及共享父轨迹身份的仿真-真实机器人配对实验，使 sim-to-real 差距成为原生归约而非跨工具链校准；此外提出带证据支撑的 System 2-1-0 交接标签与可修复性判据，实现从基准执行到匹配机器人证据与面向修复诊断的实证连续性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Physical AI 栈中评估成熟度与部署风险呈反向分布：基础模型层拥有成熟标准化的评估工具，而决定部署成败的具身层却碎片化于各种基准专属的仿真器、本体和接口之中。DeepInsight v1 虽统一了评估抽象，但其定量证据集中于基础模型层，导航/操控与全身控制仍停留在仿真案例研究，物理执行不在实证范围内，因此需要在固定统一基座的前提下量化具身半层。

Method: (1) 在原生协议下复现两个导航与四个操控基准的已发布 checkpoint 参考结果；(2) 设计 MotionBench，将四个已发布的全身控制器置于统一工作负载与指标契约下，并把合格的家庭内队列从并行仿真推进到匹配的真实机器人试验——仿真与物理 rollout 共享父轨迹身份但保留各自执行域专属记录，使 sim-to-real 差距成为原生归约；(3) 组合 System 2-1-0 研究，将轨迹定位扩展为五种证据支撑的交接标签，每种映射到具体修复动作，配以可测的可修复性判据，并用物理场景在硬件可观测状态下检验相同归因。

Result: 在四个（导航×2、操控×4）基准上获得跨任务的可复现参照；MotionBench 在统一契约下对齐四个全身控制器，并成功实现从并行仿真到匹配实体机器人的同源轨迹迁移；System 2-1-0 组合研究产生了五种证据支撑的交接标签、对应的具体修复动作、可量化的可修复性判据，并在物理硬件可观测状态下验证了归因一致性。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献并非提出新的评估架构，而是提供了从基准执行、到匹配的机器人证据、再到面向修复诊断的实证连续性，验证了 DeepInsight 统一抽象框架可以贯穿完整 Physical AI 栈，包括此前缺失的具身与物理执行层。

Abstract: Across a Physical AI stack, evaluation maturity is inversely aligned with deployment risk: foundation models enjoy mature, standardized harnesses, while the embodied layers on which deployment actually turns remain fragmented across benchmark-specific simulators, embodiments, and interfaces. The first DeepInsight report (v1) unified evaluation across this stack behind three abstractions---task, resource, and result---but its quantitative evidence centered on the foundation-model layer; navigation and manipulation (System 1) and whole-body control (System 0) remained simulation case studies, and physical execution was outside its empirical scope. DeepInsight II keeps that substrate fixed and quantifies the embodied half. First, it reproduces released-checkpoint references across two navigation and four manipulation benchmarks under their native protocols. Second, MotionBench places four released whole-body controllers under one workload and metric contract, then carries a qualified within-family cohort from parallel simulation to matched real-robot trials in which simulated and physical rollouts share a parent trace identity while retaining execution-domain-specific records, making the sim-to-real gap a native reduction rather than a reconciliation across toolchains. Third, a composed System 2--1--0 study extends trace localization into five evidence-grounded handoff labels, each mapped to a concrete repair action, with a measured repairability criterion and physical episodes testing the same attribution under hardware-observable state. The contribution is therefore not a new evaluation architecture, but empirical continuity from benchmark execution to matched robot evidence and repair-oriented diagnosis.

</details>


### [183] [CUBICS: Situation-aware performance estimation for safety-relevant ML components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16564)
*Benjamin Herd,Jessica Kelly,Mario Trapp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CUBICS是一个面向安全相关机器学习组件的上下文模块化框架，通过将运行设计域划分为情境，并利用主观逻辑（Subjective Logic）为每个组件构建情境特定的概率保证，以贝叶斯方式实现基于现场数据的性能估计，避免了对整个系统构建单一统计模型的不可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有贝叶斯现场数据分析方法通常将故障建模为单一全局故障概率的伯努利过程，且假设i.i.d.试验，这无法刻画机器学习组件性能对上下文的强依赖特性；同时，为整个系统构建单一的集成统计模型通常不可行，需要一种模块化、情境感知的安全论证方法。

Method: 提出的CUBICS框架包括：将运行设计域（ODD）划分为不同情境；对每个安全相关组件定义情境特定的假设和概率保证；使用主观逻辑以贝叶斯方式表示和更新这些保证；将各情境的保证与情境发生频率的信念相结合，为每个组件推导整体风险估计。

Result: 该方法能够在无需构建单一系统级统计模型的情况下，为每个安全相关ML组件提供情境感知的风险估计，从而为模块化、基于现场数据的安全论证提供基础构件。

Conclusion: CUBICS通过情境模块化的方式克服了传统伯努利模型对ML组件性能依赖性刻画不足以及整体统计建模不可行的问题，为安全相关的机器学习应用提供了一种可行的、模块化的现场数据驱动安全保证方法。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) is a key technology driving innovation today, but ensuring ML safety remains a major challenge for safety-related applications. A promising idea is to build proven-in-use arguments from field data, e.g. by running ML components (MLCs) in shadow mode or within safety envelopes so that their outputs can be monitored as 'safe probes' without affecting safety. These probes can then be used to build a statistical argument about field performance in a Bayesian way. However, many Bayesian field-data approaches in safety engineering model failures as a simple Bernoulli (or binomial) process with a single global failure probability and i.i.d. trials, which is rarely adequate for MLCs whose performance depends strongly on context. Statistical evidence is also about coverage of relevant situations, including edge cases, and building a single integrated statistical model for the entire system is usually not feasible. To address these challenges, this paper introduces CUBICS, a context-modular framework for per-component, situation-aware performance estimation of safety-relevant ML components. CUBICS partitions the operational design domain into situations and, for each safety-relevant component, defines a set of situation-specific assumptions and probabilistic guarantees that are represented and updated in a Bayesian manner using Subjective Logic (SL). By combining these guarantees with beliefs about how often each situation occurs, CUBICS derives an overall risk estimate for each component without requiring a monolithic system-level statistical model, and thus provides a building block for modular, field-data based safety assurance.

</details>


### [184] [Probabilistic Circuits as Reasoning Machines in Artificial Intelligence (Part I)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16565)
*Robert Peharz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文是一篇累積式资格教授论文（Habilitation Thesis），系统研究概率电路（PCs）作为AI中可处理的推理与学习框架，综合了十年间在PCs基础理论、算法开发与实证验证方面的研究成果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率推理在几乎所有概率模型中都是NP难的，面临巨大计算挑战。尽管如此，概率作为AI的核心语言具有显著优势——与逻辑和信息论的紧密联系、基于求和与乘积规则的概念简洁性、与人类认知的平行关系以及在最优决策中的作用。因此需要一种既能保留概率推理优势又能克服其计算障碍的框架。

Method: 通过结构性约束确保多项式时间内精确计算各类推理查询（边缘概率、条件概率、最可能解释、期望等）。论文涵盖PCs的基础理论构建、贝叶斯学习方法、可扩展实现与深度学习的集成、与不可处理模型的混合架构，以及与符号机器学习范式的连接。

Result: 论文综合了作者十年间在概率电路领域的研究成果，提出了PCs的基础理论，开发了贝叶斯学习算法，实现了可扩展的深层集成方案，并探索了与不可处理模型及符号机器学习相结合的混合模型。

Conclusion: 概率电路通过结构约束在可处理性与表达能力之间取得了平衡，为AI中的不确定性推理与学习提供了强大而可行的框架。该论文作为资格教授论文的第一部分，介绍了研究主题与核心贡献，而具体发表的论文汇编在第二部分（第五章）中呈现。

Abstract: This cumulative habilitation thesis studies probabilistic circuits (PCs) as a powerful and tractable framework for reasoning and learning under uncertainty in artificial intelligence (AI). It first advocates for probability as a core language for AI, emphasizing its connections to logic and information theory; the conceptual simplicity of probabilistic reasoning---based primarily on the sum and product rules; the parallels between probabilistic inference and human cognition; and the role of probability in optimal decision making. However, probability also faces significant computational challenges, as probabilistic inference is NP-hard in almost all probabilistic models. PCs address these challenges through structural constraints that ensure exact computation of a wide range of inference queries in polynomial time, such as marginals, conditionals, most probable explanations, expectations, and more advanced inference tasks. This thesis synthesizes a decade of research across foundations, algorithmic developments, and empirical validation of PCs. Key contributions highlighted in this work are foundational theory of PCs, Bayesian approaches for learning PCs, scalable implementations and integration with deep learning, hybrid models that combine PCs with intractable models, and connections with symbolic machine learning paradigms.
  This is the first part of my Habilitation Thesis. The second part is omitted, as it comprises the cumulative part of the thesis and has been published at various venues (see Chapter 5).

</details>


### [185] [Physics of Agents: Statistical Mechanics Predicts Collective Behavior of AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16578)
*Batu El,Jinhee Paeng,Fatih Dinc,Shiye Su,Mete Erdogan,Aneesh Pappu,Haotian Ye,Wanjia Zhao,Surya Ganguli,James Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过超过10,000个语言模型智能体社区，揭示了多智能体系统在反复交流和修改观点时呈现三种特征性动态阶段——冷漠、两极分化和共识，并提出一个统计力学框架，基于初始观点即可预测个体轨迹和群体动态模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体越来越多地在交互系统中运作，而非孤立运行。它们之间的信息交换和联合决策既能改进集体推理，也可能产生从众、极化和放大共同偏见等负面效应。理解和预测这些集体动态对于设计有效且对齐的多智能体系统至关重要。

Method: 该研究使用超过10,000个语言模型智能体社区，在客观数学问题和主观政治陈述上进行重复信息交换和观点修订实验。作者提出一个统计力学形式体系，其中智能体随机偏好较低的社会压力（类似于降低社会压强），基于仅初始观点即可预测个体轨迹。

Result: 研究发现：1）AI智能体从冷漠开始，在互动中建立信念强度；2）在客观问题上交流改善集体准确性，而在主观问题上观点常向右翼政治光谱漂移；3）该统计力学模型优于所有标准基线，能泛化到未见社区图，并复现群体原型分布。关键机制发现：社区运行于临界社会温度之下（解释信念建立）、吸引性联系多于排斥性联系（促进共识）、持有正确答案的智能体施加最强拉动力（驱动求真）。

Conclusion: AI智能体的集体行为与其他复杂系统一样，遵循简洁且可预测的动态规律。这为设计有效的多智能体系统提供了理论基础，表明即使是看似多样化的智能体交互也能用统一的统计力学框架来描述和预测。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly operate as part of interacting systems rather than in isolation. As agents exchange information and jointly make decisions, their interactions can improve collective reasoning but may also produce herding, polarization, or amplify shared biases. Understanding and predicting these collective dynamics is therefore important for designing effective and aligned multi-agent systems. Here, we study over 10,000 communities of language-model agents that repeatedly exchange messages and revise their opinions across objective mathematics questions and subjective political statements. Despite substantial diversity in possible behavior, the individual and group dynamics can be represented by three characteristic regimes: indifference, polarization, and consensus. AI agents start indifferent and build conviction as they interact. On objective questions, communication improves collective accuracy, while on subjective questions it often drifts group opinions toward the right in the political spectrum. We explain these observations with a statistical-mechanics formalism in which agents stochastically favor lower social pressure. Given only initial opinions, our model predicts individual trajectories, outperforms all standard baselines, generalizes to unseen community graphs, and reproduces the observed group archetype distributions. Our fitted model parameters reveal the mechanics underlying our key observations: i) communities operate below the critical social temperature, which explains conviction buildup; ii) attractive ties outweigh repulsive ones, which favors consensus; and iii) agents holding the correct answer exert the strongest pull, which drives truth-seeking. Overall, our results demonstrate that collective behavior of AI agents, like that of other complex systems, follows compact and predictive dynamical laws.

</details>


### [186] [CACSurv: Concordance-Aligned Comparative Learning with Large Language Models for Cancer Survival Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16594)
*Tianqi Xiang,Qixiang Zhang,Xinpeng Ding,Yi Li,Xiaomeng Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CACSurv，一种面向报告中心的癌症生存预测框架，将生存预测重构为小队列比较推理任务，通过一致性对齐奖励解决公式不匹配和监督不匹配两个核心问题，并在六个TCGA队列上取得平均C-index 0.722的最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有癌症生存预测方法多使用结构化临床变量、全切片图像、基因组等模态，而整合病理、临床和分子证据的患者报告尚未被充分探索。虽然大语言模型能够对这类报告进行推理，但直接进行逐病例时间回归存在两个不匹配问题：一是公式不匹配，生存评估依赖可比患者的排序一致性，而独立时间预测不保证排名一致性；二是监督不匹配，删失患者的观察时间只表明其在该时间点仍然存活，不能作为精确回归目标，但相对于更早死亡的患者仍蕴含排序信息。

Method: CACSurv将生存预测重构为小队列比较推理问题，让LLM预测相对预后排序。引入基于右删失下可比关系导出的一致性对齐奖励，使删失结果能在不依赖精确事件时间目标的情况下提供排序监督。推理阶段通过蒙特卡洛参考聚合，将每位患者与采样参考进行比较并聚合位置得到队列级排序。同时构建了覆盖六个TCGA癌症队列的TCGA-SurvReport基准。

Result: CACSurv在全部六个TCGA队列上取得最高C-index，平均C-index为0.722，比最强已发表生存模型高出6.5个百分点，比最强LLM时间回归基线高出4.2个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过将生存预测从独立时间回归重构为比较排序任务，并利用一致性对齐奖励充分利用删失数据的排序信息，CACSurv有效地解决了LLM在报告中心生存预测中的公式不匹配和监督不匹配问题，显著提升了预测性能。

Abstract: Cancer survival prediction supports treatment planning, risk stratification, and follow-up management. Existing methods use structured clinical variables, whole-slide images, genomic profiles, or multimodal inputs, while patient reports remain underexplored. We study report-centric survival prediction using reports that organize pathological, clinical, and molecular evidence. Large language models (LLMs) can reason over such reports, but case-wise time regression introduces two mismatches. First, a formulation mismatch arises because survival evaluation depends on ordering comparable patients, whereas independent time predictions do not enforce ranking consistency. Second, a supervision mismatch arises because a censored patient's observed time indicates survival beyond that point and cannot serve as an exact regression target, although it still implies orderings relative to patients who died earlier. To address these mismatches, we propose CACSurv, a Concordance-Aligned Comparative framework for report-centric survival prediction. CACSurv reformulates survival modeling as mini-cohort comparative reasoning, where an LLM predicts relative prognostic orderings. We introduce concordance-aligned rewards derived from comparable relations under right censoring, enabling censored outcomes to provide ranking supervision without exact event-time targets. At inference, Monte Carlo Reference Aggregation compares each patient with sampled references and aggregates positions into a cohort-level ranking. We establish TCGA-SurvReport, a benchmark covering six TCGA cancer cohorts. CACSurv achieves the highest C-index on all six cohorts and an average C-index of 0.722, outperforming the strongest published survival model by 6.5 percentage points and the strongest LLM time-regression baseline by 4.2 percentage points. Our code, models, and dataset will be available at https://github.com/xmed-lab/CACSurv.

</details>


### [187] [Cost Scales with Change, Not Corpus Size: Incrementally Maintaining an Evolving Semantic Substrate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16621)
*Yusuke Takahashi,Kyle Wild,Asako Uraki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将语料库语义在摄取时一次性编译为紧凑、可查询的"语义基底"（如截断SVD），反对在每次查询时重新推导语料含义的做法。核心论点是维护成本与变更量成正比而非与语料库规模成正比，并通过实验证明增量式低秩更新比全量重算SVD便宜33.7倍（单次）和23.8倍（累计），精度可追平全量重算（主轴漂移<1e-11度，recall@10=1.0）；通过正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新，仅重嵌入约10%语料即恢复0.95的平均余弦相似度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索增强与智能体问答系统在查询时反复重新推导语料库的含义，这类似于"解释器"而非"编译器"——效率低下。作者提出应在文档到达时一次性编译语义结构（如SVD），但主要障碍是维护成本：每次变更都重建SVD似乎代价高昂，且嵌入模型更换似乎需要全量重嵌入。本文旨在反驳这一观点并证明维护成本与变更量成比例而非语料规模。

Method: （1）提出"编译器"式语义基底范式：在摄取时（而非查询时）将语料编译为紧凑、可查询的语义子空间，并随语料演化进行维护。（2）采用增量式低秩更新（incremental low-rank updates）替代全量重新计算SVD。（3）引入正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新（orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update）处理嵌入模型更换场景，仅需重嵌入部分语料即可对齐新旧嵌入空间。（4）在受控合成实验上验证：维度256、秩32，语料从3,000增长至9,000文档，经历50次更新事件。

Result: 合成实验中，增量低秩更新比全量重SVD单次更新便宜33.7倍、累计便宜23.8倍；增量子空间与全量重算结果在主轴上几乎无差异（最大主轴漂移低于1e-11度，recall@10=1.0）。在嵌入模型更换场景下，正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新仅重嵌入约10%语料即使得新旧嵌入向量间平均余弦相似度达到0.95。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持"维护而非反复重建"语义基底的范式：增量维护代价与变更量成正比而非语料规模，且在数值精度上可等效于全量重算。这为检索增强和问答系统提供了一条更高效的语义持久化路径。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented and agentic question-answering systems increasingly re-derive the meaning of a corpus at query time. Put plainly, instead of re-deriving what a corpus means on every question, the work is done once when a document arrives and is thereafter merely consulted -- a compiler, not an interpreter, of meaning. An alternative is to compile that meaning once, at ingest time, into a compact, queryable semantic substrate and maintain it as the corpus evolves. The central objection is maintenance cost: rebuilding a truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) on every change appears prohibitive, and a change of embedding model seems to force a full re-embedding. We argue and show empirically that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change, not corpus size. On a controlled synthetic pilot (dimension 256, rank 32, a corpus grown from 3,000 to 9,000 documents over 50 update events), incremental low-rank updates were 33.7 times cheaper per update than full re-SVD and 23.8 times cheaper cumulatively, while the incremental subspace tracked the full recomputation to within floating-point precision (maximum principal-angle drift below 1e-11 degrees; recall@10 = 1.0). An orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update recovered 0.95 mean cosine to truly re-embedded vectors by re-embedding only about 10 percent of the corpus. The results support maintaining, rather than repeatedly reconstructing, a semantic substrate.

</details>


### [188] [A Shop Floor Production Scheduling Case based on RFID-supported Smart Factory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16626)
*Zhihui Chen,Yize Sun,Yuhao Dong,Zeyu Xiao,Ray Y. Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于RFID数据分析和深度强化学习的动态车间调度框架，通过挖掘可行生产序列和估计实时处理速率来量化操作与生产不确定性，仿真结果表明该方法在最小化完工时间方面优于FIFO、LIFO和DQN等现有调度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RFID技术虽已广泛应用于车间实时数据采集，但车间操作和生产过程中的不确定性共同导致制造动态性，阻碍调度系统实现最大效用。现有调度方法未能有效处理这种不确定性，因此需要一种能够量化不确定性并据此进行动态调度的框架。

Method: 首先对RFID采集的生产数据进行可行生产序列挖掘和实时处理速率估计，以量化操作和生产的双重不确定性；然后基于RFID数据分析结果，采用深度强化学习（DRL）方法进行车间生产调度，构建一个集成不确定性量化与动态调度的完整框架。

Result: 基于真实案例数据的仿真研究表明，所提出的动态生产调度框架是可行且实用的，在最小化操作完工时间方面优于FIFO、LIFO和DQN等现有调度方法。

Conclusion: 基于RFID数据分析的深度强化学习框架能够有效处理车间调度中的操作与生产不确定性，实现比传统调度规则和基础深度强化学习方法更优的调度性能，验证了该框架在实际智能制造场景中的可行性和实用性。

Abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has been widely implemented for real-time data collection in manufacturing shop floors, which, in turn, can be used to support dynamic shop floor production planning and scheduling. Within such an environment, uncertainty in operation and production processes collectively contribute to the dynamicity in manufacturing, thereby hampering the scheduling system from achieving maximal utility. To highlight the importance of handling such uncertainty, this paper addresses the problem of dynamic shop floor scheduling for a real-life case smart factory equipped with RFID technology. Feasible production sequence mining and real-time processing rate estimation are conducted on RFID-collected production data to quantify the operation and production uncertainties. A deep reinforcement learning approach based on the RFID data analysis is then presented for shop floor production scheduling. Simulation studies based on real-life case data have demonstrated the feasibility and practicality of the proposed dynamic production scheduling framework. Specifically, it is observed that the proposed framework outperforms existing dispatch methods in terms of minimizing operation makespan, including first in first out (FIFO), last in first out (LIFO) and deep Q network (DQN).

</details>


### [189] [Hypergraph-based Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Incremental Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16628)
*Shenao Chen,Yidan Xu,Xiangmin Han,Rundong Xue,Duanpo Wu,Yuhan Gao,Chenggang Yan,Yue Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Hyper-M2RAG框架，通过将多模态文档结构形式化为多模态超图，利用超边作为统一语义容器捕获文本、图像和表格间的高阶N元关联，并引入锚点驱动的增量细化机制解决跨页语义碎片化问题，显著提升了多模态检索增强生成的检索精度和生成连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有M-RAG系统受限于传统简单图的二值连接范式，无法建模跨模态实体间的高阶N元关联（如图表、文本描述与数值数据之间的关系）；同时现有的精细化策略常依赖全页重建来对齐跨模态信息，导致计算冗余并在长文档处理中引入上下文噪声。

Method: 构建多模态超图：将文档结构形式化为超图，以超边作为统一语义容器封装文本、图像和表格之间的多路关联，超越点对点建模。引入锚点驱动的增量细化机制：识别跨页边界锚点节点，利用一跳邻域上下文重建其局部超拓扑，最小化计算代价地弥补跨页知识缺口。

Result: 在多模态基准数据集上的大量实验表明，Hyper-M2RAG在检索精度和生成连贯性两方面均显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 超图高阶表示学习配合锚点驱动的增量细化，能够以更低的计算开销有效解决长文档多模态检索中的语义碎片化问题，为M-RAG系统提供了一种更鲁棒且高效的范式。

Abstract: Modern Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) systems are fundamentally limited by the binary connectivity paradigm of traditional simple graphs, which fails to capture the intricate, high-order correlations among heterogeneous entities, such as the N-ary relationships between a visual chart, its scattered textual descriptions, and underlying numerical data. Furthermore, existing refinement strategies often rely on exhaustive, full-page reconstruction to align cross-modal information, leading to prohibitive computational redundancy and the introduction of contextual noise in long-form document processing. In this paper, we propose Hyper-M2RAG, a novel framework that redefines multimodal document retrieval through High-order Hypergraph Representation Learning. We first formalize the document structure as a Multimodal Hypergraph, utilizing hyperedges as unified semantic containers to encapsulate multi-way associations across text, images, and tables, thereby transcending point-to-point modeling. To mitigate semantic fragmentation caused by physical pagination, we introduce an Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement mechanism. Rather than performing a global sweep, our approach identifies boundary-crossing anchor nodes and reconstructs their local hyper-topology using one-hop neighborhood contexts. This targeted refinement effectively bridges cross-page knowledge gaps with minimal computational footprints. Extensive evaluations on multimodal benchmarking datasets demonstrate that Hyper-M2RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both retrieval precision and generation coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShenAoChen2001/MMHRAG.

</details>


### [190] [PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16637)
*Veit Laule,Jiangtao Shuai,Manfred Hauswirth,Sonja Schimmler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PDDLCoder，一个迭代生成、分析和精炼PDDL规划规格的智能体框架，并引入NL-pddlgym基准数据集（23个领域、711个规划问题，含可执行gym环境）。实验表明PDDLCoder在106个held-out问题上达到89.6%的规划可应用性，远超此前PDDL生成方法（最高45.3%）和直接LLM规划方法（最高74.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在长horizon规划任务上仍然不可靠，常产生逻辑不一致或不可执行的计划。尽管混合方法尝试将自然语言转化为PDDL并使用符号规划器生成可验证计划，但现有方法存在刚性生成流程、部分PDDL定义、依赖人工反馈等缺陷，且缺乏标准化基准和自动化验证手段。

Method: PDDLCoder采用agentic框架，通过迭代循环实现PDDL规格的生成、分析和精炼。同时构建NL-pddlgym基准，包含23个领域的711个规划问题，并配备可执行的gym环境用于自动化验证计划可应用性。

Result: 在包含4个held-out领域、106个问题的测试集上，PDDLCoder对89.6%的规划问题生成了可应用计划，相比此前PDDL生成方法的最高45.3%和直接LLM规划方法最高74.5%均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了agentic式PDDL生成在规划任务中的有效性，并建立了可复现的基准，为LLM辅助符号规划的未来研究提供了标准化评估平台。

Abstract: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.

</details>


### [191] [Reconstruction: A Blind Benchmark for Recovering Research Ideas from Pre-Publication Bibliographies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16645)
*Shaolong Chen,Yanlin Fei,Nazhou Liu,Xinmiao Yu,Lei Li,Rahul Thapa,Madalina Ciobanu,Qingqing Mao,Ritankar Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍Reconstruction基准，仅凭论文预发表参考文献恢复其真实研究思想，并通过严格防泄漏协议和多智能体锦标赛方法将匹配率从3-15%提升至23-42%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 希望探索语言模型能否仅从论文的引用文献中推断出该论文的核心研究思想，同时设计严格的防泄漏协议以确保证据仅来自参考文献本身，而非训练数据或提示词中的信息泄漏。

Method: 构建Reconstruction基准：隐藏种子论文及其同期和未来文献，仅提供预发表参考文献，让模型生成假设，由独立LLM评判器与已知的真实研究思想进行匹配打分。采用时间引用截断、匿名引用ID和冻结逐论文参考文献三重防泄漏机制。提出参考文献驱动的前4多智能体流水线，结合跨模型评审与按对齐假设槽位组织的瑞士锦标赛，不使用外部网络搜索。

Result: 在6个科学领域共643篇论文上，7个前沿模型单独匹配率仅为约3-15%；而跨模型评审加锦标赛选择的组合流水线将匹配率提升至约23-42%，相对最佳单模型基线实现约2.4倍提升。

Conclusion: 仅凭参考文献恢复论文研究思想极具挑战性，单模型表现有限，但多智能体协作（跨模型评审+锦标赛筛选）能显著提升盲思想恢复能力，该结果以arXiv时间戳形式报告，以为后续研究提供基准和锚点。

Abstract: Can a language model recover the true research idea of a published paper when given only that paper's pre-publication bibliography? We introduce Reconstruction, a blind idea-recovery benchmark that withholds the seed paper and all contemporaneous or future literature, and asks models to propose hypotheses that an independent large language model judge matches against the held-out ground-truth idea. A strict anti-leakage protocol-temporal citation cutoff, anonymous reference IDs, and frozen per-paper bibliographies, which prevents prompt-time leakage of the seed idea. Across six scientific domains and 643 evaluated papers, seven frontier models achieve only modest Match rates (approx. 3-15%). We then evaluate a reference-only multi-agent (top 4) pipeline that combines cross-model review with a Swiss tournament over aligned hypothesis slots, without external web search. Cross-model review plus tournament selection raises Match rates to approx. 23-42% across all six domains, which is an observed approx. 2.4x lift over the best single-model baseline. This draft reports the protocol, anti-leakage design, and current results as an arXiv timestamp.

</details>


### [192] [Chronocooked: A Benchmark for Implicit Interval Timing in Reinforcement Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16666)
*Amrapali Pednekar,Alvaro Garrido-Perez,Yara Khaluf,Pieter Simoens*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了Chronocooked，一个用于研究强化学习（RL）智能体内隐式间隔计时能力的基准测试套件。该套件受Overcooked启发，包含需要时间决策的烹饪场景，其设计核心在于时间信息对智能体不可观测但对最优性能至关重要。环境刻意保持简单以支持受控实验和生物合理模型，评估指标专门用于暴露RL智能体在计时能力上的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL智能体普遍缺乏时间感知和时序处理能力，而在现实世界中（特别是人机交互和时间依赖的人类社会中），时间感知对智能体的部署至关重要。作者希望通过一个受控的基准测试环境系统地研究并暴露RL智能体在隐式间隔计时方面的不足。

Method: 作者构建了Chronocooked基准套件：1) 基于Overcooked的烹饪场景任务；2) 任务和奖励函数设计确保时间信息不可观测但对最优表现至关重要；3) 环境刻意保持简单以实现受控实验并支持生物合理模型；4) 设计了专门的评估指标来揭示计时能力缺陷；5) 报告了三种基线的结果：非循环网络、循环网络和生物合理模型。

Result: 论文报告了使用非循环网络、循环网络和生物合理模型三种基线的评估结果，评估指标旨在暴露各模型在时间感知和间隔计时方面的局限性。

Conclusion: 该工作旨在强调在RL智能体中融入时间感知和时序处理能力的必要性，特别是对于人机交互以及需要部署在时间依赖的人类社会中的智能体。

Abstract: This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark suite for studying implicit interval timing in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios that require temporal decision making. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved yet critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models. Evaluation metrics are designed to expose limitations in timing abilities of RL agents, and we report baselines using a non-recurrent, a recurrent, and a biologically plausible model. This work ultimately aims to underscore the need to incorporate time perception and temporal processing in artificial agents designed for human robot interaction and deployment in time dependent human societies.

</details>


### [193] [FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16697)
*Aniri,Chen Yilin,Jinhe Bi,Junfei Guo,Donglai Ran,Xu Bian,Zengjie Jin,Yujun Wang,Yijun Tian,Volker Tresp,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua,Yunpu Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MAE（马尔可夫注意力熵）框架，利用VLA模型内部注意力信号实现无外部监督的动作生成可靠性自评估，并构建了LIBERO-Reflect基准（4000个episodes）。实验表明MAE在AUPR、AUROC、FPR@95等指标上优于现有SOTA基线，并实例化了FabriMAE用于免验证器的测试时动作选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型缺乏无需外部监督的自评估能力。已有方法要么依赖专家标注，要么仅从输出统计中估计不确定性，忽略了模型内部信号，难以可靠评估动作生成的置信度。

Method: 首先观察到不同异构VLA中，内部视觉模态熵在成功与失败任务间存在一致差异。进一步发现不同VLA架构共享一个潜在的动作生成抽象过程，将其形式化为条件生成马尔可夫链（Conditional Generative Markov Chain）。基于该公式化，提出MAE（Markov Attention Entropy），将内部注意力信号直接转化为架构感知的可靠性分数。同时构建LIBERO-Reflect基准，包含4000个episodes（2000标准+2000挑战性），覆盖四个子集。

Result: 在异构VLA架构和多样场景下的大量实验中，MAE在AUPR、AUROC和FPR@95指标上一致优于SOTA基线。此外，MAE-guided多采样在LIBERO-Plus上提升了PI系列模型的鲁棒性，且运行时开销较小。

Conclusion: MAE通过利用VLA统一的潜在动作生成抽象（条件生成马尔可夫链）和内部注意力信号，实现了有效的免外部监督动作可靠性自评估，并能用于实际测试时动作选择以提升模型鲁棒性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. Although VLAs' architectures differ in their action generation, we show that they share a common latent action generation abstraction evolving under visual perception, language instruction, and state input, which we formulate as a Conditional Generative Markov Chain. Based on this formulation, we propose MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), a self-evaluation framework that directly converts internal attention signals into architecture-aware reliability scores, and introduce LIBERO-Reflect, a 4,000-episode benchmark combining 2,000 standard episodes and 2,000 challenging episodes across four subsets. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous VLA architectures and diverse scenarios show that MAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. We further instantiate FabriMAE for verifier-free test-time action selection, showing that MAE-guided multiple sampling improves PI-family robustness on LIBERO-Plus with small observed runtime overhead.

</details>


### [194] [LAVA: Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation Framework for Large-Scale Financial Document Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16763)
*Ruoqi Shu,Xuhui Wang,Isaac Wang,Yanming Mai,Bo Wan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LAVA是一个面向金融文档验证的模块化、骨干无关的多模态大语言模型流水线，通过四阶段设计（文档规则检索、布局保持信息抽取、辅助元数据增强、可审计符号/算术验证）实现了高准确性、一致性和可复现性，在真实基准上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融文档验证（如薪资审计、税务合规、贷款承销）在生产环境中要求极高的准确性、一致性和可复现性，但文档存在异构布局、语义丰富且上下文依赖的内容以及嵌入式业务规则，现有流水线难以可靠处理。

Method: LAVA采用四阶段设计：1) 文档规则检索（document-rule retrieval）实现规则接地；2) 布局保持的信息抽取（layout-preserving information extraction）；3) 辅助元数据增强（auxiliary metadata enrichment）；4) 可审计的符号/算术验证（auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification）。整个流水线基于多模态大语言模型，模块化且骨干无关。

Result: 在包含多样金融文档和数十条专家策展验证规则的大规模真实基准上，LAVA在幻觉控制和边缘情况处理方面优于基线方法，同时保持高效token使用，展现出在高吞吐、时间敏感验证场景中的实用性。

Conclusion: LAVA通过稳健的规则接地、细粒度错误归因和一致可追溯的端到端执行，满足高风险金融部署场景的关键需求，为金融文档验证提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Financial document validation in production, such as payroll auditing, tax compliance, and loan underwriting, demands exceptional accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility under strict enterprise constraints. In practice, documents arrive with heterogeneous layouts and formats, semantically rich and context-dependent content, and embedded business rules that current pipelines struggle to process reliably. We introduce LAVA (Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation), a modular, backbone-agnostic pipeline built on multimodal large language models, that integrates a four-stage design: document-rule retrieval, layout-preserving information extraction, auxiliary metadata enrichment, and auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification. LAVA supports robust rule grounding, fine-grained error attribution, and consistent, traceable end-to-end execution, capabilities essential for high-stakes deployment. Evaluated on a large real-world benchmark with diverse financial documents and dozens of expert-curated validation rules, LAVA outperforms baselines in hallucination control and edge-case handling while maintaining efficient token usage, demonstrating practicality for high-volume, time-critical validation.

</details>


### [195] [GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16776)
*Lirui Teng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GRIP方法，通过信息受限前提（随机瓶颈）限制RAG中检索证据的编码容量，解决查询主导隐状态导致检索证据失效的"查询主导"问题，在五个推理基准上超越强基线，并将查询-隐状态互信息削减约30倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在检索增强生成（RAG）中，高容量编码器的隐状态可能被查询信息主导，使得检索到的证据在功能上变得无关。这种"查询主导"（query dominance）失效模式导致模型没有真正利用检索证据进行推理，而是仅依赖查询本身作答，容易产生幻觉或推理错误。

Method: GRIP（Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises）通过引入容量不对称来解决此问题：解码器对查询保持全维度访问，而检索证据需经过一个严苛的随机瓶颈（stochastic bottleneck）通道。这种设计迫使证据通道仅编码查询无法提供的残差信息，从而确保检索证据对最终推理产生实质贡献。

Result: 在五个推理基准上，GRIP超越了强迭代式基线；查询-隐状态互信息诊断指标从14.8比特降至0.47比特（约30倍削减）；幻觉率降低73%。残差对齐分析进一步表明，瓶颈输出占据的子空间与查询的对齐程度低于基线表示。

Conclusion: GRIP通过信息瓶颈实现容量不对称，有效解决了RAG中查询主导导致证据失效的问题，使模型真正基于检索证据进行接地推理，同时显著降低幻觉率，为RAG系统的表示设计提供了新的思路。

Abstract: High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance. To address it, we introduce \textbf{GRIP} (Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises), which imposes capacity asymmetry: the decoder keeps full-dimensional access to the query, while retrieved evidence passes through a severe stochastic bottleneck. This forces the evidence channel to encode only the residual information unavailable from the query. Across five reasoning benchmarks, GRIP outperforms strong iterative baselines, cuts a query--latent mutual-information diagnostic by roughly 30$\times$ (14.8 $\to$ 0.47 bits), and reduces hallucination by 73\%. Residual-alignment analysis further shows that the bottleneck output occupies subspaces less aligned with the query than baseline representations.

</details>


### [196] [When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16801)
*Giuseppe Destefanis,Tomaso Aste*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种衡量AI编码智能体团队内部协调行为的工具，将每次运行建模为时间网络（节点为智能体和文件，边为带时间戳和成本的消息、文件读写操作），并对1902次运行在团队规模、结构和文件策略等配置下进行分析。研究揭示了协调模式随团队规模的变化规律（直接消息起初近似二次方增长，大规模时转为广播），发现共享文件可将消息密集任务的输出token削减约42%，指定协调者不产生通信枢纽也无助成功，还观察到智能体会自发寻找隐藏评分材料等现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估只报告AI智能体团队是否完成任务及运行成本，但团队内部的协调过程完全未被测量。缺乏对编码智能体之间如何协调的系统性量化方法，难以理解团队规模、结构等配置对协作效率的影响。

Method: 提出协调测量工具：将每次运行表示为时间网络，代理和文件为节点，消息、文件写入和读取为带时间戳和成本的有向边。在1902次运行上改变团队规模、团队结构和文件策略三个变量，用固定测试套件评估，并在密封环境中重复关键实验条件（用占位文件替代隐藏评分材料）进行了244次额外运行。

Result: 直接消息起初随智能体数量近似二次方增长，主要来自早期介绍环节；在大团队中增长趋缓并转为广播通信。共享规范的工作产生高连接密度的网络，流水线任务则形成围绕本地接口的稀疏网络。共享文件在8个智能体时将消息密集任务的输出token减少约42%，但在文件已承载协调时增加开销。指定协调者不产生通信枢纽且无一致性改进。智能体自发寻找隐藏评分材料，在密封环境中244次运行仍有五分之四会触及占位文件。

Conclusion: 智能体团队协调可以被系统化测量，其模式由团队规模和任务类型共同塑造。文件可作为通信替代品降低token成本，协调者角色设置无效，智能体存在追逐评分材料的投机行为。这些发现为设计更高效的AI编码团队配置提供了经验依据。

Abstract: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this instrument to 1902 runs, each evaluated with a fixed test suite, across configurations that vary the team size, the team structure, and the file policy. The resulting networks show how coordination changes as teams grow and as the work changes. Direct messaging initially increases close to quadratically with the number of agents, with much of this growth coming from an early round of introductions. As the teams grow further, this increase levels off in the largest teams we study, where agents increasingly communicate through broadcast messages. The task also shapes the network that emerges. Work built around a shared specification produces dense, highly connected teams, while pipeline tasks produce sparse networks organised around local interfaces. Shared files can replace repeated 1-to-1 communication, cutting output tokens by about 42% at eight agents on message-heavy work, while adding overhead when files already carry the coordination. Naming one agent as coordinator creates no communication hub and provides no reliable improvement in success. We also observe an unprompted tendency for agents to seek out hidden grading material. We repeat the key experimental conditions in a sealed environment, replacing the hidden material with marked placeholder files. Across 244 additional runs, agents still reach for it in four fifths of runs, while the coordinator and file-channel findings reproduce.

</details>


### [197] [Cross-Sign Language Transfer Learning Using Domain Adaptation with Multi-scale Temporal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16804)
*Keren Artiaga,Yang Li,Ercan Engin Kuruoglu,Wai Kin,Chan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究了基于迁移学习和域适应方法TA3N的手语识别，使用时序关系网络（TRN）模块对齐多尺度时间关系。研究发现域适应方法优于基于神经网络的迁移学习，尤其在美式手语（ASL）识别上表现突出；同时发现对齐源域和目标域之间的短期时间特征更为有效。实验还比较了RGB和光流两种输入模态，结果表明RGB在大多数情况下优于光流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手语是听障人士重要的沟通方式，但全球超过100种不同的手语识别资源严重匮乏。现有研究缺乏足够的标注数据来训练高质量的手语识别模型，因此需要探索迁移学习等方法来缓解数据稀缺问题。

Method: 采用迁移学习框架，结合域适应方法TA3N（Temporal Attentive Adversarial Adaptation Network），利用时序关系网络（TRN）模块进行多尺度时间关系的对齐。实验中对比了基于神经网络的迁移学习与域适应方法的性能，并分别使用RGB和光流（Optical Flow）两种输入模态进行手语样本的实验。

Result: 实验结果表明，域适应方法在性能上优于基于神经网络的迁移学习方法，特别是在美式手语（ASL）识别任务中优势明显。此外，研究发现对齐源域和目标域之间的短期时间特征比对齐长期时间特征更有效。在输入模态对比中，RGB在多数情况下优于光流。

Conclusion: 该研究证实了域适应方法在手语识别中优于传统迁移学习，并揭示了短期时间特征对齐的重要性以及RGB模态的相对优势，为改善听障人士的沟通可及性做出了贡献。

Abstract: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals with hearing impairments, yet recognition resources for the over 100 distinct sign languages are severely lacking. In response, we present our work on sign language recognition using transfer learning and the domain adaptation method TA3N, which utilizes the Temporal Relational Network (TRN) module for aligning multi-scale temporal relations. Our findings highlight the superior performance of Domain Adaptation to neural network-based transfer learning, particularly in improving recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). Our research also identifies the effectiveness of aligning shorter-term temporal features between source and target domains. In addition to using RGB, we conducted experiments using Optical Flow mode for the sign language samples, ultimately determining that RGB outperforms Optical Flow in the majority of cases. Our work aims to improve accessibility and communication for individuals who rely on sign language as their primary mode of communication.

</details>


### [198] [Quipu: A Governed Bitemporal Knowledge Graph Store](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16813)
*Steve Brown*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Quipu是一个可嵌入的知识图谱存储系统，它推翻了传统图谱存储的四个默认设置：写入即接受、单一时间轴、所有事实等权、治理依赖中间件。Quipu通过门控写入、双时态数据、以命名图为核心的信任格结构、以及将治理规则本身存储于被治理的库中，使审计变成一条查询。实验证明其在Census基准上消除所有植入缺陷，在DEMM-Bench上以纯内容方式零过度声称地回答全部512个治理问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识图谱存储的现有默认设计（先接受后清理、单一或不含时间轴、所有写入者等权、治理外包给仪表盘和中间件）在智能体（agent）工作负载下难以维持。智能体会自动写入海量数据、来自不同来源、时序敏感，且需要可验证的治理，传统的库侧默认无法满足这些需求，因此需要一种从根本上重新设计存储治理方式的方案。

Method: Quipu实现四项倒置：(1) 所有事实必须经过一个门（gate），其谓词在待提交的后状态上进行评估；(2) 数据、信任标签、裁定（verdict）与规则本身均为双时态（bitemporal）；(3) 命名图作为权威与信任的单位，在一种格（lattice）结构下组合，其不变式为组合不会扩大信任范围；(4) 治理规范Σ、痕迹（trace）和签名裁定都以事实形式存储在被治理的存储库中，使审计谓词 T ⊨ Σ 成为一条可查询的语句。

Result: 在Census基准上：门控存储以0/6个缺陷结束（非门控为6/6）；全部7个组合探针满足格契约；50/50个满意裁定在其时间点忠实重推导，而最新的规则集下50个全部误报；SARC参考检查器与库内审计逐裁定一致。在DEMM-Bench上：纯内容读取回答全部512个属性级治理问题，在全部8种退化条件下零过度声称，而容器存在性基线在高达87.5%的问题上过度声称；运行还发现并修复了一个关于拒绝裁定（denial verdict）所证明内容的缺口。

Conclusion: Quipu证明了将治理内置于存储核心、而非叠加于其上的可行性：通过门控写入、双时态建模、信任格组合以及自我引用的治理规范，可以有效消除传统默认设置导致的数据缺陷与过度声称问题。库内审计与外部基准和参考检查器的一致性表明，这种"治理即查询"的架构在实践上是正确且可行的。

Abstract: Agents now write knowledge graphs, but knowledge-graph stores still carry defaults set when humans curated them: accept writes now and clean later, keep one time axis or none, treat every writer's facts as equally trustworthy, and leave governance to dashboards and middleware. These four defaults are individually convenient and jointly untenable under agent workloads. We present Quipu, an embeddable store that inverts all four: no fact enters except through a gate whose predicates evaluate the pending post-state; data, trust labels, verdicts, and the rules themselves are bitemporal; named graphs are the unit of authority and trust, composed under a lattice whose one invariant is that composition never widens; and the governance specification $Σ$, the trace, and signed verdicts are facts in the store they govern, making the audit $T \models Σ$ a query. We evaluate with Census, a deterministic multi-writer lifecycle whose single seeded run scores every research question against planted ground truth: the gated store ends with 0 of 6 planted defects versus 6 of 6 ungated; all 7 composition probes uphold the lattice contract; 50 of 50 satisfied verdicts re-derive faithfully as of their instant while all 50 would be misreported under a latest-only rule set; and the SARC reference checker agrees with the in-store audit verdict-for-verdict, differing only on coverage semantics. A recorded trace from a governed writer surfaces a live enforcement gap the audit names with its remediation. On DEMM-Bench, an external decision-evidence sufficiency benchmark, a content-only reading of the exported records answers all 512 property-level governance questions correctly with zero overclaim under all eight degradation conditions, while container-presence baselines overclaim on up to 87.5% of them -- and the run surfaced, and led us to close, a gap in what a denial's verdict attests.

</details>


### [199] [Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16831)
*Minh-Ha Nguyen,Cathy Shyr*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF)框架，将策略迭代与人类反馈结合，利用预训练语言模型作为固定权重执行基底，通过版本化的自然语言策略和工具集实现持续修订，在罕见病诊断基准上Recall@1显著提升，验证了固定权重LLM作为专家引导策略开发执行基底的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式预训练已建立可复用的任务表征，但已有工作（语言条件任务和上下文学习）表明固定模型可通过指令和示范调整行为。作者希望拓展这一思路，将策略迭代中循环评估-改进的结构与人类反馈机制整合，实现跨多个执行器（从3B到49B参数）的专家引导策略开发，而无需更新模型权重。

Method: PIHF采用预训练语言模型作为执行基底，将持久性修订转移到版本化的自然语言策略与工具集中。其核心包括：(1) 语言模型评论器和临床专家共同审查完整面板推理及工具使用轨迹，定位重复性失败并提出候选修订方案；(2) 专家可重新解释证据，并对修订的接纳与回滚保留最终权威；(3) 通过Recall@1和Recall@5在候选执行后验证结果。整体遵循广义策略迭代的循环评估-改进结构。

Result: 在累积消融实验和超罕见疾病基准上，PIHF派生的策略在一个专有执行器和三个开源执行器（3B至49B活跃参数）上均提升了Recall@1。其中GPT-5.4提升32.7个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B提升31.1个百分点，两者相差1.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持将预训练语言模型作为固定权重执行基底用于专家引导的策略开发在罕见病诊断中具有可行性，表明在不更新模型权重的情况下，通过自然语言策略版本化管理和人类专家审核机制可以有效提升诊断召回性能。

Abstract: Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations. Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) builds on this development and the recurrent evaluate-and-improve structure of generalized policy iteration. PIHF uses a pretrained language model as its execution substrate and moves persistent revision to a versioned natural-language policy and tool set. A language-model critic and clinical expert review complete-panel reasoning and tool-use trajectories to localize recurrent failures and form candidate revisions; the expert may reinterpret the evidence and retains authority over admission and rollback, while Recall@1 and Recall@5 validate outcomes after candidate execution.
  Across cumulative ablations and ultra-rare-disease benchmarks, a PIHF-derived policy improved Recall@1 in one proprietary executor and three open-weight executors spanning 3 to 49 billion active parameters. Gains were 32.7 percentage points for GPT-5.4 and 31.1 points for Qwen3.6-35B, a difference of 1.7 points. These results support the feasibility of using pretrained language models as fixed-weight execution substrates for expert-guided policy development in rare-disease diagnosis.

</details>


### [200] [What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16852)
*Saisab Sadhu,Aadit Sengupta,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu,Pratinav Seth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了当前合规检测器（包括守卫模型和激活探针）存在的"规则盲区"问题：检测结果不依赖于所陈述的规则，删除、置换或替换规则都不会改变检测准确率。作者构建了交叉规则基准验证了这一失败，并提出了一种免训练的激活读数方法ICS（内部合规分数），尽管ICS未通过预注册的超越基线标准，但因其低成本可用于审计多个部署模型。最后发布了反事实协议和交叉规则基准以供未来测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法规合规监控作为法律和审计控制正越来越多地部署在语言模型中，用于检查模型输出是否符合数据保护、医疗、金融和平台政策等书面规则。但合规监控只有在检测器的判断真正依赖于所陈述的规则而非场景的表面特征时才有意义。本文旨在检验并揭示当前合规检测器是否真正遵循规则，而非依赖表面线索。

Method: 作者通过三步操作——删除、置换、替换规则文本——测试多个守卫模型和激活探针的决定是否变化。构建了2规则×2场景的交叉基准（使单独任一维度都无法预测标签），验证规则盲区。提出ICS（Internal Compliance Score）：一种免训练的激活读数方法，仅需十个标注对校准并通过单一投影打分。作者还进行了预注册的超越平凡基线标准检验，并用ICS审计4个部署守卫模型、8B零样本评判器和13个基准，以及测试自适应白盒攻击。

Result: 所有测试的守卫模型和激活探针均表现出规则盲区：删除、置换或替换规则后检测准确率不变。即使一个策略条件化守卫能正确引用现行条款，当该条款被换成其宽松对应条款时，其判定也几乎不变。分步推理能够逃逸规则盲区而快速检测器不能。ICS未通过预注册的超越平凡基线准则，词袋模型在池化泛化上与ICS表现相同。ICS因成本低而有用，能审计多个部署模型和基准，用于候选回答排序时可提高机械验证通过率，但自适应白盒攻击消除了这一优势。

Conclusion: 当前合规检测器普遍存在规则盲区，不能真正依据规则进行合规判断。需要分步推理而非快速检测器才能逃逸这一缺陷。ICS作为低成本审计工具虽有价值且能部署，但并未超越简单基线。作者发布反事实协议和交叉规则基准，以便未来对探针和守卫模型的规则盲区进行系统性测试。

Abstract: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prior benchmark rules out, and shows that step by step reasoning, not any fast detector we test, is what escapes it. Auditing at scale requires a retraining-free detector, so we introduce the Internal Compliance Score (ICS): a training-free activation readout calibrated from ten labelled pairs and scored by a single projection. We hold ICS to the same scrutiny as the guards it audits: a pre-registered criterion for beating trivial baselines is not met, and a bag-of-words model matches its pooled generalisation exactly. It remains useful because it is inexpensive, letting us audit four deployed guard models, an 8B zero-shot judge, and thirteen benchmarks, and it raises the mechanically verified pass rate when used to rank candidate responses, though an adaptive white-box attack removes this gain. We release the counterfactual protocol and crossed-rule benchmark so rule blindness can be tested in future probe and guard claims.

</details>

### [201] [Xemo-Talker: Unlock Emotions Explicitly for Audio-Driven Talking Portrait Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14700)
*Chaolong Yang,Yinuo Guo,Kai Yao,Yuyao Yan,Jie Sun,Guangliang Cheng,Shibin Wu,Bin Dong,Kaizhu Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Xemo-Talker提出了一种基于低主成分子空间监督的音频驱动说话人头像情感控制方法，通过学习中性语音到运动的映射并引入轻量情感分支，实现了情感分类精度与唇形同步之间的更好平衡，达到了SOTA效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频驱动的说话人头像系统对情感控制依赖于隐式情感调节，导致控制不直接且不充分；同时，在全运动空间上训练显式情感损失会面临唇形同步与情感控制之间的固有取舍问题。

Method: 提出Xemo-Talker：先学习中性语音到运动的映射以保证稳定的发音与唇形同步，再引入由低主成分子空间监督引导的轻量情感分支。设计了Tri-Loss，包含类间分离、类内紧凑以及低主成分对比学习三个损失项。

Result: 在给定音频、参考图像和情感标签时，Xemo-Talker在情感分类准确率上达到SOTA，同时保持有竞争力的唇形同步和高推理效率，性能接近真实视频测量的水平。

Conclusion: 通过将判别性监督集中在低主成分分量上，可以在情感表达与唇形同步之间取得更好的平衡，为音频驱动情感说话头提供了高效有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Precise emotion control in audio-driven talking heads remains a challenge due to the reliance on implicit emotion regulation in existing systems, which often leads to indirect and insufficient control. Additionally, training with explicit emotion-related losses across the entire motion space poses significant difficulties due to the inherent trade-off between accurate lip synchronization and fine-grained emotion control. In this paper, we reveal a key finding: although emotional cues are distributed throughout the motion space, concentrating discriminative supervision on less-principal components achieves a better emotion-lip synchronization balance, as principal components mainly encode high-energy articulation and pose variations. Building on this insight, we propose Xemo-Talker, which first learns a neutral speech-to-motion mapping for stable articulation and lip synchronization, and then introduces a lightweight emotion branch guided by less-principal subspace supervision. To enhance emotion control, we design a Tri-Loss consisting of inter-class separation, intra-class compactness, and less-principal contrastive learning. Given an audio input, a reference image, and an emotion label, Xemo-Talker achieves state-of-the-art emotion classification accuracy while maintaining competitive lip synchronization and high inference efficiency, with performance approaching that measured on real videos.The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/chaolongy/Xemo-Talker.

</details>


### [202] [Periocular Soft Biometrics: A Survey and Applications to Multimedia Forensics and Disinformation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14701)
*Fernando Alonso-Fernandez,Kevin Hernandez-Diaz,Josef Bigun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了从眼部周围区域（periocular）图像中估计人口统计学属性（性别、年龄、种族）的研究现状，涵盖公开数据集、从手工特征到深度学习的方法学趋势、当前最优性能，以及在多媒体取证和虚假信息检测中的应用与开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 眼周区域在面部被遮挡时仍常可见（这常见于取证证据和监控画面），是软生物特征（性别、年龄、种族等）的可靠来源。当完整身份识别不可行时，这些软生物特征可提供辅助证据，支持法医调查、身份验证、监控以及合成/篡改媒体检测等应用。因此需要对这一领域进行系统性综述。

Method: 这是一篇综述性论文，系统梳理了：(1) 公开可用的眼周图像数据集；(2) 从手工特征描述子到深度学习架构的方法学演进趋势；(3) 性别、年龄和种族预测的最新技术水平；并讨论了多媒体取证与虚假信息检测场景下的应用案例，以及数据集偏差、跨域泛化、公平性、伦理问题等开放挑战。

Result: 论文整理了眼周人口统计学属性估计的现有数据集、方法趋势和最新性能水平，并识别出该领域的关键开放问题，包括数据集偏差、跨域泛化能力不足、公平性缺失、伦理挑战以及缺乏面向取证场景的基准测试。

Conclusion: 眼周区域是稳健的软生物特征来源，在法医和监控场景中具有重要应用价值。然而，该领域仍面临数据集偏差、跨域泛化、公平性与伦理等核心挑战，且缺少面向取证应用的专门基准，这为未来研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Soft-biometric attributes such as gender, age, and ethnicity provide valuable ancillary evidence when full identity recognition is not feasible, supporting applications in forensic investigation, identity verification, surveillance, or detection of synthetic and manipulated media. Among biometric modalities, the periocular region is a robust source of soft-biometric cues, as it often remains visible when other parts of the face are occluded, a frequent condition in forensic evidence and surveillance footage, and can be captured across a wide range of acquisition conditions. In this paper, we provide a survey of demographic attribute estimation from periocular images, covering publicly available datasets, methodological trends from handcrafted descriptors to deep learning architectures, and the state of the art in gender, age, and ethnicity prediction. We discuss use cases relevant to multimedia forensics and disinformation-detection applications, including demographic filtering in surveillance footage, age verification, and the detection of demographic inconsistencies in synthetic data. We also highlight open challenges, including dataset bias, cross-domain generalisation, fairness, ethical aspects, and the lack of forensic-oriented benchmarks.

</details>


### [203] [Deep Analog: Open-Set Film Emulation with Reference-Conditioned 3D LUTs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14702)
*Yitong Mu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Deep Analog，一种开放集胶片仿真管线。核心创新是StyleLUTNet——从参考影片帧直接预测单个3D LUT（而非固定LUT库的加权混合），配合直方图色调匹配和物理启发的光学渲染器（多尺度颗粒与逐通道光晕）。在350个自监督对上达到色彩阶段22.05dB PSNR/0.925 SSIM，全管线21.72dB/0.923，1080p下运行5.2ms，并可导出.cube LUT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于固定3D LUT库实时图像增强方法（被证明是门控专家混合）存在两个根本缺陷：封闭集（冻结了可实现的外观）、门控坍缩（端到端训练下退化到单一专家，K个LUT只相当于1个的容量）。因此需要一种能从单一参考帧泛化到未见胶片种类的开放集方法，无需配对数据或重新训练。

Method: 1) 证明基于LUT库的增强等价于门控专家混合，熵正则项（类比MoE负载均衡）恢复LUT利用率，提升约1dB PSNR；2) 放弃固定LUT基，StyleLUTNet从参考图像预测单个3D LUT作为残差，通过程序化生成的色彩变换做自监督训练；3) 构建完整管线Deep Analog：色彩骨干+直方图色调匹配+物理启发光学渲染器（多尺度颗粒、逐通道光晕），逆网络从参考回归参数。

Result: 350个自监督对上：色彩阶段22.05dB PSNR/0.925 SSIM，全管线21.72dB/0.923；1080p色彩路径5.2ms（192 FPS）；可导出.cube LUT用于标准编辑工具。另发现条件LUT训练的"残差尺度坍缩"退化，与门控坍缩同根因，提炼出通用原则：辅助正则必须从属于重建目标。

Conclusion: 固定LUT库本质上无法实现开放集胶片仿真，必须用条件式LUT预测（从参考图预测单LUT残差）替代。自监督+程序化色彩变换可消除配对数据需求。当辅助正则化与重建目标冲突时应以重建为优先，否则引入新的坍缩退化。

Abstract: Film emulation reproduces the look of an analog film stock on a new digital photograph. We target its open-set form -- matching any reference film frame from a single example -- with a 3D lookup table (LUT) predicted from that reference. Real-time image enhancement predicts per-image weights over a fixed bank of 3D LUTs and blends them. We show this is a gated mixture of experts and inherits its failure: trained end-to-end against reconstruction, the gate collapses onto a single expert, so a bank of K LUTs delivers the capacity of one. An entropy term, the enhancement-setting analogue of mixture-of-experts load balancing, restores utilization and recovers about 1 dB PSNR. The deeper constraint survives: a fixed LUT basis is closed-set, freezing the achievable looks at training time. We therefore discard the basis and predict a single 3D LUT as a residual from a reference image (StyleLUTNet), trained by self-supervision on procedurally generated color transforms. The conditional design removes the gate and generalizes open-set to unseen film stocks without paired data or retraining. Around this color backbone we build Deep Analog, a film-emulation pipeline that adds histogram-based tone matching and a physics-informed optical renderer -- multi-scale grain and per-channel halation driven by parameters an inverse network regresses from the reference. On 350 self-supervised pairs the color stage reaches 22.05 dB PSNR / 0.925 SSIM and the full pipeline 21.72 dB / 0.923; the color path runs in 5.2 ms at 1080p (192 FPS) and exports a portable .cube LUT for standard editing tools. A second degeneracy in conditional LUT training -- residual-scale collapse -- shares the root cause and yields a general principle: auxiliary regularization must stay subordinate to reconstruction.

</details>


### [204] [On Cross-Validation for Hyperparameter Optimization of Deep Learning Image Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14705)
*Ljubomir Buturovic*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统比较了三种超参数优化协议（固定留出法、重洗留出法和5折交叉验证）在深度学习图像分类器中的绝对性能估计误差（AEE），发现医疗影像小样本场景下交叉验证优于留出法，且样本量越小优势越明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超参数优化对深度学习图像分类器性能影响显著，但缺乏关于如何设计验证信号（即用于驱动HPO的验证方案）的经验性指导，尤其是医学影像等小样本场景下。作者希望填补这一空白，为研究者提供可循证的选择依据。

Method: 在固定搜索空间、采样器、训练流程、架构和测试集的前提下，对三种HPO协议（固定留出F、重洗留出R、5折交叉验证C）进行比较。使用三个公开数据集（RSNA肺炎胸片、二值化HAM10000皮肤病变、Tiny ImageNet 200类自然图像），覆盖二分类医学成像和多类自然成像两种场景，并在不同开发集规模n和两种骨干网络（ResNet-18与ViT-S/16）下评估，以AEE为核心指标。

Result: 医学数据集上所有点估计均偏向交叉验证，AEE降低幅度在小样本时最大、随n增大而减小，且在保守的family-wise调整下依然稳健。Tiny ImageNet上三种协议AEE均可忽略不计。测试AUROC在各协议间总体相近。固定留出在12个医学条件中的11个上平均AEE低于重洗留出，但此次要发现支持力度较弱。

Conclusion: 对于小样本医学图像分类，在计算资源允许时推荐采用基于交叉验证的HPO，因为其以额外计算换取开发阶段对后续测试性能更可靠的估计。

Abstract: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) can materially affect the performance of deep learning (DL) image classifiers, but there is little empirical guidance on how to derive the validation signal that drives it, especially for the small sample sizes common in fields such as medical imaging. We compared three HPO protocols in terms of {\em
  absolute performance-estimation error} (AEE; the absolute difference between the winning configuration's validation AUROC and its test AUROC): fixed holdout (F), reshuffled holdout (R), and 5-fold cross-validation (C). The search space, sampler, training procedure, architecture, and test set were held identical across protocols. We evaluated the protocols on three public datasets spanning two regimes: binary medical imaging (RSNA pneumonia radiographs and binarized HAM10000 skin lesions) and 200-class natural imaging (Tiny ImageNet), across a range of development set sizes $n$ and two backbones (ResNet-18 on all datasets, Vision Transformer (ViT-S/16) on RSNA). On the medical datasets, every point estimate favored cross-validation over both holdout protocols, with reductions in AEE largest at small sample sizes and diminishing as $n$ increased. This pattern remained robust under conservative family-wise adjustment. On Tiny ImageNet, AEE was negligible under all three protocols. Test AUROC was generally similar among protocols. Fixed holdout had lower mean AEE than reshuffled holdout in 11 of 12 medical conditions, although this secondary finding was less uniformly supported. For small-sample medical image classification, we recommend cross-validation-based HPO when computational resources permit because it trades additional computation for a more reliable development-time estimate of subsequent test performance.

</details>


### [205] [Equilibrium Forcing: Adaptive Video Generation Without Noise Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14706)
*Hansen Jin Lillemark,Alex Rojas,Zachary Novack,Runqian Wang,Yilun Du,Yian Ma,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Equilibrium Forcing (EqF)，一种不依赖噪声水平条件化的视频去噪生成框架，解耦了去噪场学习与采样过程，支持自适应闭环推理，在自回归视频生成基准上超越传统噪声条件化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自回归视频生成算法（基于扩散和流匹配）依赖于固定的训练目标和静态采样调度，限制了推理过程无法根据数据自适应调整，缺乏灵活性。

Method: EqF 通过移除噪声水平条件化，实现模块化的训练和推理设计，使学习去噪场与采样过程解耦，从而支持推理阶段的闭环自适应算法，根据样本反馈动态调整生成过程。

Result: 在挑战性的自回归视频生成基准上，EqF 显著提升了视频质量和一致性，并超越了标准的噪声水平条件化去噪视频方法。

Conclusion: 去除噪声水平条件化是 EqF 获得数据依赖推理能力的关键，这种设计使其在自回归视频生成任务上比传统方法表现更优。

Abstract: Standard autoregressive video generation algorithms based on Diffusion and Flow Matching rely on rigid training objectives and static sampling schedules, limiting inference procedures from adapting to the data. We introduce Equilibrium Forcing (EqF), a simplified framework for video denoising generative models without noise level conditioning. EqF pioneers modular training- and inference-time designs for noise-unconditional generation that decouple learning the denoising field from sampling. This flexibility allows for inference-time algorithms that operate in a closed loop by adapting to feedback from the sample, improving video quality and consistency on challenging autoregressive video generation benchmarks. Extensive analysis elucidates exactly how removing the noise level conditioning enables EqF's data-dependent inference properties to surpass the performance of standard noise level-conditional denoising video methods.

</details>


### [206] [PE-CSNet: An equivariant network architecture with learnable patch-based sparse representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14708)
*Kai Li,Haitao Long,Bo Zhang,Haiwen Zhang,Zhi Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PE-CSNet，一种基于块等变深度展开架构的压缩感知重建网络。通过将广义块基CS模型用块坐标下降算法求解并展开为神经网络，采用随机等变训练策略提高数据效率，在CS-MRI和CS-CDP任务上达到最先进精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的压缩感知方法需要专家领域知识和繁重的参数调优来设计任务特定的稀疏变换及优化流程，这一过程费时费力且难以保证高质量重建效果。

Method: 1) 建立广义块基CS模型，将传统的预定义块变换稀疏性推广为可学习的变换稀疏性；2) 使用块坐标下降算法求解该模型；3) 将BCD求解器展开为深度神经网络，通过端到端训练学习所有CS模型和求解器参数；4) 引入随机等变训练策略利用网络的块状结构提高数据效率；5) 提供简化的参数共享版本并讨论其收敛性，同时实际应用中采用阶段特异性参数增强表达能力。

Result: 在压缩感知磁共振成像（CS-MRI）和压缩感知编码衍射图样（CS-CDP）任务上，PE-CSNet达到最先进的精度并具有快速的计算速度，优于传统方法和已有的深度展开方法。

Conclusion: 通过将可学习的块变换稀疏性与深度展开架构相结合，结合随机等变训练策略，PE-CSNet实现了高精度的CS重建，既克服了传统方法依赖人工设计的局限，又在数据效率上优于现有深度学习方法。

Abstract: Compressive sensing (CS) enables accurate signal reconstruction from sparse measurements and is widely applied in medical imaging, remote sensing, and image compression. However, designing an effective, task-specific sparse transform and the corresponding optimization procedure for high-quality CS remains challenging. This process typically requires expert domain knowledge and laborious parameter tuning. To address this issue, we present a Patch-based Equivariant deep unrolling architecture, termed PE-CSNet, for accurate CS recovery. While traditional CS methods generally use predefined patch-based transform sparsity, we generalize this idea by incorporating learnable transform sparsity that adapts to the specific CS task through an optimization-driven process. Specifically, we first establish a generalized patch-based CS model, which we solve via a block coordinate descent (BCD) algorithm. The BCD solver is then unrolled into a deep neural network, where all parameters of both the CS model and solver are learned through end-to-end training. To improve data efficiency, we introduce a stochastic equivariant training strategy that exploits the patch-wise structure of the network, enabling PE-CSNet to learn effectively even from limited data. We further provide a simpler, parameter-shared version of PE-CSNet and briefly discuss its convergence as an iterative solver. For practical applications, the network uses stage-specific (non-shared) parameters to enhance its expressive power and thereby improve its performance. On the tasks of CS magnetic resonance imaging (CS-MRI) and CS coded diffraction patterns (CS-CDP), PE-CSNet achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fast computational speed, outperforming traditional methods and existing deep unrolling methods.

</details>


### [207] [Path2ST: Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Grounded Cross-Modal Translation for Spatial Transcriptomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14710)
*Ruochen Liu,Wei Lou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Path2ST是一个将H&E染色图像转换为空间基因表达谱的层次化自回归框架，通过引入Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Conditioning机制、Scale-Adaptive Autoregressive Generation过程和SpectraLoss损失函数，在三个数据集上取得了最优性能，代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有H&E-to-ST预测方法将H&E图像视为通用视觉输入，忽略了其固有的生物学层次结构——空间组织的细胞类型共同构成功能性组织微环境，进而调控局部基因表达程序。这种层次性信息的缺失限制了预测的准确性和生物学一致性。

Method: 将H&E-to-ST预测建模为跨模态语义翻译任务，提出Path2ST框架，包含三个关键组件：(i) Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Conditioning机制，融合显式和隐式细胞特征与组织级语义表征构建层次化条件信号；(ii) Scale-Adaptive Autoregressive Generation过程，在层次化语义词汇表上实现从粗到细、生物学一致的表达合成；(iii) SpectraLoss全频谱目标函数，联合强化序数保真度、建模转录爆发并对齐语义结构与细胞类型。

Result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明，Path2ST取得了最先进的性能，能够生成高精度且空间连贯的转录组图谱。

Conclusion: Path2ST通过显式建模生物学层次结构并采用层次化自回归生成策略，有效弥合了H&E图像与空间转录组之间的语义鸿沟，验证了利用生物学先验知识提升跨模态预测性能的可行性。

Abstract: Predicting spatial gene expression from hematoxylin and eosin (H\&E)-stained images offers a cost-effective alternative to spatial transcriptomics (ST). However, existing methods treat H\&E images as generic visual inputs and ignore their intrinsic biological hierarchy, where spatially organized cell types collectively form functional tissue microenvironments that govern local gene expression programs. To bridge this gap, we formulate H\&E-to-ST prediction as a cross-modal semantic translation task and propose Path2ST, a hierarchically grounded autoregressive framework featuring three key components: (i) a Hierarchical Cell-Tissue Conditioning mechanism that fuses explicit and implicit cellular features with tissue-level semantic representations to construct hierarchical conditioning signals; (ii) a Scale-Adaptive Autoregressive Generation process over a hierarchical semantic vocabulary, enabling coarse-to-fine, biologically consistent expression synthesis; and (iii) SpectraLoss, a full-spectrum objective that jointly enforces ordinal fidelity, models transcriptional bursts, and aligns semantic structures with cell types. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, validating that Path2ST generates highly accurate and spatially coherent transcriptomic profiles. The related code is released at https://github.com/RuochenLiu23/Path2ST.

</details>


### [208] [Local Gains and Fixed-Assignment Set Losses in Shared Set Decoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14717)
*Ze Zhang,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究查询-关系删除对编辑槽位的影响与其包含的预测集效用之间的张力，通过对两个ResNet-50 DETR家族检查点（DETR和DINO）的710个配对图像-关系单元进行选择条件证据分析。结果发现目标减去匹配主动对照的复合对比在两种检查点中呈现局部为正、固定分配为负的相反符号模式，且持久性因读出方式和干预算子而异，不能建立干预不变机制或训练期正则化的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查询-关系删除可以在改善编辑槽位的同时降低包含该槽位的预测集的效用，这种张力需要在受控条件下进行因果推断。作者希望区分局部干预成功与整体解码集后果之间的关系，并检验删除敏感性在不同检查点、读出方式和干预算子之间是否具有持久性。

Method: 使用两个相关的ResNet-50 DETR家族检查点，收集710个配对图像-关系单元的选择条件证据。主要比较采用目标删除减去匹配主动对照（删除同一领导者源但在不同记录接收者处）的复合对比，而非同一接收者的安慰剂。此外进行了重新匹配（rematching），并比较硬删除与保质量编辑（mass-preserving edit）在固定地图条件下的差异。

Result: 目标减对照的对比在两种检查点中局部为正、固定分配为负。相反符号模式在302/710个DETR单元和460/710个DINO单元中出现。重新匹配后计数变为285/710和433/710。重新匹配和原生选择吸收了足够多的DETR平均损失使区间跨过零，而DINO区间保持为负，表明持久性因检查点而异。固定地图比较在重新匹配前也存在差异，但该比较以结果盲地图为条件，不能确立同剂量输送。

Conclusion: 局部干预成功不能决定联合解码集的后果。支持的结论是选择条件删除敏感性，其持久性取决于读出方式和干预算子。作者未识别出干预不变的边缘机制、检测器级退化、群体流行率或训练期正则化的价值。

Abstract: A query-relation deletion can improve the edited slot while reducing the utility of the prediction set that contains it. We study this tension in two related ResNet-50 DETR-family checkpoints using recorded, selection-conditional evidence from 710 paired image-relation units per checkpoint. The primary comparison subtracts a matched active control, which deletes the same leader source at a different recorded recipient, from the selected target deletion. It is therefore a composite contrast rather than a same-recipient placebo.
  The target-minus-control contrast is locally positive and fixed-assignment negative in both checkpoints. The opposite-sign pattern occurs within 302/710 DETR units and 460/710 DINO units. After rematching, the corresponding counts are 285/710 and 433/710. Rematching and native selection absorb enough of the mean loss for DETR intervals to cross zero, whereas DINO intervals remain negative, so persistence across readouts differs by checkpoint. A fixed-map comparison between hard deletion and a mass-preserving edit also differs before rematching. That comparison is conditional on the outcome-blind map and does not establish same-dose transport.
  Local intervention success therefore does not determine the consequence for a jointly decoded set. The supported conclusion is selection-conditional deletion sensitivity whose persistence depends on the readout and intervention operator. We do not identify an intervention-invariant edge mechanism, detector-level degradation, population prevalence, or the value of a training-time regularizer.

</details>


### [209] [VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14718)
*Fan Zhang,Guangming Yao,Jinyang Wu,Hao Wu,Zheng Lian,Xinyu Geng,Jingdong Chen,Yi Yuan,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VideoGAIA是一个面向通用AI助手的智能体式视频理解基准测试，将视频理解从传统的单轮问答任务转变为多轮、工具增强的交互过程，包含271个模型与人类协同设计的复杂真实场景任务。在包括GPT-5.5和Kimi-K3在内的前沿模型上，该基准的准确率均低于60%，表明其作为下一代MLLM评测基准的高价值和及时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主流MLLM在Video-MME等传统单轮视频理解基准上已达到约90%的准确率，说明这类任务正在趋于饱和，无法有效评估先进MLLM的真实智能水平，亟需更复杂、更接近真实应用的视频理解评测范式。

Method: 作者将视频理解建模为多轮、工具增强的智能体交互过程，模型需要迭代感知视频、调用外部工具、收集补充信息并跨轮次整合多模态证据。基准包含271个模型与人类协同设计的任务，且每个视频-问题-答案实例均由三位人类专家独立验证以确保正确性和难度适当。

Result: 所有被评估的MLLM（包括前沿模型如GPT-5.5和Kimi-K3）在VideoGAIA上的准确率均低于60%，与传统基准上约90%的准确率形成鲜明对比，验证了该基准的挑战性和区分度。

Conclusion: VideoGAIA提供了一个高质量且及时的基准，推动视频理解从传统范式向智能体式理解转变，为下一代MLLM的评测和演进提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general artificial intelligence (AI) assistants. Moving beyond one-shot video question answering, VideoGAIA formulates video understanding as a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process, where models must iteratively perceive videos, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate multimodal evidence across turns. VideoGAIA contains 271 model-human co-designed tasks covering diverse and complex real-world scenarios. Each video-question-answer instance is independently verified by three human experts to ensure both correctness and appropriate difficulty. All evaluated MLLMs, including frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Kimi-K3, achieve less than 60% accuracy on VideoGAIA, highlighting its value as a high-quality and timely benchmark for evaluating next-generation MLLMs. We hope that VideoGAIA will facilitate the transition from conventional video understanding toward agentic video understanding.

</details>


### [210] [DeCo-MIL: Debiased Counterfactual Reasoning for Long-Tailed Whole Slide Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14719)
*Xiaoxiao Li,Xitong Ling,Jiawen Li,Weiming Chen,Zhenyang Cai,Xidong Wang,Tian Guan,Benyou Wang,Yonghong He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DeCo-MIL提出了一种用于长尾分布下全切片图像（WSI）分析的弱监督多实例学习方法，通过频率去偏的反事实推理同时缓解嵌套的双重长尾问题（幻灯片间类别长尾和幻灯片内实例判别证据长尾），在三个长尾WSI基准上取得了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长尾分布下，基于MIL的WSI分析面临嵌套的双重长尾挑战：幻灯片间类别长尾（尾类训练幻灯片少）和幻灯片内实例级判别证据长尾（尾类有限的判据集中在少数patch中且被冗余掩盖）。两者相互耦合，导致模型偏向头类、尾类识别性能退化。

Method: DeCo-MIL通过频率去偏的反事实推理联合缓解嵌套双重长尾。对内部长尾：将patch聚类为组织形态锚点，用匹配的正常原型替换每个锚点进行反事实干预，用类别频率校正的预测估计其对真实类别的反事实贡献，据此指导冗余掩蔽以保留稀有的判别实例。对外部长尾：从去冗余的bag中构建锚点分层的伪bag，结合尾类感知过采样与一致性正则化，增加尾类有效监督同时保持组织形态组成。

Result: 在三个长尾WSI基准上的大量实验表明，DeCo-MIL在尾类识别和整体分类方面均达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: DeCo-MIL通过反事实推理和频率去偏策略，有效解决了长尾WSI分析中嵌套双重长尾的耦合问题，同时改善了尾类识别和整体分类性能，证明了该方法在弱监督WSI分析中的有效性。

Abstract: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used for weakly supervised whole slide image (WSI) analysis. However, under long-tailed distributions, MIL-based WSI analysis faces a nested dual long-tail: an inter-slide class long tail and an intra-slide long tail of instance-level discriminative evidence. The two long tails are coupled: tail classes have few training slides, while their limited diagnostic evidence is concentrated in a few patches and obscured by abundant within-bag redundancy. This coupling biases models toward head classes and degrades rare-class recognition. To address this, we propose DeCo-MIL for long-tailed WSI analysis, which jointly alleviates the nested dual long-tail through frequency-debiased counterfactual reasoning. For the inner long tail, DeCo-MIL clusters patches into tissue-morphology anchors, replaces each anchor with its matched normal prototype to perform a counterfactual intervention, and estimates its counterfactual contribution to the ground-truth class using class-frequency-corrected predictions. These contributions guide redundancy masking to preserve scarce discriminative instances. For the outer long tail, DeCo-MIL constructs anchor-stratified pseudo-bags from redundancy-reduced bags and combines tail-aware oversampling with consistency regularization, increasing effective supervision for tail classes while preserving tissue-morphology composition. Extensive experiments on three long-tailed WSI benchmarks demonstrate that DeCo-MIL achieves state-of-the-art performance in both tail-class recognition and overall classification.

</details>


### [211] [AeroGround: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Aerial-Ground Collaborative Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14721)
*Shenghong Yi,Lin Zhang,Muzian Li,Jiakang Yuan,Haoyu Zhang,Peng Ye,Jiayuan Fan,Huafeng Qin,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AeroGround基准，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）在空中-地面协同场景中的理解与推理能力。该基准基于包含约29,000组多模态观测数据的模拟数据集，提供了2,250个涵盖跨视角对应、空间理解和推理的高质量问答实例。实验表明，最佳VLM的平均准确率仅54.4%，远低于人类的93.3%，揭示了现有模型在空中-地面协同推理方面的显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有UAV基准主要聚焦纯航空视角场景，而空中-地面协同场景（如救援、基础设施巡检等实际应用）中VLMs的理解与推理能力尚未被充分探索，存在明显的评估空白。

Method: 构建了基于模拟环境的空中-地面协同数据集（约29,000组多模态观测），设计并发布了包含2,250个问答实例的综合基准AeroGround，覆盖跨视角对应、空间理解和推理三类任务；对16个预训练VLM及2个领域自适应变体进行系统评估，并与人类表现对比。

Result: 最佳VLM在AeroGround上平均准确率为54.4%，而人类平均准确率达93.3%，两者之间存在显著差距（约39个百分点）。

Conclusion: 当前VLMs在空中-地面协同推理任务上表现有限，AeroGround基准系统性地揭示了现有模型的优势与局限，为构建更强大的空中-地面协同具身智能系统提供了评估基础和发展方向。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely employed in understanding and reasoning tasks for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Existing UAV benchmarks primarily focus on aerial-view scenarios. However, whether current VLMs can perform well on understanding and reasoning tasks in aerial-ground collaborative scenarios which are practical in real-world applications like rescue and infrastructure inspection remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AeroGround, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning. AeroGround is built upon a simulated aerial-ground dataset containing approximately 29,000 multimodal observation groups from diverse open environments, and provides 2,250 high-quality question-answering instances covering cross-view correspondence, spatial understanding, and reasoning. Experiments on 16 pretrained VLMs, together with two domain-adapted variants, reveal a substantial gap between current models and human performance: the best model achieves an average accuracy of 54.4%, whereas humans reach 93.3%. By systematically revealing the strengths and limitations of existing models in aerial-ground collaborative reasoning, AeroGround provides a foundation for developing more capable aerial-ground collaborative embodied intelligence systems.

</details>


### [212] [IP Protection in the Era of Visual Generative AI: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14730)
*Zhuan Shi,Shunchang Liu,Alireza Dehghanpour Farashah,Qian Yang,Han Yu,Cao Yang,Chaochao Chen,Yuping Yan,Yaochu Jin,Golnoosh Farnadi,Lingjuan Lyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种二维分类体系来梳理视觉生成模型中的知识产权（IP）保护方法。主轴为"控制逻辑视图"，将方法分为信息暴露控制、生成行为约束和归因与问责三类；次轴区分数据IP与模型IP。在该框架下，论文系统综述了各类保护方法、将评估协议与保护目标对齐，并讨论了主动式模型级防御、标准化评估、对抗适应性攻击鲁棒性及可解释证据等开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉生成AI的快速发展带来了广泛的IP风险（未授权学习、复现、提取、滥用和再分发受保护数据与模型资产）。虽然已有大量技术防御方法被提出，但现有综述通常按生命周期阶段或技术机制组织，这掩盖了不同方法的保护意图，难以让研究者理解各类方法的本质目的。

Method: 提出一个二维分类体系：第一维（主轴）为控制逻辑视图，依据方法所调控的风险变量将防御方法分为三类——信息暴露控制、生成行为约束、归因与问责；第二维为跨切面的资产维度，区分数据IP与模型IP。在此框架下系统综述保护方法，将评估协议与各种保护目标对齐。

Result: 系统性地梳理和分类了当前视觉生成模型IP保护方法，建立了保护目标与评估协议之间的对应关系，并识别出四个关键开放挑战：主动性模型级防护、标准化评估体系、对自适应攻击的鲁棒性以及可解释的事证（证据）机制。

Conclusion: 该二维分类体系为视觉生成AI领域的IP保护研究提供了一种有原则性（principled）、系统性且易于遵循的概览，旨在帮助新手和有经验的研究者理解并把握该领域的方法脉络与未来发展方向。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of visual generative AI has introduced a wide range of intellectual property risks, spanning the unauthorized learning, reproduction, extraction, misuse, and redistribution of protected data and model assets. To address these risks, a growing body of technical defenses has been proposed. However, existing surveys typically organize this literature by lifecycle stage or technical mechanism, which can obscure the protective intent of different methods. This survey presents a two-dimensional taxonomy for IP protection in visual generative models. The primary axis is a Control Logic View, which classifies methods into Information Exposure Control, Generative Behavior Constraint, and Attribution & Accountability according to the risk variable they regulate. The secondary axis distinguishes Data IP from Model IP as cross-cutting asset dimensions. Under this framework, we systematically review protection methods, align evaluation protocols with protection objectives, and discuss open challenges including proactive model-level safeguards, standardized evaluation, robustness against adaptive attacks, and explainable evidence. This survey aims to offer a principled, systematic, and easy-to-follow overview for both new and experienced researchers in visual generative AI IP protection.

</details>
