### [213] [Braided Vision Transformer for Stroke Detection in Multi-view Retinal Fundus Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14722)
*Aysen Degerli,Mika Hilvo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于视网膜眼底成像的卒中与短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）检测方法，首次引入视觉变换器模型（Braided Vision Transformer, BViT），利用双眼的黄斑中心与视神经乳头中心多视图图像，捕获跨眼视图间关系，在Stroke-Data数据集上实现0.75的AUC，优于常规视觉变换器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卒中是全球致死致残的主要原因，需要准确快速的评估手段。传统的神经影像学检查成本高、侵入性强且不便携，而视网膜眼底成像作为一种非侵入性、低成本、便携的筛查手段，能够反映脑血管和神经学风险因素，因此作者探索将其用于卒中与TIA的检测。

Method: 作者提出Braided Vision Transformer（BViT）模型，这是首个用于卒中评估的视网膜眼底成像视觉变换器。该模型从双眼的多种视图（黄斑中心和视神经乳头中心）提取代表性特征，同时捕获跨眼视图之间的相互关系，从而更全面地理解与脑血管事件相关的视网膜生物标志物。

Result: 在自行收集的Stroke-Data数据集上，BViT在卒中检测上取得了0.75的AUC分数，优于常规视觉变换器模型。

Conclusion: 视网膜眼底成像结合多视图视觉变换器（BViT）为卒中快速筛查提供了一种可行且有效的新型手段，展现了在非侵入性、低成本场景下替代传统神经影像的潜力。

Abstract: Stroke remains a leading cause of mortality and morbidity worldwide, emphasizing the importance of its accurate and immediate assessment. Retinal fundus imaging has emerged as a promising modality for stroke assessment, as the retina reflects cerebrovascular and neurological risk factors. Contrary to conventional neuroimaging techniques, retinal fundus imaging offers a non-invasive, cost-effective, and portable alternative for rapid screening. This paper explores the feasibility of retinal fundus imaging for stroke and transient ischemic attack (TIA) detection using macula-centric and optic nerve head-centric views captured from both eyes. Our study introduces, to the best of our knowledge, the first vision transformer model for retinal fundus imaging in stroke assessment, offering a novel approach for capturing retinal patterns. Thereby, we propose the Braided Vision Transformer (BViT) model, which extracts representative features from the given multi-view images while simultaneously capturing inter-view relationships across both eyes, enabling a more informative understanding of retinal biomarkers associated with cerebrovascular events. Experiments conducted on our collected Stroke-Data dataset demonstrate that BViT achieves an AUC score of 0.75 for stroke detection, outperforming regular vision transformers.

</details>


### [214] [A Vision Transformer for ECG-Based Detection of Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction Across Multiple Clinical Sites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14723)
*Burcu Ozek,Aruna Mohan,David Vorchheimer,Daniel Weiss,Eyal Kedar,Tamar Sobol,Or Zilbershot,Fatemeh Afghah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文训练了一个从零开始（非预训练）的视觉Transformer集成模型，用于从12导联心电图检测左心室射血分数降低（LVEF≤40%）。在来自美国三个医疗系统七个地点的10,142名患者上训练，并在包含4,092名患者（真实患病率8.72%）的独立外部队列中验证，AUROC达0.88，敏感性81.2%，特异性81.0%，阴性预测值97.8%。模型通过逐心跳分析，其注意力图显示对QRS波群的聚焦而非P波，展现出作为可扩展的一线分流工具以筛选需接受超声心动图检查患者的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 左心室射血分数降低（LVEF≤40%）常常无症状，往往直到晚期心力衰竭才被发现。心电图作为常规检查却被严重低估利用，因为该病没有单一诊断性波形特征。作者旨在建立一种可扩展、非侵入性的筛查工具，利用常规采集的12导联心电图对无症状的射血分数降低患者进行早期识别和分流。

Method: 训练了一个从零开始训练的视觉Transformer（Vision Transformer）集成模型，对12导联ECG逐心跳（beat-level）进行分析。训练集包含来自美国三个医疗系统七个临床地点的10,142名患者；外部验证采用来自三个地理独立临床地点的4,092名患者队列，真实患病率为8.72%。模型同时利用beat-level注意力图提供可解释性分析。

Result: 在外部队列中，模型达到AUROC 0.88（95% CI 0.86-0.89），敏感性81.2%，特异性81.0%，阴性预测值97.8%。敏感性在不同性别、种族、民族和合并症亚组中保持高水平；特异性在老年患者及心房颤动或心肌病患者中有所降低。注意力图显示模型持续聚焦于QRS波群而非P波。

Conclusion: 常规心电图可作为可扩展的一线分流筛查手段，帮助识别应从超声心动图检查中获益的射血分数降低患者。研究支持跨多样化患者群体应用该方法的潜力。

Abstract: Reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is frequently asymptomatic and often detected only after advanced heart failure develops. Electrocardiograms are recorded routinely yet underused for this condition, because reduced LVEF has no single diagnostic waveform. We trained an ensemble of vision transformers from scratch to detect reduced LVEF ($\leq$40%) from 12-lead ECGs, analyzing each heartbeat individually, using 10,142 patients across seven sites in three US health systems. In a held-out external cohort of 4,092 patients from three geographically independent US clinical sites at a real-world reduced-LVEF prevalence of 8.72%, the model achieved an AUROC of 0.88 (95% CI 0.86-0.89), sensitivity 81.2%, specificity 81.0%, and negative predictive value 97.8%. Sensitivity remained high across sex, race, ethnicity, and comorbidity subgroups, while specificity was lower in older patients and those with atrial fibrillation or cardiomyopathy. Beat-level attention maps provided interpretability into the model's predictions, showing consistent focus on the QRS complex rather than the P wave. These findings support the potential of routine ECGs as a scalable first-pass triage step to identify patients who should undergo echocardiography for reduced ejection fraction across diverse patient populations.

</details>


### [215] [Privacy-Preserving Dataset Curation for Kuala Lumpur Urban Traffic: Grounded Vision-Language Detection with Spatial Vehicle-Context Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14724)
*Mohammed Abdul Al Arafat Tanzin,Rudzidatul Akmam Dziyauddin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对吉隆坡热带城市道路数据集（KL Road Dataset）提出了一套自动化的隐私匿名化框架，整合Grounding DINO零样本开放集视觉-语言Transformer与空间车辆ROI包含引擎，在1266帧上达到约95%的成功率，有效处理高摩托车密度、深色丙烯酸车牌、动态相机倾斜和极端热带眩光下的PII匿名化难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能交通系统和自动驾驶依赖多模态城市交通数据集，但在吉隆坡这一复杂热带城市环境中，由于高摩托车密度、深色丙烯酸车牌、动态相机倾斜和极端热带眩光等因素，人脸和车牌的PII匿名化面临严重挑战。传统的Haar级联和YOLOv8在这些条件下产生大量误检和漏检，需要一种更稳健的自动化匿名化方案。

Method: 提出一个结合两部分的自动化匿名化框架：（1）Grounding DINO——一种零样本开放集视觉-语言Transformer，用于通用目标检测；（2）新颖的空间车辆ROI包含引擎，要求车牌质心必须位于已验证的车辆边界内，从而抑制环境误检并自动模糊人脸、头部和车牌。框架还包含时间持久性机制和自动化质量控制审计器。

Result: 在1266帧上的初始评估显示约95%的成功率，剩余失败案例仅限于小尺寸、重度遮挡、倾斜或模糊的目标。该框架在最小化隐私相关漏检的同时保留了场景上下文，适用于下游视觉任务。

Conclusion: 该公开可用的流水线和演示笔记本为隐私感知的数据集整理提供了可审计的预处理阶段。然而，正式的法规合规性仍依赖于更广泛的治理流程。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of intelligent transportation systems and autonomous driving relies heavily on multi-modal urban traffic datasets. However, curating high-fidelity video imagery in complex tropical urban environments---specifically Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia---presents severe challenges for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) anonymization due to high motorcycle density, dark acrylic license plates, dynamic camera tilt, and extreme tropical glare. We propose an automated anonymization framework tailored for the Kuala Lumpur Road Dataset, captured via a mobile cycling platform at 2 FPS. We document how legacy Haar cascades and YOLOv8 fail under these conditions---generating false positives on background elements while missing rotated or occluded targets. Our architecture resolves this by integrating Grounding DINO---a zero-shot open-set vision-language transformer---with a novel Spatial Vehicle Region of Interest (ROI) Containment Engine. By requiring license plate centroids to reside within validated vehicle boundaries, the pipeline suppresses environmental false positives while automatically obfuscating faces, heads, and license plates. An initial evaluation on 1,266 frames demonstrates a $\sim$95\% success rate, with remaining failures restricted to small, heavily occluded, oblique, or ambiguous targets. Coupled with temporal persistence mechanisms and an automated quality-control auditor, the framework minimizes privacy-related false negatives while preserving scene context for downstream vision tasks. While formal legal compliance depends on broader governance procedures, this publicly available pipeline and demonstration notebook provide an auditable preprocessing stage for privacy-aware dataset curation.

</details>


### [216] [Spatial Attention Noise Masking for Causally Sufficient Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14725)
*Benjamin Formby,Kuang-Ching Wang,D Hudson Smith*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种新颖的因果可解释性方法，通过空间注意力噪声掩码框架动态遮蔽输入图像，生成特征归因图，为图像分类模型的预测提供因果解释。该方法包含UNet风格掩码生成器和ResNet18编码器与线性分类器，生成的掩码稀疏且空间平滑，在五种分类任务上保持接近基线的分类性能，同时对抗背景交换和自然对抗样本等分布偏移具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法大多被动应用于已训练模型，产生的是相关性而非因果性解释；现有因果可解释方法局限于事后分析，削弱了因果主张的说服力；缺乏主动方法能够明确将预测责任分配给输入特征。

Method: 提出空间注意力噪声掩码框架，包含两个核心组件：1) UNet风格的掩码生成器用于动态生成输入图像的掩码；2) ResNet18编码器与线性分类器同时对掩码和未掩码版本图像进行分类。掩码通过正则化约束保持稀疏性和空间平滑性，同时掩码图像嵌入与未掩码图像嵌入保持一致性。

Result: 定量评估表明掩码具有良好的忠实度，在五种分类任务中尽管大量遮蔽图像信息仍保持接近基线的分类性能，并且对背景交换和自然对抗样本等分布偏移具有鲁棒性。定性比较显示掩码行为与最先进的特征归因方法具有竞争力的可解释性。

Conclusion: 生成的掩码可解释为特征归因图，既与相关可解释性方法具有竞争力，又为模型预测提供了强有力的因果解释。

Abstract: We present a novel causal approach to interpretability for computer vision models that dynamically masks the input image prior to classification. The interpretability of deep learning predictions is critical in high-stakes fields such as medical imaging, security, and autonomous driving. Most interpretability methods are applied passively to already trained models, which typically result in correlational rather than causal explanations. Existing causal interpretability methods are limited to post hoc analysis, weakening the causal claims. Additionally, existing active methods generally lack explanations that explicitly assign responsibility to input features. This work proposes a spatial attention noise masking framework that provides causal explanations about the features sufficient for the prediction. The proposed framework consists of: 1) a UNet-style mask generator, and 2) a Resnet18 encoder and linear classifier that classifies both masked and unmasked versions of an input image. The generated masks are regularized to be sparse and spatially smooth, while masked image embeddings are constrained to remain consistent with embeddings from the corresponding unmasked images. The resulting masks can be interpreted as feature attribution maps that are competitive with related interpretability methods while additionally providing strong causal explanations of model predictions. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate mask faithfulness, near-baseline classification performance across five classification tasks despite substantial masking of image information, and robustness to distribution shifts such as background swapping and natural adversarial examples. Qualitative comparisons further demonstrate mask behavior and competitive interpretability relative to state-of-the-art feature attribution methods.

</details>


### [217] [Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16791)
*Ye Lu,Shen Wang,Zhaoyang Zhang,Yihan Yan,Li Liu,Runze Liu,Fanghui Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SFMI（Steering Flow Model Inversion），一种两阶段白盒模型反演方法，将反演重构为轨迹引导任务。第一阶段预训练通用Flow Matching模型作为人脸流形先验，第二阶段通过渐进式引导调度器（PGS）注入目标特定的、随时间变化的梯度，将生成流从随机噪声引导至目标类高密度区域。在CelebA数据集、身份不重叠的跨评估设置下，ArcFace目标上达到ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874，在多个目标模型上展现出具有竞争力的SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型反演攻击方法依赖间接引导或高度随机的引导，难以稳定地将生成轨迹优化到目标人脸图像，导致攻击成功率和视觉保真度不稳定。本文旨在通过将反演重构为轨迹引导任务，利用Flow Matching的先验建模能力和渐进式引导策略来实现稳定、高质量的模型反演。

Method: SFMI采用两阶段方法：Step I预训练一个通用的无条件Flow Matching模型，以编码人脸流形作为稳健先验；Step II使用渐进式引导调度器（PGS），在采样过程中注入随时间变化的目标特定梯度。PGS通过对目标模型进行反向传播，从中间生成状态获取梯度，并将自适应引导信号渐进式注入向量场，从而将生成流从随机噪声引导至目标类的高密度区域。

Result: 在CelebA数据集、身份不重叠的跨评估设置下，SFMI在ArcFace目标上达到ACC 0.9248、FID 22.61、LPIPS 0.3874；在多个目标模型上进行了广泛实验，验证了其在攻击成功率和视觉保真度上达到具有竞争力的SOTA性能。

Conclusion: SFMI通过将模型反演重构为轨迹引导任务，结合Flow Matching先验与渐进式引导调度器，有效解决了现有方法在生成轨迹优化上不稳定的问题，在白盒协议下实现了攻击成功率和视觉保真度的平衡提升，展现了模型反演攻击的新思路。

Abstract: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling. By backpropagating through the target model to obtain gradients from intermediate generated states, PGS progressively injects adaptive guidance signals into the vector field. This process effectively steers the current generative flow from random noise toward the high-density regions of the target class. Under an identity-disjoint cross-evaluation setting using the CelebA dataset, SFMI achieves an ACC of 0.9248, an FID of 22.61, and an LPIPS of 0.3874 on the ArcFace target. Extensive experiments on multiple target models demonstrate that SFMI achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance in attack success and visual fidelity under the evaluated white-box protocol.

</details>


### [218] [Low Cost Two-Stage Fabric Defect Detection at the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14727)
*Rasel Hossen,Diptajoy Mistry,Mosaddek Hossain Kamal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对低收入经济体服装厂织物检测仍依赖人眼、商用视觉系统昂贵的问题，构建了一个两级级联检测系统：先以轻量卷积自编码器（含注意力门控、边缘加权重建损失、YOLOv5n教师蒸馏）做异常筛查，仅对可疑帧调用YOLOv5n完整检测器，在NVIDIA Jetson Nano上以TensorRT FP16端到端部署。在249图基准上，一级筛查召回全部20张缺陷图（95%CI 0.83-1.00），误报率49.3%。关键发现是并行管线达13.45 FPS对串行YOLO-only的9.86 FPS（1.36倍加速），但其中91%归因于JPEG解码与推理重叠，级联本身仅贡献5.1%推理减少。作者以此警示未控制数据路径的级联加速测量，并将系统定位为AI辅助分诊而非自主验收。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低收入经济体服装厂的织物检测仍以人工为主，商用视觉系统价格超出大多数中小型工厂承受能力。缺陷在受控生产条件下稀疏分布，天然适合用级联策略——先用廉价异常检测器筛查每一帧，再对可疑帧调用完整检测器。作者旨在构建并部署这样一个端到端级联系统，并严格分解其加速来源，纠正对级联性能的高估。

Method: 两级级联：Stage 1为紧凑卷积自编码器，配备解码器注意力门控、边缘加权重建损失，并经特征级蒸馏从冻结的YOLOv5n教师学习；Stage 2为YOLOv5n，仅在被标记的帧上调用。系统在NVIDIA Jetson Nano上以TensorRT FP16端到端部署。实验分解加速贡献：对比并行级联管线与串行YOLO-only循环，逐项归因JPEG解码重叠与级联本身的推理节省，并分析转发帧构成（误报受限vs流行率受限）及更紧校准下的推理减少空间。

Result: 在249图像基准（20缺陷、229非缺陷）上，Stage 1在召回优先阈值下命中全部20张缺陷图（95%CI 0.83-1.00），误报率49.3%（113/229），较普通自编码器误报降低19.3%（p=0.011）。并行管线13.45 FPS对串行YOLO-only 9.86 FPS，但分解显示91%的1.36倍加速来自JPEG解码与推理重叠，级联本身仅贡献5.1%推理减少（转发率p=0.534时不显著）。转发帧中85%为误报，呈误报受限而非流行率受限；更紧校准可获29-45%推理减少。

Conclusion: 级联架构在召回优先阈值下达到100%缺陷召回，但实际推理加速主要来自数据路径优化（JPEG解码重叠）而非级联本身。级联在当前转发设置下未给推理带来显著节省，原因是误报受限（85%转发为误报）。作者将此报告为对未控制数据路径的级联加速测量的警示，并将系统定位为AI辅助分诊工具而非自主验收系统。

Abstract: Fabric inspection in the garment industries of low-income economies remains largely manual, and commercial vision systems are priced beyond most small and medium mills. Because defects are sparse under controlled production, a natural response is a cascade: screen every frame with a cheap anomaly detector and invoke a full detector only on suspicious frames. We build such a cascade for four knit-fabric defect classes and deploy it end-to-end on an NVIDIA Jetson Nano with TensorRT FP16. Stage 1 is a compact convolutional autoencoder with decoder attention gates, an edge-weighted reconstruction loss, and feature-level distillation from a frozen YOLOv5n teacher; Stage 2 is YOLOv5n, invoked only on flagged frames. On a 249-image benchmark disjoint from detector training (20 defective, 229 non-defective), Stage 1 at a recall-prioritised threshold flags all 20 defective images (95% CI 0.83-1.00) at a false-positive rate of 49.3% (113/229), reducing false positives by 19.3% relative to a plain autoencoder (p=0.011). The parallel pipeline reaches 13.45 FPS against 9.86 FPS for a sequential YOLO-only loop. Our central finding comes from decomposing that 1.36x: 91% of it is attributable to overlapping JPEG decode with inference rather than to the cascade, which contributes only a 5.1% inference reduction at the measured forwarding rate p = 0.534. We further show that forwarding here is false-positive-limited rather than prevalence-limited - 85% of forwarded frames are false alarms - and quantify the 29-45% inference reduction attainable under tighter calibration. We report this as a caution for cascade speedups measured without controlling the data path, and position the system as AI-assisted triage rather than autonomous acceptance.

</details>


### [219] [Do CNNs Internally Represent Real and Fake Images Differently? A Hidden-Layer Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14729)
*Moumita Sen Sarma,Pascal Hitzler,Eugene Y. Vasserman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了CNN在隐藏层激活模式上是否对真实图像和虚假图像存在不同表征。通过在场景识别任务中提取全连接层激活、使用神经符号方法标注语义神经元，并基于Stable Diffusion生成语义相似的配对齐fake图像，统计比较真实-虚假激活模式后发现，fake图像确实引发不同的隐藏神经元激活，且这种差异无法仅用简单图像退化解释。该发现为利用CNN内部行为差异改进假图检测提供了新方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 假图日益泛滥，但CNN处理真实与合成图像时是否在内部表征上存在差异尚不明确。验证这一假设可为更鲁棒的假图检测提供理论依据。

Method: 在场景识别任务中使用预训练CNN模型，提取全连接层激活；利用神经符号方法为选定神经元分配语义标签；通过Stable Diffusion变体（物体标签引导的text-to-image和image-to-image生成）为每张真实测试图生成语义内容相似的配对假图；对配对真实-虚假激活模式进行统计比较；并通过更换数据集、CNN架构、生成模型以及JPEG/模糊退化分析进行鲁棒性验证。

Result: 实验结果表明fake图像会引发不同的隐藏神经元激活模式，且这些差异不能仅归因于简单图像退化（如JPEG压缩或模糊）所造成的影响。

Conclusion: 至少在部分设置下，真实与fake图像在CNN隐藏层激活行为上存在可观测差异，这为未来利用该差异改进假图检测的研究打开了新的思路。

Abstract: Fake/synthetic images are increasingly prevalent, but it remains unclear whether Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) process real and fake images in the same internal manner. This work examines the hypothesis that CNNs represent real and fake images differently, such that fake images induce different hidden-layer activation patterns even when semantic content is preserved. The hypothesis is evaluated in scene recognition settings using trained CNN models. Dense-layer activations are extracted, and neurosymbolic methods assign semantic labels to selected neurons. For each real test image, corresponding fake images are generated with similar semantic content using object-label-guided text-to-image and image-to-image generation based on Stable Diffusion variants. Paired real-fake activation patterns are then compared statistically. Additional experiments with another dataset, CNN architecture, generative model, and JPEG/blur degradation analysis assess robustness. Results suggest that fake images evoke different hidden-neuron activations, and these differences are not explained only by simple image degradation. Overall, the findings indicate that real and fake images differ in CNN hidden-layer activation behavior at least in some settings, which opens the door for follow-up work on making use of this different behavior to improve fake image detection.

</details>


### [220] [Emergence of Transfer Learning towards Specific Identification of Alzheimer's Disease A Prospective Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14731)
*Soumik Podder,Chandramouli Haldar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了迁移学习（Transfer Learning）在阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断中的应用，重点评估了TL在分类、识别和AD转化预测中的作用，并创新性地将可解释人工智能（XAI）纳入TL-based AD诊断系统的讨论中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病是全球数百万老年人面临的严重神经退行性疾病，传统深度学习和机器学习模型在大规模神经影像数据上存在过拟合和全局优化问题，而CNN容易受到MRI图像突变、人工操作和预处理不足的影响。迁移学习利用预训练模型可帮助新模型应对数据不足的问题，因此需要系统综述其在AD诊断中的优势与局限。

Method: 本文采用综述性研究方法，系统评估迁移学习在AD分类、识别及从轻度认知障碍（MCI）向AD转化预测中的应用，同时分析TL在有限数据下提升诊断准确性的能力，并特别引入可解释人工智能（XAI）作为综述的独特视角。

Result: 综述展示了迁移学习在AD诊断中的有效性，即使在有限数据条件下也能提升诊断准确性，同时指出了TL存在的局限性，并提出了XAI与TL结合以增强诊断系统可解释性的方向。

Conclusion: 该综述为神经退行性疾病检测领域的研究者提供了迁移学习应用的全面指导，特别是TL与可解释AI结合的新视角，有助于推动AD诊断系统的进一步发展。

Abstract: Worldwide, millions of senior citizens are suffering from Alzheimer disease abbreviated as AD, a well- versed form of dementia. AD is featured by amnesia, intellectual disability, and difficulty with consciousness. DL and ML models are undoubtedly explored to identify AD related patterns on large dimensional neuroimaging data but they need global optimization and are suffering from overfitting issue that might yield dissatisfactory result in testing data set. DL overcomes the issue by convolution of input image with kernel but any sudden change in the MRI image or human manipulation, limited pre- processing of the images can mislead CNN in achieving highly accurate detection. Transfer Learning (TL) has proved itself in AD diagnosis by utilizing pre-trained models on large data sets to guide novice model in a new neuroimaging dataset. This review provides an inclusive glimpse of TL implication in classification, identification including the conversion of AD. Keeping in view, we have assessed the strengths and limitations of TL in improvising diagnostic accuracy even with limited data. The uniqueness of the present review is the incorporation of explainable AI in TL based AD diagnosis system. Finally, it can be claimed that the review will guide the new re-searchers in the area of TL induced neurodegenerative disease detection.

</details>


### [221] [From Dense Prediction to Visual Editing: Structured Supervision for Unified Image and Video Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14740)
*Zhefan Rao,Bin Zou,Haoxuan Che,Xuanhua He,Chong Hou Choi,Yanheng Li,Rui Liu,Qifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出在统一图像/视频生成框架中引入深度与表面法线预测作为图像形式去噪目标，通过结构化稠密监督（而非仅语义条件）提升下游编辑任务的时间一致性和局部结构保留能力。基于共享多模态扩散Transformer（MMDiT）主干，配合互上下文注意力（MCA）、成对视频数据构造流程以及渐进式训练课程，单一检查点在统一系统对比中取得最高总分（4.15），稠密监督分别将OpenVE Overall从3.98提升至4.06、Local Add从3.92提升至4.18。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一图像/视频生成模型仅依赖语义条件且仅在生成任务上训练，缺乏对局部结构（如空间对齐、时间一致性所需的几何与深度信息）的显式监督，导致精确、时间一致的编辑任务表现受限。

Method: 1) 将深度和表面法线预测重构为图像形式的去噪目标，作为稠密结构化视觉监督；2) 在同一MCDiT主干上统一所有任务，解耦语义解释与空间对齐视觉注入；3) 提出互上下文注意力（MCA）与成对视频数据构造流程，并通过渐进式训练课程将结构线索连接至时间局部编辑和参考条件生成。

Result: 在统一系统的对比评测中获得最高总分（4.15）；稠密监督带来显著改进：OpenVE Overall从3.98提升至4.06，Local Add从3.92提升至4.18。

Conclusion: 感知导向的稠密监督能够将有用的结构知识有效迁移至下游生成任务，尤其对编辑的局部性与保留性有益；但作者明确限定结论范围，不主张该框架作为独立稠密预测器的优越性。

Abstract: Unified image and video creation requires a model to follow diverse instructions while preserving identity, geometry, and temporal structure from visual context. However, semantic-only conditioning and creation-only training do not explicitly supervise the local structure needed for precise, temporally consistent editing. We therefore formulate depth and surface-normal prediction as image-form denoising targets, using these dense tasks as structured visual supervision within the same creation interface. Our framework decouples semantic interpretation from spatially aligned visual injection while sharing one multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT) backbone across all tasks. Mutual Context Attention (MCA), a paired-video data-construction procedure, and a progressive training curriculum then connect the learned structural cues to temporally localized editing and reference-conditioned creation. A single checkpoint obtains the highest overall score in the reported comparison of unified systems (4.15); adding dense supervision improves OpenVE Overall from 3.98 to 4.06 and Local Add from 3.92 to 4.18. These results support a deliberately bounded conclusion: perception-oriented dense supervision transfers useful structural knowledge to downstream creation, especially editing locality and preservation; we do not claim superiority as a standalone dense predictor.

</details>


### [222] [PolyComp: A Polycube-based Benchmark for Compositional 3D Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14741)
*Siddharth Patel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍PolyComp基准，一个程序化生成且经过验证的视觉识别与组合空间推理测试基准。每个问题要求模型在四个选项中识别出哪一对多立方体组件可以组合成目标实体。基准包含120个问题、四个几何系列和三种呈现格式。测试结果显示GPT-5.6 Sol达到50.0%准确率，Claude Fable 5达到39.4%，Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview仅27.5%（接近25%随机猜测基线），表明当前模型在此类组合空间推理任务上能力有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准在组合空间推理（即判断两个组件能否拼接成目标三维实体）方面缺乏严格验证且可程序化生成的测试集，难以有效评估前沿视觉语言模型在此类结构化推理任务上的真实能力，同时无法系统分析不同几何系列和呈现格式对模型性能的影响。

Method: 采用程序化生成方式构建PolyComp基准，包含120个问题、四个几何系列（多立方体家族），每个问题提供三种呈现格式（单图或多图）。每个问题要求模型从四个选项中选出能组合成目标实体的多立方体组件对，并建立了问题开发与评估协议，同时进行成本与token核算。

Result: 在三种呈现格式共360个呈现问题中：GPT-5.6 Sol（最大努力）达50.0%准确率（CI 43.3-56.7%），平均每题成本$0.951；Claude Fable 5（最大努力）达39.4%（CI 33.1-46.1%），成本$0.701；Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview（高思考级别）仅27.5%（CI 22.8-32.5%），接近25%随机基线，成本$0.350。准确率在几何系列间的差异大于呈现格式间的差异。

Conclusion: 当前最先进的多模态模型在组合空间推理上仍存在显著不足，最佳模型准确率仅50%，且各模型间性能差异巨大（最高与最低相差约23个百分点）。几何系列对性能的影响大于呈现格式，表明模型在特定几何结构推理上存在结构性短板。该基准可作为衡量模型发展的重要参考，同时发布全部120个问题供社区使用。

Abstract: We introduce PolyComp, a procedurally generated and verified benchmark that stresses visual recognition and compositional spatial reasoning. In each problem, a model must identify which of four options shows a pair of polycube components that can be combined to form a target solid. The benchmark contains 120 problems across four geometry families, and each problem has three different presentation formats using either a single image or multiple images. The random guessing baseline is 25%. Across the three presentations (360 presented problems per model), GPT-5.6 Sol with max effort attains 50.0% accuracy (95% problem-cluster CI 43.3-56.7%) at a mean cost of \$0.951 per presented problem, Claude Fable 5 with max effort attains 39.4% (33.1-46.1%) at \$0.701, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview with thinking level high attains 27.5% (22.8-32.5%), near the 25% random guessing baseline, at \$0.350. The observed accuracy spread across geometry families is larger than across presentation formats. We present a problem development and evaluation protocol, cost and token accounting, and release the 120 problems.

</details>


### [223] [Beyond Boundary Noise: Aggregated Aleatoric Uncertainty Fails to Capture Presence Ambiguity in 3D Lung Nodule Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14766)
*Simon Baur,Arne Schernich,Ekin Böke,Wojciech Samek,Jackie Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了熵基偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty）在医学影像分割中是否能够反映临床意义上的存在性歧义（pathology presence ambiguity）。结果表明，熵基不确定性映射只能捕捉边界噪声和微小标注差异，无法有效区分病理是否存在。相比之下，一个基于冻结分割特征的轻量级监督歧义头在所有架构、指标和两个队列（LIDC-IDRI和LNDb）上显著优于所有熵聚合基线，并匹配或超越显式建模歧义的方法。作者进一步证明存在性歧义已编码在冻结编码器特征中，但被分割输出和熵聚合丢弃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偶然不确定性在理论上被设计用于捕捉不可约的数据歧义，但在安全性关键的临床部署中，熵基度量是否能反映临床上有意义的歧义（即病例层面关于病理是否存在的分歧）尚不清楚。以往研究多关注像素级边界分歧，本文旨在系统评估偶然不确定性对存在性歧义的捕捉能力。

Method: 在3D肺结节分割任务上，跨越四种架构，使用Monte Carlo dropout和深度集成方法，在LIDC-IDRI和外部验证队列LNDb上进行系统性评估。对比熵基不确定性映射与一个轻量级监督歧义头（基于冻结分割特征训练），并与Probabilistic U-Net和Annotator-Confusion 3D-UNet等显式建模方法进行比较，同时进行特征空间定性分析。

Result: 熵基不确定性映射与边界噪声和微小绘制差异对齐，但对存在性歧义缺乏足够的判别信号。轻量级监督歧义头在所有架构、指标和两个队列上显著优于所有熵聚合基线，并匹配或超越显式建模方法。特征空间分析表明存在性歧义已编码在冻结编码器特征中，但被分割输出及熵聚合丢弃。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了偶然不确定性的理论承诺与其实际行为之间的根本性不匹配，表明实践者在安全性关键应用中不应依赖熵基不确定性作为临床歧义的代理指标。

Abstract: Uncertainty estimation is critical for the safe clinical deployment of deep learning in medical image segmentation, with aleatoric uncertainty theoretically designed to capture irreducible data ambiguity. However, whether entropy-based measures reflect clinically meaningful ambiguity, i.e. case-level disagreement about whether a pathology is present at all, remains poorly understood. Contrary to most prior work, which focused on pixel-wise boundary disagreement, we systematically evaluate how well aleatoric uncertainty captures presence ambiguity. Our evaluation spans 3D lung nodule segmentation across four architectures with Monte Carlo dropout and deep ensembles, on LIDC-IDRI and an external validation cohort (LNDb). We find that entropy-based uncertainty maps align with boundary noise and minor drawing variation but carry insufficient discriminative signal for presence ambiguity. In contrast, a lightweight supervised ambiguity head trained on frozen segmentation features substantially outperforms all entropy-aggregation-based baselines across architectures, metrics, and both cohorts, and matches or exceeds methods that explicitly model ambiguity under disagreement supervision (Probabilistic U-Net, Annotator-Confusion 3D-UNet). A qualitative feature-space analysis shows that presence ambiguity is already encoded in the frozen encoder features of pixel-wise-trained networks, only to be discarded by the segmentation output and its entropy aggregation. Our findings expose a fundamental mismatch between the theoretical promise of aleatoric uncertainty and its practical behavior, and suggest that practitioners should not rely on entropy-based uncertainty as a proxy for clinical ambiguity in safety-critical applications.

</details>


### [224] [NARRATE: A Multimodal Real-World Australian Driving Dataset for Human-Centred Explanations in Automated Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14767)
*Ashkan Yousefi Zadeh,Zishuo Zhu,Xiaomeng Li,Andry Rakotonirainy,Sebastien Glaser,Ronald Schroeter,Patricia Delhomme,Zahra Mehraban*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了NARRATE，一个多模态实景澳大利亚驾驶数据集，包含来自35名经验丰富驾驶员和驾驶教练的2,050个带注释事件，每个事件配有同步的视觉、定位、运动和LiDAR数据流以及车内/驾驶后的自由文本解释。数据集提供动作标签、场景上下文标签（6个高层级和32个细粒度类别）以及驾驶员解释的跨度级情景感知标注（感知、理解、预测）。四个基准任务显示该结构可从驾驶员语言中学习，但细粒度上下文识别和解释生成仍具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统需要以乘客能理解、监控和信任的方式解释决策。现有语言标注的驾驶数据集大多是观察者撰写的、事后性的、基于仿真或传感器输入生成的，而非从执行该行为的驾驶员处直接获取，缺乏真实驾驶情境下驾驶员自述的、多模态对齐的解释数据。

Method: 构建NARRATE数据集：从35名经验丰富的驾驶员和驾驶教练在公共道路上收集2,050个标注事件，同步采集视觉、定位（GPS）、运动（IMU）和LiDAR数据流，并配对车内实时和/或驾驶后的自由文本解释。数据包含动作标签、6个高层级和32个细粒度的场景上下文标签，以及驾驶员解释上跨度级别的情景感知（SA）标注（感知、理解、预测三个层次）。在此基础上设计了四个基准任务：SA识别、场景上下文识别、驾驶员动作分类和解释生成。

Result: 四个基准任务的实验结果表明，所提出的标注结构可以从驾驶员语言中学习。然而，细粒度上下文识别和解释生成仍然是具有挑战性的任务，性能尚不理想。

Conclusion: NARRATE为自动驾叙事驶领域提供了首个以驾驶员为中心、真实道路环境下的多模态解释数据集，为构建更以人为中心和领域感知的自动驾驶解释模型铺平了道路。

Abstract: Automated vehicles must explain their decisions in ways that passengers can understand, monitor, and trust. Existing language-annotated driving datasets are mostly observer-written, post-hoc, simulation-based, or generated from sensor inputs, rather than elicited from the driver performing the action. We introduce NARRATE, a multimodal real-world Australian driving dataset comprising 2,050 annotated events from 35 experienced drivers and driving instructors on public roads. Each event is grounded in synchronised visual, localisation, motion, and LiDAR streams and paired with in-vehicle and/or post-drive free-text explanations. NARRATE provides action labels, scenario-context labels spanning six high-level and 32 fine-grained categories, and span-level Situational Awareness (SA) annotations over driver explanations for Perception, Comprehension and Projection. Four benchmark tasks (SA, scenario-context, driver-action classification, and explanation generation) show that this structure is learnable from driver language, while fine-grained context recognition and explanation generation remain challenging. NARRATE paves a path towards more human-centred and domain-aware explanation models for automated driving.

</details>


### [225] [Uncertainty Identifies Difficult Samples Across Methods: A Multi-Task Study on a Heterogeneous Skin Lesion Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14768)
*Leon Koole,Jiapan Guo,Matias Valdenegro-Toro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了皮肤病变分类器的不确定性量化问题，在多个ISIC来源合并的数据集上，使用共享骨干网络和两个联合学习头（二分类良恶性头与五分类诊断头），比较了五种不确定性量化方法（MC Dropout、DropConnect、Flipout、Deep Ensembles、DUQ）在准确性、校准、不确定性分解和风险覆盖等方面的表现。研究发现样本难度大体与方法无关，但方法选择对校准和不确定性分解影响显著，其中Deep Ensembles表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮肤病变分类器可能在关键病例上自信地犯错，因此知道何时不应信任预测结果，在临床上与预测本身同样重要。这促使研究者系统性地评估不同不确定性量化方法在皮肤病变分类场景中的表现。

Method: 在多个ISIC来源合并的数据集上训练一个具有共享骨干网络和两个联合学习头的模型（一个是良/恶性二分类头，一个是五分类诊断头），比较五种不确定性量化方法：MC Dropout、DropConnect、Flipout、Deep Ensembles和DUQ，从准确性、校准、不确定性分解和风险覆盖四个维度进行评估。

Result: 样本难度在很大程度上与方法无关，即使熵分布狭窄的方法也对相同样本给出相似难度排名（样本间熵相关性在0.54到0.91之间）。方法选择对校准和不确定性分解的影响更大，Deep Ensembles在此方面明显胜出。不确定性排名足够好，将最不确定的病例延迟转诊可以移除不成比例的误差比例，支持基于不确定性的选择性转诊（仅在分布内评估）。

Conclusion: Deep Ensembles在皮肤病变分类的不确定性量化中表现最佳，尤其在校准和不确定性分解方面。样本难度判别具有方法无关性，且不确定性排名可用于有效的选择性转诊以降低错误率。

Abstract: Skin lesion classifiers can be confidently wrong on the cases that matter most, so knowing when a prediction should not be trusted is clinically as useful as the prediction. We study uncertainty quantification on a dataset pooled from many ISIC sources, with a shared backbone and two jointly learned heads: a binary malignant versus non-malignant head and a five-class diagnostic head. Five UQ methods (MC Dropout, DropConnect, Flipout, Deep Ensembles, DUQ) are compared on accuracy, calibration, uncertainty decomposition, and risk-coverage. Difficulty is largely method-agnostic: even methods with narrow entropy distributions rank the same samples as hard (per-sample entropy correlations of $0.54$ to $0.91$). The choice of method matters more for calibration and uncertainty decomposition, where Deep Ensembles is the clear winner, than for finding difficult cases. The ranking is also good enough that deferring the most uncertain cases removes a disproportionate share of errors, supporting uncertainty-based selective referral, evaluated here in-distribution only.

</details>


### [226] [Artificial Intelligence as a Tool for Combating Child Labour: A Real-Time Edge Vision Pipeline for Child Detection and Age Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14770)
*Mark Nowak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个实时计算机视觉流水线（仅作为研究原型），为儿童劳动监测与补救系统（CLMRS）提供基于在场证据的连续监测通道。该流水线结合多任务人/脸检测器（CerberusDet框架中的YOLO26x骨干）、级联年龄估计（MiVOLO v2 + 0-12岁儿童专家模型）、ByteTrack跟踪、ArcFace与DINOv2重识别及轨迹级融合，生成可审查的个人记录。在津巴布韦农场的17天现场试点中，检测产量提升36倍，身份整合将过度上报从9.1倍降至1.8-3.9倍，零虚假合并。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球约有1.38亿儿童仍处于童工状态，现有基于定期家访和访谈的监测系统系统性低估了这一数字。作者旨在探索利用实时计算机视觉为CLMRS增加连续、基于在场的证据通道，以弥补传统人工监测的检测缺口。

Method: 采用CerberusDet框架中的YOLO26x骨干进行多任务人与脸检测；级联年龄估计结合MiVOLO v2和面向0-12岁儿童的专用模型；ByteTrack用于跟踪；ArcFace和DINOv2用于重识别；轨迹级融合生成可审查的个人记录。推理优化采用FP8 TensorRT编译，并在嵌入式硬件上部署。

Result: 检测器将人mAP@0.5从0.390提升至0.683；儿童专家模型在儿童验证集上MAE达1.944年（开源基线误差18-23年）；FP8 TensorRT编译带来1.77倍加速，仅增加0.002年MAE，在嵌入式硬件上达到实时两倍以上速度；26.8小时代理视频中发现634个唯一儿童候选（前代285个）；津巴布韦农场17天试点中软件调优使检测产量提升36倍，身份整合将过度上报从9.1x降至1.8-3.9x且无虚假合并。

Conclusion: 研究表明该实时视觉流水线在技术和可行性上都能显著改善儿童劳动监测，但同时也需要明确记录训练与量化失败，并建立数据保护和人机协作（human-in-the-loop）保障措施。系统目前仅作为研究原型操作，需谨慎对待部署边界。

Abstract: An estimated 138 million children remain in child labour worldwide, and the monitoring systems used by affected sectors, built on periodic household visits and interviews, systematically under-detect them. We present a real-time computer-vision pipeline, built and operated solely as a research prototype, that studies the feasibility of giving Child Labour Monitoring and Remediation Systems (CLMRS) a continuous, presence-based evidence channel. The pipeline combines a multi-task person and face detector (YOLO26x backbone in the CerberusDet framework), cascaded age estimation pairing MiVOLO v2 with a child-specialist model for ages 0-12, ByteTrack tracking, ArcFace and DINOv2 re-identification, and track-level fusion producing reviewable per-person records. The detector raises person mAP@0.5 from 0.390 to 0.683 over the previous-generation baseline; the child specialist reaches 1.944 years MAE on children-only validation, where widely used open-source stacks err by 18-23 years. FP8 TensorRT compilation yields a 1.77x speedup at +0.002 years MAE, bringing the pipeline above twice real-time on embedded hardware. On 26.8 hours of proxy video the system finds 634 unique child candidates versus 285 for its predecessor. We further report a seventeen-day unattended field pilot on a farm in Zimbabwe (38.7 million frames, six cameras) evaluated against a daily attendance register: software tuning improved detection yield 36-fold, and identity consolidation under a simultaneity veto cut over-reporting from 9.1x to 1.8-3.9x with zero proven-false merges. We document training and quantisation failures alongside successes, and the data-protection and human-in-the-loop safeguards such a system requires.

</details>


### [227] [AMPLIFAI: A Multiphase CT Dataset for Benchmarking Clinical Reasoning in LI-RADS Assessment of Liver Lesions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14778)
*Pranav Kulkarni,Nikhil Shah,Amritansh Suryavanshi,Jana Delfino,James Tonascia,Jade Wong-You-Cheong,Barton Lane,Joseph Chirico,Jeffrey D. Hirsch,Ang Li,Heng Huang,Florence X. Doo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了AMPLIFAI——首个公开的、基于LI-RADS标准标注的多期腹部CT数据集，包含LI-RADS分类和三大关键特征（动脉期高增强、廓清、增强包膜）的分割标注，以推动AI辅助肝细胞癌（HCC）的自动化诊断研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肝细胞癌是全球癌症相关死亡的第三大原因，早期检测可将生存率从20%以下提升至70%以上。LI-RADS标准提供了无活检、纯影像学的诊断框架，可作为AI自动化诊断的基础，但缺乏高质量标注的大型公开数据集，严重限制了AI模型在LI-RADS特征识别方面的发展。

Method: 创建AMPLIFAI数据集：收集多期腹部CT扫描图像，按照LI-RADS类别进行注释，并对三大LI-RADS关键特征（动脉期高增强、廓清、增强包膜）进行分割标注；采用Datasheets for Datasets格式，详细记录数据集的构成、策展流程和标注流水线。

Result: AMPLIFAI成为首个公开的多期腹部CT数据集，包含LI-RADS标注类别及三大关键特征的分割标注，为AI在HCC诊断领域的研究提供了可供复现和透明研究的公共数据资源。

Conclusion: AMPLIFAI数据集的发布将填补LI-RADS相关AI研究缺乏高质量公开数据的空白，促进可复现、透明化的研究，并有望推动AI驱动的HCC自动化诊断从理论走向临床应用。

Abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the third leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with early detection improving survival from <20\% to >70\%. The standardized LI-RADS criteria establish a biopsy-free, fully imaging-based framework that can serve as a foundation for automating HCC diagnosis with artificial intelligence (AI). However, the lack of large, publicly available datasets with high-quality labels has limited the development of AI models for LI-RADS characterization. We introduce the \textbf{AMPLIFAI} dataset, the first public dataset of multiphase abdominal CT scans annotated with LI-RADS categories and segmented for three major LI-RADS features: arterial phase hyperenhancement, washout, and enhancing capsule. Following the \emph{Datasheets for Datasets} format, this paper details the dataset's composition, curation process, and annotation pipeline to facilitate transparent, reproducible research.

</details>


### [228] [MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14783)
*Manwen Liao,Xinyu Lian,Jian Mao,Kaixu Chen,Li Luo,Jinghao Yan,Wanshui Gan,Qiao Yu,Weitian Zhang,Chunhua Shen,Guang Chen,Bo Dai,Xudong Xu,Zhaoyang Lyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MegaParts是一个可扩展的自回归3D生成框架，通过结合结构化序列建模和token高效的向量量化形状分词器，实现最多300个部件、256k token序列长度的部件感知3D生成，在网格质量和可扩展性上均优于基线的自回归和扩散模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的部件感知3D生成方法在部件数量增加时无法良好扩展，因为生成详细几何在token长度和内存上开销巨大。作者希望解决高复杂度物体的部件级3D生成可扩展性问题。

Method: 提出MegaParts框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 一个token高效的分词器，学习部件级几何的离散潜在表示，在保持高保真重建的同时最小化token使用量，实现基于几何复杂度的自适应长度分词；(2) 在该紧凑表示之上，训练一个大型语言模型在统一结构化序列中生成物体边界框、部件边界框和部件形状token。同时结合高效的长上下文训练策略。

Result: 该方法可扩展到最多300个部件和256k token序列长度，生成的网格质量优于基线自回归模型和扩散模型，证明压缩的离散部件token不仅提升了可扩展性，还提升了生成几何的保真度。

Conclusion: LLM原生的token高效自回归建模是大规模部件感知3D生成中扩散模型的有力替代方案，在保持组合结构和细粒度部件控制的同时显著扩展了生成规模。

Abstract: Part-aware 3D object generation is essential for graphics applications such as controllable modeling, editing, and articulation, where objects are represented as coherent assemblies of semantic parts. However, existing part-aware generation methods, do not scale well to highly complex objects. As the number of parts increases, generating detailed geometry becomes prohibitively expensive in token length and memory. We introduce MegaParts, a scalable autoregressive 3D generation framework to address this challenge by combining structured sequence modeling with a token-efficient vector-quantized shape tokenizer. Our tokenizer learns discrete latent representations for part-level geometry by minimizing token usage subject to high-fidelity reconstruction, enabling adaptive-length tokenization based on geometric complexity. On top of this compact representation, we train a large language model to generate object bounding boxes, part bounding boxes, and part shape tokens within a unified structured sequence. Combined with efficient long-context training strategy, our token-efficient formulation scales to objects with up to 300 parts and sequence lengths up to 256k tokens. This substantially extends the scale of part-aware 3D generation while preserving compositional structure and enabling fine-grained part-level control. Our method achieves higher mesh quality than baseline autoregressive and diffusion models, showing that compressed discrete part tokens improve not only scalability but also the achievable fidelity of generated geometry. These results suggest that LLM native token-efficient autoregressive modeling is a compelling alternative to diffusion for large-scale part-aware 3D generation. The project page is available at https://expmaster.github.io/megaparts_webpage.

</details>


### [229] [Qwen-Video-Edit: Instruction-Based Video Editing by Repurposing an Image Editing Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14790)
*Yunpeng Bai,Yossi Gandelsman,Michaël Gharbi,Qixing Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的指令式视频编辑方法，不构建视频预训练生成骨干网络，而是直接基于强图像编辑模型Qwen-Image-Edit在视频VAE潜空间上进行视频编辑。通过将Wan 2.1视频VAE的潜空间帧排列为大型虚拟图像的瓦片，并使用轻量级输入/输出投影桥接两个潜空间，在Ditto-1M数据集上微调，辅以Wan 2.2的少量去噪步骤作为时间增强器，实现了接近图像编辑水平的视频编辑效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统指令式视频编辑严重依赖视频预训练生成骨干（如视频扩散Transformer），需要高昂的成本进行视频数据适配。作者希望探索一条不同路径：利用成熟的图像编辑先验直接处理视频潜空间，从而避免大规模视频训练开销。一系列零训练观察（如图像编辑器可以直接编辑以contact sheet形式呈现的视频、对帧编码方式不敏感、零样本编辑真实视频潜空间可达可识别程度）为该设计提供了理论动机。

Method: 方法核心包括：(1) 将Wan 2.1视频VAE的潜空间帧排列为一张大型虚拟图像的瓦片（tiles）；(2) 对每个瓦片复用Qwen-Image-Edit的图像位置编码；(3) 使用从编辑器自身patchify和unpatchify层热启动（warm-start）的轻量级输入/输出投影桥接两个潜空间，确保初始化时静态视频与图像嵌入等价；(4) 在公开Ditto-1M编辑三元组上微调整个系统；(5) 使用Wan 2.2的少量去噪步骤作为可选的时间一致性增强器。

Result: 实验结果表明，在Ditto-1M微调后，系统能够进行有效的视频编辑。作者通过一系列零训练观察验证了设计合理性：图像编辑器能够零样本编辑真实视频潜空间并达到可识别程度，微调仅需弥合保真度差距。结果支持了一个关键结论：尽管视频潜空间经过大量训练，每帧视频潜空间与图像域仍足够接近，成熟的图像编辑先验可以以最小适配完成迁移。

Conclusion: 本文证明了以最少的适配即可将成熟的图像编辑先验迁移到视频编辑领域，挑战了"视频编辑必须依赖视频预训练骨干"的传统认知。该结果表明图像与视频潜空间之间的域差距比预期更小，为未来视频编辑研究提供了低成本、高效益的新方向。

Abstract: Instruction-based video editing is commonly built on video-pretrained generative backbones: a video diffusion transformer is adapted, at considerable cost, to condition on a source video and an editing instruction. In this report we explore a different route and show that a strong instruction-based image editing model can edit videos by operating directly on video-VAE latents. Starting from Qwen-Image-Edit, we arrange the latent frames of a Wan~2.1 video VAE as tiles of one large virtual image, reuse the editor's image positional encoding for every tile, and bridge the two latent spaces with a pair of lightweight input/output projections warm-started from the editor's own patchify and unpatchify layers, so that at initialization a (static) video is embedded exactly as an image the model already understands. The whole system is then fine-tuned on the public Ditto-1M editing triplets, and a few denoising steps of Wan~2.2 serve as an optional temporal enhancer. We motivate the design with a chain of zero-training observations: the stock image editor already edits a video presented as a contact sheet; it is indifferent to whether the sheet's tokens come from one joint encode or from per-frame encodes stitched in latent space; and it even edits genuine video latents zero-shot to a clearly recognizable degree, leaving fine-tuning only a fidelity gap to close. Our results suggest that, despite the large investment in training video latent spaces, per-frame video latents remain close enough to the image domain that mature image editing priors transfer with minimal adaptation. Project Page: https://yunpeng1998.github.io/Qwen-Video-Edit-Page; Code: https://github.com/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit; Model: https://huggingface.co/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit.

</details>


### [230] [Zero-Shot Adaptation of Medical Vision Foundation Models for High-Frequency Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14796)
*Ayusha Abbas,Saram Abbas,Kabita Adhikari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对微超声（29 MHz）前列腺分割的零样本流程：MedSAM基础模型结合CLAHE、二值膨胀和傅里叶平滑等后处理步骤，无需任何训练数据即可进行分割。在75例患者（2,621张切片）的测试中，该流程在20例保留测试集上将平均边界距离误差降低45%（Dice从0.749提升至0.865），分割结果与非专家评分者无显著差异，且一致性更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺癌早期发现至关重要，而精确的前列腺边界对于PSA密度计算和活检决策不可或缺。常规超声（6-12 MHz）模糊边界，会漏掉三分之一的高危癌症；虽然微超声（29 MHz）分辨率提升三倍，但其密集的声学散斑会遮挡外壁，导致两位临床医生标注的区域面积差异超过10%。有监督方法成本高且跨扫描仪泛化差，因此亟需无需训练数据即可实现精准分割的方案。

Method: 采用MedSAM作为基础模型（预训练于150万+医学图像），利用其进行前列腺定位；随后依次应用CLAHE锐化外壁、二值膨胀恢复遗漏像素、傅里叶平滑（4个模式，s=1.05）来细化边界。由于MedSAM需要空间提示，研究者评估了边界框和点点击两种提示策略，在Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation数据集的75例患者（2,621张切片）上进行验证。

Result: 在20例保留测试集上，该流程将平均边界距离误差降低45%（Dice从0.749±0.043提升至0.865±0.029；HD95从217.2±36.9降至120.1±26.1像素），整个队列的Dice达到0.859。其平均重叠与三个非专家评分组无显著差异（p>0.19），且分割一致性高出38-52%。点点击提示在所有位置均失败（最佳Dice仅0.350），原因是散斑缺乏稳定的局部对比度。

Conclusion: 仅需一个近似的边界框提示即可实现临床部署，任何诊所都无需数据收集、标注或重新训练即可使用该流程。该方法证明了基础模型在缺乏训练数据的模态下实现零样本分割的可行性和实用价值。

Abstract: Prostate cancer claims a life every 80 seconds. Early detection is needed to prevent disease progression, and both PSA density calculation and biopsy decisions rely on knowing the exact boundary of the gland. Conventional ultrasound at 6-12 MHz blurs this boundary, missing one in three high-risk cancers. Micro-ultrasound (29 MHz) improves resolution threefold but introduces dense acoustic speckle that obscures the outer wall; given the same image, two clinicians draw outlines differing by over 10% in area. Supervised methods are costly and generalise poorly across scanners. Can a foundation model segment the prostate with no training data?
  We present the first zero-shot pipeline for this modality: MedSAM, pre-trained on over 1.5 million medical images, localises the prostate; we then apply CLAHE to sharpen the outer wall, binary dilation to recover missed pixels, and Fourier smoothing (4 modes, s=1.05) to refine the boundary. MedSAM requires a spatial prompt, so we evaluate bounding-box and point-click strategies across 75 patients of the Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Segmentation dataset (2,621 slices).
  On the 20-patient held-out test set, the pipeline reduces mean boundary-distance error by 45% (Dice 0.749+/-0.043 to 0.865+/-0.029; HD95 217.2+/-36.9 to 120.1+/-26.1 px), reaching Dice 0.859 across the cohort. Its mean overlap shows no significant difference from the three non-expert rater groups (p>0.19), while segmenting 38-52% more consistently (lower inter-patient standard deviation). Point-click prompts fail regardless of placement (best Dice=0.350), because speckle gives no stable local contrast. Only an approximate bounding box is required, so any clinic can deploy it without data collection, annotation, or retraining.

</details>


### [231] [Where the Cost Falls: A Deployment-Aware Adoption Order for Stability Enhancements to Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14811)
*Rowan Hussein,Mohamed Ouf*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了CycleGAN类无配对图像翻译模型中四种增强模块（Wasserstein梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失、多尺度判别器、自注意力）的特性，指出它们在训练成本与部署成本上的分裂，并依据计算或延迟预算给出了团队采纳顺序。实验基于马到斑马任务，逐项整合并报告了失败模式、视觉检查结果及FID/KID指标，并提出了仍需补充的评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CycleGAN类模型普遍面临对抗训练震荡或崩溃、循环一致性保留粗布局但细纹理漂移、单一判别器忽略局部伪影等问题。现有四种增强方案虽被广泛采用，但大多仅以输出质量对比，很少从成本角度分析它们的资源消耗特征及其对团队采纳决策的影响。作者希望从架构成本角度为资源受限团队提供明确的采纳顺序依据。

Method: 在轻量调参的马到斑马基线模型上，逐项引入四种增强方案（Wasserstein目标+梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失、多尺度判别器、自注意力），每次以固定对照组逐项替换，最后全部组合。文中分别记录每种方案针对的失败模式及其集成方式，并通过可视化保存样本进行人工检查，同时报告组合模型的FID和KID指标。

Result: 四种增强方案按成本归属可分为两类：Wasserstein梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失和多尺度判别器仅影响训练过程，不改变部署模型；而自注意力会保留在最终生成器中，其内存随特征图尺寸平方增长，是唯一应对资源受限团队推迟采纳的组件。实验记录了基线产生的对抗崩溃与重建伪影模式，以及各变体的目检结果，组合模型给出了FID/KID指标。

Conclusion: 增强方案的成本归属由架构决定而非具体运行，这形成了一条明确的采纳顺序：在计算或延迟预算受限时，先采纳仅影响训练的三种增强（Wasserstein梯度惩罚、VGG19感知损失、多尺度判别器），将自注意力这一部署期成本较高的模块延后。作者同时指出了仍需的完整评估协议（覆盖各变体、感知相似度与下游分割）才能基于实测证据为这些增强排序。

Abstract: Teams that adopt cycle-consistent adversarial networks for unpaired image-to-image translation meet the same obstacles: adversarial training oscillates or collapses, cycle consistency preserves coarse layout while finer texture drifts, and a single discriminator judging global realism misses local artifacts. Four enhancements address these failures, and they are usually compared on output quality alone. We show that they also divide sharply by where their cost falls, and that this division, which follows from the architecture and not from any particular run, yields an adoption order for teams under a compute or latency budget. A Wasserstein objective with gradient penalty, a VGG19 perceptual loss on the cycle reconstruction, and multi-scale discriminators change training only, so a team can adopt or drop them without altering what ships. Self-attention alone persists into the deployed generator, with memory growing as the square of the feature-map size, which makes it the one component a resource-constrained team should defer. We integrate all four onto a lightly tuned baseline for horse-to-zebra translation, introduced one at a time on a fixed control and then combined, and for each we give the failure mode it targets and how it integrates. We document the collapse and reconstruction-artifact modes the baseline produced, report what visual inspection of saved samples showed for each variant, and report Fréchet Inception Distance and Kernel Inception Distance for the combined model. We specify the protocol still needed, covering the individual variants, perceptual similarity, and downstream segmentation, to rank these enhancements on measured evidence.

</details>


### [232] [OvDSGG: End-to-End Open-Vocabulary Dynamic Scene Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14835)
*John Helsby,Yi Yang,Bodo Rosenhahn,Michael Ying Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OvDSGG，首个端到端的开放词汇动态场景图生成框架，基于开放词汇的Spatial Backbone和Temporal Backbone构建，并引入Triplet Feature Extraction Module和Visual-Language Alignment Module，在不使用昂贵知识蒸馏的情况下实现开放词汇识别。在基于Action Genome构建的开放词汇基准上大幅超越基线，同时在闭集DSGG上与SOTA相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的端到端动态场景图生成（DSGG）方法是闭集方法，只能识别固定训练词汇表中的对象和谓词，且难以处理稀有概念的长尾分布问题，限制了其实际应用。已有的开放词汇方法通常继承预训练大语言模型，导致多阶段训练和推理且成本高昂。因此需要一种端到端的开放词汇DSGG框架。

Method: OvDSGG由三部分组成：开放词汇的Spatial Backbone和Temporal Backbone作为基础架构；提出的Triplet Feature Extraction Module用于桥接两个backbone以提取三元组特征；提出的Visual-Language Alignment Module在联合视觉-语言特征空间中学习自适应决策边界，从而无需昂贵的知识蒸馏即可保留开放词汇识别能力。此外，作者基于Action Genome构建了一个严格的开放词汇DSGG基准，包含对象和谓词的不相交Base/Novel划分。

Result: OvDSGG在所有指标上显著优于开放词汇基线，zero-shot Recall@K分数比次优基线高出10.0至20.4个百分点；在闭集DSGG上与现有最先进模型保持竞争力。代码和基准已公开。

Conclusion: OvDSGG验证了端到端开放词汇动态场景图生成的可行性，通过创新的模块设计避免了昂贵的大语言模型蒸馏，在开放词汇性能上取得大幅提升，同时不损失闭集性能，为该领域提供了新的方向和高标准的基准。

Abstract: Dynamic scene graphs (DSGs) capture spatio-temporal interactions across videos as $\langle$subject, predicate, object$\rangle$ triplets, and underpin downstream tasks such as video captioning, video question answering, and action analysis. However, end-to-end dynamic scene graph generation (DSGG) methods are closed-set: they recognize only objects and predicates from a fixed training vocabulary and struggle with the long-tailed distribution of rare concepts, severely limiting their real-world applicability. Existing open-vocabulary models typically inherit pretrained large language models, resulting in multi-stage training and inference with substantial cost. We introduce OvDSGG, the first end-to-end framework for open-vocabulary DSGG. OvDSGG builds on top of an open-vocabulary Spatial Backbone and a Temporal Backbone; we further propose a Triplet Feature Extraction Module that bridges them, and a Visual-Language Alignment Module that preserves open-vocabulary recognition by learning an adaptive decision boundary in the joint visual-language feature space, without expensive knowledge distillation in existing methods. We further introduce a rigorous open-vocabulary DSGG benchmark adapted from Action Genome, with disjoint Base/Novel splits for both objects and predicates. OvDSGG significantly outperforms open-vocabulary baselines across all metrics, with zero-shot Recall@$K$ scores 10.0--20.4 percentage point higher than the next-best baseline, while on closed-set DSGG remaining competitive with state-of-the-art models. Code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/jhelsby/OvDSGG/.

</details>


### [233] [Zero-MELO: Test-Time Evidence Calibration with Multimodal LLMs for Zero-Shot Micro-Gesture Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14854)
*Chengyan Wang,Hanliang Xie,Yueyi Yang,Haoyu Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为Zero-MELO的测试时证据校准框架，用于提升多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在微手势识别（MGR）任务上的表现。该框架通过树搜索机制逐步获取局部细粒度视觉证据，并结合测试时校准模块缓解语言和外观引起的分数偏差，最终通过多线索融合模块整合证据。在iMiGUE和MA-52数据集上分别达到26.84%和22.10%的平均类别准确率，显著优于Qwen2.5-VL基线（16.15%和10.20%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs在通用视频理解中表现优异，但在微手势识别这类细粒度、运动密集的任务上能力有限。微手势是短时、局部化、细微的人体运动，是隐性情感分析的关键线索，但常被常见的提示方式忽略。现有MGR研究多为辨别式方法，MLLMs在该任务上探索不足且性能差。作者假设MLLMs的运动敏感表征能力受限于其单次前向推理，可通过精心设计的测试时引导得到增强。

Method: 作者在负对数似然（NLL）空间中诊断零样本MGR错误，发现MLLMs存在两个瓶颈：1）局部证据不足；2）由语言和运动无关外观导致的严重分数偏差。据此提出测试时证据校准框架，包含三个模块：树搜索机制（逐步获取局部细粒度视觉证据）、测试时校准模块（缓解分数偏差）、多线索融合模块（整合多源证据而不依赖单一线索进行最终预测）。

Result: 在iMiGUE上达到26.84%的平均类别准确率，在MA-52上达到22.10%，显著优于Qwen2.5-VL基线的16.15%和10.20%。

Conclusion: 通过测试时证据校准，可以有效增强MLLMs在微手势识别等运动敏感任务上的能力，验证了单次前向推理限制了MLLMs运动表征能力的假设，并为细粒度视频理解提供了新的测试时推理范式。

Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general video understanding, their capability in fine-grained and motion-centric tasks remains limited. This limitation is particularly critical in micro-gesture recognition (MGR), where micro-gestures (MGs) - subtle, short-duration, and spatially localized human movements - serve as key discriminative signals for implicit affective analysis, yet are easily neglected following common prompting practices. Although MGR has been intensively studied by many discriminative approaches, the use of MLLMs for MGR is underexplored, with notably poor performance. We hypothesize that the motion-sensitive representation ability of MLLMs is constrained by their inherent single-pass forward inference, which can be substantially enhanced through carefully designed test-time guidance. Motivated by this, building on our prior findings regarding temporal insensitivity in Video LLMs, we diagnose zero-shot MGR errors in the Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) space. We observe that MLLMs suffer from two bottlenecks: 1) insufficient localized evidence and 2) severe score biases driven by language and motion-agnostic appearances. Thus, we propose a novel test-time evidence calibration framework that improves both reasoning details and prediction reliability. Specifically, we introduce a tree search mechanism to progressively acquire localized, fine-grained visual evidence, coupled with a test-time calibration module to mitigate score biases. The multi-cue fusion module then integrates evidence from multiple cues without relying on a single cue for final prediction. Our framework achieves mean-class accuracies of 26.84\% on iMiGUE and 22.10\% on MA-52, significantly outperforming the Qwen2.5-VL baseline, which produces 16.15\% and 10.20\%, respectively. The code will be available at https://zero-melo.github.io/Zero-MELO.

</details>


### [234] [Beam-Wise Statistical Background Subtraction for Static Roadside LiDAR: A Cross-Sensor Benchmark Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14868)
*Alexander Baumann,Marcel Vosshans,Thao Dang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向静态路侧LiDAR的波束级统计背景减除比较基准，引入了新的多LiDAR数据集HighwayScene并扩展了CoopScenes数据集，证明波束级统计建模结合空间一致性滤波在跨传感器场景下具有鲁棒性和实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路侧LiDAR感知中的背景减除是关键预处理步骤，但现有研究缺乏跨传感器的系统性评估和可复现的静态路侧LiDAR实验，亟需一个统一的比较基准来验证方法的泛化能力。

Method: 将背景估计形式化为逐波束的时间建模问题，研究了捕获主模态和多样模态背景结构的互补统计策略，并结合角度域和3D域的空间滤波；提出了HighwayScene多LiDAR数据集，并扩展了CoopScenes数据集的静态/动态点级标注。

Result: 在多场景和异构传感技术上的实验表明，波束级统计建模提供鲁棒且可迁移的解决方案；轻量级逐波束模型结合空间一致性滤波显著提升了精确率，同时保持高召回率和实时处理能力。

Conclusion: 波束级统计背景减除是一种跨传感器可迁移的鲁棒方案，轻量模型与空间滤波结合在精度和实时性之间取得了良好平衡；数据集、标注和实现均已公开，为后续研究提供可复现基准。

Abstract: Background subtraction is a key preprocessing step for infrastructure-based LiDAR perception, enabling efficient isolation of dynamic traffic participants without semantic annotations. However, systematic cross-sensor evaluations and reproducible studies for static roadside LiDAR are missing. This paper presents a comparative benchmark of beam-wise statistical background subtraction for statically mounted LiDAR sensors. We formulate background estimation as a per-beam temporal modeling problem and investigate complementary statistical strategies that capture dominant as well as multi-modal background structures, combined with spatial filtering in the angular and 3D domain. To enable reproducible evaluation, we introduce HighwayScene, a new multi-LiDAR dataset recorded in a static roadside setup, and extend the public CoopScenes dataset with static/dynamic point-wise annotations. Across multiple scenes and heterogeneous sensing technologies, we demonstrate that beam-wise statistical modeling provides a robust and transferable solution. Combining lightweight per-beam models with spatial consistency filtering substantially improves precision while maintaining high recall and real-time capability. All datasets, annotations, and implementations are publicly released.

</details>


### [235] [SpIn-ViT: Designing a Sparsity-Induced Vision Transformer That Is Mechanistically Interpretable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14922)
*Philip H. Lee,Parth Padalkar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpIn-ViT框架，联合端到端训练预训练ViT和改良的稀疏自编码器（SAE），将稀疏patch级表示直接与图像分类目标对齐，在九个基准上相比SOTA后验SAE方法取得更高的分类准确率、AI和人类评估可解释性分数，并能提取更紧凑的神经符号规则集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后验SAE是在ViT优化完成后于冻结表示上训练的，其潜在特征与下游分类目标不对齐，导致可解释特征与任务目标脱节。

Method: SpIn-ViT框架联合训练预训练ViT与改良SAE，端到端地将稀疏patch级表示直接与图像分类目标对齐，学习语义连贯、能定位有意义图像区域的神经元激活，并通过SAE神经元提取可解释规则集构建神经符号模型。

Result: 在九个图像分类基准上，相比SOTA后验SAE方法：分类准确率平均提升8.84%，AI可解释性分数提升近4倍，人类评估分数提升超过2倍；神经符号模型平均准确率提升5.97%，同时规则集缩小58.8%。

Conclusion: 联合训练策略能有效弥合稀疏特征表示与分类目标之间的对齐鸿沟，在保持竞争力的同时大幅提升可解释性，并生成更紧凑有效的神经符号规则集。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has recently expanded to Vision Transformers (ViTs), with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) increasingly used as post-hoc tools to decompose internal representations into sparse and more interpretable features. However, because post-hoc SAEs are trained on frozen representations after the ViT has already been optimized, their latent features are not directly aligned with the downstream classification objective. We introduce SpIn-ViT, a framework that jointly trains a pretrained ViT and a modified SAE end-to-end, directly aligning sparse patch-level representations with image classification. SpIn-ViT learns semantically coherent neuron activations that localize meaningful image regions while maintaining competitive predictive performance. We evaluate SpIn-ViT across nine image-classification benchmarks using classification accuracy, quantitative interpretability metrics, AI-based and Human evaluations. Compared with the previous state-of-the-art post-hoc SAE method, SpIn-ViT achieves 8.84% higher average classification accuracy, an AI-based interpretability score nearly four times as high, and a human-evaluation score more than twice as high. We further extract interpretable rule-sets using the SAE neurons to create neurosymbolic models which achieve 5.97% higher average classification accuracy while requiring a 58.8\% smaller rule-set than the neurosymbolic models created from the SOTA post-hoc SAE method.

</details>


### [236] [PaSTel: Anchoring Histology in Spatial Transcriptomics via Multi-Scale Hierarchical Bio-Prior Contrastive Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14924)
*Azim Dehghani Amirabad,Junchao Zhu,Pushpak Pati,Walid Abdelmoula,Tommaso Mansi,Rui Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PaSTel是一个分层多模态预训练框架，通过在点水平（TF-IDF重加权识别空间信息基因）、功能水平（KEGG通路锚定全局生物学语义）和区域水平（空间聚类建模中尺度组织结构）三个层面整合生物学先验，解决了空间转录组学中现有方法的两大局限（管家基因主导导致判别性弱、独立点-斑块对齐无法捕捉空间依赖），在多项下游任务中一致优于现有视觉和视觉组学编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间转录组学将组织形态与分子程序联系起来，推动了将组织学图像与基因表达对齐的多模态预训练方法。然而现有方法存在两个关键局限：空间信息基因选择常被管家基因主导，导致表示判别性弱；独立的点-斑块（spot-patch）对齐无法捕捉对组织结构至关重要的空间依赖关系。

Method: PaSTel采用分层多模态预训练框架，在三个层面整合生物学先验：1）点水平（spot level）：使用TF-IDF重加权识别空间信息基因；2）功能水平（functional level）：利用KEGG通路作为锚点编码全局生物学语义；3）区域水平（regional level）：通过空间聚类聚合邻近点，建模中尺度组织结构。

Result: 在多项下游任务中，PaSTel一致优于现有的视觉和视觉组学编码器，证明整合多尺度生物学先验能产生更具信息性和可迁移性的空间转录组学表示。

Conclusion: PaSTel证明了在空间转录组多模态预训练中引入多尺度生物学先验的有效性，为获得更丰富、更具迁移能力的组织表征提供了新思路。

Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) links tissue morphology with molecular programs, motivating multimodal pretraining methods that align histology images with gene expression. However, existing approaches suffer from two key limitations: spatially informative gene selection is often dominated by ubiquitous housekeeping genes, leading to weakly discriminative representations, and independent spot-patch alignment fails to capture spatial dependencies that are critical for tissue organization. To address these challenges, we introduce PaSTel, a hierarchical multimodal pretraining framework that integrates biological priors at three levels. At the spot level, TF-IDF reweighting is used to identify spatially informative genes; at the functional level, curated KEGG pathways serve as anchors for encoding global biological semantics; and at the regional level, spatial clustering aggregates neighboring spots to model meso-scale tissue structure. Across multiple downstream tasks, PaSTel consistently outperforms existing vision and vision-omics encoders, demonstrating that incorporating multiscale biological priors yields more informative and transferable representations for spatial transcriptomics.

</details>


### [237] [Looks Can be Deceiving: Annotator and Reviewer Performance Across Imagery Sources in Crowd-Sourced Aerial Damage Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14942)
*Thomas Manzini,Priyankari Perali,Raisa Karnik,Stephen Johnson,Robin R. Murphy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次实证研究了多源遥感影像（无人机、载人航空、卫星）中标注者与审核者的表现差异，发现低分辨率影像残留更多标注分歧，并提出多源数据集策展的适应性质量控制建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有航拍影像数据集多依赖单一来源影像，缺乏多来源大规模航拍数据集中如何高效分配人工标注劳动力的成熟实践方案，本研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 基于一个包含9场灾害的后灾建筑损伤评估数据集，覆盖无人机（20041栋）、载人航空（20695栋）和卫星（33392栋）影像，187名标注者完成初始标注后，依次经过单人审核和共识委员会审核两阶段，对标注者与审核者的表现进行系统性实证分析。

Result: 初始标注被最终委员会修订的比例随分辨率降低而急剧上升（载人航空25.27%，卫星36.95%），且在各工作流程阶段保持相同排序；单人审核后，委员会仍分别修订了6.85%的无人机、14.05%的载人航空和20.86%的卫星标注，表明统一审核分配方式在低分辨率影像上留有最多残留分歧。

Conclusion: 本文基于实证证据并结合自适应任务分配与预算感知质量控制的相关工作，为多来源数据集策展提出三项建议，主张应根据影像来源或分辨率差异采用非均匀的审核资源分配策略。

Abstract: This paper presents the first known empirical investigation of annotator and reviewer performance across multi-source remotely sensed imagery, evaluating human labeling across drone, crewed aviation, and satellite views. Because existing aerial imagery datasets rely predominantly on single-source imagery, there is no currently established state of practice for efficiently allocating human labor to curate large-scale, multi-source aerial datasets. This work addresses this limitation by analyzing annotator and reviewer performance within a post-disaster building damage assessment dataset of 9 disasters, where 20041 buildings in drone, 20695 buildings in crewed aviation, and 33392 buildings in satellite imagery were labeled. These labels, provided by 187 annotators, were then refined through two successive quality-control stages: a single-reviewer pass followed by a consensus-committee review. Our analysis reveals two findings that raise questions for standard crowd-sourcing practices. First, initial annotations were revised by the final committee at rates that rise steeply from higher- to lower-resolution sources (25.27% for crewed aviation and 36.95% for satellite), with the same ordering at every observed workflow stage. Second, a single individual review reduced but did not resolve this disagreement: after review, the committee still revised 6.85% of drone, 14.05% of crewed, and 20.86% of satellite labels. These observations suggest that, in workflows like this one, uniform review allocation leaves the most residual disagreement in lower-resolution imagery. Based on this evidence, and consistent with prior work on adaptive task assignment and budget-aware quality control, this paper offers three recommendations for multi-source dataset curation.

</details>


### [238] [Benchmarking Frontier Text-to-Image Models on Image-Description Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14976)
*Sajjad Abdoli,Ghassan Al-Sumaidaee,Ahmed Rashad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文评估了四款生产级文生图系统（Hunyuan 3.0、Gemini 3 Pro Image、FLUX.2、Ideogram 3.0）在48个最具挑战性的复杂组合性提示词上的表现，采用自动化复杂度评分从DataSeeds.AI数据集中筛选提示，并使用GPT-5.4-Pro生成本体性加权MECE评估细则、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview进行独立判定。结果显示Gemini 3 Pro Image以84.8/100位居第一，FLUX.2以82.3/100紧随其后，Ideogram 3.0和Hunyuan 3.0分别得分65.7和63.3。失败分析表明领先系统主要因物体计数错误和几何伪影失分，落后系统更常产生乱码文本和遗漏元素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文生图模型的评估通常基于平均难度的提示词，这掩盖了系统在复杂组合性请求（如精确物体计数、多物体属性绑定、可读嵌入文本、显式空间约束）上的真实差距。为了更准确地揭示生产级系统的能力差异，需要对最具挑战性的提示进行系统评估。

Method: 从DataSeeds.AI Sample Dataset（DSD）中通过自动化复杂度评分选出48个最难的提示词；GPT-5.4-Pro构建原子化、加权、互斥且穷尽（MECE）的评估细则；Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview独立判定每条标准是否满足；对四款系统生成的每张图片进行独立评委评分，并辅以失败归因分析。

Result: Gemini 3 Pro Image以84.8/100排名第一，FLUX.2以82.3/100紧随其后，Ideogram 3.0和Hunyuan 3.0分别得65.7/100和63.3/100。领先系统主要因物体计数错误和几何伪影扣分；落后系统则更多出现乱码文本，Ideogram 3.0还频繁遗漏请求的元素。

Conclusion: 在最具挑战性的组合性提示下，生产级文生图系统之间存在显著性能差距，且不同系统表现出不同的失败模式。评估框架及完整数据可供学术与工业界参考，有助于针对性地改进复杂指令遵循能力。

Abstract: Text-to-image models are typically reported on average-case prompts, which understates the gap between systems on compositionally demanding requests involving precise object counts, multi-object attribute binding, legible embedded text, and explicit spatial constraints. We evaluate four production text-to-image systems: Hunyuan 3.0, Gemini 3 Pro Image ("Nano Banana Pro"), Black Forest Labs FLUX.2, and Ideogram 3.0. The evaluation uses the 48 hardest prompts drawn from the DataSeeds.AI Sample Dataset (DSD), selected through an automated complexity-scoring pass over the full corpus. Every generated image is graded using an independent-judge rubric. GPT-5.4-Pro authors an atomic, weighted, mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive (MECE) evaluation rubric, while Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview independently determines whether each criterion is satisfied. Gemini 3 Pro Image ranks first with a score of 84.8/100, narrowly ahead of FLUX.2 at 82.3/100. Ideogram 3.0 and Hunyuan 3.0 score 65.7/100 and 63.3/100, respectively. Failure analysis shows that the leading systems primarily lose points through object miscounting and geometric artifacts, whereas the trailing systems more frequently produce garbled text. Ideogram 3.0 also frequently omits requested elements. Full per-sample rubrics, scores, and failure annotations are available from the authors upon request.

</details>


### [239] [Risk-Adaptive Edge--Cloud Visual Reasoning for Communication-Efficient Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14991)
*Meng Ma,Shuyang Li,Naigang Wang,Ruimin Ke*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种风险自适应的边缘-云端架构，通过车载交通评估决定何时请求云端视觉语言模型（VLM）推理。在CARLA实验中，该方法在保持任务成功率的同时，将云端请求减少54.1%，并减少了AEB自动紧急制动激活次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云端VLM具有更强的上下文推理能力，但频繁上传视觉数据会增加通信开销，并引入网络和推理延迟，影响战术决策的实时性。需要一种机制在本地保守响应与云端推理之间取得平衡。

Method: 提出风险自适应边缘-云端架构：机载VLM与轻量级检测器共同捕捉实时交通状况和路径相关危险，用于保守的本地响应和选择性云端访问。云端模型提供战术建议，但验证、车辆控制和自动紧急制动保持本地执行。

Result: 在CARLA实验中：匹配周期性云端访问的任务成功率，云端请求减少54.1%，AEB激活次数更少；在延迟道路施工消融中，语义事件在计划审计之前触发请求；在三种模拟网络配置下仍减少云端流量，但车道变更比周期访问耗时更长。

Conclusion: 机载交通评估可作为选择性VLM推理的有效触发机制，在保障安全性的同时显著降低云端通信开销，验证了风险自适应边缘-云架构在实际自动驾驶场景中的可行性。

Abstract: Cloud-hosted vision-language models (VLMs) offer greater contextual reasoning capabilities than smaller onboard models, but frequent visual uploads increase communication overhead and add network and inference latency to tactical decisions. We present a risk-adaptive edge-cloud architecture in which onboard traffic assessment determines when cloud reasoning is requested. An onboard VLM and a lightweight detector capture temporal traffic conditions and path-relative hazards for conservative local response and selective cloud access. The cloud model provides tactical advice, while validation, vehicle control, and automatic emergency braking remain local. In CARLA experiments, our method matched the task success rate of periodic cloud access while reducing cloud requests by 54.1% and recording fewer automatic emergency braking (AEB) activations. In a delayed-roadwork ablation, semantic events triggered requests before the next scheduled audit. Across three emulated network profiles, the method continued to reduce cloud traffic, although lane changes took longer than with periodic access. Onboard traffic assessment therefore served as a practical trigger for selective VLM inference in these experiments.

</details>


### [240] [Registration-Free Hyperspectral Reconstruction from RGB via a Permutation-Invariant Gram-Matrix Principle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14994)
*Jiangsan Zhao,Masayuki Hirafuji,Seishi Ninomiya,Jakob Geipel,Wei Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Reconstructing a spatially and spectrally high-resolution hyperspectral image (HR-HSI) from a low-resolution HSI (LR-HSI) and a high-resolution RGB image (HR-RGB) usually assumes precise registration and a known camera response function (CRF). Both assumptions are difficult to satisfy with different sensors. We remove both through a permutation-invariant supervision principle: the Gram matrix of an unmixed abundance map depends on shared material composition but not on pixel ordering. Matching abundance Gram matrices therefore allows RGB-to-HSI mapping to be learned without spatial correspondence and without a predefined CRF. Under a full random permutation of HR-RGB pixels, a state-of-the-art fusion method collapses, whereas our reconstruction is unchanged after inverse reindexing for evaluation. Building on this principle, a residual spectral super-resolution function maps HR-RGB directly to HR-HSI without registration, known CRF, or paired supervision. Across indoor, natural-scene, and remote-sensing benchmarks, the method achieves accuracy comparable to approaches that require these assumptions while remaining robust when they are violated. Loss ablations further show that reconstruction accuracy is largely insensitive to the specific discrepancy used to match the Gram matrices, indicating that performance arises primarily from the permutation-invariant principle rather than loss tuning.

</details>


### [241] [FZ-VLM: A Two Stage Florence-Zephyr Vision Language Model Framework for Pulmonary Nodule Characterization and Clinical Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15004)
*Pramit Dutta,Jenita Manokaran,Richa Mittal,Ryan Appleby,Eranga Ukwatta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出FZ-VLM，一个两阶段Florence-Zephyr视觉语言模型框架，用于肺癌CT图像中肺结节的统一结构化表征。第一阶段使用微调的Florence-2模型从专家标注的二维轴向CT切片中提取放射学属性（解剖位置、直径、边缘特征、衰减类型），第二阶段使用Zephyr-7B模型基于这些属性生成结节描述、随访建议和纵向分析。实验结果显示第一阶段模型在多个属性上优于GPT-4基线和人工基线，第二阶段经放射科专家评估获得高准确率、完整性和临床相关性评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，CT是筛查和随访的主要影像工具。肺结节检测后，放射科医生需手动评估解剖位置、直径、边缘特征和衰减类型以支持风险评估和临床决策，但该流程耗时且受观察者间差异影响。现有AI方法多聚焦于孤立任务，缺乏统一且具有临床依据的解读框架。

Method: FZ-VLM采用两阶段架构：第一阶段使用微调的Florence-2模型从专家标注的2D轴向CT切片提取放射学属性（解剖位置、直径、边缘特征、衰减类型）；第二阶段使用Zephyr-7B模型基于提取的属性生成结节描述、随访建议和纵向分析。该方法将视觉特征提取与语言生成解耦，实现结构化的临床决策支持。

Result: 第一阶段模型在解剖位置上达到77.18%准确率，边缘特征67.96%，衰减类型79.13%，直径估计MAE为2.58mm，均优于GPT-4基线和人工基线。第二阶段经放射科专家评估获得93.9%准确率、98.6%完整性评分、76.1%临床相关性，综合评分89.5%。安全性分析显示大多数输出临床安全，但部分随访建议仍需专家审查。

Conclusion: 这是首个两阶段视觉语言模型框架用于肺结节结构化表征和临床决策支持。该框架展示了VLM在统一肺结节表征方面的潜力，优于GPT-4和人类基线。尽管结果令人鼓舞，但部分随访建议仍需人工专家审查，提示该技术在完全临床部署前仍需进一步完善安全性。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and Computed Tomography (CT) is a primary imaging tool for screening and followup assessment. After pulmonary nodule detection, radiologists manually assess anatomical location, diameter, margin characteristics, and attenuation type to support risk assessment and clinical decision-making. However, this post-detection workflow is time-consuming and can be affected by inter-observer variability. Existing Artificial Intelligence methods often focus on isolated tasks, limiting their use as a unified, clinically grounded interpretation framework. This study presents FZ-VLM, a two-stage Florence-Zephyr Vision Language Model framework for unified structured pulmonary nodule characterization in lung CT. The framework uses a fine-tuned Florence-2 model to extract radiological attributes from expert-annotated 2D axial CT slices, while a Zephyr-7B model uses these attributes to generate nodule descriptions, follow-up recommendations, and longitudinal analyses. Results showed that the Stage 1 model achieved 77.18\% accuracy for anatomical location, 67.96\% accuracy for margin characteristics, and 79.13\% accuracy for attenuation type, with a Mean Absolute Error of 2.58 mm for diameter estimation, outperforming evaluated GPT-4-based baselines as well as the human baseline. Expert radiologist evaluation of Stage 2 showed 93.9\% accuracy, 98.6\% completeness score, 76.1\% clinical relevance, and an overall score of 89.5\%. Safety analysis showed that most outputs were clinically safe, although some follow-up recommendations still required expert review. To the best of our knowledge, this study presents the first two-stage Vision-Language Model framework for structured nodule characterization and clinical decision-making.

</details>


### [242] [MetaReason: Precise Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning via Editing Meta Information for Solving Geometry Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15006)
*Penghao Yin,Haomin Wang,Qihong Tang,Xiaoye Qu,Hongjie Zhang,Xiao-Ping Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MetaReason框架，利用结构化元信息实现平面几何多模态推理中的辅助线构造，并构建TutorGeo数据集（17k图像到元信息转换样本、60k纯文本推理轨迹、60k交错多模态推理轨迹）和ExamGeo基准，显著优于现有开源模型且与专有模型性能相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在复杂几何任务中过度依赖纯文本推理，虽有方法引入中间视觉状态但受限于几何表示不准确和渲染保真度低，导致输出不可靠。需要一种能够生成高保真中间视觉状态的方法来解决这一问题。

Method: MetaReason框架包含三个步骤：(1) 将几何图像解析为结构化元信息；(2) 使用预定义工具对元信息进行可控编辑，合成高保真的中间视觉状态；(3) 基于增强的视图进行推理。训练阶段使用TutorGeo数据集结合监督微调和强化学习来开发鲁棒的多模态推理能力，并构建ExamGeo基准用于系统性评估。

Result: 实验结果表明MetaReason显著优于现有开源模型，并在性能上与专有模型（如GPT-4等闭源模型）达到竞争性水平。

Conclusion: 通过利用结构化元信息和合成高保真视觉状态，MetaReason有效解决了现有方法中几何表示不准确和渲染保真度低的问题，为平面几何多模态推理提供了一种可靠且有效的框架。

Abstract: Although visual reasoning is crucial for solving complex geometry tasks, existing vision-language models rely heavily on text-only reasoning. Some recent methods introduce intermediate visual states to facilitate reasoning, but they are often hindered by inaccurate geometric representations and low rendering fidelity, ultimately leading to unreliable outputs. To address these limitations, we propose MetaReason, a framework for multimodal reasoning in plane geometry that leverages structured meta-information to enable accurate auxiliary-line construction. The framework first parses geometric images into meta-information, performs controllable edits with predefined tools to synthesize high-fidelity visual states, and then conducts reasoning based on these augmented views. To support this framework, we construct TutorGeo, a comprehensive dataset containing 17k image-to-meta conversion samples, 60k text-only reasoning traces, and 60k interleaved multimodal reasoning traces. Using this dataset, we combine supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to develop robust multimodal reasoning capabilities. We also introduce ExamGeo, a benchmark derived from real-world examination problems that enables systematic evaluation across varying difficulty levels. Experimental results demonstrate that MetaReason significantly outperforms existing open-source models and achieves competitive performance against proprietary models.

</details>


### [243] [DualMiT-Net: Local-Global Transformer-Convolutional Fusion for Breast Mass Segmentation in Mammographic Regions of Interest](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15019)
*Alibek Kamiluly,Milana Muratova,Yash Patel,Fan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DualMiT-Net，一种双支路网络用于乳腺肿块分割，结合局部肿块视图（MiT-B5编码器）与全局周围组织视图（EfficientNet-B5编码器），通过空间门控制全局信息融合。在CBIS-DDSM数据集上达到0.9375的Dice系数和0.8834的IoU，优于六种标准编码器-解码器基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乳腺肿块分割在计算机辅助乳腺X线摄影中至关重要，但由于肿块对比度低、形状不规则、边界与周围乳腺组织融合，分割难度大。需要同时利用局部肿块信息和更广泛的周围组织上下文来提升分割准确性。

Method: 构建双支路网络：局部支路使用Mix Transformer (MiT-B5)编码器学习肿块的形状、纹理和边界信息；全局支路使用EfficientNet-B5编码器学习周围乳腺组织上下文。两支路在深层编码器级别共享特征，随后在单一解码器中逐步融合，并采用空间门控制解码过程中全局信息的加入。输入表示采用百分位窗口化乳腺X线图像结合Gabor纹理响应，共评估了四种输入表示。使用CBIS-DDSM肿块子集，按患者级别划分进行训练和评估，并采用指数移动平均权重。

Result: 在三次训练运行中，DualMiT-Net配合EMA权重取得了平均Dice系数0.9375和平均IoU 0.8834。在相同数据和训练设置下，其Dice和IoU均优于六种标准编码器-解码器基线模型。

Conclusion: 将局部肿块信息与更广泛的乳腺上下文相结合，能够实现准确且一致的乳腺肿块分割，验证了双支路融合架构在这一任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Breast mass segmentation is an important step in computer-aided mammography, but it remains difficult because masses can have low contrast, irregular shapes, and boundaries that blend with surrounding breast tissue. To address this problem, we present DualMiT-Net, a dual-branch network that uses both a focused view of the mass and a wider view of the surrounding tissue. The local branch uses a Mix Transformer (MiT-B5) encoder to learn mass shape, texture, and boundary information, while the global branch uses an EfficientNet-B5 encoder to learn surrounding breast context. Features from the two branches are shared at the deeper encoder levels and are then progressively fused in a single decoder. A spatial gate controls how much global information is added during decoding. We also evaluated four input representations and selected a percentile-windowed mammogram combined with a Gabor texture response. The model was trained and evaluated on the mass subset of the Curated Breast Imaging Subset of the Digital Database for Screening Mammography (CBIS-DDSM) using a patient-level split. Across three training runs, DualMiT-Net with exponential moving average weights achieved a mean Dice coefficient of 0.9375 and a mean Intersection over Union of 0.8834. It also achieved better Dice and IoU scores than six standard encoder-decoder baselines trained using the same data and training settings. These results show that combining local mass information with wider breast context can provide accurate and consistent breast mass segmentation.

</details>


### [244] [Geometry-Calibrated Closed-Form Shrinkage for SAR Despeckling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15028)
*Xuran Hu,Mingzhe Zhu,Djordje Stanković,Yujie Zhu,Zhenpeng Feng,Yifang Ban,Ljubiša Stanković*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个确定性、无需训练、无迭代的SAR去斑估计器。通过重新审视非局部稀疏估计器（log-Yeo-Johnson变换+相似块分组+左奇异基编码+系数收缩），证明三个通常被视为可调的超参数实际上由构造决定：组字典是正交的使加权Lasso有精确闭式解；字典来自噪声组自身使正则化常数可通过随机矩阵论进行几何校准；奇异投影使系数噪声近似高斯。该方法无需任何调参，在24项PSNR/SSIM对比中18项排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAR去斑是一个乘性非高斯噪声下的逆恢复问题，现有方法通常依赖多个需要人工调参的超参数（如收缩尺度、块大小、组大小），这些参数的选择缺乏理论基础且在不同图像/传感器间难以泛化。作者希望找出这些参数之间的内在耦合关系，消除经验调参。

Method: 重新分析非局部稀疏估计器的三个环节：(1) 证明组字典因构造而正交，加权Lasso退化为精确的逐系数软阈值解，两个加权矩阵实为单一阈值场的分子分母；(2) 利用随机矩阵理论，证明字典从含噪组自身估计时保留子空间吸收斑点的程度与组纵横比γ=p²/K成比例，据此将正则化常数转换为几何校准修正，将块大小、组大小与收缩尺度合并为一个解析确定的自由度；(3) 通过奇异投影使系数噪声在任意look数下近似高斯，确定精确斑似然失效的临界点。

Result: 该估计器是确定性的、无需训练，对每幅图像和传感器应用同一组解析确定的设置。在三个合成基准上对12种已发表方法进行的24项PSNR/SSIM比较中排名第一18项；在来自5个传感器的6个真实SAR配置中取得比值图像与理论斑点模型的最小平均偏差。

Conclusion: 通过揭示非局部稀疏估计器内部结构的三重约束（正交性、几何校准、近似高斯化），实现了零调参的闭式SAR去斑方法，兼具理论严谨性与实际最优性能，并开源代码。

Abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) despeckling is an inverse-recovery problem in which multiplicative non-Gaussian noise must be suppressed without erasing scattering structures. We revisit a nonlocal sparse estimator that applies a log--Yeo--Johnson transformation, stacks similar patches into groups, codes each group on its own left singular basis, and shrinks the resulting coefficients. Three quantities usually treated as tunable are shown to be fixed by this construction. First, the group dictionary is orthonormal, so the weighted Lasso admits an exact coefficient-wise soft-threshold solution: the iterative inner solver is unnecessary, and the two apparent weighting matrices are the numerator and denominator of a single threshold field rather than independent modules. Second, because the dictionary is estimated from the noisy group itself, its retained subspace absorbs speckle in proportion to the group aspect ratio $γ=p^2/K$; a random-matrix argument converts the corresponding regularization constant into a geometry-calibrated correction and collapses patch size, group size, and shrinkage scale into one analytically determined degree of freedom.
