Third, singular projection makes the coefficient noise nearly Gaussian at every tested look number, which locates the point at which an exact speckle likelihood ceases to be informative. The resulting estimator is deterministic, training-free, and applies one set of analytically determined settings to every image and sensor. It ranks first in 18 of 24 PSNR/SSIM comparisons against twelve published methods on three synthetic benchmarks, and attains the lowest mean deviation of the ratio image from the theoretical speckle model over six real-SAR configurations from five sensors. Code is available \href{https://github.com/Teriri1999/Geometry-Calibrated-Closed-Form-Shrinkage-for-SAR-Despeckling}{here}.

</details>


### [245] [Generation of Synthetic Fingerphotos with GANs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15029)
*Conor Miller-Lynch,Sandip Purnapatra,Syed Konain Abbas,Lambert Igene,Faraz Hussain,Soumyabrata Dey,Stephanie Schuckers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出使用StyleGAN2-ADA和StyleGAN3生成合成接触式指纹照片（fingerphotos），并从真实性、隐私保护和多样性三个维度进行系统评估，为未来合成指纹数据的评估提供了定量基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触式指纹采集是一种新兴的生物识别认证方式，但由于真实接触式指纹数据量有限，且共享真实个体指纹存在安全风险，因此需要探索生成合成数据的方法，以替代或补充真实数据用于系统开发和评估。

Method: 使用StyleGAN2-ADA和StyleGAN3两种现有图像生成架构生成合成指纹照片；通过比较真实与合成指纹的生物特征统计量来评估真实性；通过计算真实与合成指纹间的匹配分数评估隐私保护程度；通过计算不同合成指纹间的匹配分数评估生成数据的多样性。

Result: 该方法为合成指纹照片的真实性、隐私保护性和多样性提供了量化评估结果，并公开了评估代码以供后续研究使用。

Conclusion: 本文为未来合成指纹照片的评估提供了一个定量比较基准，证明了GAN架构在生成可用合成接触式指纹数据方面的潜力。

Abstract: Contactless fingerprinting is an emerging approach to biometric authentication that allows users to scan their fingerprints without touching a scanner. Due to the limited amount of contactless fingerprint data available and the security risks associated with sharing real individuals' fingerprints, it is valuable to explore methods of generating synthetic data that can be used in place of - or in conjunction with - real data to develop and evaluate contactless fingerprinting systems. In this paper, we present and evaluate synthetic fingerphotos generated using StyleGAN2-ADA and StyleGAN3, existing image generation architectures. We evaluate the realism, privacy preservation, and variety of the synthetic fingerphotos by comparing their biometric feature statistics to those of real fingerphotos, computing match scores between real and synthetic fingerphotos, and computing match scores between different synthetic fingerphotos. This paper provides a quantitative comparison point for future evaluations of synthetic fingerphotos. The evaluation code is made available at https://github.com/cmillerlynch/fingerphoto-gan.

</details>


### [246] [MOSS-VL Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15045)
*Pengyu Wang,Chenkun Tan,Shaojun Zhou,Qirui Zhou,Yanxin Chen,Xingyang He,Huazheng Zeng,Jijun Cheng,Chenghao Wang,Xiaomeng Qian,Pengfei Wang,Zhan Huang,Shanqing Gao,Wei Huang,Longjun Cao,Wu Ran,Jie Liu,Changtai Zhu,Hongkai Wang,Yixian Tian,Chenghao Liu,Zhen Ye,Xinghao Wang,Botian Jiang,Guoguo Feng,Zhaoye Fei,Ruixiao Li,Mingshu Chen,Yang Gao,Qinyuan Cheng,Shimin Li,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MOSS-VL是一系列开源视觉语言模型，将实时交互（边感知边说话）作为一等能力。通过门控交叉注意力让语言解码器在生成时自然地看到新帧，利用合成交互语料监督说话/沉默/修正时机，并通过分阶段课程将实时训练集中在基于强大离线基础的轻量最终阶段。离线版MOSS-VL-Instruct在同等规模下具有竞争力并在时序推理视频集上领先；实时版MOSS-VL-Realtime在四个流式基准中的三个上取得最佳平均成绩，并在三个主动行为子集上全面超越基线。模型仅11.3B参数但视觉token在解码序列之外，使首token延迟优势从2.8x扩大到5.1x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要面向离线单轮或多轮对话，缺乏实时流式交互能力——即在生成输出的同时持续感知新到达的视觉帧。作者希望构建一个原生支持实时交互的开源视觉语言模型家族，解决"边说话边看"的核心挑战。

Method: 三层协同设计：（1）架构层：语言解码器仅通过门控交叉注意力（gated cross-attention）访问视觉信息，使模型在生成时能自然感知新帧，且视觉token不进入解码序列；（2）数据层：构建合成交互语料库，监督模型何时说话、何时保持沉默、何时修正；（3）训练层：采用分阶段课程，先构建强离线基础，再通过一个轻量最终阶段集中所有实时特定训练。

Result: 离线MOSS-VL-Instruct在同等规模下具有竞争力，并在时序推理视频集上领先。实时MOSS-VL-Realtime在四个流式基准中三个取得最佳平均成绩（第四个排名第二），在三个主动行为子集上全面优于基线（OmniMMI Proactive Alerting上66.0 vs 37.5）。在11.3B参数下，随着视觉上下文增长，对同骨干的Qwen3-VL-8B的首token延迟优势从2.8x扩展到5.1x。

Conclusion: MOSS-VL证明通过架构-数据-训练的全栈协同设计，可以实现具备实时交互能力的开放视觉语言模型，且不牺牲离线性能。作者开源全部5个检查点、训练课程和实时推理代码，为社区提供可复现的实时多模态交互基座。

Abstract: We present MOSS-VL, an open vision-language model family that treats real-time interaction -- perceiving while it speaks -- as a first-class capability. It is co-designed across the stack: the language decoder attends to vision only through gated cross-attention, so the model can naturally see incoming frames while generating; a synthesized interaction corpus supervises when to speak, when to stay silent, and when to revise; and a staged curriculum concentrates all real-time-specific training in one light final stage over a strong offline foundation. Offline, MOSS-VL-Instruct is competitive at comparable scale and leads temporal-reasoning video sets. Across four streaming benchmarks, MOSS-VL-Realtime posts the best average on three (second on the fourth) among open-source streaming models, sweeping the three subsets that squarely test proactive behavior -- 66.0 vs. 37.5 for the best baseline on OmniMMI Proactive Alerting. With 11.3B parameters but visual tokens outside the decoded sequence, MOSS-VL widens its time-to-first-token advantage over same-backbone Qwen3-VL-8B from 2.8x to 5.1x as visual context grows. We release all five checkpoints, the training curriculum, and the real-time inference code at https://github.com/OpenMOSS/MOSS-VL.

</details>


### [247] [Frequency and Edge-Guided Segment Anything Model for Remote Sensing Image Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15054)
*Feng Gao,Zizhe Pan,Haoting Wang,Ruzhuang Hua,Jingchao Cao,Junyu Dong,Qian Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FE-SAM，一种面向遥感图像语义分割的可扩展高效框架。通过Frequency-Modulated Adapter (FMA) 自适应分解和调制频域特征以适配不同地物类型，并设计EGRefiner融合多尺度边缘增强信息改善边界语义模糊问题，在三个基准数据集上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于SAM的遥感分割方法存在两个局限：(1) SAM特征不能充分适配多样化的地物类型；(2) 目标边界处存在语义模糊问题，影响精确分割。

Method: 提出FE-SAM框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Frequency-Modulated Adapter (FMA)——根据输入数据自适应分解并调制频域特征，选择性增强与不同地物类型对应的信息高低频分量；(2) EGRefiner——融合从输入图像提取的多尺度边缘增强信息，提升SAM捕获细粒度细节的能力。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FE-SAM性能优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: FE-SAM通过频域自适应调制和边缘引导精化有效解决了SAM在遥感分割中特征适配不足和边界模糊的问题，验证了该框架的可扩展性和有效性。

Abstract: Remote sensing image semantic segmentation (RSISS) has attracted significant attention due to the growing demand for fine-grained land cover information. The Segment Anything Model (SAM), proposed as a foundation vision model, offers strong segmentation performance and generalization capabilities for RSISS tasks. However, existing SAM-based approaches face two limitations: (1) Insufficient adaptation of SAM's features to the diverse characteristics of land cover types. (2) Semantic ambiguity at object boundaries, which hinders accurate delineation. To address these limitations, we propose Frequency and Edge-guided SAM (FE-SAM), a scalable and efficient framework for RSISS. Specifically, we introduce a Frequency-Modulated Adapter (FMA) that adaptively decomposes and modulates frequency-domain features based on the input data. It selectively enhances informative high- and low-frequency components corresponding to different land cover types. Furthermore, to improve SAM's ability to capture fine-grained details, we design EGRefiner, which integrates multi-scale edge-enhanced information extracted from the input image. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that FE-SAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The source codes are available at: https://github.com/oucailab/FE-SAM.

</details>


### [248] [MEDR: Query-Independent Frame Selection via Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15058)
*Xinlei Pu,Weijie Shi,Wen Yang,Yi Cao,Hao Chen,Yuanjun Liu,Wenwei Ding,Jia Zhu,Jiajie Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MEDR是一种无需训练且与查询无关的视频帧选择方法，通过多信号事件建模和动态重新评分，在保持固定视觉输入可复用性的同时，比均匀采样更好地覆盖信息性事件，并在Video-MME和LongVideoBench等基准上提升模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型处理长视频时，均匀采样虽保证时间覆盖但可能遗漏短暂出现的重要信息；查询相关的帧选择方法虽然能检索问题相关帧，但导致帧集无法在不同问题间共享，多轮视频对话需重复进行帧选择。因此需要一种与查询无关但能超越均匀采样信息覆盖的帧选择方法，以保持固定视觉输入的可复用性。

Method: MEDR包含两个核心组件：(1) Multi-Signal Event Modeling，将互补的视觉、运动和文本信号组织为各自信号特定的时间事件；(2) Dynamic Rescoring，迭代地将每个候选帧相对于当前已选集合重新评估，根据帧级信号强度、额外事件覆盖和时间邻近度更新其得分。整个过程无需训练，且帧集的构建不依赖查询，可跨问题复用。

Result: 在Video-MME标准基准上，MEDR将模型精度提升0.63%-0.89%；在LongVideoBench长视频子集上，使用Qwen3-VL-8B时精度最高提升1.23%；MEDR还使总体精度提升0.53%，同时为视频的每个问题复用完全相同的帧集。

Conclusion: MEDR验证了查询无关的帧选择方法可以在不牺牲固定视觉输入可复用性的前提下，通过多信号事件建模和动态重新评分，比均匀采样更好地覆盖信息性事件，从而提升多模态大语言模型在长视频理解任务上的性能。

Abstract: Frame selection is a fundamental component of multimodal large language models, enabling long videos to be processed under limited visual-token and computational budgets. Uniform sampling preserves temporal coverage but may miss informative content that appears only briefly. To alleviate this limitation, query-dependent methods can retrieve question-relevant frames. However, because the selected frames depend on the current question, the same visual input cannot be directly shared across different questions, and frame selection must be repeated in multi-turn video dialogue. This motivates us to seek a query-independent frame selection method that preserves the reusability of a fixed visual input while improving the coverage of informative events beyond uniform sampling. We propose Multi-Signal Event Modeling and Dynamic Rescoring (MEDR), a training-free and query-independent frame selection method. Multi-Signal Event Modeling organizes complementary visual, motion, and text signals into signal-specific temporal events. Dynamic Rescoring then iteratively reevaluates each candidate relative to the current selected set, updating its score according to frame-level signal strength, additional event coverage, and temporal proximity. The resulting fixed frame set is constructed without observing the query and can be reused across different questions. On the standard benchmark evaluations, MEDR improves model accuracy by 0.63%-0.89% on Video-MME. On the long-video subset of LongVideoBench, it improves accuracy by up to 1.23% with Qwen3-VL-8B. MEDR further improves overall accuracy by 0.53%, while reusing exactly the same frame set for every question about a video.

</details>


### [249] [EgoTac: In-the-wild Tactile Prediction from Egocentric Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15060)
*Wenkang Zhang,Chengbo Yuan,Zicheng Zhang,Zhengxue Cheng,Yang Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EgoTac是一个从自我中心人类视频中直接预测触觉信息的通用模型，基于超过570万图像-触觉对统一语料库训练，涵盖连续力测量和二元接触，实现了域内平均力误差低于0.06N，并在域外接触预测基准上持续超越SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作离不开触觉信息，但大多数用于机器人学习的自我中心人类数据缺乏触觉标签。直接大规模采集触觉数据受限于传感器条件，而人类视频数据丰富、接触密集且易于扩展，因此探索能否仅从视觉推断触觉信号是一个自然且重要的研究问题。

Method: EgoTac采用统一语料库训练策略，收集超过570万对图像-触觉数据对，同时覆盖连续力测量和二元接触标签。模型从这些多样化数据中学习跨多种交互场景的细微触觉动态，实现从自我中心视频像素到触觉信号的端到端映射。

Result: 域内预测的平均力误差低于0.06N；在域外接触预测基准上持续优于最先进的接触估计器；能够捕捉真实触觉数据的上升和下降模式；支持无约束真实世界视频的零样本预测；缩放分析表明数据多样性和规模均能稳定提升性能。

Conclusion: EgoTac为从自我中心人类视频中提取触觉先验提供了一条可扩展的路径，使触觉感知的机器人学习能够在大规模范围内得到应用，弥补了人类数据中触觉信息缺失的关键缺口。

Abstract: Touch is fundamental to dexterous manipulation, yet most egocentric human data increasingly used for robot learning lacks tactile information. Directly collecting large-scale tactile data is challenging due to sensor limitations, while human video data is abundant, contact-rich, and easily scalable. This motivates a natural question: can tactile signals be inferred purely from vision? To address this, we introduce EgoTac, a generalizable model that predicts rich tactile information directly from egocentric human videos. EgoTac is trained on a unified corpus of over 5.7M image-tactile pairs, covering both continuous force measurements and binary contacts. By learning from this diverse dataset, EgoTac captures nuanced touch dynamics across varied interactions. Experiments demonstrate strong performance: in-domain prediction achieves an average force error below 0.06N. On out-of-domain contact prediction benchmarks, EgoTac consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art contact estimator. It also captures the rise and fall patterns of real tactile data and enables zero-shot predictions on unconstrained real-world videos. Scaling analyses further reveal that both data diversity and volume improve performance steadily. Overall, EgoTac provides a scalable pathway to extract tactile priors from egocentric human videos, enabling broadly applicable tactile-aware robot learning.

</details>


### [250] [Do Visual Grounding Decoders Need Feed-Forward Networks? A Controlled Study over Frozen Vision-Language Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15061)
*Tarun Tomar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究在视觉定位（visual grounding）解码器中，当预训练的视觉-语言模型已编码图像和语言上下文后，前馈网络（FFN）是否仍然必不可少。通过对比纯注意力解码器（A4）、注意力加FFN解码器（S4）及参数匹配的八层纯注意力控制组（A8），发现A4在多数基准上与S4相当或略优，仅在FineCops-Ref上小幅落后0.52个百分点（可通过增加注意力层数弥补），且A4显著减少了44.4%的可训练参数和10.1%的解码器延迟。结论是FFN并非必要，其计算可被注意力机制替代。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在预训练视觉-语言特征已提供丰富上下文的条件下，解码器中的FFN模块是否冗余，从而为简化解码器架构、减少参数和计算开销提供依据。

Method: 在冻结的VLM特征之上，分别构建四层纯注意力解码器（A4）、四层注意力+FFN解码器（S4）和八层纯注意力解码器（A8，作为参数匹配对照组），在RefCOCOg、Ref-Adv-s和FineCops-Ref三个基准上进行对比实验，统计IoU指标、可训练参数量和缓存解码延迟。

Result: A4在RefCOCOg和Ref-Adv-s上与S4相当或略优；在FineCops-Ref上A4较S4落后0.52个百分点（IoU@0.5，95%置信区间[0.12, 0.95]），但A8不仅弥补差距还反超S4 0.26个百分点；A4减少44.4%可训练参数和10.1%缓存解码延迟，端到端延迟仍由骨干网络主导。

Conclusion: 在基于预训练VLM特征的视觉定位解码器中，FFN所贡献的额外计算并非必要，其作用可通过增加注意力层数以更少的参数和相近的延迟实现同等或更优的性能。结论限定于可训练定位解码器，不推广至完整的纯注意力VLM。

Abstract: Do feed-forward networks (FFNs) in visual grounding decoders add essential computation once a pretrained vision-language model has already encoded image and language context? We compare a four-block attention-only decoder (A4), a matched four-block attention-plus-FFN decoder (S4), and an eight-block attention-only parameter control (A8) over frozen VLM features. A4 matches or slightly exceeds S4 on RefCOCOg and Ref-Adv-s. FineCops-Ref reveals a small A4 deficit of 0.52 percentage points at IoU@0.5 (95% CI [0.12, 0.95] in favor of S4), but A8 recovers it and finishes 0.26 points above S4. Official FineCops levels do not show a monotonic increase in the gap. A4 reduces trainable decoder parameters by 44.4% and cached-decoder latency by 10.1%, although end-to-end latency remains backbone-dominated. These results concern the trainable grounding decoder, not a complete attention-only VLM.

</details>


### [251] [SA-GEM: Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning for Efficient Remote Sensing Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15075)
*Kexin Ma,Jing Xiao,Bowen Xing,Liang Liao,Chia-Wen Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SA-GEM，一个即插即用的框架，通过尺度自适应分辨率选择与地理空间证据调制的令牌剪枝，解决遥感大视觉语言模型在高分辨率下视觉令牌爆炸且关键证据稀疏的问题，在精度和效率上均优于现有剪枝方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RS-LVLMs在地球观测图像的多模态理解上取得进展，但其性能受限于高分辨率处理——视觉令牌数量随输入分辨率二次增长，而关键视觉证据本质稀疏且在扩展序列中被稀释。现有令牌剪枝方法依赖与尺度无关的分辨率策略和孤立的显著性线索，难以实现任务对齐的粒度适配和整体证据保留。

Method: SA-GEM由两个核心组件构成：(1) 轻型路由器根据查询依赖的令牌粒度选择最优分辨率；(2) 令牌重要性调制器联合建模任务相关性、空间结构和局部冗余度，以保留整体地理空间证据。该框架实现任务自适应令牌粒度分配与整体地理空间令牌重要性调制的统一，且为即插即用设计。

Result: 实验证明更高分辨率并非普遍有益，一旦达到足够粒度，令牌质量比令牌数量更重要。在多个基准上，SA-GEM相较于现有剪枝方法在准确率和效率上均取得一致性提升。在XLRS-Bench上，相比GeoLLaVA-8K，准确率提升2.3%，总推理速度提升2.4倍。

Conclusion: SA-GEM通过任务对齐的粒度分配与整体地理空间证据调制，有效缓解了高分辨率下视觉令牌膨胀与证据稀疏的矛盾，验证了在足够粒度条件下令牌质量优于数量的核心观点，为遥感多模态模型的效率优化提供了新范式。

Abstract: RS-LVLMs have advanced multimodal understanding of Earth observation imagery, yet their performance is fundamentally constrained by high-resolution processing, as visual token counts grow quadratically with linear input resolution while important visual evidence is inherently sparse and increasingly diluted across the expanded sequence. Existing token pruning methods largely rely on scale-agnostic resolution policies and isolated importance cues, limiting task-aligned granularity adaptation and holistic evidence preservation. To address this, we present Scale-Adaptive and Geospatial Evidence-Modulated Token Pruning (SA-GEM), a plug-and-play framework that unifies task-adaptive token granularity allocation with holistic geospatial token importance modulation. Specifically, a lightweight router selects the resolution based on query-dependent token granularity, while a token importance modulator jointly models task relevance, spatial structure, and local redundancy to preserve holistic geospatial evidence. We show that higher resolution is not universally beneficial and, once sufficient granularity is reached, token quality matters more than token quantity. Experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that SA-GEM achieves consistent gains in both accuracy and efficiency over existing pruning methods. On XLRS-Bench, it surpasses GeoLLaVA-8K by 2.3% in accuracy with a 2.4 times total inference speedup.

</details>


### [252] [Distribution-free false-alarm calibration and chance-corrected spatial evaluation for industrial anomaly detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15090)
*Jie Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于分布自由上容忍阈值与配对-交叉空间检验的方法，用于评估工业视觉检测中异常定位的证据，纠正了仅依赖AUROC和掩膜重叠的误导性指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业视觉检测评估指标（AUROC、异常图与缺陷掩膜重叠）存在两个关键缺陷：一是无法指定在某选定阈值下的误报率；二是缺陷位置的重现性和掩膜几何形状会人为抬高重叠分数，导致评估偏差。

Method: 将分布自由的容忍上限阈值与配对-交叉空间检验相结合。该检验比较每个检测器得分贡献位置与匹配缺陷掩膜及其他图像掩膜的重叠率之差，定义空间证据提升（spatial-evidence lift）以校正经验性机会重叠率。

Result: 在120个点缺陷图像（三个ISP-AD模态、三个固定数据划分）上的378个告警中230个与匹配掩膜重叠，但9个检测器-模态单元中有8个配对与交叉率相似；仅DINOv2-ASM有95%正下界（提升0.259）。在Magnetic Tile Defect数据集上，WRN50补丁记忆提升为0.203，ViT-B/16为0.231（置换检验p=1e-5）。样本规划显示150个校准正常样本仅支持1.98%以上目标FPR，1%目标需至少299个正常样本。

Conclusion: 研究支持在报告AUROC和原始掩膜重叠的同时，补充报告操作点性能和机会校正的空间证据，以更准确地评估工业视觉检测系统。

Abstract: Studies of industrial visual inspection commonly report the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and the overlap between anomaly maps and defect masks. Neither measure specifies the false-alarm rate at a selected threshold, while recurrent defect locations and mask geometry can inflate overlap. We combine a distribution-free upper tolerance threshold with a paired-minus-crossed spatial test. This test compares each detector's score-contributing locations with the matched defect mask and with masks from other images; the difference in rates defines spatial-evidence lift relative to the empirical chance-overlap rate. We evaluate three detectors on 120 point-defect images from three ISP-AD modalities and three fixed data splits. Of 378 alarms, 230 overlap the matched mask. Paired and crossed rates are nevertheless similar in eight of nine detector--modality cells; only DINOv2--ASM has a positive 95\% bootstrap lower bound (lift 0.259, 95\% interval 0.159--0.347). On the independent Magnetic Tile Defect dataset, the same analysis gives lifts of 0.203 (0.169--0.236) for Wide ResNet-50 (WRN50) patch memory and 0.231 (0.202--0.262) for Vision Transformer B/16 (ViT-B/16) patch memory, with one-sided permutation $p=10^{-5}$ for both. When crossed masks are restricted to the same defect class, the lifts remain 0.185 and 0.210. Exact sample planning shows that, with 150 calibration normals, a 95\%-confidence distribution-free claim is supported only for target false-positive rates of 1.98\% or higher; a 1\% target requires at least 299 normals. The results support reporting operating-point performance and chance-corrected spatial evidence alongside AUROC and raw mask overlap.

</details>


### [253] [MODAL: Multi-Modal Object Re-ID via Model-Driven Sparse Decoupling and Text-Image Differential Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15096)
*Chengbo Huang,Jun-Jie Huang,Long Lan,Tianrui Liu,Xueqiong Li,Yuanxi Peng,Xinwang Liu,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MODAL，一种基于耦合稀疏编码理论和差分抑制原理的多模态目标重识别框架，通过模型驱动的深度展开方式实现多模态特征的稀疏解耦，将多模态特征显式分解为单模态特异、双模态和三模态共享表示，并引入模态感知子空间激活机制和文本-图像差分过滤模块，在四个数据集上达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态目标重识别方法缺乏原则性的特征解耦和连贯的多模态融合机制，导致：(1)纠缠的表示引入跨模态冲突；(2)掩盖判别性线索；(3)在模态缺失条件下出现分布偏移。这些问题严重限制了跨模态复杂环境下目标检索的性能。

Method: MODAL框架包含三个核心组件：(1)多模态特征稀疏解耦模块（基于多模态耦合稀疏编码的模型驱动深度展开方式实现），将多模态特征显式分解为单模态特异的、双模态共享和三模态共享表示；(2)模态感知子空间激活机制，在模态缺失场景下仅选择性地激活一致共享子空间以缓解性能退化；(3)文本-图像差分过滤模块，利用粗粒度文本语义自适应抑制解耦视觉表征中的任务无关响应。

Result: 在四个数据集上的大量实验表明，MODAL达到了最先进的性能，同时具有更优的可解释性（transparency）。

Conclusion: 通过将耦合稀疏编码理论引入模型驱动的深度展开框架，MODAL实现了透明且有效的特征解耦，从根本上解决了现有方法中跨模态冲突、判别线索模糊和模态缺失下的分布偏移问题，为多模态目标重识别提供了更具原则性的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-modal object re-identification (Re-ID) aims to facilitate cross-camera object retrieval in complex environments by leveraging complementary information from visual (e.g., RGB, NIR, TIR) and textual modalities. However, existing approaches often lack principled feature disentanglement and coherent multi-modal integration, leading to entangled representations that introduce cross-modal conflicts, obscure discriminative cues, and suffer distribution shift under modality-missing conditions. To tackle these challenges, we propose MODAL, a novel multi-modal object re-identification framework, grounded in coupled sparse coding theory and differential suppression principles. A core component of MODAL is a Multi-modal Feature Sparse Decoupling module, developed in a model-driven deep unrolling manner based on multi-modal coupled sparse coding. It explicitly decomposes multi-modal features into uni-modal specific, bi-modal and tri-modal shared representations, thereby achieving more transparent and effective feature disentanglement. Benefiting from the principled feature disentanglement, MODAL naturally mitigates performance degradation in incomplete-modality scenarios via a Modality-Aware Subspace Activation that selectively activates only the consistently shared subspaces. Moreover, we propose a Text-Image Differential Filtering module that leverages coarse-grained textual semantics to adaptively suppress task-irrelevant responses in the decoupled visual representations, thereby enhancing discriminative information. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that MODAL achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior transparency.

</details>


### [254] [ProjFormer: Point Cloud Completion via Geometric-Projective Transformer and Cross-Modal Semantic Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15104)
*Sheng Liu,Meng Wang,Ruihui Li,Huilong Pi,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出的ProjFormer框架通过显式投影和自适应特征路由强制进行几何一致的2D-3D交互，在轻量化设计下实现了具有竞争力的点云补全性能和更强的结构完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 点云补全因观测稀疏和模糊而本质上具有不适定性。现有基于多视图的方法虽然引入2D语义，但依赖学习到的注意力和固定融合，缺乏几何一致性和适应性，需要改进。

Method: ProjFormer包含两个关键模块：1）Projective Guided View Attention模块，通过确定性投影将3D点与多视图特征对齐，实现高效且几何一致的聚合；2）几何感知路由网络，执行逐点自适应融合结构和观测驱动特征，进行渐进式精化。

Result: 在轻量化设计下，ProjFormer实现了具有竞争力的性能，并改善了结构完整性。

Conclusion: 通过显式投影替代固定的学习注意力机制，并结合几何感知自适应特征路由，ProjFormer能够在较轻量级的架构下同时兼顾性能与结构完整性，验证了跨模态交互中几何一致性的重要性。

Abstract: Point cloud completion is inherently ill-posed due to severe sparsity and ambiguity in partial observations. Existing multi-view methods alleviate this by incorporating 2D semantics, but often rely on learned attention and fixed fusion, which lack geometric consistency and adaptability. We propose ProjFormer, a cross-modal framework that enforces geometry-consistent 2D-3D interaction through explicit projection and adaptive feature routing. A Projective Guided View Attention module aligns 3D points with multi-view features via deterministic projection, enabling efficient and geometrically consistent aggregation. Building on this, a geometry-aware routing network performs point-wise adaptive fusion of structural and observation-driven features for progressive refinement. Experiments show that, under a lightweight design, ProjFormer delivers competitive performance with improved structural completeness.

</details>


### [255] [CETalk: Continuous Valence-Arousal Control for Audio-Driven 3D Talking Head Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15110)
*Peng Jia,Li Dai,Zhen Xiao,Xueliang Liu,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出CETalk，一个基于连续效价-唤醒（VA）表示的音频驱动3D面部动画生成框架，通过动态情感调制模块、多尺度时序建模机制和动态融合机制，实现了精细的情感控制和准确的唇形同步，并在自建的3D-VA-MEAD数据集上超越了现有最佳方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有情感3D说话头生成方法依赖离散情感类别，无法捕捉情感的连续演变过程；同时忽略了音频发音与情感表达之间的时间频率不匹配问题，导致生成的面部动画在情感表达和唇形同步方面存在局限。

Method: CETalk框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 动态情感调制模块，利用音频派生线索自适应地缩放情感强度；(2) 多尺度时序建模机制，通过并行分支解耦高频发音运动与低频情感动态；(3) 动态融合机制，采用自适应门控网络整合多尺度特征。此外，论文构建了3D-VA-MEAD大规模数据集，包含自动估计的VA标注和重建的3D面部运动。

Result: 大量实验表明，CETalk在唇形同步准确性和情感表达力方面均优于现有最先进方法，同时能够实现平滑、可控的情感过渡。

Conclusion: CETalk通过连续VA表示替代离散情感类别，结合多尺度频率解耦策略，有效解决了情感3D说话头生成中情感连续性表达与唇形同步之间的核心矛盾，为可控情感面部动画生成提供了新的技术路线。

Abstract: Emotional 3D talking head generation aims to synthesize expressive facial animations with accurate lip synchronization. However, existing methods often rely on discrete emotion categories, which fail to capture the continuous evolution of affect. They also overlook the temporal frequency mismatch between audio articulation and emotional expression. In this paper, we propose CETalk, an audio-driven 3D facial animation framework conditioned on continuous Valence--Arousal (VA) representations for fine-grained emotion control. CETalk predicts a sequence of FLAME parameters through three key components: a Dynamic Emotion Modulation Module that adaptively scales emotional intensity using audio-derived cues; a Multi-Scale Temporal Modeling mechanism that employs parallel branches to decouple high-frequency articulatory movements from low-frequency emotional dynamics; and a Dynamic Fusion Mechanism that integrates these multi-scale features via an adaptive gating network. To support training and evaluation, we construct 3D-VA-MEAD, a large-scale dataset with automatically estimated VA annotations and reconstructed 3D facial motions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CETalk outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both lip-sync accuracy and emotional expressiveness, while enabling smooth and controllable emotion transitions.

</details>


### [256] [Fast Test-Time Refinement for Robust Learned Image Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15113)
*Jiaming Liang,Chi-Man Pun,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了学习图像压缩（LIC）系统在对抗攻击下的脆弱性问题，揭示了一个"非对称对抗轨迹"（AAT）特性：从对抗区域恢复到良性区域远比反向过程容易，通常仅需1-2步。基于此特性，作者提出了快速测试时精炼（FTTR）框架作为高效防御方法，并通过"管道模型"（Tube Model）解释其鲁棒性源于Input-as-Label属性导致的对抗区域收缩，而非梯度混淆。实验在多种强自适应攻击和多组LIC系统上验证了FTTR的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LIC虽在良性环境下具有出色的率失真性能，但其深度神经网络的高表示能力带来了对抗脆弱性。已有测试时精炼（TTR）作为灰盒防御方法存在两大问题：计算开销过大且缺乏理论解释，同时未在白盒场景或ℓ2界之外的攻击下评估。作者旨在弥合这些研究空白，提出既高效又具备理论支撑的鲁棒LIC方案。

Method: 作者首先通过系统性研究揭示了LIC系统中的非对称对抗轨迹（AAT）属性，并提出一个二维管道模型（Tube Model）从理论上解释该现象。基于AAT，设计了快速测试时精炼（FTTR）框架，以极少的迭代步数实现从对抗区域到良性区域的恢复。作者进一步论证鲁棒性源于Input-as-Label属性导致对抗区域的收缩，而非梯度混淆。

Result: 在多种强自适应攻击（涵盖白盒及ℓ2界之外的攻击目标）和多组LIC系统上的广泛评估表明，FTTR框架在显著降低计算开销的同时，提供了有效的鲁棒性防御，验证了其实际可行性。

Conclusion: FTTR为LIC系统提供了一种实用且高效的对抗防御方案，其理论性质（对抗区域收缩源于Input-as-Label属性）为该领域后续研究提供了新的视角。代码已开源供社区复现和进一步探索。

Abstract: Learned image compression (LIC) has demonstrated remarkable rate-distortion (RD) performance in benign settings. However, the high representational capacity endowed by deep neural networks (DNNs) comes at the expense of increased adversarial vulnerability. This hinders their adoption as trusted standardized codecs. Recent work has sketched test-time refinement (TTR) as a defense in gray-box scenarios, despite its original purpose of improving benign RD performance. Unfortunately, extensive iterations of TTR incur prohibitive overhead, while the robustness mechanism lacks theoretical understanding. Moreover, TTR has not been evaluated in white-box settings or against attacks beyond $\ell_2$-bounded rate and untargeted distortion objectives. To bridge these gaps, we present a systematic study. Our study reveals an Asymmetric Adversarial Trajectory (AAT) property in LIC systems: transitioning from adversarial to benign regions is significantly easier than the reverse process, where adversarial examples can often be roughly recovered within only 1-2 steps. We provide a two-dimensional Tube Model to explain this phenomenon. Based on AAT, we propose a Fast Test-Time Refinement (FTTR) framework for practical and robust LIC systems. We establish that the robustness arises from the contraction of adversarial regions induced by the Input-as-Label property of LIC systems, rather than from obfuscated gradients. Extensive evaluations with diverse strong adaptive attacks across multiple LIC systems demonstrate the promise of the proposed FTTR framework. The code is available at https://github.com/chinaliangjiaming/FTTR.git.

</details>


### [257] [Perspective-Invariant Attack with Enhanced Transferability of Adversarial Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15115)
*Kaisheng Liang,Yiming Cao,Bin Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为PIA（视角不变攻击）的对抗性样本迁移方法，通过多自由度顶点采样策略系统覆盖从2-DOF平移到8-DOF投影映射的透视变换层次，生成几何多样化的输入变体以减少对抗扰动对替代模型的过拟合，从而提高对抗样本的跨模型迁移性。此外还提出PIA-Mix扩展，通过互补变换池融合透视变换与辅助方法进一步增强迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的输入变换方法（如分块洗牌和缩放）主要依赖自由度有限的局部操作，忽略了由视角变化自然产生的全局透视变换，导致对抗样本的跨模型迁移性受限。

Method: 提出PIA，采用多DOF顶点采样策略系统覆盖从2-DOF平移到8-DOF投影映射的透视变换层次，生成几何多样的输入变体以减少过拟合；并进一步提出PIA-Mix，维护互补变换池，高效融合透视变换与辅助方法。

Result: 在多种DNN架构、先进防御机制以及多模态大语言模型上的大量实验表明，PIA和PIA-Mix均优于现有的最先进的基于迁移的攻击方法。

Conclusion: 通过引入全局透视变换来增加输入多样性，能够有效降低对抗扰动对替代模型的过拟合，从而显著提升对抗样本的跨模型迁移性能，且该方法具有通用性和良好的扩展性。

Abstract: Adversarial examples generated on a surrogate deep neural network (DNN) can often successfully fool other black-box DNN models. This cross-model transferability poses serious security threats to DNNs in practical applications. Input transformation techniques are widely used to enhance adversarial transferability by increasing the diversity of input images. However, existing methods primarily rely on local operations with limited degrees of freedom (DOF), such as block-wise shuffling and resizing, overlooking global perspective transformations that naturally arise from viewpoint changes. In this work, we propose a Perspective-Invariant Attack (PIA), which introduces a multi-DOF vertex sampling strategy that systematically covers the perspective transformation hierarchy from 2-DOF translation to 8-DOF projective mapping. By generating geometrically diverse input variations, PIA effectively reduces overfitting of adversarial perturbations to the surrogate model, thereby improving adversarial transferability. We further propose PIA-Mix, a generic extension that maintains a complementary transformation pool and efficiently combines our perspective transformation with auxiliary methods for improved transferability. Extensive experiments involving various DNN architectures, advanced defense mechanisms, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) demonstrate that PIA and PIA-Mix outperform state-of-the-art transfer-based attacks.

</details>


### [258] [HOIMask: Towards Generative Masked Modeling for Human Object Interaction Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15141)
*Yihong Ji,Jinsong Zhang,He Hu,Hongbo Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了HOIMask，这是首个基于生成式掩码建模的、在离散空间中建模人-物交互（HOI）运动的方法，通过HOI向量量化（VQ）将运动序列和接触信号编码为离散的2D token图，配合Transformer架构和接触感知重建引导，在生成更真实、语义对齐的HOI运动方面超越了现有的扩散方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于扩散的HOI生成方法虽然能够利用关键的接触融合信号引导生成过程，但在迭代去噪过程中存在误差累积，导致生成结果常有伪影且交互质量不稳定。因此需要一种新的生成范式来克服扩散模型的这些固有缺陷。

Method: 1) 提出HOI向量量化（VQ）模块，将运动序列和接触感知信号编码为离散的2D人体与物体token图，相比传统1D表示能保留更细粒度的空间-时间结构；2) 采用生成式掩码建模框架，利用Transformer架构联合捕获人-物交互动态，建模复杂的时空与交互依赖；3) 引入新颖的接触感知重建引导策略，在推理阶段于离散空间中融合接触信号以优化HOI token，使生成的运动具有更高的时空一致性。

Result: HOIMask在多个指标上超越了基于扩散的最先进方法，生成了更真实且语义对齐的HOI运动。

Conclusion: 通过精心设计的运动交互token、专用架构和引导策略，HOIMask证明了在离散空间中采用生成式掩码建模进行HOI运动生成的可行性，有效克服了扩散方法中误差累积导致的伪影和不稳定问题，为HOI生成提供了新的研究范式。

Abstract: Diffusion-based methods have dominated the HOI generation, as they enable critical contact fusions or signals to guide the diffusion process. However, they often result in high artifacts and unstable interaction quality due to error accumulation during iterative denoising. In this work, we propose HOIMask, the first generative masked framework for modeling HOI motion in discrete space. HOIMask first encodes both motion sequences and contact-aware signals into discrete 2D human and object token maps via HOI Vector Quantization (VQ), preserving fine-grained spatial-temporal structure beyond conventional 1D representations. On this basis, a generative masked modeling framework is employed to jointly capture human-object interaction dynamics, leveraging a transformer architecture designed to model complex spatial-temporal and interaction dependencies. To generate more coherent and physically plausible motions, we further introduce a novel contact-aware reconstruction guidance in discrete space during inference, which fuses contact signals to optimize HOI tokens that forces the generated motion with higher spatio-temporal consistency. With craftily designed motion interaction tokens, dedicated architecture and guidance strategy, HOIMask outperforms state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods, generating more realistic and semantically aligned HOI motions. Please refer to https://jyhflash.github.io/HOIMask/ for more results.

</details>


### [259] [A Unified Backbone--Expert Framework with Relation-Token and Residual--Classifier Interfaces for Automatic Modulation Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15160)
*Zhixiang Deng,Houbiao Li,Zongyong Cui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个统一的骨干-专家框架来解决自动调制识别（AMR）在不同观测长度下表示瓶颈问题，包含通用卷积状态空间骨干网络和两个专用接口，在RML2016.10b和HisarMod2019上分别达到67.28%和87.19%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动调制识别在不同观测长度下存在明显的表示瓶颈，单一模型架构难以在不同序列长度下都表现优异，因此需要针对短序列和长序列分别设计专门的解决方案。

Method: 提出统一的骨干-专家框架：包含一个通用的卷积状态空间骨干网络和两个专用接口。对于短序列，在编码前注入显式的滞后感知复平面描述符作为关系标记以补偿信息损失；对于长序列，设计门控多尺度残差细化模块来校正特征图，并结合固定平均分类器协作以利用互补证据。

Result: 在RML2016.10b上达到67.28±0.14%的平均准确率，在HisarMod2019上达到87.19±0.77%的平均准确率（三次运行的均值±样本标准差）。通过三种子消融实验、原生长度交叉配置测试和受控窗口研究进一步验证了框架的有效性，证实了专家接口解耦优于一刀切架构。

Conclusion: 专家接口解耦的框架设计在不同观测长度下均优于单一架构，验证了针对不同序列长度定制化接口策略的有效性。

Abstract: Automatic modulation recognition (AMR) faces distinct representation bottlenecks under varying observation lengths, where a single model architecture often fails to excel. To address this, we propose a unified backbone-expert framework with a common convolutional state-space backbone and two specialized interfaces. For short sequences, we inject explicit lag-aware complex-plane descriptors as relation tokens before encoding to compensate for information loss. For long sequences, we design a gated multi-scale residual refinement module to correct the feature map, combined with a fixed-averaging classifier collaboration to harness complementary evidence. Our framework achieves overall average accuracies of 67.28 \pm 0.14% on RML2016.10b and 87.19 \pm 0.77% on HisarMod2019 (mean \pm sample standard deviation over three runs), respectively. The framework's efficacy is further validated through three-seed ablations, native-length cross-configuration tests, and controlled window studies, confirming the benefit of expert-interface decoupling over one-size-fits-all architectures.

</details>


### [260] [From "What-If" to "What-Is": Counterfactual Thinking-Inspired Semantic Alignment for Visual Brain Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15163)
*Kaitao Yan,Chi Liu,Congcong Zhu,Huajie Chen,Gengshen Wu,Minghao Wang,Xiaotong Han,Tianqing Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ConceptAlign是一个用于视觉脑解码的反事实语义对齐框架，通过将解码的视觉token投影到冻结的文本嵌入空间，并与真实描述及场景保持的近miss反事实替代品进行对齐/分离学习，从而纠正生成结果中的语义错误（错误对象、属性或关系），提升重建真实性。在Natural Scenes Dataset上的实验表明其优于MindEye2基线，并在重建指标、反事实语义判别和表征对齐方面均取得改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉脑解码虽然借助多模态表示和扩散先验提升了重建的真实感，但视觉上合理的重建可能包含错误的对象、属性或关系，因为强生成先验会补齐解码表征中未充分指定的内容。传统重建指标仅评估最终图像，可能掩盖此类语义错误，因此需要一种能显式学习并校正细粒度语义边界的对齐方法。

Method: ConceptAlign包含以下核心步骤：(1) 聚合解码得到的视觉token并将其投影到冻结的文本嵌入空间；(2) 将该表征与ground-truth描述对齐，同时与场景保持的近miss替代品分离（这些替代品由LLM离线生成，仅修改一个关键对象、属性或关系而保留场景）；(3) 使用基于margin的目标函数学习观察刺激与看似合理但错误解释之间的细粒度语义边界，推理时不需调用LLM；(4) 引入三层次语义评估框架：基础判别性、反事实描述判别性和表征几何。

Result: 在Natural Scenes Dataset上，ConceptAlign相比MindEye2骨干在重建指标、反事实语义判别以及表征对齐方面均有提升。实验包含匹配负样本来源的消融、独立LLM和人工撰写的替代品以及人类评估，验证了监督的有效性和鲁棒性；在细粒度冲突、有限数据解码和跨受试者结构上也表现出有利模式。

Conclusion: ConceptAlign通过反事实语义对齐显式监督解码表征的语义正确性，能有效减少视觉脑解码中由生成先验导致的语义错误，同时保持重建质量，并提供了系统化的语义评估框架，对细粒度脑解码研究有重要价值。

Abstract: Visual brain decoding reconstructs visual content perceived by a person from neural measurements such as fMRI, providing a computational approach to studying how visual information is represented in the brain. Recent multimodal representations and diffusion priors have improved reconstruction realism. However, visually plausible reconstructions may contain incorrect objects, attributes, or relations because a strong generative prior can complete content not sufficiently specified by the decoded representation. Conventional reconstruction metrics mainly assess the final image and may therefore obscure such semantic errors. We propose ConceptAlign, a counterfactual semantic alignment framework for visual brain decoding. ConceptAlign pools decoded visual tokens and projects them into a frozen text-embedding space, aligning the representation with the ground-truth caption while separating it from scene-preserving near-miss alternatives. Generated offline by an LLM, these alternatives modify one critical object, attribute, or relation while retaining the scene. A margin-based objective learns fine-grained semantic boundaries between the observed stimulus and plausible but incorrect interpretations without requiring LLM calls during inference. We introduce a systematic three-level semantic evaluation framework covering foundational discriminability, counterfactual description discrimination, and representational geometry. Experiments on the Natural Scenes Dataset show that ConceptAlign improves reconstruction measures, counterfactual semantic discrimination, and representational alignment over the MindEye2 backbone. Matched negative-source ablations, independent LLM and human-written alternatives, and human evaluation support the effectiveness and robustness of the supervision, with favorable patterns in fine-grained conflicts, limited-data decoding, and cross-subject structure.

</details>


### [261] [Beyond Natural-Image Foundation Models: Benchmarking Satellite Pretraining for Ophthalmic Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15195)
*Lovre Antonio Budimir,Mingya Alexa Gong,Alyssa Foong Quinney,Ivana Matovinović,Yukun Zhou,Pearse A. Keane,Sven Lončarić,Marinko V. Šarunić*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出将卫星图像作为医学视觉基础模型（MedVFM）的全新预训练领域，以缓解医学影像数据稀缺、隐私限制和高开发成本等约束。通过比较在4.93亿张卫星图像上预训练的DINOv3-SAT493m与在17亿张自然图像上预训练的DINOv3-LVD1689m，以及两个医学专家基线模型，发现卫星图像在眼科任务中优于自然图像预训练，尤其在富含血管的en face模态上表现突出，部分任务上甚至无需医学数据即可媲美或超越医学专家模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学视觉基础模型的发展受限于训练数据不足、隐私问题和开发成本高。现有MedVFM通常基于在自然图像上预训练的通用模型权重进行微调，导致显著的域偏移（distribution shift）问题，影响医学任务适配效果。作者旨在寻找一个与医学图像视觉特征更接近、且不受隐私约束的新预训练域。

Method: 提出卫星图像作为MedVFM的新型预训练域，利用其与医学数据更接近的视觉对齐特性及无隐私限制的优势。在多种眼科成像模态上，对比DINOv3-SAT493m（4.93亿卫星图像预训练）、DINOv3-LVD1689m（17亿自然图像预训练）、以及DINOv3-RETFound和MAE-RETFound两个医学专家基线模型。

Result: 实验表明卫星图像作为预训练源在眼科任务上优于自然图像，尤其在en face血管丰富模态上优势显著。多个任务中，卫星预训练无需任何医学数据即可媲美或超越使用医学数据的专家模型（在高质量en face输入上）。

Conclusion: 卫星图像是一种有前景的MedVFM预训练替代方案，能有效缓解域偏移问题且规避医学数据隐私限制，为医学影像基础模型的开发提供了新的方向和可行性证据。

Abstract: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have emerged as a promising approach in medical imaging, producing broadly applicable systems that can be efficiently adapted across diverse imaging modalities, anatomical regions, and clinical tasks. However, VFMs require extensive training data, and their progress in medical image analysis is constrained by limited data availability, privacy concerns, and high development costs. To alleviate these constraints, medical VFMs (MedVFMs) are often built upon weights from generalist models pretrained on vast amounts of publicly available natural images, introducing a substantial distribution shift for medical task adaptation. To address this, we propose satellite imagery as a novel pretraining domain for MedVFM development and benchmarking, motivated by its closer visual alignment with medical data and its freedom from the privacy constraints that limit medical datasets. Across multiple ophthalmic imaging modalities, we compare DINOv3-SAT493m pretrained on 493 million satellite images against DINOv3-LVD1689m pretrained on 1.7 billion natural images, together with two medical specialist baselines: DINOv3-RETFound and MAE-RETFound. Our experiments show that satellite imagery is a stronger pretraining source than natural images for ophthalmic tasks, particularly on en face vascular-rich modalities. On several tasks, satellite pretraining matches or exceeds the medical specialists on high-resolution en face inputs, despite using no medical data.

</details>


### [262] [Anchor-Regularized Adaptation for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection with DINOv3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15196)
*Hyeongjun Choi,Juhun Lee,Davide Cozzolino,Luisa Verdoliva,Simon S. Woo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA)方法，利用冻结的DINOv3锚定分类器配合LoRA适配器，在捕捉像素级伪造痕迹的同时保持预训练表征结构，在九个人工智能生成图像检测基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究表明精细的数据对齐可去除伪相关以提升检测泛化能力，但冷冻DINOv3的线性探针即使在错位数据集上训练也能表现优异。作者希望理解这一现象的基本原理及其局限性，并解决混合对齐与错位数据时表征失真限制泛化的问题。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 分析冷冻DINOv3决策机制，发现其依赖忠实表征真实图像空间的特征，但最后一层对像素级伪影线索捕捉不足；(2) 观察发现简单混合对齐和错位数据可提升对伪影线索的敏感性，但会扭曲预训练表征；(3) 提出ARA：使用LoRA低秩适配捕捉像素级伪影，同时利用冻结的锚定分类器防止偏离原始表征结构，从而兼顾伪影线索利用与泛化能力。

Result: 在九个多样且具有挑战性的基准数据集上达到SOTA性能，验证了ARA能够有效利用错位和对齐数据的互补监督信息进行更有效的检测。

Conclusion: ARA方法证明可以通过锚定正则化在适配过程中保持预训练表征的完整性，同时增强对像素级伪影的敏感性，实现对齐与错位数据互补监督的充分利用，为AI生成图像检测提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: Recent works in AI-generated image detection have shown that careful training data alignment can improve generalization by removing spurious correlations. However, linear probes on frozen DINOv3 representations achieve remarkably strong performance even when trained on misaligned datasets. Motivated by this result, we analyze the underlying rationale and the limits of this generalization. We find that frozen DINOv3 performs well because its decisions rely on features that faithfully represent the space of authentic images. At the same time, its final layer is less effective at capturing the subtle pixel-artifact cues that can be emphasized by aligned training data. We further observe that naively mixing aligned and misaligned data during adaptation improves sensitivity to such cues but at the cost of distorting the pre-trained representation, limiting generalization. To address this issue, we propose Anchor-Regularized Adaptation (ARA). We apply Low-Rank Adaptation to capture pixel-level artifacts while leveraging a frozen anchor classifier to avoid deviations from the original representation structure. This allows the model to exploit pixel-artifact cues without sacrificing generalization. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on nine diverse and challenging benchmarks, indicating that ARA enables complementary supervision from misaligned and aligned data for more effective detection.

</details>


### [263] [TERRA: A Hierarchical Parallel Training and Memory Orchestration Framework for High-Resolution AI-based Earth Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15211)
*Ruohan Wu,Ziqi Zhu,Yang Zhao,Jiarui Tang,Yingzhe Cui,Junshi Chen,Zhao Jing,Jun Shi,Hong An*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TERRA是一个面向高分辨率地球预测模型的分层并行训练框架，通过采样感知的窗口/序列/张量并行（SAWSTP）和记忆编排（MO）技术，在96块H200 GPU上支持多达114亿参数的模型训练，峰值算力达到39.76 PFLOPS，强扩展效率65.0%、弱扩展效率94.1%，并将峰值显存占用降低32.2%-51.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率AI地球预测模型的训练内存开销巨大：基于窗口的Swin Transformer虽降低了全局注意力的二次方计算复杂度，但现有分布式系统（如AERIS）主要针对像素级模型，无法同时支持卷积采样模块和移位窗口执行；长预报范围的rollout微调进一步加剧了激活内存压力。

Method: 提出了两个核心组件：(1) 采样感知窗口、序列和张量并行（SAWSTP），为采样模块保持空间连续的布局，并为Transformer执行将token路由为拓扑感知的不规则窗口布局；(2) 记忆编排（MO），提供rollout感知的检查点规划和输入缓冲，结合预算约束的激活卸载，用于长预报微调。

Result: 在基于1/12° GLORYS的Wenhai工作负载上，TERRA可在96块H200 GPU上支持高达114亿参数的模型，持续算力达39.76 PFLOPS，实现65.0%的强扩展效率和94.1%的弱扩展效率。与仅检查点的策略相比，MO将峰值分配的GPU内存降低32.2%-51.8%，同时步时开销最多20.0%，使更小patch尺寸和更长rollout的微调成为可能。

Conclusion: TERRA有效解决了高分辨率地球预测模型训练中的内存与分布式并行协同问题，通过联合支持采样模块与移位窗口执行，以及面向长rollout微调的显存编排，显著提升了超大模型训练的可行性和算力利用率，为更高精度的地球预测提供了可行的训练基础设施。

Abstract: Training high-resolution AI-based Earth forecasting models is memory-intensive. Window-based Swin Transformers reduce the quadratic cost of global attention, but existing distributed systems such as AERIS primarily target pixel-level models and do not jointly support convolutional sampling modules and shifted-window execution. Long-lead rollout finetuning further increases activation memory. To address these challenges, we present TERRA, a hierarchical parallel training framework for high-resolution Earth forecasting. TERRA introduces Sampling-Aware Window, Sequence, and Tensor Parallelism (SAWSTP), which preserves spatially contiguous layouts for sampling modules and routes tokens into topology-aware ragged window layouts for Transformer execution. For long-lead finetuning, Memory Orchestration (MO) provides rollout-aware checkpoint planning and combines input buffering with budget-constrained activation offloading. Experiments on the $1/12^\circ$ GLORYS-based Wenhai workload show that TERRA supports models with up to 11.4B parameters on 96 H200 GPUs and sustains up to $39.76$ PFLOPS, achieving $65.0\%$ strong-scaling and $94.1\%$ weak-scaling efficiency. Compared with checkpoint-only policies, MO further reduces peak allocated GPU memory by $32.2\%$--$51.8\%$ with at most $20.0\%$ step-time overhead, which makes finetuning with smaller patch sizes and longer rollouts feasible for improved forecasting accuracy.

</details>


### [264] [DCA-MoE: Spatially Adaptive Cross-Layer Fusion and Density-Routed Experts for Crowd Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15213)
*Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DCA-MoE框架，通过Spatially Adaptive Layer Fusion (SALF)和Density-Routed Multi-Receptive-Field Experts (DR-MoE)实现内容自适应的特征融合与感受野选择，用于群聚计数任务。在NWPU-Crowd验证集上，基于DINOv3 ViT-L/16的配置获得31.7 MAE和72.2 RMSE，但跨数据集结果不一致，需要更多配对和多种子评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有群聚计数方法的多层级解码器大多使用空间不变的特征融合方式，且对每个位置应用统一的感受野模式，无法适应透视变化、头部尺度差异、遮挡和背景杂乱等复杂场景下局部密度的剧变。

Method: 提出DCA-MoE框架：(1) Spatially Adaptive Layer Fusion (SALF)为每个位置预测四个对齐骨干特征的逐位置权重；(2) Density-Routed Multi-Receptive-Field Experts (DR-MoE)为每个位置分配局部、中距离和大上下文残差专家的软混合；(3) 采用EBC风格头部重建块密度，使用DMCount监督和辅助路由平衡项训练解码器，冻结DINOv3骨干不更新。

Result: 在NWPU-Crowd验证集上，DINOv3 ViT-L/16的最强配对配置获得31.7 MAE和72.2 RMSE；ViT-B/16完整模型获得32.2/75.9的配对结果。跨数据集结果参差不齐，多个组件基线仍从单种子报告中独立选择最小值。

Conclusion: 证据表明空间自适应融合和路由的可行性，但需要更广泛的配对和多种子评估才能进行因果归因。

Abstract: Crowd counting must recover reliable local density under severe variations in perspective, head scale, occlusion, and background clutter. Although modern counting objectives provide strong spatial supervision, many multi-level decoders still use spatially invariant feature fusion and apply one receptive-field pattern to every location. We propose DCA-MoE, a framework that makes both decisions content dependent while retaining a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Spatially Adaptive Layer Fusion (SALF) predicts position-wise weights over four aligned backbone features, and Density-Routed Multi-Receptive-Field Experts (DR-MoE) assigns each location a soft mixture of local, mid-range, and large-context residual experts. An EBC-style head reconstructs block density, while DMCount supervision and an auxiliary routing-balance term train the decoder without updating the backbone. On the NWPU-Crowd validation split, the strongest paired configuration, based on DINOv3 ViT-L/16, obtains 31.7 MAE and 72.2 RMSE; the matched ViT-B/16 full model obtains a paired 32.2/75.9. Cross-dataset results remain mixed, and several component baselines currently report independently selected minima from a single seed. The evidence therefore supports the feasibility of spatially adaptive fusion and routing, while broader paired and multi-seed evaluation remains necessary for causal attribution.

</details>


### [265] [Self-Supervised Topologically Invariant Manifold Learning for Railway Image Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15217)
*Tingqiong Cui,Yibu Yang,Yang Li,Jiahao Fu,Xiaoliu Luo,Xu Wang,Mengzhu Wang,Siyuan Liu,Guanghui Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于拓扑不变流形学习的全自监督盲图像质量评价(BIQA)框架，无需人工标注即可构建稳定的质量参考，并在合成、真实与工业场景中展现了卓越的零样本迁移能力和拓扑鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有BIQA方法依赖合成失真和人为主观标注，限制了其在真实世界域中的泛化能力。为突破这一瓶颈，亟需一种无需人工标签、具备强泛化能力的自监督质量评价方案。

Method: 框架核心包括：(1) 通过重复随机裁剪生成渐进背景稀释尺度，利用目标信息密度单调递减特性构建自约束质量流形；(2) 线性化空间矩投影消除随机裁剪引入的几何失真；(3) 单调性散度滤波器剔除背景敏感评估器，筛出精英池M_elite；(4) 结合主成分稳定器的稳健M估计器将各度量融合为渐近有效伪真值q_PGT，使方差趋近Cramér-Rao下界。

Result: 从11个基线度量中蒸馏出的精英评估器池在CSIQ、LIVEC、LIVE-2等标准合成及野生基准上取得优越的零样本迁移性能；在CQU铁路车辆巡检监控数据集(2797张图像)上，流形余弦相似度超过0.999，工业极端应力下存活率达100%。

Conclusion: 该框架通过拓扑不变流形学习与边界约束，成功实现了无监督条件下的稳健质量评价，验证了跨范式解耦能力与拓扑弹性，为真实及工业场景的BIQA提供了可靠方案。

Abstract: Existing blind image quality assessment (BIQA) methods typically rely on synthetic distortions and subjective annotations, limiting generalization in real-world domains. To address this, we propose a fully self-supervised BIQA framework based on topologically invariant manifold learning under boundary constraints, which constructs a stable quality reference without manual labels. The framework generates progressive background dilution scales via repeated random cropping around each target; exploiting the monotonic degradation of target information density across these scales, it establishes a self-constrained quality manifold. A linearized spatial moment projection eliminates geometric distortions from random cropping; then a monotonicity divergence filter prunes background-sensitive evaluators, isolating an elite pool \(\mathcal{M}_{\text{elite}}\). A robust M-estimator with a principal component stabilizer fuses the metrics into an asymptotically efficient pseudo-ground truth \(q_{\text{PGT}}\), contracting variance toward the Cramér-Rao lower bound. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the elite evaluator pool, distilled from 11 baseline metrics, secures superior zero-shot transferability across standard synthetic and wild benchmarks (CSIQ, LIVEC, LIVE-2). Concurrently, deployments on the CQU Railway Rolling Stock Surveillance Dataset (2,797 images) yield a manifold cosine similarity \(>0.999\) and a 100.0\% survival rate under industrial extreme stresses, robustly validating its cross-paradigm decoupling and topological resilience.

</details>


### [266] [PersonaDrive: Controllable Trajectory Prediction with Multi-Dimensional Driving Personas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15230)
*Chan Lee,Kimin Yun,Yuseok Bae,Seong Tae Kim,Jung Uk Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PCT数据集和PersonaDrive框架，用于学习并生成具有可控性的驾驶个性轨迹。PCT将驾驶个性沿时间紧迫性和乘坐舒适性两个维度分解为9种组合，并配以自然语言描述；PersonaDrive通过PCAT锚点变换和PCMF多模态融合，配合层级引导损失与轴向分解多样性损失，实现个性化轨迹预测。实验表明其在多维度场景中优于对比基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的轨迹预测与端到端自动驾驶方法虽提升了城市环境的鲁棒性，但缺乏有意义的可控性。已有基准要么缺少个性条件标注，要么只支持单一紧迫性频谱（紧急/正常/放松），无法区分具有相同紧迫性等级却需要不同驾驶动态的个性。

Method: 提出两条创新：(i) PCT数据集，沿时间紧迫性与乘坐舒适性两个轴（各三级）构成九宫格个性网格，每个个性附带自然语言描述和轨迹；(ii) PersonaDrive框架，内含Persona-Conditioned Anchor Transform (PCAT)沿两轴层级重塑锚点，以及Persona-Conditioned Multi-Modal Fusion (PCMF)进行BEV级个性融合。训练由Hierarchical Guide Loss保证轴向物理排序、Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss防止对角模式坍缩共同监督。

Result: 实验结果表明，PersonaDrive在多维度场景中一致性地优于所对比的基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过二维个性分解与语言驱动的条件生成，PersonaDrive实现了超越单一紧迫性频谱的精细驾驶个性可控性，代码与数据集已开源。

Abstract: Although recent trajectory prediction and end-to-end autonomous driving methods improve robustness in urban environments, they still lack meaningful controllability. Existing benchmarks either provide no persona-conditioned annotations or support only a single urgency spectrum (i.e., emergency, normal, relaxed), which cannot distinguish personas that share the same urgency level but require different driving dynamics. To address this, we propose (i) the Persona-Conditioned Trajectory (PCT) dataset, which decomposes driving personas along two axes, Temporal Urgency and Ride Comfort, and combines three levels of each to form a grid of nine personas, each paired with natural-language descriptions and trajectories, and (ii) PersonaDrive, a framework that can learn driving personas from language and can generate persona-specific trajectories. PersonaDrive incorporates Persona-Conditioned Anchor Transform (PCAT), which hierarchically reshapes anchors along both axes, and Persona-Conditioned Multi-Modal Fusion (PCMF) for BEV-level persona fusion. Training is supervised by a Hierarchical Guide Loss enforcing axis-aligned physical orderings and an Axis-Decomposed Diversity Loss preventing diagonal mode collapse. Experimental results show that PersonaDrive consistently improves over the compared baselines across multi-dimensional scenarios. The code and PCT dataset are available at https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/PersonaDrive

</details>


### [267] [UC-VLM: Consistency-Driven Learning for AI-Generated Image Detection with Vision-Language Large Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15238)
*Lei Tan,Shuwei Li,Mohan Kankanhalli,Robby T. Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UC-VLM是一个统一的多阶段框架，仅依赖二元监督进行AI生成图像（AIGI）检测。它自动识别有效的指令变体，并通过视觉判别目标和标签条件生成目标重用二元标签，同时监督视觉路径和文本输出，无需人工标注理由或手工设计提示词。在GenImage上达到96.1%的准确率，在Chameleon上显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于VLLM的AIGI检测器主要微调语言侧，对低层视觉取证线索关注不足；同时依赖人工设计的提示词或人工标注的理由，限制了可扩展性。

Method: UC-VLM采用统一多阶段框架：(1)自动识别有效的指令变体；(2)视觉判别目标——增强对非语义取证线索的敏感性；(3)标签条件生成目标——使用二元标签监督文本输出。整个框架将弱二元监督转化为共享监督信号，同时作用于视觉通路和语言输出。

Result: 在GenImage上平均准确率达96.1%，超过最强先前结果4.6%；在Chameleon上ProGAN/SDV1.4训练下分别取得69.6%/77.9%准确率，超越最佳基线11.2%/15.3%。

Conclusion: UC-VLM证明了仅依靠二元监督即可在无需人工编写理由或提示词的情况下，通过统一的多阶段训练框架实现高效的AIGI检测，同时兼顾视觉层取证线索和语言层输出的一致性。

Abstract: Vision-Language Large Models (VLLMs) are promising for AI-generated image (AIGI) detection because they can produce both a prediction and a natural-language output. However, most existing VLLM-based detectors primarily fine-tune the language side while giving limited attention to low-level visual forensic cues. They also often depend on manually crafted prompts or human-annotated rationales, which limits scalability.We present UC-VLM, a unified multi-stage framework for AIGI detection that relies solely on binary supervision. UC-VLM first identifies effective instruction variants automatically. It then reuses the same binary label within a multi-stage training framework: (i) a visual discrimination objective that strengthens sensitivity to non-semantic forensic cues, and (ii) a label-conditioned generation objective that uses the binary label to supervise textual outputs. This design turns weak binary supervision into a shared supervision signal for both the visual pathway and the language output. Our key novelty is a unified multi-stage binary-supervised framework that consistently reuses the same authenticity labels for visual adaptation and label-conditioned text generation, while leveraging automatically optimized instructions to reduce prompt sensitivity without requiring human-written rationales or hand-crafted prompts.Experiments show that UC-VLM achieves 96.1% average accuracy on GenImage, exceeding the strongest prior result by 4.6%, and obtains 69.6% / 77.9% accuracy on Chameleon under ProGAN / SDV1.4 training, surpassing the best baseline by 11.2% / 15.3%, respectively.

</details>


### [268] [CG-GLORE: A Conjugate Gradient-Based Global-Local Regularization Network for Sparse-View CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15246)
*Tran Xuan Hieu Le,Doanh C. Bui,Vu Trung Duong Le,Hoai Luan Pham,Khang Nguyen,Mai K. Nguyen,Tu Bao Ho,Yasuhiko Nakashima*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CG-GLORE，一种受二阶优化启发的紧凑深度展开框架，用于稀疏视角CT重建。该框架在每级展开中使用基于结构化Hessian近似、由CG求解的线性系统，并设计了结合卷积局部特征与Nyström注意力长程依赖建模的GLORE先验网络，在AAPM和DeepLesion数据集上取得了优于代表性方法的重建性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角CT能降低辐射剂量但反问题高度病态，易产生严重条状伪影。现有深度重建方法多依赖一阶更新或大规模正则化网络，在病态条件下效果有限，需要更有效的二阶优化启发的重建方法。

Method: 提出CG-GLORE深度展开框架：每级展开使用基于结构化Hessian近似（数据保真项的物理诱导曲率+正则化项的恒等近似）的CG求解线性系统，实现二阶优化启发迭代；同时设计GLORE网络，联合卷积局部特征提取与基于稀疏分块和Nyström注意力的长程依赖表示模块，兼顾解剖细节与非局部依赖且保持计算复杂度可控。

Result: 在AAPM和DeepLesion数据集上，针对多种稀疏视角和噪声设置，CG-GLORE相比代表性重建方法取得更强的定量性能、更稳定的收敛、更低的噪声功率以及更好的视觉保真度。

Conclusion: CG-GLORE验证了二阶优化启发式深度展开在稀疏视角CT重建中的有效性，通过保留数据保真项的物理曲率信息和引入全局-局部联合先验建模，在病态条件下实现了高效、稳定且高质量的重建。

Abstract: Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reduces radiation dose by acquiring fewer projection views, but the resulting inverse problem is highly ill-posed and often produces severe streak artifacts. Existing deep reconstruction methods have achieved promising performance, yet many rely on first-order updates or large regularization networks, which can be less effective in ill-conditioned settings. We propose \textbf{CG-GLORE}, a compact deep unrolling framework inspired by second-order optimization for sparse-view CT reconstruction. Each unrolled stage uses a CG-solved linear system based on a structured Hessian surrogate: it retains the physics-induced curvature of the data-fidelity term while using an identity approximation for the learned regularization term. Thus, the method is second-order-inspired rather than an exact Newton method for the full learned objective. To model image priors, we design a Global-Local Regularization Network (GLORE), which combines convolutional local feature extraction with a Long-Range Dependency Representation module based on sparse patchification and Nyström attention. This design captures anatomical details and non-local dependencies while maintaining practical complexity. Experiments on AAPM and DeepLesion under multiple sparse-view and noise settings show that CG-GLORE achieves strong quantitative performance, stable convergence, lower noise power, and improved visual fidelity compared with representative reconstruction methods.

</details>


### [269] [Robust structure from motion for aerial-ground images via detector-free feature matching and multi-view track refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15251)
*San Jiang,Hui Wang,Xing Zhang,Zhongwen Hu,Zhijun Wang,Ruisheng Wang,Wanshou Jiang,Qingquan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种旋转鲁棒的检测器无关匹配网络，结合多视角轨迹细化用于增量式运动恢复结构（ISfM），通过旋转感知特征提取、多尺度注意力变换、双向特征匹配和多视角轨迹细化四个模块，解决了航拍-地面图像中视点、尺度和旋转剧烈变化导致的特征匹配难题，显著提升了3D重建精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航拍-地面图像集成的3D重建对高精度城市三维模型至关重要，但视点、尺度和旋转的剧烈变化使鲁棒特征匹配极具挑战性，现有方法难以有效处理这些变化。

Method: 提出四个关键模块：(1) 旋转感知特征提取——用全向状态空间块（OSS Block）替代传统卷积，在八个对称方向选择性扫描以建模长距离空间依赖并合成旋转不变特征图；(2) 多尺度注意力变换——利用四叉树注意力构建层次化token金字塔，隔离高关联token区域并丢弃无关区域，以线性复杂度捕获长范围上下文；(3) 双向特征匹配——执行对称的粗到细匹配方案，粗对齐在互最近邻约束下计算双向Softmax置信矩阵，细对齐用MLP回归亚像素坐标偏移；(4) 多视角轨迹细化——用集成索引结构评估局部空间邻近性并将断裂的子轨迹链接到最高置信锚点，确保ISfM管线中的特征可重复性。

Result: 在真实航拍-地面数据集上，该方法在5°位姿误差下AUC相比LoFTR提升93.9%，且在ISfM重建中达到最高精度，精度提升范围为27.6%至32.7%。

Conclusion: 所提方法为航拍-地面图像集成3D重建提供了可靠解决方案。

Abstract: Integrated 3D reconstruction from aerial-ground images is essential for generating high-precision urban 3D models, yet severe variations in viewpoint, scale, and rotation make robust feature matching highly challenging. To address these limitations, this study introduces a rotation-robust detector-free matching network coupled with multi-view track refinement for incremental Structure from Motion (ISfM). The proposed workflow features four key modules. First, rotation-aware feature extraction replaces traditional convolutions with an Omnidirectional State Space Block (OSS Block) that selectively scans across eight symmetrical directions to model long-range spatial dependencies and synthesize rotation-invariant feature maps. Second, multi-scale attention transformation utilizes quadtree attention to build a hierarchical token pyramid that isolates high-association token regions and discards irrelevant areas, capturing long-range context with linear computational complexity. Third, bi-directional feature matching executes a symmetric coarse-to-fine matching scheme where coarse alignment computes dual-direction Softmax confidence matrices under mutual nearest neighbor constraints, and fine alignment uses a multi-layer perceptron to regress sub-pixel coordinate offsets. Finally, multi-view track refinement employs an integrated indexing structure to evaluate localized spatial proximity and link disjoint sub-tracks to the highest-confidence anchor point, ensuring stable feature repeatability across the ISfM pipeline. By using real aerial-ground datasets, experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method improves AUC at 5° pose error by 93.9% compared with LoFTR and achieves the highest precision in ISfM reconstruction, with the improved accuracy ranging from 27.6% to 32.7%. The proposed method provides a reliable solution for integrated 3D reconstruction of aerial-ground images.

</details>


### [270] [UAV Video Deblurring via Motion-Aware Diffusion: A Path to Robust Target Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15259)
*Zhiqiang Hu,Shouren Huang,Masatoshi Ishikawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种计算高效且有效的无人机视频去模糊方法，通过自适应潜在尺度选择器动态调整分辨率以平衡细节与效率，并引入多帧对齐与可学习门控模块保证时序一致性，显著提升去模糊效果和下游目标检测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机航拍视频因快速飞行、振动和相机摇摄常遭受严重运动模糊，这会显著降低目标检测等下游任务的性能。现有视频去模糊方法计算成本高，难以满足无人机实时处理需求，因此亟需一种计算高效且有效的去模糊方法来增强无人机目标检测能力。

Method: 1) 提出自适应潜在尺度选择器（Adaptive Latent Scale Selector），根据无人机运动强度动态调整潜在空间分辨率，在细节保留与推理效率间取得平衡；2) 引入多帧对齐与可学习门控模块（Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating），对前序帧进行扭曲和门控，仅融合相关的时序信息并抑制错位或无信息量的特征。

Result: 在真实无人机基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法不仅获得了优越的去模糊性能，还显著提升了目标检测精度，验证了其在实际空中视觉任务中的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法能有效从无人机视频流中恢复清晰细节，兼顾计算效率与去模糊质量，对稳健的空中视觉任务具有很高的实用价值。

Abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) play a crucial role in various scenarios ranging from disaster response to traffic surveillance. However, aerial video footage often suffers from severe motion blur due to rapid flight maneuvers, vibrations, and camera panning, which can significantly degrade downstream tasks such as target detection. Our goal is to explore a computationally-efficient and effective video deblurring approach to enhance UAV target detection performance. To reduce computational cost, we first propose an Adaptive Latent Scale Selector that dynamically adjusts the latent space resolution according to the intensity of UAV motion, thus balancing detail preservation with inference efficiency. To ensure temporal consistency, we introduce a Multi-Frame Alignment and Learnable Gating module to warp and gate the preceding frames, allowing the model to fuse only relevant temporal information and suppress misaligned or uninformative features. Our method can effectively recover sharp details from the UAV video stream. Extensive experiments on real UAV benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only yields superior deblurring performance but also significantly boosts target detection accuracy, making it highly applicable to robust aerial vision tasks.

</details>


### [271] [VGGT-Align: Bridging Local Reconstruction and Global Consistency for Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15260)
*Wei Zhang,Yihang Wu,Songhua Li,Qi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种尺度一致性增强框架，通过场景几何不变量锚定（SGIA）将7自由度Sim(3)对齐退化为6自由度刚体变换，切断长序列3D重建中链式尺度漂移的传播；同时引入轻量级测试时自适应策略，仅微调归一化层参数，实现即插即用且无需离线重训的行车场景长序列重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长序列3D重建中，分块（chunk-based）推理管线的尺度自由度在顺序Sim(3)对齐中不受约束，导致估计误差乘法性累积，使全局轨迹和点云几何产生严重畸变。这是尺度漂移这一核心失效模式的根本原因。

Method: 1) SGIA（场景几何不变量锚定）：从每个分块预测点云中通过粗到精鲁棒估计提取主导几何不变量，利用其跨分块一致性建立独立于点云配准的尺度约束，将7-DoF Sim(3)对齐显式退化为6-DoF刚体变换，从源头切断链式尺度误差传播。2) 轻量级测试时自适应：通过多目标自监督仅微调归一化层参数，沿序列渐进改善分块内预测。两模块均可即插即用，无需离线重训。

Result: 在多个长序列基准上取得当前最优性能，绝对轨迹误差降低高达32%，轨迹稳定性和重建质量均有显著提升。

Conclusion: SGIA和测试时自适应策略有效解决了长序列重建中的尺度漂移问题，验证了结构化环境中场景几何不变量的跨分块一致性可作为尺度约束的核心洞察，为长序列3D重建提供了一种无需重训的轻量级增强方案。

Abstract: Maintaining global geometric consistency is a central challenge in long-sequence 3D reconstruction, with scale drift being the most critical failure mode. In chunk-based inference pipelines, the scale degree of freedom in sequential Sim(3) alignment is left unconstrained, causing estimation errors to compound multiplicatively and distort global trajectories and point cloud geometry. We present a scale-consistency enhancement framework built on a key insight: in structured environments such as driving scenes, geometric quantities arising from environmental regularity remain inherently invariant across temporal segments, and discrepancies in their per-chunk measurements directly expose inter-chunk scale drift. We propose Scene Geometric Invariant Anchoring (SGIA), which extracts dominant geometric invariants from each chunk's predicted point cloud via coarse-to-fine robust estimation and exploits their cross-chunk consistency to establish scale constraints independent of point cloud registration, explicitly degenerating 7-DoF Sim(3) alignment into 6-DoF rigid-body transformation and severing chain-wise scale error propagation at its source. We further introduce a lightweight test-time adaptation strategy that fine-tunes only normalization-layer parameters via multi-objective self-supervision, progressively improving intra-chunk predictions along the sequence. Both modules are plug-and-play and require no offline retraining. Experiments on multiple long-sequence benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, reducing absolute trajectory error by up to 32% with significant gains in trajectory stability and reconstruction quality. Code: https://github.com/WZ-CS/VGGT-Align

</details>


### [272] [Boundary-Aligned Contribution Routing for Robust Optical--SAR Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15261)
*Haifa Zhang,Yijing Wang,Haoyu Wang,Zheng Li,Zhiqiang Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于任务效用的模态贡献路由机制（fusion-boundary-aligned routing），仅利用检测监督信号即可调控光学-SAR融合目标检测中每种模态的贡献，有效缓解跨模态负迁移，在M4-SAR和SpaceNet6-OTD数据集上显著提升完整输入和缺失模态场景下的检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学图像和SAR图像具有互补优势，但多模态融合并不保证有益——空间、时间和语义上的不完美对应可能导致条件性有害的跨模态负迁移。现有方法需要显式的效用监督、质量标签等额外信息，本文希望仅用检测监督本身就能学习调节各模态贡献，从而在不需要额外标注的情况下缓解负迁移问题。

Method: 从模型特定的任务效用视角出发，在首次跨模态特征值混合操作之前调节各模态贡献。针对不同架构设计了两类路由器：(1) Feature Router——用于频繁浅层交互的架构，在输入附近进行跨条件、组可寻址的调制；(2) Dual-Statistic Semantic Router——用于双骨干架构，在晚期语义融合前从模态特定的平均和最大值统计信息预测流级贡献权重。路由无需显式效用监督、质量标签、重建或蒸馏。

Result: 在M4-SAR和SpaceNet6-OTD上，覆盖完整输入、受控对应偏移、缺失模态及四种非零模态损坏场景。相对干净训练基线，路由在完整输入下mAP50提升0.5-5.9点；相对对应模态丢弃基线，缺失模态mAP50提升7.6-41.6点，负迁移率降低最多12.7个百分点。学习到的路由权重与留一模态效用之间的Spearman相关系数达0.45-0.66。

Conclusion: 本文证明仅依靠检测监督即可学习有效的模态贡献路由，该方法能在不引入额外监督或复杂组件的情况下抑制跨模态负迁移，且路由权重具有任务效用解释性，为多模态遥感目标检测提供了一种轻量而有效的融合调控范式。

Abstract: Optical imagery provides rich appearance cues, whereas synthetic aperture radar (SAR) offers observations that are less sensitive to illumination and weather, making optical--SAR fusion attractive for remote-sensing object detection. However, the presence of multiple modalities does not guarantee beneficial fusion: imperfect spatial, temporal, and semantic correspondence can make an otherwise intact stream conditionally harmful and induce negative cross-modal transfer. We handle this issue through a model-specific task-utility perspective and learn task-conditioned contribution routing using detection supervision alone. The proposed fusion-boundary-aligned routing regulates each modality's contribution before the first learned cross-modal feature-value mixing operation. For architectures with frequent shallow interaction, a Feature Router performs cross-conditioned, group-addressable modulation near the input; for dual-backbone architectures, a Dual-Statistic Semantic Router predicts stream-level contribution weights from modality-specific average and maximum statistics before late semantic fusion. The routers require no explicit utility supervision, quality labels, reconstruction, or distillation. Experiments on M4-SAR and SpaceNet6-OTD cover nominal full inputs, controlled correspondence shifts, missing modalities, and four nonzero modality-corruption scenarios. Across the reported clean-training controls, routing improves full-input $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 0.5--5.9 points. Relative to the corresponding modality-dropout baselines, it raises missing-modality $\text{mAP}_{50}$ by 7.6--41.6 points and reduces the negative-transfer rate by up to 12.7 percentage points. Spearman correlations between the learned routing weights and model-specific leave-one-modality-out utility range from 0.45 to 0.66, supporting the task-utility interpretation of the routing coefficients.

</details>


### [273] [On the Adversarial Robustness of Remote Sensing Semantic Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15267)
*Weikang Yu,Yonghao Xu,Pedram Ghamisi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个针对语义变化检测（SCD）任务的任务特定对抗鲁棒性评估框架，在四个数据集和六种代表性模型上系统分析了组件级与时序级攻击目标、单/双时间戳扰动、多种攻击方法及跨架构迁移性，发现最终语义变化预测易被严重破坏而二值变化定位相对稳定，单时间戳扰动可跨时序传播，但跨模型迁移攻击弱于白盒攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义变化检测（SCD）是耦合两个时间戳输入的密集预测任务，涉及时间戳级语义预测、变化定位和语义变化解码，这些组件之间存在对抗性依赖关系。然而，现有鲁棒性评估协议（如针对单图像分割或二值变化检测的协议）无法捕捉这种耦合架构下的脆弱性与攻击传播特性，因此需要一个任务特定的系统性评估框架。

Method: 提出一个将输出侧攻击目标与输入侧时序扰动访问权限相分离的两维评估框架，用于系统分析组件脆弱性与跨时序传播。实验中在四个数据集上对六种代表性模型（涵盖CNN、Transformer和状态空间模型三类架构）进行全面的评估，包括组件级与时序级攻击目标、单/双时间戳扰动、多种攻击方法以及跨架构的攻击迁移性分析。

Result: 实验发现：（1）即使二值变化定位保持相对稳定，最终的语义变化预测也可能被严重破坏；（2）与某一时间戳相关的扰动或攻击目标可以传播到另一时间戳的预测中；（3）这些行为在不同架构家族中普遍存在；（4）直接的跨模型攻击迁移性显著弱于白盒攻击。

Conclusion: 研究表明SCD的对抗鲁棒性取决于完整的时间位点预测通路（而非单个分支或骨干网络家族），并提供了一个结构化的鲁棒性评估协议，适用于耦合双时相图像分析任务。

Abstract: Semantic change detection (SCD) is a bitemporal dense-prediction task that jointly identifies changed regions and their semantic states before and after change. Unlike single-image segmentation or binary change detection, SCD couples two temporal inputs with timestamp-wise semantic prediction, change localization, and final semantic-change decoding, creating adversarial dependencies that are not captured by conventional robustness protocols. We present a task-specific evaluation framework that separates output-side attack objectives from input-side temporal perturbation access, enabling systematic analysis of component vulnerability and cross-temporal propagation. Experiments on four datasets and six representative CNN-, Transformer-, and state-space-based models evaluate component-level and temporal objectives, single- and dual-timestamp perturbations, multiple attack methods, and cross-architecture transferability. The results show that final semantic-change predictions can be severely corrupted even when binary change localization remains comparatively stable, and that perturbations or attack objectives associated with one timestamp can propagate to the prediction of the other. These behaviors occur across different architecture families, while direct cross-model transfer remains considerably weaker than white-box attacks. The study demonstrates that adversarial robustness in SCD depends on the complete bitemporal prediction pathway rather than on an individual branch or backbone family, and provides a structured protocol for evaluating robustness in coupled bitemporal image analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/EricYu97/AdvSCD.

</details>


### [274] [Memory-Bounded Continuation of Greedy Sampling for Continual Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15277)
*Yoon Gyo Jung,Jaewoo Park,Kuan-Chuan Peng,Seongdeok Bang,Octavia Camps*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出ContCore，一种基于贪婪采样的固定内存持续异常检测方法。通过"贪婪扩展+贪婪整合"的持续贪婪采样策略，在严格内存约束下保持核心集的代表性，提供有界近似的理论保证，并在MVTecAD和VisA上11个任务调度中取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续异常检测需要在任务序列到达时保持紧凑且具有代表性的正常数据摘要，但实际部署要求固定内存，核心集大小不随任务数增长。朴素的持续贪婪采样在严格内存限制下的质量退化行为尚不清楚，需要一种既能保持代表性又满足固定内存约束的方法。

Method: ContCore通过两阶段策略构建贪婪延续核心集：(1) 贪婪扩展——在新任务特征上进行贪婪选择以纳入新数据；(2) 贪婪整合——对已选样本进行贪婪压缩以满足内存预算。该方法在每一步丢弃数据以维持固定内存，并证明所得核心集与最优oracle核心集的差距有界。

Result: ContCore在MVTecAD和VisA数据集的11个任务调度上取得SOTA性能，并在在线持续异常检测设置下表现优异，优于受灾难性遗忘影响的神经方法以及需要无限内存的朴素核心集累积方法。

Conclusion: 持续贪婪采样在固定内存约束下能优雅地保持核心集代表性而非灾难性退化，为实用化的持续异常检测提供了有理论保障且内存高效的解决方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: Greedy sampling produces a compact yet representative summary of normal data, which is essential for reliable anomaly detection that relies on measuring distance from normality. For continual anomaly detection where tasks arrive sequentially, extending greedy sampling is straightforward with unbounded memory through coreset accumulation. However, practical deployment requires fixed memory where the coreset size remains constant regardless of task count. We observe that continued greedy sampling, which iteratively applies greedy selection over previously greedy-sampled sets, effectively preserves representativeness under strict memory limits. Despite discarding data at each step to satisfy the memory constraint, coreset quality degrades gracefully rather than catastrophically, enabling reliable anomaly detection across the tasks. We provide theoretical justification by showing that resulting greedy-continued coreset approximates the oracle coreset within a bounded gap. We instantiate this principle in ContCore, which constructs a greedy-continued coreset through greedy expansion on new task features followed by greedy consolidation to enforce the memory budget. Unlike neural methods susceptible to catastrophic forgetting or naive coreset accumulation requiring unbounded memory, ContCore maintains fixed memory with theoretical guarantees. Empirically, ContCore achieves state-of-the-art performance across 11 task schedules on MVTecAD and VisA, and extends effectively to online continual AD settings where prior methods degrade significantly. Code: https://github.com/jungyg/ContCore

</details>


### [275] [Geometry-Aware Spatio-Temporal Context Modeling for 4D Occupancy Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15279)
*Sitao Chen,Zhuangwei Zhuang,Hui Luo,Qingyao Wu,Mingkui Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GAST（Geometry-Aware Spatio-Temporal context modeling），一种用于4D占用预测的几何感知时空上下文建模方法，通过渐进式显式-隐式生成与双路径时空建模，在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上实现mIoU提升7.67%、IoU提升6.44%，并带来2.84倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4D占用预测方法多依赖离散token化后的自回归预测，但在静态结构的几何形变和预测时域上的时间一致性方面存在缺陷，亟需更优的建模方法。

Method: GAST包含两大模块：(1) 生成模块，通过姿态驱动的warping、运动感知特征调制和注意力特征精化，逐帧生成具有高几何保真度和语义合理性的占用结果；(2) 时空模块，通过全局上下文聚合增强空间一致性，并通过时间动态提取捕捉场景演化。采用渐进式显式-隐式生成与双路径时空建模，实现历史重建与未来预测的端到端联合优化。

Result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上超越SOTA，mIoU提升7.67%，IoU提升6.44%，推理速度提升2.84倍，且在长期预测场景中保持强性能。

Conclusion: 统一的历史重建与未来预测联合优化框架有效解决了几何形变与时间一致性问题，为自动驾驶拐角场景模拟提供了高效且精确的4D占用预测方案。

Abstract: 4D occupancy forecasting models the spatio-temporal evolution of 3D scenes and is crucial for autonomous driving, especially for corner-case simulation. Existing methods often rely on discrete tokenization followed by autoregressive prediction, yet struggle with geometric distortion in static structures and inconsistent temporal coherence over the forecasting horizon. In this work, we propose a Geometry-Aware Spatio-Temporal context modeling method (GAST) for 4D occupancy forecasting, built upon progressive explicit-implicit generation and dual-path spatio-temporal modeling. Specifically, the generation module produces per-frame occupancy with high geometric fidelity and semantic plausibility through pose-driven warping, motion-aware feature modulation, and attention-based feature refinement. Subsequently, the spatio-temporal module enhances spatial consistency through global context aggregation while capturing scene evolution through temporal dynamics extraction. This unified design enables joint optimization of historical reconstruction and future forecasting in an end-to-end manner. Extensive experiments on Occ3D-nuScenes demonstrate the superiority of our method, outperforming the state-of-the-art by 7.67% in mIoU and 6.44% in IoU with a 2.84x speedup, while maintaining strong performance in long-term forecasting.

</details>


### [276] [SOS! : A Streamlined Object-Conditional Transformer for Model-free Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15295)
*Jiaqi Hu,Junwen Huang,Hongli Xu,Peter KT Yu,Nassir Navab,Benjamin Busam,Slobodan Ilic*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SOS（Streamlined Object-conditional Transformer for model-free Segmentation），一种无需3D模型先验的模型无关目标物体分割框架，仅需单个参考图像即可实现未见物体的精确分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础分割模型虽能生成高质量的类别无关掩码，但无法将提案与特定目标物体建立关联，导致在机器人操作等下游应用中受限。现有方法依赖详尽的3D物体模型先验，计算开销大且流程复杂多阶段。

Method: 提出一种新颖的Object-Conditional Transformer，学习身份锚定查询（identity-anchored queries），将掩码生成与目标识别统一到单次前向传播中，完全消除对3D模型的依赖，仅需每个目标物体一张参考图像。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，SOS在模型无关的未见物体分割任务上达到了新的最先进水平，在保持高准确率的同时实现了高效率。

Conclusion: SOS通过精简的设计极大地提升了结构和计算效率，验证了无需3D先验即可实现高精度、高效率未见物体分割的可行性。

Abstract: Foundation segmentation models excel at generating high-quality, class-agnostic masks, but they struggle to associate these proposals with specific target objects. This semantic gap severely hinders their deployment in downstream applications like robotic manipulation, which demand precise unseen objects segmentation. Existing approaches attempt to resolve this by relying on exhaustive 3D object model priors, inherently introducing prohibitive computational overhead and complex, multi-stage pipelines. To address these limitations, we propose SOS (Streamlined Object-conditional Transformer for model-free Segmentation). SOS completely eliminates the reliance on 3D models, requiring only a single reference image per target object. Central to our framework is a novel Object-Conditional Transformer that learns identity-anchored queries, unifying mask generation and target identification into a single feed-forward pass. This streamlined design drastically improves both structural and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SOS establishes a new state-of-the-art for model-free unseen objects segmentation, delivering accurate and high-efficiency performance. The project page and code are available at https://sos-seg.github.io/.

</details>


### [277] [FMReward: Aligning and Evaluating Audio-Driven 3D Facial Animation with Human Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15296)
*Sijing Wu,Yunhao Li,Zhilin Gao,Huiyu Duan,Yucheng Zhu,Guangtao Zhai,Patrick Le Callet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于人类偏好数据来改进和评估音频驱动3D面部动画感知质量的完整框架，包括首个大规模人类偏好数据集FMPair（65,574对标注样本）、感知奖励模型FMReward，以及基于奖励反馈的微调算法FMFL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频驱动的3D面部动画方法在训练和评估时通常依赖基于ground-truth的误差指标，这些指标与人类偏好不一致，无法准确反映感知质量。作者希望引入人类偏好信号来弥补这一不足。

Method: 该框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 通过系统化标注流程构建FMPair数据集，包含65,574个带注释的3D面部运动对，源自8,834个野外音频片段；(2) 提出FMReward模型，以音频和3D面部运动为输入，输出与人类偏好对齐的感知质量评分；(3) 提出FMFL直接微调算法，利用预训练的奖励模型优化基于扩散的音频驱动3D面部动画模型。

Result: 大量实验表明，FMReward在与人偏好对齐方面优于其他现有评估指标，且FMFL能有效提升音频驱动3D面部动画的感知质量。

Conclusion: 该研究通过引入人类偏好数据驱动的奖励模型和反馈学习机制，有效解决了传统ground-truth指标与人类感知不一致的问题，为音频驱动3D面部动画的生成质量和评估提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Audio-driven 3D facial animation is essential for advancing immersion and interactivity in virtual experiences. Although recent advances have shown promising capabilities, the training and evaluation of existing methods typically rely on ground-truth-based errors, which fall short of aligning with human preferences. To address this, we present a comprehensive framework that learns an automatic perceptual model from human preference data and leverages it to improve and evaluate the perceptual quality of audio-driven 3D facial animation. To begin with, we construct FMPair (Facial Motion Pairwise preference), the first human preference dataset for audio-driven 3D facial animation, which is built through a systematic annotation pipeline and comprises 65,574 annotated 3D facial motion pairs from 8,834 distinct in-the-wild audio clips. Based on the pairwise comparison dataset, we propose a Facial Motion Reward model, termed FMReward, which takes audio and 3D facial motion as inputs and predicts a perceptual quality score aligned with human preferences. Building upon FMReward, we further introduce Facial Motion reward Feedback Learning (FMFL), a direct fine-tuning algorithm that leverages a pretrained reward model to optimize diffusion-based audio-driven 3D facial animation models for better alignment with human preferences.
