Their joint optimization allows Nexus to achieve generation quality comparable to mainstream models such as SDXL and SD3 while delivering markedly higher inference efficiency. Experiments on COCO and LAION validate its effectiveness.

</details>


### [345] [SUGFW+: An Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting Framework for Cold Start Active Adaptation of SAM in Medical Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16110)
*Xiaochuan Ma,Ning Zhu,Jia Fu,Lanfeng Zhong,Hanyu Jiang,Bin Song,Kang Li,Guotai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SUGFW+框架，利用SAM基础模型的通用嵌入特征进行冷启动主动学习（CSAL），通过补丁级特征提取与不确定性计算、全局判别表示聚合模块以及结合聚类与不确定性的贪心选择策略，实现了低标注预算下医学图像分割模型的高效采样与微调，在四个公开数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CSAL方法通常依赖数据集专属的自监督学习（SSL）来映射特征空间用于样本选择，效率低下；尽管SAM等基础模型可提供强泛化性的特征嵌入，但如何系统地利用SAM的固有嵌入进行低标注预算下的冷启动样本选择和适配仍未被充分探索。

Method: SUGFW+框架包含三个核心模块：1) 利用SAM进行补丁级特征与不确定性计算（PFUC）；2) 提出补丁级全局判别表示（PGDR）模块，将补丁级嵌入聚合成高判别力、不确定性感知的图像级特征；3) 采用Greedy Selection with Cluster and Uncertainty（GSCU）策略，在选择样本时结合样本多样性与不确定性。与以往将样本选择与模型训练解耦的方法不同，SUGFW+通过不确定性提示微调（UPFT）过程将两个阶段紧密整合。

Result: 在四个公开医学图像数据集上的大量实验表明，SUGFW+相比现有CSAL方法取得了最优（state-of-the-art）性能。代码已开源。

Conclusion: SUGFW+证明了利用SAM基础模型的固有嵌入进行冷启动主动学习和适配的有效性，通过将样本选择与模型训练紧密耦合，能够在低标注预算下显著提升医学图像分割模型的性能，为CSAL提供了新的研究思路。

Abstract: Cold Start Active Learning (CSAL) is important in improving the performance of a medical image segmentation model with low annotation budget by querying a small subset for annotation from an unlabeled training set. Existing CSAL methods typically rely on inefficient dataset-specific Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) to map the unlabeled images into a feature space for sample selection. Recently, the advent of foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) offer a promising alternative as the pre-trained model can provide strong generalizable feature embeddings, and allow high performance in downstream tasks after fine-tuning (adaptation). However, how to systematically exploit SAM's inherent embeddings for cold-start sample selection during adaptation with low annotation budget remains underexplored. To address this, we propose an extended SAM-based Uncertainty-guided Feature Weighting (SUGFW+) framework for CSAL and adaptation of SAM. Specifically, it leverages the SAM for Patch-level Feature and Uncertainty Calculation (PFUC), and introduces a Patch-based Global Distinct Representation (PGDR) module that aggregates patch-level embeddings into highly discriminative, uncertainty-aware image-level features. These features are then utilized by a Greedy Selection with Cluster and Uncertainty (GSCU) strategy to combine diversity and uncertainty during sample selection. Unlike prior CSAL methods that decouple sample selection from model training, SUGFW+ tightly integrates these two stages via an Uncertainty-Prompted Fine-Tuning (UPFT) process of SAM in model training. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that SUGFW+ achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing CSAL methods. Code is available at https://github.com/HiLab-git/SUGFW-plus.

</details>


### [346] [TokenSTFormer: A Tokenized Spatial-temporal Attention Model for Holistic Motion Analysis in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16122)
*Dong Chen,Kenneth M. C. Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出ScoliGait数据集（包含1,516个步态视频片段及对应X光记录）和TokenSTFormer模型，通过将空间和时间语义进行token化以增强特征表达和收敛性，用于青少年特发性脊柱侧凸（AIS）的自动筛查。模型在步态视频上超越vanilla Vision Transformer，准确率达0.79，展示了基于步态视频和注意力机制的大规模、低成本AIS筛查潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIS如果得不到及时治疗会导致严重的健康后果，而传统筛查方法受限于主观判断、依赖专业经验和可扩展性低等问题，亟需一种客观、可扩展且低成本的自动化筛查方案。

Method: 构建了包含1,516个步态视频片段及对应X光记录的ScoliGait数据集；提出TokenSTFormer模型，通过对空间与时间语义进行token化来增强特征表示和模型收敛性。

Result: TokenSTFormer在多项关键指标上超越vanilla Vision Transformer编码器，实现了0.79的准确率，达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: 研究证明了利用步态视频中提取的整体运动特征结合基于注意力机制的模型，能够实现可扩展、低成本的AIS筛查，为未来脊柱侧凸检测的临床应用奠定了基础。

Abstract: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS) is a prevalent spinal deformity in adolescents that, if left untreated, can result in severe health outcomes. Traditional screening methods are limited by subjective interpretation, reliance on professional expertise and low scalability. To address these challenges, we present ScoliGait dataset, which comprises 1,516 gait video clips paired with corresponding X-ray records. We also introduce TokenSTFormer, a novel model that tokenizes spatial and temporal semantics to enhance feature representation and convergence. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing vanilla Vision Transformer encoder across key metrics, including accuracy of 0.79. This study highlights the potential of leveraging holistic motion features derived from gait video and attention-based models for scalable, cost-effective AIS screening, paving the way for future clinical applications in scoliosis detection.

</details>


### [347] [Graph Neural Assisted Actor-Critic for Latency-Efficient Edge Vision System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16142)
*Alam Noor,Luis Almeida,Kai Li,Jiyan Wu,Miguel Gutiérrez Gaitán,Eduardo Tovar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于图卷积神经网络（GCN）辅助的A2C深度强化学习系统模型，用于无人机机载视觉系统中的最优像素相关区域选择，通过传输帧的子区域而非整帧来降低视频传输延迟，同时提高目标检测准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机视觉系统在禁飞区监控等场景中需要将视频流传输到地面服务器供操作员协助，但视频传输延迟严重影响操作员协助的有效性。现有视频传输技术在延迟方面仍存在显著瓶颈，需要一种更高效的传输策略来优化延迟与检测性能的平衡。

Method: 提出GCN辅助的A2C深度强化学习系统：1) GCN用于探索像素特征相关分组的隐藏表示，识别可疑目标的最优像素相关区域；2) A2C模型在GCN监督下选择向服务器发送的帧子区域而非整帧；3) 将拉格朗日对偶形式与梯度下降结合，防止训练过程中缺乏收敛以及约束违规的过度/不足惩罚。

Result: 实验结果表明，与其它DRL模型和现有最先进方法相比，GCN辅助的A2C模型在降低视频帧传输延迟的同时减少了无人机视觉系统的误检率。

Conclusion: GCN辅助A2C框架有效解决了无人机视频传输延迟优化问题，通过智能选择像素相关子区域进行传输，在不牺牲检测性能的前提下显著提升了传输效率，为无人机实时视觉监控提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: UAV on-board vision systems are widely used for different activities, including monitoring in no-fly zones. In this case, the vision-equipped UAV streams a video to a ground server where an operator assists its activities. The latency of video transmission has a profound impact on the effectiveness of the operator assistance. However, most techniques available for video transmission still incur significant latency costs. In this paper, we propose a graph convolutional neural network-assisted (GCN-Assisted A2C) deep reinforcement learning (DRL) system model to find the optimal pixel-correlated area of a suspicious object. We combine the Lagrangian dual form with gradient descent to prevent lack of convergence and over- and under-penalization constraint violation during latency optimization. The proposed system model sends a sub-group pixel-correlated area of the frame from the UAV to the server rather than the transmission of the whole video frame. The proposed framework utilizes the GCN model to explore hidden representations of feature-correlated groups of pixels. Moreover, the GCN supervises the A2C model, which selects a subgroup to enhance transmission latency, thus supervising the training of UAV actions in A2C. Experimental results show that GCN-assisted A2C reduces video frame transmission latency together with false detection rate in UAV vision systems over other DRL and state-of-the-art models.

</details>


### [348] [The Right Prior for the Right Deformation: Rethinking Continuous Deformable Image Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16146)
*Hengjie Liu,Chushu Shen,Dan Ruan,Ke Sheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对连续可变形图像配准方法进行了验证性研究，系统比较了B样条隐式先验和INR（隐式神经表示）隐式先验在不同配准任务中的性能表现，发现配准精度高度依赖于变形先验与目标运动模式的匹配程度，并提出"先验-变形匹配"作为医学图像配准的实用设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形图像配准模型的参数化和优化方式隐式编码了变形先验，但以往研究缺乏对这些隐式先验如何影响不同配准任务性能的系统性验证。作者希望通过对照实验揭示不同参数化（B样条 vs INR）所施加的先验差异，并验证先验-变形匹配作为设计原则的有效性。

Method: 作者设计了四种连续配准方法进行对比验证：(1) INR-Dense (IDIR)，使用SIREN-based INR直接建模密集位移场；(2) INR-BSCP (SINR)，使用INR预测B样条控制点；(3) D-BSCP，直接优化单尺度B样条控制点；(4) MR-D-BSCP，加入多分辨率粗细配准方案的D-BSCP。在OASIS（跨被试脑部MR）和DIR-LAB 4DCT（被试内呼-吸肺CT）两个数据集上进行实验。

Result: 在OASIS上（中等但局部复杂的变形），D-BSCP匹配或略优于INR-BSCP，表明B样条参数化贡献了INR-BSCP的大部分有效性。在DIR-LAB 4DCT上（更大更连贯的呼吸运动），单尺度B样条方法效果较差，而INR-Dense和MR-D-BSCP更有效。总体而言，MR-D-BSCP在两种任务中均取得最佳性能。

Conclusion: 配准精度强烈依赖于诱导的变形先验与目标运动模式的匹配程度。"先验-变形匹配"（prior-deformation matching）应作为医学图像配准的实用设计原则；多分辨率粗细配准的B样条方法（MR-D-BSCP）在多种变形场景下均表现出鲁棒的最优性能。

Abstract: Deformable image registration models implicitly encode deformation priors through their parametrization and optimization. In this work, we conduct a validation study on continuous registration methods to examine how these implicit priors affect performance across different registration tasks. Classic B-Spline transformations impose locality, smoothness, and scale through their control-point structure, whereas recent INR-based methods impose different priors through neural parameterization and optimization. We compare INR-Dense (IDIR), which directly models a dense displacement field using a SIREN-based INR; INR-BSCP (SINR), which predicts B-Spline control points with an INR; D-BSCP, which directly optimizes single-scale B-Spline control points; and MR-D-BSCP, which adds a multiresolution coarse-to-fine scheme. Experiments on inter-subject brain MR registration (OASIS) and intra-subject exhale-to-inhale lung CT registration (DIR-LAB 4DCT) reveal different behavior across deformation regimes. On OASIS, where deformations are moderate but locally complex, D-BSCP matches or slightly outperforms INR-BSCP, suggesting that the B-Spline parameterization accounts for much of INR-BSCP's effectiveness. On DIR-LAB 4DCT, where respiratory motion is larger and more coherent, single-scale B-Spline methods (D-BSCP and INR-BSCP) are less suitable, while INR-Dense and MR-D-BSCP are more effective. Across both tasks, MR-D-BSCP achieves the best performance among the tested continuous parameterizations. These findings highlight that registration accuracy depends strongly on matching the induced deformation prior to the target motion pattern, and support prior-deformation matching as a practical design principle for medical image registration. Our code will be available at https://github.com/HengjieLiu/RightPriorDIR.

</details>


### [349] [KeyID: Decoupled Drafting and Keyframe Editing for Identity-Preserving Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16154)
*Jianjie Luo,Yiming Zhong,Haoming Shen,Yupeng Xiao,Zhenguo Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出KeyID，一个免训练的IPVG框架，通过将视频动态合成与身份注入解耦，实现身份保持的视频生成。该方法在ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG大赛Track 2中获得亚军。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IPVG方法面临高训练成本或输入级增强受限的问题，在复杂长序列动作中难以维持刚性身份一致性，且难以同时兼顾文本提示遵循和身份保真。

Method: KeyID包含两个核心组件：(1) 参考感知视频生成——生成与多个参考一致但不含特定身份的视频草稿；(2) 身份保持关键帧编辑——通过稀疏关键帧校正和后续运动插值注入目标身份。将密集帧级监督转为稀疏关键帧级精炼，以解决提示遵循与身份保真之间的容量冲突。

Result: KeyID在官方挑战基准上通过自动和人工评估优于现有方法，并在ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG大赛Track 2（序列动作）中取得亚军成绩。

Conclusion: 模块化设计使KeyID无需额外训练即可无缝扩展到多主体参考和复杂序列动作生成，验证了将身份注入与视频动态生成解耦的有效性。

Abstract: Identity-preserving video generation (IPVG) requires synthesizing videos that are faithful to both reference subjects and text prompts. Existing methods are often hindered by high tuning costs or limited input-level enhancements, struggling to maintain rigid identity consistency during complex, long-sequence actions. To address these limitations, we propose KeyID, a training-free IPVG framework that decouples the synthesis of video dynamics from the injection of identity. Specifically, KeyID comprises two components: (1) Reference-Aware Video Generation, which produces an identity-agnostic video draft aligned with multiple references, and (2) Identity-Preserved Keyframe Editing, which integrates the target identity via sparse keyframe correction and subsequent motion interpolation. By shifting from dense frame-level supervision to sparse keyframe-level refinement, KeyID effectively resolves the capacity conflict between prompt adherence and identity fidelity. Crucially, our modular design allows seamless extension to multi-subject references and complex sequential action generation without additional training. KeyID outperforms prior works and is validated by automatic and human evaluations on the official challenge benchmark, ultimately securing the runner-up position in the Track 2 (Sequential Action) of the ACM Multimedia 2026 IPVG Grand Challenge. Source code is available at https://github.com/WISLab-GDUT/KeyID.

</details>


### [350] [Beyond Clear Skies: Synthetic Seasonal and Weather Variations for Real-World Drone Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16191)
*Tamara R. Lenhard,Andreas Weinmann,Tobias Koch*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍SynDroneVision-Weather (SDV-W)，一个面向恶劣天气和季节域偏移的无人机检测合成数据集。SDV-W包含55,187张来自三个城市场景、三种季节配置和多种天气条件（雨、雪、雾，多级强度）的高分辨率标注图像，是SynDroneVision (SDV)的系统性扩展。实验表明SDV-W能提升检测器在恶劣外观变化下的可靠性，减少漏检和误报，作为通用合成无人机检测数据的补充效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可靠无人机检测需要覆盖完整运行设计域的训练数据，包括恶劣天气和季节外观变化。但采集和标注此类真实数据资源消耗极大，因为恶劣天气条件难以控制、复现和系统采样。现有数据集对这类条件的覆盖通常有限，需要可扩展的替代方案。

Method: 利用合成数据的优势（环境变化可控、基于游戏引擎的流程提供逼真渲染和自动标注），在SynDroneVision (SDV)基础上系统性扩展，构建SDV-W。数据集包含从三个城市环境渲染的55,187张标注高分辨率图像，覆盖三种季节配置及雨、雪、雾等多样天气条件（多种严重程度），并保留SDV的场景和轨迹配置以支持匹配的清洁-恶劣对比。

Result: 在代表性YOLO模型和真实世界数据集上的实验显示，SDV-W能提升检测器在恶劣外观偏移下的可靠性，减少漏检和误报。尤其在作为通用合成无人机检测数据的补充时效果最显著。

Conclusion: SDV-W是一种有效的恶劣天气和季节域偏移的合成数据资源，可作为通用合成数据的补充显著提升无人机检测的鲁棒性。数据集将在论文录用后公开发布。

Abstract: Reliable drone detection under real-world deployment conditions requires training data that spans the full operational design domain, including adverse weather and seasonal appearance variation. However, acquiring and annotating such data at scale remains highly resource-intensive, as adverse-weather conditions are inherently difficult to control, reproduce, and sample systematically. Existing datasets therefore typically provide only limited coverage of such conditions. Conversely, synthetic data offers a scalable alternative: environmental variation becomes controllable, while modern game-engine-based pipelines provide realistic rendering and automatic annotations. Leveraging this potential, we introduce SynDroneVision-Weather (SDV-W), an systematic extension of SynDroneVision (SDV) targeting adverse-weather and seasonal domain shifts in urban drone detection. SDV-W comprises 55,187 annotated high-resolution images from three urban environments, rendered across three seasonal configurations and diverse weather conditions, including rain, snow, and fog at multiple severity levels. By preserving SDV's scene and trajectory configuration, SDV-W enables matched clean-adverse comparisons and quantification of condition-specific detector degradation. Across representative YOLO models and real-world datasets, we show that SDV-W improves detector reliability under adverse appearance shifts, reduces missed detections and false alarms, and is most effective as a complement to general-purpose synthetic drone-detection data. SDV-W will be publicly released upon paper acceptance.

</details>


### [351] [Picking the Right Image to Classify: Reliable-Input Selection in Teledermatology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16198)
*Fabian Gröger,Marco Weishaupt,Philippe Gottfrois,Simone Lionetti,Linda Wermelinger,Nipun Ranasekara,Ludovic Amruthalingam,Alexander A. Navarini,Marc Pouly*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次提出并系统评估"可靠输入选择"（reliable-input selection）任务：在远程皮肤科场景中，同一病例可能有多张临床照片，但部分照片因采集条件（光照、角度、距离、对焦、构图）偏离训练分布而导致模型误分类。研究发现，一个能选择正确分类图像的oracle可使加权F1平均提升约20个百分点；但实践证明，无需训练数据的选择器（基于嵌入范数、邻域一致性、扰动稳定性或模型置信度）都无法大幅缩小这一差距，最佳选择器（模型自身置信度）仅能恢复一小部分差距，即使引入少量标注参考集（置信度与马氏距离的融合）仍无法解决。这是首个引入并基准测试该任务的临床重要且未解决的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮肤科模型在远程医疗部署中面临严重的数据分布偏移（图像在光照、角度、距离、对焦、构图等方面与训练数据不一致），导致模型频繁误分类。当同一病例有多张图像时，自然想到选择模型最可能分类正确的图像以提升精度，因此需要系统研究"可靠输入选择"这一任务。

Method: （1）定义可靠输入选择任务，并构建oracle上界评估其潜力；（2）跨6个皮肤科数据集与9个冻结骨干网络进行基准测试；（3）提出四类无需训练数据的选择器：嵌入范数、病例内图像的邻域一致性、输入小扰动下的预测稳定性、模型自身置信度；（4）进一步测试引入小型标注参考集的选择器（置信度与马氏距离的融合）。

Result: Oracle选择器使加权F1平均提升约20个百分点；但所有无需训练数据的选择器均无法大幅缩小oracle差距，其中模型自身置信度表现最佳但也仅恢复一小部分；引入小型标注参考集的融合选择器（置信度+马氏距离）仍遗留大部分差距。

Conclusion: 可靠输入选择是一个临床重要但尚未解决的任务。当前可用的选择器（无论是否使用参考数据）都远未达到oracle的理论上限，表明该领域存在显著的算法创新空间，需要进一步研究更有效的方法来判断哪些输入图像最可靠。

Abstract: Dermatology models face distribution shifts in teledermatology settings, where submitted images differ from the training data in lighting, angle, distance, focus, and framing. These test-time images are ordinary clinical photographs, but some fall outside the model's training conditions, leading the model to often misclassify them due to shifts in acquisition between training and deployment. When multiple images of the same case exist (several photos of one patient or lesion), a natural way to improve accuracy is therefore to select the image the model is most likely to classify correctly. We call this task reliable-input selection. An oracle that, for each case, selects a correctly classified image when one exists raises weighted F1 by about 20 percentage points on average across six dermatology datasets and nine frozen backbones. This oracle is an upper bound that sees the labels, whereas a selector must choose blindly. Capturing this gain in practice is hard. A selector that needs no pretraining data applies to any frozen model, including those whose data is not public. It must judge reliability from quantities the model exposes at inference: its embeddings, their norms, and its confidence. We benchmark four such training-data-free selectors: the embedding norm, the neighborhood consensus among a case's images, the stability of the prediction under small perturbations, and the model's own confidence. No training-data-free selector substantially narrows this oracle gap. The best of them is the model's own confidence, but it recovers only a small part of the gap on the clinical datasets. A small labeled reference set does not help either: the best selector overall, a fusion of confidence and Mahalanobis distance, still leaves most of the gap. To our knowledge, this is the first study to introduce and benchmark reliable input selection, a clinically important, unsolved task.

</details>


### [352] [PCT-Prompt: A Prompt-Guided Transformer Framework for Dense Prediction Tasks in Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16225)
*Dejun Zhang,Yanzi Bai,Yiqi Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PCT-Prompt框架，通过引入提示引导的特征分支来增强标准Transformer在点云密集预测任务中的性能。该框架包含细粒度特征提取（多尺度几何特征+PnP-3D层）和提示精炼特征学习（跨注意力+提示丢弃机制）两个关键组件，在ShapeNetPart、S3DIS和DALES数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer虽在点云物体分类中表现优异，但在复杂场景下的密集预测任务中因先验假设较弱而性能受限，需要改进其适应性和判别能力。

Method: 提出PCT-Prompt双分支框架：1) 标准Transformer分支利用预训练模型提取全局特征；2) 提示引导特征分支包含细粒度特征提取块（几何敏感抽象层捕获多尺度特征+PnP-3D层整合局部上下文与全局正则化）和提示精炼特征学习块（生成提示token并通过跨注意力精炼）；同时引入提示丢弃机制在Transformer层间渐进移除提示信息以平衡局部细节与全局一致性。

Result: 在ShapeNetPart（部件分割）、S3DIS（室内场景分割）和DALES（航空点云分割）三个数据集上，PCT-Prompt显著提升了标准Transformer在密集预测任务中的适应性和性能，在真实世界场景中表现出强劲效果。

Conclusion: PCT-Prompt通过提示引导的细粒度特征注入和渐进式提示丢弃机制，有效弥合了标准Transformer在点云密集预测任务上的性能差距，证明了该框架在复杂场景中的泛化能力和实用价值。

Abstract: Standard Transformers have proven effective in point cloud object classification, but their performance in dense prediction tasks within complex scenes is often hindered by weak prior assumptions. To address this challenge, we propose PCT-Prompt, a novel framework that enhances standard Transformers by introducing a prompt-guided feature branch to improve performance in dense prediction tasks. The standard Transformer branch leverages pre-trained models for global feature extraction from point cloud data, serving as the backbone for processing high-level features. Meanwhile, the prompt-guided feature branch consists of two key components: a fine-grained feature extraction block that captures multi-scale geometric features using geometry-sensitive abstraction layer, along with the PnP-3D layer to integrate local context with global regularization. The second component, the prompt-refined feature learning block generates prompt tokens, which are subsequently refined through cross-attention mechanisms. Additionally, we introduce a prompt drop mechanism that progressively removes prompt information across Transformer layers, balancing local details and global consistency. Experimental results on the ShapeNetPart, S3DIS, and DALES datasets demonstrate that PCT-Prompt significantly improves the adaptability of standard Transformers to dense prediction tasks, achieving strong performance in real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [353] [GaussianDWM++: Language-Grounded 3D Gaussian Driving World Model for Unified Scene Understanding, Editing, and Multi-Modal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16234)
*Tianchen Deng,Xuefeng Chen,Shuang Wu,Qu Chen,Jiajun Zhu,Bo Dai,Jianfei Yang,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于基础特征高斯的驾驶世界模型（DWM），在单一框架内统一了场景理解、语言接地推理、可控4D编辑和多模态生成。通过基础特征高斯分词器、几何感知高斯适配器以及KL高斯-图像分布对齐目标，实现了开放词汇的3D语义场建模，并在多个驾驶基准上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型主要依赖条件场景生成，缺乏显式3D场景理解、语言接地推理和可控4D编辑能力；传统点云、占用网格或BEV表示难以在文本信息与底层3D场景结构之间实现细粒度对齐。

Method: 1) 提出基础特征高斯分词器，将Qwen/SigLIP视觉语言特征直接蒸馏到3D高斯基元中，构建紧凑的开放词汇语义场；2) 设计几何感知高斯适配器，结合重要性感知的层次选择与文本条件的Perceiver式交叉注意力，将稠密高斯基元聚合为紧凑的世界令牌；3) 引入基于KL的高斯-图像分布对齐目标，使高斯世界令牌与基础图像令牌对齐；4) 基于对齐的高斯表示，支持指令可控的场景编辑（如天气条件生成和动态车辆操控）。

Result: 在广泛驾驶基准上，该方法在场景理解、视觉接地、规划导向推理和可控4D生成任务中均达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 通过统一且可对齐的3D高斯表示，能够同时支持显式3D理解、语言推理和可控编辑，为驾驶世界模型提供了新的范式。代码和数据集将公开发布。

Abstract: Driving World Models (DWMs) have recently advanced rapidly with generative models, yet most existing methods mainly focus on conditional scene generation and lack explicit 3D scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, and controllable 4D editing capabilities. Moreover, commonly used point cloud, occupancy, or BEV representations make it difficult to achieve fine-grained alignment between textual information and the underlying 3D scene structure. To address these limitations, we propose a foundation-feature Gaussian driving world model that unifies scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, controllable 4D editing, and multi-modal generation within a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a foundation-feature Gaussian tokenizer that directly distills Qwen/SigLIP visual-language features into 3D Gaussian primitives, building a compact open-vocabulary Gaussian semantic field. We further design a geometry-aware Gaussian adapter that combines importance-aware hierarchical selection with text-conditioned Perceiver-style cross-attention to aggregate dense Gaussian primitives into compact world tokens. To improve representation compatibility, we introduce a KL-based Gaussian--image distribution alignment objective that aligns Gaussian world tokens with foundation image tokens. Based on the aligned Gaussian representation, our framework further supports instruction-controllable scene editing, including weather-conditioned generation and dynamic vehicle manipulation. Extensive experiments on broader driving benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across scene understanding, visual grounding, planning-oriented reasoning, and controllable 4D generation tasks. We will release the code and datasets publicly on Github.

</details>


### [354] [Convolution-Free Holistic Multivariance Decomposition Layer for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Classification Tensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16241)
*Süha Tuna,Ülker Başar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为整体多方差分解（HMD）的新型端到端可微分神经网络层，用于高光谱图像分类。通过将独立的单模式变化与高阶交互分离，HMD-0、HMD-1和HMD-2近似器与下游分类器联合优化，在三个基准HS数据集上超越了传统张量分解基线，并以更少的参数实现了与2D/3D-CNN相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的高光谱图像分类特征提取方法存在两难困境：刚性张量分解无法捕捉复杂的空间-光谱相互依赖关系，而参数化的卷积神经网络计算成本过高。作者旨在克服这两种方法的局限，寻找一种既能捕获复杂跨维度交互又具有高参数效率的特征提取方案。

Method: 提出了整体多方差分解（HMD）框架，作为一种端到端可微分的神经网络层。核心思想是通过可学习的矩阵值支撑，将独立的单模式变异与合作的高维交互显式分离。设计了三个层次（HMD-0、HMD-1、HMD-2），与下游分类器通过反向传播联合优化。在三个基准HS数据集上与Tucker、CP和TT分解等可学习张量基线以及2D/3D-CNN进行对比评估。

Result: 高阶HMD层（HMD-1和HMD-2）在分类准确率上优于经典的Tucker、Canonical Polyadic和Tensor Train分解基线；同时达到与2D/3D-CNN相当的泛化能力和训练稳定性，但所需的特征提取器参数显著更少。

Conclusion: HMD框架可作为传统卷积在高维多光谱图像分类中的结构稳健替代方案，兼具高参数效率和优化过程中的稳定性，为张量分解与深度学习之间的鸿沟提供了一座桥梁。

Abstract: Feature extraction for hyperspectral image classification is conventionally addressed using rigid tensor decompositions that fail to capture complex spatio-spectral interdependencies, or heavily parameterized convolutional neural networks that are computationally expensive. To overcome these limitations, this work introduces the Holistic Multivariance Decomposition (HMD) framework as a novel, end-to-end differentiable neural network layer. By explicitly separating independent single mode variations from cooperative higher dimensional interactions via learnable, matrix valued supports, the proposed HMD-0, HMD-1 and HMD-2 approximants are optimized jointly with a downstream classifier via backpropagation. Comprehensive evaluations across three benchmark HS datasets demonstrate that the higher level HMD layers achieve superior classification accuracy compared to classical learnable tensor baselines, including Tucker, Canonical Polyadic, and Tensor Train decompositions. Furthermore, HMD-1 and HMD-2 achieve a generalization capacity and training stability comparable to standard 2D and 3D-CNNs while requiring significantly fewer feature extractor parameters. These results demonstrate that the HMD framework provides a structurally robust substitute for traditional convolution in multidimensional HS image classification, offering high parameter efficiency and stability throughout the optimization process.

</details>


### [355] [SCOUT: Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-Vocabulary Editing of face Recognition Templates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16251)
*Leon Todorov,Peter Rot,Peter Peer,Vitomir Štruc,Klemen Grm*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SCOUT是一个端到端框架，通过机制可解释性在人脸识别模板中发现和直接操纵语义概念。它学习稀疏模板表示，从自然语言描述生成潜在特征的语义假设并验证其稳定性，从而获得可直接编辑的可控语义方向，避免了昂贵的编辑-再编码流水线。实验证明在CNN、ViT和Swin三种骨干网络上均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作可以将人脸识别模板反演为图像或通过图像编辑流水线间接操纵，但在模板空间中直接进行语义编辑尚未被充分探索。已有的可解释性方法依赖人工神经元检查或预定义属性标签，限制了可扩展性和语义灵活性。

Method: SCOUT框架包括三个核心步骤：(1)学习稀疏模板表示；(2)从自然语言描述为潜在特征生成语义假说；(3)验证这些特征的稳定性。所得的稳定特征作为可控语义方向用于直接在模板空间中编辑，且通过独立的反演模型可将编辑后的模板解码为图像进行可视化和评估。

Result: 在CNN、ViT和Swin骨干网络的人脸识别模型上，SCOUT能够发现超出标准属性标签的可解释概念，实现可控且身份感知的模板操作，且对身份匹配的影响可忽略不计。

Conclusion: SCOUT首次实现了人脸识别模板空间中的开放词汇语义编辑，突破了依赖预定义标签的限制，为模板级别的机器可解释性提供了新范式。

Abstract: Face recognition templates are compact identity representations, yet they also encode rich semantic information about facial appearance. Prior work has shown that templates can be inverted to images or indirectly manipulated through image-editing pipelines, but direct semantic editing in template space remains largely unexplored. Existing interpretability methods for face recognition often rely on manual neuron inspection or predefined attribute labels, limiting scalability and semantic flexibility. To address this gap, we propose SCOUT (Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-VocabUlary Editing of Face Recognition Templates), an end-to-end framework for discovering and directly manipulating semantic concepts in face recognition templates using mechanistic interpretability. SCOUT learns sparse template representations, generates semantic hypotheses for latent features from natural-language descriptions, and validates their stability. The resulting features act as controllable semantic directions for direct editing, avoiding costly edit--re-encode pipelines. Experiments with face recognition models using CNN, ViT, and Swin backbones show that SCOUT discovers interpretable concepts beyond standard attribute labels and enables controllable, identity-aware template manipulation with negligible impact on identity matching. We further show that edited templates can subsequently be decoded with independent inversion models for visualization and evaluation.

</details>


### [356] [Defake-o3: From Speculative Rationales to Verifiable Evidence for Explainable AIGI Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16259)
*Bowen Deng,Jiahui Zhan,Yikun Ji,Haozhen Yan,Jianfu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Defake-o3是一个可解释的AI生成图像检测器，通过交互式视觉搜索和验证器引导的证据对齐，将推测性解释转变为可验证的视觉证据，并配套构建了GroundFake数据集和FakeFrontier基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于MLLM的AI生成图像检测器虽然能提供自然语言解释，但往往生成推测性论证：依赖模糊或幻觉性的伪影，遗漏最新生成器的细微局部缺陷，且无法提供可视觉验证的证据，导致解释不可靠、不准确。

Method: Defake-o3结合交互式视觉搜索（迭代放大可疑区域检查细粒度细节）与验证器引导的证据对齐。Evidence Verifier基于人类验证标注训练，为强化学习提供奖励，偏好有依据的证据并惩罚无依据的陈述。同时构建GroundFake数据集（含局部边界框证据、基于视觉依据和伪影特异性的人类验证、修正的推理轨迹、有效/无效证据监督），以及FakeFrontier基准（由真实图像和10个最新生成器输出构建，含MLLM协议评估证据质量）。

Result: 在GroundFake、FakeFrontier及额外分布外基准上的实验表明，Defake-o3在检测精度和解释质量两方面均有提升，能够产生更局部化、可验证且具有说服力的证据。

Conclusion: Defake-o3证明了从推测性解释转向可验证证据的可行性，通过证据验证引导的强化学习和交互式视觉搜索，显著提升了AIGI检测的可解释性和可靠性。

Abstract: The rapid progress of image generation models calls for AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors that are not only accurate but also explainable and reliable. While MLLM-based detectors can provide natural language explanations, existing methods often generate speculative rationales: they rely on vague or hallucinated artifacts, miss subtle localized flaws from the latest generators, and fail to provide evidence that can be visually verified. We present Defake-o3, an explainable AIGI detector that moves from speculative rationales to verifiable evidence. It combines interactive visual search with verifier-guided evidence alignment: the model iteratively zooms into suspicious regions to inspect fine-grained details, while an Evidence Verifier, trained from human verification annotations, provides reinforcement learning rewards that favor grounded evidence and penalize baseless claims. To support this objective, we construct GroundFake, a dataset designed for grounded explainable detection, with localized bounding-box evidence, human verification based on visual grounding and artifact specificity, corrected reasoning trajectories, and valid/invalid evidence supervision. We further introduce FakeFrontier, an out-of-distribution benchmark built from real images and outputs of 10 recent generators, together with an MLLM-based protocol for evaluating evidence quality and persuasiveness. Experiments on GroundFake, FakeFrontier, and additional out-of-distribution benchmarks show that Defake-o3 improves both detection accuracy and explanation quality, producing more localized, verifiable, and persuasive evidence.

</details>


### [357] [Seeing Before Answering: Training-Free Visual Layer Profiling for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16263)
*Ruchen Liu,Yi Yang,Yiming Xu,Michael Ying Yang,Monika Sester,Bodo Rosenhahn*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文发现LLaVA式VLM默认使用视觉骨干的倒数第二层作为视觉token来源是次优的（在14个模型-任务组合中有13个非最优），且最优层随任务和骨干变化。作者提出用基于矩阵熵的Visual Dataset Entropy (VDE)和Gromov-Wasserstein距离作为不依赖推理、仅需100个未标注样本即可预测最优视觉层的无训练策略，并发现VDE在投影前可迁移、GW不可迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLaVA式VLM固定从视觉骨干的倒数第二层提取视觉token，但这种约定是脆弱的：默认层在绝大多数情况下并非最优，而穷举逐层推理成本过高，又不存在更好的固定默认层。因此需要一种无需昂贵推理即可预测最优视觉层的方法。

Method: （1）系统评估2个VLM（SigLIP-based LLaVA-Video和CLIP-based Video-LLaVA）在7个图像与视频基准上不同视觉层的表现，证明默认层非最优；（2）引入Visual Dataset Entropy (VDE)，基于矩阵熵在样本级视觉嵌入上计算；（3）将Gromov-Wasserstein (GW)距离改造为逐层视觉-语言对齐信号；（4）由于视觉塔冻结而投影器被训练，分别分析投影器前后两侧的表示，评估VDE和GW作为层选择器的有效性。

Result: VDE在投影前可迁移：仅用100个未标注样本即可追踪逐层准确率，其顶层候选在SigLIP-based LLaVA-Video的每个任务上都覆盖oracle最优层，对CLIP-based Video-LLaVA提供区域级指导。GW在投影后趋于平坦，更适合作为对齐诊断而非层选择器。投影器会重塑视觉几何但不消除性能相关的趋势，投影前VDE是更强的信号。

Conclusion: VDE提供了一种可解释、无需训练的策略，能将从数百层视觉骨干中搜索最优层的问题缩小到少量候选层，再进行有限的下游验证，从而大幅降低计算成本。

Abstract: LLaVA-style Vision-Language Models (VLMs) pass visual tokens from a fixed late layer of the vision backbone, typically the penultimate one, to the language model. We first show that this hidden convention is fragile: across 2 VLMs and 7 image and video benchmarks, the default layer is sub-optimal in 13 of 14 model-task pairs, and the best layer shifts with both task and visual backbone. Finding that layer by exhaustive layer-wise inference is prohibitively expensive, and no better fixed default exists. We therefore ask whether layer usefulness can instead be predicted from representation geometry. We study matrix-based entropy, introduced for unimodal layer analysis, which we compute over sample-level visual embeddings as Visual Dataset Entropy (VDE); and Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance, introduced for encoder-level VLM model selection, which we repurpose as a layer-wise visual--language alignment signal. Transferring these to LLaVA-based models is not obvious a priori: the vision tower is frozen while the multimodal projector is trained, so we profile both sides of the projector. We find that VDE transfers, and GW does not. Computed from 100 unlabeled task samples without downstream inference, pre-projector VDE tracks layer-wise accuracy and its top-ranked layers cover the oracle best layer on every task for the SigLIP-based LLaVA-Video, while giving region-level guidance for the CLIP-based Video-LLaVA. Post-projector profiles show that the projector reshapes visual geometry but does not erase the performance-relevant trend, leaving $\mathrm{VDE}_{\mathrm{pre}}$ the stronger signal. GW instead flattens after projection and is best read as an alignment diagnostic rather than a selector. VDE thus offers an interpretable, training-free policy that narrows the visual-layer search to a handful of candidates for limited downstream verification.

</details>


### [358] [CoM$^3$eT: A foundation model for medical image analysis through federated, multidimensional context integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16268)
*J. Raphael Schäfer,Kai Geissler,Till Nicke,Chiara Tappermann,Karoline Heber,Eike Petersen,Habib Mergan,Lars Ole Schwen,Nick Weiss,Annika Gerken,Jan Hendrik Moltz,Tom Bisson,Isil Dogan O,Tim-Rasmus Kiehl,Norman Zerbe,Sefer Elezkurtaj,Robin S. Mayer,Nadine Flinner,Peter Wild,Isabel Dahm,Felix Peisen,Heinrich von Busch,Robert Grimm,Sebastian Arndt,Lisa Siegler,Matthias Stefan May,Antje Prasse,Natalia Artysh,Fabian Kiessling,Johannes Lotz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoM³eT是一种医学视觉基础模型，首次统一了病理学与放射学、稀疏与稠密预测、二维与更高维输入，通过注意力机制建模多维上下文，在开放竞赛中超越其他医学基础模型，并展示了极低的参数微调需求和联邦学习兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学基础模型受限于单一专科（如病理学或放射学）以及单一输出类型（如分类或分割），缺乏跨模态、跨任务、跨维度的统一能力，限制了其在多样化临床场景中的泛化与推广。

Method: 提出Co-representation Multidimensional Multitask Medical Transformer（CoM³eT），通过注意力机制建模多维上下文，统一处理病理与放射学图像、稀疏与稠密预测任务，以及二维和更高维（如体数据）输入。

Result: 在涵盖五个断层扫描、四个全标本和三个二维数据集的开放竞赛中超越其他医学基础模型，覆盖稀疏/稠密预测及报告生成任务；微调不足2.5%参数即可达到与全量微调相当的性能；在联邦学习场景中可实现与集中式训练相当的效果。

Conclusion: CoM³eT证明了跨专科、跨维度、跨任务统一的医学视觉基础模型是可行的，且具有高效参数微调与联邦学习部署优势，为资源受限环境下的医学AI研究提供了新可能。

Abstract: Medical foundation models improve generalization when training AI models with limited labeled data, but remain confined to a single specialty, such as pathology or radiology, and to either sparse or dense outputs, such as classification or segmentation. Here, we present CoM$^3$eT (Co-representation Multidimensional Multitask Medical Transformer), a medical vision foundation model that unifies pathology and radiology, sparse and dense predictions, and two- and higher-dimensional inputs by modeling multidimensional context with attention. CoM$^3$eT outperformed other medical foundation models in an open competition spanning five tomographic, four whole-specimen, and three two-dimensional datasets, covering sparse and dense prediction tasks as well as report generation. When adapted across diverse clinical applications, training fewer than 2.5% of parameters achieved performance comparable to full fine-tuning, enabling research without access to high-performance GPU clusters. Applied to federated learning across hospitals, this approach achieved performance comparable to pooled-data training over internet connections and with consumer-grade hardware.

</details>


### [359] [TransAnyText: Translating Arbitrary Text in E-commerce Images via Structured Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16284)
*Xiaoan Liu,Lichen Ma,Zipeng Guo,Yu He,Xiaoyan Su,Shaojie Guo,Hao Yang,Jingling Fu,Xiaolong Fu,Zhen Chen,Yu Guo,Fei Wang,Xinyi Liu,Yongjun Zhang,Ke Zhang,Junshi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了TransAnyText，一个将跨境电商图像文本翻译重构为生成可渲染HTML补丁的结构化视觉代码框架，通过VLM与扩散模型解耦语义生成与像素渲染，并配合三阶段训练流程，实现精准翻译、视觉一致性保持和可编辑输出的统一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的跨境电商图像翻译方法难以同时实现三个目标：准确的跨语言翻译、忠实的视觉身份保持（如品牌风格、排版布局）、以及易于编辑的输出。级联流程、端到端模型和闭源图像编辑系统在这三方面各有短板，缺乏统一的解决方案。

Method: TransAnyText采用结构化视觉代码框架，将图像文本翻译转化为从源图像和目标语言生成可渲染HTML补丁。框架将语义生成与像素渲染解耦：VLM负责视觉理解、跨语言翻译和结构化视觉生成，扩散模型负责背景修复和像素级精修，最终通过确定性渲染合成图像。训练采用三阶段后训练流程：SFT建立图像到代码的映射，PWSD改进风格和布局token的学习（引入特权差距加权自蒸馏），RLVR通过可验证奖励优化任务级性能。同时构建了TransAnyDataset数据集和TransAnyBench基准。

Result: 大量实验表明该方法在性能上与级联流程、开源端到端模型以及闭源图像编辑系统相比具有竞争力，为跨境电商图像翻译提供了有效、可控且可编辑的解决方案。

Conclusion: TransAnyText通过结构化视觉代码的范式重塑了图像文本翻译任务，验证了解耦语义生成与像素渲染的有效性，为跨境电商场景提供了兼顾准确性、视觉保真度和可编辑性的统一解决方案。

Abstract: Cross-border e-commerce image translation is essential for global retail, where product images, banners, and detail pages need to be produced in different languages. Existing methods struggle to achieve accurate translation, faithful visual identity preservation, and easy-to-edit outputs, simultaneously. To address these challenges, we introduce TransAnyText, a structured visual code framework that reformulates image text translation as generating renderable HTML patches from source images and target languages. Our framework decouples semantic generation from pixel rendering: a vision-language model (VLM) handles visual understanding, cross-lingual translation, and structured visual generation, while a diffusion model performs background inpainting and pixel-level refinement, followed by deterministic rendering to synthesize the final image. Based on this formulation, we develop a three-stage post-training framework, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) establishes the image-to-code mapping, privilege-gap weighted self-distillation (PWSD) improves the learning of style and layout tokens, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) further optimizes task-level performance. We further introduce TransAnyDataset and TransAnyBench, a multilingual dataset and benchmark for e-commerce image translation. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance against cascaded pipelines, open-source end-to-end models, and closed-source image editing systems, providing an effective, controllable, and editable solution for cross-border e-commerce image translation.

</details>


### [360] [Audio-Visual Segmentation via Depth-Guided Collaborative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16285)
*Zhaojin Fu,Yuyang Hong,Qi Yang,Zili Wang,Kun Ding,Shiming Xiang,Bin Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DGCM-AVS，一个三模态（音频-视觉-深度）框架，通过显式建模几何线索（深度）来提升音视频分割性能。设计了Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator改善相邻物体分离和内部一致性，以及Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion逐步对齐音频与视觉特征。在AVSS数据集上相对现有最优方法在M_J和M_F指标上分别提升10.2%和8.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AVS方法未显式建模相对距离、遮挡等几何线索，限制了跨模态对齐的鲁棒性。人类感知中空间结构自然与音视频证据结合，因此作者引入估计深度作为空间结构线索。

Method: 1) 提出DGCM-AVS三模态框架，联合建模音频、视觉和深度信息；2) 设计Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator，利用深度信息改善相邻物体分割分离并保持物体内部特征一致性；3) 提出Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion，以深度为中间桥梁逐步将音频线索与视觉特征对齐。

Result: 在AVSS数据集上，相比最先进方法，DGCM-AVS在M_J指标上相对提升10.2%，在M_F指标上相对提升8.7%。

Conclusion: 深度是AVS中一个有前景但尚未充分探索的模态，本文工作可能推动该方向的进一步研究。

Abstract: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) is a fundamental task in multimodal perception that performs pixel-level segmentation of sounding objects in videos by leveraging both visual and audio cues. It has broad applications in video understanding, human-computer interaction, and autonomous driving. However, most existing AVS methods do not explicitly model geometric cues such as relative distance and occlusion, thereby limiting the robustness of cross-modal alignment. In human perception, spatial structure is naturally integrated with audio-visual evidence to accurately localize sounding objects. Motivated by this, we incorporate estimated depth as a spatial structural cue for AVS and propose DGCM-AVS, a tri-modal framework that jointly models audio, visual, and depth information. Specifically, we design a Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator to improve the separation of adjacent objects while preserving intra-object feature consistency. Furthermore, we propose Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion, which uses depth as an intermediate bridge to progressively align audio cues with visual features. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, DGCM-AVS achieves relative improvements of 10.2 percent in M_J and 8.7 percent in M_F on the AVSS dataset. We believe our study highlights depth as a promising yet underexplored modality for AVS and may encourage further research in this direction.

</details>


### [361] [PosterText: Towards Unified Visual Text Generation and Editing for E-commerce Poster](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16289)
*Xiaoan Liu,Lichen Ma,Zipeng Guo,Yu He,Xiaoyan Su,Shaojie Guo,Jingling Fu,Xiaolong Fu,Hao Yang,Tongxuan Liu,Yu Guo,Fei Wang,Xinyi Liu,Yongjun Zhang,Junshi Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PosterText，一个统一的电商海报生成与编辑框架。通过将文本补丁作为原子单元，定义了涵盖海报生成、补丁新增、删除、修改四种操作的任务体系，并设计了四阶段课程训练策略（文本渲染预训练、指令跟随训练、强化学习偏好对齐、空间引导自蒸馏），在构建的大规模数据集和基准上取得了有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电商海报设计方法要么仅针对端到端生成，要么采用多阶段设计管线，缺乏对已有海报进行灵活、精确编辑的能力。作者希望统一生成与编辑任务，使模型既能生成高质量海报，又能对现有设计进行精准的局部修改。

Method: 提出Text Patch Generation and Editing（TPGE）统一任务框架，将文本补丁视为原子操作单元，涵盖四种操作：海报生成、补丁添加、补丁删除、补丁修改，并支持参考引导的风格控制。基于此构建PosterText统一模型，采用四阶段课程训练：(1)文本渲染预训练，(2)指令跟随训练，(3)强化学习偏好对齐，(4)空间引导自蒸馏用于执行精化。同时构建了带补丁级标注的大规模数据集和综合评测基准。

Result: 大量实验表明，PosterText在生成和编辑两类任务上与现有方法相比取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了所提出框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 将文本补丁作为原子单元的统一任务建模，配合四阶段课程训练策略，能够有效实现电商海报的统一生成与灵活编辑，为自动化电商海报设计提供了新的研究范式。

Abstract: Automated e-commerce poster design requires both high-quality poster generation and flexible editing of existing designs. However, most existing methods either target end-to-end poster generation or follow multi-stage design pipelines, with limited capability for flexible and precise editing of existing posters. To enable unified generation and editing of e-commerce posters, we introduce Text Patch Generation and Editing, a unified task formulation that treats text patches as atomic units and covers four operations: poster generation, patch addition, patch deletion, and patch modification, with optional reference-guided style control. Based on this, we propose PosterText, a unified model trained with a four-stage curriculum, including text rendering pretraining, instruction-following training, reinforcement learning for preference alignment, and spatial guidance self-distillation for execution refinement. We further construct a large-scale dataset with patch-level annotations and a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PosterText achieves competitive performance against existing generation and editing approaches, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [362] [Cross-View Urban Sensing: Mapping Subjective Streetscape Perception via AlphaEarth Embeddings and Urban Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16310)
*Peilin Li,Pengfei Chen,Jingyu Wang,Zhifeng Yang,Tiansheng Chen,Mengjie Gong,Xiao Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CVLNet，一种跨视图学习网络，利用AlphaEarth遥感嵌入和多源城市上下文数据预测街道级景观感知，无需推断时的街景图像。在东南亚四城市评估中，CVLNet达到0.76的中位道路段调整R²，比基线提升5.9-11.3%，并将感知评估从仅覆盖道路网络的13-31%扩展至完整路网。结合WorldPop人口数据，进一步量化了城市环境不平等。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 街景图像（SVI）在评估城市街道景观感知方面被广泛使用，但其覆盖不均、更新不规律等问题限制了大规模测量。研究人员希望找到一种无需SVI即可在推断时预测街道视觉感知的可扩展替代方案，以实现城市全路网的感知评估。

Method: CVLNet采用跨视图学习框架：从AlphaEarth遥感嵌入和多源城市上下文数据中学习，无需推断时使用SVI。模型通过每任务自适应门控（per-task adaptive gating）联合建模五个感知维度，使用预训练的SVI-Percept模型生成标签作为ground truth进行监督训练。

Result: 在四个东南亚城市（新加坡、吉隆坡、雅加达和马尼拉）评估中，CVLNet中位道路段级调整R²为0.76，在五个感知维度上比基线模型提升5.9-11.3%。消融实验表明AlphaEarth特征与城市上下文特征互补。将感知估计从SVI直接覆盖的13-31%道路网络扩展到完整的城市路网，并结合WorldPop人口数据量化了暴露不平等。

Conclusion: 遥感可以作为一种可扩展的SVI替代方案，用于城市范围的街道景观感知制图，从而实现对城市环境不平等更全面的评估，对公共健康、主动性出行和社交福祉相关研究具有重要价值。

Abstract: Residents' perception of the urban streetscape is an important factor in public health, active mobility, and social wellbeing. Street view imagery (SVI) has emerged as a widely used data source for assessing these perceptual qualities, yet its uneven coverage and irregular updating limit large-scale measurement. Here, we present CVLNet, a Cross-View Learning Network that predicts street-level perception from AlphaEarth embeddings and multi-source urban contextual data without requiring SVI at inference. CVLNet applies per-task adaptive gating to jointly model five perceptual dimensions, using labels from the pretrained SVI-Percept model as ground truth. The proposed method is evaluated across four Southeast Asian cities: Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, and Manila. CVLNet achieves a median road-segment-level Adjusted $R^{2}$ of 0.76 and consistently outperforms the baseline models, with gains ranging from 5.9--11.3% across the five perceptual dimensions. Ablation experiments show that AlphaEarth features and urban contextual features contribute complementary information. We further produce citywide road-level streetscape perception maps for five subjective perceptual dimensions across all four cities, extending perception estimation from the 13--31% of the road network directly covered by available SVI to the complete road network of each city. Integrating these maps with WorldPop gridded population data, we quantify exposure inequality across population-density, demographic, and land-use groups using the Deficit Palma Ratio. These results demonstrate that remote sensing can serve as a scalable alternative to SVI for citywide streetscape perception mapping, enabling a more comprehensive assessment of urban environmental inequality.

</details>


### [363] [Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16316)
*Ao Shen,Yongheng Zhang,Yinghui Li,Manning Wang,Di Yin,Xing Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent-OPD，一种通过轨迹级潜在表示蒸馏来增强On-Policy Distillation（OPD）的视频推理方法，该方法在六个视频推理基准上一致优于仅输出级别的OPD，尤其在帧数有限、长视频或复杂证据聚合任务中优势显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）在视频推理中面临大量视觉信息导致的高计算成本问题。虽然On-Policy Distillation（OPD）通过匹配学生生成轨迹上的输出token分布来将大模型推理能力迁移到小模型，但视频推理依赖跨帧累积的证据，仅输出级别的监督只能捕捉通过token预测表达的信息，无法直接约束推理过程中形成的潜在表示。

Method: Latent-OPD在OPD基础上增加了轨迹级别的潜在蒸馏。具体地，(1) 聚焦每条轨迹末尾位置，该处的隐藏状态能有效汇总累积的视觉证据和推理上下文；(2) 引入渐进式教师前瞻（progressive teacher-lookahead）策略，将学生中后层与教师更深层对齐。

Result: 在六个视频推理基准上的实验表明，Latent-OPD一致优于仅输出级别的OPD。特别是在帧数有限、长视频或需要复杂证据聚合的任务中，性能提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: Latent-OPD被证明是一种高效的帧效率视频推理方法，通过轨迹级潜在蒸馏有效弥补了输出级蒸馏在约束潜在推理表示方面的不足，为小型模型的视频推理能力迁移提供了新途径。

Abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.

</details>


### [364] [StreamOPD: A Post-Training Recipe with Spatio-Temporal Cue Gating for Streaming Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16320)
*Keming Wu,Baoyi Wang,Kaichen Zhang,Xiang An,Zuhao Yang,Sudong Wang,Haowei Zhu,Tingxuan Huang,Hongcheng Gao,Bin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出StreamOPD，一种结合可验证流式视频数据、思考模式在线策略蒸馏（OPD）与指令模式部署的训练后配方，将StreamingBench从77.9%提升至83.9%（仅落后9B教师0.3分）。此外，作者引入教师特权扩展Spatio-Temporal CueGate（ST-CueGate），通过聚合教师有无线索似然比来加权OPD，在OVO-Bench（排除HLD）达到71.9%，Video-MME达到64.9%。作者还探索用学生初始策略的冻结副本替代教师（自蒸馏），保留大部分收益并将HLD提升至57.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频理解需要在不断展开的视频前缀上进行即时因果响应。现有系统依赖推理时内存、检索和压缩等复杂手段，但一个无需训练的滑动窗口基线已能与之匹敌。作者因此固定一个无记忆的近期窗口协议，探究仅靠训练后（post-training）能取得多大进展，旨在提供简单透明且可复现的流式视频研究参考。

Method: 作者首先分析发现：RLVR（可验证奖励的强化学习）不适合流式视频场景，因为它鼓励冗长的"先思考后回答"生成；而OPD（在线策略蒸馏）提供稠密的token级教师监督，但仅在师生都处于思考模式训练时稳定。基于此，StreamOPD配方结合了：(1)可验证的流式视频数据；(2)思考模式的OPD训练；(3)指令模式部署。作为教师特权扩展，ST-CueGate通过聚合教师对有无线索的似然比来计算组内相对响应分数，用于重新加权OPD损失。最后还探索了用学生初始策略的冻结副本作为教师的自蒸馏变体。

Result: StreamOPD将StreamingBench从77.9%提升至83.9%，与9B教师差距小于0.3分；在OVO-Bench（排除HLD）上提升了9.1分，且推理开销不变。ST-CueGate在OVO-Bench（排除HLD）达到71.9%，Video-MME达到64.9%，且是唯一在所有四个基准上均高于基础模型的变体。自蒸馏保留了大部分收益，并将HLD提升至57.0%，超过未训练学生和9B教师，说明拒绝回答（abstention）的损失并非配方固有。

Conclusion: 流式视频理解中，无需引入推理时额外机制的复杂系统，仅通过精心设计的训练后配方（特别是思考模式的OPD）即可大幅提升性能。教师特权的cue信息提取（ST-CueGate）能进一步提升稳健性，而自蒸馏变体表明该配方的收益不依赖教师privilege，可为开源流式视频研究提供透明可复现的基准参考。

Abstract: Streaming video understanding demands direct responses from the causally observed prefix of an unfolding video. Existing systems add inference-time memory, retrieval, and compression, yet a training-free sliding-window baseline already matches them. We therefore fix a memory-free recent-window protocol and ask how far post-training alone can go. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards fits this regime poorly, encouraging long ``think-then-answer'' generations, while on-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense token-level teacher supervision on student trajectories but is stable only when both models train in thinking mode. These observations lead to \textsc{StreamOPD}, a recipe combining verifiable streaming-video data, thinking-mode OPD, and instruct-mode deployment. It raises StreamingBench from $77.9\%$ to $83.9\%$---within $0.3$ points of the 9B teacher---and improves OVO-Bench excluding its hallucination-detection subtask (HLD) by $9.1$ points under unchanged inference. As a teacher-privilege extension, \emph{Spatio-Temporal CueGate (ST-CueGate)} aggregates cue-versus-no-cue teacher likelihood ratios into a group-relative response score that reweights OPD. It reaches $71.9\%$ on OVO-Bench (excluding HLD) and $64.9\%$ on Video-MME, and is the only variant that stays above the base model on all four benchmarks. Replacing the teacher with a frozen copy of the student's initial policy---on-policy self-distillation---retains most of these gains and lifts HLD to $57.0\%$, above both the untrained student and the 9B teacher, so abstention loss is not intrinsic to the recipe. We provide a transparent and reproducible reference for open-source streaming-video research.

</details>


### [365] [LaGSplat: Inferring Physics-Governed Interactive Simulation from Monocular Video Using Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16324)
*Louen Pottier*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LaGSplat (Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting) 是一个从单目视频推断物理驱动动力学交互的框架，通过将低维潜状态同时用作耗散拉格朗日广义坐标和高斯溅射解码器的条件变量，使用户能够在推理时对重建物体施加训练中从未见过的外力，并在2D或3D中实时渲染响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法无法从少量单目视频中推断可交互的物理动力学：像素空间CNN或神经场NeRF解码器无法将图像域施加的力拉回为潜空间的广义力，从而无法让用户对重建物体施加未见过的外力并得到符合物理规律的响应。

Method: 构建一个低维潜状态q作为双重角色：（1）学习到的耗散拉格朗日方程中的广义坐标；（2）高斯溅射解码器的条件变量。高斯溅射的图元是随物体移动的显式点μ_i(q)，其归纳偏置使得图像上施加的力f可以通过雅可比J(q)^T拉回为潜空间的广义力并进入运动方程，从而实现对未见外力的有界、合理的响应。

Result: 在从刚体到可变形、从自主运动到受迫真实系统的递增难度测试集上验证了有效性（结合单目视频和传感器测量），并展示了交互式使用：任意大小和方向的外力可在任意时刻施加到重建物体上，响应可实时在2D或3D中渲染。相比无约束预测器，该方法能给出有界且合理的响应，而无约束预测器会发散。

Conclusion: 假设关于少量广义坐标的耗散欧拉-拉格朗日方程，以牺牲泛化性为代价，换取了对外部未见力的有界、合理的物理响应；这种结构化归纳偏置是高斯溅射显式点图元所带来的关键优势，CNN或NeRF解码器无法实现。

Abstract: We present LaGSplat (Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting), a framework that infers interactive, physics-governed dynamics from one or a few monocular videos. At inference it lets a user push on the filmed object, rigid or deformable, with an external force that was never measured, annotated, or seen during training. This is possible because a low-dimensional latent state $\mathbf{q} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ plays two roles at once: it is the generalised coordinate of a learned dissipative Lagrangian and the conditioning variable of a Gaussian Splatting decoder. The inductive bias of this decoder, whose primitives are explicit points $μ_i(\mathbf{q})$ that move with the object, is what lets a force $f$ applied in the image pull back into a latent generalised force $J(\mathbf{q})^\top f$ and enter the equations of motion, which pixel-space (CNN) or neural-field (NeRF) decoders cannot do. We validate LaGSplat on test cases of increasing difficulty, from rigid to deformable and from autonomous to forced real systems, combining monocular video and sensor measurements. We further demonstrate interactive use: forces of arbitrary magnitude and direction can be applied to the reconstructed object at any time, its response rendered in real time, in 2D or 3D. Assuming a dissipative Euler-Lagrange equation over a few generalised coordinates trades generality for a bounded, plausible response to unseen forces, where an unconstrained predictor diverges.

</details>


### [366] [GRNEdit: Efficient General Video Editing from a New Binary-Evidence Perspective in Generative Refinement Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16328)
*Feng Xie,Jiagao Hu,Fuhao Li,Zepeng Wang,Yuxuan Chen,Dahua Gao,Fei Wang,Daiguo Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GRNEdit是一个轻量级两阶段视频编辑框架，通过GRN（生成式循环网络/二进制位编码）将编辑语义建模为局部保留或翻转的比特决策，仅用0.6M训练对和不到3%的条件参数即可达到与14B开源编辑器相当甚至更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于指令的通用视频编辑方法通常依赖资源密集的条件建模方式（如重型分支或昂贵的源视频拼接），缺乏高效的编辑意图建模方法。作者希望探索一种更轻量、高效的方式来表征编辑意图。

Method: 提出GRNEdit两阶段框架。核心思想受GRN启发——通过比特组合编码视觉语义。具体地：(1) 将编辑语义重新定义为对单个比特的局部保留或翻转决策；(2) Stage I中，一个紧凑编码器将离散源码转换为连续证据信号，GRN主骨干在二进制细化过程中吸收这些信号；(3) 借鉴无空条件训练的classifier-free guidance思路，赋予空指令"不编辑"的语义（通过源重建监督），建立身份路径；(4) Stage II直接比较编辑状态与其源保持对应状态的差异，据此修正未决的目标比特决策。

Result: 仅使用0.6M训练对和不到3%的条件参数，GRNEdit-2B在OpenVE-Bench上达到4.03分，GRNEdit-8B达到4.18分。2B模型超越了多个14B开源编辑器，8B模型与领先的开源编辑器性能相当。

Conclusion: GRNEdit证明通过将编辑意图建模为二进制比特级的保留/翻转决策，可以在极低的参数开销下实现高效的通用视频编辑，验证了轻量条件建模在高性能视频编辑中的可行性。

Abstract: Instruction-based general video editing seeks to unify diverse editing operations within a single, intuitive interface. Existing approaches often rely on resource-intensive conditioning, using either heavyweight branches or costly source concatenation. Is there any efficient way to model editing intent? Thus, we introduce GRNEdit, a lightweight two-stage framework. GRN inspires our approach by encoding visual semantics through combinations of bits. Through task-specific fine-tuning, we take this representation further and recast editing semantics as local retain-or-flip decisions over individual bits. Source information is consequently modeled as coordinate-wise evidence supporting the observed binary states, while the GRN backbone remains responsible for resolving their global composition into coherent generative semantics. In Stage I, a compact encoder translates discrete source codes into continuous evidence signals, which GRN assimilates throughout binary refinement. Inspired by null-prompt training for classifier-free guidance, we further assign the null condition an editing-specific meaning: an empty instruction denotes no edit and is supervised through source reconstruction. This identity pathway not only implicitly strengthens evidence utilization and content preservation in Stage I, but also produces a source-preserving state in the same representation space as the edited state. Stage II can therefore directly compare each edited state with its source-preserving counterpart and use their discrepancy to revise unresolved target-bit decisions. Trained on only 0.6M pairs with less than 3\% conditioning parameters, GRNEdit-2B and GRNEdit-8B achieve scores of 4.03 and 4.18 on OpenVE-Bench. The 2B model outperforms multiple 14B open-source editors, while the 8B model performs on par with leading open-source editors.

</details>


### [367] [Unlocking Motion in Expressions: Temporal Calibration for Referring Video Object Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16332)
*Yiwen Jiang,Zhengtong Zhu,Ruixin Zhang,Jiaqing Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个面向视频目标分割的表达式驱动运动校准(EMC)框架，通过显式建模表达中的运动语义，自适应调节运动信息的使用，在六个标准基准上验证了方法优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RVOS方法在统一跨模态时序建模框架中引入运动信息，但未显式建模表达对运动语义的依赖，难以根据不同的语义需求自适应调整运动信息的运用。

Method: 提出EMC框架，包含三个模块：运动信号处理(MSP)模块从表达式中提取可解释的运动控制信号；运动影响校准(MIC)模块在时序决策中调节运动线索的贡献；语义时序阶段构建(STSC)模块建立与表达相关的时序阶段，为运动校准提供紧凑的时序候选空间。

Result: 在Ref-YouTubeVOS、Ref-DAVIS17、MeViS(valid/valid^u)、A2D-Sentences和JHMDB-Sentences六个标准基准上进行了广泛评估，验证了方法的优越性。

Conclusion: 通过显式解锁和利用表达中的运动语义，EMC框架能够自适应校准运动信息在RVOS任务中的贡献，有效提升了视频目标分割的性能。

Abstract: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to segment referred objects at the pixel level in video sequences based on natural language descriptions. Existing methods typically introduce motion information within a unified cross-modal temporal modeling framework, where language cues are used for target localization and segmentation. However, the dependency of expressions on motion semantics is not explicitly modeled, making it difficult to adaptively adjust the use of motion information according to different semantic requirements. To address these issues, we propose an Expression-driven Motion Calibration (EMC) framework for RVOS that explicitly unlocks and leverages the motion semantics within expressions. The proposed method extracts interpretable motion control signals from expressions via a Motion Signal Processing (MSP) module, and employs a Motion Influence Calibration (MIC) module to adjust the contribution of motion cues during temporal decision making. In addition, a Semantic Temporal Stage Construction (STSC) module is introduced to build expression-relevant temporal stages, providing a compact temporal candidate space for motion calibration. Through extensive evaluation on six standard benchmarks, including Ref-YouTubeVOS, Ref-DAVIS17, MeViS (valid/valid$^u$), A2D-Sentences, and JHMDB-Sentences, the superiority of our method is validated. We will release the code on https://github.com/Jeven7/EMC.

</details>


### [368] [SIGMA-Lane: Scale-pyramId Gated MAmba for Temporally Consistent Video Lane Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16338)
*Tiancheng Zhang,Mengmeng Wang,Yan Gao,Xiangjie Kong,Guojiang Shen,Jiaxin Du*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SIGMA-Lane，一种基于状态空间模型(SSM)的视频车道线检测方法，通过在SSM写入路径和残差融合路径上设置遮挡感知门控，有效缓解重遮挡导致的时域状态污染问题，并引入结构空间检索(SSR)从对齐历史先验中恢复缺失车道结构，在VIL-100和OpenLane-V上取得竞争力结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频车道线检测需要跨帧稳定的预测，但严重的车辆遮挡会破坏时域线索。在流式循环模型中，被污染的观测会进入隐藏状态并在后续帧中持续产生错误。现有遮挡感知方法通常仅将障碍物掩码作为辅助输入，无法直接保护状态更新路径，因此需要设计一种直接防护状态污染机制的方案。

Method: SIGMA-Lane将遮挡导致的失败模式建模为SSM时域建模中的状态污染问题。具体地：(1) 在SSM写入路径和残差融合路径上放置遮挡感知门控，控制当前观测如何进入时域记忆以及时域传播后如何融合回输出；(2) 进行坐标一致的仿射对齐；(3) 融合两条互补路径：SSM一致的双门控机制用于时域滤波，以及结构空间检索(SSR)用于从对齐的历史先验中恢复缺失的车道结构。

Result: 在VIL-100和OpenLane-V数据集上的实验表明，SIGMA-Lane在严重遮挡场景下提升了时域稳定性，并取得了具有竞争力的F1和mIoU分数。

Conclusion: 通过将遮挡感知门控直接作用于SSM的状态写入与融合路径，而非仅提供辅助遮挡掩码，SIGMA-Lane有效解决了视频车道线检测中因车辆遮挡导致的状态污染问题，验证了从状态空间模型角度建模该问题的有效性。

Abstract: Video lane detection requires predictions that remain stable across frames, yet severe vehicle occlusions can break temporal cues. In streaming recurrent models, corrupted observations may enter the hidden state and produce errors that persist into later frames. Existing occlusion-aware refinements usually provide obstacle masks as auxiliary inputs, so the state-update path is only indirectly protected. We propose SIGMA-Lane, which treats this failure mode as state contamination in State Space Model (SSM)-based temporal modeling. SIGMA-Lane places occlusion-aware gates on the SSM write and residual-fusion paths, controlling how current observations enter temporal memory and are fused back after temporal propagation. After coordinate-consistent affine alignment, the model combines two complementary paths: SSM-consistent dual-gating for temporal filtering and Structural Spatial Retrieval (SSR) for recovering missing lane structure from aligned historical priors. Experiments on VIL-100 and OpenLane-V show improved temporal stability under heavy occlusion, with competitive F1 and mIoU scores.

</details>


### [369] [Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection for Natural Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16367)
*Chengkun Rao,Yixuan Deng,Min Li,Yangjun Ou,Ye Li,Ziwei Luo,Zhaojing Wang,Junwei Tang,Bangchao Wang,Xiaoyun Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次提出以深度图为主模态、RGB图为辅助模态的自然场景骨架检测新范式，并设计了DDSkel模型。该模型采用非对称编码器融合RGB信息到深度特征中，RGB分支参数仅占深度分支的12%。尽管结构简单且仅用当前最佳方法36%的可训练参数，DDSkel在最具挑战性的SymPASCAL数据集上超越了所有现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自然场景骨架检测均以RGB图像为唯一输入，在复杂内容图像上性能显著退化。作者观察到深度图像对颜色和纹理不敏感，能提供清晰的区域轮廓和区域间空间关系，可天然缓解复杂场景下骨架检测的困难，因此提出以深度图为主导的新范式。

Method: 提出DDSkel（Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection）模型，采用非对称编码器设计，将RGB信息融合到深度特征中，其中RGB模态分支参数量仅为深度模态分支的12%。模型结构简单，不包含复杂设计。

Result: DDSkel仅使用当前最佳方法36%的可训练参数，在SymPASCAL这一包含大量复杂图像的最具挑战性数据集上超越了所有现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 本文证明深度图作为主导模态、RGB作为辅助模态的骨架检测范式是可行且高效的，在更少的参数量下取得了更优的性能，为自然场景骨架检测提供了新的研究方向。

Abstract: To date, all natural scene skeleton detection follows the paradigm of taking RGB images as the sole input; despite notable progress, methods under this paradigm suffer significant performance degradation on complex-content images. We observe that depth images are inherently insensitive to color and texture, and can provide clear regional contours and inter-region spatial relationships, which naturally alleviates the difficulty of skeleton detection in complex scenarios. Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes for the first time a novel skeleton detection paradigm where depth images serve as the dominant modality and RGB images act as the auxiliary, and accordingly presents a model DDSkel (short for Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection) under this paradigm. DDSkel employs an asymmetric encoder design to fuse RGB information into depth features, with the RGB modality branch having only 12% the parameters of the depth modality branch. DDSkel has a simple structure without intricate designs. Nevertheless, with only 36% of the trainable parameters of the current best method, DDSkel outperforms all state-of-the-art approaches on SymPASCAL, the most challenging dataset with a large volume of complex images.

</details>


### [370] [Adaptive Post-Processing Drives Instance-Level Detection in Stroke Lesion Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16377)
*Qinghui Liu,Jon André Ottesen,Atle Bjørnerud,Kyrre Eeg Emblem*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于容量条件自适应后处理（VCAP）方案，用于医学图像中病变实例级检测的评估与优化。研究发现后处理对实例级检测（Lesion-F1）的提升远大于架构设计，VCAP在ISLES'26数据集上使Lesion-F1提升0.032，约是任何架构改进效果的6倍。同时提出一种分辨率感知注意力架构Viola2Plus，虽未改善小病灶Dice，但将小病灶检测率提升3.7%。后处理后的双架构集成在5折交叉验证下达到Dice 0.651和Lesion-F1 0.614，显著优于未处理单模型基线的0.644和0.573。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医学图像分割中，实例级病变检测（如Lesion-F1）日益重要，但大多数pipeline仅针对体素级重叠（Dice）进行训练和后处理优化。这种失配在小病灶上尤为严重——接近命中（实质上大量重叠但略低于实例匹配阈值）的预测与完全漏检得分相同。作者旨在通过后处理而非架构设计来缩小这一差距。

Method: 提出VCAP（Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing）方案，根据每个病例的预测病变负荷自适应调整组件大小阈值，从而优化实例级匹配。同时设计了Viola2Plus，一种针对小病灶分割的分辨率感知注意力架构。最终将VCAP后处理应用于双架构集成，并通过5折交叉验证在1,453例训练集上评估。

Result: VCAP使Lesion-F1提升0.032（无偏交叉折叠估计），约为任何架构改进效果的6倍。Viola2Plus未改变小病灶Dice但将小病灶检测率提高3.7%。后处理双架构集成达到Dice 0.651和Lesion-F1 0.614，对比未处理单模型基线的0.644和0.573，Lesion-F1提升0.041。

Conclusion: 实例级病变检测的提升更多来自后处理策略（如VCAP）而非架构设计，特别是对小病灶而言。体素重叠指标（Dice）会掩盖检测率的实质性提升，评估时应同时关注实例级指标。这一发现为医学图像分割任务中的后处理优化提供了新的思路和方向。

Abstract: Instance-level lesion detection has been an increasingly larger focal point in medical image segmentation besides the more standard voxel-level overlap. Still, most pipelines are trained and post-processed for voxel overlap alone. In particular, the mismatch is most pronounced for small lesions, where a near-miss prediction---substantial overlap that falls just short of the instance-matching threshold---scores the same as a complete miss. In our ISLES'26 submission, we found that closing this gap mattered far more in post-processing than in architecture design. Our Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP) scheme adjusts component-size thresholds to each case's predicted lesion burden, improving Lesion-F1 by 0.032 (unbiased cross-fold estimate)---approximately 6 times larger than any architectural change we tested. A resolution-aware attention architecture (Viola2Plus), designed for small-lesion segmentation, shows why the distinction matters: it left small-lesion Dice unchanged but raised small-lesion detection rate by 3.7\%, a real effect voxel-overlap metrics alone would have missed. Under 5-fold cross-validation on the 1,453-case training set, our post-processed two-architecture ensemble achieves Dice 0.651 and Lesion-F1 0.614, versus 0.644 and 0.573 for the unprocessed single-model baseline.

</details>


### [371] [Synthetic Data Augmentation for Satellite-Based Analysis of Battle-Damaged Agricultural Fields in Ukraine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16380)
*Marta Sumyk,Oleksandr Kosovan,Iryna Voitsitska*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究利用合成数据增强方法（GAN和DDPM）来缓解卫星图像标注稀缺问题，用于监测乌克兰战争中农田受损情况。通过DDPM平衡增强，将分类准确率从84%提升至88%，平衡准确率从67%提升至81%，证明了合成卫星图像在数据稀缺的地球空间应用中的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监测乌克兰战争对农田的破坏对粮食安全和战后恢复至关重要，但基于卫星图像的计算机视觉系统受限于标注图像稀缺，尤其是受损农田样本不足的问题。

Method: 训练类条件GAN和DDPM在真实卫星图像上生成额外的"被轰炸"和"未被轰炸"农田样本，仅用生成图像进行训练增强，在完全真实的测试集上评估Vision Transformer分类器的性能，并比较多种真实与合成数据配置。

Result: 最佳配置（基于平衡DDPM增强）将准确率从84%提升到88%，平衡准确率从67%提升到81%，宏F1从65%提升到78%，未被轰炸类别的召回率从41%提升到69%。

Conclusion: 合成卫星图像增强方法能有效提升数据稀缺情况下战争受损农田分类的性能，展示了生成模型在战争影响地区地球空间应用中的实际价值。

Abstract: Monitoring war-induced damage to agricultural land in Ukraine is important for understanding threats to food security, environmental stability, and post-war recovery. However, the development of computer-vision systems for satellite-based damage analysis is limited by the scarcity of labeled imagery, especially for damaged agricultural fields. This work investigates synthetic data augmentation as a method for improving classification under limited and imbalanced training data. We train class-conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) architectures on real satellite images and use them to generate additional bombed and not-bombed agricultural-field samples. The generated images are used only for training augmentation, while all downstream evaluation is performed on an exclusively real test set. A Vision Transformer classifier is trained under multiple real and synthetic data configurations to measure the practical utility of each generative approach. The best configuration, based on balanced DDPM augmentation, improves accuracy from 84\% to 88\%, balanced accuracy from 67\% to 81\%, macro F1 from 65\% to 78\%, and recall for the underrepresented not-bombed class from 41\% to 69\%. These results demonstrate the potential of synthetic satellite imagery for data-scarce geospatial applications in war-affected regions.

</details>


### [372] [Self-Routed Tensor Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Universal Visual Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16384)
*Suraj Yadav*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Self-Routed Tensor Adapters (SRTA)，一种紧凑的多域视觉适配框架。SRTA将输入投影到低秩空间、用可学习的域矩阵计算路由权重、并以此权重混合共享Tucker核的切片，从而无需外部门控网络即可生成样本特定的适配矩阵。引入渐进式深度加权路由目标来监督路由决策。在五个多域视觉分类基准上，SRTA以显著更少的参数（rank=64时4域2.77M vs MoLoRA 9.52M）获得与MoE式PEFT基线相当或略优的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用视觉表示需要跨异质域的适配机制而不碎片化知识。标准低秩适配器对所有输入使用固定子空间，在域差异（风格、背景、语义上下文）大时受限；MoE式适配器虽能通过多专家通路实现专业化，但依赖外部路由器和大型专家库，引入额外参数并将路由与适配分离。目标是设计一种紧凑、无外部门控、将路由与适配统一的多域适配方法。

Method: SRTA包含三个核心组件：(1) 将每个输入投影到低秩空间；(2) 利用可学习的域矩阵从该低秩表示计算路由权重；(3) 用路由权重混合共享Tucker核的切片，生成样本特定的适配矩阵。整个过程无需外部门控网络，共享视觉因子可复用同时支持域感知专业化。此外引入渐进式深度加权路由目标，跨适配器层监督路由决策，强化通路学习。

Result: 在五个异质多域视觉分类基准上，SRTA的平均精度达到与MoE式PEFT基线（如MoLoRA）相当或略优的水平，同时训练参数大幅减少。rank=64时，4域设置下SRTA仅需2.77M参数（MoLoRA为9.52M），6域设置下仅需3.00M参数（MoLoRA为14.31M）。

Conclusion: SRTA提供了一种行之有效的精度-参数权衡方案，用于将视觉基础模型适配为通用多域表示，在保持竞争力的同时显著削减了参数量，适合大规模多域适配场景。

Abstract: Universal visual representations require adaptation mechanisms that adapt across heterogeneous domains without fragmenting knowledge into domain-specific modules. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts frozen visual foundation models efficiently, but standard low-rank adapters use a fixed subspace for all inputs, which can be restrictive when domains differ in style, background, and semantic context. MoE-based adapters improve specialization through multiple expert pathways, but often rely on external routers and large expert banks, adding parameters and separating routing from adaptation. We propose \textbf{Self-Routed Tensor Adapters}, a compact framework for multi-domain visual adaptation. SRTA projects each input into a low-rank space, computes routing weights from this representation using a learnable domain matrix, and uses these weights to blend slices of a shared Tucker core. This produces a sample-specific adaptation matrix without an external gating network, allowing shared visual factors to be reused while supporting domain-aware specialization. To strengthen pathway learning, we introduce a progressive depth-weighted routing objective that supervises routing decisions across adapter layers. Across five heterogeneous multi-domain visual classification benchmarks, SRTA achieves competitive or slightly stronger average accuracy than MoE-style PEFT baselines while using substantially fewer trainable parameters. At rank 64, SRTA uses 2.77M parameters in the 4-domain setting compared with 9.52M for MoLoRA, and 3.00M in the 6-domain setting compared with 14.31M. Overall, SRTA offers an effective accuracy-parameter trade-off for adapting visual foundation models toward universal multi-domain representations. \href{https://github.com/surajyadav-research/SRTA}{GitHub}

</details>


### [373] [Joint Flow Matching Enables Continuous Dose-Conditioned Cell Morphing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16424)
*Lea Bogensperger,Manuela Merlo,Martin Baumgartner,Michael Krauthammer,Bernard Ciraulo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种双时间步的联合流匹配（joint flow matching）方法，同时建模细胞潜伏表示和药物浓度，实现剂量条件下的单细胞形态变形，并支持从细胞形态估计浓度，在两种化合物上取得了有竞争力的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型预测化合物处理下的细胞扰动效应时存在局限：要么将扰动建模为分布到分布的映射而无法显式处理浓度，要么将浓度视为离散类别标签而无法实现连续剂量控制。因此需要一种能够支持连续浓度控制且具有可逆性的方法。

Method: 采用双时间步（dual-timestep）公式化的联合流匹配方法，同时建模细胞潜伏向量和药物浓度。利用流匹配的可逆性实现剂量条件下的单细胞形态变形（morphing），并通过联合公式在潜伏空间中诱导出单调的剂量-响应几何结构，同时支持从细胞形态反推浓度估计。

Result: 在两种化合物上，与代表性基线相比，该方法在逐浓度指标上达到有竞争力或更优的性能；同时展示了在训练中未见剂量上的泛化能力，并实现了离散类别方法结构上无法提供的能力（如连续剂量控制和浓度估计）。

Conclusion: 联合流匹配方法能够有效实现剂量条件化的细胞扰动建模，兼具连续浓度控制和可逆形态变形的能力，且能泛化到未见的剂量，为细胞扰动预测提供了一种优于离散类方法的新范式。

Abstract: Generative modeling has shown increasing promise for predicting cellular perturbation effects under chemical compound treatments. Existing approaches either model perturbation as a distribution-to-distribution mapping without explicit concentration handling, or treat concentration as a discrete class label, precluding continuous dose control. We introduce a joint flow matching approach that simultaneously models cell latents and drug concentration via a dual-timestep formulation, enabling dose-conditioned single-cell morphing through the invertibility of flow matching. The joint formulation induces a monotonic dose-response geometry in latent space and additionally supports concentration estimation from cell morphology. As proof of concept, we further demonstrate generalization to an unseen dose held out during training. Empirically, our method achieves competitive or improved per-concentration metrics on two compounds compared with representative baselines, while enabling capabilities structurally unavailable to discrete-class methods.

</details>


### [374] [Contrastive Energy Fields for Inference-Time Procedure Planning in Instructional Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16457)
*Mohamed Afham,Christoph Reich,Oliver Hahn,Daniel Cremers,Stefan Roth*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CEFITO提出将程序规划重新表述为任务约束优化问题，通过学习行动条件化的表示空间，并在推理时显式省略不相关行动，从而在程序规划基准上实现最先进准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有程序规划方法（如前馈神经网络或扩散模型）将每个行动都视为可能，缺乏强制任务特定逻辑约束的能力，这些约束本应使某些行动变得无关或不成立。因此需要一种能够显式推理行动空间并排除无关行动的方法。

Method: CEFITO首先学习一个预测器来表达行动条件化的表示空间，在此表示空间基础上将程序规划公式化为任务约束优化问题。与以往方法不同，CEFITO在推理时通过省略不相关行动来显式推理行动空间，实现有效的程序规划。

Result: 该方法在两个已建立的程序规划基准上取得了最先进的准确率。

Conclusion: 将程序规划重新定义为任务约束优化问题，并利用行动条件化表示空间进行显式行动空间推理，是提升程序规划性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Procedure planning seeks to estimate a sequence of actions to transition from an observed initial state to a given goal state. Current procedure planning approaches directly predict action sequences from latent representations using feed-forward neural networks or diffusion-based inference. These paradigms treat every action as plausible, lacking the ability to enforce task-specific logical constraints that render certain actions irrelevant or not plausible. We propose CEFITO, a procedure planning approach that learns a predictor to express an action-conditioned representation space. Based on this representation space, we formulate procedure planning as a task-constrained optimization problem. Unlike prior methods, CEFITO explicitly reasons over the action space by omitting irrelevant actions during inference-time planning. This reformulation enables effective procedure planning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on two established procedure planning benchmarks.

</details>


### [375] [Shared-Structure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation for Sparse-View Spectral CT Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16463)
*Jiancheng Fang,Shaoyu Wang,Wenjun Xia,Yang Chen,Qiegen Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种共享结构的4D光谱高斯表示（4D-SG），通过共享高斯几何与高斯级光谱密度曲线网络（GSC-Net）解耦空间结构和光谱衰减变化，实现稀疏视角光谱CT的连续4D重建，在50视角下平均性能最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏视角光谱CT需要同时处理角度欠采样和光谱耦合问题，现有方法通常为每个光谱通道独立优化几何结构，既缺乏对共享空间结构的利用，也不支持未观测光谱通道的连续查询。

Method: 提出4D-SG框架：从全光谱结构投影中学习共享高斯几何，并通过高斯级光谱密度曲线网络（GSC-Net）预测每个高斯体的原始密度变换，将共享空间结构与光谱衰减变化分解开，建立从离散光谱测量到连续4D表示的映射。

Result: 在6个包含合成、模拟投影和真实投影的数据集上（50视角）取得平均最佳性能。相比最强高斯基线，PSNR从35.56 dB提升至36.61 dB，SSIM从0.909提升至0.914，LPIPS从0.208降至0.194。

Conclusion: 4D-SG通过共享高斯几何与光谱密度曲线的解耦设计，有效避免了各通道独立几何优化，显著改善了稀疏视角光谱CT的重建质量，验证了其有效性与通用性。

Abstract: Sparse-view spectral computed tomography (CT) reconstructs energy-resolved attenuation volumes from limited projection views, requiring simultaneous handling of angular undersampling and spectral coupling. We propose a SharedStructure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation (4D-SG) that learns shared Gaussian geometry from full spectrum structural projections and uses a Gaussian-wise Spectral Density Curve Network (GSC-Net) to predict Gaussian raw density transformations. This factorization separates shared spatial structure from spectral attenuation variation, avoids independent channel geometry optimization, and establishes a continuous 4D-SG representation from discrete spectral measurements for unobserved spectral channel queries. Experiments on six synthesized, simulated projection, and real projection datasets with 50 views demonstrate the best average performance. Compared with the strongest Gaussian baseline, 4D-SG improves PSNR from 35.56 dB to 36.61 dB, increases SSIM from 0.909 to 0.914, and reduces LPIPS from 0.208 to 0.194, demonstrating its effectiveness for sparse-view spectral CT reconstruction.

</details>


### [376] [Sterilizable Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16469)
*Nick Lemke,Ssharvien Kumar Sivakumar,Antoine P. Sanner,John Kalkhof,Henry John Krumb,Ghazal Ghazaei,Anirban Mukhopadhyay*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SG-NCA是首个基于神经细胞自动机（NCA）的手术场景图生成框架，专为手术室（OR）中的无风扇边缘设备设计。该框架将NCA多类分割用于目标检测和特征提取，结合轻量级关系预测器，在保持与基线相当性能的同时参数减少55倍，并支持无风扇设备部署和手术视频字幕等下流应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的手术场景图生成方法依赖大规模、参数繁重的深度学习模型，由于硬件占用、卫生约束、延迟和数据隐私问题，难以在实际手术室环境中部署。作者旨在开发一个轻量级且可在无风扇设备上运行的场景图生成方法，以满足手术室的卫生协议和隐私保护需求。

Method: SG-NCA基于Neural Cellular Automata（NCA）构建，首次将NCA用于场景图生成任务。该方法包含两个核心组件：一是基于NCA的多类分割模块，用于高效的目标检测和特征提取；二是一个轻量级的关系预测器，用于建模对象间的语义关系。整个框架专门设计用于在无风扇边缘设备上进行推理。

Result: 在白内障手术和胆囊切除术视频上评估，SG-NCA实现了与既有基线方法相当的性能，同时参数量减少55倍。此外，作者展示了在无风扇边缘设备上的部署能力以及手术视频字幕等下游应用。

Conclusion: SG-NCA展示了NCA框架学习结构化表示的潜力，为经济实惠、隐私保护和适用于手术室的术中场景理解提供了可行方案，在保持性能的同时大幅降低了模型规模，适合部署于无风扇边缘设备。

Abstract: Scene graph generation from surgical video enables a holistic and structured understanding of surgical scenes by modeling objects and their semantic relationships. Despite recent advances, state-of-the-art approaches rely on large, parameter-heavy deep learning models that are impractical for deployment in the operating room (OR) due to hardware footprint, hygiene constraints, latency, and data privacy concerns. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scene graph generation method built on NCAs and the first NCA framework capable of learning structured representations. We introduce SG-NCA, a lightweight scene graph generation framework based on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), designed for inference in fanless devices critical for OR hygiene protocols. SG-NCA is the first scene graph generation combining NCA-based multiclass segmentation for efficient object detection and feature extraction with a lightweight relation predictor. We evaluate SG-NCA on videos of cataract surgery and cholecystectomy, demonstrating performance comparable to established baselines while requiring 55x fewer parameters. We showcase deployment on fanless edge devices better suited for the OR and demonstrate downstream applications such as surgical video captioning, highlighting SG-NCA's potential for affordable, privacy-preserving, and OR-ready intraoperative scene understanding.

</details>


### [377] [RISE: Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding across 3D Tracking and Structured Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16480)
*Yanbo Jiang,Haotian Zheng,Jiahao Wang,Hanxiao Ren,Yitao Xu,Yining Xing,Zehong Ke,Hao Cheng,Yiqian Tu,Jinhao Li,Zhiyuan Xuan,Fang Zhang,Jianqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RISE框架，涵盖路边序列中的度量3D跟踪与结构化视觉-语言推理。度量跟踪方面，采用仅图像的SAM3视频身份与校准引导掩膜一致性实现多视角身份关联，无需LiDAR或任务特定3D训练即可恢复持久3D轨迹；在6个交叉口的20个人工审核片段上达到66.9 MOTA。视觉-语言推理方面，构建了RISE-VQA数据集（557个片段、16个交叉口、61个路边视角、33,910个QA对），并提出交叉口留出的RISE-Bench评测基准，采用确定性任务特定指标评估语义选择、坐标、未来框和交互集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 路边感知场景中缺乏统一框架同时处理度量3D跟踪与结构化视觉-语言推理；现有方法依赖LiDAR或任务特定3D训练，泛化到不同交叉口布局需要重新训练；同时缺乏基于路边序列的高质量预测性问答数据集与公平评测协议。

Method: 1) 度量跟踪：将SAM3视频身份与校准引导的掩膜一致性相结合进行多视角身份关联，通过标定条件几何实现不同标定多相机交叉口的免重训练部署，仅用图像即可恢复持久3D轨迹。2) 视觉-语言推理：采用人工审核的MLLM流水线挖掘高价值片段，用受限全上下文Oracle构建带bbox锚定的预测性QA（不向被评测模型暴露未来证据），形成RISE-VQA数据集；设计交叉口留出的RISE-Bench评测语义、坐标、未来框和交互集合，使用确定性任务特定指标。

Result: 度量跟踪在6个交叉口的20个人工审核片段上达到66.9 MOTA；RISE-VQA包含33,910个QA对（557个片段、16个交叉口、61个路边视角）；实验显示领域自适应带来一致收益、时间上下文通常有助益，同时暴露空间定位、未来定位与交互推理方面的持续挑战。

Conclusion: RISE实现了一种无需LiDAR或重训练即可部署的跨交叉口度量3D跟踪方案，并通过严格数据构建协议与留出评测基准推动路边序列的视觉-语言推理研究；结果表明该方向仍有待解决的空间接地、未来预测与交互推理等核心难题。

Abstract: We present RISE (Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding and Evaluation), a framework spanning metric 3D tracking and structured vision-language reasoning in roadside sequences. For metric tracking, our image-only method combines SAM3 video identities with calibration-guided mask agreement for multi-view identity association, recovering persistent 3D tracks without LiDAR or task-specific 3D training.
