We further explore the potential of our method on downstream video applications, including object detection and monocular depth estimation.

</details>


### [409] [TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16765)
*Haoran Wang,Chaofan Ma,Ran Yi,Lizhuang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE-Bench，一个基于能力导向视角的多参考图像生成基准测试。通过将多参考任务形式化为四种原子操作（Anchor、Disentangle、Apply、Compose），构建了约1600个测试用例（槽位1-8），并设计了算子对齐的评估协议和诊断树分析。评估9个主流模型后发现核心瓶颈在于解耦（g）和属性绑定（⊕）而非场景级组合（C），最佳模型在属性保真度上仅得0.74分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对多参考图像生成的基准测试仍然围绕预定义的任务类型（如"主题组合"）组织，这种组织方式不适应组合式设置，导致覆盖碎片化、复杂度不可控、诊断价值有限。研究者希望采用能力导向的视角，通过识别多参考任务共享的原子操作来构建更具诊断性的基准。

Method: 形式化定义了四种原子操作：Anchor（锚定）、Disentangle（解耦）、Apply（应用）、Compose（组合），任何多参考提示可表示为这些算子上的组合公式，结构复杂度由算子槽位数量量化。据此构建TRACE-Bench，包含约1600个测试用例（槽位数1-8）、631个公式模板、约4000张参考图像。公式结构驱动算子对齐的评估协议（分能力评分）和诊断树分析（递归故障定位）。

Result: 评估9个领先模型后发现：核心瓶颈在于解耦（g）和属性绑定（⊕）而非场景级组合（C），即使最佳模型在属性保真度上也仅得0.74分。这些洞察在整体评分中不可见，展现了TRACE-Bench的诊断价值。

Conclusion: 现有基准的碎片化问题可通过能力导向的算子形式化框架解决。TRACE-Bench提供了可量化的结构复杂度控制和逐能力诊断能力，揭示出多参考图像生成真正需要攻克的技术难点在解耦和属性绑定层面。

Abstract: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. Building on this formulation, we construct TRACE-Bench, comprising approximately 1,600 evaluation cases across slot counts 1--8, built from 631 formula templates and around 4,000 reference images spanning diverse artistic styles and real-world subjects. The formula structure directly drives an operator-aligned evaluation protocol for per-capability scoring and a diagnostic tree analysis for recursive failure localization. Evaluating 9 leading models reveals insights invisible to holistic scoring: the primary bottleneck lies in disentanglement ($g$) and attribute binding ($\oplus$) rather than scene-level composition ($C$), with even the best model scoring only 0.74 on attribute fidelity. Project page: https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench

</details>


### [410] [Calibration-Free Vehicle Speed Estimation: A Monocular Keypoint-Template Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16785)
*Gaofeng Su,Keya Li,Raja Sengupta,Kara M. Kockelman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需相机标定的单目视频车速估计框架，利用36关键点车辆模板和逐帧更新的单应矩阵，结合YOLO关键点检测与扭曲光流法，在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集上实现可靠的速度估计（MAE低至7.6%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉的车速估计方法通常依赖路面特征、相机标定或参考物体，限制了其在便携设备（如行车记录仪、智能手机）上的部署。本文旨在解决这些局限，实现低成本、高效率且面向公民执法场景的车速估计。

Method: 采用36关键点车辆模板，训练基于YOLO的关键点检测模块（在多样化数据集上训练）；通过逐帧更新的单应矩阵将像素位移投影至度量空间。比较两种估计策略：仅关键点追踪和扭曲光流加稠密空间聚合，并应用10%修剪去除边缘离群值。

Result: 在VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集上，扭曲光流法MAE分别为15.0%和9.7%，±20%误差内精度为77.9%和93.1%；经10%修剪后MAE降至11.7%和7.6%，±20%精度提升至85.3%和95.4%。在400余个视频片段（30-100 mph）上验证有效。

Conclusion: 该框架解决了现有视觉方案的关键限制，支持使用行车记录仪和智能手机等便携设备进行低成本高效车速执法，推动基于公民参与的道路交通安全执法项目。

Abstract: This paper proposes a calibration-free framework for reliably and effectively estimating vehicle speeds from monocular videos, without relying on roadway features, camera calibration, or roadway-feature-based reference objects. The proposed framework estimates vehicle speeds using a 36-keypoint vehicle template and a homography matrix updated at each frame. A YOLO-based keypoint detection module is trained on diverse datasets, and two estimation strategies are compared: keypoint-only tracking and warped optical flow with dense spatial aggregation. Speed is estimated by projecting displacements into metric space using the homography, with validation conducted on over 400 video clips from roadside and overhead datasets, covering speeds from 30 to 100 mph. The method achieves reliable speed estimation on the VS13 and BrnoCompSpeed datasets, with the warped optical flow method delivering MAEs of 15.0% and 9.7%, respectively, and 77.9% and 93.1% of estimates falling within +/-20% error. After applying a 10% trim to remove edge-of-frame outliers, performance improves to MAEs of 11.7% and 7.6%, with within-+/-20% accuracy increasing to 85.3% and 95.4%. This work addresses key limitations of existing vision-based approaches and enables low-cost and efficient speed enforcement using portable devices such as dashcams and smartphones, thereby supporting citizen-based enforcement programs for traffic safety.

</details>


### [411] [Revisiting Classifier-Free Guidance Methods in Latent Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16786)
*Artem Sergievskii,Artyom Turevich,Sergey Kastryulin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了八种基于CFG延伸的训练免费推理时质量增强方法，在两类开权重rectified-flow transformer模型（SD3.5 Medium和FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base）及三个合成对齐基准上的表现。结果显示：没有任何方法在各项指标上持续优于传统CFG；APG虽获得若干名义最佳分数，但增益多在评估不确定度范围内；注意力扰动方法在SD3.5上偶有收益、在FLUX上更常出现性能退化，CFG仍是性价比最高的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的推理时质量增强方法大多在旧版U-Net扩散模型上提出，且评价指标仅关注图像质量本身，忽略了生成图像与文本提示之间的合成对齐和语义对应。随着扩散模型向rectified-flow transformer架构演进，需要重新审视这些方法的有效性。

Method: 在固定的逐模型协议下，对八种训练免费技术（多基于CFG），使用三个合成对齐基准，在SD3.5 Medium和FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base两种开权重rectified-flow transformer上进行系统化重评估。

Result: 没有方法在测量标准上一致优于CFG。APG获得几个名义最佳分数但增益处于评估不确定性内；注意力扰动方法在SD3.5 Medium上有零散收益，在FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base上更频繁出现退化；CFG作为低成本基线仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 在新型rectified-flow transformer架构下，现有训练免费增强方法相比CFG缺乏一致的优越性，提示这些方法需要针对新架构重新适配或验证，同时CFG仍是可靠且经济的选择。

Abstract: Inference-time quality-enhancement methods are an effective and widely adopted means of improving diffusion models without expensive retraining. We study a family of training-free techniques conceptually rooted in Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), most of which were originally proposed on older U-Net diffusion models and validated using metrics that assess image quality in isolation, without accounting for compositional alignment or semantic correspondence between the generated image and its associated text prompt. We re-evaluate eight such methods on two open-weight rectified-flow transformers under a fixed per-model protocol and three compositional-alignment benchmarks. No method consistently improves on CFG across the measured criteria. APG obtains several nominal best scores, but the corresponding gains often remain within the estimated evaluation uncertainty. Attention-perturbation methods provide isolated gains on SD3.5 Medium and more frequent degradations on FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base, while CFG remains a competitive lower-cost baseline.

</details>


### [412] [PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16793)
*Lingchen Sun,Rongyuan Wu,Xiangtao Kong,Jixin Zhao,Qiaosi Yi,Yujing Sun,Shuaizheng Liu,Zhengqiang Zhang,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixRestore 是一种无 VAE 的像素空间扩散 Transformer，用于统一图像复原任务。它直接在 patch 化像素上进行流匹配训练，完全不依赖 T2I 预训练。通过 LQ-HQ DINO 特征相似度预测层级特征可靠性，实现适应性条件融合和 HQ 特征监督。仅约 50M 参数、单步推理即在保真度、感知质量和退化鲁棒性上优于现有 UIR 模型，且更高效。更大变体可进一步提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 UIR 方法多基于大型预训练 T2I 潜在扩散模型，但存在两个关键问题：(1) 潜在空间中的 VAE 会丢失与复原相关的精细细节；(2) 开放式的文本生成先验容易引入与内容不一致的伪影。因此需要一种不依赖 T2I 预训练、直接在像素空间操作且保留细节的 UIR 方案。

Method: (1) 提出 VAE-free 的像素空间 Diffusion Transformer（DiT），扩散骨干完全从零训练，在 patch 化像素上直接进行流匹配，兼顾细节保留与序列长度可控性。(2) 利用 LQ-HQ DINO 特征相似度预测各层特征的可靠性：可靠层特征作为密集条件融合，不可靠层则施加更强的 HQ 特征监督以促进退化去除。(3) 在大规模多样场景与退化数据上训练，并利用 DINO 对抗目标微调为单步生成器。

Result: 在公开基准和真实世界测试集上，仅约 50M 参数且单步推理的 PixRestore 在保真度、感知质量和退化鲁棒性上均优于竞品 UIR 模型，同时计算效率远高于它们。更大的 PixRestore 变体可进一步提升性能，验证了像素空间设计的可扩展性。

Conclusion: PixRestore 证明了无需 T2I 预训练、直接在像素空间训练扩散 Transformer 即可实现统一图像复原，既避免了 VAE 信息损失和开放先验的不一致伪影，又通过 DINO 特征可靠性指导实现了对多种退化的适应性处理，且在极小参数量和单步推理下达到了最优性能，具备良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors. However, the variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent T2I models may discard restoration-sensitive details, while the open-ended synthesis prior can introduce content-inconsistent artifacts. We present PixRestore, a VAE-free pixel-space Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for UIR, where the diffusion backbone is trained entirely from scratch, without relying on T2I pretraining. PixRestore performs flow matching directly on patchified pixels, preserving fine-grained details while keeping the token sequence tractable. To adapt to different degradations, PixRestore learns to predict the reliability of layer features using LQ--HQ DINO feature similarity. Features from more reliable layers are fused as dense conditioning, while less reliable layers receive stronger HQ-feature supervision to encourage degradation removal. We train PixRestore on a large-scale corpus of diverse scenes and degradations, and further finetune it into a one-step generator using DINO-based adversarial objectives for efficient inference. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world test sets show that, with only about 50M parameters and single-step inference, PixRestore achieves the best overall fidelity, perceptual quality, and robustness to degradations among competing UIR models while being far more efficient. Larger PixRestore variants can further boost performance, demonstrating the scalability of our pixel-space design. Code and the curated benchmark can be found at https://github.com/csslc/PixRestore.

</details>


### [413] [Diagnosing Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding in Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16805)
*Yuanzhi Xu,Qian Gao,Jun Fan,Guohui Ding,Zhenyu Yang,Yuteng Xiao,Sixue Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文形式化了大视觉语言模型中的"密集同类属性错绑"（DSCAM）问题——模型能识别拥挤场景中的对象和属性，却将属性错误地分配给同类的其他实例。作者提出InstaBind-Lite基准，包含524张图像、529组3-6个同类实体的组、1773个框选实例、4种互补问题层级，共9580个确定性评估问题。实验显示开源系统平均错绑率19.84%，API系统7.55%，且80%以上的可识别错绑源自相邻实例，而传统聚合准确率指标完全掩盖了这些错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉问答精度指标无法区分"属性分配给错误实例"这类错误，而对象幻觉指标可能认为对象和属性都在图像中得到支持，从而掩盖属性错绑这一系统性盲区。需要一种能直接度量并追溯错误来源的基准。

Method: 提出InstaBind-Lite受控基准：包含529组3-6个同类实体的图像、1773个框选实例、有序相邻关系和可区分的颜色类属性、四层互补问题设计。通过源实例标注将"无依据生成"和"识别失败"与"属性从其他可见实体复制"相分离，并用错绑相关指标量化转移频率、相邻性、序数距离和干预效果。

Result: 开源模型平均错绑率19.84%，API/商业模型7.55%，且这些错误被聚合准确率隐藏。可识别错绑中，开源模型80.70%和API模型81.51%来自相邻实例。定位和实例优先干预对部分模型有效，但并非通用解决方案。

Conclusion: InstaBind-Lite将原本无法区分的错误答案转化为可溯源来源的失败类别，测试了传统基准无法测定的可靠性维度：模型不仅要知道"可见了什么"，还要知道"每个属性属于哪个实例"。

Abstract: Large vision-language models can recognize the objects and attributes in a crowded scene yet assign an attribute to the wrong same-class instance. Generic visual-question-answering accuracy marks the response as wrong, while object-hallucination metrics may regard both the object and attribute as image-supported; neither reveals the transfer. This study formalizes this blind spot as Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and presents InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark that makes it directly measurable. Its 524 images contain 529 curated groups of 3-6 same-class entities, 1773 boxed instances, ordered neighbors, distinguishable color-like attributes, and four complementary question levels, yielding 9580 deterministically evaluated questions. Unlike existing protocols, source-instance annotations separate unsupported generation and recognition failure from an attribute copied from another visible entity. Binding-specific metrics further quantify transfer frequency, adjacency, ordinal distance, and intervention effects. Across five open-source and two commercial/API models, the open-source systems average 19.84% Misbinding Rate and the API systems 7.55%; these errors are hidden by aggregate accuracy. Among identifiable transfers, 80.70% and 81.51%, respectively, originate from adjacent instances. Localization and instance-first interventions help selected models but are not universal remedies. InstaBind-Lite therefore turns previously undifferentiated wrong answers into source-identifiable failure categories and tests a reliability dimension that conventional benchmarks cannot determine: whether a model knows not only what is visible, but which instance owns each attribute.

</details>


### [414] [Unsupervised Learning of Cell Instances with Generative Routing Pyramids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16810)
*Ziwen Liu,Martin Weigert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无监督的细胞实例分割与表型分类方法，基于粗到细路由金字塔（coarse-to-fine routing pyramid）将像素与空间稀疏的潜在源关联，从而生成实例掩膜并编码细胞形态，在多种细胞形态和成像模态下取得有竞争力的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的显微镜图像细胞实例分割和表型分类依赖监督学习，需要大量人工标注，且将实例分割与细胞表征视为分离的独立阶段。本文旨在克服这一瓶颈，提出无需标注、端到端的无监督方法。

Method: 提出一种无监督方法，通过粗到细路由金字塔重建图像，将像素与空间上稀疏的潜在源（latent sources）关联。像素到潜在源的关联产生实例掩膜，而潜在源编码细胞形态特征，实现分割与表型建模的统一。

Result: 在多种细胞形态和成像模态下，实例分割性能具有竞争力；同时能对扰动条件下的细胞表型进行生成式建模。

Conclusion: 该无监督方法将实例分割和细胞表型表征统一在一个框架中，无需人工标注即可完成分割与分类，为显微镜图像分析提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Identifying and representing object instances such as cells or nuclei is a common task in microscopy image analysis. Established machine learning workflows typically use supervised detection or segmentation followed by feature extraction or classification, which requires manual annotations and treats instance segmentation and cell representation as separate stages. We describe a new unsupervised method for cell instance segmentation and phenotypic classification from unlabeled microscopy images. Our method is based on reconstructing each image using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid that associates pixels with spatially sparse latent sources. The resulting pixel-to-latent associations yield instance masks, while the source latents encode cell morphology. We demonstrate competitive performance in instance segmentation across diverse cell morphologies and imaging modalities, as well as generative modeling of cellular phenotypes under perturbations. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/weigertlab/routing-pyramids.

</details>


### [415] [Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16812)
*Long Cui,Xiaoqian Liu,Qi Qin,Yi Xin,Tao Lin,Jianguo Li,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套完整的图像编辑方案，包括包含1000多个细粒度编辑概念的分层分类体系、1200万高质量编辑对的ConceptEdit-12M数据集、概念库驱动的数据合成框架、密集监督训练策略以及用于细粒度诊断的ConceptEdit-Bench评估基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像编辑框架沿用文生图扩散模型的训练范式，但存在两个固有缺陷：一是对编辑概念粒度（edit concept granularity）关注不足，二是稀疏监督信号导致训练效率低下。

Method: 1) 建立包含超过1000个细粒度编辑概念的分层分类体系；2) 通过改进的合成框架构建1200万高质量编辑对的ConceptEdit-12M数据集，以修正生成数据的分布坍缩并保证数据保真度；3) 提出密集监督训练策略，将多个互不干扰的概念合成到单个图像对中，提供更丰富的学习信号。

Result: 训练结果验证了该策略的有效性，显著优于先前工作；同时提出了ConceptEdit-Bench细粒度评估套件用于诊断模型在大量真实场景下的能力。

Conclusion: 概念库驱动的数据集构建与密集监督训练策略有效解决了图像编辑中概念粒度缺失和训练效率低下的问题，大幅提升了模型性能，并提供了更完善的评估体系。

Abstract: Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. To address these issues, we establish a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy featuring over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts and build ConceptEdit-12M, a massive dataset of 12 million high-quality editing pairs via an improved synthesis framework. This library-driven approach effectively rectifies the distribution collapse of generated data while ensuring high data fidelity. Furthermore, we propose a dense supervision training strategy that synthesizes multiple non-interfering concepts into single image pairs. By providing richer learning signals, this strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and overall model performance. Training results validate our strategy, significantly outperforming prior works. Finally, we present ConceptEdit-Bench, a granular evaluation suite designed to diagnose model capabilities across a vast array of real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [416] [Can Unsupervised Methods Outperform Supervised Deep Learning When Ground Truth Is Sparse? A Case Study of Bronchovascular Bundle Segmentation in Low-Dose CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16855)
*Anna Mrukwa,Marek Socha,Aleksandra Suwalska,Agata Durawa,Malgorzata Jelitto,Katarzyna Dziadziuszko,Edyta Szurowska,Pawel Bozek,Michal Marczyk,Witold Rzyman,Rafal Dziadziuszko,Joanna Polanska*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种名为RONALD的支气管血管束分割流程，用于低剂量CT扫描中分割肺实质内的血管和支气管，通过去除支气管血管束改善肺结节检测，在DLCS和Pomeranian数据集上将结节保留率从约84-94%提升至接近100%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌因早期诊断难而成为全球致死率最高的癌症。早期筛查阶段结节常与血管和支气管壁相连，可见性降低，而患者增多和放射科医生不足导致诊断等待时间长。因此，需要对支气管血管束进行任务特异性分析，通过去除该结构来提升肺癌筛查的诊断潜力。

Method: 提出的RONALD分割流程作用于CT图像，返回肺实质中血管和支气管的二元掩膜。方法包括预处理阶段（肺、肺叶和纵隔分割），随后分别进行血管分割和支气管树分割。使用DLCS数据集和Pilot Pomeranian肺癌筛查计划的数据进行评估。

Result: RONALD成功分割了低剂量CT扫描中的支气管血管束，并相比其他分割方法改善了结节保留率：在DLCS中从93.98%和90.36%提升至100%，在Pomeranian数据集中从83.16%和62.36%提升至99.92%。

Conclusion: RONALD生成的支气管血管束分割结果可改善肺癌极早期阶段的肺结节检测能力。

Abstract: Background
  Lung cancer remains the deadliest cancer worldwide because it is often diagnosed too late. Effective treatment depends on detection at an early screening stage. However, the growing number of patients and the limited number of radiologists lead to prolonged diagnostic waiting times. In very early stage lung cancer, nodule visibility is further reduced by adjacent blood vessels and airway walls, because nodules are often connected to or supplied by these structures. Task-specific analysis of the bronchovascular bundle is therefore important for efficient nodule detection, and its removal can increase the diagnostic potential of lung cancer screening.
  Materials and Methods
  To assess the efficacy of the proposed method, we used series from widely utilized LDCT datasets, including the Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCS) dataset and the Pilot Pomeranian Lung Cancer Screening Program. The proposed bronchovascular bundle segmentation pipeline, RONALD, operates on computed tomography images and returns binary masks of vessels and bronchi located in the lung parenchyma. The method includes a preprocessing stage with lung, lobe, and mediastinum segmentation, followed by separate vessel and bronchial tree segmentation.
  Results
  The proposed pipeline segmented the bronchovascular bundle in low-dose computed tomography scans while improving nodule retention compared with other segmentation methods: from 93.98% and 90.36% to 100% in DLCS, and from 83.16% and 62.36% to 99.92% in the Pomeranian dataset.
  Conclusion
  The resulting segmentations can improve lung nodule detection in the very early stages of lung cancer.

</details>


### [417] [HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16859)
*Weiliang Chen,Haowen Sun,Jun Gao,Jiawei Chi,Hanyang Wang,Qiyu Dai,Yihao Li,Hao Li,Jingnan Gao,Yi-Hsin Hung,Xingzhuo Guo,Shangchen Miao,Zhiyuan Shi,Xiang Li,Fengrui Tian,Weihua Du,Ziqi Huang,Shenyuan Gao,Siqiao Huang,Mingyu Liu,Yifei Li,Shizun Wang,Xi Wang,Tianqi Zhang,Xue Luo,Xiyin Ren,Jinshan Ren,Xiaoyang Shen,Xiaobo Hu,Zhiyang Dou,Mingyu Ding,Yichao Yan,Xinchao Wang,Yizhou Wang,Shilong Liu,Wenzhao Zheng,Yueqi Duan,Yuan Gong,Ziwei Liu,Ming-Yu Liu,Jialong Wu,Jiangran Lyu,Fangfu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HarnessEval-W是一个智能体化的世界模型评估管线，通过分层智能体工作流将评估转化为可验证的推理树，从而替代传统的暴力计算评分方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准评估不应仅输出标量分数，其可信度取决于支撑分数的推理过程。这在世界模型评估中尤为关键，因为判断rollout是否正确需要理解物理、因果关系和世界状态的演化。人类能自然识别这些违例，但现有基准无法自动化这一能力，指标以暴力计算方式得出，缺乏可审查的推理链。

Method: HarnessEval-W将LLM生态中的harness范式引入世界模型基准評估。它不是应用固定规则，而是：1) 解读每个评估案例的上下文；2) 将评估问题分解为可测量的子问题；3) 生成专门的子智能体，每个配备定制上下文和诊断工具，独立推理其子问题；4) 父智能体验证收集的证据并总结为最终结论。这一分层工作流将每次评估转化为完整的证据树。

Result: 将HarnessEval-W应用于18个代表性世界模型、330个评估案例。其判断与人类偏好高度一致，同时为每个生成的rollout提供可验证、细粒度的诊断。完整管线作为实时基准开源，邀请社区贡献以扩展新的技能和评估案例。

Conclusion: HarnessEval-W通过将评估转化为可验证的推理链，弥补了世界模型基准评估在可解释性和可验证性方面的空白，使评估结果不仅限于分数，还包含完整的推理依据。

Abstract: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-W, an agentified evaluation pipeline that brings the harness paradigm from the LLM ecosystem to world model benchmarking. Rather than applying a fixed rubric, HarnessEval-W interprets the context of each evaluation case, decomposes the evaluation question into measurable subproblems, and spawns specialized sub-agents, each equipped with tailored context and diagnostic tools to reason over its own subproblem. The parent agent then validates the gathered evidence and summarizes it into the final verdict. This hierarchical workflow turns every evaluation into a transparent evidence tree whose complete reasoning chain justifies the result. We apply HarnessEval-W to 18 representative world models over 330 evaluation cases. Its judgments closely align with human preferences while providing verifiable, fine-grained diagnoses of every generated rollout. We open-source the full pipeline as a live benchmark and invite the broad community to contribute to grow new skills and evaluation cases as world models evolve.

</details>


### [418] [SplatGuide: Geometric Priors from 3D Gaussians for Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16863)
*Yejun Zhang,Zihan Wang,Xu Ji,Yihao Wang,Yuxin Hou,Junyuan Fang,Juho-Matti Kilpeläinen,Arno Solin,Hamed Rezazadegan Tavakoli,Esa Rahtu,Juho Kannala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SplatGuide提出了一种无缝融合3DGS重建与多视图扩散的框架，从单个3DGS场景中提取三种互补信号（像素渲染、逐高斯可见性投票图、重建token特征），解决了以往管线仅利用单一信号导致的信息断连问题，在多个数据集上达到SOTA的无位姿新视图合成效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有管线将前馈3DGS重建与多视图扩散结合时，最多只从重建中提取一种信号（要么像素渲染，要么学习到的特征），而忽略了逐高斯可见性这一关键信息，导致可渲染几何、可见性线索与学习特征未能被充分利用，形成信息断连，限制了新视图合成的质量与遮挡感知能力。

Method: SplatGuide复用单个3DGS场景承担三种互补角色：1）渲染图像提供像素级对齐的几何条件；2）将逐高斯的源视图索引渲染为目标视图投票图，用于遮挡感知的参考视图选择；3）重建token通过交叉注意力提供特征级引导。三种信号全部来自同一次重建前向传播，计算成本低，信息互补充分。

Result: 在RealEstate10K、DL3DV、Tanks-and-Temples和Mip-NeRF 360四个数据集上达到SOTA的无位姿新视图合成效果；在RealEstate10K上使用中等数量的输入视图时，甚至超越了使用真实位姿的基线方法。

Conclusion: SplatGuide通过同时利用重建的几何渲染、可见性投票和特征token三种信号，有效弥合了3DGS重建与多视图扩散之间的信息断连，证明了单一重建结果的多角色复用能够显著提升无位姿新视图合成的性能上限。

Abstract: Generating photorealistic novel views from unposed images requires both 3D geometric understanding and the ability to synthesize unseen content. A natural strategy combines feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction with multi-view diffusion. Yet prior pipelines extract at most one signal from the reconstruction, either pixel rendering or learned features, while none exploits per-Gaussian visibility for occlusion-aware reference selection. This *information disconnect* leaves renderable geometry, visibility cues, and learned features unused. SplatGuide closes this disconnect by reusing a single 3DGS scene across three complementary roles. Rendered images provide pixel-aligned geometric conditioning. Per-Gaussian source-view indices are rendered into a target-view voting map for occlusion-aware reference selection. Reconstruction tokens supply feature-level guidance via cross-attention. All three signals derive from the same reconstruction forward pass. Across RealEstate10K, DL3DV, Tanks-and-Temples, and Mip-NeRF 360, SplatGuide achieves state-of-the-art pose-free novel view synthesis. On RealEstate10K, with a moderate number of input views, it surpasses the ground-truth-pose baseline.

</details>


### [419] [An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16887)
*Dengyang Jiang,Ruoyi Du,Zhennan Chen,Dongyang Liu,Zanyi Wang,Mingzhe Zheng,Xiangpeng Yang,Huanqia Cai,Aiming Hao,Yuming Jiang,Peng Gao,Harry Yang,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对像素空间扩散模型的训练问题展开研究。通过实证观察发现，直接大规模像素空间预训练收敛速度远慢于隐空间，因此提出了一种"隐空间到像素空间"（latent-to-pixel）的训练策略：在隐空间高效获取生成先验，后训练阶段迁移到像素空间。系统研究了权重初始化、数据组成、预测目标、解码器架构和噪声调度等关键设计选择，提出了一套实用配方，使像素空间模型性能匹配或超越隐空间对应模型，同时实现3.18至4.75倍的端到端推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管像素空间扩散模型日益重要，但现有研究多局限于小规模或类别条件设置，缺乏能与隐空间模型竞争的大规模像素空间训练实用配方。直接大规模像素空间预训练收敛明显更慢，亟需一种可行的训练策略。

Method: 首先通过全面的实证研究发现直接像素空间大规模预训练收敛速度显著慢于隐空间；基于此观察提出latent-to-pixel策略，即在隐空间先高效学习生成先验，后训练阶段再迁移至像素空间。随后系统研究了迁移过程中的关键设计选择：权重初始化、数据组成、预测目标、解码器架构和噪声调度，从而确定最优训练配方。

Result: 提出的像素空间模型在生成性能上匹配或超越隐空间对应模型，同时端到端推理速度快3.18至4.75倍。

Conclusion: 研究提供了像素空间生成未来研究的有用实证经验和实用指南，验证了latent-to-pixel策略是大规模像素空间扩散模型训练的有效路径。

Abstract: This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. Although numerous studies have explored this topic, most focus on small-scale or class-conditional settings. Consequently, a practical recipe for training pixel-space models that rival or exceed well-established latent-space counterparts remains elusive. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we first observe that direct large-scale pre-training in pixel space converges substantially more slowly than in latent space. This observation motivates a latent-to-pixel strategy that acquires generative priors efficiently in latent space and transitions to pixel space during post-training. We then systematically investigate the key design choices governing this transition, including weight initialization, data composition, prediction target, decoder architecture, and noise schedule, and identify a practical recipe that makes the resulting pixel-space models match or outperform their latent-space counterparts while delivering 3.18 to 4.75 times end-to-end inference speedups. We hope that our findings provide useful empirical insights and practical guidelines for future research on pixel-space generation.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [420] [AccretionLink: On-Device Auditing of Exposure-Control Attacks on Attribute Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14735)
*Faruk Alpay,Taylan Alpay*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出AccretionLink，定义了暴露控制攻击（通过选择公开帖子来强化私密属性推断，而不改变内容）的机密性与完整性博弈，并使用依赖感知的时间均匀e-process建模有界选择赔率。在52个合成画像上，四倍选择在每一时间范围均降低聚合负对数似然，八帖时优势为0.01595 nats；在142个PAN15测试画像上，探索性选择产生0.01227-nat优势但无反转。系统在Pixel 10设备上使用Tensor G5图一次性编码全部1,622个保留帖子，并通过P-256检查点及StrongBox密钥认证相关摘要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 攻击者可仅通过选择性地暴露用户的真实公开帖子（不修改内容）来增强对私密属性的推断能力。现有研究未系统定义此类攻击的安全性边界与统计保证，本文旨在建立形式化框架并量化其实际效果。

Method: AccretionLink定义了针对暴露控制攻击的机密性与完整性安全博弈；通过部分识别（partial identification）对受限制的选择赔率建模；构建依赖感知的时间均匀e-process（dependence-aware time-uniform e-processes）。实验在52个合成画像和142个PAN15画像上进行，比较了标签盲选模型引导选择、探索性选择及TF-IDF选择器，并使用P-256检查点和StrongBox密钥进行认证。

Result: 在52个合成画像上，四倍选择在每一时间范围均降低聚合负对数似然；八帖时优势为0.01595 nats（95% CI [0.00890, 0.02336]），四个目标效应中有三个在Holm校正后仍显著，标签盲模型引导选择导致6/109个高置信度错误反转。在142个PAN15画像上，探索性选择产生0.01227-nat优势但无反转；TF-IDF选择器对未变化的G5目标保留0.01470-nat优势，而匹配身份洗牌无法复现。Pixel 10在Tensor G5图上无回退地一次性编码全部1,622个保留帖子。

Conclusion: 暴露控制是一种切实可行的攻击向量，能够在真实社交帖子场景下提升私密属性推断效果；本文提供的形式化框架（安全博弈、部分识别、e-process）和实证结果表明需要针对此类选择性暴露攻击设计防御机制。

Abstract: Exposure control lets an adversary rank authentic public posts to strengthen private-attribute inference without altering content. AccretionLink defines confidentiality and integrity games for this attack, models bounded selection odds through partial identification, and constructs dependence-aware time-uniform e-processes. On 52 held-out synthetic profiles, odds-four selection reduced aggregate negative log likelihood at every horizon. At eight posts the advantage was 0.01595 nats (95% CI [0.00890, 0.02336]), three of four target effects survived Holm adjustment, and label-blind model-guided selection caused 6/109 high-confidence false reversals. On 142 PAN15 test profiles, exploratory selection produced a 0.01227-nat advantage but no reversal. A separate TF-IDF selector retained a 0.01470-nat advantage against the unchanged G5 target, while matched identity shuffling did not reproduce it. Pixel 10 encoded all 1,622 held-out posts once with a fallback-free Tensor G5 graph. A P-256 checkpoint authenticated the selected-replay, actual-model, native-report, and operation digests; local KeyInfo identified the signing key as StrongBox-backed.

</details>


### [421] [Not Discrete Enough: On the Inherent Insecurity of dTPMs for Measured Boot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14736)
*Christian Werling,Tahmid Zahin,Jean-Pierre Seifert*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文论证在安全性上，固件TPM（fTPM）或SoC内部TPM优于外部离散TPM（dTPM）。作者演示了即使短暂物理接触TPM 2.0并能够从受控系统启动，攻击者也能重置并重放任意测量值，从而解除受TPM保护的数据（如磁盘加密密钥），这是20多年前针对TPM 1.1就曾展示过的攻击。总线加密和CPU与TPM间相互认证只能抵御被动攻击，无法防御此类主动重放攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管离散TPM（dTPM）被视为黄金标准，其总线攻击可通过总线加密和相互认证缓解，但本文旨在指出另一类更难缓解的固有攻击——对TPM测量值的重置与重放攻击。现有观点认为fTPM虽经济但安全性较低，作者意图扭转这一共识，从安全角度论证fTPM优于dTPM。

Method: 本文为立场论文（position paper），通过实验演示对TPM 2.0的攻击：在短暂物理接触TPM且攻击者控制系统启动的情况下，重置并重放任意平台配置寄存器（PCR）测量值，从而绕过Measured Boot的完整性保证，解除受TPM封装的秘密（如磁盘加密密钥）。并对比分析了fTPM与dTPM的攻击面差异，以及总线保护技术的局限性。

Result: 成功证明了即使对TPM 2.0，仅需短暂物理访问即可重置和重放测量值，使攻击者能够解除仅由TPM保护的磁盘加密密钥。总线加密与相互认证只能防御被动嗅探攻击，无法防御主动的测量值重置/重放攻击。因此dTPM即便配合总线保护，其安全保证仍不充分。

Conclusion: 从安全角度看，固件TPM或任何SoC内部TPM优于外部离散TPM。为使基于dTPM的配置对封装的秘密提供有意义的保护，必须要求用户提供PIN或密码配合Measured Boot配置，不能仅依赖TPM单独保护。

Abstract: Measured Boot, a mechanism enabled through Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs), is commonly used for passwordless protection of data-at-rest, aiming to protect data when the device is lost or stolen. Microsoft's standpoint is neutral on which way a TPM should be implemented: Firmware-based TPMs (fTPMs) are viewed as more economical but less secure. Despite the inherent susceptibility to bus sniffing attacks, discrete TPMs (dTPMs) are still seen as the gold standard, as many deliver better on-paper tamper resistance. It is often argued that attacks against the bus can be mitigated by bus encryption and, ideally, mutual authentication between the CPU and TPM. This position paper aims to emphasize another inherent, difficult-to-mitigate attack against dTPMs that was originally shown against a TPM 1.1 over 20 years ago: We demonstrate that even brief physical access to a TPM 2.0 and the ability to boot from an attacker-controlled system enable an attacker to reset and replay arbitrary measurements, thereby allowing an attacker to unseal, for example, a disk encryption key solely protected by the TPM. While there have been attacks against fTPMs, too, we argue that their practical attack surface is fundamentally smaller. Bus protection techniques can be used to protect dTPMs, but only guard against passive attacks. After all, we argue that, from a security standpoint, firmware TPMs, or any TPM internal to the SoC, are superior to discrete (external) ones. Lastly, in order for dTPM-based setups to provide meaningful protection of sealed secrets, configurations must require a user-provided PIN or password along with the Measured Boot configuration.

</details>


### [422] [SynthGuard-ReleaseBench: Locked-Audit Evidence for Synthetic Tabular Data Releases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14753)
*Jeffery Opoku,David Banahene*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了SynthGuard-ReleaseBench，一个用于合成表格数据发布审计的框架，该框架在评估前锁定用途、候选面板、容差和审计时间表，将真实训练与合成训练的工作流在受保护数据上进行比较，同时给出有限样本界、对照组，并分离效用、经验隐私风险、机制声明和人工发布权限。在四个ACS研究、五个非ACS记录、两个时间诊断及一个密封原型上验证，结果表明透明基线通过部分锁定审计，紧凑学习模型在声明的预算下失败，且标准能够区分而非仅仅拒绝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的合成表格数据评估方式（真实性、隐私性或下游任务分数）无法回答一个关键问题：提出的数据发布是否支持特定用途、特定人群和特定威胁模型。作者希望建立一个审计框架，在评估前锁定所有关键参数，以提供可复现的、面向具体用途的发布证据。

Method: SynthGuard-ReleaseBench引入预审计样本量规则、方差自适应和任意时间有效的证书（将界限收紧2-10倍）、时间顺序审计的时间证书，以及两个下界：普通有界查询在查询预算达到审计规模时可重建受保护审计（证明面板大小修正必要而非保守）。框架要求使用对照组，并保持效用、经验隐私风险、机制声明和人工发布权限四个维度分离。

Result: 在四个ACS研究、五个非ACS记录、两个时间诊断和密封原型上，透明基线的通过情况与紧凑学习模型的失败结果并存；健康表案例因负对照组通过而被排除。事后审计扩展实验（三个生成种子重复）显示，同一锁定标准在学习模型在足够数据上拟合后接受它们，但始终拒绝破坏依赖性的对照组，证明标准具有判别力；同一重复过程也撤回了基于单种子的精细排序。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献是一个可复现的、面向具体用途的发布证据工作流，而非声称任何生成器是私有、安全或可部署的。审计框架能够判别性地评估合成数据发布，并提供了理论保障以支撑决策过程。

Abstract: Synthetic tabular data are often judged by realism, privacy, or downstream-task scores. Those scores do not answer whether a proposed release is supported for a named use, population, and threat model. We introduce SynthGuard-ReleaseBench, an audit framework that locks the use, candidate panel, tolerances, and audit schedule before evaluation. It compares real-trained and synthetic-trained workflows on protected data, gives simultaneous finite-sample bounds for bounded loss gaps, requires controls, and keeps utility, empirical privacy risk, mechanism claims, and human release authority separate.
  Across four American Community Survey studies, five non-ACS records, two chronological diagnostics, and a sealed prototype, the benchmark retains favorable, unfavorable, and excluded outcomes. Transparent baselines pass some locked audits; compact learned models fail under the declared budgets; a health-table case is excluded because its negative control passes. A post-audit scaling arm, repeated across three generation seeds, shows the same locked criterion admitting those learned models once they are fit on enough data while still rejecting a dependence-destroying control at every size, so the criterion discriminates rather than merely rejects; the same repetition withdraws a finer single-seed ordering.
  The theory adds a pre-audit sample-size rule, variance-adaptive and anytime-valid certificates that tighten the bound two to ten times on the same locked evidence, a temporal certificate for time-ordered audits, and two lower bounds: ordinary bounded queries reconstruct a protected audit once the query budget reaches its size, and the panel-size correction is necessary rather than conservative. The contribution is a reproducible workflow for use-specific release evidence, not a claim that any generator is private, safe, or deployment-ready.

</details>


### [423] [From Positionwise Confidence to Prefix Scheduling: Verifier Skipping in Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14787)
*Haoxuan Luo,Jameson Sandler,Ferdinando Fioretto*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究了投机扩散解码中的一个新控制手段：验证器跳过（verifier skipping），即直接提交所选草稿前缀而不调用验证器。研究发现更好的token预测器不一定带来更好的调度器，因为跳过需要连续高置信度的前缀，而短跳过可能引发额外草稿轮次。实验表明，在HumanEval上使用三种置信度信号可节省9.6%到13.5%的验证器调用，且原始置信度节省最多，表明验证器跳过的核心挑战在于前缀调度而非token预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机扩散解码（SDD）虽然通过离散扩散模型并行生成草稿块消除了顺序草稿，但仍然在每个块上调用目标模型进行验证，使得验证成为瓶颈。作者认识到这创造了一个新的控制手段：是否调用验证器，因此研究验证器跳过这一有损策略，以进一步降低验证开销。

Method: 提出验证器跳过（verifier skipping）策略，直接提交选定草稿前缀。基于Strict SDD、lenience和top-k接受作为基线，在同一策略下比较原始置信度与学习得到的边际生存分数和条件生存分数作为调度信号，用于决定何时跳过验证器。

Result: 在HumanEval上使用DiffuCoder-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-32B，三种置信度信号在保持相同pass@1的情况下节省了9.6%到13.5%的验证器调用。值得注意的是，原始置信度节省最多；边际生存分数在大多数位置上的位置级AUROC高于原始置信度，但两种学习信号在在线场景中均未占优。

Conclusion: 验证器跳过是一个有用的新的有损轴，但令人惊讶的是，其关键挑战在于前缀调度而非单独的token预测。更好的token预测器并不必然产生更好的调度器，因为跳过要求连续高置信度前缀的匹配，而短跳过可能引入额外的草稿轮次。

Abstract: Speculative decoding is a leading technique to reduce the cost of autoregressive generation by using a small drafter to propose several tokens, which are then verified in parallel by a larger target model. Speculative diffusion decoding (SDD) further removes sequential drafting by generating every position in a draft block in parallel with a discrete diffusion model. However, SDD still invokes the target on every block, leaving verification as a potential bottleneck. This paper recognizes that this creates a new control handle: whether to invoke the verifier at all. Thus, we study verifier skipping, a lossy policy that commits a selected draft prefix directly, and ask which confidence signal should schedule it. Interestingly, our study finds that better token predictors need not yield better schedulers: skips require contiguous high-confidence prefixes, while short skips can induce additional drafting rounds. To study this mismatch, we compare raw confidence with learned marginal and conditional survival scores under the same policy, using Strict SDD, lenience, and top-$k$ acceptance as baselines. On HumanEval with DiffuCoder-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-32B, all three confidence signals save $9.6\%$ to $13.5\%$ of verifier calls at the same observed pass@1 as Strict SDD. Surprisingly, raw confidence saves the most; marginal survival has higher positionwise AUROC than raw confidence at most positions, yet neither learned signal dominates online. Our analysis shows that verifier skipping is a useful new lossy axis and, surprisingly, its key challenge is prefix scheduling rather than token prediction alone.

</details>


### [424] [Bit-Level Triangular Content-Aware Permutation for Fragile Image Watermarking: Zero False Positive Rate, Single-Bit Sensitivity, and Arbitrary Dimension Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14800)
*Zahra Ghoraeian,Mohammad-Reza Sadeghi,Samaneh Mashhadi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于三角内容感知置换（TCA）的维度无关脆弱水印算法，替代传统哈希函数，实现针对VQ、拼贴等多种攻击的100%篡改检测与定位精度，FPR和FNR在17种攻击下均为0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脆弱水印方法对VQ攻击和拼贴攻击的鲁棒性不足，且受限于固定图像尺寸，无法满足数字文档交换中对图像完整性保护的安全需求。

Method: 将图像与基于密钥的全局噪声结合并分块；核心创新是在位平面级别应用具有内在雪崩效应的内容依赖置换（TCA），生成与内容唯一相关的水印；对彩色图像采用垂直夹层变换合并通道以保持通道间依赖性；通过"余数合并"策略消除填充约束，实现维度无关性。

Result: 在50幅灰度图和10幅彩色图上测试18种攻击：17种攻击下FPR=0%且FNR=0%，椒盐噪声下FNR仅为0.27%（灰度）和0.14%（彩色）；平均PSNR达51.14dB（8-bit）、75.25dB（12-bit）、99.33dB（16-bit）；嵌入与提取时间分别约1.61s和1.63s。

Conclusion: 该算法在拼贴、VQ、复制-移动、JPEG（质量5-95）及几何攻击下均实现100%检测精度，为数字取证、医学影像和法律文档认证提供了安全可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: With the growth of digital document exchange, protecting image integrity against attacks such as Vector Quantization (VQ) and collage has become critical. Existing methods are vulnerable to these attacks and limited to fixed image dimensions. This paper presents a novel, dimension-agnostic, fragile watermarking algorithm that enhances security and tamper localization by replacing conventional hash functions with Triangular Content-Aware Permutation (TCA).
  The image is combined with key-based global noise and divided into blocks. The core innovation is applying content-dependent permutation with intrinsic avalanche effect (TCA) at the bit-plane level, generating a unique content-dependent watermark. For color images, a vertical sandwich transformation merges channels, preserving inter-channel dependency with only 1.62x time increase. The "remainder merging" strategy eliminates padding constraints.
  Experiments on 50 grayscale and 10 color images under 18 attacks show FPR=0% and FNR=0% for 17 attacks. Salt-and-pepper noise yields negligible FNR of 0.27% (grayscale) and 0.14% (color). Average PSNR is 51.14 dB (8-bit), 75.25 dB (12-bit), and 99.33 dB (16-bit). Embedding and extraction times are 1.61 s and 1.63 s, respectively.
  The algorithm achieves 100% accuracy against collage, VQ, copy-move, JPEG (quality 5-95), and geometric attacks, providing a secure solution for digital forensics, medical imaging, and legal document authentication.

</details>


### [425] [STAR-FL: Secure Federated Learning with Spatial-Temporal Analysis and Robust Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14861)
*Nawrin Tabassum,Yanzhao Wu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出STAR-FL防御框架，通过时空聚类识别并移除恶意模型更新，并在聚合阶段动态调整学习率以减轻逃逸恶意更新的影响，在多个基准数据集上显著降低针对联邦学习定向投毒攻击的成功率，优于现有最先进的防御方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习系统中的数据投毒攻击构成严重安全威胁，而现有防御技术面临两大挑战：(1) 难以准确区分良性更新与恶意更新；(2) 难以在模型聚合阶段有效减轻被投毒更新的影响。

Method: STAR-FL由三个核心部分组成：首先，采用时空聚类（spatial-temporal clustering）识别并移除可能恶意的模型更新；其次，在聚合阶段动态调整学习率，以缓解逃逸检测的恶意更新的影响；最后，在多个基准数据集上进行广泛的实验评估时空分析和鲁棒聚合的协同效果。

Result: 实验结果表明，STAR-FL中的时空聚类分析与鲁棒聚合具有协同效应，能够有效保护联邦学习系统免受定向投毒攻击，一致性地优于现有的最新防御方法，显著降低了攻击成功率（ASRs）。

Conclusion: STAR-FL通过时空分析与鲁棒聚合的组合策略，有效解决了联邦学习中恶意更新识别和聚合阶段缓解两大难题，为定向投毒攻击提供了一种可靠的防御方案，且代码已开源。

Abstract: Data poisoning attacks pose serious security threats to Federated Learning (FL) systems in Computer Vision. Despite growing research attention, two key challenges remain for existing defense techniques: (1) accurately distinguishing between benign and malicious model updates and (2) effectively mitigating the influence of poisoned model updates during model aggregation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel defense framework against targeted poisoning attacks with Spatial-Temporal Analysis and Robust aggregation for FL (STAR-FL). First, we employ spatial-temporal clustering to identify and remove potentially malicious updates from the FL training process. Second, we adjust the learning rate during aggregation to mitigate the impact of any malicious updates that evade detection. Third, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple benchmark datasets to evaluate the spatial-temporal analysis and robust aggregation in STAR-FL. Experimental results demonstrate their synergistic effect in enabling STAR-FL to effectively protect FL and consistently outperform state-of-the-art defenses against targeted poisoning attacks, significantly reducing Attack Success Rates (ASRs). The source code is available at https://github.com/mlsysx/STAR-FL.

</details>


### [426] [Workspace Topology as an Attack Vector in Agentic Coding Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14876)
*Alexandre G. R. Day,Pradeep Yadlapalli,Sriram Venkatapathy,Thomas Paniagua,Nick Raines,Sahil Wadhwa,Himanshu Kumar,Andy Luo,Sudeep Panyam,Rikhiya Ghosh,Pranab Mohanty,Giri Iyengar*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了"工作区拓扑"（workspace topology）这一新型攻击面如何影响编码助手在集成第三方代码时遭受间接提示注入（IPI）攻击的成功率，发现代码库模块化程度、注入位置、上下文框架等维度都会显著改变攻击成功率（ASR），为编码代理的安全评测提供了实践指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码助手广泛用于集成和利用第三方代码，但其具有广泛的文件系统访问权限，导致恶意代码被悄悄注入的风险。现有研究缺乏对工作区结构维度如何影响IPI攻击成功率的系统性理解，因此需要量化评估这些因素。

Method: 定义"工作区拓扑"这一攻击面概念，包含四个维度：目录深度（directory depth）、代码库模块化（codebase modularity）、文件内注入位置（in-file injection position）和上下文框架（context framing）。在10种语言、6个工程领域的多样化开源仓库中，针对开源代码框架上的开放权重模型，评估了三种IPI入口点的攻击成功率。

Result: 工作区拓扑确实可测量地影响IPI攻击成功率。其中，代码库模块化程度的变化能显著改变ASR——高度模块化的环境攻击成功率显著更低；此外，上下文框架和工作区中引入安全提示也能改变ASR。

Conclusion: 研究为跨多样场景下编码代理的评估和安全测试提供了实用价值，同时强调了在无污染测试环境中进行评测以获得可靠结果和结论的重要性。

Abstract: Agentic coding assistants are finding widespread use, not just in new code development but in quickly ingesting and leveraging third-party code. This opens up a risk of malicious code being ingested as these coding tools operate with broad filesystem access inside developer workspaces. In this paper, we extensively study the impact of different dimensions of a novel attack surface we term workspace topology -- defined via directory depth, codebase modularity, in-file injection position and context framing -- on the attack success rate of adversarial prompt injection attempts.
  We perform an empirical study of indirect prompt injection (IPI) across a diverse set of open-source repositories spanning 10 languages and 6 engineering domains, evaluating three IPI entry points against open-weight models operating open source code harnesses.
  We find that workspace topology measurably affects IPI success. Specifically, changes in codebase modularity can significantly alter the Attack Success Rate (ASR), with highly modular environments demonstrating significantly lower attack success rates. Furthermore, context framing and introduction of security-cues in the workspace can also alter the ASR. Our findings offer practical value for the evaluation and security testing of coding agents across diverse settings, while underscoring the importance of an uncontaminated testing environment to obtain reliable results and conclusions.

</details>


### [427] [SysEvolve: An AI-native, safe, autonomous adversarial attack-defense co-evolutionary system](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15012)
*Yuhan Meng,Shaofei Li,Jionghao Huang,Jiandong Jin,Puyi Wang,Hanlin Jiang,Anis Yusof,Peng Jiang,Zhenkai Liang,Yao Guo,Ding Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出基于对抗共演化的安全AI框架SysEvolve，包含Field（构建真实多主机靶场）、Spear（生成高效安全攻击方案）和Armor（实施实时可解释防御）三个协同组件，形成自主对抗闭环，在三个层面恢复攻防演化。实验表明Field以2.1%开销实现零损失采集并编排257个CVE到1148个靶场，Spear将攻击成功率提升25%以上，Armor精度比现有系统高10-1000倍并已在华为和深信服生产中检测到真实APT攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展加剧了网络安全中攻防不对称：攻击正加速走向自主执行，而防御仍严重依赖人力。尽管已有大量关于网络靶场、AI攻击和AI防御的研究，这种不对称仍然存在。作者将其追溯到更深层的根本原因——攻防两端的演化在三个层面（数据层、模型层、系统层）都已停滞，需要一种整合性思路来打破僵局。

Method: 提出"共演化"（co-evolution）作为核心洞察——让攻击和防御AI代理通过对抗性交锋自主且安全地驱动彼此的演化。据此构建SysEvolve，由三个协同设计组件组成：SysField构建真实多主机靶场；SysSpear生成高效且安全的攻击方案；SysArmor执行实时、可解释的防御。三者共同构成自我驱动的对抗闭环，在全部三个层面恢复演化过程。

Result: SysField以2.1%开销实现零损失数据采集，并将257个CVE编排为1148个靶场；SysSpear相较基线LLM将攻击成功率提升超过25%；SysArmor精度比现有系统高出10-1000倍，并在华为和深信服的生产环境中检测到真实APT攻击。此外，评估还揭示三个发现：(1)多步组合和更大拓扑会暴露单步评估中隐藏的能力差距；(2)瓶颈在于初始访问后的后渗透状态利用；(3)LLM代理易受环境干扰——在靶场部署诱饵端点后，代理超时翻倍且下游完成度消失，尽管初始访问成功率不变。

Conclusion: 本文以对抗共演化作为攻防AI发展的整合框架，通过Field、Spear、Armor三组件形成自主对抗闭环，验证了在真实生产环境中的有效性。同时揭示LLM代理在多步组合能力、后渗透状态利用瓶颈和对环境干扰的脆弱性三个关键问题，为安全AI领域指明了未来研究方向。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has created a growing asymmetry in cybersecurity, where attack accelerates toward autonomous execution while defense remains predominantly human-intensive. Despite substantial prior work across cyber ranges, AI-driven attack, and AI-driven defense, this asymmetry persists. We trace it to a deeper root cause, that evolution itself has stalled on both sides at three layers. To overcome this, we propose co-evolution as the integrating insight, where attack and defense AI agents autonomously and safely drive each other's evolution through adversarial confrontation. Based on this insight, we present \sysevolve, comprising three co-designed components, \sysfield, \sysspear, and \sysarmor. \sysfield constructs realistic multi-host ranges. \sysspear generates efficient, safe attack schemes. \sysarmor performs real-time, interpretable defense. Together they form a self-driven adversarial loop restoring evolution at all three layers. In evaluation, \sysfield achieves zero-loss collection at 2.1\% overhead and orchestrates 257 CVEs into 1,148 ranges, \sysspear improves attack success by over 25\% over baseline LLMs, and \sysarmor achieves 10--1000$\times$ greater precision than prior systems and detects real APT attacks in production at Huawei and Sangfor. Our evaluation also reveals three findings about LLM agent capabilities. First, multi-step composition and larger topologies expose agent capability gaps hidden by single-step evaluations. Second, the bottleneck lies after initial access in post-compromise state utilization. Third, LLM agents are susceptible to environmental interference. When decoy endpoints are deployed in the range, agent timeouts triple and downstream completion disappears despite the success rates of initial accesses are unchanged.

</details>


### [428] [Hierarchical Agentic Incident Response with Digital-Twin-Validated Attack Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15016)
*Yiran Gao,Juntao Chen,Tao Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个分层智能体响应框架，整合LLM驱动的攻击推断、rollout规划与数字孪生验证，在33组件企业网络测试台上将恢复成功率较前沿LLM基线提升18-31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络事件响应仍缓慢且劳动密集，因防御者需从不完整观测中推断多阶段攻击并将恢复决策转换为可靠系统命令。决策理论规划器依赖抽象状态和预定义动作，而LLM智能体虽能推理操作上下文但可能产生幻觉。需要一种兼顾两者优势的自动化响应方案。

Method: 提出分层智能体响应框架，包含三层：(1) 微调LLM从安全告警和系统测量中推断攻击进程及受影响主机，并通过仿真网络数字孪生重放推断攻击、比对预测与实际效应的差异来校准推断；(2) 战术层使用rollout规划方法对受影响组件进行优先级排序；(3) 操作层规划智能体提出高层恢复动作，执行智能体将其翻译为恢复与验证命令并在数字孪生中验证。

Result: 在33组件企业网络测试台上针对三种多阶段攻击场景的评估显示，该框架在恢复成功率上较前沿LLM基线方法提升18-31%。

Conclusion: LLM推断、rollout规划与数字孪生验证的分层集成能有效提升自动化网络事件响应能力，优于单纯依赖前沿LLM的基线方法。

Abstract: Network incident response remains slow and labor-intensive as the defender must infer multi-stage attacks from partial observations and translate recovery decisions into reliable system commands. Decision-theoretic planners provide principled optimization but typically rely on abstract states and predefined actions, while large language model (LLM) agents can reason over operational context but may hallucinate attacks and responses. Toward automating response planning, we present a hierarchical agentic response framework that integrates LLM-based attack inference, rollout planning, and digital-twin validation. A fine-tuned LLM infers the attack progression and affected hosts from security alerts and system measurements. An emulated network digital twin replays the inferred attack and returns discrepancies between predicted and observed effects to calibrate the inference. A separately fine-tuned planning agent uses the rollout planning method to prioritize affected components at the tactical layer. At the operational layer, the planning agent proposes high-level recovery actions, and an execution agent translates selected actions into recovery and verification commands that are validated in the digital twin. We evaluate the framework on a 33-component enterprise-network testbed under three multi-stage attack scenarios. The results show that our framework outperforms frontier-LLM baselines in recovery success rate by 18--31%.

</details>


### [429] [Tensor--Action Ko--Lee Cryptography: A Framework and Structural Cryptanalysis of Commuting Subgroup Constructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15030)
*Ziyan Chen,Yuqiao Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于三次张量作用的Ko-Lee式公钥加密框架，并证明了其形式正确性，但随后展示了该框架在公开有限生成集的交换矩阵子群下普遍不安全，通过线性分解攻击可在多项式时间内从公开交互恢复共享张量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 张量同构作为代数问题已被研究与后量子密码学相关，但将其用于公钥加密仍是开放问题。本文旨在探索三次张量作用在公钥加密中的应用框架，并对其实用安全性进行严格分析。

Method: 作者首先形式化定义Ko-Lee风格的公钥加密框架，基于三次张量作用构建。然后针对公开有限生成集的交换矩阵子群场景，提出了线性分解攻击（linear decomposition attack），将三次张量视为d^3维空间中的向量来进行攻击。此外还分析了两类自然构造（域扩张、块对角、张量积）以及缩放块结构引起的低维泄漏，并进行了toy-scale实验。

Result: 该框架在公开有限生成集的交换子群设定下是普遍不安全的，线性分解攻击可在不恢复任何秘密作用的情况下、于多项式时间内从公开信息恢复共享张量。三种自然构造（域扩张、块对角、张量积）均有特定结构泄漏，缩放块结构还引起额外的低维泄漏。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献是一个框架提案及其密码分析，但该框架未能提供安全的公钥加密方案；结果表明基于三次张量作用的Ko-Lee式构造需要更谨慎的子群设计或不同的攻击面考虑。

Abstract: Tensor isomorphism has been studied as an algebraic problem relevant to post-quantum cryptography, while its use in public-key encryption remains open. In this paper, we formulate a Ko--Lee-style framework for public-key encryption from cubic tensor actions and prove its formal correctness. We then show that the framework is generically insecure when the commuting matrix subgroups are given by public finite generating sets. Viewing a cubic tensor as a vector in a $d^3$-dimensional space, a linear decomposition attack recovers the shared tensor from the public transcript in polynomial time without recovering either secret action. We also cryptanalyze three natural commuting-subgroup constructions---field-extension, block-diagonal, and tensor-product constructions---and give toy-scale experiments illustrating their specific structural leakage. Finally, we examine the lower-dimensional leakage caused by scaled-block structure. The contribution is therefore a framework proposal together with its cryptanalysis; it does not provide a secure public-key encryption scheme.

</details>


### [430] [WeSCE: A Benchmark for Measuring Security Drift in LLM-Driven Code Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15092)
*Zhiyu Zhang,Tingyue Wen,Senke Sun,Dengxiang Liang,Enhao Huang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出WeSCE基准，用于量化代码编辑在弱安全约束下的安全漂移。该基准包含400个来自真实代码的可执行程序，涵盖功能添加、删除、缺陷修复和重构四类任务。作者提出一种连续风险表示方法，通过统一公式聚合异构漏洞信号，并定义了捕获整体风险、最坏情况严重性和漏洞分布变化的漂移度量，提供从平均行为到最坏情况强调的多尺度安全视图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际代码编辑场景中，任务通常只指定功能目标而不包含明确的安全要求（即弱安全约束），导致代码编辑过程中容易引入或加剧安全漏洞，形成"安全漂移"问题。然而，现有工作缺乏系统化的基准和量化指标来度量这一现象。

Method: (1) 构建WeSCE基准：收集400个来自真实代码的可执行程序，覆盖功能添加、功能删除、缺陷修复和重构四类编辑任务；(2) 提出连续风险表示：通过统一公式聚合异构漏洞信号，将离散漏洞信息转化为连续风险值；(3) 定义漂移度量：分别从整体风险变化、最坏情况严重性变化和漏洞分布变化三个维度定义安全漂移指标，提供从平均行为到最坏情况强调的多尺度视角。

Result: 论文提出了WeSCE基准和配套的安全漂移量化框架，但摘要中未展示具体实验数值结果。

Conclusion: WeSCE提供了首个系统化量化代码编辑安全漂移的基准，连续风险表示和三维漂移度量共同构成多尺度安全评估框架，为弱安全约束下的代码编辑安全评估奠定了基础。

Abstract: In this work, we introduce WeSCE, a benchmark for quantifying security drift in code editing under weak-security constraints, where tasks specify only functional objectives without explicit security requirements. WeSCE consists of 400 executable programs derived from real-world code, covering feature addition, feature removal, bug fixing, and refactoring. To quantify security drift, we propose a continuous risk representation that aggregates heterogeneous vulnerability signals through a unified formulation, and define drift measures capturing changes in overall risk, worst-case severity, and vulnerability distribution under code transformations, providing a multi-scale view of security spanning average-case behavior to worst-case emphasis.

</details>


### [431] [Beyond Direct Access: Resource Hijacking in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15108)
*Puyu Zeng,Qibing Ren*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地研究了"智能体资源劫持"（agent resource hijacking）这一安全盲区：攻击者诱导智能体调用、消耗、转移或控制高价值资源（而非直接窃取资源或凭证）以实现自身目标。作者提出ResourceHijackBench基准和自动化生成管道，将高价值资源分为六类，构建300个攻击场景和900个攻击提示。实验表明无防御时OpenClaw平均攻击成功率达84.06%，不同模型后端成功率在69.98%-89.58%之间，最强防御后仍残留55.11%的平均攻击成功率，证明现有防御不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体安全研究主要关注对指令、数据和工具行为的攻击，而智能体可访问的高价值资源（如计算基础设施、凭证、预算、身份、私有知识、通信渠道和组织工作流）作为直接攻击目标尚未受到足够关注。作者旨在填补这一安全盲区，揭示资源劫持这一被忽视的攻击面。

Method: 作者首先定义并识别"智能体资源劫持"攻击模式（攻击者不直接获取资源或凭证，而是诱导智能体代为使用资源）；然后引入ResourceHijackBench基准，将高价值智能体资源分为六类，构建300个攻击场景和900个攻击提示；并设计自动化管道生成资源劫持用例。每个用例在隔离的本地环境中运行，记录实际资源使用情况，从而基于智能体行为而非文本回复评估攻击是否成功。

Result: 无额外防御时OpenClaw平均攻击成功率达84.06%；不同模型后端攻击成功率在69.98%-89.58%之间，表明攻击具有较强的跨模型泛化性。现有防御措施可降低部分风险，但最强的防御方案仍使平均攻击成功率高达55.11%。

Conclusion: 智能体可访问的高价值资源构成了一个重要且此前被忽视的攻击面，现有的智能体防御措施不足以有效抵御资源劫持攻击，亟需针对这一威胁开发新的防护机制。

Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly connected to high-value resources such as computing infrastructure, credentials, usage budgets, identities, private knowledge, communication channels, and organizational workflows. Existing agent security research mainly studies attacks on instructions, data, and tool behaviors, while high-value resources accessible to agents have received much less attention as direct attack targets. We are the first to identify and systematically study agent resource hijacking, a security blind spot in which attackers induce agents to invoke, consume, transfer, or control high-value resources for their own goals without directly obtaining those resources or their credentials. To study this threat, we introduce ResourceHijackBench together with an automated pipeline for generating resource hijacking cases. We organize high-value agent resources into six categories and construct 300 attack scenarios with 900 attack prompts. Each case runs in an isolated local environment that records actual resource use, allowing attacks to be evaluated from agent behavior rather than text responses alone. Without additional defenses, OpenClaw reaches an average attack success rate of 84.06%. The attack remains effective across different model backends, with average success rates ranging from 69.98% to 89.58%. Existing defenses reduce part of the risk, but the strongest evaluated defense still leaves an average attack success rate of 55.11%. These results show that high-value resources accessible to agents form an important and previously overlooked attack surface, and that current agent defenses are not sufficient to protect them from resource hijacking.

</details>


### [432] [SAEFUZZ: Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection through Statically Guided Evolutionary Fuzzing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15151)
*Shiting Yu,Rundong Wei,Xiaoqi Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出SAEFUZZ，一种轻量级智能合约模糊测试方法，通过字节码级静态引导生成测试用例，利用EVM控制流图提取漏洞相关路径、恢复函数选择器并按存储读写依赖排序函数调用顺序，结合覆盖引导的进化策略和五种运行时oracle，在已部署合约上达到98.50%准确率、90.00%精确率和81.82%召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能合约模糊测试器常生成高度随机的调用序列，浪费执行在语义无效或低价值状态上，导致需要特定调用顺序才能触发的漏洞无法被发现。

Method: 构建以太坊虚拟机控制流图，提取包含漏洞相关指令的路径，恢复函数选择器，根据存储读写依赖对外部可调用函数排序；采用覆盖引导的进化策略生成、评估、重组和变异可执行种子；设计五个专注的运行时oracle分别检测重入、整数溢出/下溢、区块状态依赖、不安全的delegate调用和冻结Ether。

Result: 在已部署的以太坊合约（含标注漏洞合约）上评估，SAEFUZZ检测到大多数标注漏洞合约，达到98.50%准确率、90.00%精确率和81.82%召回率；平均指令覆盖率为84.07%，生成用例中有效测试用例占93.48%。消融实验表明静态引导、定向种子生成和漏洞特定oracle均对最终性能有贡献。

Conclusion: 字节码级静态引导、依赖感知的函数排序和漏洞特定oracle的组合能有效提升智能合约模糊测试的漏洞检测能力和用例有效性。

Abstract: The effectiveness of smart contract fuzzing depends strongly on whether generated transactions reach deep, state-dependent execution paths. Existing fuzzers often generate highly random call sequences, wasting executions on semantically invalid or low-value states and leaving vulnerabilities that require specific invocation orders unexplored. We present a lightweight method for generating fuzz test cases under bytecode-level static guidance. We construct an Ethereum virtual machine control-flow graph, extract paths containing vulnerability-relevant instructions, recover function selectors, and order externally callable functions according to storage read-write dependencies. A coverage-guided evolutionary strategy then generates, evaluates, recombines, and mutates executable seeds. Five dedicated runtime oracles target reentrancy, integer overflow or underflow, block-state dependence, unsafe delegate calls, and frozen Ether. The evaluation uses deployed Ethereum contracts, including labelled vulnerable contracts. SAEFUZZ detects most labelled vulnerable contracts, yielding 98.50% accuracy, 90.00% precision, and 81.82% recall. It also achieves 84.07% mean instruction coverage, with valid test cases accounting for 93.48% of generated cases. Ablation results indicate that static guidance, directed seed generation, and vulnerability-specific oracles each contribute to the final performance.

</details>


### [433] [An Adaptive Gradient Clipping and Noise Injection Mechanism for Differentially Private Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15153)
*Wenjing Wei,Alla Jammine,Farid Nait-Abdesselam*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出DDP-SA-adaptive，一种用于带安全聚合的差分隐私联邦学习中的自适应梯度裁剪与噪声添加机制。与传统静态裁剪不同，该机制在每个通信轮次中，由每个客户端根据其逐样本梯度范数的中位数，为每个模型层确定独立的裁剪阈值，并据此校准添加的拉普拉斯噪声。实验表明，相比静态DDP-SA基线，该方法大幅提升训练效率（通信轮次减少6.81%，总训练时间减少19.21%），显著提高模型精度（测试损失降低98.74%，R²提升3.41%），并在达到相同精度时使用更小的隐私预算（ε=0.1 vs 0.4），实现了隐私-精度-效率三者的更优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私联邦学习需要在隐私保护与模型精度、训练效率之间取得平衡。现有静态梯度裁剪在整个训练过程和各层之间使用固定阈值，导致阈值过小时过度裁剪、阈值过大时引入不必要的大噪声，从而劣化模型性能。因此需要一种能够随训练进程和层间差异动态调整的自适应裁剪与噪声机制。

Method: DDP-SA-adaptive在每个通信轮次中，各客户端利用其逐样本梯度范数的中位数为每个模型层分别确定裁剪阈值，实现轮次级与层级双重自适应；随后根据这些自适应阈值校准在梯度编码和秘密共享到中间聚合服务器之前所添加的拉普拉斯噪声。该方法结合了安全聚合协议，在保护隐私的同时实现动态调整。

Result: 在联邦回归任务上，相比静态DDP-SA基线：通信轮次减少6.81%，总训练时间减少19.21%，平均每轮训练时间减少13.33%；测试损失降低98.74%，测试R²提升3.41%。达到R²=0.99时，自适应机制的隐私预算约为ε=0.1，而静态基线需要ε=0.4，表明在更强的隐私保护下仍能达到同等精度。

Conclusion: 轮级和层级的自适应裁剪与噪声添加机制能够有效改善差分隐私联邦学习的隐私-精度-效率三角权衡。该研究证明，动态调整裁剪阈值以适应梯度分布的变化，比静态固定阈值策略在多个维度上均具有显著优势，为差分隐私联邦学习的实用化提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Differentially private federated learning must balance privacy protection against model accuracy and training efficiency. Static gradient clipping applies a fixed threshold throughout training and across model layers, which can cause excessive clipping when the threshold is too small or unnecessarily large noise when it is too large. This paper presents DDP-SA-adaptive, an adaptive gradient clipping and noise adding mechanism for differentially private federated learning with secure aggregation. At each communication round, every client determines a separate clipping threshold for each model layer from the median of its per-sample gradient norms. The resulting layer-wise thresholds adapt to the evolving gradient distributions and calibrate the Laplace noise added before the updates are encoded and secret-shared among intermediate aggregation servers. We evaluate the proposed mechanism on a federated regression task in terms of efficiency, accuracy, privacy, convergence, clipping norm, and noise magnitude. Compared with the static DDP-SA baseline, DDP-SA-adaptive reduces the number of communication rounds by 6.81%, total training time by 19.21%, and average per-round training time by 13.33%, leading to improved training efficiency. It also reduces test loss by 98.74% and increases test R2 by 3.41%, leading to improved model accuracy. To attain R2 = 0.99, the adaptive mechanism operates with a privacy budget of approximately epsilon = 0.1, compared with epsilon = 0.4 for static DDP-SA, thus providing stronger privacy protection and achieving stronger privacy guarantees. These results demonstrate that round-wise, layer-wise adaptation can improve the privacy-accuracy-efficiency trade-off of differentially private federated learning.

</details>


### [434] [Pre-Model Representation Failures in GNN-Based Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15184)
*Birindwa Prisca Hondi,Chinoso Philip Nwishienyi,Charity Wanja Mwaura,Alia Teto,Jema David Ndibwile*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对基于GNN的智能合约漏洞检测器的表示层（图构建阶段）进行了失效分析，识别出四个严重缺陷：结构不同的合约生成逐字节相同的图（构成逃逸攻击）、硬编码47项变量白名单约束图构建、重入攻击的C节点在最经典的漏洞合约中缺失、以及可完全利用的合约因C->W边从未被构建而被误判为安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN智能合约漏洞检测器的准确率数据是在未暴露这些表示层缺陷的条件下测得的，作者旨在揭示这些隐藏在"学习之前"的图构建阶段的系统性失败，说明无论模型如何改进都无法弥补表示层的信息丢失。

Method: 以GNNSCVulDetector为研究对象，通过结构不同的合约生成对比、变量白名单映射分析、经典重入漏洞合约的图结构检查，以及一个受控实验（完全可利用合约被标记为安全）四个维度进行失效分析。

Result: 确认了四个表示层失效现象：逃逸攻击（结构不同但图相同）、白名单导致的变量名敏感性和命名漂移导致的图质量退化、C节点缺失、以及由C->W边缺失直接导致的误分类。其中一个误分类案例被直接证实。

Conclusion: 表示层失效是GNN智能合约漏洞检测器的根本性问题，当前文献中的准确率评估条件掩盖了这些缺陷；这类失效在真实合约群体中的普遍性仍需实证研究，但已确认的误分类案例表明该问题不容忽视。

Abstract: This paper is a failure analysis of the representation layer underlying GNN-based smart contract vulnerability detectors. These systems convert source code into graphs before any learning takes place; if the graph fails to capture the code's semantics, no model improvement can compensate.
  We investigate GNNSCVulDetector and identify four failures. First, structurally different contracts produce byte-for-byte identical graphs, constituting a concrete evasion attack. Second, graph construction is governed by a hardcoded 47-entry variable whitelist (including one duplicate entry), which constrains what the extractor can recognise. As a consequence, identical vulnerabilities with different variable names produce inconsistent graphs, graph quality degrades as naming diverges from the whitelist, and when no entry matches the pipeline produces structural output not grounded in source variables. Third, the C node (the graph element representing the external caller that triggers a reentrancy attack) is absent from even the most canonical vulnerable contract in the literature. Fourth, a controlled experiment confirms this as a direct misclassification: a fully exploitable contract is labelled safe because the C -> W edge is never constructed.
  All four failures are demonstrated experimentally. Current accuracy figures in the literature are measured under conditions that do not expose these failures. We demonstrate one confirmed case of misclassification caused directly by a representation-layer failure; the prevalence of such failures in real-world contract populations remains an open empirical question.

</details>


### [435] [Inferring 1-Minimal Trigger Configurations for Assessing Linux Kernel CVE Triggerability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15225)
*Tongjie Wei,Peng Zhang,Zhiwen Hu,Xupu Hu,Chen Lyu,Gangyan Zeng*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出了FCC框架，用于推断Linux内核CVE的最小触发配置：给定CVE和目标内核版本，合成Kconfig可满足的选项集，经make olddefconfig后仍有效，并裁剪为1-最小边界。在88个CVE上，配置成功率从62.5%提升到96.6%，候选集大小平均减少78.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内核CVE评估者需要知道漏洞在定制化生产配置下是否可触发，而不仅仅是版本是否受影响。上游复现程序和漏洞数据库很少提供配置层面的上下文，导致供应商难以评估其部署配置下的触发风险。

Method: FCC框架包含三个关键环节：(1) 将漏洞线索关联到构建系统符号；(2) 利用olddefconfig反馈补全隐式前提条件，避免静默回滚；(3) 基于依赖拓扑进行运行时验证的最小化，得到1-最小配置边界。支持可选基线.config和指定的评估协议。

Result: 在KernJC和KernelCTF共88个CVE上评估：post-make olddefconfig配置成功率从62.5%(55/88)提升到96.6%(85/88)；在KernJC上平均候选集大小从69.00减少到14.72个选项，降低78.7%。阶段分析显示Stage I主导开销，CVE聚焦的证据选择可显著降低成本。

Conclusion: FCC通过返回有效且可审计的1-最小配置边界，为供应商提供了工具支持的决策线，帮助其针对自身部署配置判断CVE的触发器范围（triggerability），弥合了上游漏洞信息与生产配置评估之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Vendors assessing Linux kernel CVEs need to know whether a bug is triggerable under production-tailored configurations, not merely whether a version is affected, yet upstream reproducers and vulnerability databases rarely provide configuration-level context. We study minimal trigger-configuration inference: given a CVE entry and a target kernel version (optionally a baseline .config), we synthesize a Kconfig-satisfiable option set that remains effective after make olddefconfig and, when a reproducer is available, still triggers under a specified evaluation protocol; we then prune it to a 1-minimal (subset-minimal) boundary for evaluation. Our framework FCC links vulnerability cues to build-system symbols, completes implicit prerequisites under olddefconfig feedback to avoid silent rollback, and performs runtime-validated minimization guided by dependency topology. We evaluate on KernJC and KernelCTF, totaling 88 CVEs across multiple kernel versions. On the 88-CVE set, FCC improves the post-make olddefconfig configuration success rate from 62.5% (55/88) to 96.6% (85/88) over an olddef-only injection baseline; on the KernJC set, FCC reduces the average candidate set size by 78.7% compared to KernJC (Avg. 14.72 vs. 69.00 options per CVE). A stage-wise analysis of time and token costs shows that Stage I dominates overhead, while CVE-focused evidence selection substantially reduces this cost. By returning an effective and auditable 1-minimal configuration boundary, FCC helps vendors scope triggerability against their deployment configurations with a clear, tool-supported decision line.

</details>


### [436] [External Sinkhole Attack Detection in Large-Scale WSNs Using Metaheuristic Feature Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15274)
*Seungwoo Han,Sawako Kitagata,Ingon Chanpornpakdi,Toshihisa Tanaka,Su Man Nam*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对大规模无线传感器网络中的污水坑攻击，提出了一种基于蜂群优化（BSO）算法的元启发式特征选择方法用于攻击检测。在3000×3000 m²区域部署2000个节点的外部污水坑攻击仿真中，该方法以16个特征缩减至8个特征实现了0.997的检测准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模无线传感器网络中污水坑攻击对网络功能构成严重威胁，需要高效、准确的检测方法。同时，高维特征集可能增加计算开销并影响检测性能，因此需要有效的特征选择技术。

Method: 采用蜂群优化（BSO）算法作为元启发式特征选择方法，从16个特征中筛选出8个最具判别力的特征用于污水坑攻击检测。

Result: 在2000个节点、3000×3000 m²区域的仿真场景下，所提方法实现了0.997的检测准确率，同时将特征维度从16维降至8维。

Conclusion: BSO特征选择方法能有效减少特征数量而不牺牲检测精度，为大规模WSN中的污水坑攻击检测提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: Sinkhole attacks in large-scale wireless sensor networks (WSNs) pose a serious threat to network functionality. This paper presents a metaheuristic feature selection for sinkhole attack detection using the bee swarm optimization (BSO) algorithm. In an external sinkhole attack simulation with 2000 nodes deployed over a 3000 $\times$ 3000 m$^2$ field, the proposed method achieves a detection accuracy of 0.997 while reducing the 16-feature set to eight features.

</details>


### [437] [Balancing Privacy and Compliance in DeFi: A Zero-Knowledge-Based Auditable Cross-Chain Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15276)
*Huiheng Li,Kainuo Feng,Jiahao Ding,Ziqi Ma*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可审计的跨链交易框架，通过零知识证明、轻客户端验证和基于分布式密钥生成的阈值视图密钥机制，在保护用户隐私的同时满足监管合规（如FATF旅行规则和MiCA法规）要求，为去中心化金融中的跨链交易提供了兼顾隐私与可审计性的解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨链交易面临用户隐私与监管合规之间的根本性冲突。与单链系统不同，跨链环境需要在异构架构中同时平衡隐私性和可审计性，而现有的透明账本和匿名加密货币解决方案均无法同时满足这两个要求，阻碍了监管机构的采纳。

Method: 构建可审计跨链框架，整合三大技术构件：1）零知识证明（ZKP）在不揭示交易细节的前提下验证交易合规性（如金额非负性、签名有效性）；2）轻客户端机制实现无需第三方中继的信任最小化跨链验证；3）基于分布式密钥生成（DKG）的阈值视图密钥机制，仅在法律触发条件（如FATF旅行规则、MiCA法规）下向授权实体授予审计访问权限。跨境调查场景遵循各国法律和欧盟司法协助指令。

Result: 系统性地将零知识证明、阈值密码学和轻客户端验证结合为可审计且保护隐私的跨链协议，为RegTech领域做出了贡献，为合规且可互操作的去中心化金融提供了可行路径。

Conclusion: 该框架为跨链环境中的隐私与合规兼顾问题提供了可行的技术方案，但仍有待实际部署验证其性能与安全性，未来需在更多合规场景和真实跨链生态中进一步检验。

Abstract: With the rise of decentralized finance (DeFi), cross-chain transactions, transfers of assets across different blockchain networks, face a fundamental conflict between user privacy and regulatory compliance. Unlike single-chain systems, cross-chain environments must balance privacy and auditability across heterogeneous architectures. Existing solutions, from transparent ledgers to anonymous cryptocurrencies, fail to reconcile these two requirements, hindering regulatory adoption. This research proposes an auditable cross-chain framework that integrates three building blocks. First, zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) verify transaction compliance (e.g., amount non-negativity, signature validity) without revealing transaction details. Second, a light-client mechanism enables trust-minimized cross-chain verification without relying on third-party relayers. Third, a threshold view-key mechanism based on distributed key generation (DKG) ensures that audit access is granted only to authorized entities under legal triggers such as the FATF Travel Rule and MiCA Regulation. For cross-border investigations, the framework adheres to national laws and the EU Directive on Mutual Legal Assistance. This work systematically combines ZKPs, threshold cryptography, and light-client verification into an auditable, privacy-preserving cross-chain protocol. It contributes to Regulatory Technology (RegTech) and provides a viable path toward compliant, interoperable decentralized finance.

</details>


### [438] [FedADB: Class Anchor-Driven Dual-Branch Federated Learning for Mitigating Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15310)
*Zhenyan Liu,Hua Zhang,Haoran Gao,Qi Li,Hongliang Zhu,Huiyu Zhou,Zongliang Shen,Yanxin Xu,Jiahui Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出FedADB框架，通过服务器生成可微分类锚点作为全局参考，结合双分支协同训练机制（全局锚点分支+局部校准分支），在无需代理数据集的情况下平衡类级全局一致性与局部优化，显著提升联邦学习的准确率和收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中，跨客户端数据异构导致本地训练遗忘已有的全局知识，造成性能和收敛速度下降。现有方法依赖全局对齐策略会阻碍局部优化，且对缺失类监督不足；引入代理数据集补充监督又难以平衡类级全局一致性与局部优化目标。

Method: 提出FedADB（Class Anchor-Driven Dual-Branch FL）框架。服务器在可微输入空间中生成类锚点（class anchors）并在客户端间共享，作为全局参考为本地训练中的缺失类提供监督。客户端采用双分支协同训练：锚点驱动的全局分支通过类锚点平衡采样实现全局一致性对齐；局部校准分支专注于学习判别性局部特征，缓解过度全局对齐导致的局部表征退化。

Result: 在多个医学和自然图像数据集上的大量实验表明，FedADB在准确率和收敛速度上均取得了显著提升。

Conclusion: FedADB通过类锚点驱动的双分支机制，在无需代理数据集的前提下有效平衡了类级全局一致性与局部优化目标，解决联邦学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，实现性能与收敛速度的双重提升。

Abstract: Multimodal data collected by heterogeneous devices are used for collaborative training, where federated learning (FL) serves as a key paradigm for effective distributed modeling with data privacy preservation. However, local training suffers from the forgetting of previously learned global knowledge under cross-client data heterogeneity, which leads to significant declines in both performance and convergence speed. Most previous studies rely on global alignment strategies to retain global knowledge, which hinder local optimization and lead to inadequate supervision of missing classes. Some studies introduce proxy datasets to supplement supervision for missing classes. However, it remains a challenge to balance class-wise global consistency and local optimization objectives without proxy datasets. In this work, we propose FedADB, a Class Anchor-Driven Dual-Branch FL framework. Specifically, the server generates class anchors optimized in a differentiable input space, which are shared across clients. These class anchors serve as global references that provide supervision for missing classes during local training. A dual-branch collaborative training mechanism is designed for clients. In this mechanism, the anchor-based global branch focuses on learning with global consistency, achieving global knowledge alignment by class-anchor balanced sampling. The local calibration branch focuses on learning discriminative local features, mitigating the degradation of local representations caused by excessive global alignment. Extensive experiments across multiple medical and natural datasets demonstrate that FedADB achieves significant improvements in both accuracy and convergence speed.

</details>


### [439] [Chameleon: An Adaptive AI-Driven Honeypot Architecture Using Threat-Calibrated Particle Swarm Optimization and Semantic Deception Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15407)
*Rohit Swami,Tushar Singh,Akash Warde,Sri Muthu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出Chameleon，一种开源自适应蜜罐平台，通过双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）分类器、本地部署的Qwen3.5-0.8B语言模型以及两种领域专用元启发式引擎（TC-PSO和S-RRT）协同工作，克服了传统蜜罐行为特征固定易被识破的缺陷。实验显示TC-PSO相比标准PSO在平均适应度上提升48.1%，S-RRT相比标准RRT在最佳适应度上提升258.9%，运行成本约为每月17美元，较商业方案降低约490倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统蜜罐存在固有弱点：其不变的行为特征使熟练攻击者仅通过少量诊断命令即可识别出欺骗环境，严重限制了情报价值。此外，高成本商业欺骗产品（年费10万至15万美元）的响应引擎未与实时模型驱动反馈耦合，同样存在响应不够智能的问题。为此需要一种既能动态调整行为使攻击者难以识别，又能与实时模型反馈深度集成的低成本自适应蜜罐平台。

Method: Chameleon平台集成了三大核心组件：(1) BiLSTM分类器，在七个威胁类别上达到99.61%准确率，CPU延迟约2毫秒；(2) 本地部署的Qwen3.5-0.8B语言模型，提供90%的上下文生成准确率和4.5毫秒平均延迟；(3) 两个领域专用元启发式引擎——威胁校准粒子群优化（TC-PSO）根据分类器异常输出动态调整群惯性和目标放大，实现连接保持延迟的实时调整；语义欺骗快速探索随机树（S-RRT）通过语言模型严重性评估衍生的指数缩放信息素更新驱动欺骗模式进化，并以深度衰减乘数限制内存占用。

Result: 在种子42至46的五次基准测试中，TC-PSO平均适应度较标准PSO提升48.1%（从2.60提升至3.85），收敛增益32.7%；S-RRT最佳适应度较标准RRT提升258.9%（从450.2提升至1,615.8），在关键严重级别实现329.2%增益，内存减少24.9%（p < 0.01）。运行成本约每月17美元，相比商业替代方案实现约490倍的成本降低。

Conclusion: Chameleon通过将深度学习分类器、轻量级本地语言模型与领域定制的元启发式引擎深度融合，成功构建了具有动态自适应能力的低成本蜜罐平台，在检测精度、欺骗真实性、应对效率和经济性四个维度上均显著优于传统及商业方案，为网络安全欺骗防御提供了新的可行范式。

Abstract: An invariant behavioral profile is the defining vulnerability of traditional honeypot installations: a skilled adversary can confirm the presence of a deception environment within only a few diagnostic commands, limiting its intelligence value. High-cost commercial deception products (USD 100,000--150,000 per year) share a related weakness in that their response engines are not coupled to real-time model-driven feedback. Chameleon is an openly distributed adaptive honeypot platform introduced here to address both shortcomings. Three core components are integrated: a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) classifier achieving 99.61% accuracy across seven threat categories at approximately two milliseconds CPU latency; a locally deployed Qwen3.5-0.8B language model (Qwen Team, 2026; Unsloth, 2026) delivering 90% contextual generation accuracy at 4.5 milliseconds average latency; and two domain-specific meta-heuristic engines. Threat-Calibrated Particle Swarm Optimization (TC-PSO) dynamically reshapes swarm inertia and objective amplification in proportion to the classifier's anomaly output, enabling real-time adjustment of connection-holding delays. Semantic Deception Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees (S-RRT) drives deception schema evolution via exponentially scaled pheromone updates derived from a language-model severity assessment, while a depth-decay multiplier enforces a finite memory footprint. Across five benchmark runs (seeds 42--46), TC-PSO outperformed standard PSO by 48.1% in mean fitness (2.60 to 3.85) with a 32.7% convergence gain, and S-RRT exceeded standard RRT by 258.9% in best-run fitness (450.2 to 1,615.8), achieving a 329.2% gain at critical severity and a 24.9% memory reduction (p < 0.01). Operating costs are approximately USD 17 per month, a roughly 490-fold reduction versus commercial alternatives.

</details>


### [440] [Bit-Flip Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models: Action-Decoding Architecture Shapes the Vulnerability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15475)
*Yudong Gao,Linghan Chen,Wenhan Wu,Mia Zhou,Jiyao Wang,Kaiyan Ji,Mingyu Guo,Honglong Chen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次提出针对量化视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的比特翻转攻击。通过梯度选位的少量比特翻转即可将闭环成功率降至0%，不同动作头家族的攻击预算差异显著（直接回归和token策略仅需1-5次翻转，flow-matching策略约需100-300次）。保护少量权重（3.1%-5.3%）即可显著提升模型鲁棒性，验证了权重完整性是具身基础模型的安全边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化VLA模型存在权重故障面：Rowhammer类故障可破坏部署的INT8比特位。这是首次针对VLA模型的比特翻转攻击研究，旨在揭示此类模型在物理部署场景下的安全性漏洞。

Method: 1) 提出基于梯度选位的比特翻转攻击方法；2) 提出固定方向流形逃逸损失(fixed-direction manifold-escape loss)，将π0的攻击预算从约1000次降至约100次翻转；3) 通过五方向扫描验证攻击不特定于全正方向；4) 对直接动作头进行针对性权重保护评估。

Result: - 少量梯度选位翻转使闭环成功率降至0%，而数百次随机翻转无害；- 三种动作头家族中，直接回归和token策略仅需1-5次翻转，flow-matching策略约需100-300次；- 固定方向流形逃逸损失将π0的攻击预算从~1000降至~100次翻转；- 保护3.1%权重可在K=100时维持60%成功率，保护5.3%可将开环破坏阈值从3次提升到100次翻转；- 任务校准的模拟K=100翻转导致真实机器人0/20成功（对比干净14/20、全局随机16/20）。

Conclusion: 权重完整性是具身基础模型（embodied foundation models）的安全边界。量化VLA模型极易受到针对性的比特翻转攻击，需将权重完整性保护与模型鲁棒性设计纳入安全考量。代码已附为补充材料。

Abstract: Quantized Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models expose a weight-fault surface: Rowhammer-style faults can corrupt deployed INT8 bits. We present the first bit-flip attack on a VLA: a few gradient-selected flips reduce closed-loop success to $0\%$, while hundreds of random flips are harmless. Across four model variants spanning three action-head families, damaging bits concentrate in a few action-generating layers, but the empirical budget depends sharply on the head: direct regression and token policies fall in $1$--$5$ flips, whereas the evaluated flow-matching policies require ${\sim}100$--$300$. Our fixed-direction manifold-escape loss cuts \pizero{}'s budget from ${\sim}1000$ to ${\sim}100$ flips, and a matched five-direction sweep shows that the attack is not specific to an all-positive direction. On a direct head, protecting $3.1\%$ of weights preserves $60\%$ success at $K{=}100$, and protecting $5.3\%$ moves the open-loop break threshold from 3 to 100 flips. Finally, task-calibrated emulated $K{=}100$ flips yield $0/20$ real-robot successes, versus $14/20$ clean and $16/20$ global-random. Weight integrity is therefore a security boundary for embodied foundation models. Code is included as ancillary material.

</details>


### [441] [A Lifecycle-Oriented Detection and Defense Framework for Price Manipulation Attacks in DeFi](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15518)
*Xingyu Xiong,Chang Liu,Xiaoqi Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对DeFi中频繁发生的预言机价格操纵攻击，提出了一个覆盖攻击模式分析、漏洞分类、风险评估、自动化检测和防御策略的全流程解决方案。基于预言机生命周期理论构建三层攻击树，识别出四个关键合约级漏洞，结合模糊层次分析法（Fuzzy-AHP）与风险价值模型（VaR）进行风险评估，开发了基于扩展Slither框架的自动化检测工具，并提出了多层防御策略。实验表明该方法可将攻击导致的价格偏差从55.56%降至5%以下，检测工具准确率达94.38%、召回率达92.31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化金融（DeFi）中预言机价格操纵攻击频繁发生，对协议和用户资金安全构成严重威胁。现有研究在攻击模式系统性分析、风险量化评估和自动化检测方面存在不足，缺乏从攻击链分析到检测防御的一体化解决方案。

Method: 采用多层方法论：（1）基于预言机生命周期理论构建覆盖物理层、协议层、应用层的三层攻击树，识别数据选举阶段为关键入侵点；（2）汇总四类合约级漏洞：价格数据流验证不足、预言机调用风险、不受控的跨合约调用、AMM价格读取逻辑缺陷；（3）结合Fuzzy-AHP与VaR模型量化风险因子并构建涵盖技术、市场、治理和合约风险的风险矩阵；（4）开发基于扩展Slither框架的自动化检测工具，采用污点追踪和模式匹配技术；（5）提出多层防御策略：数据源层采用可信执行环境（TEE），智能合约层采用TWAP平滑和自适应熔断器，操作系统层优化内核网络配置。

Result: 实验结果显示，所提出的防御方法将攻击导致的价格偏差从55.56%降低至5%以下；自动化检测工具在准确率和召回率上分别达到94.38%和92.31%，优于现有开源检测工具。

Conclusion: 该研究系统性地覆盖了DeFi预言机价格操纵攻击的完整攻击链分析、风险评估、检测与防御，形成了一个从理论分析到工程实现的闭环方案，显著提升了对该类攻击的检测能力与抵御水平，为DeFi安全领域提供了可借鉴的综合防护框架。

Abstract: Aiming at frequent oracle price manipulation attacks in Decentralized Finance (DeFi), this paper investigates attack patterns, vulnerability types, risk assessment, automated detection, and defense strategies. Based on Oracle lifecycle theory, a three-layer attack tree covering the physical, protocol, and application layers is constructed to analyze the attack chain and identify the data election stage as a key intrusion point. Four major contract-level vulnerabilities are summarized: insufficient validation of price data flow, oracle call risks, uncontrolled cross-contract calls, and defects in AMM price reading logic. Fuzzy-AHP and Value-at-Risk (VaR) models are combined to quantify risk factors and construct a risk matrix covering technology, market, governance, and contract risks. An automated detection tool based on an extended Slither framework is developed using taint tracking and pattern matching. Finally, a multi-layer defense strategy is proposed, integrating trusted execution environments at the data source layer, TWAP smoothing and adaptive circuit breakers at the smart contract layer, and optimized kernel network configurations at the operating system layer.
