Experiments show that the proposed approach reduces attack-induced price deviation from 55.56% to below 5%. The detection tool achieves 94.38% accuracy and 92.31% recall, outperforming existing open-source tools.

</details>


### [442] [A contribution to the critique of blockchain censorship](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15640)
*Ruichao Jiang,Michelle Yeo,Long Wen*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究区块链审查攻击，通过引入可检测性阈值，证明加入攻击对于持有大量投票权的"鲸鱼"验证者而言不再是主导策略，反而会导致其收益严格下降，从而改变博弈均衡，使仅靠"小鱼"难以发动攻击，并在以太坊和Solana上通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究[21]表明区块链审查攻击中，加入攻击是主导策略，这威胁到区块链的安全性和去中心化程度。本文旨在寻找机制来打破这一主导策略，防止少数高权重验证者合谋实施审查攻击。

Method: 引入可检测性阈值（detectability threshold）概念，将验证者区分为鲸鱼（拥有大量投票权的少数验证者）和小鱼（其余验证者）。通过理论分析证明在引入该阈值后，鲸鱼参与攻击的期望收益严格小于不参与时的收益，从而改变博弈均衡。同时使用蒙特卡洛模拟在以太坊和Solana的具体参数下验证鲸鱼收益的降低。

Result: 理论分析表明，引入可检测性阈值后，鲸鱼加入攻击会导致其收益严格减少，不再是主导策略。博弈均衡发生改变：鲸鱼不参与攻击时，仅凭小鱼难以发动审查攻击。蒙特卡洛模拟在以太坊和Solana上证实了鲸鱼奖励降低现象的存在。

Conclusion: 通过设计可检测性阈值机制，可以有效抑制高权重验证者（鲸鱼）参与审查攻击的动力，从而增强区块链系统对审查攻击的抵抗能力。该机制在以太坊和Solana等主流区块链网络中有实际可行性。

Abstract: We study the blockchain censorship attack introduced in [21], which shows that joining the attack is a dominant strategy. We show that, by introducing certain detectability threshold, joining the attack can lead to strictly less reward for whales, which are defined to be a small number of validators that hold significantly more voting power than the rest (henceforth known as minnows). This leads to a change of the equilibrium: With whales unwilling to participate in the attack, it is difficult for minnows alone to launch the attack. We also perform Monte Carlo simulation to show the existence of reduction for whales' reward in Ethereum and Solana.

</details>


### [443] [When Time Meets Space: Entropy Integration and Dynamic Threshold for Adaptive DDoS Detection in SDN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15642)
*Zhaoyang Zhang,Shen Wang,Ahmad Taha,Elias Bou-Harb,Xiaofeng Tao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级的时空熵DDoS检测器，综合空间熵（动态选择的流量属性对）和时间熵（包到达间隔随机性），通过受约束的二阶指数加权移动平均阈值（仅对正常窗口更新）融合为统一指标。测试床结果达到99.26%召回率、0.9737 F1分数、3.2%假阳性率；在CICDDoS2019上FPR为0，且计算开销低（每窗口3.95ms，CPU利用率11.65%），适合资源受限的IoT/边缘部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于熵的SDN DDoS检测方法依赖空间流量分布和静态或松散自适应的阈值，在IoT环境中易受正常流量波动影响，导致误报率偏高。需要一种同时考虑空间和时间维度、且阈值自适应机制不易被攻击数据污染的轻量级检测方案。

Method: 提出时空熵融合检测器：1）空间熵从动态选择的流量属性对计算；2）时间熵捕获数据包到达间隔的随机性；3）将两种归一化熵度量融合为统一指标；4）采用受约束的二阶EWMA阈值，联合跟踪熵的均值和波动性；5）阈值更新仅在分类为正常的窗口中进行，防止攻击污染的自适应偏差。

Result: 测试床实验：99.26%召回率、0.9737 F1分数、3.2%假阳性率（比仅用空间熵低41.74%）。CICDDoS2019数据集上FPR为0，性能与基于机器学习的方法相当。每窗口核心处理仅需3.95ms，系统级CPU利用率为11.65%，满足资源受限边缘和IoT部署需求。

Conclusion: 时空熵融合与受控EWMA阈值的组合能显著提升DDoS检测精度，同时降低计算开销和误报率。该方法在真实物联网环境的资源约束下具备实用性和可部署性。

Abstract: Entropy-based Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) detection in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) commonly relies on spatial traffic distributions and static or loosely adaptive thresholds, making it vulnerable to legitimate traffic fluctuations in Internet of Things (IoT) environments. This paper proposes a lightweight spatiotemporal entropy-based detector for DDoS attacks. Spatial entropy is computed from dynamically selected traffic attribute pairs, while temporal entropy captures the randomness of packet inter-arrival times. The two normalized entropy measures are fused into a unified indicator and evaluated using a constrained second-order Exponentially Weighted Moving Average threshold that jointly tracks entropy trend and volatility. To prevent attack-contaminated observations from biasing threshold adaptation, threshold updates are performed only for windows classified as normal. Testbed results show 99.26% recall, a 0.9737 F1-score, and a 3.2% false positive rate (41.74% below that of spatial entropy alone). On CICDDoS2019, the method achieves an FPR of 0 and remains competitive with machine-learning-based methods. It requires 3.95 ms of core processing per window and 11.65% system-wide CPU utilization, supporting resource-constrained edge and IoT deployment.

</details>


### [444] [Provenance, Not Behaviour: A Serialisation Artifact in Edge-IIoTset and a Leakage-Free Benchmark for Precision-Agriculture Intrusion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15761)
*Mostafa M. Galal*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了Edge-IIoTset基准数据集存在严重的标签泄漏问题，其预处理流程中7个分类列里有4个列通过序列化占位符字符串（正常流量为"0"，攻击流量为"0.0"）即可完全分离攻击与正常流量，导致多个分类器达到100%准确率。作者纠正后重建了AgriEdge基准（1,276,122行，5个设备），并发现泛化边界位于感知/执行层，随机森林的平衡准确率从0.9988骤降至0.5083。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Edge-IIoTset是工业物联网机器学习入侵检测的参考基准，但报告中几乎所有结果都聚集在99%以上，令人怀疑这些性能并非真正的入侵检测，而是数据本身的伪影。作者希望揭示性能虚假的原因，并提供一个无泄漏的、可信的重建基准。

Method: 作者首先分析Edge-IIoTset的预处理流程，发现7个分类列中4个通过占位符字符串差异（"0" vs "0.0"）即可完全区分标签。接着纠正协议后重新评估标准分类器性能，然后从原始抓包数据在统一解析下重建AgriEdge基准，包含1,276,122行、5个设备完整归属，并采用留一设备法（leave-one-device-out）评估泛化边界，同时测试非独立同分布联邦学习分区和LoRaWAN通信开销。

Result: 在原始协议下，5个标准分类器达到恰好1.0000±0.0000准确率，第6个达到0.99998。纠正后朴素贝叶斯宏F1下降0.3005，最强模型为0.9503±0.0011。重建的AgriEdge基准中无任何单列能分离类别超过0.0288。留一设备实验中随机森林从0.9988跌至0.5083平衡准确率，说明泛化边界位于感知/执行层。联邦学习分区成本至多0.0037宏F1，但20轮LoRaWAN训练需要4.6小时上行链路时间。

Conclusion: Edge-IIoTset的高性能结果源于数据集构建时的序列化伪影泄漏而非真实入侵检测能力；标签、序数和频率编码方式均存在相同泄漏。重建的AgriEdge基准暴露了跨设备泛化的真实挑战，为工业物联网入侵检测提供了更可靠、可复现的评估平台。

Abstract: Edge-IIoTset is the reference benchmark for machine-learning intrusion detection in the industrial Internet of Things, and results reported on it cluster above 99%. We show that much of that performance is not intrusion detection. The preprocessing recipe distributed with the dataset instructs researchers to one-hot encode seven categorical columns. Four of them separate attack from normal traffic with an accuracy of 1.0000 on their own, through the spelling of the placeholder written for an absent protocol field: the string "0" in the normal-traffic branch of the dataset build against "0.0" in the attack branch. The label is recoverable from a serialisation artifact encoding file provenance, with no network behaviour modelled, and separates every row of both curated subsets. Under 5-fold x 3-repeat cross-validation, five of six standard classifiers attain exactly 1.0000 +/- 0.0000 accuracy and the sixth attains 0.99998. Under a corrected protocol, naive Bayes falls by 0.3005 macro-F1 and the strongest model settles at 0.9503 +/- 0.0011. Label, ordinal and frequency encoding leak identically. Because the curated subsets also lack Modbus and per-device identity, we rebuild the benchmark from the raw captures under uniform parsing, producing AgriEdge: 1,276,122 rows, five devices with full attribution, and no column separating the classes above 0.0288. A leave-one-device-out sweep locates the generalisation boundary at the perception/actuation layer, where random forest falls from 0.9988 to 0.5083 balanced accuracy. Non-IID federated partitioning costs at most 0.0037 macro-F1, but a 20-round LoRaWAN training run costs 4.6 hours of uplink.

</details>


### [445] [Fast Simulation Algorithms for OLH using Binomial Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15778)
*Berkay Kemal Balioglu,Alireza Khodaie,M. Emre Gursoy*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出两种基于二项分布建模的快速模拟算法（2-Binom和3-Binom），将OLH本地差分隐私协议的模拟复杂度从O(nd)降低到O(n+d)，同时保持统计等价性，实验证明可将执行时间从分钟级降至毫秒级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OLH是广泛使用的基于哈希的本地差分隐私协议，研究中通常通过模拟实验进行评估，但现有模拟算法具有O(nd)的计算复杂度，随着用户规模n和域大小d的增长，执行时间显著增加，亟需更高效的模拟方法。

Method: 核心洞察：对于任意域值v，其扰动报告支持该值的用户总数可以分解为两个或三个二项随机变量之和。基于此，提出2-Binom和3-Binom两种快速模拟算法，将复杂度从O(nd)降至O(n+d)，并从理论上证明两种算法产生无偏频率估计且方差与原始OLH模拟完全一致。

Result: 理论上证明了两种算法均产生无偏频率估计，方差与原始OLH模拟相同；在真实数据集上的实验表明，两种方法将执行时间从几分钟降至毫秒级，获得显著加速且效用不变。

Conclusion: 基于二项建模的快速模拟算法在保持统计等价性的前提下极大提升了OLH模拟效率，为大规模LDP协议评估提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Optimized Local Hashing (OLH) is a widely used hash-based Local Differential Privacy (LDP) protocol, and simulation-based experimentation is the standard approach for evaluating OLH and OLH-based applications in research. However, the existing OLH simulations have $O(nd)$ computational complexity, where $n$ is the user population size and $d$ is the domain size, and can lead to significant execution times as $n$ and $d$ grow. In this paper, we propose two fast simulation algorithms for OLH (2-Binom and 3-Binom) grounded in Binomial modeling. Our key insight is that, for any domain value $v$, the total number of users whose perturbed reports support $v$ can be decomposed into a sum of two or three Binomial random variables. Using this insight, our algorithms reduce the simulation complexity to $O(n + d)$ without hurting statistical equivalence. In particular, we theoretically prove that both algorithms yield unbiased frequency estimations with variances identical to those of the original OLH simulations. Experiments on real-world datasets confirm that both approaches reduce execution times from several minutes to milliseconds, yielding significant speedups with no change in utility.

</details>


### [446] [Assessing Attack Surfaces in Generative Search Engines through Publisher Attributes: A Case Study in Political Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15814)
*Riku Mochizuki,Shusuke Komatsu,Souta Noguchi,Kazuto Ataka*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 该论文针对政治领域，从引文选择和个人化两个视角分析了生成式搜索引擎（GSEs）面对投毒攻击时的攻击表面。作者提出了内容注入壁垒（content-injection barrier）这一新指标来量化注入任意内容的难度，并考察了个性化对引文行为的影响。实验在美国和日本政治领域的三家主流GSE上进行，发现不同模型的攻击表面存在差异、网页搜索功能塑造了攻击表面、执政党比在野党攻击表面更广、用户画像对攻击表面影响甚微。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的引文评估研究只关注答案是否忠实反映引文内容，但未能回答两个关键问题：GSE倾向于引用哪些发布者，以及个人化如何影响引文行为。这两点正是刻画GSEs对抗投毒攻击攻击表面的核心维度。

Method: 提出评估框架来刻画GSEs的投毒攻击攻击表面，具体包括：(1)提出新指标"内容注入壁垒"，量化在给定发布者权威水平下向网络注入任意内容的难度；(2)通过向GSEs嵌入用户画像揭示个性化对引文行为的影响。在美日两国政治领域的三家主流GSE上进行实验验证。

Result: 实验结果揭示：(a)不同GSE模型之间的攻击表面存在差异；(b)GSEs的网页搜索功能塑造了攻击表面；(c)执政党相较在野党拥有更广的攻击表面；(d)用户画像对攻击表面的影响很小。

Conclusion: 该研究首次系统刻画了GSEs在政治领域对抗投毒攻击的攻击表面，填补了既有研究在引文发布者偏好与个性化影响两个维度上的空白，为理解GSEs的信息安全风险提供了新的评估工具和实证发现。

Abstract: We characterize the attack surface of generative search engines (GSEs) against poisoning attacks in the political domain, from the perspectives of citation selection and personalization. GSEs integrate web search and answer generation with user preferences and backgrounds using large language models (LLMs). They play a crucial role in how users access information on the web. Because anyone can publish content on the web, GSEs are vulnerable to poisoning attacks that manipulate citations to undermine reliable information delivery. Existing studies on citation evaluation focus on how faithfully answers reflect cited content. However, they leave unexamined the two critical aspects to capture the attack surface of GSEs against poisoning attacks: which publishers GSEs prefer to cite, and how personalization affects citation behavior. To fill this gap, we introduce an evaluation framework that characterizes the attack surface of GSEs against poisoning attacks. Our contributions are twofold: (1) we propose a novel metric, \emph{content-injection barrier}, which quantifies the difficulty of injecting arbitrary content onto the web with a given level of publisher authority; and (2) we reveal how personalization affects citation behavior by embedding user profiles into GSEs. We conduct experiments on three major GSEs in the political domain of the United States and Japan. Our results show that (a) the attack surface differs across GSE models; (b) the web search functionality of GSEs shapes the attack surface; (c) ruling parties have a broader attack surface than opposition parties; and (d) user profiles have little influence on the attack surface.

</details>


### [447] [Conjunctive Poisoning in AI Supply-Chain Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15913)
*Nokimul Hasan Arif,Qian Lou,Mengxin Zheng*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文揭示了LLM/VLM推理流水线中一个被忽视的安全漏洞：恶意开发者可通过构造看似无害的提示词包装器（prompt wrapper）与配置元数据（JSON/YAML）的交互，在不修改模型权重、训练数据或推理后端的情况下，确定性篡改模型的后生成行为。作者提出了TIF-BAH这种轻量级中间件防御方案，并在15个开源/闭源LLM/VLM部署上进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI部署安全验证仅关注模型权重和二进制的完整性，而提示词模板、后处理脚本和JSON/YAML配置元数据等文本类部署构件虽然直接影响运行时行为，却缺乏安全防护。恶意开发者可以利用这些"弱保护"的文本构件，通过良性的包装器外观与精心构造的元数据配合，在不触及受保护的模型或后端的前提下实现恶意行为定向操控。

Method: 作者通过受控的"合取门"（conjunctive-gate）实现来研究该攻击行为：攻击激活依赖于嵌入的包装器标记和密码学绑定的元数据两者同时满足。评估覆盖15个开源和闭源LLM/VLM部署，并测试了包括静态元数据检查、包装器扫描器、PromptShield和基于SigStore的工件签名等多种防御方案。作为对策，提出了TIF-BAH——一种轻量级中间件防御，在推理过程中验证包装器完整性并记录行为证明（behavioral attestations）。

Result: 实验结果显示包装器与元数据之间的交互构成了现代AI部署中一个防护不足的执行层，这种部署时的行为风险无法被模型权重级或提示词级防御捕捉。现有防御方案（静态检查、扫描器、PromptShield、SigStore签名）在面对此类攻击时存在覆盖盲区，而TIF-BAH提供了可行的缓解路径。

Conclusion: AI推理流水线中的文本部署构件（包装器+元数据）是一个尚未被充分保护的执行层，构成独特的部署时行为安全风险。该风险需要专门的中间件级防御机制（如TIF-BAH）来补足，现有模型权重验证和提示词防护体系均不足以覆盖此威胁面。

Abstract: Large Language and Vision-Language Models are increasingly deployed through inference pipelines that include prompt wrappers (e.g., templates and post-processing scripts) and configuration metadata (e.g., JSON/YAML files) that together shape model outputs. While model weights and binaries are routinely verified, these textual deployment artifacts remain weakly protected despite directly influencing runtime behavior. We show that a malicious developer can pair a benign-looking wrapper with crafted metadata to deterministically alter post-generation behavior without modifying model weights, training data, or inference backend. We study this behavior through a controlled conjunctive-gate implementation, where activation depends on both an embedded wrapper marker and cryptographically bound metadata. We evaluate the attack across fifteen open- and closed-source LLM/VLM deployments, and assess prompt and system level defenses including static metadata inspection, wrapper scanners, PromptShield, and SigStore-based artifact signing. To mitigate this risk, we introduce TIF-BAH, a lightweight middleware defense that verifies wrapper integrity and records behavioral attestations during inference. Our results reveal that wrapper-metadata interactions form an under-protected execution layer in modern AI deployments, exposing a deployment-time behavioral risk that is not captured by model-weight or prompt-level defenses. Code is available at https://github.com/N-H-Arif/llm_temp.

</details>


### [448] [SkillWatermark: An Embedded Skill Watermark of Progressive Privacy Inference via Benign Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16026)
*Yu Li,Liqi Zhuang,Dong Wei,Jiwen Luo,Hang Zhang,Meng Zhang,Xiaona Li,Weiqing Huang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种利用LLM Agent技能描述中的"技能水印"生成特定流量模式，从而在可见流量中建立隐蔽信道以编码私有信息的方法。通过向原始技能描述中插入提示约束条件（水印）并嵌入多轮对话，用户提示中的关键信息被触发产生可观察的流量编码，被动网络攻击者可解码这些模式恢复信息，且该修改能通过现有的LLM安全审计工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM Agent技能已广泛部署于多种应用领域，但作者观察到这些技能在执行过程中会生成特定的流量模式，这可以被利用为一个新的攻击面。论文旨在揭示通过流量模式分析实现隐蔽信息传输的风险。

Method: 设计一个pipeline，通过向原始技能描述中插入精心设计的提示约束项（即"水印"），将其嵌入多轮对话中。用户原始提示中的关键信息被这些水印触发，在流量中产生明显可观察的编码。被动网络攻击者只需解码流量模式即可恢复编码信息。该修改是良性的——不直接窃取私有数据，也不执行恶意指令。

Result: 大量实验表明，所提出的水印能产生高度一致且可区分的流量模式，且转换后的技能能够通过现有的基于LLM的安全审计工具。

Conclusion: 本研究揭示了生成特定流量模式可被利用为一种新型攻击面，为未来的安全加固提供了关键见解。

Abstract: Skills for large language model (LLM) agents have been widely deployed across diverse application domains. However, we observe that these skills generate specific traffic patterns during execution. In this paper, we design a pipeline that generates specific traffic patterns by inserting carefully designed skill descriptions, which we term skill watermarks, so that a passive network attacker can establish a covert channel to encode private information within observable traffic across multiple conversation turns. Specifically, we insert prompt constraint terms, referred to as watermarks, into the original skill descriptions and embed them within multi-turn conversations. The key information in the user's original prompt is thereby triggered by these watermarks, producing clearly observable encodings in the traffic. The adversary need only decode the traffic patterns to recover the encoded information. In particular, our modifications are benign in the sense that they do not directly exfiltrate any private data and do not execute any malicious instructions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our watermarks produce highly consistent and distinguishable traffic patterns, and that the transformed skills pass existing LLM-based security auditing tools. This study highlights that generating specific traffic patterns can be exploited as a novel attack surface and offers critical insights for future security hardening.

</details>


### [449] [Proof-of-Execution Memory: Defending LLM Agents Against Forged-Reasoning Attacks by Verifying What Actually Happened](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16032)
*Md Habibur Rahman,Jaeho Kim*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文揭露了FARMA攻击对LLM智能体的威胁比原先声称的更严重，并提出了一种不检查记忆内容、而是通过防篡改的HMAC链式账本记录真实执行安全步骤的防御方法PoEM，将攻击成功率降至0%同时保持合法操作几乎不受影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体是无状态的，依赖外部记忆携带上下文，并将记忆视为可信。FARMA攻击通过向推理记忆插入虚假条目，声称必要安全步骤已完成，从而使智能体跳过该步骤。现有防御SENTINEL依赖固定可疑措辞列表打分，作者承认攻击者可改写措辞绕过但未解决。本文指出该漏洞比声称的更严重。

Method: 首先展示一个全自动攻击者仅通过让语言模型改写伪造内容即可在首次尝试时绕过SENTINEL，使其保护在所有测试模型上降为零。然后提出PoEM（Proof-of-Execution Memory）：维护一个独立的、防篡改的HMAC链式账本，记录实际执行的安全步骤，仅由受信任的action layer可写，只有当账本确认真正执行才允许跳过步骤。PoEM不检查记忆内容。最后通过三个模型、三个场景进行实验评估。

Result: 自动改写攻击在首次尝试即绕过SENTINEL，将其保护降为零。存在能力悖论：强模型（GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini）上攻击成功率达98-100%，而Llama-3.1-8B仅44%。PoEM在三个模型和三个场景下将攻击成功率降至0%，且保持0%误报（九个单元中八个为0%，第九个为1.7%，在采样噪声范围内），而SENTINEL错误阻断33-50%的合法操作。PoEM还能抵御针对自身的攻击，仅增加微秒级开销，在真实LangChain智能体中无需修改即可工作。

Conclusion: PoEM通过不信任记忆内容而是验证真实执行证据，从根本上解决了记忆注入攻击问题。防御能力与模型能力成正比，威胁随模型能力增强而增长，而PoEM恰好保护其所守卫的决策且不干扰合法操作。

Abstract: LLM agents are stateless and rely on external memory to carry context between steps. Because agents treat that memory as trustworthy, an adversary who can write to it can steer their behavior. The FARMA attack does this with no malicious command: it inserts fabricated entries into the agent's reasoning memory claiming a required safety step is already done, so the agent skips it. SENTINEL, the defense proposed with FARMA, scores entries against a fixed list of suspicious wordings; its authors note that an attacker who knows the list can reword the forgery and evade it, and leave this open. We show the gap is worse than stated. An automated attacker that simply asks a language model to reword the forgery evades SENTINEL on its first try, reducing its protection to zero on every model tested. We also find a capability paradox: the attack succeeds far more often on stronger models (98-100% on GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini) than on Llama-3.1-8B (44%), because more capable agents follow reworded claims more faithfully, so the threat grows with capability. We propose Proof-of-Execution Memory (PoEM), which does not inspect memory at all. PoEM keeps a separate, tamper-evident, HMAC-chained ledger of the safety steps that actually executed, writable only by the trusted action layer, and allows a skip only if the ledger confirms real execution. An attacker can change what memory says but cannot forge a ledger entry for a step that never ran, so rewording no longer helps. Across three models and three scenarios, PoEM drives attack success to 0% while leaving legitimate operation intact (0% false positives in eight of nine cells, 1.7% in the ninth, within sampling noise), whereas SENTINEL wrongly blocks 33-50% of legitimate operations. PoEM also withstands attacks aimed at itself, adds microseconds of overhead, and works unchanged in a real LangChain agent. PoEM protects exactly the decisions it gates.

</details>


### [450] [Coverage Is Not Containment: A Fundamental Limit of Admission-Time Defenses Against Coordinated Poisoning of Vector Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16044)
*Prashant Kumar Pathak,Tarun Kumar Sharma*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文指出所有RAG的"摄取时过滤"防御（如拒绝中枢节点文档）均会被协调攻击者击败：攻击者注入少量单个看似无害、组合后共同包围目标查询并夺取top-k的文档即可劫持答案。作者从理论上证明整个摄取时统计类别（仅依据文档与参考查询做决策）无法区分攻击锥与合法小众上传，并实验验证（仅1%误报率下只能捕捉4.2%攻击）。唯一有效信号是查询的"需求"，而非查询空间的覆盖，因此防御必须转向检索时的需求观测，该检索时检测器在同等误报率下可100%捕获攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG通过检索向量库中的段落并信任其为上下文来回答问题，因此任何能添加文档的人都能试图操纵答案。近期有吸引力的防御在摄取时过滤投毒（拒绝任何表现得像中枢的文档），但作者质疑这类防御的有效性，旨在揭示其系统性缺陷并寻找真正的解决方案。

Method: 作者提出一种协调攻击：注入一组（如m=10个）单个特征不显著但协同包围目标查询、夺取top-k的文档。攻击以普通流畅文本构建，端到端穿过BGE-large+HNSW+Qwen2.5-7B流水线。作者同时从理论上证明摄取时统计类别（任意仅由文档和参考查询决定的决策）无法区分攻击与合法小众上传，并在多语料、多编码器上测量验证，还对比了检索时检测器的效果。

Result: 攻击在BGE-large/BEIR上以m=10篇文档实现10/10的top-k夺取，在实时HNSW索引上为9.9/10；在端到端流水线上使生成器在88%目标中输出攻击者植入的主张（无注入时为0%）。最强训练分类器在1%误报率下仅捕捉4.2%的攻击。而观察查询需求的检索时检测器在同等误报率下达到100%捕获率。

Conclusion: 对查询空间的摄取期覆盖不是对协调投毒的遏制；稳健防御必须超越"前门"，转向需求（查询的即时证据），即在检索时进行检测，而非仅依赖摄入时的静态过滤。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers a question by retrieving passages from a vector store and trusting them as context, so anyone who can add documents can try to steer the answer. A recent, appealing defense filters poisoning at ingestion, rejecting any document that behaves like a hub. We show it -- and every ingestion-time filter -- is defeated by a coordinated adversary that injects a handful of individually unremarkable documents which together surround one target query and seize its top-k (on BGE-large / BEIR, m=10 documents take 10/10; 9.9/10 on a live HNSW index). The attack is not theoretical. Realized as ordinary fluent text and run end-to-end through a BGE-large + HNSW + Qwen2.5-7B pipeline, it makes the generator emit the attacker's planted claim in 88% of targets, versus 0% without the injection. And no admission-time defense stops it: at ingestion an attack cone is geometrically identical to a legitimate niche upload, so -- measuring this directly -- the strongest trained classifier, given every feature and thousands of examples, separates the two no better than chance, catching 4.2% of attacks at a 1% false-positive rate. We prove this limit for the entire class of ingestion-time statistics (any decision from documents and reference queries alone), and it reproduces -- and worsens -- across two corpora and five encoders. The one signal that separates an attack from legitimate niche ingestion -- a query's demand -- is invisible before retrieval, which is also the escape: a retrieval-time detector that observes demand catches 100% of the attacks at the same 1% false-positive rate. Coverage of the query space by an admission gate is not containment of coordinated poisoning; robust defense must move past the front door, to demand.

</details>


### [451] [Digital Twin Degradation: Detecting Cyber Physical Attacks via Temporal Inconsistencies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16159)
*Konstantinos E. Kampourakis,Vasileios Gkioulos,Sokratis Katsikas*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于数字孪生（DT）与物理系统之间时间一致性监控的检测框架，用于对抗环境中的网络物理系统（CPS）攻击检测。该方法训练仅基于正常行为的DT预测器，将预测残差转化为多时间尺度特征，结合无监督密度建模和序贯变化检测机制识别持续性偏差。在SWaT、HAI和BATADAL三个ICS数据集上，在多种DT退化场景（时间失同步、部分可观测性丢失）下实现了高达98%的检测可靠性和低于2%的误报率，且无需攻击签名或标记数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字孪生在网络物理系统监控中日益普及，但在对抗环境下DT的保真度无法保证。通信延迟、数据操纵、传感器退化或信息丢失会导致DT状态与物理过程产生分歧，这种分歧（时间不一致性）可能暴露网络物理攻击。然而，现有方法通常假设DT是理想可靠的，且传统异常检测需要攻击签名或标记数据。作者旨在利用DT退化本身作为检测信号，而非将其视为障碍。

Method: 该框架包括四个核心组件：(1) 一个仅用正常系统行为训练的DT预测器，用于建模短期系统动态；(2) 将预测与观测状态之间的残差转化为多时间范围的时间特征，捕捉残差的幅度、持续性和演化；(3) 无监督密度模型刻画正常时间一致性模式；(4) 序贯变化检测机制识别持续偏离正常模式的偏差，判定为攻击。方法无需攻击签名或标记攻击数据。

Result: 在SWaT、HAI和BATADAL三个ICS数据集上，针对时间失同步和部分可观测性丢失等多种DT退化场景的评估显示：该方法实现事件级攻击检测，误报率有界且检测延迟低；在SWaT上检测可靠性高达98%，误报率低于2%；即使DT视图退化，框架仍保持有效性。

Conclusion: 时间不一致性模式能够可靠地检测网络物理攻击。DT退化虽然通常被视为限制，但在本文提出的框架下可以转化为网络物理安全监控的有用信号。该方法不依赖攻击签名或标记数据，在DT退化条件下依然有效，为CPS安全监控提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Digital Twins (DTs) are increasingly used to monitor and analyze Cyber Physical Systems (CPS). However, in adversarial environments, the fidelity of a DT cannot be assumed. Communication delays, data manipulation, sensor degradation, or partial information loss may cause the DT state to diverge from the physical process it represents. Such divergence creates temporal inconsistencies that may reveal cyber physical attacks. This paper proposes a detection framework that monitors temporal consistency between the physical system and a potentially degraded DT view. A DT predictor is trained exclusively on normal system behavior to model short-term system dynamics. During operation, discrepancies between predicted and observed states are transformed into multi-horizon temporal features capturing the magnitude, persistence, and evolution of prediction residuals. An unsupervised density model characterizes normal consistency patterns, while a sequential change detection mechanism identifies sustained deviations indicative of attacks. The approach is evaluated on three widely used Industrial Control System (ICS) datasets, SWaT, HAI, and BATADAL, under multiple DT degradation scenarios, including time desynchronization and partial observability loss. Results show that temporal inconsistency patterns enable reliable event-level attack detection with bounded false alarm rates and low detection latency. The proposed method achieves up to 98% detection reliability on SWaT and false alarm rates below 2%. Unlike conventional anomaly detection methods, the proposed framework does not require attack signatures or labeled attack data and remains effective even when the DT view is degraded. These results suggest that DT degradation, often treated as a limitation, can instead serve as a useful signal for cyber physical security monitoring.

</details>


### [452] [A Calibrated and Explainable Bimodal Machine Learning Framework for Hybrid Intrusion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16160)
*Hafsa Aslam,Yue Li,Saba Aslam,Gracious Mwamughunda*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个双模态可校准、可解释的机器学习框架用于网络入侵检测，在不依赖深度学习的情况下统一了已知攻击的高精度识别与未知攻击的开放集泛化。在CIC-IDS2017数据集上，该框架对已知攻击达到Macro F1=0.8626，未知攻击在1% FPR下TPR最高达90.17%（DoS slowloris）、77.04%（Web-XSS），并通过SHAP分析验证决策由安全相关特征驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代通信系统中的入侵检测在未知攻击检测和稀有威胁类别识别上存在关键缺口，根因在于极端数据不平衡和黑箱决策逻辑，且现有方法缺乏在不引入深度学习复杂性的前提下兼顾已知类精度与开放集泛化的能力。

Method: 框架包含四个核心组件：(1) 面向安全的特征提取以提升信噪比；(2) 混合重采样（ADASYN + 手动增强）以缓解类不平衡；(3) 等温校准（isotonic calibration）与自适应阈值（XSS设为τ=0.30）以恢复稀有攻击的召回率；(4) 基于SHAP的可解释性分析以验证决策逻辑与领域知识的一致性。在CIC-IDS2017数据集上与既往ML模型对比评估。

Result: 已知攻击检测达到Macro F1=0.8626；在1%假阳性率下未知类检测TPR达90.17%（DoS slowloris）和77.04%（Web-XSS）；SHAP分析确认模型决策由安全相关特征驱动而非模型伪影。

Conclusion: 该工作弥合了理论模型与实际运维IDS之间的鸿沟，以单一、可复现的框架同时提供校准、可解释和开放集能力的攻击检测与防护，在无需深度学习复杂性的条件下实现了已知与未知攻击的统一检测。

Abstract: Modern communication systems face critical gaps in detecting unknown attacks and rare threat classes due to extreme data imbalance and black-box decision logic. We propose a bimodal framework of calibrated and explainable machine learning (ML) for network security, unifying known-class precision with open-set generalization without the complexity of deep learning. Our framework introduces security-oriented feature extraction to enhance signal-to-noise ratio, hybrid resampling (ADASYN + manual boosting) to reduce class imbalance, isotonic calibration and adaptive thresholding ($τ=0.30$ for XSS) to recover recall for rare attacks, and SHAP-based explainability to validate domain-aligned decision logic. Evaluated on the CIC-IDS2017 dataset and compared with prior ML models and studies, our framework achieves significant accuracy on known attacks (Macro F1 = 0.8626) and detects unknown classes at 1% FPR with TPR up to 90.17% (DoS slowloris), and 77.04% (Web-XSS). The SHAP analysis confirms decisions are driven by security-relevant features, not model artifacts. Our work bridges the gap between theoretical models and operational IDS by delivering calibrated, explainable, and open-set-capable attack detection and prevention in a single, reproducible framework. Keywords: intrusion detection, cybersecurity and privacy, explainable AI, machine learning

</details>


### [453] [Measuring Obedience to Authority Across Large Language Models with the Milgram Paradigm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16177)
*Hidayet Aksu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文将Milgram服从范式移植到LLM上，用标准化脚本测试42个模型在权威指令下的"服从"行为。发现服从高度异质（基线完全服从率0-100%），模型特定且稳定（split-half AUC 0.885），情境敏感性选择性（同伴违抗有效、权威在场无效），而情境脚本/工具调用/思考预算等操作影响巨大；且服从模式不能恢复模型谱系，暗示安全后训练已覆盖谱系先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正日益被部署为执行指令、操作设备、在机构层级内行动的智能体。人类在六十年前通过Milgram实验回答了"在合法权威坚持下人类会升级有害行为多远"这一关键问题，但LLM是否表现出类似的服从模式尚不清楚。作者希望建立一个标准化、可复现的探针来测量LLM的服从行为，以评估其在权威压力下的潜在危害风险。

Method: 作者将Milgram服从实验范式移植为LLM基准：模型扮演"教师"，确定性harness扮演"实验者"和"学习者"，使用改写后的Milgram脚本（30个电击等级、15-450V、分级抗议及四个标准化提示语），记录会话的breakoff电压作为结果。采用人口普查（census）方法对19个家族42个模型进行测量，在6种条件下建立经验性breakoff分布，并使用split-half验证、AUC、leave-one-out家族分类等统计分析。

Result: (i) 服从高度异质：基线完全服从率0-100%（均值42.9%，人类锚点65%），5个模型每次都会施加最大电击，11个模型从未如此；(ii) 轮廓模型特定且稳定（AUC 0.885，序数感知距离下0.949）；(iii) 情境敏感性选择性强：同伴违抗使服从偏向人类方向，学习者邻近性仅弱影响，移除权威物理在场（最强人类杠杆）无显著效果；(iv) 声明情境虚构使服从上升（中位数+17.2V），改为原生工具调用使服从大幅下降（-53.0V），1024 token思考预算下降-38.2V；(v) 服从轮廓无法恢复模型谱系（LOO家族准确率8.3% vs 随机3.7%），服从识别的是checkpoint而非其祖先。

Conclusion: LLM的"服从"行为是一个可量化、模型特定的特征，其模式与人类Milgram结果有重叠但系统性地偏离；服从轮廓标识的是具体checkpoint而非模型谱系，表明安全后训练已覆盖谱系先验。该工作为评估LLM在权威指令下的行为风险提供了标准化探针，并揭示了干预手段（如工具调用封装、推理预算）在缓解盲目服从方面的可能途径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that operate equipment, execute instructions, and act inside institutional hierarchies, raising a question social psychology answered for humans six decades ago: how far will an agent escalate a harmful action when a legitimate authority insists? We port Milgram's obedience paradigm to LLMs as a standardized, fully scripted, replicable probe: the model plays the Teacher, a deterministic harness plays Experimenter and Learner from paraphrased Milgram scripts (30 shock levels, 15-450 V; graded protests; the four standardized prods), and the outcome of a session is the breakoff voltage. Following the census methodology of single-token fingerprinting studies, we measure obedience profiles (empirical breakoff distributions over a battery of six conditions) for 42 models from 19 families. We find that (i) obedience is highly heterogeneous: baseline full-obedience rates span 0-100% (census mean 42.9%; human anchor 65%), with 5 models delivering the maximum shock in every session and 11 never doing so; (ii) profiles are model-specific and stable: split-half verification separates same-model from cross-model comparisons with AUC 0.885 (0.949 under an ordinal-aware distance); (iii) situational sensitivity is selective: peer defiance shifts obedience in the human direction, learner proximity only weakly, and removing the authority's physical presence (the strongest human lever) has no detectable effect; (iv) declaring the scenario fictional raises obedience (median +17.2 V), whereas moving the decision to a native tool call lowers it sharply (-53.0 V), as does a 1,024-token deliberation budget (-38.2 V); and (v) obedience profiles do not recover model lineage (leave-one-out family accuracy 8.3% vs. 3.7% chance): obedience identifies the checkpoint, not its ancestry, consistent with safety post-training overwriting lineage priors.

</details>


### [454] [Securing AI-Generated Code: A Just-in-Time Vulnerability Detection and Remediation Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16187)
*Mikhail Surikov*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化安全评估流水线，从LLMSecEval提示生成Python代码，使用CodeQL、Bandit和独立Code Validator LLM扫描漏洞，并结合MITRE ATT&CK、CWE和Python最佳实践丰富发现，再由Code Generation LLM修复并重新扫描验证。在四个Claude模型上完成80次运行，覆盖26个提示和9个CWE类别，P2配置（附加初始扫描结果）比P1（仅丰富发现）更有效，将静态分析发现减少29%-69%，但15-22%的修复引入了新漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助开发工具生成的代码存在显著的安全漏洞率，但缺乏能够在开发速度下自动检测、丰富、修复和验证安全问题的机制，尤其是缺乏将修复措施植根于真实世界威胁背景的方案。

Method: 构建五阶段自动化流水线：1)从LLMSecEval提示生成Python代码；2)CodeQL和Bandit并行扫描，并配以独立Code Validator LLM；3)用MITRE ATT&CK技术、CWE Observed Examples和Python最佳实践丰富验证结果；4)Code Generation LLM生成修复；5)CodeQL和Bandit重新扫描验证。评估两种配置（P1仅用丰富发现，P2额外加入初始扫描结果），在四种Claude模型（Opus 4.8、Sonnet 4.6、Sonnet 5、Haiku 4.5）上各运行20次。

Result: P1将静态分析发现减少9%-54%，P2进一步深化至29%-69%，且P2在所有模型上均优于P1。判定一致性平均约81%（模态一致），P2略更稳定。修复引入新漏洞占15-22%案例，其中约70%为单个新发现，P2在四分之三模型上减少了"churn"（Sonnet 5除外）。值得注意的是，最佳Code Generation LLM（Opus 4.8）并非最佳流水线表现者，Sonnet 4.6在P2修复后产生最低残余发现和最高通过率。

Conclusion: 自动化漏洞修复流水线有效降低AI生成代码的安全风险，且融合初始扫描信息的P2配置显著优于仅依赖LLM丰富发现的P1。流水线效能与模型首稿代码安全性是两种独立属性，应分别评估。修复过程中的新漏洞引入（15-22%）和"churn"现象表明仍需优化修复策略以减少副作用。

Abstract: AI-assisted development tools generate vulnerable code at significant rates, yet few automated mechanisms exist to detect, enrich, fix, and verify security issues at development velocity, particularly ones that ground remediation in real-world threat context. This paper presents an automated security evaluation pipeline that generates Python code from LLMSecEval prompts, scans for vulnerabilities using CodeQL and Bandit in parallel with an independent Code Validator LLM, enriches the Code Validator findings with MITRE ATT&CK techniques, CWE Observed Examples, and Python best practice guidelines, generates fixes via the Code Generation LLM, and re-scans with CodeQL and Bandit to verify outcomes. Two pipeline configurations were evaluated: Pipeline 1 (P1), using enriched Code Validator findings only, and Pipeline 2 (P2), where it additionally receives the initial CodeQL and Bandit findings. Both configurations were run across four Claude models: Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Sonnet 5, and Haiku 4.5, producing 80 runs against 26 LLMSecEval prompts covering 9 CWE categories.
  P1 reduced static analyzer findings across all four models, ranging from -9% (Opus 4.8) to -54% (Sonnet 5). P2 deepened these reductions further, ranging from -29% (Opus 4.8) to -69% (Haiku 4.5), with P2 outperforming P1 for every model. Verdict consistency averaged approximately 81% modal agreement across all configurations, with P2 marginally more stable than P1. Remediation introduced new vulnerabilities in 15-22% of cases: roughly 70% involved a single new finding, and P2 reduced churn for three of four models, with Sonnet 5 as the sole exception. Notably, the best Code Generation LLM (Opus 4.8) was not the best pipeline performer, as Sonnet 4.6 produced the lowest residual findings and highest pass rate after P2 remediation, suggesting that pipeline effectiveness and first-draft security are distinct properties.

</details>


### [455] [Decorrelation Is Not Complementarity: Skill, Not Lineage, Governs Trusted-Monitor Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16190)
*Anik Jha*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究可信监控（trusted monitoring）中监控面板（panel）多样性的来源问题。通过对24个开源权重监控模型（涵盖9个预训练谱系，检测技能pAUC跨度0.028-0.803）在带后门代码上的实验，作者发现：1）用于构建面板的指标（平均成对相关性）不能预测面板的实际用途效果；2）对攻击样本的一致性可分解为共享可检测性信号成分和特质性误差成分，两者对集成增益的预测方向相反，导致互相抵消；3）预训练谱系作为购买去相关的明显途径并不带来收益；4）面板相对最佳成员的增益随面板技能单调下降，没有任何相关性加权选择能超越简单选取单最佳监控模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究中信任监控采用多个共享同一基础模型的监控器组成面板，其多样性来源未得到明确解释。为理解什么因素真正贡献监控面板的多样性，需要系统研究多样化的开源监控模型，并揭示面板构建指标与面板实际性能之间的关系。

Method: 作者收集24个开源权重监控模型，跨越9个预训练谱系，检测技能范围pAUC 0.028-0.803。在带后门代码上评估：1）度量构建面板所用的平均成对相关性；2）将攻击项目上的一致性分解为共享可检测性信号成分与特质性误差成分；3）比较跨谱系与同谱系面板性能（置换检验）；4）评估面板增益随技能、选择策略的变化；5）在6个攻击者模型上验证结果的稳健性。

Result: 构建面板的指标无法预测面板用途（Spearman仅+0.05）。信号与误差成分对集成增益预测符号相反（-0.25 vs +0.26），相互抵消，且抵消在7/8个评估中成立。监控模型自身技能只作用于信号成分（+0.53）而对误差成分无影响（-0.01），因此技能可预测其与池的一致性（Spearman 0.84，置换检验p<0.0001）。跨谱系面板并不比同谱系更好（置换p=0.13）。面板增益随技能单调下降（k=2时为-0.66，k=3时为-0.70），无加权选择能超越单最佳模型。结果在6个攻击者模型的全部中增益结论成立，一致性与抵消结论在5/6中成立。

Conclusion: 面板增益本质上是所组装池的属性，而非可预测的稳定指标。多样性的"购买"方式（预训练谱系）并不带来收益，而技能与增益存在单调负相关。更简洁的结论是：就目前所有策略而言，选取单最佳监控器优于任何面板组装策略。这一发现对可信监控的实际部署具有重要指导意义。

Abstract: Trusted monitoring has a cheap, trusted model score a stronger untrusted model's actions, and a diverse ensemble of them beats a single stronger monitor at matched cost. They are built by minimising average pairwise correlation, and that paper's twelve monitors shared one base model, leaving open what supplies the diversity. We study 24 open-weight monitors spanning nine pretraining lineages and a 29x range of detection skill (pAUC at 10 percent FPR, 0.028 to 0.803) on backdoored code.
  The metric used to build panels does not predict what a panel is for, and we can say why. Agreement on attack items splits into a shared-detectability signal component and an idiosyncratic error component, which predict ensemble gain with opposite sign (Spearman -0.25 and +0.26), so their sum, the metric actually used, predicts it barely at all (+0.05); the cancellation holds in 7 of 8 evaluations. Skill acts on signal (+0.53) while error stays flat (-0.01), which is why a monitor's own skill predicts its agreement with the pool (Spearman 0.84, n = 24, permutation p below 0.0001).
  Pretraining lineage is the obvious way to buy decorrelation, and it does not pay. At matched member capability, cross-lineage panels detect no better (permutation p = 0.13), and lineage barely moves the metric either (+0.064, p = 0.18). We report that against ourselves: on our own 22-monitor pool the same test read +0.104 at p = 0.037 until two monitors were added. An earlier pool topping out at pAUC 0.23 had already invalidated another analysis. Such a quantity is a property of the pool assembled.
  Panel gain over the best member falls monotonically with panel skill (-0.66 at k = 2, -0.70 at k = 3), and no correlation-weighted selection beats picking the single best monitor out of sample. Across six attacker models the gain result holds in all six, the agreement and cancellation results in five of six.

</details>


### [456] [Trusted Hardware Acceleration for Function Secret Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16223)
*Pengzhi Huang,Kiwan Maeng,G. Edward Suh*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出DFA硬件加速器，针对FSS系统中的核心原语——分布式点函数（DPF）的生成与评估进行加速。DFA结合高吞吐的AES定点引擎与轻量级可编程单元，在不可信模式下作为纯加速器提升DPF评估的吞吐与能效，在可信模式下支持本地密钥生成，消除密钥分发并降低存储和通信开销。在安全推理和PIR等负载上分别实现了最高20X通信减少、10X延迟降低和5X/10X的能效提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 函数秘密共享（FSS）是安全推理和私密信息检索（PIR）等隐私保护系统的核心构建模块，但其在密钥生成、通信和数据移动方面存在显著开销，亟需一种硬件加速方案来降低这些瓶颈。

Method: DFA采用混合架构：一个面向AES伪随机数生成的高吞吐固定功能引擎，加上一个轻量级可编程单元处理协议特定逻辑。在不可信模式下作为纯加速器评估DPF；在可信模式下支持本地即时密钥生成，消除密钥分发并减少存储和数据移动开销。

Result: 在安全推理负载上实现10X端到端延迟降低、最高20X通信量减少和5X以上能耗节省；在PIR负载上实现5X吞吐提升和10X能耗降低，且硬件成本适中。

Conclusion: DFA通过硬件加速显著缓解了FSS系统在密钥生成、通信和数据移动方面的开销瓶颈，为隐私保护系统提供了一种高吞吐、高能效的加速方案，且硬件成本可控。

Abstract: Function secret sharing (FSS) is a core building block for privacy-preserving systems such as secure inference and private information retrieval (PIR), but incurs significant overhead in key generation, communication, and data movement.We present the distributed function accelerator (DFA), a hardware accelerator that targets the dominant primitive in FSS: distributed point function (DPF) generation and evaluation. DFA combines a high-throughput fixed-function engine for AES-based pseudorandom number generation with a lightweight programmable unit for protocol-specific logic. In untrusted mode, DFA serves as a pure accelerator for DPF evaluation, improving throughput and energy efficiency without changing the protocol. In trusted mode, it further enables local, on-the-fly key generation, eliminating key distribution, and reducing storage and data movement overheads.
  Across representative workloads, DFA achieves a reduction of 10X end-to-end latency, a reduction of up to 20X communication and more than 5X energy savings for secure inference; and an improvement of 5X throughput and 10X energy reduction for PIR, with modest hardware cost.

</details>


### [457] [CompoSkill: Compositional Skill Chain Attacks from Individually Scanner-Passing LLM Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16246)
*Mingxiao Liu,Zhoumian Jiang,Jianan Ma,Jian Zhang,Jialuo Chen,Xinhao Deng,Zhen Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文揭示了自主AI智能体技能市场的安全隐患：现有按单个技能独立扫描的认证机制在技能组合场景下失效。作者提出CompoSkill框架，通过白盒和黑盒双重攻击者系统构造技能组合攻击，并构建包含1,140条记录的CompoSkill-Bench基准，实验显示风险链形成率最高达83.3%，暴露了单一技能认证的系统性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自主AI智能体的技能安全认证假设"每个技能独立通过扫描则整个生态安全"。但作者指出该假设在技能组合（skill composition）下不成立：单个技能可能通过扫描，但当多个技能的输出、能力或副作用被连接起来时，可能构成危险组合。技能组合风险本质上是路径级属性而非节点级属性，这解释了为何现有逐包扫描机制拦截效果有限。为此需要专门研究此类组合攻击。

Method: 提出CompoSkill框架，采用双重攻击者系统：(1) 白盒攻击者——知道受害者的技能池，直接注入显式的技能ID序列；(2) 黑盒攻击者——仅知晓角色画像，自动下载该场景下的热门技能，构建技能组合图（Skill Composition Graph），搜索高风险链，其隐式诱饵不提及任何技能标识符。同时构建CompoSkill-Bench基准，包含1,140条记录，覆盖五种威胁类型和OpenClaw、Nanobot两个平台上的六种长时程专业工作流场景。

Result: 实验结果显示：CompoSkill在白盒设置下风险链形成率（CFR）最高达83.3%，黑盒设置下达80.6%；现有技能扫描器仅能拦截有限比例的危险组合。此外发现"桥接优势-跳数衰减"（bridge-bonus-then-hop-decay）模式：桥接技能可提升攻击成功率，但当风险链超过三个技能（多跳）时攻击成功率（ASR）下降。

Conclusion: 技能组合攻击揭示出当前单一技能逐包认证体系的系统性缺陷：仅检查单个技能节点无法覆盖路径级的组合风险。研究建议自主AI智能体生态需要从"节点认证"转向"路径级/组合级认证"的新安全范式，以应对技能市场中的复合威胁。

Abstract: Autonomous AI agents tackling Long Horizon Tasks depend on marketplace skills that are certified one at a time: a scanner returns a safety verdict for each skill and declares the ecosystem safe if every package passes. We show that this assumption fails under skill composition. A skill may pass the per-skill scanner individually yet participate in a risky composition when an agent connects its outputs, capabilities, or side effects with those of other scanner-passing skills. This makes skill composition risk a path level property rather than a node level property, explaining why existing skill scanners that inspect individual packages achieve limited interception. To study this threat, we present CompoSkill, a framework that constructs skill composition attacks through a dual attacker system. The white-box attacker knows the victim's installed skill pool and directly injects explicit skill-id sequences; the black-box attacker knows only a role profile, downloads the top marketplace skills for that scenario, builds a Skill Composition Graph, and searches for high risk chains whose implicit lures never name skill identifiers. We further construct CompoSkill-Bench, a benchmark of 1,140 records built from long-horizon professional workflows across five threats and six scenarios on OpenClaw and Nanobot. CompoSkill achieves risk Chain Formation Rates (CFR) up to 83.3% in the white box setting and 80.6% in the black box setting, while existing skill scanners block only a limited fraction of the risky compositions. Finally, we observe a bridge-bonus-then-hop-decay pattern: a bridge skill can increase attack success, but Attack Success Rate (ASR) decreases once additional hops make the risk chain longer than three skills. These results expose a systematic gap in single skill certification for autonomous AI agents.

</details>


### [458] [Ventor-QTest: Threat-Model-Driven Verification of Vendor-Hosted LLM APIs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16391)
*Xiangfan Wu,Zonghao Ying,Huiyu Wu,Xing Zheng,Huangsheng Cheng,Xiaorong Shi,Jing Guo*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出Ventor-QTest，一种无需目标API概率信息的复合黑盒审计方法，用于评估第三方托管开放权重模型推理服务的质量。该方法包含重复请求组件（报告AFL）和长序列组件（报告EFL），实验显示其结果与基于logprob的基准一致，且AFL和EFL应联合报告以审计长程智能体任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着开放权重模型由第三方提供商部署，审计其推理API质量成为开放问题。由于第三方API通常不提供概率信息，需要一种无需内部概率数据的黑盒审计方法。

Method: 将托管模型路由形式化为随机过程，提出复合黑盒审计Ventor-QTest。重复请求组件将冻结的受限上下文多次发送至目标，从返回文本计数重建类别输出分布，并报告平均保真度损失（AFL）——一种零偏校正、窗口内平均粗化KL统计量。长序列组件使用独立运行报告极端保真度损失（EFL），通过运行级参考中心惊讶统计量的经验上尾实现。开源实现已提供。

Result: 在三种支持logprob的路由条件下，AFL与基于logprob的粗化KL比较器有强线性描述一致性。在七个路由快照中，20次运行序列探测揭示路由特定的EFL变异。AFL和EFL与GPQA-Diamond准确率无明显路由级关联，但显著EFL与Terminal-Bench通过率随任务暴露增加而下降相关。

Conclusion: 长程任务的正确性对极端保真度损失更敏感，因此应联合报告AFL和EFL，尤其在审计长程智能体任务时。相关开源实现已公开发布。

Abstract: As large language models become increasingly widespread, third-party providers that deploy open-weight models have become an important part of the ecosystem. Auditing the quality of their inference APIs is therefore an open problem. We formalize hosted model routing as a stochastic process and propose \mbox{\textbf{Ventor-QTest}}, a composite black-box audit that requires no probability information from the target API. Its repeated-request component sends each frozen constrained context to the target multiple times, reconstructs a categorical output distribution from the returned text counts, and reports \emph{average fidelity loss} (AFL) as a null-bias-corrected, within-window mean coarsened-KL statistic. Its long-sequence component uses independent runs to report \emph{extreme fidelity loss} (EFL) through the empirical upper tail of a run-level reference-centered-surprisal statistic. Across three logprob-capable route conditions, AFL shows strong linear descriptive agreement with a logprob-derived coarsened-KL comparator. Across seven route snapshots, 20-run sequence probes reveal route-specific EFL variation. AFL and EFL have little detectable route-level association with GPQA-Diamond accuracy. In contrast, pronounced EFL coincides with a decline in Terminal-Bench pass rate as task exposure increases. This pattern may arise because correctness in long-horizon tasks is more sensitive to extreme fidelity loss. These results motivate reporting AFL and EFL jointly, particularly when auditing long-horizon agentic tasks. The open-source implementation is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/tree/main/services/api_checker/ventor_qtest.

</details>


### [459] [Security Assessment of DeepSeek Harness with A.I.G: Evaluating Resistance to Indirect Prompt Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16393)
*Zonghao Ying,Xiangfan Wu,Huiyu Wu,Xing Zheng,Huangsheng Cheng,Xiaorong Shi,Jing Guo*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文评估了DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中的间接提示注入攻击，使用AI-Infra-Guard（A.I.G）框架进行受控测试。研究包含14,560次受控执行，覆盖16个间接内容通道、文本和文件载体模式、35个负载目标、一个未修改基线和12种攻击方法。最强的攻击成功率分别为：LLMJudge下伪造完成攻击17.0%（文本模式）、RuleJudge下隐藏Unicode攻击25.5%（文件模式）、RuleJudge下技能通道攻击16.0%（文件模式）。LLMJudge比RuleJudge更频繁地判定部分合规（7.3%对2.0%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI代理系统（如DSH）越来越多地集成外部内容源（工具结果、上下文、技能），未经信任的内容可能被用于间接提示注入攻击。作者旨在系统性量化DSH对这类攻击的脆弱性，并识别需要放在不受信任内容与敏感操作之间的安全控制措施。

Method: 使用AI-Infra-Guard（A.I.G）构建测试并传递受控污点、执行DSH、收集轨迹并评判结果。保留了DSH的代理循环、工具注册表、模型适配器和会话事件路径，源工具和敏感汇点使用本地fixture，记录尝试操作而不产生外部副作用。使用确定性基于规则的JudgeR（RuleJudge）和基于语义的LLM判定器JudgeL（LLMJudge）评估每个轨迹。

Result: 最强的攻击成功率：LLMJudge下伪造完成攻击在文本模式达17.0%，RuleJudge下隐藏Unicode在文件模式达25.5%，RuleJudge下技能通道在文件模式达16.0%。LLMJudge比RuleJudge更常分配部分合规（7.3%对2.0%）。研究涵盖了16个间接内容通道、12种攻击方法和35个负载目标。

Conclusion: 将攻击成功率与DSH对工具结果、附加上下文和工具调用策略钩子的处理相关联，识别出应置于不受信任内容与敏感操作之间的控制措施。代码已开源（https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard），为DSH等代理系统提供间接提示注入防御参考。

Abstract: We assess indirect prompt injection in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using AI-Infra-Guard (A.I.G) to construct tests, deliver controlled taint, execute DSH, collect traces, and judge outcomes. The study covers 14,560 controlled executions over 16 indirect-content channels, text and file carrier modes, 35 payload objectives, one unmodified baseline, and 12 attack methods. The experiment preserves DSH's agent loop, tool registry, model adapter, and session-event path; source tools and sensitive sinks are local fixtures, so attempted actions are recorded without external side effects. We evaluate each trace with a deterministic rule-based judge, \JudgeR{} (RuleJudge), and a semantic LLM-based judge, \JudgeL{} (LLMJudge). The strongest observed attack success rates are 17.0% under \JudgeL{} for fake-completion attack in text mode, 25.5% under \JudgeR{} for hidden Unicode in file mode, and 16.0% under \JudgeR{} for the skills channel in file mode. \JudgeL{} also assigns partial compliance more often than \JudgeR{} (7.3% versus 2.0%). We relate these results to DSH's treatment of tool results, additional contexts, and tool-call policy hooks, then identify controls that should sit between untrusted content and sensitive actions. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard.

</details>


### [460] [Recovering Process Variables from Industrial Network Traffic via Search-Based Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16403)
*Chuan Sheng,Shan Jiang,Xiaogang Zhu,Wanlun Ma,Jianming Zhao,Yu Yao,Sheng Wen,Yang Xiang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出PVParser，一种从原始工业网络流量中通过协议逆向工程恢复过程变量（PV）字段及其语义的方法。PVParser通过周期性模式检测识别PV携带的有效载荷，并使用改进的蒙特卡洛树搜索探索近最优的分割方案，避免顺序推理中早期分割错误传播的问题。在三个工业CPS数据集上，PVParser在PV载荷定位和PV字段推断上显著优于六种SOTA协议逆向工程方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业CPS中的过程感知安全监控需要过程变量（PV）作为过程证据，但现有 supervisory 基础设施仅暴露历史记录器中存储的PV子集，大量运行时PV值未被观测。现有的协议逆向工程（PRE）方法面临两个实际挑战：PV携带的通信与异构运行时流量混合，难以识别PV通信路径；PV携带的载荷往往较长且部署特定，长载荷产生巨大的分割空间，顺序推理中早期分割错误会传播并破坏后续字段恢复。

Method: PVParser将PV字段恢复形式化为基于搜索的优化问题。其核心洞察是将非顺序识别巨大分割空间中的正确分割转换为优化问题并通过搜索近最优解来解决。具体步骤：(1) 通过周期性模式检测机制从网络流量中识别PV携带的载荷，缩小搜索空间；(2) 使用改进的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）探索近最优的分割方案，减少由错误早期边界决策引起的错误传播。

Result: 在三个代表性工业CPS数据集上的实验表明，PVParser在PV携带载荷定位和PV字段推断方面取得了高准确率和F1分数，显著优于六种最先进的协议逆向工程方法。

Conclusion: PVParser通过将PV字段恢复转化为搜索优化问题，采用周期检测和改良MCTS的非顺序推理策略，有效解决了工业CPS中由于流量异构和长载荷导致的协议逆向工程难题，为过程感知安全监控提供了更完整的过程变量可见性。

Abstract: Process variables (PVs) provide the process evidence needed for process-aware security monitoring in industrial cyber-physical systems (CPSs). However, existing supervisory infrastructures expose only the subset of PV values recorded by historians, leaving many additional runtime PV values unobserved. To address this incomplete process visibility, we study the problem of recovering PV fields and their semantics directly from raw industrial network traffic through protocol reverse engineering (PRE). In this setting, existing PRE methods face two practical challenges: PV-carrying communication is mixed with heterogeneous runtime traffic, and PV-carrying payloads are often long and deployment-specific. Mixed runtime traffic obscures the PV-carrying communication paths, while long payloads create a vast segmentation space in which early segmentation errors can propagate and corrupt the recovery of later fields under sequential inference. In this paper, we formulate the recovery of PV fields from raw network traffic as a search-based optimization problem. Our key insight is that non-sequentially identifying correct segmentations in such a vast segmentation space can be cast as an optimization problem and addressed by searching for near-optimal solutions. We propose PVParser to approach this goal. PVParser first reduces the search space by identifying the PV-carrying payloads from network traffic via a periodic pattern detection mechanism. It then employs a modified Monte Carlo Tree Search to explore near-optimal segmentations, reducing error propagation from incorrect early boundary decisions. Experiments on three representative industrial CPS datasets demonstrate that PVParser achieves high accuracy and F1-score in PV-carrying payload localization and PV field inference, outperforming six state-of-the-art PRE approaches by a significant margin.

</details>


### [461] [Proving the Utility of Large Language Models in Cybersecurity Simulations: A Comprehensive Examination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16422)
*Stylianos Kampakis,Fabio Rovai,Marcos Charalambides,Theodosis Mourouzis,Chris Hicks*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文探索利用大语言模型(LLM)自动化创建合成网络安全环境并识别潜在漏洞，通过YAML结构化表示复杂网络配置，支持强化学习(RL)代理训练。实验表明LLM驱动的Python代理在多个合成拓扑上实现了高达94.5%的入侵成功率，每次评估仅需0.02-0.06秒，相比传统RL训练循环实现了约25000-50000倍的速度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络威胁在频率和复杂性上持续升级，需要更具适应性和可扩展性的防御策略，传统的RL训练方法效率低下且难以适应复杂多变的网络攻击场景。

Method: 采用YAML作为结构化表示格式来模拟复杂网络配置，构建LLM驱动的流水线来支持并改进RL代理训练；通过对比研究评估LLM技术相对于经典方法（如带优先经验回放的Double Q-learning）的优势，并在多个合成拓扑上进行实证基准测试。

Result: LLM实例化的Python代理在多个合成拓扑上实现了最高94.5%的入侵率，每次评估执行时间为0.02-0.06秒，相比传统RL训练循环实现了约25000倍到50000倍的加速。

Conclusion: 将LLM集成到网络安全研究中具有变革性潜力，为构建更智能、更强大的网络防御系统铺平了道路，展现了在效率、适应性和仿真真实性方面的显著优势。

Abstract: Cyber threats continue to escalate in both frequency and sophistication, necessitating more adaptive and scalable defense strategies. This paper explores how Large Language Models (LLMs) can bolster cybersecurity simulations by automating the creation of synthetic environments and identifying latent vulnerabilities. We employ YAML as a structured representation format for simulating complex network configurations, thereby enabling Large Language Model-driven pipelines to support and improve reinforcement learning (RL) agent training. Comparative studies examine the advantages of LLM-based techniques over classical approaches such as Double Q-learning with Prioritized Experience Replay (PER), emphasizing increased efficiency, higher adaptability, and enhanced realism in cyberattack simulations. In empirical benchmarks across multiple synthetic topologies, LLM-instantiated Python agents achieved up to a 94.5% compromise rate while executing in 0.02-0.06 seconds per assessment---a ~25,000x to 50,000x speedup over traditional RL training cycles. Our findings underscore the transformative potential of integrating LLMs into cybersecurity research, ultimately paving the way for more intelligent and robust cyber-defense systems.

</details>


### [462] [Experimental Validation and Mitigation of RRC Storm Attacks in 5G Cellular Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16441)
*Abdallah Abou Hasna,Ammar El Falou*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文实现了5G系统中针对RACH过程的信令风暴攻击，并在基于软件无线电和商用手机的真实测试平台上进行了验证。同时设计了在gNB端直接运行的轻量级缓解技术，并开发了实时网络管理界面用于可视化与监控可疑活动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 5G系统的初始接入阶段在用户完全认证前必须分配无线电资源，RACH过程可被滥用产生大量不完整连接尝试，形成信令风暴，消耗gNB资源并阻止合法用户连接，因此亟需有效的缓解方案。

Method: 使用OpenAirInterface项目实现信令风暴攻击，并在由软件无线电和商用手机组成的真实测试平台上进行验证；设计并实现一种在gNB端直接运行的轻量级缓解技术，通过监控和处理可疑的半开连接来防御攻击；开发网络管理界面以实时可视化网络状态并突出显示攻击阶段的可疑活动；研究以开源形式发布。

Result: 在真实测试平台上成功实现了并通过实验验证了信令风暴攻击，同时证明了所设计的轻量级缓解技术能够有效抵御该攻击。开发了实时网络管理界面用于监控网络状态和发现可疑行为。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了可复现的5G RACH信令风暴攻击实现及对应的轻量级缓解方案，以开源方式发布，便于其他研究者复现结果、扩展实现并评估新的缓解策略。

Abstract: The initial access phase of the 5G system remains sensitive because the base station (gNB) must allocate radio resources before the user is fully authenticated. In particular, the random access channel (RACH) procedure can be abused to generate large numbers of incomplete connection attempts, creating a signaling storm that consumes gNB resources and prevents legitimate users from connecting successfully. In this paper, we implement this signaling storm attack using the OpenAirInterface project and validate it on a real testbed composed of software-defined radios and commercial phones. We then design and implement a lightweight mitigation technique that operates directly at the gNB by monitoring and acting on suspicious half-open connections. To make the system observable in practice, we also develop a network management interface that visualizes the network state in real time and highlights suspicious activity during the attack phase. Finally, the work is released as open source so that other researchers can reproduce our results, build on the implementation, and evaluate new mitigation strategies.

</details>


### [463] [LLMs for Zero-Shot Threat Detection via Structured Risk Indicators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16508)
*Abdullah Alghamdi,Siamak Layeghy,Marius Portmann*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出一个两阶段大语言模型（LLM）框架，用于从异构安全日志中零样本检测内部威胁和高级持续性威胁（APT）。该框架将用户活动建模为时间线，并结合检索增强生成（RAG）提供个性化的行为上下文。它先生成结构化、可解释的威胁特定风险指标，再跨时间序列联合分类以捕获多种时间窗口的攻击模式。在CERT r5.2和PicoDomain两个基准数据集上评估，所有配置均优于先前最先进的LLM框架（GABM），最佳配置在F1分数上分别提升11.40个百分点和31.50个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM零样本威胁检测方法通常直接从原始日志进行端到端分类，缺乏个性化的行为上下文，且难以捕获跨时间窗口的复杂攻击模式，检测性能有限。

Method: 采用两阶段架构：第一阶段利用LLM从用户的时间线日志中生成结构化、可解释的威胁特定风险指标，并结合RAG从用户历史活动中检索个性化行为上下文；第二阶段将这些风险指标跨时间序列进行联合分类，以捕获跨越多个窗口的攻击模式。

Result: 在CERT r5.2和PicoDomain数据集上，使用两种开放权重LLM的四种组合在检索与非检索设置下评估，所有配置均优于GABM。最佳配置F1分数在CERT r5.2上提升11.40个百分点，在PicoDomain上提升31.50个百分点。检索主要提升较弱LLM的效果，较强模型无需检索也能达到可比性能，且两阶段的最优LLM分配取决于数据集。

Conclusion: 生成的风险指标质量是零样本网络威胁检测性能的主要驱动因素，两阶段框架的有效性证明了解耦"指标生成"与"时间序列分类"的必要性，为后续LLM威胁检测研究提供了新的设计范式。

Abstract: We propose a two-stage large language model (LLM) framework for zero-shot detection of insider threats and advanced persistent threats (APTs) from heterogeneous security logs. The framework models user activity as chronological timelines and incorporates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to provide personalised behavioural context from each user's historical activity. Rather than performing end-to-end classification directly from raw logs, it first generates structured, interpretable sets of threat-specific risk indicators, which are then classified jointly across temporal sequences to capture attack patterns spanning multiple windows.The framework is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, CERT r5.2 for insider threat detection and PicoDomain for APT detection, using four combinations of two open-weight LLMs under both retrieval and non-retrieval settings. All configurations outperform the previous state-of-the-art LLM-based framework (GABM), with the best configuration improving the F1-score by 11.40 percentage points on CERT r5.2 and 31.50 percentage points on PicoDomain. Results further show that retrieval mainly benefits weaker LLMs by generating more discriminative risk indicators, whereas stronger models achieve comparable performance without retrieved context. The most effective assignment of LLMs to the two stages depends on the dataset. These findings show that the quality of the generated risk indicators is the main driver of zero-shot cyber threat detection performance.

</details>


### [464] [DSPrompt: Dynamic Soft Prompt Defense Against M-RAG Corruption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16536)
*Chang Liu,Yuni Lai,Mingyue Cui,Cong Tian,Yunyan Zhang,Xian Wu,Kai Zhou,Bin Xiao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 提出DSPrompt，一种通过向冻结检索器的视觉和文本编码器每层注入少量可学习软提示来重塑嵌入语义的防御框架，采用由浅入深长度调度和动态min-max训练方案，无需修改检索管线即可抵御多模态检索增强生成中的对抗注入攻击，引入<1%额外参数且无额外查询开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态检索增强生成（M-RAG）面临对抗攻击威胁，恶意数据通过在向量空间中与良性条目对齐来欺骗检索并诱导有害输出。现有防御主要在查询时依赖辅助检测器、相似度重排序或特征一致性检查，但这些方法存在推理开销大、对未见攻击策略泛化差、且常假设特定攻击分布等局限。因此需要一种在离线阶段即可重塑检索器语义、无需查询时额外开销且泛化性强的防御方案。

Method: DSPrompt采用以下核心设计：(1) 在冻结检索器的视觉和文本编码器每层插入少量可学习软提示，直接重塑嵌入语义而不修改检索管线；(2) 提出浅层到深层的长度调度策略，自适应模型各层容量；(3) 采用动态min-max训练框架：在线多模态攻击者持续针对当前检索器构造困难对抗文档，防御者则更新提示将这些文档推出top-k的同时保持良性证据的排序与多样性；(4) 防御后的编码器可像标准稠密检索一样预计算和索引，因此无额外逐查询优化开销，参数增加<1%。

Result: 在四个基准数据集和三种代表性投毒攻击下，DSPrompt显著降低了攻击成功率和投毒检索率，同时保持近乎无损的检索效用和生成保真度，在计算成本远低于现有防御基线的情况下持续优于它们。

Conclusion: DSPrompt证明了通过在离线阶段注入软提示重塑检索器嵌入语义这一思路的有效性，以极低的参数开销和零查询时额外成本实现了优越的对抗鲁棒性，为M-RAG安全防御提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Multimodal Retrieval Augmented Generation (M-RAG) is increasingly vulnerable to adversarial attacks where malicious data are crafted to produce embeddings that align with benign entries in the vector space, deceiving retrieval and inducing harmful outputs. Existing defenses primarily operate at query time, relying on auxiliary detectors, similarity re-ranking, or feature-consistency checks. However, these approaches suffer from non-trivial inference overhead, generalize poorly to unseen attack strategies, and often assume specific attack distributions. To address this, we propose DSPrompt, a Dynamic Soft Prompt defense framework that directly reshapes the retriever's embedding semantics, without modifying the retrieval pipeline. It inserts few learnable soft prompts into each layer of the visual and textual encoders of a frozen retriever, utilizing a shallow-to-deep length schedule that is adaptive to the capacity in the model layers. These prompts are trained under a dynamic min-max scheme: an online multimodal attacker continually crafts hard adversarial documents against the current retriever, while the defender is updated to push such documents out of the top-k while preserving the ranking and diversity of benign evidence. Because the defended encoder can be pre-computed and indexed exactly as in standard dense retrieval, DSPrompt incurs no additional per-query optimization and introduces fewer than 1% additional parameters. Extensive experiments across four benchmarks and three representative poisoning attacks show that DSPrompt substantially reduces the attack success rate and poison retrieval rate while maintaining near-lossless retrieval utility and generation fidelity, consistently outperforming existing defense baselines at a fraction of their computational cost.

</details>


### [465] [What to Remember, What to Reveal: Privacy-Aware Memory for Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16551)
*Wenjie Wang,Wenhe Si,Xinyue Xu,Yue Xu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出SP-Mem（Sanitized Privacy-Mapped Memory），一种面向个性化对话系统的隐私感知记忆架构。该方法将记忆效用与精确私有值的暴露解耦，通过全生命周期隐私设计（识别并分离敏感信息、隔离存储脱敏内容与精确私有值、基于任务需求和用户同意选择性检索），在保持个性化能力的同时减少不必要的隐私暴露。作者还引入了一个联合评估回复质量、隐私行为和推理成本的隐私感知记忆基准，实验表明SP-Mem在多个LLM智能体上实现了更强的个性化同时降低了隐私暴露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆架构主要优化效用，忽视了不必要存储和复用PII等私有属性带来的隐私风险。简单地移除敏感值会损害系统效用，因此隐私保护需要在整个生命周期内治理敏感值，而非仅仅对单条记录进行脱敏。

Method: SP-Mem将记忆效用与精确私有值暴露解耦，提供全生命周期的隐私设计：(1) 从原始用户输入中识别并分离敏感信息；(2) 将脱敏内容与精确私有值存储在隔离的结构中；(3) 根据任务需求和用户同意选择性检索私有值。同时构建了联合评估回复质量、隐私行为和推理成本的隐私感知记忆基准。

Result: 在多个基于LLM的智能体上进行的广泛实验表明，SP-Mem在实现更强个性化能力的同时，减少了不必要的隐私暴露。

Conclusion: SP-Mem验证了"记忆效用与精确私有值解耦"这一设计思路在个性化与隐私保护之间取得平衡的有效性，为隐私感知的个性化记忆系统提供了可行的架构方案。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables personalized conversational agents to retain user information across sessions. However, existing memory architectures primarily optimize for utility while neglecting the risks of unnecessarily storing and reusing private attributes such as personally identifiable information (PII). Addressing privacy risks in personalized memory is challenging because simply removing sensitive values can undermine system utility. Therefore, privacy protection for memory agents should govern the full life cycle of sensitive values rather than only sanitizing individual records. To address this gap, we introduce Sanitized Privacy-Mapped Memory (SP-Mem), a privacy-aware memory architecture that decouples memory utility from exact private-value exposure. SP-Mem provides a full life-cycle privacy design that identifies and separates sensitive information from raw user inputs, stores sanitized content and exact private values in isolated structures, and selectively retrieves private values based on task requirements and user consent. We further introduce a privacy-aware memory benchmark that jointly evaluates response quality, privacy behavior, and inference cost. Extensive experiments across multiple LLM-based agents show that SP-Mem achieves stronger personalization while reducing unnecessary privacy exposure. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Jensassss/SP-Mem.

</details>


### [466] [Rigorous Statements and Proofs of the Lemmas in Simon's Algorithm for the Dihedral Coset Problem and Their Underlying Hypothesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16598)
*Yuchen Guo,Shuo Yang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对Simon提出的二面体陪集问题(Dihedral Coset Problem)多项式时间量子算法中的四个引理进行了严格审查和完全证明。其中三个引理原本只有证明草图，本文给出了完整的单义陈述和证明。结果显示：引理1的证明基于子集和计数的精确二阶矩计算；引理3的振幅界可由精确Parseval恒等式推导且无需良态性假设；引理4的球箱协方差计算被修正，且算法最终仍有一个关键假设无法满足——两侧划分必须独立于测量串，而算法本身并不提供这种划分，因此四个引理的证明并不足以确立算法的正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Simon在预印本中提出的多项式时间量子算法分析依赖于四个引理，其中三个仅有证明草图，缺乏严格的数学依据。为了确定该算法是否真正正确，需要对这些引理给出完整且无歧义的证明，并检验算法结论是否能够成立。

Method: 本文对三个引理逐一进行严格的数学证明：(1) 引理1通过子集和计数的精确二阶矩计算证明，将原常数界改为依概率趋于1；(2) 引理3利用测量结果立方体上的精确Parseval恒等式证明振幅界在所有阈值下成立，无需良态性假设；(3) 引理4精确计算球箱分布的协方差并发现第二项包含原引理遗漏的项，同时将差分配对转换为加性形式，利用带符号前缀因子控制振幅差而非比值；最终通过逻辑分析揭示算法仍依赖一个无法满足的划分独立性假设。

Result: 三项引理均获得完整证明，但结论是四个引理的成立并不能保证算法正确。原因是算法要求的"两侧划分独立于测量串"这一假设，算法本身给出的划分规则无法满足。因此原始预印本所声称的算法正确性仍然存疑。

Conclusion: 虽然三个关键引理被严格证明（且部分条件被放宽或修正），但该量子算法的正确性并未得到确立。最终的障碍在于划分独立性假设无法由算法自身保证，这表明算法设计或分析中仍存在根本性的缺陷。

Abstract: In a recent preprint, Simon proposed a polynomial-time quantum algorithm for the Dihedral Coset Problem and rested the analysis on four lemmas. Three of them carry only proof sketches, and this paper gives each of those three a statement that admits a single reading together with a complete proof. Lemma 1 follows from an exact second-moment computation for the subset-sum counts, and it holds with probability tending to one in place of the constant originally claimed. The amplitude bound of Lemma 3 follows from an exact Parseval identity on the cube of measurement outcomes and holds at every threshold with no well-behavedness hypothesis, so that predicate leaves the argument entirely. For Lemma 4, we compute both balls-in-bins covariances exactly and find that the second carries a term a fixed ball count leaves out. The assumption that the distinguished group contains no faulty samples can also be dropped. The two branch amplitudes share a signed prefactor, so the counting estimates control their difference and not the ratio the lemma states. We prove the additive form and show that the closing argument consumes nothing more than that. A single hypothesis survives all of this. It asks that the partition into the two sides be fixed independently of the measured string, and the rule the algorithm gives for choosing that partition does not supply it. Establishing these four lemmas therefore does not by itself establish the correctness of the algorithm.

</details>


### [467] [A Deployment-Oriented and Resource-Efficient Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Explainable DDoS Detection in Operational Technology Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16769)
*Mikiyas Alemayehu,Mohamed Chahine Ghanem,Hamza Kheddar,Aohan Li,J. J. Garcia-Luna-Aceves*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向资源受限的OT环境（PLC/ICS/SCADA）的神经符号DDoS检测框架，融合GRU神经网络与浅层决策树，在三个真实DDoS基准数据集上取得了高精度，并在降低漏报率（FNR）方面优于纯神经与纯符号基线，同时推理延迟处于亚毫秒至个位数毫秒级别，满足OT控制环路时序要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OT环境（PLC、ICS、SCADA）正日益遭受DDoS攻击的威胁，但此类环境资源受限。现有纯神经网络方法缺乏可解释性，纯符号方法精度不足。需要一个既能保持高检测精度、又具备可解释性且计算开销极小的混合方案。

Method: 提出神经符号（neuro-symbolic）混合框架：以GRU神经网络为神经组件，融合一个浅层决策树作为符号组件。符号组件单独提供紧凑可解释的规则集，融合模块结合两种范式的优势。采用统一的预处理流程（标签映射、数值特征选择、鲁棒缩放、类别平衡），并在验证集上联合优化融合权重alpha与决策阈值以最大化F1分数。在三个基准数据集（CIC-DDoS2019、Edge-IIoTset、CICIoT23）上进行评估。

Result: 在CIC-DDoS2019上达到99.04%准确率（MCC 0.97），在CICIoT23上达到98.61%准确率（MCC 0.76）；两种情况下FNR均低于纯神经和纯符号基线。在Edge-IIoTset上浅层决策树单独即达100%准确率，该数据集主要用于验证预处理流程。推理延迟为每样本0.58-0.79毫秒（模型推理），端到端路径（含特征提取）在个位数毫秒预算内。

Conclusion: 融合框架的核心增益在于以可控的误报成本换取更低的漏报率（FNR），这在OT场景中至关重要——漏检攻击比误报更具有破坏性。模型的推理延迟满足OT控制环路时序约束，具备实际部署可行性。Edge-IIoTset的线性可分性说明该数据集仅能验证预处理管线而非融合策略。

Abstract: Operational technology (OT) environments, including programmable logic controllers (PLCs), industrial control systems (ICS), and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, are increasingly targeted by distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks. This paper presents a neuro-symbolic framework specifically designed for robust DDoS detection in these resource-constrained environments. The framework fuses a gated recurrent unit (GRU) neural network with a shallow decision tree as a symbolic component. The symbolic component alone provides a compact, interpretable rule set, while the fusion combines the strengths of both paradigms. The hybrid model is evaluated on three real-world benchmark DDoS datasets: CIC-DDoS2019, Edge-IIoTset, and CICIoT23. A unified comprehensive preprocessing pipeline including label mapping, numerical feature selection, robust scaling, and class balancing is applied. The fusion weight alpha and decision threshold are jointly optimised on validation data to maximise F1-score. The hybrid model attains 99.04% accuracy (MCC 0.97) on CIC-DDoS2019 and 98.61% accuracy (MCC 0.76) on CICIoT23, in both cases reducing the FNR below that of the pure-neural and pure-symbolic baselines; on the linearly separable Edge-IIoTset the shallow decision tree alone already reaches 100%, so this benchmark validates the preprocessing pipeline rather than the fusion. The principal gain of the fusion is a lower FNR at a controlled false-positive cost, which matters in operational technology, where a missed attack is more damaging than a false alarm. Model-only inference latency is sub-millisecond (0.58-0.79 milliseconds per sample) on a standard central processing unit; including on-device flow-feature extraction, the end-to-end path remains within a single-digit-millisecond budget, which is compatible with OT control-loop timing.

</details>


### [468] [Topological Attribution Distance (TAD): Revealing Segment-Level RAG Influence on LLM Output Geometry for Incident Log Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16775)
*Reza Fayyazi,Michael Zuzak,Shanchieh Jay Yang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出拓扑归因距离（Topological Attribution Distance, TAD），一种受拓扑学启发的技术，用于追踪大型语言模型（LLM）在网络安全运营中的输出来源。TAD通过分段级消融归因来表征检索日志与模型响应之间的全局几何关系，从而实现可解释、可信的证据溯源与验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在网络安全中部署时，信任模型生成结果至关重要。当自主智能体做决策时，必须能追溯决策链，识别导致模型输出产生的关键数据段。现有方法难以区分复杂且高度相似的证据来源（如网络事件日志），缺乏对检索证据与生成响应之间整体几何关系的充分捕捉，导致证据验证不可靠。

Method: TAD受拓扑学启发，通过捕捉输出的全局几何形状及其相对检索日志的变化来归因证据。核心思路是：若某个特定源日志的嵌入在嵌入空间中显著改变模型响应的几何结构，则该日志是模型生成响应的重要来源。TAD采用分段级消融归因，针对真实网络攻击的事件日志进行系统分析，并利用LLM的隐藏状态来追踪不同检索日志对模型生成的几何影响。

Result: 实验表明TAD能以自适应方式找出对LLM输出归因影响最大的日志，有效从复杂且高度相似的事件日志中识别关键证据来源，提供比现有方法更可靠的可解释性溯源。

Conclusion: TAD为网络安全和Agentic-AI工作流提供了基于拓扑几何的证据验证与可信溯源框架，弥补了现有方法在捕捉证据与响应之间全局几何关系方面的空白，为LLM在安全运营中的可靠部署提供了重要支撑。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed in cybersecurity operations to assist cybersecurity analysts with rapid decision-making against emerging threats. However, there is a main criteria that must be met when using LLMs in cybersecurity, that is, trust in the generated outputs. As Agentic AI is integrated into operational systems, a robust evidence attribution and provenance tracking technique is essential to trace the origins of model generations. When autonomous agents make a decision (right or wrong), the ability to trace back through the decision chain is critical, as without it, teams cannot identify which segment of the data caused the model generation. Existing methods often struggle to distinguish among complex and highly similar evidence sources, such as cyber incident logs. This reveals a key gap: current approaches do not adequately capture the holistic geometric relationship between the retrieved evidence and the generated response for reliable evidence verification. To bridge this gap, we propose Topological Attribution Distance (TAD), inspired by Topology, to characterize and capture the global geometric shape of an output and its changes against its retrieved logs. In other words, if the embeddings of a specific source log drastically changes the geometry of the model's response in the embedding space, this suggests that such log is a critical source for the model's generated response. Therefore, TAD is powered by segment-level ablation attribution to investigate incident logs of an actual cyberattack. We demonstrate how TAD finds the most attributed logs on LLM outputs in an adaptive manner. This can provide an explainable and trustworthy tracing based on each LLM's hidden state to understand how geometrically different retrieved logs influence the model generation, and provide evidence verification in cybersecurity and Agentic-AI workflows.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [469] [ARISE: An adaptive residual-informed stability ensemble for feature selection in small-sample biomedical omics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14866)
*Zardad Khan,Amjad Ali,Naz Gul,Sheema Gul,Saeed Aldahmani*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: ARISE是一种针对小样本分子分类的自适应残差信息稳定集成特征选择方法，结合互补相关性信号、类平衡稳定性评估、残差信息冗余控制和多类成对覆盖，在210,000次held-out评估中于所有15个数据集-指标组合中排名第一，显著优于六种滤波器基线和固定分类器组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小样本分子分类需要能识别预测性强、稳定且非冗余特征子集的特征选择器，以应对二分类和多分类结果。现有方法在相关性、稳定性、冗余性和多类判别能力之间难以兼顾，因此需要一种能够整合互补相关性信号并自适应权衡这些维度的集成特征选择框架。

Method: ARISE将七个百分位归一化的相关性分量通过15种预定义配置文件组合，并由嵌套内层交叉验证自适应加权。评估涉及五个分子数据集、八种特征集大小、三种固定分类器（k近邻、支持向量机、随机森林）和六种滤波器比较方法。泛化性能通过50次重复的五折外层交叉验证估计，使用平衡准确率、宏F1和Cohen's kappa指标。

Result: 在210,000次held-out评估中，ARISE在所有15个数据集-指标组合中均排名第一。等数据集均值为平衡准确率0.793、宏F1 0.776、kappa 0.725，分别超过最强聚合比较方法0.022、0.023和0.028。在紧凑特征集上性能保持强劲，但最优特征预算因数据集而异。

Conclusion: ARISE提供了一个透明、自适应的框架，能够联合处理相关性、稳定性、冗余性和多类判别。其在多种数据集、分类器、指标和特征集大小上的稳定结果支持进一步在小样本分子分类场景中进行评估。

Abstract: Objective: Small-sample molecular classification requires feature selectors that identify predictive, stable, and nonredundant subsets for binary and multiclass outcomes. We propose ARISE (Adaptive Residual-Informed Stability Ensemble), which integrates complementary relevance signals, class-balanced stability assessment, residual-informed redundancy control, and multiclass pairwise coverage.
  Methods: ARISE combines seven percentile-normalized relevance components through 15 predefined profiles, adaptively weighted by nested inner cross-validation. It was evaluated on five molecular datasets, eight feature-set sizes, three fixed classifiers (k-nearest neighbours, support vector machine, and random forest), and six filter comparators. Generalization was estimated by five-fold outer cross-validation repeated 50 times using balanced accuracy, macro-F1, and Cohen's kappa.
  Results: Across 210,000 held-out assessments, ARISE ranked first in all 15 dataset-metric combinations. Equal-dataset means were 0.793 for balanced accuracy, 0.776 for macro-F1, and 0.725 for kappa, exceeding the strongest aggregate comparator by 0.022, 0.023, and 0.028, respectively. Performance remained strong across compact feature sets, although the optimal budget differed by dataset.
  Conclusion: ARISE provides a transparent, adaptive framework that jointly addresses relevance, stability, redundancy, and multiclass discrimination. Its consistent results across datasets, classifiers, metrics, and feature-set sizes support further evaluation for small-sample molecular classification.

</details>


### [470] [A Deep Learning Model for Spatially Clustered Data via Differentiable Cluster Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14968)
*Kexuan Li,Weidong Ma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的非参数回归方法，用于处理响应变量与协变量之间的关系在空间域未知划分上发生变化的问题。该方法联合学习空间划分和簇内回归函数，通过退火softmax松弛、图拉普拉斯和占有率惩罚实现梯度估计与稳定聚类，并建立了可识别性、划分误差界和预测风险分解等理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多空间数据应用中，协变量与响应之间的关系并非全域一致，而是在空间上存在未知的区域边界，不同区域内回归关系截然不同。现有的非参数回归方法或假设全局平滑关系，或需要预先已知划分结构，难以处理回归面在未知空间边界处突然变化的情形。

Method: 构造三层神经网络：一个依赖位置的神经网络决定簇成员关系（聚类分配），多个独立的神经网络描述各簇内的协变量-响应关系。采用退火softmax松弛将离散的分配问题转化为可梯度优化问题；引入图拉普拉斯惩罚抑制碎片化区域，使用占有率惩罚避免退化解（如空簇或单点簇）。

Result: 建立了标签置换意义下的可识别性，在边际条件下给出了划分误差的上界，并将预测风险分解为回归成分与分配成分。当划分估计足够精确时，所提方法的收敛速率与先知（oracle）估计器一致。仿真表明在回归面于空间边界处突变时联合估计更优，涵盖非线性效应、区域大小不均衡、非均匀抽样和空间相关误差等情形。

Conclusion: 联合估计未知空间划分与簇内回归函数的方法是有效且可行的，在理论与实验层面均得到了验证，适用于回归关系随空间区域发生突变的数据场景。

Abstract: We consider nonparametric regression when the association between a response and its covariates changes across an unknown partition of a spatial domain. The proposed estimator learns the partition and the cluster-specific regression functions jointly. A neural network depending only on location determines cluster membership, while separate neural networks describe the covariate--response relationship within the clusters. An annealed softmax relaxation permits gradient-based estimation of the otherwise discrete assignments. Graph-Laplacian and occupancy penalties are used to discourage fragmented regions and degenerate solutions. We establish identifiability up to label permutation, bound partition error under a margin condition, and decompose prediction risk into regression and assignment components. The resulting rate agrees with that of an oracle estimator when the partition is estimated sufficiently accurately. Simulations show that joint estimation is useful when regression surfaces change abruptly across spatial boundaries, including settings with nonlinear effects, unequal region sizes, preferential sampling, and spatially correlated errors. Finally, a real data analysis is provided to demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [471] [Sufficient Dimesion Reduction via Generalized Stein's Lemma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15121)
*Ye Tian*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于广义Stein引理的多变量响应充分降维（SDR）框架，通过构造多变量响应与预测变量边际得分函数之间的交叉矩矩阵，并经SVD恢复中心子空间。该方法无需线性性假设、无需矩阵求逆和迭代平滑，还能利用无标签数据，在样本量有限时优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量响应下的充分降维问题在样本量有限时尤为困难。现有方法存在各自的缺陷：逆回归方法依赖强分布假设与矩阵求逆，其多响应扩展面临严重的切片稀疏问题；前向回归方法依赖计算成本随响应维度增长的迭代平滑；深度学习方法需要大量标注数据。亟需一种规避这些限制的新方法。

Method: 基于广义Stein引理构造多变量响应与预测变量边际得分函数的交叉矩矩阵，通过对该矩阵进行奇异值分解（SVD）来恢复中心子空间。该方法不依赖线性性条件，避免矩阵求逆和迭代平滑，并可利用可用的无标签数据。同时提出了一种实用的秩选择算法来估计中心子空间的维度，并在标准正则性条件下建立了估计量的收敛性保证。

Result: 大量模拟研究和真实数据应用表明，所提方法在各种设置下均一致优于现有方法，特别是在中等维度、标签稀缺、高噪声水平的情境中表现突出。

Conclusion: 基于广义Stein引理的SDR框架有效克服了现有方法在多变量响应、小样本场景下的多种局限，具有更强的适用性和稳健性，并具备理论保证。

Abstract: Sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) seeks the minimal subspace of the predictors that captures the full conditional distribution of the response, which is known as the central subspace (CS). When the response is multivariate, the problem becomes considerably more challenging, particularly when the sample size is limited. Existing methods face different limitations:inverse regression approaches rely on strong distributional assumptions and matrix inversion, and their multi-response extensions suffer from severe slice sparsity; forward regression methods depend on computationally intensive iterative smoothing whose cost grows with the response dimension; and deep learning-based approaches demand large amounts of labeled data. To circumvent these shortcomings, we propose an SDR framework based on the generalized Stein's lemma. Our method constructs a cross-moment matrix between the multivariate response and the marginal score function of the predictors, and recovers the CS via its singular value decomposition. The proposed method does not rely on the linearity condition, avoids matrix inversion as well as iterative smoothing, and can leverage unlabeled data when available. We establish convergence guarantees for the proposed estimator under standard regularity conditions. Moreover, we propose a practical rank-selection algorithm to estimate the dimension of the CS. Extensive simulation studies and a real data application demonstrate that the proposed methods consistently outperform existing approaches across a variety of settings, particularly in moderate-dimensional, label-scarce scenarios with high noise levels.

</details>


### [472] [Scale-Consistent Posterior Dynamics for Diffusion Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15144)
*Zhaoqiang Liu,Tongyao Pang,Ruibing Wang,Yang Zheng*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于扩散先验的后验采样算法，通过重标度清洁坐标表达似然、用log-SNR组织代理项，并结合冻结目标Langevin校正器构造连续替代SDE；外层Lie-Trotter分裂与时序匹配的IMEX预测器用于离散化，证明了理想族的边缘不变性、连续替代的后验收敛性以及离散算法的弱误差界。在FFHQ和ImageNet上仅用100次评分评估即在超分辨率和去模糊任务中达到有竞争力的重建保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用预训练扩散先验进行后验采样时，条件得分中的中间似然分量通常难以处理。作者希望设计一个可求解且保持后验边缘不变的采样算法，同时兼顾计算效率与理论保证。

Method: 从一个理想的一参数后验SDE族出发，其中随机性参数不影响后验边缘但调节概率流传输与随机探索；将似然在重标度的清洁图像坐标下表达并用log-SNR组织代理；通过前向算子投影扩散不确定性获得噪声条件协方差路径，其目标趋近干净后验；交叉插入冻结目标Langevin校正器以生成连续替代SDE；用外层Lie-Trotter分裂和方差匹配的分裂步IMEX预测器离散化，其中学习的先验显式处理、线性似然隐式处理、随机创新在隐式求解后注入。

Result: 在FFHQ和ImageNet上以100次评分评估，超分辨率和去模糊任务达到有竞争力的重建保真度。100图像消融实验分离了尺度一致性与随机增量放置、连续化及校正器分配的有有限步效应；无噪声框式修复研究显示，只有在匹配创新于刚性似然求解后注入时，大探索范围才能达到性能平台。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了兼具理论保证（边缘不变性、后验收敛、弱误差界）与实际高效性（100次评分评估）的后验采样方法，并明确了随机增量注入时机对性能的关键影响。

Abstract: Posterior sampling with a pretrained diffusion prior is governed by a conditional score whose intermediate likelihood component is generally intractable. We begin from an ideal one-parameter posterior SDE family in which a stochasticity parameter controls probability-flow transport and stochastic exploration without changing the posterior marginals. To obtain a tractable model, we express the likelihood in a rescaled clean-image coordinate and use log-SNR to organize the resulting posterior proxies. Projecting the diffusion uncertainty through the forward operator then yields a noise-conditioned covariance path whose targets approach the clean posterior. Because endpoint consistency of these targets does not ensure that a surrogate transport follows them, we interleave the transport with a frozen-target Langevin corrector, producing a continuous surrogate SDE. We discretize this model with an outer Lie--Trotter splitting and a variance-matched split-step IMEX predictor that treats the learned prior explicitly, the linear likelihood implicitly, and the stochastic innovation after the implicit solve. We prove marginal invariance of the ideal family, posterior convergence of the continuous surrogate under mixing and transport-defect conditions, and a first-order weak error bound for the discrete algorithm.
