Experiments on FFHQ and ImageNet with 100 score evaluations demonstrate competitive reconstruction fidelity for super-resolution and deblurring. A controlled 100-image ablation separates scale consistency from the finite-step effects of stochastic-increment placement, continuation, and corrector allocation. A separate noiseless box-inpainting study shows that large exploration reaches a performance plateau only when the matched innovation is injected after the stiff likelihood solve.

</details>


### [473] [Beyond Effective Sample Size: Effective Number of Proposals for Adaptive Importance Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15154)
*Ali Mousavi,Victor Elvira*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出有效提案数（ENP），一种用于群体自适应重要性采样（AIS）的相似度感知的提案级诊断指标。ENP结合每个提案的总归一化权重与目标加权样本间的冗余度度量，估计近似中对非冗余经验提案贡献的数量，能够检测标准ESS所遗漏的提案塌缩和重复问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的有效样本量（ESS）等基于权重的诊断指标只能衡量归一化重要性权重的集中程度，无法反映提案分量在采样空间中的排列方式。在群体AIS中，多个提案分量可能在同一目标区域生成样本，导致样本权重看似均衡，但实际不同的提案分量数量很少。因此需要一种能够检测提案冗余和塌缩的提案级诊断指标。

Method: 论文引入了有效提案数（ENP），这是一种相似度感知的提案级诊断指标。ENP结合了两部分信息：每个提案分配到的总归一化权重，以及从目标加权样本之间的相似度计算得到的冗余度量。通过综合这两个信息，ENP估计近似中对非冗余经验提案贡献的有效数量。

Result: 论文建立了ENP的基本有效数性质，并证明ENP能够检测标准ESS所遗漏的提案塌缩（proposal collapse）和提案重复（proposal duplication）现象。此外，还展示了ENP可作为提案更新的定向反馈信号。

Conclusion: ENP为群体AIS提供了一种比传统权重诊断更全面、更能反映提案分布结构的评估工具，弥补了ESS在检测提案级冗余方面的不足，并可作为提案翻新机制的指导信号。

Abstract: Population-based adaptive importance sampling (AIS) methods use a set of
  proposal densities to approximate complex target distributions. Their
  performance is commonly assessed through effective sample size (ESS) and related
  weight-based diagnostics, which measure the concentration of normalized
  importance weights. However, a large ESS only indicates that the normalized
  sample weights are not strongly concentrated; it does not describe how the
  proposal components are arranged in the sampling space. In population-based AIS,
  several proposal components may generate samples in the same region of the
  target, so the sample weights can appear well balanced even though the effective
  number of distinct proposal components is small. This letter introduces the
  effective number of proposals (ENP), a similarity-aware proposal-level diagnostic
  for population-based AIS. ENP combines the total normalized weight assigned to
  each proposal with a redundancy measure computed from similarities among
  target-weighted samples, estimating the number of non-redundant empirical
  proposal contributions to the approximation. We establish basic effective-number
  properties and show that ENP detects proposal collapse and duplication missed by
  standard ESS. We also illustrate its use as a targeted feedback signal for
  proposal rejuvenation.

</details>


### [474] [Identifying parameter couplings and uncertainties of mixed-noise stochastic systems via full-covariance Gaussian mixture network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15198)
*Xiaolong Wang,Xiangwen Hao,Jing Feng,Yuanyuan Liu,Yong Xu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出PENN-GMD，一种参数估计神经网络，将部分观测轨迹映射到系统参数上的高斯混合分布（GMD）。通过满协方差矩阵显式揭示参数耦合和多峰似然结构，并通过满射参数化硬编码所有GMD约束来近似真实似然函数。在五个数值示例中验证，能准确恢复似然分布、捕捉参数耦合，并自然诊断不可辨识性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合噪声驱动的随机动力系统参数辨识极具挑战性，因其似然函数难以处理（intractable）。传统基于似然的方法在此类系统中不可行，需要一种能够处理复杂似然结构并进行不确定性感知参数辨识的新方法。

Method: PENN-GMD网络将部分观测轨迹映射为系统参数上的高斯混合分布；与常规不确定性估计不同，GMD使用满协方差矩阵以显式揭示参数耦合和多峰似然结构；通过最小化负对数似然进行训练，采用满射参数化（surjective parameterization）硬编码所有GMD约束以近似真实似然。

Result: 在五个数值示例上验证：含分数高斯噪声和Lévy噪声的系统、色噪声驱动的振荡器、不同可观测性下的耦合神经元、以及具有不可辨识随机扰动的气动弹性翼。结果表明PENN-GMD能准确恢复似然分布、捕捉参数耦合，并通过方差扩张或模式分裂自然诊断非可辨识性。

Conclusion: PENN-GMD可作为复杂随机系统中不确定性感知参数辨识的实用工具，填补了传统基于似然方法在该类系统中不可行的空白。

Abstract: Parameter identification of stochastic dynamical systems driven by mixed noises is challenging due to intractable likelihood functions. We propose PENN-GMD, a parameter estimation neural network that maps partially observed trajectories to a Gaussian mixture distribution (GMD) over the system parameters. Unlike conventional uncertainty estimates, the GMD employs full covariance matrices to explicitly reveal parameter couplings and multi-modal likelihood structures. The network is trained by minimizing the negative log-likelihood via a surjective parameterization that hard-encodes all GMD constraints, thereby approximating the true likelihood. We validate the method on five numerical examples with increasing complexity, including systems driven by fractional Gaussian and Lévy noises, oscillators with colored noise, coupled neurons under different observability, and an aeroelastic airfoil with unidentifiable stochastic disturbances. Results demonstrate that PENN-GMD accurately recovers likelihood distributions, captures parameter couplings, and naturally diagnoses non-identifiability through variance broadening or mode splitting. These capabilities establish PENN-GMD as a practical tool for uncertainty-aware parameter identification in complex stochastic systems where conventional likelihood-based methods are infeasible.

</details>


### [475] [The Distributional View of Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15215)
*Gordei Verbii,Juho Lee*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分布视角的 token 级知识蒸馏框架：教师不再由单一软化输出表示，而是由多温度视图族（logits 退火路径的边缘分布）表示，学生在基于嵌入的代价下对几何感知聚合（混合物、对数线性池化、熵 Wasserstein 重心及去偏 Sinkhorn 散度）进行训练。实验在指令微调的 Pythia 模型对上发现三条经验定律：多温度聚合的收益随视图温度离散度单调增长而非视图数量；离散视图激活聚合算子（重心与算术混合分离恰在传输聚合超越平均时）；由天花板间隙 Γ 决定的两区制图景决定了最佳 KD 损失的选择。核心主张："哪种蒸馏损失最佳"不是损失的固定属性，而是 Γ 的函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准 token 级知识蒸馏用 KL 散度逐点比较教师与学生的条件分布，但 KL 梯度无法识别"错误 token 的概率质量究竟落在哪个 token 上"，对错配的位置结构不敏感。作者希望超越点式比较，引入分布层面的几何信息，让蒸馏过程感知概率质量的分布位置而非仅仅匹配逐点数值。

Method: 将教师表示为一族多温度视图（logits 退火路径的边缘），学生针对这些视图在嵌入基代价下的几何感知聚合进行训练。形式上形式化了一个设计空间：混合物、对数线性池化、熵 Wasserstein 重心，以及作为旗舰的去偏 Sinkhorn 散度（具 hub 和 path 两种形态）。证明了一个精确坍缩结果：tempered 视图的对数线性池化等价于单一温度。并给出多边缘 Schrödinger 桥的解读以产生可证伪的预测。

Result: 在指令微调 Pythia 模型对上的实验揭示三条经验定律：(i) 离散度定律——多温度聚合的收益随视图有效温度离散度单调增长，与视图数量无关；(ii) 离散视图激活聚合算子——传输基聚合开始胜过算术平均时，重心恰好与算术混合分离；(iii) 由天花板间隙 Γ=PPLL_SFT−PPL_T 主导的两区制图景：教师仅勉强胜过学生时，温和传输目标是最佳 KD 损失但 KD 无法超越监督微调；真正天花板存在时排名反转，且保真度-泛化相关性符号翻转。

Conclusion: 作者论证"哪种蒸馏损失最佳"并非损失的固有属性，而是天花板间隙 Γ 的函数。这推翻了将 KD 损失视为静态最优选择的观点，表明损失的选择需根据教师相对学生的实际能力上限动态决定。

Abstract: Token-level knowledge distillation (KD) matches two conditional distributions per position, yet the standard objectives compare them pointwise: a Kullback-Leibler gradient is blind to which wrong token receives probability mass. We develop a distributional view in which the teacher is represented not by a single softened output but by a family of multi-temperature views - marginals of the annealing path of its logits - and the student is trained against a geometry-aware aggregate of these views under an embedding-based ground cost. We formalize the resulting design space (mixtures, log-linear pooling, entropic Wasserstein barycenters, and a debiased Sinkhorn-divergence flagship in hub and path forms), prove an exact collapse result showing log-linear pooling of tempered views is equivalent to a single temperature, and give a multi-marginal Schrodinger-bridge reading that yields falsifiable predictions. On instruction-tuned Pythia pairs, experiments yield three empirical laws: (i) dispersion law - the benefit of multi-temperature aggregation grows monotonically with the effective temperature dispersion of the views, not with their number; (ii) dispersed views unlock the aggregation operator - the barycenter separates from the arithmetic mixture exactly when transport-based aggregation starts to beat averaging; and (iii) two-regime picture governed by the ceiling gap $Γ=\mathrm{PPL}_{\mathrm{SFT}}-\mathrm{PPL}_{T}$: when the fine-tuned teacher barely beats a supervised student the gentle transport objective is the best KD loss but no KD beats supervised fine-tuning, whereas at a real ceiling the ranking inverts - and the sign of the fidelity-generalization correlation flips. We argue that "which distillation loss is the best" is not a fixed property of the loss but a function of $Γ$.

</details>


### [476] [Convolution Smoothed Quantile Regression for XGBoost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15290)
*Mandy Yao,Meredith Franklin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出QXGB，一种基于分位数的梯度提升框架，通过卷积平滑损失估计条件分位数，构建稠密累积分布函数（CDF）、超越概率和尾部行为，用于极端事件预测，同时在保持XGBoost计算效率的前提下恢复树分裂所需的Hessian信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数ML算法只提供点估计，缺乏预测不确定性或响应条件分布的信息，难以刻画稀有或极端结果。现有分位数回归方法在梯度提升框架中存在Hessian信息缺失或分位数穿越等问题，需要一种既能高效计算又能提供完整分布信息的方法。

Method: 开发QXGB分位数梯度提升框架，引入卷积平滑损失来估计条件分位数，构造稠密CDF、超越概率和尾部行为。推导了不同核函数规格下卷积平滑分位数损失的梯度和Hessian，并集成到XGBoost中。在模拟数据上与替代平滑分位数回归损失、XGBoost Python包原生分位数目标、独立与多输出树估计进行基准比较。

Result: 卷积平滑QXGB（特别是与多输出树结合时）实现了几乎零分位数穿越的准确预测、良好校准的CDF和超越概率估计，以及有用的极值尾部刻画。在北加州PM2.5预测（含野火烟雾期间）的实际应用中验证了其有效性，并评估了区间估计作为数据离散度的度量。

Conclusion: 卷积平滑QXGB为极端值预测和分位数估计提供了一种计算高效且可解释的解决方案，在分位数校准、超越概率和尾部行为刻画方面优于现有替代方法，尤其适用于环境数据等存在极端事件场景的应用。

Abstract: The increasing availability of large and complex datasets across many scientific disciplines has led to widespread adoption of machine learning (ML) for prediction. However, most ML algorithms focus on point estimation and provide limited information about predictive uncertainty or the conditional distribution of the response, restricting their ability to characterize rare or extreme outcomes. We develop QXGB, a quantile-based gradient boosting framework, and introduce a convolution smoothed loss within it that estimates conditional quantiles for constructing dense cumulative distribution functions (CDFs), exceedance probabilities, and tail behaviour relevant to extreme outcomes. This approach preserves the computational efficiency of extreme gradient boosting while restoring the Hessian information XGBoost relies on for tree splitting, in turn providing interpretable measures of extreme value and exceedance probability predictions. We derive the gradients and Hessians needed to integrate convolution smoothed quantile loss with different kernel specifications into XGBoost, and with simulated data, benchmark this approach against alternative smoothed quantile regression losses, the native quantile objective in the XGBoost Python package, and independent versus multi-output tree estimation. The practical relevance is illustrated in an application predicting fine particulate matter (PM$_{2.5}$) in northern California, including periods where levels were elevated due to wildfire smoke. Our results show that convolution smoothed QXGB, particularly when paired with multi-output trees, delivers accurate predictions with near-zero quantile crossing, well-calibrated CDF and exceedance probability estimates, and useful tail characterization for extreme values. Interval estimation is also evaluated as a measure of data spread.

</details>


### [477] [A Unified Geometric Framework for Developmental Analysis of Spatial Transcriptomic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15306)
*Mary Chriselda Antony Oliver,Kaitlyn Hohmeier,Tuyen Tran,Alejandra Castillo,Caroline Moosmüller,Shiying Li*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）空间的几何框架，用于分析基因表达网络在时空维度上的演化。通过将每个发育阶段表示为结合基因表达与空间邻近性的图，该框架支持跨时间的网络结构比较、GW测地线连续插值以及基于Ollivier-Ricci曲率的网络级变化量化，并在果蝇时空转录组数据上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高通量单细胞和空间转录组技术虽能提供高分辨率细胞状态快照，但其破坏性特性导致无法对同一细胞进行重复测量，时空动力学只能从独立采样且未对齐的细胞群中推断。现有的最优传输（OT）方法多聚焦于基因表达空间中细胞分布的演化，而忽视了由基因表达网络编码的关系结构，因此需要能够捕捉网络结构演化的新框架。

Method: 将每个发育阶段表示为结合基因表达与空间邻近性的图，嵌入Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）空间；通过GW测地线实现发育阶段间的连续插值；利用Ollivier-Ricci曲率定量刻画网络层面的结构变化；使用更高阶的Co-Optimal Transport（COOT）距离联合表征时空信息以验证框架。

Result: 在果蝇时空转录组数据集上的评估表明，GW测地线插值能够再现经验基因表达网络中曲率动力学的主要趋势；与高阶COOT距离的一致性进一步验证了框架的有效性，表明超网络表示能成功记录跨时间的显著生物学变化。

Conclusion: 该框架为研究动态演化的生物网络提供了一种统一的几何方法，能够利用GW空间中的嵌入来比较、插值和量化基因表达网络在不同发育阶段的结构演化。

Abstract: High-throughput single-cell and spatial transcriptomic technologies provide high-resolution snapshots of heterogeneous cellular states, but their destructive nature prevents repeated measurements of the same cells over time. Consequently, temporal and spatial dynamics must be inferred from independently sampled, unaligned cell populations, making it challenging to reconstruct developmental trajectories. Optimal transport (OT) offers a geometric framework for aligning cell populations and inferring developmental trajectories, but many existing approaches focus on modeling the evolution of distributions of cells in gene expression space rather than the relational structure encoded by gene expression networks. To address this limitation, we introduce a geometric framework for analyzing the spatiotemporal evolution of gene expression networks through embeddings in Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) space. By representing each developmental stage as a graph combining gene expression and spatial proximity, our approach enables comparisons of network structure across time, continuous interpolation between developmental stages via GW geodesics, and quantification of network-level changes using Ollivier-Ricci curvature. We evaluate our framework on a spatiotemporal transcriptomic \textit{Drosophila} dataset and show that GW geodesic interpolations reproduce main trends in curvature dynamics observed in empirical gene expression networks. Agreement with higher-order Co-Optimal Transport (COOT) distances, which jointly represent spatial and temporal information, further validates the framework and suggests that hypernetwork representations successfully record salient biological changes across time. In general, our approach provides a unified geometric approach to study dynamically evolving biological networks.

</details>


### [478] [Prediction Inference of Time Series with Standard ReLU Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15362)
*Kejin Wu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于ReLU深度神经网络(DNN)的时间序列预测及不确定度量化方法，构建所谓的"相关预测区间"(PPI)，同时捕获未来变异性和训练数据内的估计变异性，并给出了理论保障（一致性、beta-mixing性质保持等）及数值验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然DNN因其通用逼近能力被广泛应用于时间序列预测，但其不确定度量化尚未被深入研究。传统方法（线性、非线性或非参数核方法）在预测时间序列时存在局限，而预测中的不确定性由两部分组成：未来变动性和训练数据内的估计变异性，需要一种能同时捕获两者的方法。

Method: 基于标准ReLU DNN建立预测模型，构建"相关预测区间"(PPI)。首先证明在beta-mixing依赖数据下DNN估计量的一致性；随后证明由模型隐含的前向bootstrap序列仍保持beta-mixing性质，且与原时间序列以概率收敛地拥有相同平稳分布；最后在预测根的极限分布满足最小条件的前提下构建PPI。

Result: 理论上证明了DNN估计量在beta-mixing依赖数据下的一致性，以及前向bootstrap序列的beta-mixing性质和平稳分布保持性；通过数值模拟和真实数据分析验证了该方法优于标准非参数方法。

Conclusion: 该方法为深度神经网络在时间序列预测中提供了一种具有理论保障的不确定度量化工具，能够同时捕获未来变动性和估计变异性，并在仿真和真实数据中展现出超越标准非参数方法的性能。

Abstract: We propose a methodology based on the standard ReLU Deep Neural Networks (DNN) to make predictions and quantify their uncertainty. Classically, people rely on linear, non-linear, or non-parametric kernel methods to fit and then predict the time series. As the universal approximation ability was revealed for DNN, its application has become more and more popular for prediction tasks in various scientific areas. However, the corresponding uncertainty quantification has not been studied thoroughly. Particularly, the uncertainty in prediction will consist of two parts: (1) the future variability; (2) the estimation variability within training data. To capture both variabilities, we build the so-called pertinent prediction interval (PPI) with the DNN model estimator. We first explore the consistency property of the DNN estimator with beta-mixing dependent data. Subsequently, we show that the implied forward bootstrap series is still beta-mixing and possesses the same stationary distribution as the original time series in probability, which is a key condition to enable the PPI. Lastly, the desired PPI is built after imposing minimal conditions on the limiting distribution of predictive roots. Simulations and real-data analysis are deployed to challenge our approach with standard non-parametric methods.

</details>


### [479] [On Stopping Rules and Spatial Adaptation for CART](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15649)
*Zineng Xu,Yuchao Cai,Yan Shuo Tan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文证明了在空间异质和各向异性光滑性假设下，CART算法结合最小杂质下降（MID）停止规则能在所有点上同时达到接近极小极大最优的点态收敛速率，并证明常用的最小叶子数停止规则无法实现空间自适应，从而明确了MID停止规则的统计作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CART算法的分裂规则已被广泛研究，但停止规则的统计作用尚未被很好理解。此外，尽管贝叶斯回归树和ERM回归树已被证明具有空间自适应性，但CART能否实现相同的自适应（对局部光滑性和各向异性适应）仍是未知数。本文旨在填补这两方面的理论空白。

Method: 作者在空间异质和各向异性光滑性假设下，配合对回归函数和协变量分布的适当结构假设，对使用MID停止规则和合适阈值的CART算法进行了理论分析。通过同时考虑所有域内点上的点态收敛速率，证明了其达到极小极大最优（至多差对数因子），并通过构造反例证明最小叶子数停止规则无法实现空间自适应。

Result: CART与MID停止规则在适当阈值下，对所有域内点同时实现接近极小极大最优的点态速率（至多差对数因子）；而最小叶子数停止规则被证明无法实现空间自适应。

Conclusion: 这些结果确立了MID停止规则的精确统计作用，为CART在实践中的成功提供了理论基础。

Abstract: The popular CART algorithm for regression trees combines a greedy splitting rule with a stopping rule, but while the splitting rule has been well studied, the statistical role of stopping rules is less well understood. Meanwhile, although regression trees fit using Bayesian methods or via empirical risk minimization (ERM) have been shown to be spatially adaptive to local smoothness and anisotropy, it is unknown whether CART can achieve the same adaptation. We address these gaps by proving that, under spatially heterogeneous and anisotropic smoothness and appropriate structural assumptions on the regression function and covariate distribution, CART with the minimum impurity decrease (MID) stopping rule and a suitable threshold achieves pointwise rates that are minimax up to logarithmic factors. These rates hold simultaneously over all points in the domain. Moreover, we prove that spatial adaptation cannot be achieved under the widely used minimum leaf size stopping rule. Together, these results establish a precise statistical role for the MID stopping rule and provide a theoretical basis for the empirical success of CART.

</details>


### [480] [Inferential Evaluation of Surrogate-Derived Models under Covariate Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15783)
*Longtian Shi,Molei Liu,Doudou Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究三样本设置下的迁移学习模型评估问题：有一个小的金标来源、一个较大的代理标签来源和一个未标记的目标群体。在条件可迁移性假设下，利用源特定的密度比将信息从两个已标记来源传输到目标群体，提出交叉拟合估计器以及结合回归增强和核校正的方法，用于估计目标群体中代理模型的TPR、FPR、ROC曲线和AUC，并建立相应的渐近推断性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在迁移学习场景中，基于丰富代理标签训练的模型可能部署在无法观测金标结果的目�标群体中。评估模型在目标群体的性能对于判断基于模型的决策是否仍然可靠至关重要，但当金标稀缺且不同数据源间协变量分布存在差异时，评估十分困难。现有方法难以同时处理金标稀缺、代理标签丰富和分布漂移的复杂情况。

Method: 提出三样本框架：小规模金标来源、较大代理标签来源和未标记目标群体。在条件可迁移性假设下，通过源特定的密度比将两个已标记来源的信息传输到目标群体。采用交叉拟合估计器估计TPR和FPR，并将结果回归增强与核校正结合用于阈值附近模型的估计，同时考虑三个样本带来的不确定性。

Result: 建立了TPR和FPR的渐近线性推断、ROC曲线的一致性和逐点推断、以及AUC的渐近正态推断。仿真实验评估了偏差、覆盖率以及对带宽和相对样本量的敏感性。两个真实应用（Chatbot Arena的回顾性时间验证和半合成ACS-Income研究）验证了方法在真实AI应用中的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一套完整的统计推断框架，能够在金标标签稀缺、代理标签丰富且目标群体协变量分布不同的迁移学习场景下，对代理模型的性能进行可靠评估和推断，为AI模型在目标人群中的部署决策提供理论保障。

Abstract: In transfer-learning settings, a model derived from abundant surrogate labels may be deployed in a target population where gold-standard outcomes are unobserved. Evaluating its target performance is essential for determining whether decisions based on the model remain reliable, yet it is difficult when gold labels are scarce, and covariate distributions differ across data sources. We study a three-sample setting with a small gold-labeled source, a larger surrogate-labeled source, and an unlabeled target. Under conditional transportability, we evaluate the surrogate-derived model against the latent gold-standard outcome in the target population. We propose cross-fitted estimators that transport information from the two labeled sources through source-specific density ratios. We also combine outcome-regression augmentation with a kernel correction for estimating the model near a threshold, accounting for uncertainty from all three samples. We establish asymptotically linear inference for TPR and FPR, consistency and pointwise inference for the ROC curve, and asymptotically normal inference for AUC. Simulations assess bias, coverage, and sensitivity to bandwidth and relative sample sizes. A retrospective temporal validation on Chatbot Arena and a semi-synthetic ACS-Income study provide validation in real-world AI applications.

</details>


### [481] [Generalized Linear Bandits with Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15848)
*Heesang Ann,Hyunjun Choi,Taehyun Hwang,Younghoon Shin,Haeju Cheong,Min-hwan Oh*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究带记忆的广义线性bandit问题，通过改进先前线性模型的分析，将遗憾界从Õ(T^{3/4})提升到Õ(√T)量级，并提出基于收缩置信界的块式算法，在广义线性模型下实现了与曲率参数κ无关的前导遗憾项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的线性模型分析存在松散的上界（Õ(T^{3/4})），未能达到最优的√T遗憾率；同时，记忆效应带来的内源非平稳性与非线性链接函数的组合缺乏统一的理论处理。

Method: 首先对Clerici等人的线性模型分析进行精炼，恢复√T遗憾率；随后将该改进推广到广义线性模型，提出基于收缩置信界（shrunken confidence bounds）的块式（block-wise）算法，并给出包含特征维度d、记忆长度m和曲率参数κ的完整遗憾上界。

Result: 算法实现Õ(√(mT) + d√T + √κ d² m^{1/4} T^{1/4} + κd²)的遗憾界，在非线性奖励和记忆效应下仍达到√T类型的速率，且前导项与链接函数曲率κ无关；数值实验与理论结果一致。

Conclusion: 该工作为记忆诱导的非平稳性与非线性链接函数提供了统一的遗憾分析框架，首次确保前导遗憾项不依赖链接函数的曲率参数，代表了该方向理论分析的重要进展。

Abstract: We study generalized linear bandits with memory, an endogenous non-stationary setting in which rewards depend on past actions through a finite memory matrix. Building on prior work for linear models (Clerici et al., 2024), we show that the previously known $\tilde{O}(T^{3/4})$ regret bound stems from a loose analysis, and we provide a sharpened analysis that recovers a $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret rate in the linear case. We then extend this improvement to generalized linear models and propose a block-wise algorithm based on shrunken confidence bounds. Our algorithm achieves a regret bound of $\tilde{O}\left(\sqrt{mT} + d\sqrt{T} + \sqrtκ\, d^{2} m^{1/4} T^{1/4} + κd^{2} \right)$, where $d$ denotes the feature dimension, $m$ the memory length, and $κ$ a curvature parameter of the link function. This attains a $\sqrt{T}$-type rate despite nonlinear rewards and memory effects. To the best of our knowledge, this analysis provides a unified treatment of memory-induced non-stationarity and nonlinear link functions, while ensuring that the leading regret term is independent of the curvature of the link function. We conduct numerical experiments that are consistent with our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [482] [EMS Coreset: An Efficient Expectation-Maximization Algorithm for Sinkhorn Coreset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16101)
*Haoyun Yin,Chuanhui Liu,Xiao Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种可扩展的Sinkhorn Coreset方法，通过允许非均匀coreset权重实现熵正则化OT耦合的闭式更新，在保持近似质量的同时大幅降低计算复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于最优传输（OT）的coreset选择通常需要计算传输计划的密集开销，严重限制了其在大规模数据集上的可扩展性。现有方法在计算效率和近似质量之间难以兼顾。

Method: 引入一种可扩展的Sinkhorn coreset方法，通过放宽coreset权重为允许非均匀取值，使得熵正则化的OT耦合可以进行闭式更新。该方法生成的质心通过软分配推广了k-means。

Result: 在合成和真实世界基准上，该方法相比基于Wasserstein和标准Sinkhorn的coreset选择方法，在实现竞争性或更优的近似质量的同时，大幅缩短了运行时间，尤其在大规模场景下优势明显。此外还建立了所选度量的渐近一致性和对数据扰动的Lipschitz稳定性。

Conclusion: 该方法为大规模coreset选择提供了高效且理论上可保证的解决方案，兼具精度、鲁棒性和可扩展性。

Abstract: Coresets distill large datasets into small, representative subsets for efficient downstream learning. Yet Optimal Transport (OT)-based selection typically requires intensive computation of transport plans, limiting scalability. We introduce a scalable Sinkhorn coreset method that permits closed-form updates of the entropically regularized OT coupling by allowing non-uniform coreset weights. This produces centroids that generalize k-means via soft assignments. We establish asymptotic consistency of the selected measure and Lipschitz stability to data perturbations, providing accuracy and robustness guarantees. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, the proposed method achieves competitive or improved approximation quality while substantially reducing runtime compared to Wasserstein- and standard Sinkhorn-based coreset selection, especially at large scale.

</details>


### [483] [Coded Hankel Polynomial Chaos: Spectral Identification of Dominant Polynomial-Chaos Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16126)
*Zhiliang Deng,Xiaomei Yang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出编码Hankel多项式混沌（CH-PC）方法，将PCE系数通过有限生成变换转化为系数生成多项式，并沿几何相位轨道求值得到有限指数和，利用低秩Hankel矩阵和单位根相位标签恢复多项式多指标，实现主导多项式混沌模态的识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的主导多项式混沌模态识别通常被表述为在采样多元多项式字典上的稀疏回归问题，缺乏互补的谱分析方法。作者希望发展一种基于Hankel矩阵的谱方法，以利用指数和分解、低秩结构和相位编码等工具来处理PCE主导模态识别，同时将采样/求积误差和观测误差纳入统一的扰动框架。

Method: 将PCE系数通过有限生成变换转化为系数生成多项式；沿几何相位轨道求值产生有限指数和，其模型阶数和谱节点由低秩Hankel矩阵编码；通过坐标相位位移附加单位根标签，从而重构完整的多项式多指标。坐标位移探针组合为公共节点快照，独立相位编码在单谱编码病态时提供冗余表示。对有限观测，区分总体、有限数据和观测探针，将采样/求积误差与观测误差作为独立的Hankel扰动处理。对张量积候选集，生成核可分解为一维和，无需组装完整多元PCE设计矩阵即可求值。

Result: 在稀疏Legendre基准测试和随机Darcy问题上的数值实验表明：该方法能实现精确恢复、噪声稳定性、通过相位持久性实现未知阶数识别，以及对PDE生成量的主导模态恢复。

Conclusion: CH-PC提供了一种鲁棒且有效的谱方法用于PCE主导模态识别，将误差扰动分析与Hankel低秩结构相结合，并在张量积候选集上实现计算高效性。

Abstract: Identification of dominant polynomial-chaos modes is usually formulated as a sparse-regression problem on a sampled multivariate polynomial dictionary. We develop coded Hankel polynomial chaos (CH-PC), a complementary spectral formulation for dominant-mode identification. A finite generating transform converts PCE coefficients into a coefficient-generating polynomial, and evaluation along a geometric phase orbit produces a finite exponential sum. Its model order and spectral nodes are encoded by low-rank Hankel matrices, while coordinate phase shifts attach root-of-unity labels from which the full polynomial multi-indices are recovered. Coordinate-shifted probes are combined as common-node snapshots, and independent phase encodings provide redundant representations when a single spectral encoding is poorly conditioned. For finite observations, population, finite-data, and observed probes are kept distinct: sampling or quadrature error and observation error enter as separate Hankel perturbations, which are then connected to spectral stability, discrete decoding, and phase voting. For tensor-product candidate sets, the generating kernel factorizes into one-dimensional sums and can be evaluated without assembling the full multivariate PCE design matrix. Numerical experiments on sparse Legendre benchmarks and a stochastic Darcy problem illustrate exact recovery, noise stabilization, unknown-order identification by phase persistence, and dominant-mode recovery for a PDE-generated quantity of interest.

</details>


### [484] [LiD-GLM: Lipschitz-constrained Deep Generalized Linear Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16340)
*Tom Splittgerber,Niklas Koenen,Marvin N. Wright,Werner Brannath*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于可逆残差神经网络（i-ResNets）的半结构化混合模型方法，将广义线性模型与NN组件相结合，通过约束Lipschitz常数来精确控制模型对传统统计模型的偏离程度，在保持可解释性的同时允许学习非线性与交互效应，并开发了专用的解释技术与模型可识别性正交化方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统统计模型与神经网络融合的混合方法需要在可解释性与灵活性之间权衡：现有方法若强制结构约束会严重限制模型灵活性，若仅施加弱间接约束则会丧失有意义的可解释性。因此需要一种既能严格限制和量化NN组件对模型的影响，又不限制其非线性学习能力的方案。

Method: 利用可逆残差神经网络（i-ResNets）为广义线性模型赋予非线性参数估计和分布假设的灵活校正能力，同时保持建模分布在预测变量上的随机单调性。i-ResNet对应从恒等映射的可控偏离，通过约束其Lipschitz常数来严格限制和量化混合模型对传统模型的偏离程度。此外，开发了针对该模型的固有解释技术，并通过适应的后验正交化确保模型的可识别性。

Result: 该方法实现了用户可指定的灵活性与可解释性之间的折中，且不限制可学习的非线性与交互效应结构。通过Lipschitz约束可以严格界定混合模型与传统广义线性模型之间的偏差范围。

Conclusion: i-ResNet约束下的半结构化混合模型能够在保持有意义可解释性的同时获得NN的灵活性，为统计建模与深度学习之间的融合提供了一条新的可行路径。

Abstract: The combination of traditional statistical models and neural network (NN) components into semi-structured hybrid models is an intriguing approach to construct models that, ideally, combine traditional interpretability with the unprecedented flexibility of NNs. In order to preserve interpretability, it is usually necessary to restrict the NN components to prevent them from dominating the model. However, existing methods that enforce structural constraints on their NN components severely limit their models' flexibility; in contrast, methods that only enforce weak, indirect constraints lose meaningful interpretability. The method we propose therefore leverages invertible residual neural networks (i-ResNets) to equip generalized linear models with both nonlinear parameter estimation and a flexible correction of their distributional assumptions while always retaining stochastic monotonicity of the modeled distribution in the (formerly linear) predictor. The i-ResNets correspond to a controlled deviation from identity and by constraining their Lipschitz constant one can rigorously limit and quantify how far the hybrid model deviates from its traditional counterpart. This enables a user-specifiable compromise between flexibility and interpretability without limiting the structure of nonlinear and interaction effects that can be learned. Furthermore, we develop specific inherent interpretation techniques for our model and enforce model identifiability through an adapted post-hoc orthogonalization.

</details>


### [485] [Improved Regret Analysis for Parallel Gaussian Process Bandit Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16492)
*Shion Takeno,Shogo Iwazaki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究了并行高斯过程（GP）bandit优化中的遗憾分析，证明了无需初始不确定性采样阶段即可实现没有批量大小Q乘法因子的遗憾上界，并以GP批量汤普森采样（GP-BTS）为例进行了验证，同时在无噪声设置下展示了比有噪声设置更好的遗憾上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有并行GP bandit算法的遗憾上界（如GP批量UCB和GP-BTS）受到批量大小Q的乘法因子影响导致性能退化；虽然已有方法通过初始不确定性采样（US）阶段来解决这一问题，但该初始阶段在实际中往往效果不佳，因此需要寻找无需初始US阶段即可避免Q乘法因子的方法。

Method: 以GP-BTS为具体算法实例，在不引入初始不确定性采样阶段的前提下，重新分析并行GP bandit优化中的遗憾上界，证明可以消除与批量大小Q相关的乘法因子。同时分别考虑有噪声和无噪声两种设置下的遗憾分析。

Result: 理论证明了无需初始US阶段即可获得不包含批量大小Q乘法因子的遗憾上界；在无噪声设置下，得到的遗憾上界显著优于有噪声设置，这与顺序GP bandit设置中的结论一致。

Conclusion: 并行GP bandit优化可以在不牺牲批量效率的前提下避免因批量大小引起的遗憾退化，且无噪声场景下性能更优，为实际应用中避免低效的初始US阶段提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: This paper studies the regret analysis for parallel Gaussian process (GP) bandit optimization. The known regret upper bounds for the widely used GP batched upper confidence bound and GP batched Thompson sampling (GP-BTS) suffer from a multiplicative factor with respect to the batch size $Q$. To avoid this degradation, existing analyses require a polynomial number of uncertainty sampling (US) for $Q$ at the beginning of optimization. However, this initial US phase is often ineffective in practice. This paper shows that the regret upper bound without the multiplicative factor on $Q$ can be achieved without the initial US phase, using GP-BTS as an example. Furthermore, we show much better regret upper bounds in the noiseless setting than in the noisy setting, as in the sequential GP bandit setting.

</details>


### [486] [Density-Reweighted Entropic Optimal Transport: Decoupling Geometry from Sampling Density](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16506)
*Keyi Li,Yuval Kluger,Boris Landa*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出了一种密度重加权熵最优传输（EOT）框架，用于解决数据集对齐时采样密度差异导致几何对应关系失真的问题，并建立了理论收敛性保证与仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准熵最优传输（EOT）在数据集对齐时，当两个数据集从几何相似的流形结构上以显著不同的密度采样时，传输计划会倾向于按采样密度而非几何邻近性匹配点，从而产生几何上误导性的对应关系。

Method: 提出密度重加权EOT框架，通过一个可调参数控制采样密度对传输计划的影响程度，使框架可在标准EOT与纯几何驱动对齐之间连续调节；在适度正则条件下证明了重加权EOT计划收敛到一族总体水平（population-level）的计划，并显式给出其对采样密度的依赖关系。

Result: 通过仿真实验表明，所提方法能够在数据集存在显著采样密度差异时恢复几何上忠实的对应关系，优于相关的EOT框架。

Conclusion: 该密度重加权EOT框架有效缓解了采样密度不均对EOT对齐结果的几何误导，兼顾了计算可行性与几何保真度。

Abstract: Dataset alignment is a central step in data analysis across science and engineering, where the goal is to match observations between datasets. Entropic Optimal Transport (EOT) offers a computationally tractable framework for this task by encoding cross-dataset affinities in a transport plan. However, when two datasets are sampled from geometrically similar low-dimensional structures with substantially different sampling densities, the EOT plan may match points by relative sampling density rather than geometric proximity, yielding geometrically misleading correspondences. To address this issue, we propose a density-reweighted EOT framework in which the influence of sampling density on the transport plan can be discounted to a desired degree, ranging from standard EOT to alignment driven purely by underlying geometry. Under suitable regularity conditions, we establish convergence of the reweighted EOT plan to a family of population-level plans whose dependence on sampling density is made explicit. Through simulations, we show that our approach recovers geometrically faithful correspondences, improving over related EOT-based frameworks when datasets exhibit substantial sampling density disparity.

</details>


### [487] [Hide&Seek: Learning to Explain in an End-to-End Differentiable Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16689)
*Tal Ellinson,Hadi Mohasel Afshar,Sally Cripps*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出Hide&Seek，一种端到端可微分的实例级特征选择模型，通过将特征移除重构为可微分操作（用每个特征的比例替换替代离散移除），并结合稀疏度权重退火框架稳定训练，在无信息泄漏的前提下联合学习特征选择与预测，超越了现有最先进方法且训练速度快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实例级特征选择方法虽然能动态识别每个实例的重要特征，但面临信息泄漏和缺乏可微性等挑战，导致训练缓慢。这些pioneering方法（学习选择器+预测器）存在的这些问题限制了其性能和应用。

Method: Hide&Seek采用端到端可微的架构设计：将特征移除重新表述为可微分操作——不是离散地移除特征，而是替换每个特征的一部分比例；在单一目标下联合学习特征选择与预测，避免信息泄漏；通过parsimony-weight annealing框架进一步稳定训练过程。

Result: 在一系列实验中，Hide&Seek在性能上优于现有最先进的实例级特征选择模型，并且训练速度快。

Conclusion: Hide&Seek通过可微化的特征移除操作和稀疏度权重退火机制，有效解决了现有方法中信息泄漏和缺乏可微性的问题，在保持端到端训练效率的同时取得了更优的特征选择性能。

Abstract: Instance-wise feature selection is a valuable tool for interpreting labeled data and the predictions of black-box models. In contrast to global feature selection techniques, instance-wise methods dynamically identify important features for each instance. A growing number of methods learn a selector, which identifies important features, and a predictor, which uses these to make predictions. However, these pioneering methods face challenges including information leakage and lack of differentiability, which can slow training. In this paper, we present Hide&Seek, an end-to-end differentiable model for instance-wise feature selection. We jointly learn feature selection and prediction under a single objective without information leakage. Hide&Seek outperforms existing state-of-the-art models across a range of experiments and is fast to train. We achieve this by reformulating feature removal as a differentiable operation where instead of discretely removing features, we replace a proportion of each feature. Training is further stabilized via a parsimony-weight annealing framework.

</details>


### [488] [Non-Crossing Deep Quantile Regression for Distributional Survival Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16864)
*Shuai Huang,Zhe Qu,Zhaowei Hua,Guohao Shen,Rui Tang,Hongtu Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一个面向右删失数据的保序非交叉分位数（CNQ）框架，利用Kolmogorov-Arnold和Transformer骨干网络联合估计多个条件生存分位数，并保证排序有效性，同时建立联合有限样本超额风险界。在27种模拟设置和6个队列中优于现有方法，并在两个临床病例中揭示被单一风险比掩盖的时变协变量效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统生存分析中，风险函数和均值类摘要将协变量对事件风险的影响压缩为单一数值，掩盖了早期与晚期失败时间之间协变量效应的差异。分位数建模虽能刻画完整条件分布，但现有删失数据方法要么灵活性不足，要么产生逻辑上不一致的交叉分位数曲线。

Method: 提出Censored Non-crossing Quantile（CNQ）框架：联合估计多个条件生存分位数，通过构造保证分位数排序有效性（无交叉）；采用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络和Transformer作为骨干网络提供建模灵活性；建立了在所有拟合分位数水平上联合成立的有限样本超额风险界。

Result: 在27种模拟设置和6个队列中，当条件分布不对称时，CNQ框架的pinball损失低于分位数、风险和树基的竞争方法；在全部6个队列中区间覆盖率更接近名义水平。在METABRIC（乳腺癌）和FLCHAIN（人群死亡率）两个临床案例中，恢复了随生存分布变化的协变量效应（这类效应被单一风险比掩盖），并产生一致且可解释的个体化分位数里程碑。

Conclusion: CNQ框架能够在不牺牲排序一致性的前提下灵活建模右删失数据中的完整条件生存分布，揭示被传统摘要指标隐藏的时变协变量效应，在预测性能和临床可解释性上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: In survival analysis the way covariates act on the risk of an event often differs between early and late failure times, yet hazard- and mean-based summaries collapse this variation into a single number. Quantile-based modeling instead describes the full conditional distribution on the original time scale, but existing censored-data methods are either inflexible or produce logically inconsistent crossing quantile curves. We propose a Censored Non-crossing Quantile (CNQ) framework for right-censored data that jointly estimates several conditional survival quantiles and guarantees valid ordering by construction, with flexibility supplied by Kolmogorov-Arnold and Transformer backbones, and we establish a finite-sample excess-risk bound holding jointly across all fitted quantile levels. Across 27 simulation settings and six cohorts the framework attains lower pinball loss than quantile-, hazard- and tree-based competitors whenever the conditional distribution is asymmetric, with interval coverage closer to nominal on all six. In two clinical case studies (METABRIC, breast cancer; FLCHAIN, population mortality) it recovers covariate effects that vary across the survival distribution and would be hidden by a single hazard ratio, and yields coherent individualized quantile milestones. Code: https://github.com/BIG-S2/deepcnq

</details>


<div id='math.ST'></div>

# math.ST [[Back]](#toc)

### [489] [How Many Samples Are Needed to Determine Causal Direction? Sharp Minimax Bounds for Bivariate LiNGAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15840)
*Jikai Jin*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究了在线性双变量因果方向推断中，需要多少观测样本才能确定因果方向。作者证明了尖锐的局部极小极大样本复杂度定律，将样本需求刻画为结构系数强度、扰动非高斯性程度和尺度不确定性的联合函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典LiNGAM理论表明独立非高斯扰动可以识别因果方向，但未量化在因果效应弱或扰动接近高斯时识别的困难程度。已有理论仅建立了总体可识别性，或假设两个方向之间存在固定间隔，缺乏对样本复杂度的精细刻画。

Method: 设β为结构系数绝对值的下界，ν度量每个标准化扰动与高斯性的距离，扰动尺度在[σ̲,σ̄]范围内。作者证明了尖锐的局部极小极大定律N_2^*(β,ν,δ) ≍ log(1/δ)/(d_β²+β²ν²)，其中d_β=[β²-(1-σ̲²/σ̄²)]_+。

Result: 建立了样本复杂度作为边强度、高斯性距离和尺度不确定性的联合尖锐函数，刻画了识别来自非高斯依赖还是仅来自协方差的条件，并给出极小极大最优的样本下界与匹配的上界。

Conclusion: 这项工作将因果方向识别的理论从总体可识别性推进到有限样本的精确复杂度刻画，明确了非高斯性与协方差信息各自对识别难度的贡献，为实际应用中判断样本量是否充足提供了理论依据。

Abstract: We study how many observations are needed to determine the causal direction between two linearly related variables. Classical LiNGAM theory shows that independent non-Gaussian disturbances identify the direction, but does not quantify the difficulty when the causal effect is weak or the disturbances are nearly Gaussian. Let $β$ bound the absolute structural coefficient from below, let $ν$ measure each standardized disturbance's distance from Gaussianity, and let the disturbance scales lie in $[\underlineσ,\overlineσ]$. We prove the sharp local minimax law \[
  N_2^\star(β,ν,δ)
  \asymp
  \frac{\log(1/δ)}
  {d_β^2+β^2ν^2},
  \qquad
  d_β=
  \left[β^2-
  \left(1-\frac{\underlineσ^2}{\overlineσ^2}\right)\right]_+. \] Previous theory established population identifiability or assumed a fixed separation between the two directions. By contrast, we establish the sharp sample complexity as a joint function of edge strength, distance from Gaussianity, and scale uncertainty, and characterize when identification comes from non-Gaussian dependence or from covariance alone. The proof was independently generated with GPT-5.6 Sol in Codex's Ultra mode during a two-hour session. The human author supplied the prompt and was responsible only forchecking the proof and revising and polishing the manuscript.

</details>


### [490] [Asymptotic Normality and Convergence Rates for Tsallis Entropy Estimators via Stabilization Techniques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14553)
*Mehmet Sıddık Çadırcı,Martin Singull*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于最近邻的Tsallis熵估计量在一般度量测度空间上（对应于Poisson和二项点过程）的渐近正态性。通过基于灵活加一成本算子的稳定化技术结合二阶Poincaré不等式，建立了Kolmogorov距离下的渐近正态性及显式收敛速率，避免了显式得分函数分解。在自然稳定化和矩条件下，恢复经典速率s^{-1/2}和n^{-1/2}，并推广了Shannon和Rényi熵估计量的相关结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Tsallis熵作为Shannon和Rényi熵的推广，在复杂空间和高维统计推断中具有广泛应用，但其最近邻估计量的渐近正态性缺乏系统研究。现有方法依赖显式得分函数分解，处理高阶项时较为繁琐，难以适用于一般度量测度空间上的点过程。

Method: 采用基于灵活加一成本算子（flexible add-one cost operators）的稳定化技术，结合二阶Poincaré不等式，建立估计量的渐近正态性和Kolmogorov距离下的收敛速率。方法核心在于通过灵活局部化的加一成本处理高阶项，无需显式得分函数分解。

Result: 在自然稳定化和矩条件下，建立了Tsallis熵最近邻估计量的渐近正态性，并获得了Kolmogorov距离下的显式收敛速率，恢复经典的最小二乘速率s^{-1/2}和n^{-1/2}，同时推广了Shannon和Rényi熵估计量的已有结果。

Conclusion: 基于稳定化的正态近似方法为复杂空间和高维场景下的非参数统计推断提供了统一且有效的理论框架，未来可在更广泛的熵泛函和点过程类型中进一步拓展。

Abstract: We study nearest-neighbor-based estimators of Tsallis entropy associated with Poisson and binomial point processes on general metric measure spaces. Using stabilization techniques based on flexible add-one cost operators together with second-order Poincaré inequalities, we establish asymptotic normality and derive explicit convergence rates for the Kolmogorov distance. Our analysis avoids explicit score-function decompositions and instead relies on flexible localizations of add-one costs, which simplify the treatment of higher-order terms. Under natural stabilization and moment conditions, the resulting bounds recover the classical normal approximation rates \(s^{-1/2}\) and \(n^{-1/2}\) and extend corresponding results for Shannon and Rényi entropy estimators. We further illustrate the scope of the framework through examples involving Tsallis entropy functionals, weighted \(k\)-nearest-neighbor Shannon entropy estimators. The examples provided highlight the benefits of stabilization-based normal approximations for non-parametric statistical inference in complex spatial and high-dimensional settings.

</details>


### [491] [The Boltzmann structure of sampling: Intrinsic $p$-value and its emergent closed-form expression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14608)
*Orestis Loukas*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究观测数据被限制在有限可区分类别的情况，通过前向采样过程的组合构造定义一个内在离散的p-value。利用鞍点技术在连续极限下近似线性数据集族的概率质量，结合大N球形对称性，通过Laplace近似将p-value简化为$2N$乘以两个信息投影间的KL散度，最终用$\chi^2_k$分布高效计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实数据常受测量分辨率等限制，观测类别是有限可区分的，而理论域可能是无限的。需要一种直接从采样过程定义而非依赖额外概率结构的p-value，以正确处理离散化数据下的统计推断问题。

Method: (1) 在多项式万有类下，通过组合构造定义内在离散p-value；(2) 将d+k个函数样本均值固定的数据集族映射为线性多面体内的整数格点加权和；(3) 利用鞍点技巧推导连续极限下的密度近似；(4) 借助信息几何和球形对称性，在Laplace近似下将p-value计算化为$\chi^2_k$分布；(5) 最终统计量表达为$2N$乘以结构族与观测族信息投影间的KL散度。

Result: 推导出半解析的统计量$2N \cdot KL$，遵循$\chi^2_k$分布，信息投影可通过标准数值方法高效计算且收敛良好。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了在离散观测限制下无需额外概率结构即可定义和高效计算p-value的途径，适用于条件采样等多种场景，且在大N极限下具有明确的渐近分布。

Abstract: We consider observables $X$ whose realizations in a sampled dataset are restricted, for example by measurement resolution, to a finite set of distinguishable categories within their possibly infinite theoretical domain. Given the probabilities of observable categories, we study the coarse-grained probability mass of families of possible datasets generated through a forward sampling process. The combinatorial construction induces an intrinsically discrete $p$-value defined directly from the sampling process rather than through additional probabilistic structure on observables.
  Specifying the sample means of $d+k$ arbitrary functions $g_α(X)$ defines a linear family of datasets whose probability mass is obtained as a weighted sum over integer lattice points contained within the associated polyhedron. To overcome the intractable large-$N$ combinatorics, we derive via saddle-point techniques a density approximating these probability masses in the continuum limit of forward sampling within the multinomial universality class. As a demonstration, we consider conditional sampling, where $d$ structural means are fixed while $k$ means vary over admissible datasets. The information geometry emerging from the saddle-point density, together with the spherical symmetry arising at large $N$ from the intrinsic $p$-value construction, enables efficient computation of the $p$-value in the Laplace approximation via the $χ^2_k$ distribution. The resulting statistic is given by the semi-analytic expression $2N$ times the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the information projections associated with the corresponding structural and observed linear families. These projections can be computed efficiently via standard numerical routines converging for sufficiently well-behaved sample means.

</details>


### [492] [A Central Limit Theorem for Regularized M-Estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15034)
*Cosme Louart*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文证明了高维比例情形（p=O(n)）下，正则化经验风险最小化器的线性泛函满足定量中心极限定理。在数据列独立（不必同分布）、满足一致 Poincaré 不等式、且目标函数具有一致曲率与光滑性假设下，任意非退化统计量 sqrt(n)u^Tθ_hat 经中心化和标准化后以 Wasserstein 距离收敛到标准正态分布，收敛速度为 O((log n)^7 n^{-1/4})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维统计中经验风险最小化（ERM）估计量的分布刻画对统计推断至关重要，但比例维数情形下其线性泛函的中心极限定理缺乏量化误差界，现有结果多依赖强分布假设或缺乏显式收敛速度。

Method: 证明基于三部分技术工具：(1) 最小化器的矩与稳定性估计；(2) 二阶 leave-one-out 展开；(3) 对独立变量函数的摄动正态逼近论证。同时利用数据列一致 Poincaré 不等式和二次正则化结构。

Result: 获得了两个主要结果：(i) 任意非退化统计量 sqrt(n)u^Tθ_hat 经标准化后以 Wasserstein 距离 O((log n)^7 n^{-1/4}) 收敛到标准正态；(ii) 方差上界 Var(u^Tθ_hat) ≤ C||u||^2/n，确立了 sqrt(n) 的波动尺度。

Conclusion: 该结果在高维比例区间内为 ERM 估计量的线性泛函提供了带显式收敛速率的高斯近似，为高维统计推断提供了理论基础；同时方差上界确认了正确的波动尺度，具有实际推断意义。

Abstract: We prove a quantitative central limit theorem for linear functionals of regularized empirical-risk minimizers in the proportional-dimensional regime \(p=O(n)\). The data columns are independent, not necessarily identically distributed, and satisfy a uniform columnwise Poincaré inequality. Under uniform curvature and smoothness assumptions, and for a quadratic regularizer, we show that every nondegenerate statistic \(\sqrt n\,u^\top\hatθ\), centered by its expectation and normalized by its standard deviation, converges to a standard normal random variable in Wasserstein distance, with rate \(O((\log n)^7n^{-1/4})\). The proof is based on moment and stability bounds for the minimizer, a second-order leave-one-out expansion, and a perturbative normal-approximation argument for functions of independent variables. We also prove the variance upper bound \(\Var(u^\top\hatθ)\le C\norm{u}_2^2/n\), identifying the \(\sqrt n\) fluctuation scale.

</details>


### [493] [Multiplier Bootstrap and Edge Phase Transitions of High-Dimensional Covariance Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15053)
*Jiahui Xie*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究乘子自助法（multiplier bootstrap）在高维样本协方差矩阵最大特征值渐近分布分析中的作用，涵盖尖峰（spiked）与非尖峰（non-spiked）两种模型。研究发现乘子自助法在边界分布中建立了多种相变：非尖峰模型中无界乘子导致Frechet或Gumbel极限，有界乘子则呈现Tracy-Widom、Gaussian或Weibull极限的转变；尖峰模型在适当信号强度下有界和无界乘子均导致渐近正态分布。数值模拟验证了理论结果的准确性及谱推断方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维样本协方差矩阵的最大特征值在多元统计推断中具有核心地位，其渐近分布（如Tracy-Widom定律）已在经典文献中广泛研究。然而，如何在实际中可靠地进行谱推断（spectral inference）仍面临挑战。本文旨在探索乘子自助法这一通用重采样技术在高维协方差矩阵谱统计推断中的可行性与适应性，系统刻画其在尖峰与非尖峰模型下产生的不同渐近极限及相变现象。

Method: 本文采用理论分析与数值模拟相结合的方法。理论上，作者系统研究乘子自助法在高维样本协方差矩阵最大特征值上的渐近行为，分别考察非尖峰模型与尖峰模型，并区分有界与无界两类乘子函数，同时分析条件（conditional）与非条件（unconditional）两种自助协方差矩阵的极限分布。研究揭示了纵横比p/n、乘子上端点行为及总体协方差矩阵三者对极限分布类型的联合调控作用。数值模拟用于验证理论结果的准确性及所提谱推断程序的有效性。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）非尖峰模型中，无界乘子导致条件与非条件自助协方差矩阵最大特征值的Frechet或Gumbel极限；（2）有界乘子下，非条件模型在Tracy-Widom、Gaussian或Weibull极限之间发生相变，转变由纵横比p/n、乘子上端点行为和总体协方差矩阵共同决定；（3）条件模型展现出相应的Gaussian和Weibull区间，但非条件Tracy-Widom区间的条件对应退化为点质量；（4）尖峰模型中，在适当的信号强度条件下，有界与无界乘子的自助样本协方差矩阵前导特征值均渐近服从Gaussian分布。

Conclusion: 本文系统揭示了乘子自助法在高维协方差矩阵谱推断中的复杂渐近行为，阐明了该方法在不同模型设置、不同乘子类别下的极限分布相变机制。研究不仅澄清了乘子自助法在高维谱推断中的可行性与适用范围，还提供了有效的推断程序，为高维样本协方差矩阵的特征值统计推断提供了新的理论工具和实践指导。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the effects of employing multiplier bootstrap to analyze the asymptotic distributions of the largest eigenvalues of high-dimensional sample covariance matrices in both spiked and non-spiked models. Our findings demonstrate that the multiplier bootstrap establishes several phase transitions in the limiting edge distributions of both unconditional and conditional bootstrapped covariance matrices, provided the different classes of multipliers. In the nonspiked setting, unbounded multipliers lead to Frechet or Gumbel limits for the largest eigenvalue of the bootstrapped covariance matrix, both conditionally on the observed data and unconditionally. For bounded multipliers, the unconditional model exhibits transitions among Tracy-Widom, Gaussian, or Weibull limits, determined jointly by the aspect ratio p/n, the upper-endpoint behavior of the multipliers, and the population covariance matrix. The conditional model displays analogous Gaussian and Weibull regimes; in contrast, the conditional counterpart of the unconditional Tracy-Widom regime collapses to a point mass. In the spiked setting, under suitable signal-strength conditions, the leading eigenvalues of both the unconditional and conditional bootstrapped sample covariance matrices are asymptotically Gaussian for bounded as well as unbounded multipliers, under some mild assumptions. Our theoretical results also clarify the feasibility and adaptability of the multiplier bootstrap for spectral inference in high-dimensional sample covariance models. Numerical simulations confirm the accuracy of our results and the effectiveness of the proposed spectral inference procedures, which may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [494] [Forward-Evolution Error Analysis and Adaptive Design for Matrix-Valued Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15103)
*Tongyao Pang,Zuowei Shen,Ruitong Zhang*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究了方差保持（VP）扩散模型中矩阵值噪声调度下的反向时间采样问题，将反向时间离散误差转化为前向退化律的误差进行分析。针对两种数值方案（冻结分数方案与保持高斯漂移精确方案），分别推导出与数据维度d和度量熵维度k相关的KL精度步数复杂度（d/ε² 与 k log k/ε²），并提出局部误差驱动的矩阵调度方向准则与渐近最优的平方根自适应网格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型采样需要昂贵的离散时间步数且依赖噪声调度选择，已有理论大多只针对标量调度，缺乏对矩阵值调度和两种常见数值方案的统一分析框架。论文希望系统性地理解反向时间离散误差的传播机制，并据此给出更优的步数复杂度界限和调度/网格设计准则。

Method: 论文将反向时间离散化误差转移到前向退化机制中分析。第一种方案冻结分数（score），通过矩阵敏感的局部比较和前向信息耗散得到环境维度步数复杂度d/ε²。第二种方案保持已知高斯漂移项精确并冻结后验均值，对度量熵维度k的数据，利用前向Markov恒等式、各向异性覆盖估计和Stieltjes分布积分法得到k log k/ε²的复杂度。两种情形均通过鉴别局部误差、沿前向演化累积、插回统一KL分解完成证明。局部误差还用于推导矩阵调度的方向判据和渐近最优平方根自适应网格。

Result: 两种数值方案分别获得了以d/ε²和k log k/ε²为前导因子的KL精度步数复杂度；推导出矩阵调度的方向性判据；构造了渐近最优的平方根自适应时间网格。高维高斯混合实验验证了调度和网格改进的有效性。

Conclusion: 论文为矩阵值调度的扩散模型采样建立了统一的理论分析框架，明确了两种数值方案的复杂度差异（环境维度d vs. 度量熵维度k），并利用局部误差理论指导了调度方向与自适应网格设计，为高效扩散采样提供了新理论依据。

Abstract: Diffusion models learn to reverse a predefined corruption process, but sampling still requires a costly time discretization and depends on the chosen noise schedule. We study these two issues for variance-preserving diffusions with matrix-valued schedules. Our analysis transfers reverse-time discretization errors to the forward corruption law and treats two numerical schemes within a common framework. The first freezes the score and yields, through a matrix-sensitive local comparison and forward information dissipation, an ambient-dimensional step complexity with leading factor $d/\varepsilon^2$ for KL accuracy $\varepsilon^2$. The second keeps the known Gaussian drift exact and freezes the posterior mean. For data of metric-entropy dimension $k$, a forward Markov identity, an anisotropic covering estimate, and Stieltjes integration by parts give the corresponding factor $k\log k/\varepsilon^2$. In both cases, the proof identifies a local error, accumulates it through the forward evolution, and inserts the result into a common KL decomposition. The local errors further provide directional criteria for matrix schedules and an asymptotically optimal square-root adaptive grid. A high-dimensional Gaussian-mixture experiment illustrates the resulting schedule and grid improvements.

</details>


### [495] [Bootstrap Error Estimation and Sketch-Size Selection for Sketched Ridge Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15478)
*Akito Narahara,Takayuki Kawashima,Takafumi Kanamori*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文提出将配对行自助法从随机化最小二乘扩展到岭回归，利用压缩数据估计系数误差，建立了渐近线性表示和高斯极限，证明了自助法误差分布的一致一致性以及渐近精确覆盖率，并通过实验验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模岭回归问题中，随机化sketching技术虽能降低计算成本，但系数误差依赖于具体的sketch实现。现有的误差估计方法未能充分利用压缩数据，因此需要一种能够仅基于压缩数据估计系数误差的高效方法。

Method: 将配对行自助法从随机化最小二乘推广到岭回归，在固定系数维度、数据量和sketch尺寸递增的条件下，推导sketched估计量和条件自助法分布的渐近线性表示与高斯极限。推导了独立、均值零、方差一元素的sketch的显式协方差公式，提出快速线性化自助法、用于有限自助法重复的序统计量修正，以及用于从固定sketch尺寸集合中选取的Bonferroni规则。

Result: Rademacher条目在Loewner序下最小化前导协方差矩阵；在真实和合成数据集实验中，sketch尺寸为系数数的15倍、199次自助法重复、名义覆盖率95%时，带重拟合的自助法覆盖率介于92.0%到95.3%之间，经序统计量修正后覆盖率提升至94.7%到97.7%。

Conclusion: 该研究建立了基于压缩数据的岭回归引导法误差估计的理论基础，证明了其渐近有效性，并提供了实用的计算加速和修正策略，使随机化sketching方法在大规模岭回归中既高效又可靠。

Abstract: Randomized sketching reduces the computational cost of large ridge-regression problems, but the coefficient error depends on the realized sketch. We extend the paired-row bootstrap from randomized least squares to ridge regression, enabling coefficient-error estimation using only compressed data. Under a fixed coefficient dimension and increasing data and sketch sizes, we derive asymptotic linear representations and Gaussian limits for the sketched estimator and the conditional bootstrap distribution. These results establish uniform consistency of the bootstrap error distribution and asymptotically exact coverage when the estimator and error bound are computed from the same sketch. For sketches with independent, mean-zero, variance-one entries, an explicit covariance formula separates the effects of the residual, regularization, and fourth moment of the sketch entries, and shows that Rademacher entries minimize the leading covariance matrix in the Loewner order. We also develop a fast linearized bootstrap, an order-statistic correction for finitely many bootstrap replicates, and a Bonferroni rule for selecting from a fixed set of sketch sizes. Experiments on two real and two synthetic data sets support the proposed methods. With a sketch size 15 times the number of coefficients, 199 bootstrap replicates, and nominal coverage of 95\%, the bootstrap with refitting attains coverage between 92.0\% and 95.3\%; after the order-statistic correction, coverage ranges from 94.7\% to 97.7\%.

</details>


### [496] [On the minimax-rate optimality of approximate Bayesian computation in nonparametric problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15648)
*Hien Duy Nguyen*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文证明了近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）在非参数设定下可以达到极小极大速率最优，并给出了基于汇总统计筛选与局部先验质量条件的通用收缩定理，适用于高斯序列估计和密度估计等场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯计算依赖似然函数的解析评估，而ABC通过模拟与数据比对来替代似然，避免了似然计算的困难。然而ABC在非参数问题中的理论性质，特别是其收缩速率是否达到极小极大最优，此前缺乏严格的保证。

Method: 提出一个基于汇总统计筛选（summary statistics sieves）和局部先验质量条件（localized prior-mass condition）的通用ABC后验收缩定理；将该定理应用于Sobolev椭球上的高斯序列估计和有界Sobolev型类的密度估计；在模型特定条件下构造ABC过程，使得理想后验和后验均值达到相应极小极大速率；分析传统蒙特卡洛拒绝ABC算法的收敛性质，证明当事先给出的模拟提案数量以有效维度的充分大指数速率增长时，该算法继承相同的速率。

Result: ABC在非参数设定下可达到极小极大速率最优。具体地，在高斯序列估计（Sobolev椭球）和密度估计（有界Sobolev型类）两类问题中，构造的ABC过程的理想后验及后验均值均达到对应极小极大速率；蒙特卡洛拒绝ABC算法在提案数量以足够大的指数速率增长时也继承相同速率。

Conclusion: ABC不仅在计算上有替代似然的便利性，在理论上也具备非参数最优性保障，其收缩速率能够达到与参数设定下传统贝叶斯方法相当的极小极大最优水平。

Abstract: Approximate Bayesian computation (ABC) replaces likelihood evaluation in conventional Bayesian computation by simulation and comparison of observed and synthetic data. We demonstrate that ABC can be minimax-rate optimal in nonparametric settings. Our main result is a general contraction theorem for ABC posteriors based on summary statistics sieves and a localized prior-mass condition. We apply this theorem to Gaussian sequence estimation over Sobolev ellipsoids and to density estimation over bounded Sobolev-type classes and, under model-specific conditions, construct ABC procedures whose ideal posteriors and posterior means attain the corresponding minimax rates. Conditional on sampling from the specified priors, we show that the conventional Monte Carlo rejection ABC algorithm inherits the same rates when the number of simulation proposals grows at a sufficiently large exponential rate in the effective dimension.

</details>


### [497] [The Dual-Population Benchmark Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15769)
*Alexander Gnedin*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文基于Fisher和Hill的排序与枢轴量思想，引入平面泊松过程（PPP）模型，其中负分量在选择算子作用下提供过去基准，将正分量的未来点划分为有序类别，从而将顺序作为交换结构的重要特征融入贝叶斯非参数推断工具箱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者旨在解决组合结构与贝叶斯分布自由推断中"顺序"这一特征被忽视的问题。现有理论多关注分量大小（size）的描述，而对分量之间的顺序关系缺乏系统性框架。此外，非线性CRP中分量被视作不可区分（即非交换性）的观点存在争议，作者希望从时间采样顺序的角度调和这一矛盾。

Method: 论文引入平面泊松过程（PPP）模型，利用负分量与选择算子C生成一组过去基准（benchmarks），这些基准作为有序paintbox中的分隔符，将正分量的未来点划分为排序类别。基准同时充当选择算子建立的历史标准。特别地，提出的指数赛跑（exponential race）基准生成机制等价于将非齐次顺序统计量的间隔进行分裂。作者从方法论上论证顺序是交换结构的重要特征，并主张由潜在强度参数诱导的顺序本质上是"内在地"从远古时间的采样顺序中继承而来的，从而解耦的顺序可共存于群体对偶框架中，不影响分量的大小偏倚和样本内的完全交换性。

Result: 论文表明PPP的齐次性结构可吸收许多现有组合结构，丰富贝叶斯分布自由推断的工具箱。该方法论证了非线性CRP中被视为不可区分（即非交换性）的分量实际上并不破坏交换性，可由有序结构的到达顺序范式加以调和。

Conclusion: 顺序应与分量大小并列，作为交换结构的重要特征。PPP框架为在贝叶斯推断中引入顺序维度提供了自然且灵活的建模工具，同时澄清了交换性与顺序排序之间的兼容性。

Abstract: Motivated by Fisher's and Hill's \cite{Fisher,Hill} ideas of ranking and pivotal quantities, we introduce a planar Poisson process (PPP) model in which the negative component \(Π_-\), acted upon by a choice operator {\rm C}, supplies a set of past benchmarks that divide the future points of the positive component \(Π_+\) into ranked categories. The benchmarks act as separators in an ordered paintbox while simultaneously acquiring the dual role of past standards established by the choice operator. The exceptional homogeneity properties of the PPP offer an infinitude of possibilities which absorb many existing combinatorial structures and enrich the toolbox of Bayesian distribution-free inference. A particular benchmark generating mechanism considered here (the exponential race) amounts to the device of splitting into spacings of nonhomogeneous order statistics.
  On the methodological side, the paper aims to highlight the role of order as important characteristic of an exchangeable structure, complementary to the description in terms of the components size. Moreover, we advocate the viewpoint that the order induced by a latent strength parameter is {\it intrinsically} inherited from the distant-past temporal sampling order, hence the decoupled orders may coexist within the framework of population duality without disturbing size-biasedness of components and the full exchangeability within the sample. This implies that the indistinguishability of components in the nonlinear CRP, sometimes regarded as nonexchangeability, does not in fact destroy exchangeability and should be reconciled with the arrival ordering within the paradigm of ordered structures.

</details>


### [498] [Gaussianization-Based Parameter Estimation for Gamma-Gamma and Lognormal-Rician Turbulence Channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15990)
*Maoke Miao,Bo Liu,Xinyu Zhang,Xiao-Yu Chen*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文针对Gamma-Gamma (GG) 和 Lognormal-Rician (LR) 大气湍流信道中因概率密度函数涉及特殊函数和数值积分而难以精确估计参数的问题，提出了两种高斯化参数估计器——分位数变换（QT）估计器和Box-Cox估计器，并结合基于扩展Rytov理论的物理信息正则化器提升参数可辨识性。仿真表明在特定湍流场景下性能优于现有方法至少三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大气湍流信道（GG和LR模型）的参数估计因概率密度函数包含特殊函数和数值积分而极具挑战性，现有估计方法精度不足，亟需提出更高效、更鲁棒的参数估计方案。

Method: 提出两种高斯化参数估计器：(1) QT估计器采用双向交叉变换并结合高阶统计量匹配；(2) Box-Cox估计器通过引入变换雅可比构造近似似然函数。此外，利用扩展Rytov理论建立Rytov方差到GG形状参数的映射关系，设计物理信息正则化器以提升参数可辨识性。渐近分析揭示弱至中等湍流下偏度是偏离高斯性的主要来源，并给出了Box-Cox功率参数的渐近表达式。

Result: 仿真结果验证了两种估计器在无噪声和有噪声条件下均具有鲁棒性能；在特定湍流场景下，引入物理信息正则化可将参数估计性能较迭代矩估计器和矩匹配/凸优化估计器提升至少三个数量级。

Conclusion: 本文提出的高斯化参数估计框架结合物理信息正则化，为大气湍流信道参数估计提供了高精度、高鲁棒性的解决方案，显著优于现有迭代矩方法和凸优化方法。

Abstract: Accurate parameter estimation for atmospheric turbulence channels is challenging because the probability density functions of the Gamma-Gamma (GG) and Lognormal-Rician (LR) models involve special functions and numerical integrations. This paper proposes two Gaussianization parameter estimators for GG and LR turbulence channels, i.e., the quantile-transformation (QT) estimator and the Box-Cox estimator. The QT estimator employs bidirectional cross-transformation together with higher-order statistical matching, whereas the Box-Cox estimator constructs an approximate likelihood by incorporating the transformation Jacobian. Asymptotic analysis identifies skewness as the leading-order deviation from Gaussianity under weak-to-moderate turbulence and yields asymptotic expressions for the Box-Cox power parameters. In addition, a physics-informed regularizer based on the extended Rytov-theory mapping from the Rytov variance to the GG shape parameters is introduced to improve parameter identifiability. Simulation results demonstrate that both estimators provide robust performance under noiseless and noisy conditions, while the physics-informed regularization term can improve the parameter estimation performance by at least three orders of magnitude compared with the iterative moment-based estimator and the method-of-moments/convex-optimization estimator in specific turbulence scenarios.

</details>


### [499] [The Bethe-Hessian down to the Percolation Threshold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16672)
*Dingding Dong,Theo McKenzie*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文证明了在随机块模型（SBM）中，当期望度d>1时，Bethe-Hessian矩阵的负特征值数量恰好等于植入模型在谱带外特征值所预测的数量，将Stephan和Zhu在d≥2条件下的结果推广到最优的d>1条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Bethe-Hessian矩阵的负谱被认为编码了稀疏随机块模型的信息结构，但此前仅知道当d≥2时该结论成立。作者希望将条件放宽到d>1这一最优临界值，以匹配基于更大非Hermitian矩阵的现有谱方法的适用区间。

Method: 两个核心思想：(1) 在2-core上构造测试向量，此处度波动显著更小，然后通过控制二次型将向量扩展到整个图；(2) 使用底层马尔可夫随机场的各向同性基构造测试向量，系数根据每个相关的植入特征值自适应选取，从而在稀疏区间内控制测试向量的波动。

Result: 证明了在期望度d>1的随机块模型中，Bethe-Hessian负特征值的数量恰好等于由植入模型谱带外特征值预测的数量，且d>1这一条件是最优的。

Conclusion: 该结果将Stephan和Zhu的定理从d≥2推广到最优的d>1，填补了稀疏随机块模型谱理论中的一个关键区间，与基于非Hermitian矩阵的谱方法适用条件保持一致。

Abstract: The Bethe-Hessian is a symmetric matrix for which the negative spectrum has been observed to encode the informative structure of sparse stochastic block models. We prove that, in the stochastic block model where all vertices have expected degree $d>1$, the number of negative eigenvalues of the Bethe-Hessian is exactly the number predicted by the eigenvalues of the planted model lying outside the bulk spectrum. The condition $d>1$ is optimal, and matches a regime in which existing spectral approaches based on larger non-Hermitian matrices apply. Our result extends a theorem of Stephan and Zhu, who established the same conclusion under the assumption $d\geq 2$.
  Our improvement relies on two main ideas. First, we construct test vectors on the $2$-core, where degree fluctuations are substantially smaller, and then extend them to the entire graph while controlling the quadratic form. Second, we construct the test vectors using an isotropic basis of the underlying Markov random field, with coefficients adapted to each relevant planted eigenvalue. This allows us to control the fluctuations of the test vectors throughout the sparse regime.

</details>


### [500] [On Finite Gaussian Mixtures: Finiteness of the Number of Modes and an Application to NPMLE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16675)
*Haiyang Wang*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文证明所有有限分量的各向同性高斯混合模型具有有限多个模态。在一维情形下，经典Chebyshev系统理论给出了紧致上界；但多维情形此前长期未解决。作者结合实解析曲线选择定理与Ax函数超越定理，证明了更强的结论——整个临界集是有限基数。作为应用，证明了基于有限数据集的Gauss位置混合NPMLE是有限支撑的，且所有NPMLE共享相同的允许原子位置有限集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维高斯混合模型的模态数量问题长期悬而未决。一维情形可由Chebyshev系统经典理论给出至多n个模态的紧致上界，但多维情形是否每个有限分量混合都具有有限模态一直是开放问题。

Method: 将问题转化为研究高斯混合密度函数的临界集（梯度零点）的有限性。关键方法包括：(1) 实解析曲线选择定理（real analytic curve selection theorem）来分析临界集的解析结构；(2) Ax函数超越定理（Ax's functional-transcendence theorem）处理涉及的超越函数关系。

Result: 证明了任意有限分量各向同性高斯混合的整个临界集具有有限基数（更强的结论），从而推出模态数量有限。作为应用，证明了基于有限数据集的高斯位置混合NPMLE必定是有限支撑的，且所有NPMLE共享同一有限集合作为允许的原子位置。

Conclusion: 本文解决了多维高斯混合模态有限性的长期开放问题，不仅获得了模态数量的有限性，还得到了整个临界集有限性的更强结果；并将此理论结果应用于非参数最大似然估计的结构刻画，表明有限数据的NPMLE必然具有有限支撑。

Abstract: We prove that every isotropic Gaussian mixture with finitely many components has finitely many modes. In one dimension, classical theory of Chebyshev systems gives the sharp bound of at most $n$ modes for an $n$-component mixture. In several dimensions, however, it has remained open whether every such mixture has finitely many modes. Our main result is the stronger statement that the entire critical set has finite cardinality, which is proven by combining real analytic curve selection theorem and Ax's functional-transcendence theorem.
  As an application, we show that, for Gaussian location mixtures, every nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) based on a finite dataset is finitely supported. More specifically, all NPMLEs share the same finite set of allowable atom locations.

</details>


### [501] [Empirical Bayes linear regression in high dimensions: Method of moments and sub-linear sample complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16771)
*Zhou Fan,Yandi Shen,Haoyu Wang,Yihong Wu*

Main category: math.ST

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于高维线性回归中经验贝叶斯先验估计的计算高效方法EBMoM（Empirical Bayes Method of Moments），通过递归估计先验矩实现非参数先验恢复，在最坏情况下仅需n≥p^{1-o(1)}（次线性）的样本量，并匹配信息论下界，显著优于现有似然方法所需的线性样本量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高维线性回归中，回归系数从未知的次高斯先验中独立抽取，但设计矩阵将潜在系数耦合在一起，使得恢复先验需要同时从噪声和系数自身的副本中进行反卷积。与序列模型不同，这一问题更具挑战性。现有基于似然的方法需要线性样本量n=Ω(p)才能保证一致性，作者希望探索是否可以用更少的样本实现先验估计。

Method: 提出EBMoM（Empirical Bayes Method of Moments），通过一个下三角估计方程组递归估计先验矩。该方法适用于一般设计矩阵，计算复杂度为O(np^2)。在温和的设计条件下（包括一类广泛的相关随机设计），该方法能够一致地估计不断增长的矩数量，从而恢复整个先验分布。

Result: 在温和设计条件下，EBMoM在n≥p^{1-o(1)}时能够一致估计先验矩和先验本身。作者还给出了适用于广泛设计类的匹配信息论下界，证明这一次线性样本复杂度对于非参数先验估计是最优的。这相较于现有似然方法所需的线性样本量n=Ω(p)有显著改进。

Conclusion: 研究表明，在高维线性回归中，非参数经验贝叶斯先验估计可以实现次线性样本复杂度，且这一复杂度在信息论意义下是最优的。EBMoM提供了一种计算高效且统计最优的解决方案，解决了现有似然方法对线性样本量的依赖问题。

Abstract: We study empirical Bayes estimation of the prior in high-dimensional linear regression $\mathbf{y}=\mathbf{X}\mathbfβ+\mathbf{\varepsilon}$, where the regression coefficients are drawn independently from an unknown sub-Gaussian prior. In contrast to the sequence model, the design matrix couples the latent coefficients, so that recovering the prior requires deconvolving it from both the noise and copies of itself. We introduce the \emph{Empirical Bayes Method of Moments} (EBMoM), a computationally efficient procedure for general designs that recursively estimates the prior moments through a lower-triangular system of estimating equations and runs in time $O(np^2)$.
  Under mild design conditions, satisfied in particular by a broad class of correlated random designs, we show that EBMoM consistently estimates a growing number of moments and hence the prior itself, provided that $n\geq p^{1-o(1)}$. A matching information-theoretic lower bound, valid for a broad class of designs, shows that this sub-linear sample complexity is optimal for nonparametric prior estimation. This improves on existing results for likelihood-based methods whose consistency requires a linear sample size $n=Ω(p)$.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [502] [RouteTS: Frequency-Time Routing for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14682)
*Gaofeng Lin,Lei Duan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RouteTS提出了一种基于数据自适应计算域选择的统一时间序列预测框架，通过振幅路由将频谱分区：主频分量交由频域复数线性预测器处理以保持周期性结构，残差频谱能量还原至时域由轻量MLP建模局部变化，兼顾全局周期性与局部瞬变的预测精度和计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界时间序列天然交织着全局周期结构与局部非平稳变化，而现有方法在单一计算域中处理这些异质动态存在根本性局限：时域模型在长水平预测中面临周期错位问题，频域模型则会过度平滑瞬态尖峰。作者认为最优计算域不是模型的属性，而是数据的属性，因此需要一种能根据数据频谱特征自适应的框架。

Method: RouteTS通过振幅路由机制划分频率谱：将主导频率分量交给频域中的复值线性预测器以保留周期结构，将剩余频谱能量还原到时域，由轻量级MLP建模局部变化。该框架实现了计算域与数据分量特征的数学最优匹配。

Result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，RouteTS在预测精度上具有竞争力，其路由决策由底层频谱特征引导。此外，轻量级设计使RouteTS在计算效率上具有显著优势。

Conclusion: RouteTS为全局周期性与局部瞬变之间的长期困境提供了原则性解决方案，证明了计算域应随数据频谱特性而自适应选择，而非固定于单一域。

Abstract: Real-world time series inherently intertwine global periodic structures with localized non-stationary variations. Existing approaches process these heterogeneous dynamics within a single computational domain, incurring fundamental limitations: time-domain models suffer from periodic misalignment over long horizons, while frequency-domain models over-smooth transient spikes. We argue that the optimal computational domain is not a property of the model, but of the data itself. Based on this principle, we propose RouteTS, a unified forecasting framework that partitions the frequency spectrum via amplitude routing and delegates components to their mathematically optimal domains. Dominant frequencies are processed by a complex-valued linear predictor in the frequency domain to preserve periodic structure, while residual spectral energy is reverted to the time domain and modeled by a lightweight MLP for local variations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouteTS achieves competitive prediction accuracy across diverse real-world datasets, with routing decisions guided by the underlying spectral signature. Furthermore, the lightweight design of RouteTS provides significant computational efficiency advantages, offering a principled solution to the longstanding dilemma between global periodicity and local transience.

</details>


### [503] [Rethinking Reverse KL as Adaptive Entropy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14685)
*Shizhen Li,Zhiyu Shen,Yuyin Lu,Yunhe Pang,Jielin Song,Yanghui Rao,Fu Lee Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了在线策略RKL蒸馏，将其目标分解为教师拟合项和学生熵项，提出自适应熵蒸馏（AED），利用教师熵动态校准token级模仿强度，在指令遵循和数学推理基准上取得更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏目标在平衡忠实模仿和鲁棒生成之间存在困难，主流方法盲目组合FKL和RKL，忽视了RKL本身已提供调节学生模仿强度的机制。

Method: 将on-policy RKL蒸馏目标分解为教师拟合项和学生熵项；理论上证明token级最优学生分布是教师分布的温控变体，用自适应权重控制模式寻求与不确定性保留的权衡；提出AED方法，利用教师熵动态校准token级模仿强度。

Result: 在指令遵循和数学推理基准上，AED实现了更优的整体性能，并普遍改善了师生分布对齐和熵对齐。

Conclusion: RKL自身即可提供模仿强度调节机制，无需显式引入FKL分支；基于教师熵的自适应校准能有效平衡忠实模仿与鲁棒生成。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is widely used to transfer the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to smaller students, but existing objectives often struggle to balance faithful imitation and robust generation. In particular, existing methods mainly combine FKL and RKL, overlooking that RKL itself provides a mechanism for adjusting the student's imitation strength. Motivated by this, we revisit on-policy Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) distillation and decompose its objective into a teacher-fitting term and a student-entropy term, without introducing an explicit FKL branch. We show theoretically that the token-level optimal student distribution corresponds to a tempered variant of the teacher distribution, where the adaptive weight controls the trade-off between mode-seeking and uncertainty preservation. Guided by this insight, we propose \textbf{Adaptive Entropy Distillation (AED)}, which uses the teacher's entropy to dynamically calibrate token-level imitation strength. Experiments on instruction-following and mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that AED achieves superior overall performance and generally improves teacher--student distributional and entropy alignment.

</details>


### [504] [Generative Learning of Separatrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14743)
*Ellis R. Crabtree,Dimitris G. Giovanis,Anastasia Georgiou,George Datseris,Ioannis G. Kevrekidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合监督分类与生成建模的框架，用于重建多稳定、高维动力系统中吸引盆边界（分界流形）。该方法首先用分类器对均匀/随机采样的初始条件进行盆地标签分类，利用分类器的不确定性指标识别高不确定区域作为初步近似分界线，然后训练基于分数的生成模型对高不确定区域的样本进行稠密采样，从而重建与经验密度一致的分界流形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多稳定动力系统中吸引盆边界的识别与重建是计算动力学中的基础挑战。这些边界控制着转变路径和大时间尺度行为，但传统直接模拟很少访问其邻域导致欠采样；传统计算方法在高维系统中面临计算限制且需要系统的先验知识；而简单采样方法（如随机或均匀采样）无法定量逼近分界线及其结构。因此需要一种无需先验方程、可扩展至高维系统的数据驱动重建方法。

Method: 该框架包含两个阶段：(1) 判别阶段：在均匀/随机采样的初始条件上训练神经网络分类器，以盆地归属为标签，利用分类器的不确定性度量（如预测熵）识别高不确定区域，将其视为初步近似分界线；(2) 生成阶段：专门在高不确定区域上训练基于分数的生成模型，生成与该区域样本的经验密度一致的稠密样本，从而重建分界流形。整个过程是迭代式的、数据驱动的，结合判别模型（全局相空间划分）与生成模型（局部几何细节采样）的互补优势。

Result: 该框架能够系统性地重建多稳定动力系统中的（近似）分界流形，生成的样本密度与分界流形附近或之上的经验密度一致，在两个阶段分别利用分类器不确定性定位高不确定边界区域和生成模型实现稠密几何采样，克服了传统方法在高维系统中的计算瓶颈。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了判别式分类与生成式建模的协同效应：判别模型提供全局相空间的粗划分能力，生成模型提供局部流形的精细采样能力，二者结合构成一种系统、迭代、无需方程先验知识的数据驱动框架，能够有效重建高维多稳定系统中的分界流形。

Abstract: The identification and reconstruction of the boundaries separating basins of attraction in multistable, multidimensional dynamical systems presents a fundamental challenge in computational dynamics. These structures govern transition pathways and other important large timescale behavior, yet they remain typically under-sampled since their neighborhood does not get routinely visited during direct simulations. Traditional computational approaches face computational limitations in high-dimensional systems and require a priori knowledge of the dynamical system and its equations. Simplistic sampling methods such as random or uniform sampling of the phase space typically fail to quantitatively approximate separatrices and their structure altogether.
  We introduce and implement a framework that combines supervised classification with generative modeling to address this challenge. Our approach first trains neural network classifiers on uniformly or randomly sampled initial conditions labeled by their corresponding basins of attraction in the system of interest. Using uncertainty metrics of the trained classifier to quantify decision boundaries, the method then identifies these high uncertainty regions and boundaries of the classifier as preliminary approximate separatrices. Subsequently, score-based generative models are trained specifically on samples from high-uncertainty regions, ultimately generating densities of samples consistent with the empirical density of samples on or close to the manifold that constitutes the separatrix between basins in the sampled region. This approach leverages the complementary strengths of (a) discriminative models for global phase space partitioning and (b) generative models for detailed geometric sampling, resulting in a systematic, iterative, data-driven framework that produces empirically consistent reconstructions of (approximate) separatrix manifolds.

</details>


### [505] [PathFinder: Joint Decompositions of Linked Multimodal Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14951)
*Ying-Qiu Zheng,Alex Fung,Stephen M Smith,Rogier B Mars,Saad Jbabdi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PathFinder，一种新型联合矩阵分解方法，允许对不必共享相同维度的多模态数据集进行协同分析，通过矩阵对间的维度共享路径实现全局联合分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的联合低秩矩阵分解方法要求所有多模态数据共享一个或多个维度，这限制了它们在数据集不完全对齐（如不同物种、不同尺度或不同模态）场景中的应用。需要一种更灵活的方法来处理维度不完全共享的多模态数据。

Method: PathFinder的核心思想是：只要矩阵对或子组之间存在共享维度，并且有路径将这些数据矩阵连接起来，就可以寻求全局联合分解。它通过构建数据矩阵之间的连接路径，将对间共享维度扩展为全局共享结构，从而实现对多个不完全对齐数据集的联合估计。

Result: PathFinder是许多矩阵分解方法的泛化框架，许多现有矩阵分解方法可以视为其特例。它可以用于发现不同数据集间的共同模式，并为缺失数据或模态进行预测。

Conclusion: PathFinder为多模态数据协同分析提供了一种通用框架，放松了传统联合矩阵分解对维度一致性的严格要求，扩展了联合低秩分解的适用范围，使其能够处理跨物种、跨尺度等更广泛的真实数据场景。

Abstract: Low-rank matrix decompositions can uncover patterns and structure in data and have a number of different applications across many disciplines. Extensions to "joint" low-rank decompositions have been proposed to link datasets from different modalities. While these methods enable the discovery of common patterns across modalities, they require that all the multimodal data share one or more dimensions. We propose a new analysis method, PathFinder, that enables co-analysis of datasets that do not necessarily all share a dimension. The key insight is that as long as pairs or subgroups of matrices do share some dimension, and that there are one or more paths that link across the data matrices, a global joint decomposition can be sought out. This enables the joint estimation of common patterns across different modalities, species, or scales, where a one-to-one mapping across all data along some dimension is not necessarily available. We show that PathFinder is a general umbrella under which many matrix decomposition methods fall as special cases. It can be used to discover common patterns across disparate datasets and to make predictions for missing data or modalities.

</details>


### [506] [Do Geometry-Aware Positional Encodings Help Transformers in Spatial Imperfect-Information Games?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14982)
*Wenji Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在空间不完美信息博弈中，几何感知的位置编码（HexRoPE）能否提升模型对地图几何的表征与隐藏实体追踪能力。结果表明HexRoPE显著改善了信念估计（后验交叉熵降低0.278–0.329）和数据效率（1k局策略准确率提升4.63个百分点），但未提升实际对战胜率（-1.56个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer应用于空间不完美信息博弈时，必须同时表征地图几何并随时间追踪隐藏实体，但现有研究中针对此类环境的位置编码设计尚未被系统验证。作者希望回答"几何感知的位置编码能否提升模型在这两方面的能力"，而非提出新编码。

Method: 构建了四级基准测试：1）受控几何与拓扑探测；2）六边形海上追捕游戏中的精确贝叶斯隐藏目标追踪任务；3）1k与10k局离线策略模仿；4）7,200局固定种子对抗三个遗留对手的闭环测试。在匹配的Transformer主干上对比HexRoPE、无位置编码、矩形相对偏置及图偏置。

Result: HexRoPE在D6变换测试轨道上将精确贝叶斯后验交叉熵降低0.278，在更大地图上降低0.329（置信区间排除零，Holm校正后p<0.001）。1k局时策略动作准确率提升4.63pp（vs无编码）和2.05pp（vs矩形偏置），10k局降至1.55pp和0.41pp。但对战胜率无提升（-1.56pp，95%CI [-4.50, 1.17]）。矩形偏置在D6信念一致性最强但半径3→4外推失败，图偏置仅有小块边增益。

Conclusion: 几何归纳偏置能改善信念估计和数据高效的模仿学习，但这些表征层面的提升并不能自动转化为更强的闭环博弈表现，暗示表征增益与决策/对战性能之间存在需要弥合的鸿沟。

Abstract: Transformers applied to spatial imperfect-information games must represent map geometry while tracking hidden entities through time. We ask whether geometry-aware positional encodings improve these capabilities, without claiming a new positional encoding. We construct a four-level benchmark on a hexagonal naval pursuit game: controlled geometry and topology probes, an exact-Bayes hidden-target tracking task, offline policy imitation at 1k and 10k games, and 7,200 fixed-seed games against three legacy opponents. Across matched Transformer backbones, HexRoPE reduces exact-belief posterior cross-entropy relative to no positional encoding by 0.278 on D6-transformed test orbits and 0.329 on a larger map; both hierarchical-bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero, and both Holm-adjusted p-values are below 0.001. At 1k games, HexRoPE improves policy action accuracy by 4.63 percentage points over no encoding and 2.05 points over rectangular relative bias; the gains shrink to 1.55 and 0.41 points at 10k games. However, HexRoPE does not improve aggregate gameplay win rate: its paired effect over no encoding is -1.56 percentage points (95% CI [-4.50, 1.17]). Rectangular relative bias is strongest on D6 belief consistency but fails sharply when extrapolating from radius 3 to radius 4, while graph bias provides only a small blocked-edge gain. The results show that geometric inductive bias improves belief estimation and data-efficient imitation, but those representation gains do not automatically produce stronger closed-loop play.

</details>


### [507] [Learning reshapes power-law anisotropy in internal representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15239)
*Asahi Nakamuta,Jun-nosuke Teramae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过精确求解两层线性神经网络在教师-学生设定下的学习动力学，揭示了内部表征幂律各向异性如何从输入结构和任务驱动学习中涌现的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 幂律各向异性广泛存在于从语言模型到小鼠大脑皮层等各类神经系统中，是理解高维信息处理的关键几何性质，但其从输入结构和任务学习中的涌现机制尚不明确。

Method: 在具有幂律输入和教师结构的教师-学生设定下，精确求解宽两层线性神经网络的学习动力学，分别分析特征学习（feature-learning）和惰性（lazy）两种训练范式下的内部表征谱演化。

Result: 在特征学习机制下，内部表征谱的局部幂律指数在训练过程中非单调演化，跨模式和训练时间呈现多达四种不同的渐近阶段；而在惰性机制下指数基本保持不变。数值实验表明类似的指数动力学在更真实的非线性网络中也成立。

Conclusion: 研究提出了一种通用机制，即输入统计特性与任务结构之间的动态相互作用产生幂律内部表征，为理解各类神经系统中普遍存在的幂律各向异性提供了理论框架。

Abstract: Power-law anisotropy in internal representations has been observed across a wide range of biological and artificial neural systems, from state-of-the-art language models to the mouse cerebral cortex. This anisotropy is a key geometric property of high-dimensional information processing and underlies a variety of theoretical analyses. However, the mechanism by which it emerges from input structure and task-driven learning has remained unclear. Here, we characterize this formation process by exactly solving the learning dynamics of a wide two-layer linear neural network in a teacher--student setting with power-law input and teacher structures. We show that, in the feature-learning regime, the local power-law exponent of the internal-representation spectrum evolves nonmonotonically over the course of training and exhibits up to four distinct asymptotic regimes across modes and training times. By contrast, in the lazy regime, the exponent remains essentially unchanged. We further demonstrate numerically that similar exponent dynamics arise in more realistic nonlinear networks. Together, these results suggest a general mechanism by which the dynamic interaction between input statistics and task structure gives rise to power-law internal representations.

</details>


### [508] [Shape Operator PCA: Curvature-Aware Projections for Geometric Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15313)
*Alexandre L. M. Levada*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SHOPCA（基于形状算子的主成分分析），一种融合微分几何信息到经典PCA协方差结构中的无监督度量学习与降维方法。它利用数据流形的平均形状算子正则化全局协方差矩阵，通过单一混合系数α控制正则化强度，并借助谱特征间隙的无监督准则自动选择α。在50多个真实数据集上的实验表明，SHOPCA相比PCA一致地提升了聚类质量，并在小样本场景下优于UMAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典PCA仅基于全局协方差矩阵捕捉线性方差结构，忽略了数据流形中蕴含的曲率（微分几何）信息，导致在非线性结构明显的数据上降维效果受限。现有流形学习方法（如ISOMAP、UMAP）虽然考虑了局部几何结构，但往往需要迭代估计、参数敏感，且在小样本场景下性能退化。因此，作者希望设计一种既保留PCA计算高效性、又融入几何信息、且完全无监督的降维方法。

Method: SHOPCA的核心步骤包括：(1) 从数据流形上估计每个数据点的局部形状算子，并取其绝对值后平均，得到平均形状算子；(2) 用该平均形状算子对经典PCA的全局协方差矩阵进行正则化，形成新的目标矩阵；(3) 引入单一迹归一化混合系数α控制正则化权重，α=0时退化为标准PCA，α→∞时趋向曲率驱动的嵌入；(4) 提出基于正则化协方差矩阵谱特征间隙（eigengap）的完全无监督准则，通过最大化前d个特征值与剩余特征值的相对分离度来自动选择α，无需类别标签。

Result: 在超过50个真实世界基准数据集上，SHOPCA与PCA、ISOMAP、UMAP对比，使用ARI、NMI、FM和V-measure等聚类指标评估。结果表明：SHOPCA在广泛数据集上一致地优于PCA的聚类质量；在小样本设置下，SHOPCA超越UMAP（因UMAP的迭代邻域流形估计在小样本下容易退化）；SHOPCA计算上可处理、参数效率高。
