Conclusion: SHOPCA成功地将微分几何信息（形状算子）整合到经典PCA框架中，实现了在无需任何标签的情况下、兼顾方差最大化和曲率信息的几何感知降维。它不仅提升了聚类性能，还避免了流形学习方法在小样本场景下的退化问题，适用于需要完全无监督、几何感知降维的应用领域。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose SHOPCA (Shape Operator-based Principal Component Analysis), a novel method for unsupervised metric learning and dimensionality reduction that incorporates differential geometric information into the covariance structure of classical PCA. SHOPCA regularizes the global covariance matrix using the mean shape operator, defined as the average of the absolute local shape operators estimated from the data manifold, steering principal components toward directions of both maximum variance and informative curvature. A single trace-normalized mixing coefficient $α$ controls the regularization, recovering standard PCA at $α= 0$ and a curvature-driven embedding as $α\to \infty$. We further introduce a fully unsupervised criterion for selecting $α$ based on the spectral eigengap of the regularized covariance matrix, maximizing the relative separation between the top-$d$ and remaining eigenvalues without using class labels. We evaluate SHOPCA on more than 50 real-world benchmark datasets, comparing it with PCA, ISOMAP, and UMAP using Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), Fowlkes-Mallows index (FM), and V-measure. Results show that SHOPCA consistently improves clustering quality over PCA across a broad range of datasets and surpasses UMAP on small-sample settings, where iterative neighborhood-based manifold estimation can degrade. SHOPCA is computationally tractable, parameter-efficient, and applicable to domains requiring fully unsupervised, geometry-aware dimensionality reduction.

</details>


### [509] [Optimal Lower Bounds for Networked Information Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15472)
*Ambar Pal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了网络化信息聚合中预测误差的最优下界问题。此前Kearns等人(2026)证明了MSE误差沿长度为D的路径的上界为O(1/√D)、下界为Ω(1/D)，本文构造了一族最坏情况问题实例，将MSE下界提升至Ω(1/√D)，从而与上界匹配。利用学习器预测器的结构不变性，该分析推广到满足正则条件的任意凸损失函数（包括强凸、与标签正相关等），其中逻辑损失满足这些条件，同时也闭合了Bateni等人(2026)中上界与下界之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决Kearns等人(2026)提出的网络化信息聚合问题中MSE误差上下界之间的gap：上界为O(1/√D)、下界为Ω(1/D)，正确阶数未知。此开放问题对于理解信息在有向无环图中逐层传播时的累积误差至关重要。

Method: 构造一族最坏情况的高斯问题实例，使得沿D长路径的MSE误差达到Ω(1/√D)下界，与已知上界O(1/√D)匹配。通过发掘学习器预测器结构中的不变性，将分析从MSE推广到满足正则条件的任意凸损失函数，这些条件包括在原点的球内强凸性以及最小化总体损失的理想预测器与标签正相关。

Result: 获得了一族最坏情况问题实例，其MSE下界为Ω(1/√D)，从而解决了该开放问题并闭合了上下界之间的差距。同时证明了该结果对满足正则条件的一类凸损失函数（包括逻辑损失等常见损失）普遍成立，并闭合了Bateni等人(2026)中相应结果的上界与下界之间的差距。

Conclusion: 网络化信息聚合中沿D长路径的误差最优阶数为Θ(1/√D)。该结果在MSE和满足正则条件的一般凸损失下均成立，为理解图结构限制下的分布式学习误差传播提供了完整的刻画。

Abstract: The problem of networked information aggregation, studied in Kearns et al. (2026), involves a group of learners situated on the vertices of a directed acyclic graph $G$, each learning a linear predictor $\widehat Y$ for a fixed random variable $Y$ given access to a local feature, as well as the predictors learnt by its parents. Learning proceeds iteratively, with learners ordered according to a topological sort of $G$. The main quantity of interest is the error incurred by the current learner, constrained to this flow of information, with respect to the best linear predictor using all the features seen so far. When the studied error is the MSE, i.e., $\mathbb{E} (\widehat Y - Y)^2$, Kearns et al. (2026) show that the error is at most $O(1/\sqrt{D})$ along a path of length $D$. They also obtain a hard instance where the MSE is lower bounded by $Ω(1/D)$, leaving the correct order open. In this work, we resolve this central open problem, and obtain a family of worst case problem instances with a MSE lower bound of $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$.
  By exploiting invariances in the structure of the learnt predictors, our analysis generalizes to all convex loss functions $\ell(\widehat Y, Y)$ satisfying regularity conditions which include strong convexity in a ball around the origin, and that the ideal predictor minimizing the population loss is positively correlated with the label. We show that networked information aggregation on a gaussian instance in our worst case family incurs an $\ell$-error lower bounded by $Ω(1/\sqrt{D})$ with respect to this ideal predictor. We demonstrate that a variety of common losses satisfy these regularity conditions. In particular, the logistic loss satisfies them, and hence our analysis also closes the gap between the upper and lower bounds in Bateni et al. (2026).

</details>


### [510] [PERO: Efficient Robust Post-Training Foundation Models for Encrypted Traffic Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15504)
*Wumei Du,Jiarong Wen,Kaiyu Zhang,Zi Yang,Yiqin Lv,Longfei Zhang,Dong Liang,Zheng Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PERO（预评估鲁棒优化）框架，用于加密流量基础模型的高效鲁棒后训练。PERO采用轻量级代理模型预先估计样本风险，仅选择高风险样本子集对基础模型进行更新，将风险估计与昂贵的大模型优化解耦，在保持或提升鲁棒性和平均性能的同时显著降低计算与内存开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加密流量分类在实际部署中易受高损失罕见错误（如恶意流量误分类）的影响，但标准经验风险最小化目标忽略了高风险尾部事件，常用指标无法反映风险敏感场景下的鲁棒性局限。此外，直接将CVaR等鲁棒优化目标应用于大模型后训练计算方法开销极大，因为识别高损失样本需要消耗大量计算资源。

Method: PERO框架包含两个关键设计：(1) 使用轻量级代理模型估计样本级风险，避免直接在大模型上计算每个样本的损失；(2) 基于代理模型的风险评估结果筛选出高风险样本子集，仅用该子集更新基础模型，从而实现风险估计与大模型优化的解耦，大幅降低计算和内存开销。

Result: 在典型加密流量数据集上的大量实验表明，PERO在鲁棒性和平均性能方面与优秀的鲁棒后训练方法相比达到竞争力或更优水平，同时在计算和内存成本上实现了显著降低。

Conclusion: PERO为加密流量基础模型提供了一种高效、实用的鲁棒后训练方案，在保证鲁棒性能的前提下解决了直接应用CVaR等鲁棒优化在大模型上计算开销过高的问题。

Abstract: Encrypted traffic classification is vital for network security, yet real-world deployments are inherently sensitive to rare but high-loss errors such as misclassification of malicious traffic. The encrypted traffic foundation model, as a promising general-purpose technique, can achieve impressive overall performance. However, employing standard objectives such as empirical risk minimization often overlooks high-risk tail events, and commonly used performance metrics hardly reflect robustness limitations in risk-sensitive scenarios. Directly applying robust optimization objectives, such as conditional value-at-risk, to post-training is computationally prohibitive for large models, as identifying high-loss samples exhausts substantial computation. To this end, we propose Pre-Evaluation Robust Optimization (PERO), an efficient robust post-training framework for encrypted traffic foundation models. PERO employs a lightweight proxy to estimate sample-wise risk and selects a subset of high-risk samples to update the foundation model, decoupling risk estimation from expensive large-model optimization. Extensive experiments on typical encrypted traffic datasets show that PERO achieves competitive or superior robustness and average performance compared to outstanding robust post-training methods, while significantly reducing computational and memory costs.

</details>


### [511] [Benchmarking Quantum Machine Learning for Power-System Attack Detection: Evaluation Choices Decide the Outcome Before the Models Do](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15617)
*Md Rezwanul Islam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对电力系统网络攻击检测中的机器学习（含量子机器学习）模型进行了系统性的安全基准测试，核心发现是方法论层面的：即基准测试的结论在很大程度上由评估者的先验选择决定，而非模型本身。作者识别出八种关键选择点，每个都足以反转或改变结论，并提供了相应的控制和带种子的基准测试集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习检测器本身会成为攻击面，量子机器学习被提出作为解决方案，但缺乏系统的安全基准评估。作者质疑现有基准测试结论的稳健性，试图揭示评估协议选择如何影响对量子vs经典模型安全性的判断。

Method: 在公开的电力系统攻击数据集（Mississippi State/ORNL）上，对保真度核SVM和变分分类器（量子方法）与六个调优的经典模型进行基准测试，覆盖白盒攻击、迁移攻击、基于决策的黑盒攻击和投毒攻击。系统性地改变评估协议中八个选择点来考察结论的稳定性。

Result: 八个评估选择中的每一个都在固定模型下反转或移动了结论。最重要的是数据划分方式：行级协议得分0.905宏F1，而按源文件整体划分时降至0.594。在封顶的匹配维度场景中，量子算法接近随机水平而经典算法高出0.024。保真度核看似最稳健，但直接攻击下保留率从0.886降至0.064；误拟合的替代模型可制造10倍的攻击不对称性；未播种黑盒攻击在多次重启间有75%的变动。阳性对照证明准确率缺陷来自标签而非流程。

Conclusion: 基准测试的答案在模型比较之前就被评估者的选择所决定，研究提供了能捕捉每种选择影响的控制手段，并发布了带种子的基准测试集以确保可复现性和公平比较。

Abstract: Machine-learning detectors for power-system cyberattacks are themselves attack surfaces, and quantum machine learning has been proposed for them. We benchmark fidelity-kernel SVMs and variational classifiers against six tuned classical models on public power-system attack data (Mississippi State/ORNL), across white-box, transfer, decision-based black-box, and poisoning attacks. Our headline finding is methodological: the benchmark's answers are set by the evaluator's choices before the models. Eight choices -- six in the evaluation protocol, two in the tuning the benchmark itself runs -- each reversed or moved a conclusion at fixed models. The largest is the split: the row-level protocol scores 0.905 macro-F1 where holding whole source files out leaves 0.594, and in the capped matched-dimensionality regime the quantum arm sits within noise of chance with the classical arm 0.024 above it. A fidelity kernel looks most robust until attacked directly (retention 0.886 to 0.064); a mis-fitted surrogate manufactures a 10x asymmetry; an unseeded black-box attack moves 75% between restarts. A positive control explains the accuracy null: the labels, not the pipeline. We give the control that catches each choice and release the seeded benchmark.

</details>


### [512] [Sparse Prototype Code Underlies Classification and Prediction Across Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15632)
*Yehonatan Avidan,Daniel D. Lee,Haim Sompolinsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现分类任务在视觉、音频和语言处理模型中存在普遍的表征几何结构：类内变异的分类器相关分量与真实类和竞争类质心具有强结构化相关性。基于此构建了平均场理论，仅用真实类和最强竞争类质心坐标的少量变量即可准确预测跨架构和跨模态的分类精度，且相关几何量随模型规模提升而系统性改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经表征是现代AI模型内部机制研究的核心工具，但其高维复杂结构难以解释。已有研究缺乏对表征几何结构的统一理论理解，难以预测模型分类性能，需要一种简洁而通用的解释框架。

Method: 作者首先通过实证观察发现类内变异不是随机的，其分类器相关分量与类质心及竞争类质心存在结构化相关性。基于此，推导出解析的平均场理论，核心变量为真实类和竞争类质心坐标上的变异性，并引入全局类半径重归一化以补偿真实表征的非高斯统计特性。理论仅需使用真实类及其最强竞争者的少量质心坐标。

Result: 该理论能够准确预测跨视觉、音频和语言架构的分类精度；相关几何量随模型规模增大而系统性改善，与精度增益一致；理论具有稀疏性特征，只需少量质心坐标即可准确预测，与稀疏自编码器等稀疏特征提取方法相呼应。

Conclusion: 深度网络中的分类由一个稀疏、质心对齐的结构所主导，该结构嵌入在完整的高维表征空间中。这一发现提供了一种简约且可预测的神经表征理论，并连接了稀疏特征提取方法，为理解现代AI模型的内部机制提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Neural representations have become a central tool for studying the internal mechanisms of modern AI models, yet their complex high-dimensional structure makes them difficult to interpret. We show that classification tasks give rise to a universal representational geometry, shared across state-of-the-art models in vision, audio, and language processing. The key structure is that within-class variability is not random in representation space. Instead, its classifier-relevant component has strong and structured correlations with the class's own centroid and with the centroids of its competing classes. Building on this observation, we derive an analytical mean-field theory governed mainly by the variability along true-class and rival-class centroid coordinates, together with a global renormalization of the class radius that compensates for the non-Gaussian statistics of real representations. The theory accurately predicts classification accuracy across architectures and modalities. The relevant geometric quantities improve systematically with model scale, mirroring the observed gains in accuracy. A striking feature of the theory is its sparsity: accurate prediction requires only a small set of centroid coordinates associated with the true class and its strongest rivals - connecting our framework to sparse-feature extraction approaches such as sparse autoencoders. Together, these results provide a parsimonious predictive theory of neural representations and suggest that classification in deep networks is governed by a sparse, centroid-aligned structure embedded within the full high-dimensional representation space.

</details>


### [513] [FirstDiff: One-Step Diffusion-Based Anomaly Detection for Multivariate Time Series via Initial Noise Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15727)
*Ali Boudaghi,Alireza Nemati,Hadi Zare*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FirstDiff，一种基于扩散模型的多元时间序列异常检测框架，核心观察是初始反向扩散评估中预测的扩散噪声已包含足够异常检测信息。FirstDiff利用验证数据建模正常行为下预测扩散噪声的统计分布，仅需单次去噪网络评估即可进行异常推断，大幅降低计算开销，并以Diffusion Transformer作为去噪骨干建模时序与跨传感器依赖。在五个公开基准数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的时间序列异常检测方法通常在完整反向扩散过程完成后才进行检测，依赖最终重建信号而忽视去噪过程中产生的中间表示，这导致计算开销大且未能充分利用扩散模型的中间信息。

Method: FirstDiff利用初始反向扩散评估中预测的扩散噪声已足够用于异常检测这一观察，使用验证数据建模正常行为下预测扩散噪声的统计分布，将完整的反向扩散轨迹简化为单次去噪网络评估；采用Diffusion Transformer作为去噪骨干以捕获复杂的时间与跨传感器依赖关系。

Result: 在五个公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FirstDiff达到最先进的检测性能，同时将扩散推理从完整的反向轨迹缩减为单次去噪网络评估，显著降低计算成本。

Conclusion: 通过利用初始反向扩散步骤中的扩散噪声信息，可以在不牺牲检测精度的前提下大幅降低扩散模型用于异常检测的推理开销，验证了扩散中间信息对异常检测具有充分价值这一假设。

Abstract: Diffusion models have recently shown strong potential for multivariate time-series anomaly detection by learning the distribution of normal data through iterative denoising. Existing diffusion-based approaches, however, typically perform anomaly detection after completing the reverse diffusion process, relying primarily on the final reconstructed signal and overlooking informative representations produced during denoising. This design incurs substantial computational cost and limits the use of intermediate diffusion information for anomaly detection.
  In this paper, we propose FirstDiff, a diffusion-based anomaly detection framework based on the observation that the predicted diffusion noise at the initial reverse-diffusion evaluation already contains sufficient information for accurate anomaly detection. FirstDiff models the statistical distribution of predicted diffusion noise under normal behavior using validation data, enabling anomaly inference from a single denoising-network evaluation rather than completing the reverse diffusion trajectory.
  To model complex temporal and inter-sensor dependencies, FirstDiff employs a Diffusion Transformer as the denoising backbone. Extensive experiments on five public benchmark datasets demonstrate that FirstDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing diffusion inference from the full reverse trajectory to a single denoising-network evaluation.

</details>


### [514] [Learning Stock Trading Policies via Barycenter-Based Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15770)
*Arishi Orra,Himanshu Choudhary,Manoj Thakur*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BRaG，一种基于重心（barycenter）的对抗逆强化学习框架用于股票交易。该方法通过性能加权的Wasserstein重心聚合多种异构专家策略，形成稳定的伪专家表征，用于预训练交易策略（对抗模仿学习），随后用真实市场奖励进行强化学习微调，并通过控制障碍函数（CBF）约束动作执行以控制回撤风险。在美、英、印度和台湾四大全球股票市场验证，性能优于经典交易规则和近期深度强化学习方法，且风险特征更稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习在设计有效交易策略时面临三大挑战：奖励延迟且噪声大、探索效率差、难以强制执行显式风险约束。现有方法难以同时解决这些问题，需要一种能融合多种专家经验、稳定预训练且兼顾风险约束的框架。

Method: BRaG框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 使用性能加权的Wasserstein重心聚合多个异构专家演示，得到稳定的伪专家表征，捕捉不同交易风格的共享结构；(2) 利用该伪专家表征通过对抗模仿学习预训练交易策略，缓解强化学习中的不稳定探索；(3) 在真实市场奖励下用强化学习微调预训练策略，并引入控制障碍函数约束动作执行、正则化策略学习以满足回撤限制。

Result: 在美、英、印度和台湾四大全球股票指数市场进行实验验证，BRaG在所有市场上均取得优于经典交易规则和近期深度强化学习方法的性能，同时展现出更稳定的风险特征。

Conclusion: BRaG通过重心聚合多专家演示进行预训练并结合控制障碍函数约束，有效解决了强化学习在交易中的探索不稳定和风险约束难题，证明了多专家模仿学习与安全约束相结合在金融交易领域的有效性。

Abstract: Designing effective trading strategies using reinforcement learning remains challenging due to delayed and noisy rewards, poor exploration, and the difficulty of enforcing explicit risk constraints. In this work, we propose BRaG, a barycenter-based adversarial inverse reinforcement learning framework for stock trading that learns trading behavior from multiple heterogeneous expert strategies. BRaG aggregates expert demonstrations using a performance-weighted Wasserstein barycenter, yielding a stable pseudo-expert representation that captures shared structure across diverse trading styles. This representation is used to pretrain a trading policy via adversarial imitation learning, which alleviates unstable exploration during reinforcement learning. The pretrained policy is subsequently refined using reinforcement learning with true market rewards. To ensure risk-aware decision-making, BRaG incorporates control barrier functions that constrain action execution and regularize policy learning to satisfy drawdown limits. We evaluate the proposed approach on four major global equity markets, including the US, UK, Indian, and Taiwanese indices. Across all the markets, the proposed approach achieves stronger performance than both classical trading rules and recent deep reinforcement learning methods, while exhibiting more stable risk characteristics.

</details>


### [515] [Cross-Entropy Risk Estimation for Language Models: Inconsistency Must Be Dense, and the Holdout Method Is No Exception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15798)
*Hanti Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文论证语言模型常用的每词元交叉熵风险（用于拟合缩放定律的指标）无法被一致估计。一致性相对于"可能的世界状态"（数据生成分布+训练出的模型）定义；由于有限风险与无限风险在拓扑上彼此任意接近，任何估计器都无法在所有风险有定义的状态下保持一致。即使限制期望序列长度有界或限制为全支撑模型，不一致性依然存在，且在后一情形中不一致的状态稠密。文中提出两条出路：1) 使用有界上下文窗口并对next-token概率设下限，使风险有限恰对应数据分布期望序列长度有限；2) 仅在风险低于预定阈值时报告，虽恢复一致性但实质是修订了估计目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型的比较通常基于每词元交叉熵风险，这也是缩放定律拟合的目标量。然而该量是否可被可靠估计从未被严格审视。作者希望从统计学一致性角度检验这一核心指标的可估计性，发现其存在根本性的估计障碍。

Method: 采用形式化的统计一致性框架，将一致性定义为相对于"可能的世界状态"（数据生成分布+训练出的模型对）的收敛性质。通过拓扑分析考察有限风险与无限风险状态的空间分布，证明二者任意接近，从而排除了任何一致估计器的存在。进一步在限制性设定（有界期望序列长度、全支撑模型）下检验不一致性的持续性，并分析两种缓解途径的可行性与代价。

Result: 1) 每词元交叉熵风险不存在一致估计器——不只是留出法平均失效，而是任何估计器都失效；2) 在有界期望序列长度和全支撑模型的限制下，不一致性依然存在且不一致状态稠密；3) 提出的两条出路各有代价：有界上下文+概率下限路径引入不可检验的假设，阈值报告路径则实质改变了估计目标。

Conclusion: 每词元交叉熵风险作为估计目标在统计上存在根本性缺陷。但论文并非全盘否定该指标，而是指出在特定修订条件下（阈值报告法）该指标对模型选择依然足够，只是需要明确承认估计目标的改变。这为语言模型评估的统计基础提供了重要反思。

Abstract: Language models are compared by their held-out per-token cross-entropy risk---the quantity scaling laws are fitted to. We show that it cannot be consistently estimated. Consistency, or convergence to the estimand, is defined relative to a \emph{possible state of the world}: a pair consisting of a data-generating distribution and a model we turn out to train. Quantifying over models as well as data-generating mechanisms is essential, because what decides whether a model's risk is estimable is a tail property of the distribution its weights induce, which no sample reveals. The per-token cross-entropy risk is hard to estimate because of a topological fact: among the possible states, finite risk and infinite risk each lie arbitrarily close to every instance of the other. Consequently no estimator---not merely the holdout average---is consistent at every state at which the risk is defined. Worse, inconsistent estimation persists under both bounding the expected sequence length and restricting to full-support models; and in that restricted setting the states at which inconsistency occurs are even dense. Two interesting ways out are identified, and neither is free. Way out 1: using a bounded context window, we can floor a model's next-token probabilities, making its risk finite exactly when the data-generating distribution has finite expected sequence length---a new, statistical rationale for a choice that was made on computational grounds, though the assumption it substitutes is itself beyond the reach of any test. Way out 2: reporting the risk only when it falls below a threshold fixed in advance restores consistency, at no cost to what model selection actually requires---but we need to recognize that the goal of estimation is revised.

</details>


### [516] [Self-Supervised Auxiliary Task Discovery for Stable Reinforcement Learning in Stock Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15841)
*Arishi Orra,Himanshu Choudhary,Manoj Thakur*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个自监督框架，自动发现辅助任务（以General Value Functions形式）来支持股票交易的强化学习，通过元梯度机制更新辅助任务的累积量和折扣因子，在四个主要股指上取得优于基线的鲁棒交易表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 股票交易中的强化学习面临市场非平稳和奖励信号噪声的挑战。现有辅助任务通常手工设计，依赖对目标和预测时域的先验假设，在不同市场状态下可能不再适用，因此需要一种能自动发现辅助任务的方法。

Method: 构建双网络框架：主网络学习交易策略及辅助预测；次级网络通过可学习的累积量（cumulants）和折扣因子（discount factors）生成辅助任务定义（General Value Functions）。辅助任务通过元梯度机制更新，考虑其对交易表现的长期影响并提升训练稳定性。

Result: 在DJI、FTSE、Sensex和TAIEX四个主要股票指数上，自动发现的辅助任务相比现有基线方法带来更稳健的学习过程和更好的交易表现。

Conclusion: 自动发现的辅助任务比手工设计更具适应性，能够跨越不同市场状态增强状态表征并辅助策略优化，为股票交易强化学习提供了更稳定且有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has gained increasing attention as a data-driven approach for stock trading. However, learning a policy that is both profitable and stable remains challenging due to non-stationary market behaviour and noisy reward signals. Auxiliary tasks are often used to improve representation learning and stabilize training, yet they are usually designed manually and depend heavily on prior assumptions about targets and prediction horizons. Such fixed designs may not remain suitable across changing market regimes. In this work, we propose a self-supervised framework that automatically discovers auxiliary tasks to support reinforcement learning for stock trading. The auxiliary tasks are formulated as General Value Functions so that their predictions enrich the learned state representation and assist policy optimization. The framework consists of two networks. The main network learns the trading policy along with the auxiliary predictions, while the secondary network generates the definitions of auxiliary tasks through learned cumulants and discount factors. These tasks are updated using a meta gradient mechanism that accounts for their long-term impact on trading performance and improves training stability. We evaluate the proposed approach across four major equity indices: DJI, FTSE, Sensex, and TAIEX. The empirical results demonstrate that automatically discovered auxiliary tasks lead to more robust learning and improved trading performance compared to existing baselines.

</details>


### [517] [Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14556)
*Dongzhe Zheng,Christine Allen-Blanchette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出黎曼Hodge消息传递（RHMP），将拓扑与几何分离作为架构原则：固定由定向关联决定的cellular coboundary算子（d_k），学习对称正定cochain度量（H_k）用于几何相关传播，从而实现精确的cochain复形恒等式、非负Hodge能量、半正定算子及精确Abel曲率不变性。在7个物理基准上（流体、电磁、规范场、变网格CFD）取得最佳整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经替代模型（neural surrogates）常通过无约束的消息传递将拓扑与几何的角色混在一起。然而物理场在网格上的建模需要严格分离拓扑与几何：守恒律是拓扑性的应当精确成立，而几何、材料响应和各向异性耦合应从数据中学习。作者希望将这种分离转化为显式的架构设计原则。

Method: RHMP将分离原则落实为：固定由网格定向关联确定的cellular coboundary算子（d_k），学习对称正定的cochain度量（H_k）来实现几何依赖的传播。将H_k视为学习到的度量，从而引入cochain-frame等变性——物理传播应对隐藏cochain特征基的正交变换保持不变。架构以度量加权的Hodge块（d_k^T H_{k+1} d_k）实现，确保精确的拓扑恒等式与几何约束。

Result: 在涵盖流体、电磁、规范场和变网格CFD的七个物理基准上，RHMP取得最佳整体性能，且在拓扑、学习几何与场结构相互交织的场景中提升最为显著。

Conclusion: 将拓扑与几何分离作为神经架构的构建原则是有效且本质性的：精确的拓扑约束（coboundary固定）与数据驱动的几何学习（度量学习）相结合，不仅能提升物理保真度，还能带来更优的泛化性能，尤其在复杂物理场中优势明显。

Abstract: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing. We introduce Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP), which turns this separation into an architectural principle. RHMP fixes the cellular coboundaries ($d_k$) determined by oriented incidence and learns symmetric positive-definite cochain metrics ($H_k$) for geometry-dependent propagation. Treating $H_k$ as the learned metric motivates cochain-frame equivariance: physical propagation should be invariant to orthogonal changes of the hidden cochain feature basis. RHMP implements this principle with metric-weighted Hodge blocks ($d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$), yielding exact cochain-complex identities ($d_{k+1}d_k=0$), nonnegative Hodge energies, positive-semidefinite operators, and exact Abelian curvature invariance. Across seven physical benchmarks spanning fluids, electromagnetism, gauge fields, and variable-mesh CFD, RHMP achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains when topology, learned geometry, and field structure interact.

</details>


### [518] [Conditional Evaluation of Language Models with Cheap Auxiliary Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16210)
*Zhi Zhang,Lingfeng Lyu,Yue Kang,Doudou Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了LACE（局部增强控制变量评估）方法，一种用于条件LLM评估的半监督估计器。通过局部中心化处理，利用廉价辅助信号（LLM法官评分、置信度、成对比较等）在不引入偏差的情况下提升条件性能画像的估计效率，并给出了无偏性、局部最优性和适应性等理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合精度指标无法揭示模型在哪些条件下成功或失败。获取条件性能画像需要金标（gold labels），代价高昂；而廉价辅助信号虽然可以为每个基准项收集，但往往存在偏差或校准不良，难以直接用于条件估计。

Method: LACE的核心是"局部中心化"（local centering）：在目标画像区域内减去廉价信号的条件均值后，任何线性增广的条件均值为零，因此不会改变估计目标。增广系数仅用于提升效率。使用局部岭控制变量（local ridge control variate），将来自标注子集的金标残差均值与来自完整项目池的廉价信号均值相结合。同时推导了直接成对模型差距和部署加权得分的对应估计器。

Result: 证明了免校准的识别性、分组画像的无偏性、中心化线性增广内的局部oracle最优性，以及对估计系数的一阶自适应性。效率增益由一个总体局部R²刻画。在MATH-500、ScienceQA、MMLU、WinoGrande、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、GSM8K和ARC等数据集上对主要性能画像估计器进行了实证评估。

Conclusion: LACE通过廉价信号的有效利用，在不引入偏差的前提下显著提升条件性能估计的效率，为大规模LLM的细粒度条件评估提供了可扩展且理论有保证的解决方案。

Abstract: Aggregate accuracy hides where models succeed and fail. Estimating conditional performance profiles from gold labels alone is expensive, while cheap auxiliary signals such as LLM-judge scores, pairwise comparisons, confidence scores, and judge-disagreement features can be collected for every benchmark item but are often biased or miscalibrated. We propose LACE (Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation), a semi-supervised estimator for conditional LLM evaluation. The key step is local centering: after subtracting the conditional mean of a cheap signal within the target profile region, any linear augmentation has zero conditional mean and therefore cannot change the estimand. The augmentation coefficient is used only for efficiency, and a local ridge control variate combines a gold-label residual mean from the labeled subset with a cheap-signal mean from the full item pool. We prove calibration-free identification, unbiasedness for grouped profiles, local oracle optimality within centered linear augmentations, and first-order adaptivity to the estimated coefficient. The resulting gain formula is governed by a population local $R^2$, which characterizes how the efficiency attainable from the cheap signals varies across profile values. We also derive corresponding estimators for direct paired model gaps and deployment-weighted scores. We empirically evaluate the primary performance-profile estimator on MATH-500, ScienceQA, MMLU, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, GSM8K, and ARC.

</details>


### [519] [Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14563)
*Rivaan Patil,Simon Dennis,Hao Guo,Kevin Shabahang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FPO是一种仅前向传播的MLP训练方法，通过在后层利用输出层预测误差近似梯度，无需反向传播即可适配大语言模型，吞吐量提升2.7-3.2倍，峰值训练内存降低约40%，同时在域外基准上保持在种子噪声范围内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准全网络微调需要完整反向传播，计算开销大、内存占用高，且可能导致域外性能退化。作者希望寻找一种更高效的适配方式，利用变换器后层中输出层预测误差近似梯度的现象，实现仅前向传播的模型训练。

Method: FPO基于一个经验观察：在变换器后层，输出层预测误差与真实梯度的余弦相似度为0.47-0.59。作者提出一个两分钟的诊断方法，可逐层量化该近似程度，判断后层适配是否可行。FPO仅在输出层计算单一误差信号，并将其应用于每个目标层，层间不传播信号，全程不构建autograd图。

Result: 在三个模型家族（OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-8B、Falcon3-7B）上评估，FPO均能实现域内困惑度改善，同时MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag和Winogrande保持在种子噪声范围内。相比标准微调吞吐量提升2.7-3.2倍，峰值内存降低约40%。局部化SFT也可进入该regime，但耗时是FPO的2.2倍。

Conclusion: FPO证明在变换器后层，仅前向传播即可实现有效的模型适配，避免了反向传播的计算和内存开销，且不会破坏域外性能。该方法通过简易诊断工具验证可行性，为高效大模型微调提供了新范式。

Abstract: Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO) adapts large language models without a backward pass through the model body, achieving 2.7--3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning at ~40% less peak training memory, while leaving off-domain benchmarks within seed-noise of baseline, a property that full-network fine-tuning does not reliably reproduce. FPO rests on a single empirical observation: at late layers of a transformer, the output-layer prediction error approximates the true gradient with cosine similarity 0.47--0.59 across six public models we survey. We introduce a two-minute diagnostic that quantifies this approximation per layer for any model, identifying where late-layer adaptation is viable. Informed by the diagnostic, FPO computes a single error signal at the output and applies it to each target layer. No signal is propagated between layers, and no autograd graph is constructed at any point. We evaluate FPO on three model families (OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-8B, Falcon3-7B). Across all three, FPO produces in-domain perplexity improvement and leaves MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and Winogrande within seed-noise of baseline. Localizing SFT to FPO's target layers to enter this regime is also feasible, but at 2.2x the wall-clock cost of FPO.

</details>


### [520] [Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Resolution Diffusion Models for Trajectory Generation in Urban Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14570)
*Wen Ye,Muyan Weng,Chuizheng Meng,Hao Niu,Yizhou Zhang,Yan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的多分辨率扩散框架MR-Traj，用于大规模轨迹生成。它将轨迹建模为粗粒度里程碑与细粒度片段的组合，从而捕捉多分辨率的时空依赖。实验表明MR-Traj在全局分布相似性上与现有最优方法相当，在细粒度移动模式建模和下游城市任务上更优，且通过多级随机性生成更多样化的轨迹以降低轨迹链接风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类移动性分析对交通管理、流行病控制和城市规划等城市应用至关重要，但由于隐私问题，大规模公开轨迹数据稀缺。现有合成轨迹生成方法主要关注全局分布匹配，忽视了不同空间和时间分辨率下的移动模式，而这些模式对实际应用效用至关重要。

Method: 提出MR-Traj，一种多分辨率扩散框架。它将轨迹显式建模为粗粒度里程碑和细粒度片段的组合，利用扩散模型在不同分辨率级别捕捉复杂的时空依赖关系，并在多个分辨率级别引入随机性以增强生成轨迹的多样性。

Result: MR-Traj在全局分布相似性方面达到与现有最优方法相当的性能，在细粒度移动模式建模和下游城市移动任务上始终优于现有方法。同时，多分辨率级别的随机性使生成轨迹更多样化，在种子引导的数据发布设置下降低了轨迹链接风险。

Conclusion: 多分辨率扩散框架能有效兼顾全局分布相似性与细粒度移动模式建模，提升合成轨迹的实用效用，同时通过多样性增强降低隐私泄露风险，为大规模轨迹生成提供了一种可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Understanding human mobility is critical for a wide range of urban applications, including traffic management, epidemic control, and urban planning. However, due to privacy concerns, the availability of large-scale public trajectory data remains limited, posing challenges for downstream mobility analysis. Existing methods for synthetic trajectory generation primarily focus on matching global distribution similarity, while often overlooking mobility patterns across different spatial and temporal resolutions that are essential for practical utility.
  To address these challenges, we propose a novel multi-resolution diffusion framework, MR-Traj, for large-scale trajectory generation. MR-Traj explicitly models trajectories as compositions of coarse-grained milestones and fine-grained segments, enabling the capture of complex spatial-temporal dependencies at multiple resolutions. Experimental results demonstrate that MR-Traj achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods in terms of global distribution similarity, while consistently outperforming them in modeling fine-resolution mobility patterns and supporting downstream urban mobility tasks. In addition, by introducing stochasticity at multiple resolution levels, MR-Traj generates more diverse trajectories, which empirically reduces trajectory linkage risk under a seed-guided data release setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ray0202/MR-Traj.

</details>


### [521] [Geometry Is Not Robustness: A Trajectory-Level Study of PGD Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14594)
*Dhairysheel Durgule*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对Fashion-MNIST上卷积神经网络的PGD攻击进行了轨迹级（trajectory-level）调查，比较了干净训练和对抗训练模型在不同鲁棒性体制下的表现。研究发现，尽管模型间存在清晰的鲁棒性层级，但不同轨迹指标对鲁棒性识别的贡献不均——平均损失轨迹和梯度对齐模式在鲁棒性差异显著的对抗训练模型间表现相似，而steps-to-failure分布能更清晰地区分鲁棒性体制。结论是轨迹级诊断描述的是优化几何特性，不能独立衡量对抗鲁棒性，应作为标准鲁棒性测量的补充工具而非替代品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PGD攻击广泛用于评估对抗鲁棒性，但通常仅使用最终的对抗准确率，无法捕捉攻击过程中模型的行为变化。近期工作提出轨迹级诊断指标（如损失演化、梯度对齐、steps-to-failure），但这些指标是否可靠地指示鲁棒性强弱仍不清楚，本文旨在对此进行系统调查。

Method: 在Fashion-MNIST上训练卷积神经网络，比较干净训练和对抗训练模型（涵盖多个鲁棒性体制）。使用严格的20步PGD评估（随机初始化和多次重启）测量鲁棒性，用单初始化轨迹记录进行诊断。对每个模型的3000个干净正确样本记录完整PGD轨迹，分析攻击迭代中的损失演化、梯度对齐和失败时机。

Result: 模型间存在清晰的鲁棒性层级，但轨迹指标贡献不均：平均损失轨迹和梯度对齐模式在鲁棒性准确率差异显著的对抗训练模型间定量相似；而steps-to-failure分布能更清晰地区分鲁棒性体制，直接反映对对抗扰动的功能性抵抗能力。

Conclusion: 轨迹级诊断描述的是优化几何特性，不能独立衡量对抗鲁棒性。其可解释性取决于鲁棒性体制、攻击强度和多指标评估。轨迹级分析应作为补充诊断工具，在上下文中解读，而非替代标准鲁棒性测量。

Abstract: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) is widely used to evaluate adversarial robustness, typically via final adversarial accuracy, which does not capture model behaviour throughout the attack. Recent work proposes trajectory-level diagnostics, such as loss evolution, gradient alignment, and steps-to-failure, for deeper insight into adversarial optimisation dynamics. However, whether these diagnostics reliably indicate robustness strength remains unclear. We conduct a trajectory-level investigation of PGD attacks on convolutional neural networks trained on Fashion-MNIST. We compare clean-trained and adversarially-trained models across multiple robustness regimes, using rigorous 20-step PGD evaluations with random initialisation and multiple restarts for robustness measurement, and single-initialisation trajectory recording for diagnostics. We record full PGD trajectories across 3000 clean-correct samples per model and analyse loss evolution, gradient alignment, and failure timing across attack iterations. Our results reveal a clear robustness hierarchy across models; however, trajectory metrics do not contribute equally to its identification. Mean loss trajectories and gradient alignment patterns appear quantitatively similar across adversarially-trained models with substantially different robust accuracies. In contrast, steps-to-failure distributions provide a clearer separation of robustness regimes, directly reflecting functional resistance to adversarial perturbation. These findings indicate that trajectory-level diagnostics describe optimisation geometry but do not independently measure adversarial robustness. Their interpretability depends on robustness regime, attack strength, and multi-metric evaluation. Trajectory-level analysis should be a complementary diagnostic tool, interpreted in context, rather than a replacement for standard robustness measurements.

</details>


### [522] [DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14614)
*Zeyu Cao,Xuan Guo,Cheng Zhang,Cheuk Hang Lau,Ilia Shumailov,Yiren Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了将退役GPU组成"DumpsterCluster"（垃圾桶集群）以服务现代LLM推理的可行性与条件。作者实际构建了一个128-GPU的二手集群并运行一年，发现在成本上（$22K vs $600K）具有显著优势，通过流水线并行优化可在V100集群上实现与LLaMA-70B竞争性的吞吐量。然而，环境可持续性存在关键依赖：旧GPU每token能耗更高，只有在电价低廉且清洁能源充足的地区，二手硬件的全生命周期成本和碳排放才具有优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数据中心不断淘汰功能完好的GPU，大量仍具计算能力的加速器进入二手市场，但缺乏系统性研究来验证这些退役GPU能否真正服务于现代LLM推理，以及在何种条件下这种再利用在经济和环境上是否可行。

Method: 作者从头使用纯二手组件物理搭建了一个128-GPU的DumpsterCluster并实际运行一年；通过流水线并行（pipeline-parallel）优化，在V100集群上运行LLaMA-70B等模型进行性能评估；并从经济成本（总拥有成本）和环境足迹（碳排放）两个维度，与当前一代8-GPU B200系统进行系统对比分析。

Result: DumpsterCluster成本约$22K，远低于B200系统的$600K；通过流水线并行优化，V100集群在LLaMA-70B推理吞吐量上具有竞争力，验证了生产可用性。但旧GPU每token能耗显著更高，在电网平均碳强度下，二手系统对8B模型每token碳排放约为当前硬件的4倍，对70B模型则超过40倍。

Conclusion: GPU的"来世"并非普遍可持续——硬件再利用必须与低碳能源战略性地耦合。当部署在能源成本有利且电力清洁的地区时，二手GPU为扩大AI算力提供了一条兼顾可负担性、能源安全与环境责任的道路。

Abstract: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. However, our deployment reveals critical context dependencies. Older GPUs consume significantly more energy per token, making total cost of ownership favorable only in regions with inexpensive electricity. Under grid-average carbon intensity, second-hand systems can produce approximately 4x higher total carbon emissions per token for 8B models, and over 40x for 70B models, compared to current-generation hardware. These findings show that GPU afterlife is not universally sustainable - hardware repurposing must be strategically coupled with low carbon energy sources. When deployed in regions with favourable energy economics and clean electricity, second-hand GPUs offer a viable pathway for expanding AI capacity while advancing affordability, energy security, and environmental responsibility.

</details>


### [523] [Calibrated Trust, Not Sharper Prediction: An Empirical Test of Uncertainty Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14617)
*Surya Saka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过约4,750项测试，在1,000个真实欧洲人权法院案例上检验了将多种不确定性工具（证据图、贝叶斯赔率更新、Dempster-Shafer融合、保形预测）融合为一个pipeline用于案例结果预测的设想。研究发现：融合pipeline在区分能力上不优于直接使用LLM，且天真组合会严重破坏校准；Dempster-Shafer融合在长链推理中不安全。但该pipeline在运维层面确有价值——通过保形选择性预测层决定自动化与升级，经调优后可实现96.8%的自动判定准确率，仅0.5%错误漏过。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律AI领域中反复有人提议将多种不确定性推理工具（证据图、序贯贝叶斯赔率更新、Dempster-Shafer组合、保形预测）融合为单一pipeline以改进案件结果预测。作者旨在系统性地检验这一融合提案是否真正有效，以及其在预测精度之外的价值所在。

Method: 使用来自LexGLUE和FairLex的1,000个真实欧洲人权法院案例，基于事实段落预测法院是否认定公约违规。比较三个族系：原始LLM、经融合pipeline路由的LLM、经相同pipeline的词频基线。评估使用两个前沿LLM（Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5）作为逐事实证据估计器，共约4,750项测试，指标包括AUROC和预期校准误差（ECE），并采用保形选择性预测层进行风险控制。

Result: (1) 在歧视案件中（AUROC约0.83）pipeline相比原始LLM或基线无改进，直接使用前沿LLM是最强判别器。(2) 天真组合LLM与贝叶斯赔率和Dempster-Shafer融合使ECE从约0.16翻倍至0.46，由先验失配机制驱动，在两个模型上均复现。(3) Dempster-Shafer融合在长链上不安全，会在低于偶然水平的准确率下自信地提交错误标签，建议移除。(4) pipeline的真正价值是运维性的：经保形选择性预测层路由后，在移除Dempster-Shafer、重新校准并应用类别条件风险控制后，调优引擎实现96.8%自动判定准确率，0.5%错误漏出，96.3%错误被捕获用于审查；未调优基线为85.9/3.8/72.1。

Conclusion: 这类不确定性融合pipeline在法律领域的贡献不是更锐利的预测能力，而是经过校准的信任（calibrated trust）——即决定哪些案件可以自动处理、哪些需要升级人工审查的操作层面的可靠决策机制，而非提升预测精度本身。

Abstract: A recurring proposal in legal AI is to improve case-outcome prediction by fusing uncertainty tools (evidence graphs with belief propagation, sequential Bayesian odds updating, Dempster-Shafer combination, and conformal prediction) into one pipeline. We test this on 1,000 real European Court of Human Rights cases from LexGLUE and FairLex, predicting whether the Court found a Convention violation from the case's fact paragraphs. We compare three families across two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5) as per-fact evidence estimators: (A) the raw LLM, (B) the LLM routed through the fusion pipeline, and (C) a term-frequency baseline through the same pipeline. Across roughly 4,750 tests we find: (1) on discrimination (AUROC around 0.83) the pipeline yields no improvement over either the raw LLM or the baseline; a frontier LLM used directly is the strongest single discriminator. (2) Naively composing an LLM with Bayesian-odds and Dempster-Shafer fusion more than doubles calibration error (ECE from about 0.16 to 0.46) via a prior-mismatch mechanism that replicates across both models. (3) Dempster-Shafer fusion is actively unsafe on long chains, committing confidently to wrong labels at below-chance accuracy; we recommend removing it. (4) The pipeline's genuine value is operational: routed through a conformal selective-prediction layer, the system decides which cases to automate and which to escalate. After removing Dempster-Shafer, recalibrating, and applying class-conditional risk control on the full 1,000-case set, the tuned engine auto-clears at 96.8 percent accuracy with 0.5 percent errors escaping and 96.3 percent caught for review, versus 85.9 / 3.8 / 72.1 for an untuned baseline. The contribution of such pipelines in law is calibrated trust, not sharper prediction.

</details>


### [524] [PIKFNO: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Physics Informed Kernel Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14619)
*Yuan Guo,Hanshu Chen,Zhuojia Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可解释的神经算子框架PIKFNO（Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator），通过将源自控制方程的物理信息核函数显式地整合到神经算子架构中，约束trunk网络，使其算子结构与无网格配点法中的核展开对齐，从而在少量训练数据下实现高预测精度、更好的可解释性和更强的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的神经算子（如DeepONet）依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且在小样本训练条件下泛化能力受限。作者希望通过显式引入物理信息核函数来弥补这一不足。

Method: PIKFNO将物理信息核函数（由控制方程推导而来）显式嵌入神经算子架构中，用于约束trunk网络。提供了两种核函数构造策略：一是直接从数据中学习核函数（学习到的核可视为非奇异基本解）；二是通过解析基本解的变换来构建核函数。

Result: 数值实验表明，PIKFNO在少量训练数据条件下取得了高预测精度，同时显著提升了可解释性，并展现出优越的泛化能力。

Conclusion: PIKFNO为开发高效、物理一致且可解释的神经算子提供了一条新途径，弥合了神经算子与经典无网格数值方法之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: This work proposes a new interpretable neural operator framework, termed the Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator (PIKFNO), which explicitly incorporates physics informed kernel functions derived from governing equations into the neural operator architecture. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which rely on deep networks to implicitly learn basis functions, PIKFNO constrains the trunk network through physics informed kernel functions, thereby aligning its operator structure with the kernel expansions used in meshless collocation methods. Two construction strategies are introduced: one learns kernel functions directly from data, where the learned kernel can be regarded as a nonsingular fundamental solution, while the other builds them through transformations of analytical fundamental solutions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that PIKFNO achieves high predictive accuracy with substantially improved interpretability and superior generalization under limited training data. The proposed framework offers a new pathway for developing efficient, physically consistent, and interpretable neural operators.

</details>


### [525] [Explaining Reinforcement Learning Decisions in Self-adaptive Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14620)
*Jasmina Gajcin,Juan C. Rosero,Ivana Dusparic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了EARL，一个Python库，用于在强化学习（RL）环境中生成反事实解释，通过探索"What-if"场景来阐明代理行为。该库支持在真实RL自适应系统中生成反事实解释，并在CitiBikes共享单车系统模拟中验证了其应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度RL策略依赖神经网络，缺乏透明性且难以理解，导致用户信任度降低和系统验证困难。虽然反事实解释在心理学研究中已被证明直观且用户友好，但在RL中的应用还很有限，现有实现通常仅限于玩具示例和基准测试。

Method: 设计并实现EARL（Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning）Python库，通过探索What-if场景比较可能的结果来生成反事实解释，从而阐明代理行为。该库设计用于支持现实RL自适应系统中的反事实解释生成。

Result: 在CitiBikes（一个自适应共享单车系统）模拟中展示了EARL的应用，并通过评估证明了其在真实应用中的性能表现。

Conclusion: EARL填补了RL反事实解释在现实应用中的空白，为RL策略提供了更直观、用户友好的透明性方案，从而有助于提升用户信任并简化系统验证。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been extensively used in autonomous and self-* systems, but RL policies, especially deep RL ones relying on neural networks, lack transparency and are difficult to understand. This can lead to diminished user trust, and makes for a more challenging verification of systems. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning (EARL), a Python library to produce counterfactual explanations in RL settings. This library allows the user to produce explanations by exploring What-if scenarios to clarify agent behavior by comparing possible outcomes. Counterfactual explanations have been shown to be intuitive and user-friendly in psychology research, but have only recently been explored in RL, with existing implementations usually limited to toy examples and benchmarks. EARL supports counterfactual explanation generation in realistic RL-based self-adaptive systems. To demonstrate its applicability, we demonstrate its use in a simulation of CitiBikes, a self-adaptive bike-sharing system, and we provide evaluations showing how it performs in real applications.

</details>


### [526] [Metaplasticity as adaptive gradient preconditioning for incremental learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14634)
*Isabelle Aguilar,Zayn Andre Zainal,Omid Kavehei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SynGAP 是一种基于适应性梯度预条件（adaptive gradient preconditioning）的无任务（task-free）持续学习框架，通过维护 Fisher 信息矩阵的指数移动平均来模拟生物突触元可塑性（metaplasticity），将动态元塑性状态转化为有界的乘法掩码以选择性地衰减对关键历史参数的梯度更新，从而有效缓解灾难性遗忘。在 Split CIFAR-100 上较 EWC++ 提升 4 倍准确率，较 Experience Replay 提升约 10%，在 CORe50 上达到约 68% 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物智能通过互补学习系统（CLS）和突触元可塑性避免灾难性遗忘，而现有神经网络持续学习方案要么依赖任务标签，要么产生大量内存开销，缺乏生物合理性。作者希望将局部化神经调控重新框架为优化驱动的过程，实现无需任务标签且内存高效的持续学习。

Method: SynGAP 框架：1) 以无任务方式维护数据连续流上 Fisher 信息矩阵的指数移动平均，模拟实时元可塑性；2) 在优化步骤中，将动态元塑性状态转化为有界的乘法掩码，对原始梯度进行预条件处理，选择性衰减对关键历史参数的更新；3) 将连续的生物元可塑性形式化为稳定的基于梯度的正则化。

Result: 在 Split CIFAR-100 基准上，SynGAP 相比 EWC++ 准确率提升 4 倍，相比 Experience Replay 提升近 10%；遗忘度量在两个方法上均降低超过 10%。在 CORe50 基准上达到约 68% 准确率，较优化器基线提升 10%。

Conclusion: SynGAP 通过数学形式化生物的连续元可塑性，提供了一种高度鲁棒且内存高效的持续学习解决方案，适用于边缘设备的自适应智能。

Abstract: Biological intelligence naturally prevents catastrophic forgetting through Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory, a macroscopic consolidation process driven at the local level by synaptic metaplasticity: the continuous, history-dependent neuromodulation of individual synapses. While artificial neural networks struggle with the stability-plasticity dilemma in non-stationary environments, existing solutions often require task labels or incur massive memory overhead, diverging from biological reality. Re-framing this localized neuromodulation as an optimization-driven process, we introduce $\textbf{SynGAP}$: $\textbf{Syn}$aptic $\textbf{G}$eometric $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{P}$reconditioning. SynGAP is a task-free continual learning framework based on adaptive gradient preconditioning. Rather than relying on explicit episodic triggers, SynGAP simulates real-time metaplasticity by maintaining an exponential moving average of the Fisher Information Matrix over a continuous data stream. During the optimization step, these dynamic metaplastic states are translated into a bounded multiplicative mask that preconditions raw gradients, selectively attenuating updates to critical historical parameters. Empirical evaluations demonstrate SynGAP's superior ability to mitigate catastrophic forgetting compared to established baselines. On the Split CIFAR-100 benchmark, SynGAP delivers a $4\times$ increase in accuracy compared to EWC++ and outperforms Experience Replay (ER) by almost $10\%$, while reducing the forgetting measure by over $10\%$ against both methods. Furthermore, on the CORe50 benchmark, SynGAP achieves about $68\%$, a $10\%$ improvement over optimizer baselines. By mathematically formalizing continuous biological metaplasticity as stable gradient-based regularization, SynGAP offers a highly robust and memory-efficient solution for adaptive intelligence at the edge.

</details>


### [527] [Fractional Optimizers Meet Fractal Activation Functions: An Empirical Study of Multi-Scale Optimization in Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14636)
*Sebastian Raubitzek,Georg Goldenits,Sebastian Schrittwieser,Philip König,Kevin Mallinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在统一实验框架下，系统研究了分数阶优化方法与分形激活函数之间的交互作用。在Ackley和Himmelblau基准曲面（含Weierstrass型扰动）以及十个分类数据集的前馈神经网络中，比较了多种分数阶优化器（正则化风格、显式/自适应记忆型）与传统及分形激活函数的组合。结果表明二者存在选择性配对：正则化风格分数缩放与特定分形激活在网络训练中表现良好，Grünwald-Letnikov记忆在扰动曲面上最有效，自适应记忆在多种情形下优于普通记忆替换，支持受控分数记忆作为有前景的方向而非通用替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分数阶优化方法和分形激活函数是两条独立改进神经网络训练的技术路线，但此前缺乏对二者交互作用的系统研究。作者希望在一个统一框架下考察这两类方法结合时的实际效果，以回答它们是互补增强还是互相干扰，从而为研究人员在组合使用这些技术时提供依据。

Method: 构建统一实验框架，在两类基准曲面（Ackley和Himmelblau，含标准形式和加性Weierstrass型扰动）上评估分数阶优化器家族，再进一步在十个分类数据集的前馈神经网络上，交叉组合常规激活与分形激活（基于自相似Weierstrass和Blancmange型函数的激活函数）以及多种优化器——包括标准方法、正则化风格优化器、显式记忆型和自适应记忆型分数阶优化器，以及文献中的其他代表性方法。

Result: 分数阶优化与分形激活存在有用但具选择性的配对关系。正则化风格的分数缩放与选定的分形激活在网络训练中表现良好；Grünwald-Letnikov记忆型优化器在扰动曲面上最为有效；自适应记忆在多个场景中优于普通记忆替换。

Conclusion: 分数阶优化与分形激活并非普适性改进，其效果具有明显的场景选择性和交互依赖性。受控的分数记忆（如自适应记忆）是一种有前景的改进方向，但不应被视为替代标准优化器的通用方案。未来研究应关注更精确的配对策略而非盲目组合。

Abstract: Fractional optimization methods and fractal activation functions are two independent directions for improving neural network training. Fractional optimizers extend first-order optimization through fractional derivatives and memory effects, whereas fractal activations introduce multi-scale nonlinear representations based on self-similar Weierstrass- and Blancmange-type functions. Here, we investigate their interaction within a unified experimental framework. We evaluate fractional optimizer families on Ackley and Himmelblau benchmark surfaces, in standard form and with additive Weierstrass-type perturbations, and then in feed-forward neural networks with conventional and fractal activations on ten classification datasets. The comparison includes standard methods, regularization-style optimizers, explicit and adaptive memory-based fractional optimizers, and other representative literature methods. Overall, fractional optimization and fractal activations show useful but selective pairings. Regularization-style fractional scaling performs well with selected fractal activations in network training, while Grünwald--Letnikov memory is most relevant on perturbed surfaces. Adaptive memory improves plain memory substitution in several cases, supporting controlled fractional memory as a promising direction rather than a universal replacement.

</details>


### [528] [Early Cycle Charge Trajectory Generative Prediction and Full Life Cycle Health Management of Iron-Chromium Flow Batteries Based on FlowBD-E1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14637)
*Suyang Zhuang,Zekun Jiang,Tianhang Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FlowBD-E1框架，一种面向工业33 kW铁铬液流电池的早期循环生成式预测框架，仅用前9个循环即可预测未来完整充放电V/I轨迹，联合MAPE为0.731%，SOH估计误差低于1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时储能电池需要在大量容量损失累积前检测退化，但现有电池寿命预测研究大多聚焦锂离子电池，或仅将老化压缩为标量容量/SOH标签，忽视了液流电池V/I轨迹中耦合退化过程的演变信息。

Method: FlowBD-E1结合多尺度卷积编码器、生命周期Transformer和年龄感知FiLM解码器，提出三种部署策略（SLE单步潜空间外推、RLF递归潜空间预测、TFU教师强迫更新），用前9个循环（共289个）生成未来完整V/I轨迹。

Result: RLF策略在剩余生命周期上实现联合V/I MAPE为0.731%，SOH估计MAPE低于1%；消融实验和独立序列测试表明年龄感知生成架构优于LSTM和TCN基线，在工业验证下保持亚百分比误差。

Conclusion: 早期循环轨迹生成可将短暂的调试记录转化为长时程诊断信号，为液流电池管理提供新途径，证明从少量早期数据即可获得高精度全生命周期预测。

Abstract: Long-duration stationary energy storage requires batteries whose degradation can be detected before substantial capacity loss has accumulated. Iron-chromium redox flow batteries are attractive for this role because they use abundant and low-cost active species, yet their operation is shaped by slow chromium kinetics, hydrogen evolution, membrane crossover and electrolyte imbalance. These coupled processes gradually reshape the full charge voltage/current (V/I) trajectory, but most battery prognostic studies either focus on lithium-ion cells or compress ageing into scalar capacity and state-of-health (SOH) labels. Here we study an industrial 33 kW Fe-Cr redox flow battery and introduce FlowBD-E1, an early-cycle generative forecasting framework that predicts complete future charge V/I trajectories from only the first few cycles. The model combines a multi-scale convolutional encoder, a lifecycle Transformer and an age-aware FiLM decoder, and we compare three deployment strategies: single-step latent extrapolation (SLE), recursive latent forecasting (RLF) and teacher-forced updating (TFU). Using the first 9 of 289 cycles, RLF achieved a joint V/I mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 0.731% over the remaining lifecycle and produced SOH estimates below 1% MAPE. Ablation and independent-sequence tests showed that the age-aware generative architecture outperformed LSTM and TCN baselines and retained sub-percent errors under industrial validation. These results suggest that early-cycle trajectory generation can turn a short commissioning record into a long-horizon diagnostic signal for flow-battery management.

</details>


### [529] [Randomly initialized autoencoders: fixed points and edge-of-chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14638)
*Leonid Berlyand,Roman Sarapin,Yitzchak Shmalo,Victor Slavin,Sasha Sodin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过不动点理论研究自编码器（一类特殊的深度神经网络），利用压缩映射性质分析其不动点的存在性、稳定性与吸引域，并引入局部和全局"混沌边缘"（Edge-of-Chaos）概念来刻画自编码器对输入扰动的鲁棒性。局部EoC基于随机矩阵理论的谱技术分析，全局EoC则借助高斯过程的Sudakov-Fernique不等式研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自编码器作为一种特殊的深度神经网络，其性能可以通过不动点来表征，这自然引出了不动点存在性、稳定性及吸引域等基础问题。同时，EoC概念此前已在多种神经网络中通过均值场平均方法引入，但尚未针对自编码器进行专门定义和理论分析，因此有必要将EoC概念适配到自编码器的研究框架中。

Method: 本文首先利用自编码器的压缩性质（contractive properties）来研究其不动点的存在性、稳定性和吸引域。在此基础上，提出局部EoC和全局EoC两个概念：局部EoC控制输入的小扰动，采用随机矩阵理论的谱分析技术；全局EoC控制输入的任意扰动，利用Sudakov-Fernique不等式对高斯过程进行分析。

Result: 成功为自编码器定义了局部和全局两种EoC概念，并通过随机矩阵理论谱方法和Sudakov-Fernique不等式分别对这两种EoC进行了理论分析，建立了自编码器不动点稳定性与EoC临界状态之间的理论联系。

Conclusion: 本文将EoC概念从一般深度神经网络扩展到自编码器，通过随机矩阵理论和高斯过程不等式建立了自编码器不动点稳定性分析的完整理论框架，为理解和设计处于临界状态的自编码器提供了理论基础。

Abstract: In this paper we study autoencoders, a special class of deep neural nets (DNNs) whose performance can be characterized via their fixed points. This perspective naturally raises questions of existence, stability, and basins of attraction of these fixed points. These questions are addressed via the contractive properties of autoencoders, and are closely related to the notion of edge-of-chaos.
  Edge-of-chaos (EoC) is an important notion in the theory of DNNs. It describes the critical regime separating ordered and chaotic signal propagation through a randomly initialized network. Initialization at or near this critical regime offers several theoretical and practical advantages, including stability of the network w.r.t. perturbations of the input. EoC was previously introduced for broad classes of neural networks using mean-field averaging methods. In this paper we modify the notion of EoC for the study of autoencoders. Specifically, we introduce local and global EoC for autoencoders that control local (small) and global (arbitrary) perturbations of the input respectively.
  The study of stability of autoencoders falls within the scope of nonlinear problems in Random Matrix Theory (RMT). Our analysis of local EoC is based on spectral techniques of RMT, whereas global EoC is studied by employing Sudakov-Fernique inequality for Gaussian processes.

</details>


### [530] [Valid Per-Field Selective Risk Control for Document Extraction: Three Failure Modes, a Validity Ladder, and When Conditioning Pays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14639)
*Bhaskar Gurram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究文档抽取系统中"按字段接受/审核"流程的选择性风险控制问题。在13,859个Claude-Sonnet-5真实字段上诊断出三种失效模式（文档聚类、分数重拟合泄漏、平局质量病态），并提出"有效性阶梯"（validity ladder）框架，包含三类保证级别的修复方案。其中Mondrian Learn-then-Test方法提供分组PAC证书，是唯一能匹配真实文档结构的方案，但当前尚接近平凡下界；支持箱（Support-bin）方法在Sonnet捕获上赢得所有严格性层级的对比，但在其他模型上无法复现。论文还通过冻结配置确认、三标注者人工金标审计（Fleiss' kappa=0.83，实测风险1.3%对10%预算）验证实际层的风险控制。代码以Apache-2.0协议发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档抽取系统需要对"按字段接受/审核"操作提供选择性风险控制（接受字段的错误率≤alpha），这是此类系统所需的信任契约。但自然做法在真实文档上会静默地违反该契约，因此需要系统的诊断、修复方案与保障形式化。

Method: ①在13,859个真实字段上诊断三种失败模式：文档聚类（design effect 1.84-2.45）、分数重拟合泄漏（coverage 0.416时risk 0.127，违反alpha=0.10）、平局质量病态（退化分数使阈值网格崩塌）。②提出"有效性阶梯"，按层级规定保证形式：fit/val分割协议恢复学习融合的期望选择性风险控制；Mondrian Learn-then-Test结合精确二项尾部给出逐组PAC证书；支持箱方法作为预指定的来源分类法。

Result: fit/val协议：coverage 0.318、risk 0.096（名义alpha=0.10），生产变体coverage 0.326，但在47.5%重分割中实现风险超过alpha因此只是平均意义而非证书。Mondrian方法：field-iid下coverage 0.171/risk 0.068，聚类校正0.140，doc-iid下0.060——唯一能匹配文档结构的层级但诚实而言接近平凡。支持箱在Sonnet CORD上赢得所有严格性层级（p<1e-4, Bonferroni校正），但该优势在haiku/qwen上不复现；高精度语料上池化阈值胜出。验证：冻结配置在haiku-4-5上两个风险水平均通过；人工审计实测1.3%风险对10%预算。

Conclusion: 文档抽取的选择性风险控制不能用单一"一刀切"方法解决，必须按保证强度分层（阶梯式框架）。没有任何单一方法在所有条件下占优：条件化方法（支持箱）在需要认证时有用且在Sonnet上获胜，但优势不跨模型泛化；池化方法在更高精度时更好；PAC证书方法虽然严谨但在真实文档结构下慷慨地近乎平凡。选择方法取决于准确度水平、模型与所需保证类型。

Abstract: Per-field accept/review with selective risk at most alpha -- accept a field only if the error rate among accepted fields is controlled -- is the trust contract document-extraction systems need, and the natural procedure silently violates it on real documents. On 13,859 genuine claude-sonnet-5 fields from 800 CORD receipts (49.0% correct) we diagnose three failure modes: document clustering (design effect 1.84-2.45), score-refit leakage (coverage 0.416 at risk 0.127, violating alpha=0.10 in 95% of splits), and a tie-mass pathology (a degenerate score collapses the threshold grid, 0.030 to 0.001). We organize the fixes as a validity ladder, guarantee form stated per tier. A fit/val split protocol restores expected-selective-risk control for a learned fusion: coverage 0.318 at risk 0.096 at nominal alpha=0.10, no tolerance band (production variant 0.326) -- an on-average point whose realized risk exceeds alpha in 47.5% of resplits, not a certificate. Mondrian Learn-then-Test with exact binomial tails yields per-group PAC certificates: field-iid 0.171 at risk 0.068, cluster-corrected 0.140, doc-iid 0.060 -- the only tier matching documents, honestly near-vacuous today. Support-bin, the pre-specified provenance taxonomy, wins every rigor tier on the sonnet CORD capture (p<1e-4, Bonferroni-corrected) -- a win that does not replicate on the same documents under haiku or qwen -- while on higher-accuracy corpora pooled thresholds win: conditioning helps exactly where pooled cannot certify, subsumed by a learned score elsewhere. A frozen-configuration confirmation on selection-untouched claude-haiku-4-5 held at both risk levels, and a blind three-annotator human-gold audit verifies the practical tier's accepted-set risk at 1.3% against its 10% budget (Fleiss' kappa=0.83; labels err one-sidedly pessimistic). Released Apache-2.0 with seed-pinned, regression-gated procedures.

</details>


### [531] [BDIP-Net: Dual-Interaction Graph Learning for Property Prediction of Bilayer Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14640)
*An Vuong,Chen Zhao,Jin Hu,Shui-Qing Yu,Xintao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一套基于机器学习的双层堆叠材料构建与性质预测框架，包含MatterSim-D3结构优化流程和BDIP-Net图神经网络，在多个数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双层堆叠材料具有丰富的堆叠依赖性质，但计算发现这类材料面临两大挑战：高质量结构生成依赖昂贵的DFT优化，而现有机器学习模型在性质预测时未能显式区分层内与层间相互作用类型。

Method: 1) 采用基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化工作流，从单层构建块和堆叠构型出发，以大幅降低的计算成本生成DFT质量的双层结构；2) 提出BDIP-Net（双层双相互作用势网络），一种图神经网络，通过相互作用特异的势表示和自适应消息融合显式建模层内与层间相互作用。

Result: 在BiDB、HetDB和SAMBA三个数据集上（涵盖同质双层、异质双层和扭转双层体系），MatterSim-D3工作流紧密复现了DFT-PBE-D3优化的结构；BDIP-Net在双层性质预测上持续优于现有图神经网络和基于势函数的方法。

Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了双层堆叠材料计算发现中结构生成成本高和相互作用类型识别不足的问题，为精确高效的双层材料性质预测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Stacked bilayer materials exhibit rich stacking-dependent properties driven by the interplay between strong intra-layer bonding and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions. The computational discovery of such materials is challenging because accurate structure generation typically relies on expensive DFT-based optimization, while existing machine-learning models often fail to explicitly distinguish different interaction types during property prediction. To address these challenges, we propose a machine-learning framework for efficient construction and property prediction of stacked bilayer materials. The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost. For property prediction, we introduce BDIP-Net (Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network), a graph neural network that explicitly models intra-layer and inter-layer interactions through interaction-specific potential representations and adaptive message fusion. We evaluate the proposed framework on BiDB, HetDB, and SAMBA, encompassing homobilayers, heterobilayers, and twisted bilayer systems. Results show that the MatterSim-D3-based workflow closely reproduces DFT-PBE-D3 optimized structures, while BDIP-Net consistently outperforms existing graph neural network and potential-based approaches for bilayer property prediction.

</details>


### [532] [Training and Evaluating Ethical Reinforcement Learning Agents on Per-Episode Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14642)
*Prabhjyot Singh,Majid Ghasemi,Mark Crowley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨了强化学习智能体在训练中利用奖励设计漏洞、将伦理违规集中到少数坏回合中"平均上看起来道德"的问题。作者在Craftax基准上比较了四种训练方法（标量惩罚+终止、线性多目标权重扫描、自适应拉格朗日约束、基于ESR准则的回合级非补偿性效用优化），发现它们在均值前沿上无法区分，但在回合级分布上差异显著。ESR智能体能在几乎所有回合中维持预算内一次违规（最差十分位1.04±0.07），拉格朗日方法会轻微泄漏（1.14±0.03），权重扫描的最差回合违规翻倍（2.20±0.20）。结论是当伦理违规不能跨回合平均化时，训练和评估都应针对回合级分布而非均值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL智能体基于单一奖励信号训练时，会利用设计奖励与预期行为之间的差距。在注入伦理行为时，智能体可以"平均上看起来道德"而将违规集中在少数回合中——一个回合中对环境实体的伤害无法被另一个回合的良好行为所补偿。这揭示了以均值为目标的训练和评估协议的深层缺陷。

Method: 在Craftax开放生存基准上比较四种方法：(1) 标量惩罚+终止；(2) 线性多目标权重扫描；(3) 自适应拉格朗日约束；(4) 基于期望标量化回报（ESR）准则的每回合非补偿性效用优化。所有方法使用统一的基于检测器的协议，对每个回合的每次违规都不加审查地计数。同时设置观测增强控制实验来区分训练目标和观测内容的影响。

Result: 四种方法在平均回报与平均违规率的均值前沿上无法区分，但在回合级分布上显著分离。在匹配的均值回报下，ESR智能体能在几乎所有回合中维持预算（最差十分位1.04±0.07违规），拉格朗日方法泄漏超出预算（1.14±0.03），权重扫描的最差回合违规翻倍（2.20±0.20）。观测增强控制实验表明分离归因于训练目标而非观测差异，且回合级保证在均值前沿上不损失性能。

Conclusion: 当伦理违规不能跨回合平均化时（一个回合的道德无法补偿另一个回合的伤害），训练和评估都必须以回合级分布为目标，而非仅仅关注均值。ESR准则为每回合伦理预算提供了最可靠的保证，而传统方法即使均值表现相当，在分布尾部也可能严重违约。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents trained on a single reward signal exploit the gap between the designed reward and the intended behavior. This is particularly a problem when we are trying to imbue ethical behavior into RL agents. An agent can look ethical on average while concentrating its violations in a few bad episodes, and a creature in the environment harmed in one episode is not restored by good conduct in another. We compare four ways of training ethical behavior in Craftax, an open-ended survival benchmark. The four are: scalar penalties with termination, a linear multi-objective weight sweep, an adaptive Lagrangian constraint, and a non-compensatory utility optimized per episode under the Expected Scalarized Returns (ESR) criterion. All are evaluated under a single detector-based protocol that counts every violation in every episode without censoring. On the frontier of mean return against mean violation rate, the four methods are indistinguishable; per episode they separate sharply. At matched mean return, the ESR agent holds its stated budget of one violation in effectively every episode (worst-decile 1.04 +/- 0.07 violations), the Lagrangian leaks past the same budget (1.14 +/- 0.03), and the weight sweep's worst episodes double it (2.20 +/- 0.20). An observation-augmentation control attributes the separation to the training objective rather than to what the agent observes, and the per-episode guarantee costs nothing on the mean frontier. When ethical violations do not average away across episodes, we argue both training and evaluation must target the per-episode distribution rather than the mean.

</details>


### [533] [DUET: Dual-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Same-Weight Disagreement for Prohibition Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14644)
*Zihan Li,Feifei Li,Wenhui Que*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DUET 是一种基于token选择的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过配对两个仅禁制可见性不同的教师模型，利用它们之间的token级分歧作为监督信号，实现禁止性合规学习。在1.5B-8B Qwen模型上达到72.3-85.2%违规合规率，同时保持88-93%正常效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实LLM部署依赖运行时注入的禁止性策略（企业政策、PII红线、工具边界），这些策略随请求和租户变化。传统后训练方法不适合此任务：SFT将违规信号隐藏在合规标签中，DPO的序列级偏好与token级违规不匹配。

Method: DUET采用token选择性在线策略蒸馏（OPD）。核心思想是配对两个同权重的教师模型：一个能看到禁止性策略（正样本），一个看不到（负样本）。由于两教师仅禁制可见性不同，它们的token级分歧可分离出禁制的因果效应，形成不受模型能力或失配污染的干净监督信号。该分歧驱动两个互补机制：信号清洗（丢弃冗余或前缀污染的同意token）和偏好导向学习（在token粒度上推动学生远离负教师、靠近正教师，将DPO风格优化嵌入OPD，无需离线偏好数据）。

Result: 构建了涵盖5个任务族（显式拒绝、释义鲁棒性、过度拒绝等）的工业级Prohibition-Compliance基准。在1.5B-8B Qwen变体上，DUET实现72.3-85.2%违规合规率，同时保留88-93%正常效用，显著优于教师模型和其他蒸馏基线。在SysBench外部评估中确认了安全对齐改善，GSM8K和MATH-500仅有最小退化。

Conclusion: DUET通过教师对间的token级分歧提取干净的禁制因果信号，在token粒度上实现偏好优化，有效解决了运行时注入禁止性策略的合规问题，兼顾了合规率与正常能力保持。

Abstract: Real-world LLM deployments increasingly rely on runtime-injected prohibitions--enterprise policies, PII redlines, tool boundaries--that vary per request and per tenant. Conventional post-training is structurally ill-suited: SFT hides the violation signal in compliant labels, and DPO's sequence-level preferences mismatch token-localized violations. We propose DUET, a token-selective on-policy distillation method for prohibition compliance. DUET pairs a teacher that sees the prohibition (positive) with an identical-weight teacher that does not (negative). Because the two teachers differ only in prohibition visibility, their per-token disagreement isolates the prohibition's causal effect--yielding a clean supervision signal uncontaminated by model capacity or mismatch. This disagreement drives two complementary mechanisms: signal cleaning, which discards agreement tokens as redundant or prefix-corrupted, and preference-directed learning, which pushes the student away from the negative teacher and toward the positive one at token granularity, embedding DPO-style optimization directly into OPD without offline preference data. We construct an industrial Prohibition-Compliance benchmark spanning five task families covering explicit-refusal, paraphrase robustness, and over-refusal. Across 1.5B-8B Qwen variants, DUET achieves 72.3-85.2% violation compliance while preserving 88-93% normal utility, dramatically outperforming teacher model and other distillation baselines. External evaluation on SysBench confirms improved safety alignment with minimal degradation on GSM8K and MATH-500.

</details>


### [534] [Efficient Neural-Network-Based High-Resolution Radiative Transfer for CO___ Retrieval, and Application to Interferometric Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14645)
*Jordan Lontsi Tedongmo,Yann Ferrec,Laurence Croizé,Pablo Musé,Gabriele Facciolo,Andrés Almansa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对气候监测中对CO2和CH4排放估算精度和覆盖范围的需求，在SCARBOn项目背景下，提出一种基于前馈多层感知机（MLP）的辐射传输代理模型，用于高效准确地预测CO2弱波段的星载顶部大气辐射，并结合NanoCarb仪器响应，为CO2浓度反演提供高效精确的正演模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化研究要求降低CO2和CH4排放估算的不确定性，以更好区分人为源与自然源，这推动了具有更高重访频率和空间覆盖的星载测量需求。然而，全物理反演算法依赖高分辨率逐线辐射传输模型，计算成本高昂，难以满足高重访和高空间覆盖下的快速反演需求，亟需高效的辐射传输替代方案。

Method: 提出一种前馈多层感知机（MLP）代理模型，用于快速准确地预测CO2弱波段大气顶部辐射。模型采用辐射值与RT雅可比矩阵的联合平均绝对误差（MAE）损失函数进行训练，以同时保证光谱精度和对地球物理参数的敏感性。将MLP驱动的RT代理模型与NanoCarb成像干涉仪的仪器响应函数耦合，构建完整高效的NanoCarb正演模型。

Result: 所提出的MLP辐射传输代理模型在预测CO2弱波段辐射方面表现出良好的精度与效率，与NanoCarb仪器响应耦合后形成的正演模型在CO2浓度反演中展现出有前景的结果。

Conclusion: 基于MLP的辐射传输代理模型能够显著降低计算成本，同时保持对CO2反演所需的光谱精度和物理敏感性，为低成本卫星星座快速监测CO2提供了可行且高效的正演建模方案。

Abstract: Studying climate change requires reducing uncertainties in CO2 and CH4 emission estimates to better distinguish anthropogenic from natural sources, which motivates spaceborne measurements with improved revisit frequency and spatial coverage. In this context, the Horizon Europe SCARBOn project assesses a low-cost satellite constellation featuring the NanoCarb imaging interferometer as its core sensor for monitoring CO2 and CH4 emissions in the atmosphere. However, estimating CO2 and CH4 concentrations with high revisit and spatial coverage poses significant challenges: full-physics retrieval algorithms commonly used rely on repeated high-resolution radiative transfer (RT) simulations, which are computationally expensive when using line-by-line RT models. As an alternative, we propose in this study a feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) surrogate designed to accurately and efficiently predict top-of-atmosphere radiances in the CO2 weak band, using a combined mean absolute error (MAE) loss on radiances and RT Jacobians to preserve both spectral accuracy and sensitivity to geophysical parameters. Coupling the MLP-based RT surrogate with the NanoCarb instrumental response yields an efficient and precise forward model for NanoCarb measurements, which shows promising results for CO2 concentration retrieval.

</details>


### [535] [iFuzz-Meta: An Interpretable Fuzzy Learning Framework Bridging Top-Down and Bottom-Up Knowledge Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14646)
*Xiaowei Jiang,Daniel Leong,Beining Cao,Nan Zhou,Yingtao Ren,Yu-Cheng Chang,Thomas Do,Chin-Teng Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出iFuzz-Meta，一个可解释的模糊规则学习框架，通过将每条模糊规则映射到原始特征空间中的语义与空间原型，在保持透明推理的同时融入元学习与知识引导正则化，实现跨域泛化与可解释推理的统一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经计算中可解释表示学习仍是关键挑战，模型不仅需要执行任务还需要解释其推理过程。现有方法难以在保持高性能的同时维持人类可理解的推理结构，缺乏将理论先验与数据驱动学习有效整合的机制。

Method: iFuzz-Meta包含三个核心组件：(1) 模糊规则学习框架，每条规则对应原始特征空间中的语义与空间原型，实现透明可解释的推理；(2) 元学习范式，用于分析可解释规则如何在任务和领域间重组，将算法适应与认知表征联系起来；(3) 知识引导正则化机制，实现自上而下与自下而上的双向整合，理论先验作为软归纳偏置，数据驱动学习对其进行细化与扩展。

Result: 实验评估表明iFuzz-Meta实现了可解释推理和稳定的跨域泛化，验证了模糊规则重组的有效性以及知识引导正则化对适应轨迹的约束作用。

Conclusion: iFuzz-Meta为可解释、知识感知的模糊系统提供了一条潜在的一般性路径，证明了在神经架构中保留人类可理解推理结构的同时实现跨任务、跨领域稳定适应的可行性。

Abstract: Interpretable representation learning remains a key challenge in modern neural computation, particularly when models are expected not only to perform but also to explain their reasoning. This paper introduces iFuzz-Meta, an interpretable fuzzy rule-based learning framework that preserves human-understandable reasoning structures within modern neural architectures. Each fuzzy rule corresponds to a semantic and spatial prototype defined in the original feature space, enabling transparent inference and direct interpretability. Meta-learning is employed as an analytical paradigm to examine how these interpretable rules reorganize across tasks and domains, providing a principled means to link algorithmic adaptation with cognitive representation. A knowledge-guided regularization mechanism further enables a top-down-bottom-up integration, in which theoretical priors act as soft inductive biases while data-driven learning refines and extends them. This dual process ensures that adaptation proceeds along semantically and physiologically meaningful trajectories, rather than arbitrary parameter shifts. Evaluations demonstrate that iFuzz-Meta achieves interpretable reasoning and stable cross-domain generalization, establishing a potential general pathway toward explainable and knowledge-aware fuzzy systems.

</details>


### [536] [SMOPD: Selective Token-Entropy Masking for Dirty-History Multi-Turn On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14647)
*Chenyang Jiang,Changhan Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SMOPD（选择掩蔽在线策略蒸馏），一种仅作用于损失函数的稳定化方法，用于多轮在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）。该方法按学生熵排名中间轮次生成的token，从裁剪的广义Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失中移除熵最低的20% token，解决"脏历史"回滚导致的OPSD脆弱性问题。在LiC基准上用Qwen3模型验证，SMOPD在1.7B、4B和8B规模上使SHARDED视图准确率提升1.0-2.5个百分点，而基于最终答案正确性的标量缩放方法在不同规模下表现不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）存在"脏历史回滚"的固有脆弱性：学生产生错误的中间回复后，后续轮次的条件会基于该错误回复，统一蒸馏会在携带少量纠正信号的token上浪费损失。现有方法要么忽略此问题，要么依赖粗粒度的轨迹结果（如最终答案正确性）作为可靠度信号，缺乏对token级不确定性的细粒度建模。

Method: SMOPD的核心设计包括：(1) 对每个生成的中间轮次回复，按学生token的熵对所有位置排序，移除熵最低的20% token，使其不参与裁剪的广义Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失；(2) 最终答案损失和完整的保留损失（FULL-preservation loss）保持不变；(3) 对比设置使用正确性缩放变体，即用最终答案正确性作为共享的分离可靠度代理来缩放损失。该方法无新增参数，推理时零开销。

Result: 在LiC基准上使用Qwen3模型，SMOPD在1.7B、4B和8B单种子比较中使SHARDED视图准确率提升1.0-2.5个百分点；4B多种子检验显示平均+1.7pp的SHARDED提升（双尾p=0.022）。仅添加结果标量在1.7B上有害（-4.0pp），与掩蔽结合时仍依赖规模（4B上+1.3pp，1.7B中性，8B上-0.5pp）。

Conclusion: token级不确定性是比标量最终答案正确性更可靠的稳定化信号。实验结果来自归档的聚合数据，缺乏因果机制测试和更广泛基准验证，这些留待未来工作。

Abstract: Dirty-history rollouts make multi-turn on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) brittle: once a student emits an erroneous intermediate reply, later turns are conditioned on that reply, and uniform distillation can spend loss on tokens that carry little corrective signal. We introduce SMOPD (Selective Masking for On-Policy Distillation), a loss-only stabilization method for multi-turn OPSD. For each generated middle-turn reply, SMOPD ranks token positions by student entropy and removes the lowest-entropy 20% from the clipped generalized Jensen-Shannon distillation loss; final-answer and FULL-preservation losses are unchanged. This design targets token-level uncertainty rather than coarse trajectory outcomes, adds no parameters, and has zero inference-time overhead. We compare SMOPD with a correctness-scaling variant that multiplies a common detached reliability proxy using final-answer correctness. On LiC with Qwen3 models, SMOPD improves SHARDED-view accuracy by 1.0-2.5 percentage points in single-seed 1.7B, 4B, and 8B comparisons, and a small 4B multi-seed check shows a +1.7pp mean SHARDED gain over baseline (two-tailed p = 0.022). Adding the outcome scalar is harmful without masking at 1.7B (-4.0pp) and remains scale-dependent when combined with masking (+1.3pp at 4B, neutral at 1.7B, and -0.5pp at 8B). These archived aggregate results suggest that token-level uncertainty is a more reliable stabilization signal than scalar final-answer correctness in this evaluated dirty-history OPSD setting, while leaving causal mechanism tests and broader benchmark validation to future work.

</details>


### [537] [Discrete Diffusion Language Models Are Training-Free Multi-Label Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14649)
*Pawan Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 dLLM-SetScore，一种无需训练的基于离散掩码扩散语言模型的多标签文本分类方法。通过每个标签的短是非问题比较掩码位置两个答案标记的概率；无需微调或文本蕴含数据训练，仅用200个标注验证样本选择阈值、温度和提示措辞。发现将所有标签放在同一提示中会产生槽位位置不对称（首个答案槽在GoEmotions上99.4%被预测为正），逐标签评分使预测对标签顺序不变。在六数据集上对比NLI模型、自回归LLM、SetFit和监督分类器，指令微调检查点在10次比较中9次提升宏F1、8次提升微F1。证明置换不变性，刻画加权汉明损失下的阈值决策，并推导短名单的召回率与F1上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有掩码扩散语言模型在多标签文本分类中的零样本/训练自由能力尚未被充分探索；同时将所有标签放入同一提示会导致槽位位置不对称伪影，使模型产生严重的首位偏好偏差。作者旨在开发一种无训练、无NLI数据集依赖的多标签分类方法，并系统分析其理论性质。

Method: 提出训练自由的dLLM-SetScore方法：对每个候选标签构造简短是非问题，在掩码位置比较两个答案标记（yes/no）的概率；通过200示例的标注验证集选择阈值、温度和提示措辞。采用逐标签评分（per-label scoring）使每个标签处于相同的句法位置以消除槽位不对称。提供置换不变性的理论证明、加权汉明损失下的阈值决策刻画，并导出短名单的召回率与F1理论上限。另探索了局部联合集合精炼（Local Joint Set Refinement）步骤，作为负面结果保留。

Result: 在六个数据集上评估LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B：指令微调检查点在5个共享数据集上10次比较中9次提高宏F1、8次提高微F1；LLaDA-Instruct在Reuters和ECtHR上取得最高的训练自由值。同时验证了槽位位置不对称伪影的严重性（GoEmotions上99.4%和Reuters上100%的首槽正预测率），表明逐标签评分方法的必要性与有效性。

Conclusion: dLLM-SetScore作为一种无需训练的掩码扩散语言模型多标签分类方法，通过逐标签评分有效规避了槽位位置不对称问题，并具备置换不变性等良好理论性质。指令微调可显著提升性能；局部联合集合精炼步骤未能改善性能，被作为负面结果记录。

Abstract: We present dLLM-SetScore, a training-free method that uses discrete masked-diffusion language models for multi-label text classification. For each candidate label, it asks a short yes/no question and compares the probabilities of the two answer tokens at one masked position. The method uses no task-specific fine-tuning or training on textual-entailment datasets; a 200-example labelled validation slice selects thresholds, temperature, and prompt wording.
  We first show that placing all labels in one prompt creates a strong slot-position asymmetry: the first answer slot is predicted positive on $99.4\%$ of GoEmotions examples and $100\%$ of Reuters examples. Per-label scoring places every label in the same syntactic position, making predictions invariant to label order and avoiding this artifact. We evaluate LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B on six datasets against NLI models, an autoregressive LLM, SetFit, and supervised classifiers. On the five datasets shared by both diffusion families, Instruct checkpoints improve macro-F1 in 9 of 10 comparisons and micro-F1 in 8 of 10, although these comparisons do not identify the cause. Within our protocol, LLaDA-Instruct records the highest training-free values for both Reuters and ECtHR metrics. We prove permutation invariance, characterize thresholded decisions under weighted Hamming loss, and derive shortlist ceilings for recall and F1. An exploratory local Joint Set Refinement step lowers F1 from biased and unbiased initializations and is retained as a negative result.

</details>


### [538] [Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation of a Prediction-Derived Medium-to-Full World-Model Cascade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14650)
*Malo de Pastor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种配对评估与审计协议，在物理结果完全重置的条件下，检验Medium派生接口能否预测何时切换到冻结的Full预测器能降低任务决策损失并弥补序贯开销。在PushT V106和V107数据集上（共3,200状态、39任务、三组检查点对），该预测接口路由器相对于独立Medium、独立Full及延迟优势的任务路由器降低了包含开销的决策成本，但仅限低计算价格场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应推理和世界-动作模型系统依赖廉价阶段输出或预测未来来分配额外计算，但这些方法缺乏在配对物理结果重置下对路由决策目标的严格评估。本文聚焦一个更窄的问题：在成对的精确重置物理结果条件下，Medium派生接口能否判断何时切换到冻结的Full预测器，使其任务特定决策损失的改善足以抵消序贯计算开销。

Method: 提出配对评估与审计协议：(1) 所有候选动作从相同重置状态执行；(2) Medium和Full作用于相同候选集与任务；(3) 配对的物理损失差值定义路由目标。在PushT V106（1,600状态、39任务、三组检查点对）上训练冻结预测接口路由器，随后在V107（1,600状态）上针对更强的当前状态控制（包含任务、维度匹配的当前DINO特征投影及全部五个候选动作，且不收取DINO编码器延迟）进行前瞻性验证，并用受控PyBullet审计独立支持复合任务-预测-机制路由器。

Result: 预测接口将定价物理决策成本降低0.002549（状态聚类95%区间[-0.002867, -0.002238]；单侧95%上界-0.002286），三组检查点对均为负效应。受控PyBullet审计独立支持复合任务-预测-机制路由器。但序贯路由器仍比固定策略更慢，优势仅限于低计算价格场景。

Conclusion: 证据支持测试的预测接口在超越刻意偏袒的当前DINO控制之外提供了增量路由信息，但不足以证明因果充分性、计算节省、闭环价值或跨系列通用性。

Abstract: Existing adaptive-inference and world-action-model systems use cheap-stage outputs or predicted futures to allocate additional computation. We study a narrower question: under paired exact-reset physical outcomes, can a Medium-derived interface predict when switching to a separately frozen Full predictor improves task-specific decision loss enough to justify sequential overhead? Our contribution is a paired evaluation and audit protocol, not a new generic routing rule: all candidate actions are executed from the same reset state, Medium and Full act on the same candidate set and task, and their paired physical-loss difference defines the routing target. On a fresh PushT bank (V106; 1,600 states, 39 tasks, three checkpoint pairs), a frozen prediction-interface router lowers overhead-inclusive decision cost relative to standalone Medium, standalone Full, and a latency-advantaged task-only router. We then prospectively seal a second 1,600-state PushT confirmation (V107) against a stronger current-state control using the task, a dimension-matched projection of current DINO features, and all five candidate actions, with no DINO encoder latency charged. The prediction interface lowers priced physical decision cost by 0.002549 (state-clustered 95% interval [-0.002867, -0.002238]; one-sided 95% upper bound -0.002286), with negative effects for all three checkpoint pairs. A controlled-PyBullet audit independently supports a composite task-prediction-regime router. The sequential router remains slower than fixed policies, and its advantage is restricted to low compute prices. The evidence supports incremental routing information in the tested prediction interface beyond one deliberately favoured current-DINO control, but not causal sufficiency, compute saving, closed-loop value, or cross-family generality.

</details>


### [539] [Pushing the Limits of High-Resolution Weather Forecasting through Data Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14652)
*Yang Zhao,Peisong Niu,Tian Zhou,Ziqing Ma,Guanlong Ma,Rong Jin,Huiling Yuan,Liang Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对0.1°高分辨率全球天气预报模型因高分辨率数据稀缺而受限的问题，提出BaguanHR框架，将焦点从模型迁移转向数据迁移，通过变量级超分辨率合成大量0.1° ERA5数据来扩增训练集，在72小时内超过85%的预报时效上优于现有ML方法和IFS-HRES，并揭示了数据量翻倍分别使72小时和120小时预报RMSE降低4.6%和4.9%的幂律缩放效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发基于机器学习的0.1°高分辨率全球天气预报模型受到高分辨率数据稀缺的制约（数十年再分析资料仅有0.25°分辨率）。现有的方法是对0.25°预报模型在有限的0.1°样本上进行微调，但研究发现这种迁移受到粗分辨率预报中不可避免的不可逆信息损失的限制。因此需要一种新的方案来突破这一数据瓶颈。

Method: BaguanHR框架的核心思想是从"迁移模型"转向"迁移数据"。首先论证超分辨率（SR）相比预报具有更低的条件熵和输入放大效应，因此更适合作为分辨率迁移的载体。利用这一优势，通过变量级（variable-wise）超分辨率从ERA5中合成了大量0.1°数据，将合成数据与真实数据结合构成训练集。

Result: BaguanHR在合成加真实数据集上的性能超过了ML方法和IFS-HRES，在72小时内的超过85%的预报时效上表现更优。同时发现幂律缩放效应：数据量翻倍使72小时预报RMSE降低4.6%，120小时预报RMSE降低4.9%。

Conclusion: 高分辨率ML预报的扩展主要受数据瓶颈制约，变量级超分辨率提供了一种简单而通用的解决方案，能够解锁长时段粗分辨率再分析资料以用于高分辨率训练。

Abstract: The development of 0.1$^{\circ}$ global weather forecasting models based on machine learning (ML) is constrained by the limited availability of high-resolution data, as decades of reanalysis are only available at 0.25$^{\circ}$ resolution. While existing approaches fine-tune 0.25$^{\circ}$ forecast models on limited 0.1$^{\circ}$ samples, we show that this transfer is hindered by the irreversible information loss inherent in coarse-resolution forecasting. Therefore, we propose BaguanHR, a framework that shifts the focus from transferring models to transferring data. We first show that super-resolution (SR) has lower conditional entropy and input amplification than forecasting, making it a more robust vehicle for resolution transfer. By leveraging this advantage through variable-wise SR, we synthesize extensive 0.1$^{\circ}$ data from ERA5. BaguanHR's performance on the synthetic-plus-real dataset exceeds both ML-based methods and IFS-HRES, achieving superior performance across over 85% of the lead times within 72 hours. Furthermore, our findings highlight a power-law scaling effect, as a twofold increase in data reduces RMSE by 4.6% for 72-hour forecasting and 4.9% for 120-hour forecasting. Our results demonstrate that scaling high resolution ML-based forecasting is primarily a data bottleneck, and that variable-wise super-resolution provides a simple yet general solution to unlock long coarse-resolution reanalyses for high-resolution training.

</details>


### [540] [Do Uncertainty Signals Help? A Systematic Study of Uncertainty-Aware Decoding with Rollback Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14653)
