Using deep neural network, the shape of ONH, which is under genetic control, is decomposed into a set of hierarchical features through self-taught learning. Features captured at different levels are selected according to their discriminant power in identifying the two populations. The prediction accuracy is evaluated with stratified cross validation. Given the selected feature set, individuals are grouped into k hierarchical clusters and cluster membership fractions are determined for k=2,3,4,5,6,7. Population structure analysis on the basis of phenotypes through image analysis allows heritability and linkage analysis, including founder effects from English and Polynesian ancestors, potentially leading to new genetic risk factors for glaucoma and other ONH-related eye diseases.

</details>


### [605] [Measuring Structured Predictability in Neural Training Dynamics: A Cross-Regime Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15483)
*Fanqi Wang,Weisheng Tang,Hairong Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了深度网络训练过程中的短时程可预测性（short-horizon predictability），将其作为衡量训练轨迹时间冗余度的指标。通过在CIFAR和Pythia预训练检查点上应用三类互补探针（位移方向、子空间残差、预测器），发现辅助参数（如归一化参数、偏置）的动力学比主参数（如特征变换权重）更简单；主参数的可预测行为集中在局部、随时间变化的小区域内。研究还发现架构和训练方案会系统性调节这些结构，并在Pythia-70M中揭示了多层级的动态事件序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络现代训练涉及长时间更新轨迹，但训练轨迹的时间组织性（temporal organization）相对于架构、损失函数或优化器而言，尚未得到系统化的刻画。作者希望提出一种可量化的度量来理解训练动力学的时间冗余结构，进而作为回顾性的训练诊断工具。

Method: 提出短时程可预测性作为时间冗余度的度量，组合三类互补探针：（1）位移方向探针、（2）子空间残差探针、（3）预测器探针。同时引入顾及约定（convention-aware）、零校准（null-calibrated）的组级读出方式。在CIFAR多轮视觉训练和公开的Pythia预训练检查点上进行实验，并进行受控对比实验和Pythia-70M案例研究。

Result: 两类训练机制下均发现：向量型张量（辅助参数，如归一化参数和偏置）的短时程动力学比矩阵型特征变换权重（主参数）更简单；主参数的可预测行为集中在局部、时变的"口袋"区域。不同探针家族内部及彼此间的一致性表明测量捕获了固有轨迹结构。受控CIFAR实验显示架构和训练配方系统性调节该结构。Pythia-70M案例分析揭示了按角色、深度和尺度划分的动态事件序列，包括主参数ESA跌破随机符号一致水平，以及可预测qkv口袋在各层级的出现与重新分布。

Conclusion: 短时程可预测性可作为一种回顾性的、参数解析的训练动力学诊断工具，能够揭示训练轨迹中不同参数类别的时间组织差异及其随训练进程的演化，为理解和监控深度网络训练提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Modern deep networks are trained through long update trajectories, yet their temporal organization remains less systematically characterized than architectures, losses, or optimizers. We study short-horizon predictability as a measure of temporal redundancy: where, when, and under which training conditions recent updates contain information about near-future parameter motion. We combine three complementary probe families, displacement-direction, subspace-residual, and predictor-based probes, with convention-aware, null-calibrated group-level readouts, and apply them to multi-pass vision training on CIFAR and public Pythia pretraining checkpoints. Across both regimes, vector-like tensors such as normalization parameters and biases (auxiliary parameters) exhibit simpler short-horizon dynamics than matrix-like feature-transforming weights (bulk parameters), whose predictable behavior concentrates in localized, time-varying pockets. Agreement within and across probe families, and with independent trajectory diagnostics, indicates that these measurements capture intrinsic trajectory structure, while probe differences distinguish complementary forms of temporal organization. Controlled CIFAR comparisons further show that architecture and training recipe systematically modulate the measured structure. A Pythia-70M case study further exposes a sequence of role-, depth-, and scale-dependent events, including bulk ESA falling below the random sign-agreement level and the emergence and redistribution of predictable qkv pockets across layers. These results position short-horizon predictability as a retrospective, parameter-resolved diagnostic of training dynamics.

</details>


### [606] [QSMP: finding representative time series subsequences through Quick Shift+Matrix Profile](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15492)
*Carlos H. Mendoza-Cardenas,Rogers F. Silva,Austin J. Brockmeier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QSMP是一种通过密度引导的子序列聚类在长时间序列中寻找代表性波形的方法，它将Quick Shift模式搜索算法与Matrix Profile时间序列相似性搜索数据结构相结合，具有优于现有方法的空间复杂度，在合成和真实数据集上均验证了其总结和可视化长时间序列的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在长时间序列中寻找代表性波形具有重要的科学和实践价值，可支持数据的摘要、可视化以及分类和预测等下游任务。需要一种高效的方法来从长序列中识别出具有代表性的子序列模式。

Method: 提出QSMP方法，通过密度引导对时间序列子序列进行聚类。核心创新在于将Quick Shift模式搜索算法与Matrix Profile数据结构之间建立新的联系，使Quick Shift能够适应长时间序列中子序列的聚类任务，从而获得优于现有最优方法的空间复杂度。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，QSMP能够有效通过寻找代表性波形来总结和可视化长时间序列，是一种有价值的工具。

Conclusion: QSMP通过密度引导的聚类方法成功实现了长时间序列中代表性波形的自动发现，结合Quick Shift和Matrix Profile的优势，提供了高效且空间复杂度更优的解决方案，在序列摘要与可视化方面展现了良好的应用前景。

Abstract: Finding representative waveforms in long time series has scientific and practical value in many domains, as it enables summarization and visualization of large time series datasets, and downstream tasks like classification and forecasting. We present here QSMP, a method to find representative waveforms in long time series through a density-guided clustering of time series subsequences. Our method makes a novel connection between Quick Shift, a mode-seeking algorithm, and the Matrix Profile, a time series similarity-search data structure, to adapt Quick Shift to the clustering of subsequences in long time series, with a space complexity that is superior to the state-of-the-art method. Our experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that QSMP can be a valuable tool to summarize and visualize long time series by finding representative waveforms.

</details>


### [607] [UniFed-VLM: Federated Instruction Tuning for Vision-Language Models with Multiple Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15516)
*Pengyu Wang,Baochen Xiong,Xiaoshan Yang,Yifan Xu,Zhang Qimeng,Haifeng Chen,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出UniFed-VLM，一个统一的分层联邦指令微调框架，专门解决视觉语言模型（VLMs）在联邦学习场景中面临的任务、模态和模型架构多维异构问题。通过Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation (FedCSA)和Two-stage Collaborative Distillation (TCoD)两个核心组件，实现跨异构客户端的高效知识聚合与迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM微调通常依赖集中式数据，在医疗等敏感领域存在隐私风险。联邦学习虽可解决隐私问题，但直接将FL应用于VLM指令微调面临严峻挑战：VLM参数量巨大，且真实场景中客户端在任务、模态和模型架构上存在显著异质性。现有方法仅处理简化场景，无法应对这种多维异构问题。

Method: UniFed-VLM包含两个关键组件：1) FedCSA（Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation）：在子空间中对参数高效适配器进行对齐聚合，采用动态加权和补偿机制缓解异构性引发的参数冲突；2) TCoD（Two-stage Collaborative Distillation）：通过互蒸馏适配器（MDA）和基于混合专家（MoE）的蒸馏策略，在异构模型之间实现有效的知识迁移。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上进行实验，UniFed-VLM在多样任务上的平均性能优于现有联邦学习方法。

Conclusion: UniFed-VLM为VLM下的联邦指令微调提供了统一的解决方案，有效处理了任务、模态和架构维度的联合异构性，展示了更强的跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in multimodal understanding and generation. However, fine-tuning of VLMs typically relies on centralized data, which raises privacy concerns in certain domains (e.g. healthcare). Federated Learning (FL) provides a natural solution by enabling model training without sharing raw data. However, applying FL to VLM instruction tuning is highly challenging. VLMs have substantial parameter scales, and in real-world scenarios, clients exhibit significant heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures.
  Existing methods mainly focus on simplified settings and are unable to handle such multi-dimensional heterogeneous scenarios. In this work, we study federated instruction tuning under joint heterogeneity in tasks, modalities, and model architectures.
  We propose UniFed-VLM, a unified federated instruction tuning framework for VLMs that addresses multiple types of heterogeneity. It consists of two key components: 1) Federated Compensated Subspace Aggregation (FedCSA), which performs subspace-aligned aggregation of parameter-efficient adapters with dynamic weighting and compensation to mitigate heterogeneity-induced conflicts; 2) Two-stage Collaborative Distillation (TCoD), which enables effective knowledge transfer across heterogeneous models via a Mutual Distillation Adapter (MDA) and a mixture-of-experts-based distillation strategy. We conduct experiments on multiple benchmark datasets, and the results show that UniFed-VLM achieves stronger average performance across diverse tasks compared with existing FL methods. The source code is available at: https://github.com/wangpengyu2004/UniFed-VLM.

</details>


### [608] [Guaranteed Adaptive Modality Acquisition: When the Policy Chooses Its Own Calibration Group](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15520)
*Melika Baghi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 RouteCert 方法，用于多模态系统中自适应输入获取（adaptive acquisition）条件下的条件校准。当策略决定哪些输入被观测时，传统假设分组映射独立于校准样本不再成立。作者刻画了模式条件保证仍然有效的条件，给出两种有限样本构造（阈值无关路由+终端模式校准、同时认证完整策略-模式对），并通过心电图临床任务和遮蔽多模态基准验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态系统推理时可能仅持有部分输入，其余输入需要付费获取。在自适应获取机制下，策略决定了最终观测到哪些输入，因此保证需以最终输入模式为条件给出。然而传统条件校准假设分组映射独立于校准样本，策略诱导的分组并不满足这一假设，导致现有的模式条件保证无法直接适用。

Method: 1）刻画模式条件保证在策略诱导分组下仍然有效的条件；2）提出两种有限样本构造：a）阈值无关路由（threshold-free routing），在终端模式上应用校准；b）同时认证完整策略-模式对，允许校准数据选择部署策略。另给出反例证明校准独立分组映射的保证在策略使终端分组校准相关时不一定成立。

Result: 在临床心电图任务上（分阶段、按成本排序的导联协议），认证策略在48.8%的预设序数成本下回答了71.2%的留出患者，与心脏病专家诊断的观测分歧率为7.4%，且全部三个获取阶段各自携带证书。在遮蔽多模态基准上，按终端模式逐点认证在观测最差模式选择性风险（对照全信息参考决策而非真实标签）达到0.034，而池化设计在0.10上限下达到0.145；已回答比例相当（0.350 vs 0.342），预算匹配同时比较下回答比例降至0.305。

Conclusion: RouteCert 提供了一种在自适应输入获取策略下保持模式条件校准有效性的框架，通过在终端模式上应用校准和对完整策略-模式对进行同时认证，能够以较低成本回答大部分查询并保持严格的选择性风险保证，优于池化设计。

Abstract: A multimodal system may begin inference holding only some of its inputs and may acquire the rest at a cost. With adaptive acquisition, the policy determines which inputs are ultimately observed, so we state the guarantee conditional on that terminal input pattern. Conditional calibration normally assumes the grouping map is fixed independently of the calibration sample, which policy-induced grouping does not satisfy. We characterize when pattern-conditional guarantees remain valid and give two finite-sample constructions: threshold-free routing with calibration applied at the terminal pattern, and simultaneous certification of complete policy-pattern pairs, which lets calibration data select the deployed policy. A counterexample shows that a guarantee proved for a calibration-independent grouping map need not transfer once the policy makes the terminal group calibration-dependent. We call the resulting method RouteCert. On a clinical electrocardiogram task with a staged, cost-ordered lead protocol, the certified policy answers 71.2% of held-out patients at an observed 7.4% disagreement with the cardiologist's diagnosis at 48.8% of the prespecified ordinal cost of acquiring every stage, and all three acquisition stages carry their own certificate. On masked multimodal benchmarks, certifying pointwise at each terminal pattern holds observed worst-pattern selective risk, measured against the full-information reference decision rather than the true label, at 0.034 where a pooled design reaches 0.145 against a 0.10 cap, at a comparable answered fraction (0.350 vs 0.342); under the budget-matched simultaneous comparison the answered fraction falls to 0.305.

</details>


### [609] [Spectral Saliency for Machine Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15548)
*Cedar Site Bai,Amber Yijia Zheng,Raymond A. Yeh,Brian Bullins*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出频谱显著性遗忘（SSU），一种基于频谱视角的机器遗忘方法。SSU通过阈值化弱的奇异分量，仅沿具有高置信遗忘信号的方向更新模型参数，并在遗忘-保留权衡下提供了理论依据。实验覆盖图像分类器、扩散模型和大语言模型，验证了SSU的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘旨在移除特定训练数据的影响同时保持模型效用。受Muon优化器（通过谱幅度归一化鼓励探索稀有方向）的启发，作者希望从频谱视角设计遗忘算法，更精准地区分"需要遗忘的方向"与"需要保留的方向"，从而更好地平衡遗忘效果与模型保留能力。

Method: SSU采用频谱视角进行遗忘：对模型梯度或参数进行奇异值分解，设定阈值以过滤掉弱的奇异分量，仅更新那些具有高置信遗忘信号支持的方向。该方法结合了谱阈值化与梯度更新的方向选择机制，并提供了关于遗忘-保留权衡的理论分析。

Result: 实验在多种模型类型（图像分类器、扩散模型、大语言模型）上验证了SSU的有效性，表明该方法能够有效实现目标数据的遗忘，同时保持模型的整体效用。

Conclusion: SSU通过频谱阈值化策略提供了一种新颖且有效的机器遗忘方案，理论上从遗忘-保留权衡角度证明了该方法的合理性，并实证展示了其在多种模型架构和任务上的泛化能力。

Abstract: Machine unlearning (MU) aims to remove the influence of specific training data while preserving model utility. As the name suggests, MU can be viewed as the inverse of learning, using gradient-based updates to reduce the influence of a forget-set by counteracting the previously learned behavior. Recently, Muon, a gradient descent variant, has been introduced. Muon applies spectral magnitude normalization to encourage exploration of rare directions and demonstrates promising performance. Inspired by Muon, we adopt the spectral view for unlearning and propose Spectral Saliency Unlearning (SSU). SSU thresholds weak singular components and updates only those directions supported by a confident unlearning signal. We further provide theoretical justification for this thresholding approach from the perspective of the forgetting-retention trade-off. Experiments across image classifiers, diffusion models, and LLMs demonstrate SSU's effectiveness.

</details>


### [610] [Amortised Post-Hoc Explanation with Exact Preservation for Dynamic Graph Anomaly Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15559)
*Iyad Assaad Nekka,Hamida Seba,Walid Khaled Hidouci,Karima Amrouche*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Anomaly detection in dynamic graphs underpins financial fraud analysis, intrusion detection, and platform integrity, where automated decisions require human-interpretable justifications. StrGNN, the strongest performer in recent benchmarks, produces no explanation: when an edge is flagged, the analyst receives only a score. Explanation metrics are undefined for StrGNN because no attribution vector exists. This paper closes that gap. We present X-StrGNN, a post-hoc explanation layer that wraps a trained, frozen StrGNN and emits, for every flagged edge, dual attributions: a structural attribution identifying which contextual interactions in the enclosing subgraph drove the decision, and a temporal attribution identifying which historical snapshot carried the signal. Both attributions are multiplicative masks identically one in the unexplained pass, so the layer is an exact pass-through: detection is preserved to machine precision, verified rather than asserted (Delta AUC = 0.0000, Delta AP = 0.0000, Delta P@100 = 0.0000). Attribution costs 0.66 ms per edge, making explanation of an entire alarm list feasible. We conduct the first controlled design study of attribution strategies for this architecture, comparing gradient attribution, per-instance mask optimisation, and amortised parameterisation under one protocol, one budget, and three seeds. X-StrGNN attains the highest stability (0.913) at 268x lower cost than per-instance optimisation, and its temporal attribution (1.601 against a measured random floor of 0.973) is separably better than its ablated control, while per-instance optimisation - the most expensive strategy - falls below that floor. Code, protocol, and per-seed measurements are released.

</details>


### [611] [SchurQuant: Groupwise Discrete Optimization for Layer-Wise LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15567)
*Gunjun Lee,Sehwan Son,Younjoo Lee,Byungjun Kim,Jung Ho Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SCHUROPT和SCHURQUANT两种免反向传播的权重量化后训练方法。SCHUROPT通过解析消除后缀最优连续响应，利用Schur补曲率构建精确的逐组二次目标，交替进行闭式逐行缩放/零点重拟合与整数码坐标下降，在2-bit Qwen3-4B上零样本准确率提升11.88个百分点。SCHURQUANT在此基础上结合量化前缀教师重建、参考权重正则化、残差加性目标和教师决策令牌加权，在8个Llama和Qwen模型上以2-bit精度超越最强基线9.65个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现存的免反向传播权重量化优化器存在两个局限：其一是分组决策忽略了剩余连续后缀可以吸收的校正量，导致分组判断不够精确；其二是离散细化过程通常保持仿射量化网格固定不变，限制了优化空间。在2-3比特低精度下，现有方法的准确率严重下降，需要更精细的优化策略。

Method: SCHUROPT首先解析地消除后缀的最优连续响应，通过Schur补曲率得到精确的逐组二次目标函数；然后交替执行闭式逐行尺度/零点重拟合和整数码的坐标下降优化。SCHURQUANT在此基础之上，融合了量化前缀教师重建、参考权重正则化、残差加性目标和教师决策令牌加权四种策略，兼顾低比特下的重建精度与高比特下的端模型指标。

Result: 在固定GPTQ目标下，SCHUROPT在2-bit Qwen3-4B上将平均零样本准确率提升11.88个百分点。SCHURQUANT在8个Llama和Qwen模型中取得所有评估的免反向传播PTQ基线中最高的平均零样本准确率，2-bit下比最强基线高出9.65个百分点。研究发现，在高精度下更紧的重建并不总是一致地改善端模型指标。

Conclusion: 通过Schur补精确建模后缀校正并引入多元正则化与教师训练策略，SCHUROPT和SCHURQUANT显著改善了免反向传播权重量化的精度，特别是在极低比特（2-bit）场景下，展示了优于现有PTQ基线的性能。

Abstract: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) enables the deployment of large language models under tight memory budgets, but accuracy often collapses at 2-3 bits. Existing backpropagation-free PTQ optimizers have two limitations: group decisions ignore the correction that the remaining continuous suffix can absorb, and discrete refinements typically keep the affine quantization grid fixed. We introduce SCHUROPT, which analytically eliminates the suffix's optimal continuous response, yielding an exact groupwise quadratic with Schur-complement curvature. It then alternates closed-form row-wise scale/zero-point refitting with coordinate descent over integer codes. With the GPTQ objective fixed, SCHUROPT improves mean zero-shot accuracy on 2-bit Qwen3-4B by 11.88 percentage points (pp). At higher precision, however, tighter reconstruction does not consistently improve end-model metrics. SCHURQUANT therefore combines SCHUROPT with quantized-prefix teacher reconstruction, reference-weight regularization, residual-add targets, and teacher-decision token weighting. Across eight Llama and Qwen models, SCHURQUANT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the evaluated backpropagation free PTQ baselines, outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.65 pp at 2 bits.

</details>


### [612] [GraniKV: Asymmetric Granularity KV-Cache Paging for Multi-Agent Systems with Long Shared Prefix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15584)
*Jinhyun Jeon,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraniKV是一个针对生产级分页服务引擎的KV缓存层，采用非对称分页粒度（共享前缀用连续HOT池，逐请求后缀用token级COLD池），并配备每步调度器在双后端间选择。相比生产基线，在Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2和Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4上分别达到2.16×、1.98×和1.57倍的输出token吞吐量；在异构多智能体场景（不同提示长度）下达到1.95×，而batch-global级联方法退化至基线水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产级分页服务引擎对KV缓存使用统一的分页粒度，但多智能体工作负载的两个区域有相反的存储需求：共享前缀长且需要连续性，而逐请求后缀需要细粒度分配。这种矛盾需要一个能同时满足两种需求的存储层。

Method: GraniKV将共享前缀分配在连续的HOT池中，将后缀分配在token级COLD池中，并通过每步调度器在计算受限、内存受限或通信受限三类场景中为每个regime选择合适的后端（双后端机制）。

Result: 在Lp=16K共享token下，GraniKV在Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1、Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2和Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4上分别达2.16×、1.98×和1.57×吞吐量。级联注意力集成在饱和时贡献大部分增益；非对称存储层额外增加1.05-1.15×端到端性能，并使batched-GEMM前缀后端成为可能。在异构多智能体服务（不同长度提示）下达1.95×，而batch-global级联退化为平级，存储层单独承担该场景的主要增益。

Conclusion: GraniKV是首次将非对称分页粒度应用于生产分页服务引擎KV缓存的系统，通过区分共享前缀与逐请求后缀的存储需求，在均匀及异构多智能体工作负载下均显著提升吞吐量，并阐明了存储层与级联注意力在不同场景下的增益归属。

Abstract: Production paged-serving engines apply uniform paging granularity to the KV cache, even though the two regions of a multi-agent workload have opposite storage requirements: a long shared prefix demands contiguity, while the per-request suffix demands fine-grained allocation.
  We present \textbf{GraniKV}, a KV-cache layer that allocates the shared prefix in a contiguous HOT pool and the suffix in a token-level COLD pool, combined with a per-step dispatcher which selects the appropriate backend among dual backends for each regime (compute-, memory-, or communication-bound). To the best of our knowledge, GraniKV is the first system to apply asymmetric paging granularity to the KV cache of a production paged-serving engine.
  At $L_p{=}16$\,K shared tokens GraniKV reaches $\mathbf{2.16\times}$, $\mathbf{1.98\times}$, and $\mathbf{1.57\times}$ output-token throughput over the production baseline on Llama-3.1-8B/TP=1, Qwen-2.5-14B/TP=2, and Qwen-2.5-32B/TP=4. The gain decomposes: cascade attention integration contributes the majority at saturation; the asymmetric storage layer adds $1.05$--$1.15\times$ end-to-end while being what makes the batched-GEMM prefix backend possible at all. Under heterogeneous multi-agent serving with \emph{distinct} prompts of different lengths, the attribution inverts: GraniKV sustains $\mathbf{1.95\times}$ while batch-global cascade collapses to parity --- the storage layer alone carries the win in the regime that motivates the paper.

</details>


### [613] [Quantum Models with Multi-Stage Training for Compositional Concept Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15601)
*Mina Abbaszadeh,Matilda Karabina Moore,Mehrnoosh Sadrzadeh,Martha Lewis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于量子计算的组合式语义模型（CoCoGen），通过张量和变分量子电路分离名词与关系，采用多阶段训练范式（先学习物体表示，再冻结物体参数仅训练关系组件），在CLEVR数据集上显著提升分布外关系泛化能力，且所需可训练参数远少于经典基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合式概念泛化（CoCoGen）——即系统性地在新颖情境中重组已学到的原始概念——是多模态学习中的一个关键挑战。现有方法难以在关系推理中实现这种泛化能力，本文旨在构建一个能显式强制组合因子化的模型以解决此问题。

Method: 1) 使用张量表示名词的向量、高阶张量表示关系的组合式语义模型；2) 采用变分量子电路（VQC）作为可训练模型；3) 设计多阶段训练范式：第一阶段从单物体图像-字幕对学习物体表示，第二阶段冻结物体参数，仅优化关系组件；4) 图像方面对比了CLIP嵌入的幅度编码（保留原始嵌入几何结构）与角度编码（引入非线性特征变换）两种量子编码方案。

Result: 多阶段训练结合结构化编码显著提升了分布外关系泛化性能；可训练参数数量比经典基线少数个数量级；性能提升源于表示与编码的交互作用，非线性量子编码增强了组合结构的可分离性。

Conclusion: 结构化量子表示与分阶段学习为多模态量子机器学习中的组合式泛化提供了有效框架，展示了量子方法在系统组合推理方面的潜力。

Abstract: Compositional Concept Generalization (CoCoGen), the ability to systematically recombine learned primitives in novel contexts, is a key challenge for multimodal learning. In this work, we provide a solution using a compositional model of meaning that separates nouns from relations and uses tensors and variational quantum circuits to train them on data. This model enables us to employ a multi stage training paradigm, one that first learns object representations from single-object image-caption pairs, then subsequently transfers these to the relational stage where object parameters are frozen and optimisation is only applied to relational components. This design explicitly enforces compositional factorisation at the circuit, ensuring that relations are learned as transformations over stable primitives. The training paradigm is tested on the CLEVR dataset developed specificially for CoCoGen. For text, we work with vector representations of nouns and higher order tensor representations of relations using a set of different ansatz. For images, we work with quantum encodings of image embeddings dervied from Open AI's Vision Language tool CLIP and contrast amplitude encoding, which preserves the original embedding geometry, with angle encoding, which introduces nonlinear feature transformations. Our results show that multi-staged training combined with structured encodings significantly improves out of distribution relational generalisation, while using orders of magnitude fewer trainable parameters than classical baselines. We find that performance gains arise from the interaction between representation and encoding, with nonlinear quantum encodings enhancing the separability of compositional structure. These findings demonstrate that structured quantum representations and staged learning provide an effective framework for compositional generalisation in multimodal quantum machine learning.

</details>


### [614] [FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15602)
*Qingyao Yang,Runming Yang,He Xiao,Wendong Xu,Junyu Chen,Haobo Liu,Chenchen Ding,Ruihan Hu,Yik-Chung Wu,Ngai Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FluxBin是一个算法-内核协同设计的框架，通过解耦行列二进制分解和查找表构建方法，在保持精度的同时实现LLM的极端压缩与加速，在A100 GPU上实现最高5.92倍加速和10.19倍能耗节省，支持70B模型单卡部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有二值量化研究虽然理论上能实现极端压缩和加速，但往往忽略了专用硬件内核的必要性，导致实际加速效果受限——因为仍依赖昂贵的浮点运算或运行时反量化开销，未能充分发挥量化潜能。

Method: 采用算法-内核协同设计：(1)算法层面引入解耦行列二进制分解增强表示能力，并结合Hessian引导的显著性感知混合基保留关键信息；(2)内核层面实现基于查找表的构建方法配合尺度融合减少浮点运算，同时采用虚拟列映射将不规则、稀疏和显著矩阵转化为稠密执行。

Result: 在不同模型架构上实现最高5.92倍加速和10.19倍能耗节省，精度可与深度微调方法相媲美，并支持在单个A100 GPU上部署70B模型，内存开销减少4倍。

Conclusion: FluxBin通过算法与内核的协同优化，有效解决了二值量化在实际硬件上加速受限的问题，实现了精度、速度和能耗的全面提升，为大规模LLM的高效部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: While binary quantization theoretically promises extreme compression and acceleration for Large Language Models (LLMs), existing research often overlooks the necessity of specialized hardware kernels, thus failing to unleash the full acceleration potential due to persistent reliance on expensive floating-point arithmetic or runtime dequantization overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose FluxBin (\textbf{F}lexible \textbf{L}UT-based \textbf{U}ltra-low-bit e\textbf{X}ecution with \textbf{Bin}ary bases), an algorithm-kernel co-design that synergizes post-training quantization with a highly optimized CUDA kernel. Algorithmically, we introduce Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition to enhance representational capacity while maintaining hardware efficiency, complemented by a Hessian-guided saliency-aware hybrid bases that preserve critical information. At the kernel level, we implement a Lookup Table Building Approach with Scale Fusion to reduce floating-point arithmetic, featuring a Virtual Columnar Mapping that transforms irregular, sparse, and salient matrices into dense execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate FluxBin achieves up to $5.92\times$ speedup and $10.19\times$ energy savings across diverse model architectures, delivering comparable accuracy to heavily fine-tuned methods. This effectively enables the deployment of 70B-scale models on one single A100 GPU with a $4\times$ memory reduction. Code is available at https://github.com/nicyyyy/FluxBin.

</details>


### [615] [In Defense of OCTA: The Reconstruction-Utility Gap in OCT-to-OCTA Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15626)
*Michael Chertok,Alon Tiosano,Orly Gal-Or,Lior Kramarski,Einav Baharav Shlezinger,Irit Bahar,Lior Wolf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究质疑OCT-to-OCTA合成重建的传统评估标准（PSNR/SSIM），提出应以下游任务保真度（downstream-task fidelity）评估。通过冻结的真实OCTA分割器作为探针，发现两个合成器（XOCT, TransPro）在细毛细血管网络上的分割Dice严重下降（0.798→0.635），远大于大血管的损失，且TransPro表现更差。在私有Spectralis数据集上重训练后，两合成器均无法复现新生血管病变。结论是合成图像外观相似不等于临床测量效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OCTA硬件不如结构OCT普及，近期研究用OCT合成OCTA并报告了强重建指标（PSNR>31dB, SSIM>0.9）。但作者质疑这些合成图像是否真正支持OCTA本来要做的临床测量（如毛细灌注和中心凹无血管区生物标志物），而非仅仅看起来相似。因此需要评估下游临床任务的保真度。

Method: 将冻结的真实OCTA分割器作为探针，应用于两个合成器（XOCT和TransPro）生成的图像，比较大血管与细毛细血管网络的下游分割Dice分数；并加入匹配模糊对照实验以区分细节是"伪造"还是"模糊"。此外在私有Spectralis数据集上重新训练两个合成器，定性检查其是否能复现新生血管病变（n=3）。

Result: 下游分割Dice随结构精细度下降：大血管从0.862降至0.831，而细毛细血管网络从0.798降至0.635（损失为大血管的5倍，配对Wilcoxon p<1e-3）。TransPro在所有指标上均更差。匹配模糊对照表明细毛细结构是伪造而非模糊。在Spectralis数据上重训练后，两个合成器均无法复现新生血管病变。

Conclusion: 重建保真度不等于临床效用。作者提出应以下游任务保真度作为OCT-to-OCTA合成评估的标准，因为细毛细血管细节的丢失和伪造会直接影响糖尿病视网膜病变缺血分级等临床判断。

Abstract: Optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) images retinal blood flow, giving capillary-perfusion and foveal-avascular-zone biomarkers that grade diabetic-retinopathy ischemia. Because OCTA hardware is less common than structural OCT, recent work synthesizes it from OCT, reporting strong reconstruction (3D PSNR > 31 dB, SSIM > 0.9). We ask not whether the synthetic image looks similar, but whether it supports the measurements OCTA is acquired for. A frozen real-OCTA segmenter, applied as a probe to two synthesizers (XOCT, TransPro), shows downstream Dice falling with structural fineness: large vessels survive (0.862 -> 0.831) while the fine capillary network collapses (0.798 -> 0.635, five times the large-vessel loss; paired Wilcoxon p < 1e-3), TransPro worse throughout. A matched-blur control shows this detail is fabricated, not blurred. Retrained on a private Spectralis dataset, neither synthesizer reproduces the neovascular lesion (qualitative, n=3). Reconstruction fidelity is not clinical utility; we establish downstream-task fidelity as the evaluation OCT-to-OCTA synthesis needs.

</details>


### [616] [Generalised Transportability via Causal Abstractions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15645)
*Yorgos Felekis,Paris Giampouras,Fabio Massimo Zennaro,Theodoros Damoulas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于因果抽象理论的模型级可迁移性框架，将传统查询级可迁移性推广为模型级对齐，并利用分布稳健优化为不可迁移查询和无目标数据场景提供有保证的查询区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的可迁移性理论存在两个实际重要场景的盲区：一是当查询不可迁移时保持沉默，二是当目标数据完全不存在时无法处理。此外，该理论一次只能处理一个查询且返回表达式而非具体数值。

Method: 采用因果抽象理论的模型级视角，源与目标共享变量、图结构及干预，仅在已知机制集合上不同，使可迁移性成为同层抽象的特例。通过询问是否存在单一映射对齐源与目标在干预行为上的差异来表征精确情形（Markovian和半Markovian）；在无精确映射时，将模型级可迁移性形式化为对未见目标机制与环境扰动的分布稳健优化问题，推导认证的查询区间。

Result: 在合成Markovian和半Markovian基准以及真实生态数据集上评估，认证的区间能够界定真实干预查询值。

Conclusion: 该框架将抽象误差重新概念化为近似可迁移性的定量度量，同时覆盖了传统可迁移性理论的两个盲区：为非传输查询提供有界区间，以及在目标无关设置下提供保证。

Abstract: Transporting a causal conclusion from a source study population to a target one is a fundamental problem in causal inference. The theory of transportability provides a criterion for when this is possible: given experimental data from the source and observational data from the target, it determines whether a target query is identifiable and does so completely; i.e. if the query can be transported, the criterion finds the exact formula. However, it works one query at a time and returns an expression rather than the value itself. It is also silent in two practically important regimes: when the query is not transportable and when no target data exist at all. To tackle both, we take a model-level perspective grounded in Causal Abstraction theory. Source and target share variables, graph, and interventions, differing only at a known set of mechanisms, which makes transportability a special case of same-level abstraction. Thus, instead of asking whether one query transports, we ask whether a single map aligns the source and target across their interventional behaviour. We characterise when such a map exists in both the Markovian and semi-Markovian settings; when it does, every target query transports at once. Our main contribution lies in the approximate case. When no exact map exists, the best approximate one still yields certified query intervals, recasting abstraction error as a quantitative notion of approximate transportability. We formulate model-level transport as distributionally robust optimisation over mechanism and environment perturbations of the unseen target and derive certificates for both challenging regimes: bounds for non-transportable queries, and guarantees under target-agnostic settings. We evaluate our framework on synthetic Markovian and semi-Markovian benchmarks and a real ecological dataset, and we show that the certified intervals bracket the true interventional query.

</details>


### [617] [Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization for Product Media Ranking in E-Commerce](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15662)
*Prasenjit Dey,Frank McIntyre,Arnab Sinha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SMEO（序列多模态证据优化）框架，这是一个两阶段的效用引导框架，用于电商平台商品媒体排序。SMEO首先从用户消费的媒体前缀序列中学习轨迹效用模型，然后训练一个带生存加权奖励的自回归排序策略，优先展示最有助于决策的信息，使顾客以更少操作达成购买决策，离线评估中转化率提升5.5%，滑动次数减少15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代电商平台中，顾客在购买前会消费有序的异构商品媒体（如图片、视频、3D渲染）。现有媒体排序系统通常优化点击或停留时长等短视的参与度代理指标，忽略了这些媒体本质上属于同一商品的协作性信息组件，需要通过顾客的序列化交互共同帮助其找到所需信息。现有方法缺少对媒体序列整体效用（而非单点参与度）的建模与优化。

Method: SMEO采用两阶段框架：第一阶段学习轨迹效用模型，从已消费的媒体前缀估计有序证据如何帮助顾客达成购买决策，同时缓解日志数据中的位置偏差和变深度不平衡问题；第二阶段将顾客注意力视为有限资源，训练自回归排序策略，使用生存加权奖励（survival-weighted reward-to-go），优先将最关键的决策信息前置呈现。该框架将效用学习与策略优化解耦，使模型能够在偏差日志上进行稳定的离线学习，并在无需显式媒体级标签的情况下进行事后媒体归因。

Result: 在大规模电商会话数据上使用双重稳健离线策略评估（doubly robust off-policy estimation），SMEO相比现有基线将预估转化率提升5.5%，并帮助顾客以减少15%的滑动操作达成购买决策。

Conclusion: SMEO通过将媒体序列视为协作性信息组件进行整体效用建模，并解耦效用学习与策略优化，实现了面向顾客的媒体排序优化。该方法不仅能提升转化效果，还能显著减少顾客寻找决策信息所需的交互成本，验证了效用引导的序列媒体排序在电商场景的有效性。

Abstract: On modern e-commerce stores, customers consume ordered slates of heterogeneous product media, such as images, videos, and 3D renders, before making purchase decisions. Existing media-ranking systems often optimize myopic engagement proxies such as clicks or dwell time, even though product media assets are cooperative informational components of the same item that together help customers find the information they need through sequential interaction. We present Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization (SMEO), a two-stage utility-guided framework for customer-oriented media sequencing. SMEO first learns a trajectory utility model from consumed media prefixes to estimate how ordered evidence helps customers reach a purchase decision, while mitigating position-bias and variable-depth imbalance in logged data. Recognizing that customer attention is a limited resource, it then trains an autoregressive ranking policy with survival-weighted reward-to-go that prioritizes the most decision-relevant information early, so customers can find what they need with less effort. By decoupling utility learning from policy optimization, SMEO enables stable offline learning from biased logs and post-hoc media attribution without explicit media-level labels. Evaluated offline on large-scale e-commerce sessions using doubly robust off-policy estimation, SMEO improves estimated conversion by 5.5% and helps customers reach a purchase decision with 15% fewer swipes than existing baselines.

</details>


### [618] [SubZero+: Efficient Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning via Large Learning Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15665)
*Ziming Yu,Shuyao Xiao,Xingyu Zhao,Sike Wang,Pan Zhou,Peiyu Zang,Xiangda Yan,Yongjie Yang,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SubZero+ 通过三种互补的改进策略（层内低秩子空间中的多查询梯度估计、子空间内 Adam 自适应优化器、以及基于符号修正的 QR 子空间构建），显著提升了 zeroth-order 优化在 LLM 微调中的稳定性，在 1.3B 到 32B 规模的模型上优于现有 ZO 基线方法，并缩小了与一阶方法的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 zeroth-order (ZO) 优化方法虽然能在无需反向传播的情况下微调大语言模型，但其梯度估计器方差高，导致收敛不稳定且对学习率极为敏感，这严重限制了 ZO 方法的实际应用效果。

Method: SubZero+ 通过三个正交方向提升稳定性：(i) 在层特定的低秩子空间内进行多查询梯度估计，以降低方差且避免"多查询悖论"；(ii) 引入子空间 Adam 优化器，利用子空间内的多查询梯度统计进行自适应更新；(iii) 对基于 QR 分解的子空间构建施加符号修正，确保投影矩阵服从 Haar 分布，消除实现相关的方向歧义。

Result: 在 SuperGLUE 基准上对 1.3B 至 32B 规模的模型进行全参数微调和 LoRA 实验，SubZero+ 持续优于现有 ZO 基线，扩大了稳定学习率范围，并在极小的额外内存开销下缩小了与一阶方法的性能差距。

Conclusion: SubZero+ 有效解决了 ZO 优化中高方差梯度估计和稳定性不足的核心问题，为免反向传播的 LLM 微调提供了更可靠且实用性的方案，同时验证了子空间自适应优化与多查询策略结合的有效性。

Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables backpropagation-free fine-tuning of large language models, but existing ZO methods suffer from high-variance gradient estimators, making convergence unstable and highly sensitive to learning rates. We propose SubZero+, an improved SubZero framework that improves stability in three complementary ways: (i) multi-query gradient estimation within layer-specific low-rank subspaces to reduce variance without exhibiting the multi-query paradox; (ii) a subspace Adam optimizer that performs adaptive updates using in-subspace multi-query gradient statistics; and (iii) a sign correction for QR-based subspace construction to ensure Haar-distributed projection matrices, eliminating implementation-dependent orientation ambiguity. Experiments on models from 1.3B to 32B across SuperGLUE, under both full-parameter tuning and LoRA, show that SubZero+ consistently outperforms prior ZO baselines, enlarges the stable learning-rate range, and narrows the gap to first-order methods with minimal extra memory overhead.

</details>


### [619] [Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15669)
*Zhongwei Yu,Yan Song,Xue Yan,Anjie Liu,Xingyu Lu,Yihang Chen,Huichi Zhou,Siyuan Guo,Luoyang Sun,Sihan Chen,Xiangning Yu,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出大型发现模型（LDM），它将生成模型与贝叶斯非参数奖励替代模型耦合，用于在开放式的假设空间（如分子、蛋白质序列、计算机程序）中进行高效的科学发现。LDM在神经网络训练、抗体设计和分子优化三个场景中分别取得了2.4倍更优的验证BPB改善、18.2%的结合能相对降低和60%以上的分子多目标性能相对提升，显著优于仅依赖LLM反思或传统统计搜索的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现通常需要在庞大、结构化的开放假设空间中对昂贵评估目标进行优化。虽然生成模型（如LLM）能提供丰富的先验，但其似然性和自我评估作为奖励代理和校准后的认知不确定性估计并不可靠，尤其对于分布外的新颖候选设计。这促使需要一种能将生成先验与可靠的不确定性量化相结合的框架。

Method: LDM是一种经验驱动的循环架构，将生成模型与贝叶斯非参数奖励替代模型耦合。生成模型负责提出和精炼候选设计，替代模型预测候选性能并量化不确定性，进而产生不确定性感知的价值函数指导生成、精炼和选择过程。发现记忆和替代模型会随每次新的实验观测持续更新。

Result: 在三个涵盖不同设计模态和目标的场景中（神经网络训练、抗体设计和分子优化），LDM相比LLM-only反思和传统统计搜索方法，实现了验证BPB改善提高2.4倍、结合能相对降低18.2%、分子多目标性能相对提升超过60%。

Conclusion: 实验结果暗示LDM可以作为通用发现引擎，在开放的假设空间中进行高效的搜索，为科学发现提供一种结合生成先验与可靠不确定性量化的通用解决方案。

Abstract: Scientific discovery often involves optimising expensive-to-evaluate objectives over vast, structured, and open-ended hypothesis spaces, such as molecules, protein sequences, and computer programs. Generative models such as large language models (LLMs) provide expressive priors over such spaces, but their likelihoods and self-assessments are unreliable proxies for the objectives and calibrated epistemic uncertainty, especially for novel candidates outside the observed data distribution. We introduce the Large Discovery Model (LDM), an empirically grounded recurrent architecture that couples a generative model with a Bayesian non-parametric reward surrogate model. The generative model proposes and refines candidate designs, while the surrogate predicts their performance and quantifies uncertainty, yielding an uncertainty-aware value that guides candidate generation, refinement, and selection. The discovery memory and the surrogate model are continually updated as each new experimental observation arrives. We evaluate LDM on three scenarios spanning different design modalities and objectives, including neural-network training, antibody design, and molecular optimisation. Compared to LLM-only reflection or traditional statistical search across these domains, LDM achieves a $2.4\times$ greater reduction in validation BPB, an $18.2\%$ relative decrease in binding energy, and more than $60\%$ relative gains in molecular multi-objective performance. These results suggests that LDM could serve as a general-purpose discovery engine for effective search over open-ended hypothesis spaces.

</details>


### [620] [PL-Guard: Probabilistic Logic Reasoning for LLM Guardrails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15673)
*Satchit Chatterji,Shihan Wang,Giovanni Sileno,Erman Acar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PL-Guard，一种神经符号护栏架构，将语义接地（LLM将提示-响应对映射为谓词概率）与策略推理（ProbLog概率规则推理）分离，在XSTest基准上将不安全合规率从22.0%降至0.5%，但代价是过度拒答率从5.2%升至14.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM护栏（如策略提示和LLM-as-a-judge）将语义接地与策略推理两项任务混叠在同一模型中，导致对有害提示的危险合规或对良性提示的过度拒绝。作者认为将这两个角色分离可以更清晰地暴露安全性-有用性权衡，并使推理步骤可审计。

Method: PL-Guard由两部分组成：(1) 符号策略接口，包含谓词（predicates）和ProbLog规则；(2) 局部LLM通过重归一化的True/False令牌分数将提示-响应对接地为谓词概率，然后由ProbLog执行显式的概率规则推理。

Result: 在XSTest基准上，离线Qwen评估器显示：PL-Guard配合手工策展策略将不安全合规率从基础模型的22.0%降至0.5%，低于LLM-as-a-judge基线的6.0%；但过度拒答率高于基线（14.4%对5.2%）。

Conclusion: 将神经接地与概率符号推理分离，能够显式暴露安全性-有用性权衡，同时使护栏的中间推理步骤变得清晰和可审计。

Abstract: Large language model guardrails can be viewed as policy-consistency problems: a system must determine which policy-relevant facts hold in a prompt-response pair and what those facts imply under a given policy. Common approaches, including policy prompting and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, often overlap the tasks of semantic grounding and policy reasoning: the model both interprets the prompt-response pair and reasons about whether a policy has been violated. This can lead to unsafe compliance with harmful prompts, or refusals to assist benign ones. To separate grounding and reasoning roles, we propose PL-Guard, a neurosymbolic guardrail architecture. Using a symbolic policy interface consisting of predicates and ProbLog rules, a local LLM grounds prompt-response pairs into predicate probabilities using renormalized True/False token scores, while ProbLog performs explicit probabilistic rule inference over the symbolic policy. On the XSTest benchmark, an offline Qwen-based evaluator finds that PL-Guard with a hand-curated policy reduces unsafe compliance from 22.0% for the base model to 0.5%, and below the 6.0% rate of an LLM-as-a-judge baseline. This comes at the cost of higher over-refusal than the LLM-as-a-judge baseline, 14.4% versus 5.2%. These results suggest that separating neural grounding from probabilistic symbolic reasoning can expose the safety-helpfulness tradeoff while making the guardrail's intermediate reasoning steps explicit and auditable.

</details>


### [621] [Learning Auditable Classifier Models: Source-Disjoint Tree Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15725)
*Srikumar Krishnamoorthy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出残差模式树集成（RPTE），一种三阶段可审计预测模型学习方法，通过有界特征预算、源不相交性和分离系数估计三个原则，确保每个预测可分解为具名、不重叠规则贡献的代数之和，实现完全可审计性。在12个临床二分类基准上，RPTE与调优的黑盒集成及可解释基线性能相当，并将模型检查单元较XGBoost减少9至87倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在临床和受监管场景中，预测模型必须既准确又完全可审计。树集成（如boosting）在表格数据上精度高，但其顺序提升过程将结构发现与系数估计耦合，难以进行紧凑的逐预测审计。可解释替代方法受结构约束限制表达能力：广义加性模型通常仅限成对交互，事后规则提取器产生重叠规则妨碍紧凑解释。因此需要一种兼具强表达能力和完全可审计性的新方法。

Method: RPTE采用三阶段学习流程。第一阶段构建监督式符号特征词汇表；第二阶段在源不相交约束下生长浅层树——每个原始变量最多分配给一棵树，仅保留发现的树结构；第三阶段在叶区域指示变量上求解单个L1正则化逻辑回归，获得联合最优的稀疏系数。三个核心原则包括：有界特征预算、源不相交性和分离系数估计。

Result: 在12个临床领域二分类基准上通过重复分层5折交叉验证，RPTE的预测性能与调优的不透明集成和可解释基线相当。相比XGBoost，模型检查单元减少9至87倍；在所有12个数据集上，RPTE的审计复杂度均低于EBM。RuleFit在3个规则数较少的数据集上需要相当或更少的检查单元，但缺乏源不相交性保证。

Conclusion: RPTE通过设计确保每个预测可分解为具名、非重叠规则贡献的代数之和，在保持竞争性预测精度的同时大幅降低了模型审计复杂度，为临床等受监管场景提供了一种兼顾准确性与完全可审计性的解决方案。

Abstract: Predictive models in clinical and regulated settings must be accurate and fully auditable. Tree ensembles deliver strong accuracy on tabular data, but their sequential boosting couples structure discovery with coefficient estimation, making compact per-prediction auditing difficult. Interpretable alternatives impose structural constraints that limit expressiveness: generalized additive models typically restrict interactions to pairwise terms and post-hoc rule extractors produce overlapping rules that hinder compact interpretation. We introduce Residual Pattern Tree Ensemble (RPTE), a three-stage learning approach, that is built on three key principles: bounded feature budget, source disjointness, and separate coefficient estimation. Stage~1 builds a supervised symbolic feature vocabulary. Stage~2 grows shallow trees under a source-disjointness constraint, where each raw variable is allocated to at most one tree, and retains only the discovered tree structures. Stage~3 solves a single $\ell_1$-regularized logistic regression over leaf-region indicators, yielding jointly optimal sparse coefficients. This learning approach ensures that every prediction decomposes into an algebraic sum of named, non-overlapping rule contributions, enabling full auditability by design. Empirical evaluation on twelve clinical-domain binary classification benchmarks using repeated stratified 5-fold cross-validation shows that RPTE performs competitively against tuned opaque ensembles and interpretable baselines. RPTE reduces model inspection units by 9$\times$ to 87$\times$ relative to XGBoost and maintains lower audit complexity than EBM on all 12 datasets. RuleFit requires comparable or fewer inspection units on three datasets where its rule count is small, but without source-disjointness guarantees. The source code is available at \href{https://github.com/srikumar2050/hugiml-core}{this https URL}.

</details>


### [622] [TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15767)
*Armin Steinhauser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TinyCast，一个仅含146,505个参数的免注意力零样本时序预测器。它利用零参数频谱检测器获取主导周期并折叠上下文相位，再通过膨胀卷积编码器和块自回归分位数解码器建模剩余结构，在极小参数规模下达到尺寸-精度前沿，且支持INT8量化部署于嵌入式设备。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在极小模型规模下，周期结构的计算成本低于学习成本。作者旨在探索:当模型足够小时，显式计算序列的周期性结构（而非依赖注意力机制学习）能更高效地实现零样本时序预测，从而在极低参数预算内达到具有竞争力的预测精度。

Method: TinyCast由三部分组成:(1)零参数频谱检测器，用于提取上下文中的主导周期;(2)相位折叠操作，将输入序列按照检测到的周期进行折叠;(3)膨胀卷积编码器与块自回归分位数解码器，用于建模剩余的非周期结构。整个网络仅使用卷积和矩阵乘法，无注意力机制。模型仅146,505个参数，支持INT8静态量化导出并端到端部署。

Result: TinyCast是GIFT-Eval榜单上参数可确认的所有零样本模型中参数最少的。在概率精度上它定义了尺寸-精度前沿。在无测试数据泄露的零样本条目中，它是唯一低于140万参数且能输出预测分布的模型，所有得分更高的条目参数均不小于该预算。在Chronos-ZS和fev-bench上，领先于它的所有神经模型参数至少是其28倍。

Conclusion: 在极小参数规模下，显式计算周期性结构比学习更高效，TinyCast验证了"计算优于学习"的设计理念在极低预算场景的可行性。它实现了出色的尺寸-精度权衡，并凭借纯卷积/矩阵乘法的架构获得了嵌入式设备上的高效部署能力。

Abstract: We introduce TinyCast, an attention-free zero-shot forecaster that emits a predictive distribution from 146,505 parameters, on the premise that at this size the periodic structure of a context is worth computing rather than learning. A zero-parameter spectral detector supplies the dominant periods, the context is folded on their phase, and a dilated convolutional encoder and a block-autoregressive quantile decoder model the rest. It is smaller than every zero-shot entry on the GIFT-Eval board whose parameter count can be established. On probabilistic accuracy it defines the size-accuracy frontier. Among zero-shot entries declaring no test-data leakage it is the only one below 1.4M parameters that emits a predictive distribution, and every entry scoring better carries at least that budget. On Chronos-ZS and fev-bench every neural model ahead of it carries at least 28 times its parameters. Because the mixing path is convolutions and matrix multiplications only, it exports to static INT8 and forecasts end to end on an embedded device without per-signal fitting.

</details>


### [623] [Temporal Graph Prototype-conditioned Conformal Prediction for Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15768)
*Xudong Chen,Shengbo Gong,Lu Cheng,Wei Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ProtoCP 是一个针对时序交互图边级欺诈检测的共形预测框架，通过聚焦欺诈相关子图上下文进行校准，并引入邻居相对评分与时间分数扩散机制，在四类欺诈基准数据集上以更小预测集实现目标覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边级欺诈检测中假阳性和假阴性代价高昂，共形预测提供的分布无关覆盖保证对风险感知决策很有吸引力。但现有图共形预测器在欺诈数据上预测集低效，原因有二：欺诈交互常嵌入良性主导的邻域中稀释校准信号；极端类别不平衡导致校准集中标注欺诈样本稀缺，产生过于保守的类别条件阈值。

Method: ProtoCP 通过两个核心机制提升校准效率：一是利用学习到的原型（prototypes）抑制校准上下文中良性主导的噪声；二是引入邻居相对评分机制配合时间分数扩散，实现稳定的类别条件校准，从而在类别不平衡和时间漂移下产生更稳定的非一致性分数。

Result: 在 YelpChi、S-FFSD、FTFD 和 BankSim 四个欺诈基准数据集上的实验表明，ProtoCP 在达到目标覆盖率的同时，预测集规模持续小于现有最优基线。

Conclusion: ProtoCP 有效解决了欺诈数据中良性主导邻域稀释校准信号和类别不平衡导致过度保守阈值的问题，为时序图上的边级欺诈检测提供了更高效的不确定性量化方法。

Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free coverage guarantees and has emerged as a principled tool for uncertainty quantification. In edge-level fraud detection on temporal interaction graphs, where false positives and false negatives both carry substantial cost, such coverage guarantees are particularly appealing for risk-aware decision making. However, directly applying existing graph conformal predictors yields inefficient prediction sets due to two recurring properties of fraud data. Fraudulent interactions are often embedded in benign-dominated neighborhoods that dilute calibration signals, while extreme class imbalance leaves scarce labeled-fraud support in the calibration split and leads to overly conservative class-conditional thresholds. To address these issues, we propose ProtoCP, a conformal prediction framework for edge-level fraud detection on temporal graphs. ProtoCP improves calibration efficiency by focusing calibration on fraud-relevant subgraph context and producing more stable nonconformity scores under class imbalance and temporal drift. Specifically, it leverages learned prototypes to suppress benign-dominated noise in the calibration context and introduces a neighborhood-relative scoring mechanism with temporal score diffusion for stable class-conditional calibration. Experiments on four fraud benchmarks (YelpChi, S-FFSD, FTFD, and BankSim) show that ProtoCP achieves the target coverage with consistently smaller prediction sets than state-of-the-art baselines. Our codes are available at https://github.com/Picard1701ent/ProtoCP.git

</details>


### [624] [Routing Divergence Is Not Evidence of Behavioral Influence in Same-Weight MoE Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15787)
*Cedric Caruzzo,Donggeun Yoo,Tae Soo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究MoE模型中“同权重自蒸馏”的盲区：两次前向传播共享所有权重，但门控路由可能将同一token分配到不同专家。作者在单步冻结权重场景下，通过精确的块级分解将路由项与内容项分离，在7个开源检查点和两个领域上测量了路由项对输出的实际影响（暴露度），发现其块级影响范围仅1.6倍，残差流暴露为3.2倍，且该暴露与路由块残差占比一致排序。预注册的PubMedQA补丁实验表明，路由项对输出的影响小于自然上下文效应的一半，且可被匹配范数的噪声大致复现，而内容项则具有强方向特异性。结论是：单纯路由变化不足作为行为影响的证据，应优先测量暴露度，并依据行为干预做决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE中两次共享权重的前向传播可能通过路由将同一token送至不同专家，这造成同权重自蒸馏（demonstration-conditioned teacher监督query-only student）存在潜在盲区——即路由差异可能被误认为行为差异，或反之。先前工作多将其作为完整训练轨迹的代理，作者希望在单步冻结权重的场景下严谨地量化路由变化对输出的真实影响，以纠正可能的因果误判。

Method: 作者提出一种精确的块级分解方法，将输出变化分离为：(1) 路由项（固定内容下的门控变化）和 (2) 类稠密内容项（固定门控下的内容变化）。在7个开源MoE检查点和两个领域上进行测量，以路由项在块输出中的占比及残差流暴露度作为指标。采用两个确认模型通过缩放always-on主干验证暴露度变化方向，并设计common-mode对照以区分质量与相干性机制。随后进行预注册的PubMedQA补丁实验，比较完整路由项与匹配范数噪声的效果，并开展规模与合并专家探针以检验结果的普遍性。

Result: 路由项占块输出的比例范围仅1.6倍，但其残差流暴露度为3.2倍；暴露度与路由块的残差占比排序一致。缩放主干使暴露度单调变化，common-mode对照支持“质量与相干性”机制而非单纯分母稀释。PubMedQA实验中，完整路由项对输出的移动小于自然上下文效应的一半，且被匹配范数噪声大致复现，说明方向特异性弱；内容项则高度方向特异。规模与合并专家探针表明块级窄范围并非普遍现象，但在测试边界处暴露度仍保持较小。

Conclusion: 路由变化本身并不构成行为影响的证据。实践中应首先测量暴露度，当决策关键时应结合行为干预来确认因果影响。这一结论为MoE自蒸馏设置下的模型解释和评估方法提供了重要警示。

Abstract: Two Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) forward passes can share every weight yet route the same token through different experts. This creates a possible blind spot in same-weight self-distillation, where a demonstration-conditioned teacher supervises a query-only student. We study this mismatch in its single-step form, with frozen weights rather than as a proxy for a full training trajectory. An exact blockwise decomposition separates a routing term, which changes gates at fixed content, from a dense-like content term. Across seven open-weight checkpoints and two domains, the routing term spans only $1.6\times$ as a fraction of block output, while its residual-stream exposure spans $3.2\times$. Exposure is ordered by the routed block's share of the residual. Scaling the always-on backbone in two confirmatory models moves exposure monotonically; common-mode controls support a mass-and-coherence mechanism rather than denominator dilution alone. Preregistered PubMedQA patches on three models show that the full routing term moves outputs by less than half the natural context effect and is largely reproduced by matched-norm noise, whereas the content term is strongly direction-specific. Scale and merged-expert probes show that the narrow block-level range is not universal, although exposure remains small at the tested boundaries. Router movement alone is therefore not evidence of behavioral influence: measure exposure first, and use a behavioral intervention when the decision matters.

</details>


### [625] [CrevasseSeg: A Label-Efficient UAV Crevasse Segmentation Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15790)
*Steven Wallace,William D Harcourt,Richard Hann,Aiden Durrant,Somayajulu Sripada,Georgios Leontidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了CrevasseSeg框架，用于冰川裂缝二值分割，包含1,938张无标注UAV正射影像拼接瓦片（自监督微调）、24张标注瓦片（验证）和176张标注瓦片（测试）。基准测试了五种自监督目标和三种架构，核心发现是DINOv3特征在线性探针下最弱但在非线性XGBoost读出下最强，并发布该数据集以支持遥感领域的标签高效分割研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冰川裂缝制图对冰川学研究和野外安全至关重要，但逐像素标注冰川表面成本高昂且需要领域专家。现有方法依赖大量标注数据，缺乏标签高效的分割方案。

Method: 提出CrevasseSeg框架，在Borebreen冰舌区域构建数据集。基准测试五种自监督目标（BYOL、JSD、Barlow-Twins、VICReg、BYOL-JSD组合），跨越三种架构（O-Net、O-Net++、DINOv3初始化的O-Net）。每种配置在两种冻结特征读出下评估：线性探针和非线性XGBoost分类器（仅用24张标注验证图训练）。并利用UMAP分析特征空间结构。

Result: 核心发现是两种读出之间存在一致的倒置关系：DINOv3特征在线性探针下最弱，但在非线性读出下最强。UMAP显示DINOv3将像素分裂成许多小簇且类别局部交织，而卷积架构嵌入到单一类别排序流形上。卫星预训练的DINOv3优于自然图像初始化，标签高效的DINOv3-ViT-L-Sat-O-Net-BYOL-JSD管道达到75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU，优于用相同24张标注图像和RGB像素特征的标准机器学习基线。

Conclusion: 发布CrevasseSeg数据集和框架以支持遥感领域的标签高效分割研究，表明自监督预训练结合卫星图像预训练权重的策略在极低标注条件下具有显著优势，同时揭示了不同特征读出方式对模型评估的关键影响。

Abstract: Crevasse mapping from uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery matters for glaciological research and for field safety in glaciated terrain. Yet, pixel-level annotation of glacier surfaces is costly and requires domain experts. We introduce CrevasseSeg, a framework for binary segmentation over the terminus of Borebreen, Svalbard, comprising 1,938 unlabelled UAV orthomosaic tiles for self-supervised/unsupervised fine-tuning, 24 labelled tiles for validation and 176 labelled tiles for testing. Using CrevasseSeg, we benchmark five self-supervised objectives -- BYOL, a Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) objective, Barlow-Twins, VICReg, and a combined BYOL-JSD objective -- across three architectures: O-Net, O-Net++, and a DINOv3-initialised O-Net. Each configuration is evaluated under two frozen-feature readouts that differ only in the form of their decision boundary: a linear probe and a non-linear XGBoost classifier fit only on the 24 labelled validation images. Our central finding is a consistent inversion between the two readouts: DINOv3 features are the weakest under linear probing but the strongest under a non-linear readout. A UMAP analysis of the learned feature space shows that DINOv3 fragments pixels into many small clusters in which the classes are locally interleaved, whereas the convolutional architectures (O-Net and O-Net++) embed them onto a single class-sorted manifold. Satellite-pretrained DINOv3 improves over natural-image initialisation across objectives, and our label-efficient DINOv3-ViT-L-Sat-O-Net-BYOL-JSD pipeline reaches 75.33 mDSC / 61.28 mIoU, outperforming standard machine learning baselines fit on the same 24 labelled images with the RGB pixel values used as features. We release CrevasseSeg to support label-efficient segmentation research in remote sensing.

</details>


### [626] [A Pre-Specified Construction-Confirmation Test of Operation-Level Causal Transfer Across Finite Isomorphic Symbolic Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15809)
*Xinyi Shan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在有限同构状态空间中，通过输入端特异性干预实验验证了模型中是否存在从符号域到另一个符号域的操作级结构转移。在冻结的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型第20-21层，唯一通过预注册PyVenne检验的候选（integer_mod16→letters16, successor→predecessor）的确认p值为0.000198，家族调整p值为0.006943。随后的NNsight 0.7.0复现实验在预注册条件下成功复制了全部12个确认效应估计值和置信区间，调整p值为0.007141，但结论仅限单一路径、单一候选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的工作仅通过行为准确率、线性可解码性和成功的激活干预来推断模型具有跨符号域的运算级结构，这些证据并不充分。作者提出更窄、更严格的问题：在有限同构状态空间中，若对每个源输入分别估计两个运算的隐状态差异，再将该差异加到映射后的接收端输入上，是否能使模型朝对应接收端答案的方向移动？这旨在更直接地检验模型是否真正携带运算层面的跨域结构。

Method: 设计包含输入端特异性干预（input-specific intervention）方法，并设置四种对照：错误运算对照、范数匹配随机对照、无操作对照。将候选构建与确认阶段分离，确认分裂独立隔离。在冻结的Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型第20-21层进行实验，使用预注册并冻结的候选家族。使用PyVenne分裂检验识别显著候选，随后用NNsight 0.7.0在预注册条件下对选中的唯一候选进行独立复现。

Result: 唯一通过预注册检验的候选为transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor，其确认交集-并集p值为0.000198，36家族Holm调整p值为0.006943。NNsight复现实验在无候选或层重新选择的情况下，数值复现了全部12个确认效应估计、置信区间和精确符号翻转p值，调整p值为0.007141。

Conclusion: 该结果仅对一个提示路径和一个候选有效，且在单一模型版本和单一层区间上通过两种干预实现方式得到复现。研究不声称跨模型泛化、全家族后端独立性、域通用迁移或代数不变性。这体现了对神经语言模型内部结构主张的严谨、保守的验证态度。

Abstract: Behavioral accuracy, linear decodability, and successful activation interventions do not by themselves show that a model carries an operation-level structure from one symbolic domain to another. We ask a narrower question in finite isomorphic state spaces: if the hidden-state difference between two operations is estimated separately for each source input, does adding that difference to a mapped recipient input move the model toward the corresponding recipient answer? The design compares this input-specific intervention with wrong-operation, norm-matched random, and no-op controls, and separates candidate construction from an independently isolated confirmation split. On a frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model at layers 20--21, one route--domain--operation candidate from a family pre-specified and frozen before confirmation access, transparent | integer_mod16--letters16 | successor->predecessor, passed both PyVene splits; its confirmation intersection--union p-value was 0.000198 and its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.006943. A subsequent NNsight 0.7.0 experiment, pre-specified and frozen before its confirmation access, tested only this selected prompt route, without candidate or layer reselection. It reproduced all 12 confirmation effect estimates, confidence intervals, and exact sign-flip p-values numerically; its 36-family Holm-adjusted p-value was 0.007141. The result is therefore limited to one prompt route and one candidate, replicated across two intervention implementations on one model revision and one layer interval. It does not establish cross-model generalization, full-family backend independence, domain-general transfer, or algebraic invariance.

</details>


### [627] [KOALA: Koopman Operator Learning for WiFi-Based Anticipatory Hum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15815)
*Quang-Anh N. D.,Duc Pham Minh,Thao Phuong Pham,Minh Anh Nguyen,Huan X. Nguyen,Tuan Dang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KOALA是一个直接从WiFi CSI信号进行人体运动预测的框架，通过将噪声的CSI姿态序列提升到学习得到的Koopman潜空间，使非线性动力学变为线性，并通过简单的矩阵-向量乘积实现多时间跨度预测，避免自回归迭代带来的误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于WiFi CSI的人体姿态估计方法将姿态推断视为瞬时回归问题，未建模时间动态，无法进行未来运动预测。直接套用基于视觉的预测方法会放大CSI姿态中已有的估计噪声（自回归展开在每一步都会放大误差），因此需要一种能够在噪声条件下进行鲁棒多跨度运动预测的方法。

Method: KOALA包含三个关键组件：(1) 将噪声CSI姿态序列提升到学习的Koopman潜空间，使非线性动力学线性化，通过矩阵-向量乘法实现多跨度预测；(2) 残差CSI条件算子解决Koopman公式固有的恒等吸引子问题；(3) 锚点-增量预测头消除在所有时间跨度上复制当前姿态的退化捷径。此外提出Koopman锚定潜空间（KAL）损失，在时间编码器特征空间中联合正则化提升和算子，强制预测跨度间的动力学一致性，且无需对比、谱或辅助损失。

Result: 在MM-Fi和WiPose两个数据集上的实验表明，KOALA在短长期预测跨度上均表现稳健且一致，显著超越所有基线方法。

Conclusion: KOALA验证了将Koopman算子理论应用于WiFi CSI运动预测的可行性，通过潜空间线性化有效规避了自回归误差累积和估计噪声放大的问题，为隐私保护的人体运动预测提供了新范式。

Abstract: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has emerged as a privacy-preserving alternative to cameras for human pose estimation. However, existing approaches treat pose inference as an instantaneous regression problem and do not model temporal dynamics, making future motion prediction infeasible. Naively applying vision-based prediction methods compounds the estimation noise already present in CSI-derived poses, as autoregressive rollouts amplify errors at every step. We propose KOALA, the framework for human motion prediction directly from WiFi CSI, by lifting noisy CSI-derived pose sequences into a learned Koopman latent space where nonlinear dynamics become linear, enabling multi-horizon prediction via simple matrix-vector products without autoregressive iteration or error accumulation. A residual CSI-conditioned operator resolves the identity attractor problem inherent from Koopman formulations, and an anchor-delta prediction head eliminates the degenerate shortcut of copying the current pose across all horizons. To regularise the lifting and operator jointly, we introduce a Koopman Anchored Latent (KAL) loss that operates in the temporal-encoder feature space, enforcing dynamical consistency across prediction horizons without requiring contrastive, spectral, or auxiliary losses. Experiments on MM-Fi and WiPose show that KOALA achieves robust, consistent performance across both short- and long-term prediction horizons, outperforming all baselines by a substantial margin.

</details>


### [628] [Second-Moment Memory in Coordinatewise Adam](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15824)
*Jeonseong Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了Adam优化器中二阶矩记忆（分母中过去梯度平方的滑动平均）会抑制优化进展。即使在有限方差随机梯度下，长二阶矩记忆也会显著减慢收敛速度，其导致的平均平稳性下界与记忆长度M2=(1-β2)^{-1}的平方根倒数同阶。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam优化器在分母中保持过去平方梯度的滑动平均，但这一记忆对优化成本的影响尚未被充分理解。作者希望从理论角度阐明二阶矩记忆如何影响优化进度，特别是即使梯度噪声方差有限时是否仍会损害收敛。

Method: 作者首先针对一个简单的两点查询模型（two-point oracle）进行理论分析，证明在初始化暂态之后，期望的正则化更新量以O(M2^{-1/2})为界。随后将此方向性边界，在给定记忆和步长缩放条件下，转化为光滑凸问题上的平均平稳性下界，该问题具有归一化的间隙、光滑性和方差。

Result: 理论结果表明，在有限方差随机梯度下，Adam的二阶矩记忆长度M2=(1-β2)^{-1}会导致优化停滞：期望正更新量以O(M2^{-1/2})为界，对应的平均平稳性下界也与同阶相关。长二阶矩记忆会减缓优化速度，即使梯度噪声方差是有限的。

Conclusion: Adam中较长的二阶矩记忆不仅不是无害的，反而会从机制上抑制优化进展。即使梯度噪声方差有限，长二阶矩记忆也会造成显著的收敛速率下降，这对Adam及其变体在实际应用中的超参数选择具有重要启示。

Abstract: Adam retains a moving average of past squared gradients in its denominator, but the optimization cost of this memory is not well understood. We show that second-moment memory can itself suppress progress toward the optimum even under finite-variance stochastic gradients. For a simple two-point oracle, the expected positive normalized update is $O(M_2^{-1/2})$ after an initialization transient, where $M_2=(1-β_2)^{-1}$ is the second-moment memory length. We convert this directional bound, under the stated memory and stepsize scaling, into an average-stationarity lower bound of the same order on a smooth convex problem with normalized gap, smoothness, and variance. Long second-moment memory can slow optimization even when the gradient noise has finite variance.

</details>


### [629] [Geometry of Forgetting: Representation Flux in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15854)
*Maksim A. Kazanskii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"表示通量"（representation flux）这一几何度量来刻画持续学习中样本级表示位移与灾难性遗忘的关联，并基于此提出架构无关的正则化方法FlowLess-R，通过在回放方法中约束重放表示相对存储参考的稳定性，在多个基准数据集上提升最终平均准确率并减少遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习的根本障碍，现有方法主要通过参数正则化或经验回放来缓解遗忘，但表示空间中与遗忘相关的动态演变仍缺乏深入理解。作者旨在揭示潜在表示演化过程与遗忘之间的几何关联，并利用这一洞察设计更有效的缓解策略。

Method: 1) 引入"表示通量"（representation flux），一种度量训练过程中样本级表示位移的几何量；2) 通过时序分析证明表示通量与遗忘强相关，且升高的通量可能先于性能退化出现；3) 提出FlowLess-R，一种表示空间正则化方法，约束回放表示相对于存储参考的表示匹配项，允许网络继续学习的同时稳定潜在表示；该方法架构无关，可无缝集成到ER、DER++、ER-ACE等回放方法中。

Result: 在SplitMNIST、SplitFashionMNIST、SplitCIFAR10和SplitTinyImageNet四个基准上，FlowLess-R与ER、DER++、ER-ACE结合后均提升了最终平均准确率并降低了遗忘程度。实验也验证了表示通量是可提供遗忘预警信息的几何标记。

Conclusion: 表示通量是灾难性遗忘的有效几何标记，稳定潜在表示是缓解持续学习中灾难性遗忘的简单有效策略，FlowLess-R作为一种轻量、架构无关的正则化手段可广泛适用于现有回放类持续学习方法。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting remains a fundamental obstacle to continual learning, where neural networks lose previously acquired knowledge while learning new tasks. Existing methods primarily mitigate forgetting through parameter regularization or experience replay, while the representation-space dynamics associated with forgetting remain less understood. We investigate latent representation evolution during sequential learning and introduce representation flux, a geometric measure of sample-level representation displacement across training. We show that representation flux is strongly associated with catastrophic forgetting across multiple benchmarks, with temporal analyses indicating that elevated flux can precede subsequent performance degradation. Representation displacement is also associated with confidence degradation, while complementary geometric properties provide additional information about sample-level forgetting. Motivated by these observations, we propose FlowLess-R, a representation-space regularization method that constrains replay representations relative to stored references while allowing continued learning. FlowLess-R is architecture-agnostic and integrates into replay-based methods through a representation-matching term. Experiments on SplitMNIST, SplitFashionMNIST, SplitCIFAR10, and SplitTinyImageNet show improved final average accuracy and reduced forgetting with ER, DER++, and ER-ACE. Our results identify representation flux as an informative geometric marker of forgetting and show that stabilizing latent representations provides a simple strategy for mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

</details>


### [630] [TransfHAR: Self-Supervised Wrist Representations for On-Demand Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15861)
*Aidan Bradshaw,Riku Arakawa,Xin Liu,Karan Ahuja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TransfHAR 是一个基于自监督学习的腕部 IMU 活动识别框架，通过从粗粒度、无标签的日常活动中预训练学习可迁移的运动先验，实现在仅有少量演示样本的情况下进行细粒度活动识别，并在真实智能手表上运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度腕部活动识别可支持程序步骤指导和情境感知辅助等应用，但为每个新任务、新用户和新活动粒度获取标注数据仍然是瓶颈，需要一种无需大量标注即可迁移到细粒度活动识别的方法。

Method: TransfHAR 采用自监督预训练策略，从全局无标签的粗粒度腕部 IMU 活动（如坐、走、锻炼）中学习运动结构先验，再迁移至训练中未出现的细粒度操作、手势和程序性活动（如弹指、搅拌、挥手）。系统实现为实时智能手表应用，允许用户通过少量演示自定义活动集合。

Result: 在三个离线跨数据集评估中，TransfHAR 相比使用完整标签集和相同或更多传感器通道的完全监督基线，平均提升 6.2 个平衡准确率点。在 10 名参与者各执行 7 种新型腕部活动的实验室研究中，每类 5 个样本时达到 86.7% 的平衡准确率，每类使用一段一分钟录音更新后可达到 90.4%。

Conclusion: 广泛的自监督腕部预训练为按需细粒度活动识别提供了有效基础，证明了自监督预训练学到的运动结构足以泛化到未见过的细粒度活动，缓解了标注数据稀缺的瓶颈。

Abstract: Fine-grained wrist activity recognition can support applications such as procedural step guidance and context-aware assistance, yet acquiring labeled data for every new task, user, and activity granularity remains a bottleneck. We present TransfHAR, a self-supervised wrist IMU framework for on-demand, fine-grained activity recognition by learning transferable motion priors from global, unlabeled activities. We show that self-supervised pretraining on coarse wrist IMU activities (e.g., sitting, walking, exercise) learns motion structure rich enough to transfer to fine-grained manipulative, gestural, and procedural activities (e.g., snapping, stirring, waving) that are absent from pretraining. We implement TransfHAR as a real-time smartwatch application that lets users define and expand their own activity set for personalized recognition from only a few demonstrations. Across three offline cross-dataset evaluations, TransfHAR matches or exceeds fully supervised baselines that use complete label sets with equal or additional sensor channels, by 6.2 balanced-accuracy points on average. In an in-lab study with 10 participants each performing seven novel wrist activities, TransfHAR reaches 86.7% balanced accuracy across participants with five examples per class and 90.4% when updated from a single one-minute recording per class. These results indicate that broad self-supervised wrist pretraining provides an effective foundation for on-demand fine-grained activity recognition.

</details>


### [631] [Feasible and Novel Synthetic Population Generation with Tabular and Sequential Travel Attributes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15867)
*Farbod Abbasi,Zachary Patterson,Bilal Farooq*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个正则化的两阶段生成框架用于合成人口生成：第一阶段用带三项正则（IGP, LDR, CLAP）的WGAN-GP生成表格化社会人口属性，第二阶段用Transformer或LSTM-Attention生成序列出行行为（出发时间、出行目的、出行方式）。实验表明正则化模型在可行性、多样性、新颖性上均优于基线WGAN-GP，且跨阶段一致性得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于活动（activity-based）的出行需求模型需要合成人口作为关键输入，但从小样本调查数据生成现实人口存在挑战：小样本导致采样零（sampling zeros）缺失有效属性组合，生成模型可能产生不可行的结构零，且合成人口需同时捕捉静态社会人口属性和序列出行行为（如出行链）。

Method: 提出正则化两阶段生成框架。Stage 1使用Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty（WGAN-GP）并增强三项正则化损失：IGP、LDR和CLAP，以提升表格化人口合成的可行性、多样性和新颖性。Stage 2分别用Transformer和LSTM-Attention模型，基于合成的表格化档案条件生成序列出行属性（出发时间、出行目的、出行方式）。同时引入新颖性和计数感知指标，评估有效未见组合是否以现实比例被恢复和生成。

Result: 正则化模型在可行性、多样性和新颖性上均优于vanilla WGAN-GP。正则化使可行性提升2.1至3.7个百分点，新颖性提升6.6至10.0个百分点，F1分数提升6.3至8.6个百分点。序列生成方面，LSTM-Attention在出行长度分布上最佳匹配，Transformer整体序列F1更高（90.6%对89.1%）。跨阶段验证确认生成的出行状态与出行链间具有强一致性。

Conclusion: 正则化策略能有效缓解采样零和结构零问题，在提升合成人口覆盖率的同时不牺牲可行性。两阶段框架成功地将表格化人口合成与序列出行行为生成相结合，且跨阶段结果一致性良好，表明该框架可支撑活动型出行需求建模的实际应用。

Abstract: Synthetic populations are critical inputs for activity-based travel demand models, yet generating realistic populations from limited survey data remains challenging. Small samples miss valid attribute combinations, known as sampling zeros, and generative models may also produce infeasible structural zeros. Moreover, realistic synthetic populations must capture both static socio-demographic attributes and sequential travel behaviour, such as trip chains. This paper proposes a regularized two-stage generative framework to address these challenges, where regularization refers to additional loss terms that guide the generator toward broader valid coverage and fewer infeasible samples. In Stage 1, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty is augmented with three regularization terms, IGP, LDR, and CLAP, to improve feasibility, diversity, and novelty in tabular population synthesis. In Stage 2, Transformer and LSTM-Attention models generate sequential travel attributes, including departure time, trip purpose, and travel mode, conditioned on the synthesized tabular profiles. We also introduce novelty and count-aware metrics to evaluate whether valid unseen combinations are recovered and generated in realistic proportions. Results show that regularized models outperform the vanilla WGAN-GP across feasibility, diversity, and novelty. Regularization increases feasibility by 2.1 to 3.7 percentage points and novelty by 6.6 to 10.0 percentage points, improving sampling-zero recovery without sacrificing feasibility. The F1 score improves by 6.3 to 8.6 percentage points. For sequential attributes, LSTM-Attention best matches the trip-length distribution, while Transformer achieves higher overall sequential F1, 90.6\% versus 89.1\%. Cross-stage validation confirms strong consistency between generated mobility status and generated trip chains.

</details>


### [632] [Deploying Frontier Agentic Technology in MOOSEnger, a Multiphysics-Capable AI Assistant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15881)
*Zaid Abulawi,Mengnan Li,Guillaume Giudicelli,Yang Liu,Cody Permann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了MOOSEnger——一个基于MOOSE框架的领域特定AI代理，并扩展了其本地托管模型的支持能力。该代理通过完整的pipeline（从MOOSE仓库检索上下文知识、与仿真执行环境交互验证输入、将经验存储到持久记忆）来辅助多物理场仿真工作流。在VTB工程问题及8类仿真任务（共200个案例）上评估，MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2达到90%成功率，MOOSEnger-Gemma4为76.5%，而基线模型仅5%和0%，证明了代理框架的显著价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多物理场仿真环境（如MOOSE）的使用需要高度专业化的知识，对领域科学家和工程师构成了使用门槛。作者旨在通过构建一个具备完整工作流（检索、验证、记忆）的AI代理，降低使用MOOSE框架的难度，提升仿真任务的自动化效率和成功率。

Method: MOOSEnger代理包含三个核心组件：(1) 从MOOSE仓库检索上下文知识的检索模块；(2) 通过与仿真可执行环境交互来验证和诊断输入的执行模块；(3) 将经验教训提取并存储在持久记忆中的记忆模块。代理支持本地托管的模型，并在8个仿真类别（扩散、Navier-Stokes、相场、塑性、多孔介质流、固体力学、瞬态传热、反应堆网格生成）各25个案例上进行了评估，对比了四种配置：MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2、MOOSEnger-Gemma4以及无代理能力的GPT-5.2和Gemma4基线。

Result: MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2达到90%的成功率，略优于MOOSEnger-Gemma4的76.5%。无代理能力的基线模型表现远差：GPT-5.2仅5%、Gemma4为0%。代理框架（harness）带来了显著的性能提升，且已在INL国家反应堆创新中心虚拟测试台（VTB）的真实工程问题上得到验证。

Conclusion: 代理化框架（检索-验证-记忆pipeline）是提升LLM在MOOSE多物理场仿真任务上表现的关键因素，显著优于原生模型的直接使用。即使较弱的开源模型（Gemma4）在代理支持下也能达到76.5%的成功率，表明该方法具有降低多物理场仿真领域专业门槛的潜力。

Abstract: The Multiphysics Object-Oriented Simulation Environment (MOOSE) is an open-source finite-element framework for building multiphysics simulation applications. Using a multiphysics environment effectively demands specialized expertise, creating a barrier for many domain scientists and engineers. MOOSEnger, developed at Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is a domain-specific, tool-enabled AI agent built for the MOOSE Framework. This work extends MOOSEnger with a harness focused on locally-hosted models. The harness gives the agent a full pipeline: it retrieves contextual knowledge from the MOOSE repository, validates and diagnoses the resulting input through interaction with the simulation executable environment, and extracts and stores lessons in a persistent memory.
  The resulting framework is demonstrated on an engineering problem from the National Reactor Innovation Center Virtual Test Bed (VTB), illustrating its potential to support realistic multiphysics simulation workflows. Additionally, the agent performance is evaluated on different categories including diffusion, Navier--Stokes, phase field, plasticity, porous media flow, solid mechanics, transient heat transfer, and reactor mesh generation. Each category consists of 25 prompts/cases. We compare MOOSEnger-Gemma4 against MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2, alongside baseline Gemma4 and GPT-5.2 without agentic capabilities. MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2 shows a slight edge, achieving a 90\% success rate versus 76.5\% for MOOSEnger-Gemma4. The baseline models perform far worse, at just 5\% (GPT-5.2) and 0\% (Gemma4), underscoring the impact of the agentic harness.

</details>


### [633] [Layers Matter: Why Continual Learning Regularization Should Be Layer-Adaptive](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15901)
*Brian B. Moser,Ahmed Anwar,Tobias Christian Nauen,Shishir Muralidhara,Federico Raue,René Schuster,Stanislav Frolov,Andreas Dengel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出持续学习正则化方法（如EWC）使用对角Fisher作为参数重要性度量，但忽略了每一层Hessian矩阵的top特征值信息，而这一信息恰恰控制着遗忘。在块对角Hessian假设下，作者证明了遗忘可以分解为按各层top Hessian特征值加权的逐层项之和，对角Fisher权重无法捕捉这些特征值。基于此理论，作者提出简单策略：强保护浅层，允许深层自由移动，并将其应用于EWC和SLCA，在平均性能与遗忘指标上均有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习正则化方法（如EWC）使用逐参数的对角Fisher重要性权重来防止遗忘，但这种对角近似是对每层Hessian曲率的弱概括，丢失了控制遗忘的关键top特征值信息。对抗性比特翻转攻击和Hessian谱研究表明，不同层之间的这种敏感性差异可跨越多个数量级，因此需要从理论上理解并利用逐层曲率信息来改进正则化策略。

Method: 在块对角Hessian假设下（即每层Hessian为对角块的模拟EWC中已有的对角假设），作者从理论上证明：(1) 遗忘可分解为按各层top Hessian特征值加权的逐层项之和；(2) 对角Fisher权重无法恢复该特征值信息，例如Fisher均值相同的两层，其top特征值差异可达层宽度量级；(3) 在相同遗忘水平下，统一正则化丢失的新任务性能随层条件数缩放。基于理论推导，提出"强保护浅层、放开深层"的简单训练配方，并应用于EWC和SLCA。

Result: 将所提出的"保护浅层、放开深层"配方应用于EWC和SLCA后，在平均性能和遗忘指标上均取得明显改进，验证了理论分析的有效性。

Conclusion: 逐层而非逐参数是持续学习正则化中更合适的粒度：每层的top Hessian特征值才是决定遗忘的关键因素，而对角Fisher权重无法捕获这一信息。简单的"强保护浅层、放开深层"策略能够在不增加复杂性的情况下显著改善持续学习性能。

Abstract: Continual learning regularizers like EWC fight forgetting by penalizing changes from previous-task parameters with per-parameter importance, typically diagonal Fisher values. Per-parameter looks more flexible than per-layer, but each layer's diagonal Fisher is a weak summary of its actual curvature, missing the top-eigenvalue information that controls forgetting. Adversarial bit-flip attacks and Hessian-spectrum studies show that this missing per-layer sensitivity spans orders of magnitude in neural networks. Under a block-diagonal Hessian assumption, the layer-level analogue of EWC's existing diagonal assumption, we prove three things. Forgetting decomposes as a sum of per-layer terms weighted by each layer's top Hessian eigenvalue. Diagonal-Fisher weights cannot recover this eigenvalue. For instance, two layers with identical Fisher averages can have top eigenvalues differing by a factor as large as the layer width. For the same level of forgetting, uniform regularization loses new-task performance by an amount scaling with the layer condition number. Our theoretical analysis leads to a simple recipe: protect early layers strongly, let deeper layers move. We apply this recipe to EWC and SLCA and show clear improvements in average performance and forgetting metrics.

</details>


### [634] [Information Geometry of Message Passing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15922)
*Mykola Lukashchuk,Kyrylo Yemets,Alex Ledbetter,İsmail Şenöz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自然梯度消息传递（NGMP）方法。在Forney式因子图上，变分推断的自然梯度平稳条件具有边缘局部形式：在静止点，某条边的自然参数等于来自两个相邻因子的投影消息之和。每条投影消息是精确置信传播对数消息在当前接收边际上的自然梯度投影，或等价于其期望在均值坐标下的梯度。NGMP相比变分消息传递（VMP）保留了接收族能表示的精确消息部分，而非在相邻信念下对因子取平均，在非共轭因子边缘存在不确定性时更准确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变分消息传递（VMP）在处理非共轭因子时，通过将因子在相邻信念下取平均来近似消息，当边缘不确定性持续存在时（如部分观测的潜在链或参数逐批过滤），这种近似过于粗糙，导致不确定性校准不佳。作者希望从自然梯度平稳条件出发，推导一种能保留更多精确消息信息的局部消息传递规则。

Method: 从Bethe自由能出发，将选定的边边际约束到指数族。推导自然梯度平稳条件，发现其具有边缘局部形式：边参数=两个投影消息之和。每个投影消息为精确BP对数消息在当前接收边际上的自然梯度投影，即其在均值坐标下的期望梯度。由此定义NGMP规则——每条边可携带自身指数族，某因子发送的消息依赖于接收它的当前边际。

Result: 在泊松平滑、异方差回归、按小时ETTh预测等实验中，NGMP在不确定性校准方面优于VMP。当非共轭因子输入边上的不确定性消失时两者一致；当不确定性持续存在时NGMP更准确，增益主要体现在不确定性校准上。

Conclusion: NGMP提供了一种比VMP更精确的变分消息传递方案，通过在非共轭因子上保持接收边际中的不确定性信息来改善推断精度，尤其在不确定性校准方面具有显著优势。

Abstract: We show that the natural-gradient stationary condition of variational inference has an edge-local form on a Forney-style factor graph. We start from the Bethe free energy and constrain a selected edge marginal to an exponential family. At a stationary point, the natural parameter of that edge equals the sum of two projected messages, one from each incident factor. Each projected message is the natural-gradient projection of the exact belief-propagation log-message at the current receiving marginal, or equivalently, the gradient of its expectation in the so-called mean coordinates. We call the resulting scheme natural-gradient message passing (NGMP). The rule is local; each edge may carry its own exponential family, and the message a factor sends depends on the marginal that receives it. Compared with variational message passing, NGMP keeps the part of the exact message that the receiving family can represent instead of averaging the factor under the neighboring beliefs. The two coincide when the uncertainty on the edges entering a non-conjugate factor vanishes, and NGMP is more accurate when that uncertainty persists, for example, along a partially observed latent chain or when parameters are filtered through successive data batches. Experiments on Poisson smoothing, heteroskedastic regression, and hourly ETTh forecasting confirm this and show that the gain appears mainly in uncertainty calibration.

</details>


### [635] [ReliaGate: Reliability Routing for Low-Stakes Wearable Stress Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15951)
*Jaden Moon,Yu Wu,Arvind Pillai,Andrew Campbell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究可穿戴压力系统中的"何时上报预测而非更改预测"问题。在低风险反思与总结场景中，仅靠整体精度不够，因为保留（不输出）标签虽可降低错误，却可能让部分用户得不到任何信息。作者提出固定标签可靠性路由框架：在锁定分类器输出协议定义的应激/非应激标签后，由后置门控器（gate）决定上报该未修改标签或将其标记为不可用而保留。所提方法 ReliaGate 将置信度、信号质量/可信度、一致性、训练标准化非典型性及训练拟合几何特征等线索组合为后置正确性评分。在四个可穿戴数据集上，采用受试者不相交折、验证集选择路由、配对保留受试者区间及合并/逐受试者分析进行评估。WESAD 点估计和 UBFC-Phys 主要覆盖率/风险区间支持 ReliaGate，E4 检查结果混合。ReliaGate 为研究被上报标签的错误率、输出可用性及跨受试者的接受输出分布提供了操作性框架，但不修改标签，也不提供临床或有限样本风险保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在低风险的可穿戴应激反思与总结场景中，系统的整体聚合精度不足以衡量其实用性：当系统选择保留（不输出）预测时，整体错误可能下降，但部分用户可能因此获得极少甚至没有信息。因此需要一个能权衡"错误减少"与"信息可用性"的路由机制，而非简单地修改或改变预测标签。

Method: 提出固定标签可靠性路由（fixed-label reliability routing）框架：锁定分类器先输出协议定义的应激/非应激标签，后置门控器再决定上报该不变标签或将其保留为不可用。具体方法 ReliaGate 将五类线索——置信度、信号质量/可信度、分类器一致性、训练标准化非典型性、训练拟合几何特征——组合成一个后置正确性评分。

Result: 在四个可穿戴数据集上采用受试者不相交折、验证选择路由、配对保留受试者间隔及合并与逐受试者分析进行评估。WESAD 上点估计支持 ReliaGate，UBFC-Phys 上主要覆盖率/风险区间支持 ReliaGate，E4 检查结果各指标表现不一（混合）。

Conclusion: ReliaGate 为可穿戴应激系统提供了一个操作性框架，用于研究上报标签错误率、输出可用性以及跨受试者的接受输出分布，而不改变标签本身。作者明确指出该方法不提供临床或有限样本风险保证，定位为低风险反思与总结场景的工具。

Abstract: We study when a wearable stress system should surface a prediction rather than change it. In low-stakes reflection and summary settings, aggregate accuracy is insufficient because withholding can reduce error while leaving some people with little or no information. We formulate fixed-label reliability routing: after a locked classifier emits a protocol-defined stress/non-stress label, a post-hoc gate surfaces that unchanged label or withholds it as unavailable. ReliaGate assembles established confidence, signal-quality/trust, agreement, train-standardized atypicality, and train-fitted geometry cues into a post-hoc correctness score. We evaluate four wearable datasets using subject-disjoint folds, validation-selected routing, paired held-out-subject intervals, and pooled and per-subject analyses. WESAD point estimates favored ReliaGate, UBFC-Phys primary coverage/risk intervals favored ReliaGate, and E4 checks were mixed. ReliaGate provides an operational framework for studying surfaced-label error, output availability, and accepted-output distribution across subjects, without revising labels or providing clinical or finite-sample risk guarantees.

</details>


### [636] [Beat the Counter First: A Baseline for Temporal-Graph Anomaly Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15965)
*Omair Shafi Ahmed,Zohair Shafi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SimpleCount，一个无需参数拟合的强基线，仅从固定特征池中选择单个标量特征用于流式图异常检测。实验表明SimpleCount在六个数据集中的三个匹配或超过SLADE，在所有六个数据集上超过IsoForest，且推理速度快23-133倍，凸显了复杂模型收益的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式图异常检测领域的研究趋势是架构日益复杂（从count-min-sketch卡方检验到记忆增强注意力网络），但这些复杂架构带来的实际增益从未被系统评估。作者质疑：复杂的模型是否真的比简单基线更有效？缺乏一个强且计算成本低的参考来验证复杂方法的真实贡献。

Method: 提出SimpleCount基线：从固定特征池（计数、最近发生时间、首次出现指示器及计数派生变换）中为每个数据集选择单个标量特征，无需任何参数拟合。将其与两个时序图检测器模型（包括SLADE）及以完整特征向量为输入的IsoForest对照，在五个公开数据集和一个合成数据集上进行对比，并采用配对统计检验和五种子SLADE评估。

Result: SimpleCount在六个数据集中的三个上匹配或超过SLADE，在所有六个数据集上超过IsoForest。SLADE的运行时间比SimpleCount慢23-133倍。在Synth-Triangle和新增的Synth-Quad探针上，事件前结构评分以最高0.955的AUC恢复植入信号，而所有被评估的检测器模型接近随机水平。

Conclusion: 复杂模型的收益是依赖数据集的，并非普遍优于简单基线。研究者应在报告任何增益时，将其与强单特征参考以及计算成本一起呈报，以更公平地评估复杂GAD模型的真实价值。

Abstract: Progress in streaming, edge-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) has been marked by increasingly elaborate architectures, from count-min-sketch chi square tests to memory-augmented attention networks. Yet the empirical gains attributable to this added complexity have not been systematically evaluated. We propose SimpleCount, a reference with no parameter fitting that selects one scalar feature per dataset from a fixed pool of counts, recencies, first-occurrence indicators, and count-derived transforms. We compare SimpleCount with two temporal-graph detector models and an IsoForest control fitted to the complete feature vector across five public datasets and one synthetic dataset. SimpleCount matches or exceeds SLADE on three of six datasets and exceeds IsoForest on all six. We report paired statistical tests and five-seed SLADE evaluations. SLADE requires 23 to 133x more wall-clock time than SimpleCount. On Synth-Triangle and an additional Synth-Quad probe, pre-event structural scores recover the planted signal at AUC up to 0.955, while all evaluated detector models remain near random. The benefit of complexity is dataset-dependent, and every claimed gain should be reported against a strong one-feature reference together with its compute cost.

</details>


### [637] [A Banach-Space Theory of Markovian Halpern Iteration for Non-Expansive Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15966)
*Ege C. Kaya,Arda Fazla,M. Berk Sahin,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG
